articles.title: Exact Fractional Chern Insulators from Hubbard Interactions
articles.title_zh: 哈伯德相互作用的精确分数陈绝缘子
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.25010v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Laughlin's wavefunction and its parent interaction, Haldane's pseudopotential, underpin our analytic understanding of fractional quantum Hall effect. They are an exact pair in the sense that the wavefunction is the unique, zero-energy ground state of its frustration-free parent Hamiltonian. In this work, we propose exact pairs of many-body wavefunctions for fractional Chern insulators in tight binding models with onsite Hubbard interactions as their parents. The key to our construction is introduction of a Landau-dual Chern band, a multi-orbital Chern band obtained from directly sampling the spin-s Dirac Landau level on a Bravais lattice. The exact many-body wavefunctions are given, analytically, in terms of the matrix coordinate X+iY+J, where (X,Y) are the lattice coordinates and J is a nilpotent matrix in spin space. The constructed exact pairs cover the fractional Chern states of the Laughlin, the Read-Rezayi, and the Halperin series. Our results prove that FCI ground states exist beyond ideal bands.
articles.abstract_zh: 劳克林的波函数及其母体相互作用，霍尔丹的赝势，支撑了我们对分数量子霍尔效应的分析理解。它们是精确的一对，因为波函数是其无挫折父哈密顿量的独特的零能量基态。在这项工作中，我们提出了紧束缚模型中分数陈绝缘体的精确多体波函数对，以现场哈伯德相互作用作为其父母。我们构建的关键是引入朗道对偶陈氏带，这是通过直接对布拉维晶格上的自旋-s 狄拉克朗道能级进行采样而获得的多轨道陈氏带。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 劳克林的波函数及其母体相互作用，霍尔丹的赝势，支撑了我们对分数量子霍尔效应的分析理解。它们是精确的一对，因为波函数是其无挫折父哈密顿量的独特的零能量基态。在这项工作中，我们提出了紧束缚模型中分数陈绝缘体的精确多体波函数对，以现场哈伯德相互作用作为其父母。我们构建的关键是引入朗道对偶陈氏带，这是通过直接对布拉维晶格上的自旋-s 狄拉克朗道能级进行采样而获得的多轨道陈氏带。精确的多体波函数以矩阵坐标 X+iY+J 的形式给出，其中 (X,Y) 是晶格坐标，J 是自旋空间中的幂零矩阵。构建的精确对涵盖了 Laughlin、Read-Rezayi 和 Halperin 级数的分数陈状态。我们的结果证明 FCI 基态存在于理想能带之外。

articles.title: Umklapp-enhanced high-T_c topological superconductivity mediated by magnons in p-wave magnets
articles.title_zh: P波磁体中磁振子介导的Umklapp增强高温拓扑超导性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.25015v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We show that magnon exchange can induce nodal topological superconductivity in a microscopic model of a p-wave magnet. Solving the weak-coupling multiband gap equation for itinerant electrons exchange-coupled to localized spins, we find a nodal p-wave gap and a critical temperature that rises sharply as the Fermi surface approaches the magnetic Brillouin-zone boundary. In this regime, small-reduced-momentum magnons can scatter electrons between Fermi-surface segments on opposite sides of the zone. These Umklapp processes enhance pairing because the contributions from different sites in the magnetic unit cell cancel less in their electron-magnon vertices than in those for ordinary scattering at comparable reduced momenta. Momentum-resolved winding numbers predict zero-energy Majorana flat bands at symmetry-preserving edges where the bulk nodes project to distinct momenta.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们证明磁振子交换可以在 p 波磁体的微观模型中诱导节点拓扑超导性。求解与局域自旋交换耦合的流动电子的弱耦合多带隙方程，我们发现了节点 p 波间隙和临界温度，当费米表面接近磁性布里渊区边界时，临界温度急剧上升。在这种情况下，小型减动量磁振子可以在该区域相对两侧的费米表面段之间散射电子。这些 Umklapp 过程增强了配对，因为磁性晶胞中不同位点的贡献在其电子-磁振子顶点中抵消的程度比在可比降低动量下的普通散射的贡献要小。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们证明磁振子交换可以在 p 波磁体的微观模型中诱导节点拓扑超导性。求解与局域自旋交换耦合的流动电子的弱耦合多带隙方程，我们发现了节点 p 波间隙和临界温度，当费米表面接近磁性布里渊区边界时，临界温度急剧上升。在这种情况下，小型减动量磁振子可以在该区域相对两侧的费米表面段之间散射电子。这些 Umklapp 过程增强了配对，因为磁性晶胞中不同位点的贡献在其电子-磁振子顶点中抵消的程度比在可比降低动量下的普通散射的贡献要小。动量解析的缠绕数预测了对称性保持边缘处的零能量马约拉纳平带，其中体节点投射到不同的动量。

articles.title: Anyon Coherent States in Fractional Chern Insulators
articles.title_zh: 分数陈绝缘体中的任意子相干态
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.25034v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In fractional quantum Hall (FQH) systems, coherent anyonic excitations are the natural entities for describing anyon dynamics, their interactions, and braiding, yet no general expression for their wavefunctions is known beyond Laughlin's quasiholes. We introduce a systematic, operator-based construction of maximally-localized wavefunctions of anyons of either charge in FQH states and fractional Chern insulators, including those in non-ideal, non-vortexable bands. We find that these wavefunctions describe coherent quasiparticles: zero modes of local annihilation operators that saturate projected-density uncertainty bounds. These coherent states owe their existence to a nontrivial topology of the anyon band, with the winding of their Bloch coefficients encoding an anyon band's Chern number. As such, their guiding centers exist anywhere within the lattice, and their mutual overlaps decay as Gaussians determined by the effective magnetic length of the anyon band.
articles.abstract_zh: 在分数量子霍尔（FQH）系统中，相干任意子激发是描述任意子动力学、它们的相互作用和编织的自然实体，但除了劳克林准空穴之外，尚无其波函数的通用表达式。我们引入了一种系统的、基于算子的构造，对 FQH 态和分数陈绝缘体中任一电荷的任意子的最大局域波函数进行构建，包括非理想、不可涡旋带中的那些。我们发现这些波函数描述了相干准粒子：使投影密度不确定性界限饱和的局域湮没算子的零模式。这些相干态的存在归功于任意子带的非平凡拓扑，其布洛赫系数的缠绕编码了任意子带的陈数。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在分数量子霍尔（FQH）系统中，相干任意子激发是描述任意子动力学、它们的相互作用和编织的自然实体，但除了劳克林准空穴之外，尚无其波函数的通用表达式。我们引入了一种系统的、基于算子的构造，对 FQH 态和分数陈绝缘体中任一电荷的任意子的最大局域波函数进行构建，包括非理想、不可涡旋带中的那些。我们发现这些波函数描述了相干准粒子：使投影密度不确定性界限饱和的局域湮没算子的零模式。这些相干态的存在归功于任意子带的非平凡拓扑，其布洛赫系数的缠绕编码了任意子带的陈数。因此，它们的引导中心存在于晶格内的任何位置，并且它们的相互重叠衰减为由任意子带的有效磁长度决定的高斯分布。

articles.title: Quantum many-body scars and zero modes in the spin-1 Kitaev chain
articles.title_zh: spin-1 Kitaev 链中的量子多体疤痕和零模式
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.25051v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study the spin-1 Kitaev chain and, by analyzing its Hilbert-space connectivity in the Cartesian basis, show that it hosts an exponentially large number of exact zero-energy modes protected by chiral symmetry. For even-length periodic chains, their count is lower-bounded by the Jacobsthal number (2L⁺¹+1)/3, where L is the chain length. We then construct an exponentially large number (2L/²) of zero modes with an analytic expression that have a maximally mixed density matrix for a contiguous bipartition using the operator-state mapping. We further identify an embedded tight-binding structure governing defect dynamics that supports PXP-like quantum many-body scars (QMBS) in multiple sectors previously not reported. The associated forward-scattering approximation (FSA) Hamiltonian takes a universal form across the scarred sectors studied. A simple physical picture of defects propagating between walls provides an intuitive description of these dynamics and a structural guide to identifying sectors with fidelity revivals, while its limitations point to additional scarring mechanisms.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们研究了 spin-1 Kitaev 链，并通过分析其在笛卡尔基础上的希尔伯特空间连通性，表明它拥有指数级数量的受手性对称性保护的精确零能量模式。对于偶数长度的周期链，它们的计数下限为 Jacobsthal 数 (2L⁺1+1)/3，其中 L 是链长度。然后，我们使用解析表达式构造指数大量 (2L/²) 的零模式，该解析表达式具有使用运算符状态映射的连续二分的最大混合密度矩阵。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们研究了 spin-1 Kitaev 链，并通过分析其在笛卡尔基础上的希尔伯特空间连通性，表明它拥有指数级数量的受手性对称性保护的精确零能量模式。对于偶数长度的周期链，它们的计数下限为 Jacobsthal 数 (2L⁺1+1)/3，其中 L 是链长度。然后，我们使用解析表达式构造指数大量 (2L/²) 的零模式，该解析表达式具有使用运算符状态映射的连续二分的最大混合密度矩阵。我们进一步确定了一种控制缺陷动力学的嵌入式紧束缚结构，该结构在以前未报道的多个领域中支持类似 PXP 的量子多体疤痕（QMBS）。相关的前向散射近似 (FSA) 哈密顿量在所研究的伤痕扇区中采用通用形式。墙壁之间传播的缺陷的简单物理图片提供了对这些动态的直观描述，并为识别具有保真度复兴的扇区提供了结构指南，而其局限性则指向了额外的疤痕机制。

articles.title: Mixtures of a fluid with competing interactions and a simple solvent near a hard wall
articles.title_zh: 具有竞争相互作用的流体与硬壁附近的简单溶剂的混合物
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.25097v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study a binary mixture of soft particles near a planar surface. The main component interacts through a competing short-range attraction and long-range repulsion (SALR) potential, modelled by a sum of three Yukawa terms, while the solvent and the cross interactions are described by two Yukawa terms. Using a field-theoretical mean-field approach we derive the coupled equations for the density profiles of both species, formulate the contact theorem for the two-component system, and obtain closed-form profiles in the mesoscopically homogeneous region by linearizing the theory and solving the associated eigenvalue problem. Their amplitudes are fixed by exact boundary conditions following from the continuity of the Yukawa potentials at the wall, which supply as many relations as there are unknowns. Although these conditions are implicit in the derivation of the contact theorem, they have not previously been used to fix the amplitudes of the linearized profiles, and they bring those profiles into quantitative agreement with the nonlinear solution. The equations are solved numerically for a fluid confined by hard walls. The theory predicts mixing of the two species far from the surface at high temperatures, and their microphase separation into alternating layers upon cooling or upon increasing the density. The mean-field profiles agree well with molecular dynamics data once the mean-field overestimate of the onset temperature of microsegregation is taken into account, and the analytical ones reproduce them closely except in the immediate vicinity of the wall.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们研究平面附近软颗粒的二元混合物。主要成分通过竞争的短程吸引和远程排斥 (SALR) 势相互作用，由三个 Yukawa 项之和建模，而溶剂和交叉相互作用则由两个 Yukawa 项描述。使用场论平均场方法，我们推导了两种物质的密度分布的耦合方程，制定了双组分系统的接触定理，并通过线性化理论和求解相关的特征值问题，获得了介观均匀区域的闭合形式分布。它们的振幅由精确的边界条件确定，该边界条件遵循壁上汤川势的连续性，提供了与未知数一样多的关系。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们研究平面附近软颗粒的二元混合物。主要成分通过竞争的短程吸引和远程排斥 (SALR) 势相互作用，由三个 Yukawa 项之和建模，而溶剂和交叉相互作用则由两个 Yukawa 项描述。使用场论平均场方法，我们推导了两种物质的密度分布的耦合方程，制定了双组分系统的接触定理，并通过线性化理论和求解相关的特征值问题，获得了介观均匀区域的闭合形式分布。它们的振幅由精确的边界条件确定，该边界条件遵循壁上汤川势的连续性，提供了与未知数一样多的关系。尽管这些条件隐含在接触定理的推导中，但它们以前并未用于固定线性化轮廓的幅度，并且它们使这些轮廓与非线性解在定量上一致。对于由硬壁限制的流体，对方程进行数值求解。该理论预测这两种物质在高温下会在远离表面的地方混合，并且在冷却或增加密度时它们的微相分离成交替的层。一旦考虑到微观偏析起始温度的平均场高估，平均场分布与分子动力学数据非常吻合，并且分析分布紧密地再现了它们，除了紧邻壁的区域。

articles.title: Machine Learning-Driven High-Throughput Screening of Equimolar and Non-Equimolar High-Entropy Carbides
articles.title_zh: 机器学习驱动的等摩尔和非等摩尔高熵碳化物的高通量筛选
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.25127v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Search for optimal compositions among high-entropy ceramics are challenging due to large composition space, which are unable to test either experimentally or by ab initio calculations. Here we present a high-throughput screening for equimolar and non-equimolar high-entropy carbides (HEC) among group IVB and VB transition metals (Ti, Zr, Hf, V, Nb and Ta). Large Atomistic Model MACE, and deep learning based interatomic potential DeePMD trained on ab initio-based dataset of structures are used to effectively screen over the thousands of potential non-equimolar compositions among high-entropy carbides of Ti, Zr, Hf, V, Nb and Ta transition metals. A set of both equimolar and non-equimolar HECs are predicted to be stable in order to further synthesize those compositions based on the predictions.
articles.abstract_zh: 由于成分空间较大，无法通过实验或从头计算进行测试，因此在高熵陶瓷中寻找最佳成分具有挑战性。在这里，我们提出了 IVB 和 VB 族过渡金属（Ti、Zr、Hf、V、Nb 和 Ta）中等摩尔和非等摩尔高熵碳化物 (HEC) 的高通量筛选。大型原子模型 MACE 和基于从头开始的结构数据集训练的基于深度学习的原子间势 DeePMD 用于有效筛选 Ti、Zr、Hf、V、Nb 和 Ta 过渡金属高熵碳化物中的数千种潜在非等摩尔成分。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 由于成分空间较大，无法通过实验或从头计算进行测试，因此在高熵陶瓷中寻找最佳成分具有挑战性。在这里，我们提出了 IVB 和 VB 族过渡金属（Ti、Zr、Hf、V、Nb 和 Ta）中等摩尔和非等摩尔高熵碳化物 (HEC) 的高通量筛选。大型原子模型 MACE 和基于从头开始的结构数据集训练的基于深度学习的原子间势 DeePMD 用于有效筛选 Ti、Zr、Hf、V、Nb 和 Ta 过渡金属高熵碳化物中的数千种潜在非等摩尔成分。预测一组等摩尔和非等摩尔 HEC 是稳定的，以便根据预测进一步合成这些组合物。

articles.title: The phase diagram of fluid hydrogen near melting from machine-learned interatomic potentials trained on quantum Monte Carlo
articles.title_zh: 根据量子蒙特卡罗训练的机器学习原子间势绘制接近熔化状态的液态氢相图
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.25178v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Dissociation of molecular hydrogen increasing temperature or pressure may either occur gradually or abruptly, via a phase transition. Despite considerable experimental and theoretical efforts, the phase diagram of dense hydrogen at temperatures above solid melting is not precisely known. Here, we perform classical and quantum Path Integral molecular dynamics simulations of dense hydrogen using two machine-learned interatomic potentials both trained on quantum Monte Carlo energies and forces. The resulting phase diagram is constructed using state-of-the-art techniques. Both models show a first-order phase transition from the molecular to the atomic liquid terminating in critical points whose locations were determined using finite-size scaling techniques. Triple points, located at the highest temperature of the melting curve, are found at the intersection of the liquid-liquid lines with the melting curve and should lead to clear signatures in ramp compression experiments.
articles.abstract_zh: 随着温度或压力的升高，分子氢的解离可以通过相变逐渐或突然发生。尽管进行了大量的实验和理论工作，但在高于固体熔化的温度下稠密氢的相图仍不清楚。在这里，我们使用两个机器学习的原子间势对稠密氢进行经典和量子路径积分分子动力学模拟，这两个原子间势均经过量子蒙特卡罗能量和力的训练。由此产生的相图是使用最先进的技术构建的。两个模型都显示了从分子到原子液体的一级相变，终止于临界点，其位置是使用有限尺寸缩放技术确定的。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 随着温度或压力的升高，分子氢的解离可以通过相变逐渐或突然发生。尽管进行了大量的实验和理论工作，但在高于固体熔化的温度下稠密氢的相图仍不清楚。在这里，我们使用两个机器学习的原子间势对稠密氢进行经典和量子路径积分分子动力学模拟，这两个原子间势均经过量子蒙特卡罗能量和力的训练。由此产生的相图是使用最先进的技术构建的。两个模型都显示了从分子到原子液体的一级相变，终止于临界点，其位置是使用有限尺寸缩放技术确定的。三相点位于熔化曲线的最高温度处，位于液-液线与熔化曲线的交叉点处，并且应该在斜坡压缩实验中产生清晰的特征。

articles.title: Single-Crystal Growth, Structure, and Physical Properties of Yb2MoO6
articles.title_zh: Yb2MoO6 的单晶生长、结构和物理性质
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.25225v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Rare-earth molybdates are functional oxides of considerable interest because their structural and chemical flexibility enables diverse magnetic, electronic, and optical behavior. Here, millimeter-sized single crystals of Yb₂MoO₆ are synthesized, their crystal structure determined and physical properties investigated. Single-crystal X-ray diffraction confirms the formation of Yb₂MoO₆ and yielded lattice parameters of a = 16.228(2) mathringA, b = 10.901(3) mathringA, and c = 5.286(2) mathringA, in good agreement with previously reported neutron powder diffraction data. Scanning electron microscopy and energy-dispersive spectroscopy show a Yb:Mo ratio close to the expected 2:1 stoichiometry. Optical measurements based on diffuse-reflectance spectra and Tauc analysis yield an estimated optical gap of sim 3.28 eV under the direct-allowed transition assumption. Magnetic susceptibility measurements reveal Curie-Weiss-like paramagnetic behavior, with an effective magnetic moment of μₑff approx 4.2μ_B per Yb and an apparent Weiss temperature of θ approx -65.7 K, consistent with possible antiferromagnetic interactions or correlations, with no clear magnetic-ordering transition observed down to 10 K. These results establish the growth of Yb₂MoO₆ single crystals and provide initial insight into their structural, optical, and magnetic properties.
articles.abstract_zh: 稀土钼酸盐是备受关注的功能性氧化物，因为它们的结构和化学灵活性能够实现不同的磁、电子和光学行为。 Here, millimeter-sized single crystals of Yb₂MoO₆ are synthesized, their crystal structure determined and physical properties investigated.单晶 X 射线衍射证实了 Yb2MoO6 的形成，并产生了 a = 16.228(2) mathring…
articles.abstract_zh_full: 稀土钼酸盐是备受关注的功能性氧化物，因为它们的结构和化学灵活性能够实现不同的磁、电子和光学行为。 Here, millimeter-sized single crystals of Yb₂MoO₆ are synthesized, their crystal structure determined and physical properties investigated.单晶 X 射线衍射证实了 Yb2MoO6 的形成，并产生了 a = 16.228(2) mathringA、b = 10.901(3) mathringA 和 c = 5.286(2) mathringA 的晶格参数，与之前报道的中子粉末衍射数据非常吻合。扫描电子显微镜和能量色散光谱显示 Yb:Mo 比率接近预期的 2:1 化学计量。基于漫反射光谱和 Tauc 分析的光学测量在直接允许跃迁假设下产生了 sim 3.28 eV 的估计光学间隙。磁化率测量揭示了类似居里-魏斯的顺磁行为，每 Yb 的有效磁矩为 μₑff 约 4.2μ_B，表观魏斯温度为 θ 约 -65.7 K，与可能的反铁磁相互作用或相关性一致，在低至 10 K 时没有观察到明显的磁有序转变。这些结果建立了 Yb2MoO₆ 单晶的生长，并提供了对其结构、光学和结构的初步了解。磁性。

articles.title: Molecular engineering for crack-free transfer of single-crystalline oxide membranes onto silicon
articles.title_zh: 将单晶氧化物膜无裂纹转移到硅上的分子工程
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.25246v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Heterogeneous integration of single-crystalline complex oxides with silicon offers a route to incorporating their functionalities into next-generation microelectronics. Released from their growth substrates, freestanding oxide membranes enable this integration. However, cracks, wrinkles, and fragmentation during release and transfer limit membrane size and quality. Here, we present an interfacial energy-controlled release strategy that enables crack-free, single-crystalline freestanding oxide membranes with centimeter-scale lateral dimensions. Using SrTiO3 as a model system, time-resolved release studies identify water-induced blistering at the membrane-support interface during prolonged water exposure as the origin of membrane cracking. Lowering the molecular weight of the poly(propylene carbonate) support through polymer deconstruction increases its polarity and surface energy, suppresses interfacial blistering, and reduces organic residue after support removal. The resulting SrTiO3 membranes exhibit optical properties comparable to those of bulk single crystals. We extend this approach to the metallic ferromagnet La0.7Sr0.3MnO3, obtaining crack-free membranes on Si that preserve ferromagnetism and metallicity.
articles.abstract_zh: 单晶复合氧化物与硅的异质集成提供了将其功能融入下一代微电子学的途径。从生长基底上释放出来的独立式氧化膜实现了这种集成。然而，释放和转移过程中的裂纹、皱纹和碎片限制了膜的尺寸和质量。在这里，我们提出了一种界面能量控制释放策略，该策略能够实现具有厘米级横向尺寸的无裂纹、单晶独立氧化物膜。使用 SrTiO3 作为模型系统，时间分辨释放研究发现，长时间暴露在水中时，水引起的膜-支撑界面起泡是膜破裂的根源。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 单晶复合氧化物与硅的异质集成提供了将其功能融入下一代微电子学的途径。从生长基底上释放出来的独立式氧化膜实现了这种集成。然而，释放和转移过程中的裂纹、皱纹和碎片限制了膜的尺寸和质量。在这里，我们提出了一种界面能量控制释放策略，该策略能够实现具有厘米级横向尺寸的无裂纹、单晶独立氧化物膜。使用 SrTiO3 作为模型系统，时间分辨释放研究发现，长时间暴露在水中时，水引起的膜-支撑界面起泡是膜破裂的根源。通过聚合物解构降低聚碳酸亚丙酯载体的分子量可增加其极性和表面能，抑制界面起泡，并减少载体去除后的有机残留物。所得的 SrTiO3 膜表现出与块状单晶相当的光学特性。我们将这种方法扩展到金属铁磁体 La0.7Sr0.3MnO3，在 Si 上获得无裂纹的膜，从而保持铁磁性和金属性。

articles.title: Altermagnetic magnon splitting in hematite: from bulk g-wave to planar i-wave
articles.title_zh: 赤铁矿中的交变磁振子分裂：从块体 g 波到平面 i 波
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.25284v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Hematite is an insulating iron oxide with both a collinear antiferromagnetic and a weakly ferromagnetic phase with intriguing properties, such as long-range spin transport distances, that make it promising for spintronics applications. It has also been identified as a candidate for g-wave altermagnetism. Here, we present the results of fully relativistic ab initio calculations of the magnon properties of hematite, with a focus on altermagnetic effects. We quantitatively evaluate both the anisotropic and altermagnetic magnon band splitting as well as the magnon lifetimes. We show that dipolar interactions lead to a sizeable non-altermagnetic splitting and a hybridisation between opposite-chirality magnons resulting in a strong reduction of the spin expectation value of magnons close to the Γ point and around nodal planes, even in the collinear out-of-plane phase. Both the frequencies and the lifetimes have a large altermagnetic splitting in the k_z = 0 plane, which is characteristic of hematite and not generally expected for g-wave altermagnets. We compare our results to the prototypical, hexagonal g-wave altermagnet manganese telluride, which has four symmetry-protected nodal planes, whereas the fourth nodal surface in hematite is not completely fixed by symmetry. We derive implicit analytical expressions for this surface and discuss how it arises from a combination of rotational and translational symmetry, which leads to a transition to i-wave symmetry at the Brillouin zone boundary. The example of hematite reveals the trigonal altermagnets as a special case where the splitting function exhibits both bulk (g-wave) and planar (i-wave) components, and shows that the point symmetries alone are not sufficient to capture the full symmetry-determined behaviour of the splitting function.
articles.abstract_zh: 赤铁矿是一种绝缘氧化铁，具有共线反铁磁相和弱铁磁相，具有有趣的特性，例如长程自旋输运距离，这使其在自旋电子学应用中很有前景。它也被认为是 g 波交变磁力的候选者。在这里，我们展示了赤铁矿磁振子特性的完全相对论从头计算的结果，重点是交磁效应。我们定量评估了各向异性和交磁磁振子带分裂以及磁振子寿命。我们表明，偶极相互作用会导致相当大的非交变磁分裂和相反手性磁振子之间的杂化，从而导致靠近 Γ 点和节面周围的磁振子的自旋期望值大幅降低，即使在共线面外相位也是如此。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 赤铁矿是一种绝缘氧化铁，具有共线反铁磁相和弱铁磁相，具有有趣的特性，例如长程自旋输运距离，这使其在自旋电子学应用中很有前景。它也被认为是 g 波交变磁力的候选者。在这里，我们展示了赤铁矿磁振子特性的完全相对论从头计算的结果，重点是交磁效应。我们定量评估了各向异性和交磁磁振子带分裂以及磁振子寿命。我们表明，偶极相互作用会导致相当大的非交变磁分裂和相反手性磁振子之间的杂化，从而导致靠近 Γ 点和节面周围的磁振子的自旋期望值大幅降低，即使在共线面外相位也是如此。频率和寿命在 k_z = 0 平面上都有很大的交变磁分裂，这是赤铁矿的特征，但通常不会出现在 g 波交变磁体中。我们将我们的结果与原型六边形 g 波交变磁体碲化锰进行比较，后者具有四个受对称性保护的节点面，而赤铁矿中的第四个节点面并未完全由对称性固定。我们推导了该表面的隐式解析表达式，并讨论了它是如何从旋转和平移对称性的组合中产生的，从而导致布里渊区边界处向 i 波对称性的转变。赤铁矿的例子揭示了三角交替磁体作为一种特殊情况，其中分裂函数表现出体（g 波）和平面（i 波）分量，并表明仅点对称性不足以捕获分裂函数的完全对称确定的行为。

articles.title: Canted antiferromagnetism and spin-flop transition in honeycomb α-Na₂PrO₃ revealed by angle-dependent torque magnetometry up to 35 T
articles.title_zh: 通过高达 35 T 的角度相关扭矩磁力测量揭示了蜂窝 α-Na2PrO₃ 中的倾斜反铁磁性和自旋翻转转变
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.25291v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We report angle-dependent piezocantilever torque measurements on single crystals of the honeycomb magnet α-Na₂PrO₃, proposed to display unconventional magnetism stabilized by anisotropic exchange interactions between spin-orbit entangled, pseudospin 1/2 Pr⁴⁺ magnetic moments. Previous powder susceptibility observed signatures of a transition at low temperatures to antiferromagnetic order with a weak ferromagnetic moment. From the torque angular dependence in three orthogonal crystallographic planes, we infer a zero-field canted antiferromagnetic structure, with moments almost normal to the honeycomb layers, but weakly canted such as to give rise to a spontaneous magnetization along the in-plane monoclinic a-axis, with two magnetic domains related by time reversal. Sharp jumps in the torque angular dependence when the field projection along a changes sign are interpreted as field-induced switching between the two degenerate domains with oppositely aligned ferromagnetic moments. We propose a minimal spin Hamiltonian including easy-axis exchange anisotropy and symmetry-allowed Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya (DM) couplings, for which mean-field calculations reproduce the main features of the observed angle-dependent torque. Torque measurements up to 35 T applied almost normal to the layers observe a strong anomaly attributed to proximity to the field-induced spin-flop transition predicted for the above Hamiltonian. We contrast the predicted magnetic phase diagrams for magnetic fields in different orthogonal crystallographic planes normal to the honeycomb layers and discuss how DM interactions convert some transitions into smooth crossovers and stabilize a phase boundary line connecting the spin-flop transition in field normal to the layers to magnetization saturation for in-plane field normal to a; such a phase boundary line does not exist in the absence of DM interactions.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们报告了对蜂窝磁体 α-Na2PrO3 单晶的角度相关压电悬臂梁扭矩测量，建议显示通过自旋轨道纠缠、赝自旋 1/2 Pr⁴⁺ 磁矩之间的各向异性交换相互作用稳定的非常规磁性。以前的粉末磁化率观察到在低温下向具有弱铁磁矩的反铁磁序转变的特征。根据三个正交晶面的扭矩角依赖性，我们推断出一种零场倾斜反铁磁结构，其力矩几乎垂直于蜂窝层，但倾斜较弱，以便沿面内单斜 a 轴产生自发磁化，具有两个与时间反转相关的磁畴。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们报告了对蜂窝磁体 α-Na2PrO3 单晶的角度相关压电悬臂梁扭矩测量，建议显示通过自旋轨道纠缠、赝自旋 1/2 Pr⁴⁺ 磁矩之间的各向异性交换相互作用稳定的非常规磁性。以前的粉末磁化率观察到在低温下向具有弱铁磁矩的反铁磁序转变的特征。根据三个正交晶面的扭矩角依赖性，我们推断出一种零场倾斜反铁磁结构，其力矩几乎垂直于蜂窝层，但倾斜较弱，以便沿面内单斜 a 轴产生自发磁化，具有两个与时间反转相关的磁畴。当沿变化符号的场投影被解释为具有相反排列的铁磁矩的两个简并域之间的场感应切换时，扭矩角依赖性的急剧跳跃。我们提出了一种最小自旋哈密顿量，包括易轴交换各向异性和允许对称性的 Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya (DM) 耦合，其平均场计算再现了观察到的与角度相关的扭矩的主要特征。几乎垂直施加于层的高达 35 T 的扭矩测量观察到由于接近上述哈密顿量预测的场引起的自旋翻转转变而导致的强烈异常。我们对比了垂直于蜂窝层的不同正交晶面中磁场的预测磁相图，并讨论了DM相互作用如何将一些转变转化为平滑交叉，并稳定了连接垂直于层的场中的自旋翻转转变与垂直于a的面内场的磁化饱和的相界线；在没有 DM 相互作用的情况下，这样的相界线不存在。

articles.title: Learning Spin Hamiltonians from Interacting Magnon Spectra
articles.title_zh: 从相互作用磁振子谱中学习自旋哈密顿量
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.25321v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: A neural network that learns an inverse map inherits the approximations of the forward solver used to generate its training data. We demonstrate this in the inference of spin Hamiltonians from synthetic neutron-scattering spectra and show how a fast many-body solver can overcome the limitation of linear spin-wave theory (LSWT). We consider a family of anisotropic triangular-lattice spin Hamiltonians at fields just above saturation, where magnon interactions shift and broaden the spectrum in ways that LSWT cannot capture. Using the truncated Hilbert-space ladder (THL) method, we compute the dynamical spin structure factor (DSSF) nonperturbatively within the one- and two-magnon space. THL is fast enough to generate large training sets of DSSF spectra, enabling us to train neural networks that accurately predict Hamiltonian parameters. By empirically benchmarking several neural-network architectures, we find that a one-dimensional convolutional network performs best. A learned forward decoder then reconstructs the DSSF from the predicted parameters, providing a rapid self-consistency check and a visualization of the predicted response. When interactions are strong, networks trained on LSWT and THL spectra infer markedly different parameters. Analysis of the Fisher information matrix shows that the measurement protocol, including which spin-correlation components are resolved and the momentum cut, determines which couplings can be identified. Combining machine learning with fast many- body theory is therefore essential for quantitative Hamiltonian inference from scattering data.
articles.abstract_zh: 学习逆映射的神经网络继承了用于生成其训练数据的正向求解器的近似值。我们通过合成中子散射谱的自旋哈密顿量推理证明了这一点，并展示了快速多体求解器如何克服线性自旋波理论（LSWT）的局限性。我们考虑在略高于饱和度的场上的一系列各向异性三角晶格自旋哈密顿量，其中磁振子相互作用以 LSWT 无法捕获的方式移动并拓宽光谱。使用截断希尔伯特空间阶梯（THL）方法，我们在一磁振子空间和二磁振子空间内非微扰地计算动态自旋结构因子（DSSF）。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 学习逆映射的神经网络继承了用于生成其训练数据的正向求解器的近似值。我们通过合成中子散射谱的自旋哈密顿量推理证明了这一点，并展示了快速多体求解器如何克服线性自旋波理论（LSWT）的局限性。我们考虑在略高于饱和度的场上的一系列各向异性三角晶格自旋哈密顿量，其中磁振子相互作用以 LSWT 无法捕获的方式移动并拓宽光谱。使用截断希尔伯特空间阶梯（THL）方法，我们在一磁振子空间和二磁振子空间内非微扰地计算动态自旋结构因子（DSSF）。 THL 足够快，可以生成大量 DSSF 谱训练集，使我们能够训练准确预测哈密顿参数的神经网络。通过对几种神经网络架构进行实证基准测试，我们发现一维卷积网络表现最好。然后，学习的前向解码器根据预测参数重建 DSSF，提供快速的自我一致性检查和预测响应的可视化。当相互作用很强时，在 LSWT 和 THL 谱上训练的网络会推断出明显不同的参数。 Fisher 信息矩阵的分析表明，测量协议（包括解析哪些自旋相关分量和动量切割）决定了可以识别哪些耦合。因此，将机器学习与快速多体理论相结合对于从散射数据进行定量哈密顿推理至关重要。

articles.title: Symmetry-resolved spectroscopy of truncation-induced perturbations in loop tensor network renormalization of the six-vertex model
articles.title_zh: 六顶点模型的环张量网络重整化中截断引起的扰动的对称分辨光谱
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.25322v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Tensor network renormalization at finite bond dimension χ introduces truncation errors that are amplified by the renormalization-group (RG) flow. For loop tensor network renormalization (LoopTNR) on the c=1 critical line of the six-vertex model, with Luttinger parameter K, we identify these errors operator by operator from symmetry-resolved transfer-matrix spectra and conformal perturbation theory. With O(2) symmetry imposed, the dominant error is the dimerization operator, which is allowed because LoopTNR breaks one-site translation. With less symmetry it is the U(1) current or a charge-two vertex operator. The growth of the dimerization per RG step and a parameter-free ratio of its amplitudes agree with conformal perturbation theory to within a few percent. The parameter K drifts slowly, owing to a weak marginal error and to the running induced by the dimerization. A larger χ lowers the initial amplitude of the error for 0.75le Kle 1.5 but changes neither the operator nor its growth rate.
articles.abstract_zh: 有限键维 χ 处的张量网络重整化会引入截断误差，该误差会被重整化群 (RG) 流放大。对于六顶点模型的 c=1 临界线上的环张量网络重整化（LoopTNR），使用 Luttinger 参数 K，我们从对称解析的传递矩阵谱和共形微扰理论中逐个算子识别这些误差。施加 O(2) 对称性后，主要错误是二聚化算子，这是允许的，因为 LoopTNR 破坏了单位点翻译。对称性较低，它是 U(1) 电流或电荷二顶点算子。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 有限键维 χ 处的张量网络重整化会引入截断误差，该误差会被重整化群 (RG) 流放大。对于六顶点模型的 c=1 临界线上的环张量网络重整化（LoopTNR），使用 Luttinger 参数 K，我们从对称解析的传递矩阵谱和共形微扰理论中逐个算子识别这些误差。施加 O(2) 对称性后，主要错误是二聚化算子，这是允许的，因为 LoopTNR 破坏了单位点翻译。对称性较低，它是 U(1) 电流或电荷二顶点算子。每个 RG 步长的二聚化增长及其振幅的无参数比率与共形微扰理论一致，误差在几个百分点之内。由于边际误差较弱以及二聚化引起的运行，参数 K 漂移缓慢。较大的 χ 会降低 0.75le Kle 1.5 的初始误差幅度，但不会改变算子及其增长率。

articles.title: Magnetic order in Tb and Dy substituted La3Ni2O7 and effects of high-pressure high-temperature O2 annealing
articles.title_zh: Tb和Dy取代La3Ni2O7的磁序及高压高温O2退火的影响
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.25349v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: To study the influence of magnetic lanthanide (Ln) substituents on La3Ni2O7, polycrystalline samples of La3-xLnxNi2O7 (Ln = Pr, Eu, Gd, Tb, Dy, Ho, Er, Tm, and Yb) were synthesized and characterized by electrical transport, magnetization, and x-ray and neutron powder diffraction before and after high-pressure high-temperature oxygen annealing. The annealing process led to the formation of La3Ni2O7 polymorphs and more metallic-like temperature dependence of the electrical resistance while changing the density-wave transition temperature only slightly. For unannealed La2.7Tb0.3Ni2O7 and La2.7Dy0.3Ni2O7, distinct features in the magnetic susceptibility and additional magnetic peaks in neutron diffraction patterns indicate that both samples develop long-range magnetic order below ~13 and 11 K, respectively. The magnetic signatures were strongly suppressed following oxygen annealing, suggesting a possible association with the accompanying structural modifications. These behaviors distinguish Tb and Dy from Pr, Nd, and Sm substituents which do not introduce magnetic ordering in the system, establishing La3-xTbxNi2O7 and La3-xDyxNi2O7 as promising platforms for exploring the interplay between magnetic order and pressure-induced superconductivity in La3Ni2O7.
articles.abstract_zh: 为了研究磁性镧系元素（Ln）取代基对La3Ni2O7的影响，合成了La3-xLnxNi2O7（Ln = Pr、Eu、Gd、Tb、Dy、Ho、Er、Tm和Yb）多晶样品，并通过高压高温氧退火前后的电输运、磁化、X射线和中子粉末衍射对其进行了表征。退火过程导致 La3Ni2O7 多晶型物的形成以及电阻的更像金属的温度依赖性，同时仅轻微改变密度波转变温度。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 为了研究磁性镧系元素（Ln）取代基对La3Ni2O7的影响，合成了La3-xLnxNi2O7（Ln = Pr、Eu、Gd、Tb、Dy、Ho、Er、Tm和Yb）多晶样品，并通过高压高温氧退火前后的电输运、磁化、X射线和中子粉末衍射对其进行了表征。退火过程导致 La3Ni2O7 多晶型物的形成以及电阻的更像金属的温度依赖性，同时仅轻微改变密度波转变温度。对于未退火的 La2.7Tb0.3Ni2O7 和 La2.7Dy0.3Ni2O7，磁化率的明显特征和中子衍射图中的附加磁峰表明，这两个样品分别形成低于约 13 K 和 11 K 的长程磁序。氧退火后，磁性特征被强烈抑制，这表明可能与伴随的结构修饰有关。这些行为将 Tb 和 Dy 与不会在系统中引入磁有序的 Pr、Nd 和 Sm 取代基区分开来，使 La3-xTbxNi2O7 和 La3-xDyxNi2O7 成为探索 La3Ni2O7 中磁有序与压力诱导超导性之间相互作用的有前途的平台。

articles.title: Generalized Critical-State Analysis of Local Field Screening in High-Pressure Yttrium Polyhydride
articles.title_zh: 高压聚氢化钇局部场筛选的广义临界状态分析
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.25456v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We resolve the long-standing controversy over the interpretation of magnetic-flux expulsion in high-pressure superhydrides by measuring the local magnetic field adjacent to yttrium polyhydride at 171 GPa and 4.1 K with a ⁵⁷Fe Mössbauer sensor. Nuclear forward scattering tracks the local induction Bᵣₘ ₛₑₙₛₒᵣ(Bₐ), which nearly merges with the normal-state line near 1.5 T. Rather than assuming a constant-current Bean state, we solve the critical-state problem for the actual thin-disk geometry using the Shantsev--Clem--Sanchez method and compare generalized field-dependent critical-state models. Both the Kim and exponential laws reproduce the measured virgin branch, whereas the constant-J_c Bean model fails. The corresponding zero-field critical-current densities, (4.38±1.48)×10¹¹ and (2.45±0.22)×10¹¹ A/m², respectively, are consistent in order of magnitude with transport estimates for granular YH₆. These results establish that the observed flux expulsion is a pinned critical state, not the equilibrium Meissner effect, and demonstrate a general methodology for probing local superconductivity under extreme conditions.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们通过使用 ⁵⁷Fe 穆斯堡尔传感器测量 171 GPa 和 4.1 K 下聚氢化钇附近的局部磁场，解决了关于高压超级氢化物中磁通排斥解释的长期争议。核前向散射跟踪局部感应 Bᵣₘ ₛₑₙₛₒᵣ(Bₐ)，它几乎与 1.5 T 附近的正常状态线合并。我们没有假设恒流 Bean 状态，而是使用 Shantsev--Clem--Sanchez 方法解决了实际薄盘几何的临界状态问题，并比较了广义场相关临界状态模型。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们通过使用 ⁵⁷Fe 穆斯堡尔传感器测量 171 GPa 和 4.1 K 下聚氢化钇附近的局部磁场，解决了关于高压超级氢化物中磁通排斥解释的长期争议。核前向散射跟踪局部感应 Bᵣₘ ₛₑₙₛₒᵣ(Bₐ)，它几乎与 1.5 T 附近的正常状态线合并。我们没有假设恒流 Bean 状态，而是使用 Shantsev--Clem--Sanchez 方法解决了实际薄盘几何的临界状态问题，并比较了广义场相关临界状态模型。 Kim 定律和指数定律都重现了测量到的原始分支，而常数 J_c Bean 模型则失败了。相应的零场临界电流密度分别为（4.38±1.48）×10¹ 和（2.45±0.22）×10¹A/m2，在数量级上与粒状 YH₆ 的输运估计一致。这些结果表明，观察到的通量排出是固定临界状态，而不是平衡迈斯纳效应，并证明了在极端条件下探测局部超导性的通用方法。

articles.title: Dynamical Variational Theory of Stochastic Reaction Networks
articles.title_zh: 随机反应网络的动力变分理论
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.25491v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Discrete stochastic population dynamics describe systems ranging from biochemical reaction networks and gene regulation to epidemic spreading, ecology, and population genetics, where finite populations generate strong intrinsic fluctuations. Predicting their dynamics, including mean populations, fluctuations, time-lagged correlations, response functions, and steady states, remains challenging: the chemical master equation admits no general analytical solution, numerical solutions scale poorly with system size, and standard approximations fail at low copy numbers. Using a field-theoretic representation of the reaction dynamics, we develop a dynamical variational approximation for stochastic reaction networks based on the Plefka expansion from spin-glass physics. For reaction systems with general stoichiometry and time-dependent rates, the expansion yields tractable non-Markovian effective dynamics with self-consistent memory. We further introduce a generalized self-consistent bubble resummation that provides closed predictions for means, correlations, and response functions. The formulation applies broadly to discrete stochastic population dynamics on networks, and we provide a numerical implementation with adaptive time stepping for user-defined systems. We benchmark the method on stochastic gene regulation, enzyme kinetics, and infection dynamics, where it accurately captures both time-dependent behaviour and steady states, including fluctuation-driven effects missed by conventional approximations. Together, these results establish a general analytical framework for stochastic reaction dynamics across transient and stationary regimes in strongly fluctuating low-copy-number systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 离散随机种群动态描述了从生化反应网络和基因调控到流行病传播、生态学和种群遗传学的系统，其中有限的种群产生强烈的内在波动。预测它们的动态，包括平均种群、波动、时滞相关性、响应函数和稳态，仍然具有挑战性：化学主方程不允许通用解析解，数值解随系统大小的变化很差，标准近似在低拷贝数时失败。使用反应动力学的场论表示，我们基于自旋玻璃物理学的普莱夫卡展开式开发了随机反应网络的动态变分近似。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 离散随机种群动态描述了从生化反应网络和基因调控到流行病传播、生态学和种群遗传学的系统，其中有限的种群产生强烈的内在波动。预测它们的动态，包括平均种群、波动、时滞相关性、响应函数和稳态，仍然具有挑战性：化学主方程不允许通用解析解，数值解随系统大小的变化很差，标准近似在低拷贝数时失败。使用反应动力学的场论表示，我们基于自旋玻璃物理学的普莱夫卡展开式开发了随机反应网络的动态变分近似。对于具有一般化学计量和时间依赖性速率的反应系统，展开式产生具有自洽记忆的易处理的非马尔可夫有效动力学。我们进一步引入了一种广义的自洽气泡恢复，它为均值、相关性和响应函数提供了封闭的预测。该公式广泛适用于网络上的离散随机群体动态，并且我们为用户定义的系统提供了具有自适应时间步长的数值实现。我们对随机基因调控、酶动力学和感染动力学的方法进行了基准测试，它准确地捕获了时间依赖性行为和稳态，包括传统近似法忽略的波动驱动效应。总之，这些结果为强烈波动的低拷贝数系统中瞬态和稳态状态下的随机反应动力学建立了通用分析框架。

articles.title: Scattering Circular Dichroism from Spatially Modulated Anisotropic Magnetic Dipoles in BiFeO₃
articles.title_zh: BiFeO₃ 中空间调制各向异性磁偶极子的散射圆二色性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.25546v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Antiferromagnets with broken time-reversal symmetry, including altermagnets, have attracted growing interest because they can exhibit ferromagnet-like responses, such as the anomalous Hall effect and magneto-optical effects, despite their compensated spin structures. Such time-reversal symmetry breaking is characterized by ferroic time-reversal-odd multipoles, distinct from the conventional spin and orbital moments. Among them, the anisotropic magnetic dipole (AMD), which reflects the local orbital anisotropy, shares the symmetry of magnetization and can have a ferroic component even when the spin moments cancel. AMD responses have thus far been identified primarily in antiferromagnets with unit-cell magnetic periodicity, whereas spatially modulated AMDs in long-wavelength magnetic textures remain unexplored. Here, we report resonant soft x-ray small-angle scattering measurements on the antiferromagnetic spin cycloid of the multiferroic BiFeO₃. We observe pronounced circular dichroism in the resonant scattering intensity, i.e., scattering circular dichroism, which is not expected from the established cycloidal and Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya-interaction-induced sinusoidal spin structures. We show that the staggered rotation of the FeO₆ octahedra gives rise to ferroic AMD components despite the antiparallel spin alignment. As the local magnetic symmetry varies with the cycloidal phase, these AMDs are spatially modulated and produce the dichroism through interference with the sinusoidal spin component. Our findings demonstrate that long-wavelength antiferromagnetic textures can host spatially modulated AMDs, opening new avenues for exploring hidden multipole textures in magnetic and multiferroic materials.
articles.abstract_zh: 具有破缺时间反转对称性的反铁磁体（包括交变磁体）引起了越来越多的兴趣，因为尽管它们具有补偿自旋结构，但它们仍可以表现出类似铁磁体的响应，例如反常霍尔效应和磁光效应。这种时间反演对称性破缺的特点是铁性时间反演奇多极，与传统的自旋和轨道矩不同。其中，反映局域轨道各向异性的各向异性磁偶极子（AMD）具有磁化对称性，即使自旋矩抵消也可以具有铁性成分。迄今为止，AMD 响应主要在具有单位单元磁周期性的反铁磁体中被识别，而长波长磁性纹理中的空间调制 AMD 仍未被探索。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 具有破缺时间反转对称性的反铁磁体（包括交变磁体）引起了越来越多的兴趣，因为尽管它们具有补偿自旋结构，但它们仍可以表现出类似铁磁体的响应，例如反常霍尔效应和磁光效应。这种时间反演对称性破缺的特点是铁性时间反演奇多极，与传统的自旋和轨道矩不同。其中，反映局域轨道各向异性的各向异性磁偶极子（AMD）具有磁化对称性，即使自旋矩抵消也可以具有铁性成分。迄今为止，AMD 响应主要在具有单位单元磁周期性的反铁磁体中被识别，而长波长磁性纹理中的空间调制 AMD 仍未被探索。在这里，我们报告了多铁性 BiFeO₃ 的反铁磁自旋摆线的共振软 X 射线小角度散射测量。我们在共振散射强度中观察到明显的圆二色性，即散射圆二色性，这是从已建立的摆线和 Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya 相互作用诱导的正弦自旋结构中所预料不到的。我们表明，尽管具有反平行自旋排列，FeO₆ 八面体的交错旋转仍会产生铁性 AMD 成分。由于局部磁对称性随摆线相位的变化而变化，这些 AMD 受到空间调制，并通过干扰正弦自旋分量产生二向色性。我们的研究结果表明，长波长反铁磁纹理可以容纳空间调制的 AMD，为探索磁性和多铁材料中隐藏的多极纹理开辟了新途径。

articles.title: Comparative First-Principles Study of the Physical Properties, Phonon-Mediated Superconductivity and Functional Potential of Technetium-Based Binary Borides TcB2, Tc2B and Tc3B
articles.title_zh: 锝基二元硼化物TcB2、Tc2B和Tc3B的物理性质、声子介导超导性和功能潜力的比较第一性原理研究
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.25554v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Phonon-mediated superconductivity in binary transition-metal borides reflects a balance between the metal d-states, metal-boron bonding, and the lattice vibrations that couple to them. Here, we compare P6/mmm TcB2 at 20 GPa with I4/mcm Tc2B and P4/mmm Tc3B at 0 GPa within a first-principles framework. Their mechanical responses differ appreciably: TcB2 is the most rigid under its compressed condition, Tc2B shows the strongest tendency toward ductility, and Tc3B falls between the two. Despite these differences, all three phases remain metallic. The states at the Fermi level are dominated by Tc-4d character, although the extent of Tc-d/B-p mixing varies from one compound to another. Charge redistribution is more directional and B-centered in TcB2, but more delocalized around the Tc network in Tc2B and Tc3B. Inclusion of spin-orbit coupling leaves all three compounds metallic. The optical response remains metallic and electric field polarization dependent, with substantial visible reflectivity and strong ultraviolet absorption. Low-frequency Tc rich vibrations dominate the electron-phonon coupling (EPC). With μ* = 0.10, the Tc values of TcB2, Tc2B, and Tc3B are 24.92, 11.07, and 15.12 K, respectively. Although Tc3B exhibits a higher electronic density of states at the Fermi level, N(EF), TcB2 couples most strongly to EPC-active low-frequency modes, showing that the superconducting hierarchy depends on electronic-phonon matching rather than DOS magnitude alone.
articles.abstract_zh: 二元过渡金属硼化物中声子介导的超导性反映了金属 d 态、金属-硼键合以及与其耦合的晶格振动之间的平衡。在这里，我们在第一性原理框架内将 20 GPa 下的 P6/mmm TcB2 与 0 GPa 下的 I4/mcm Tc2B 和 P4/mmm Tc3B 进行比较。它们的机械响应明显不同：TcB2 在压缩条件下刚性最强，Tc2B 显示出最强的延展性，而 Tc3B 介于两者之间。尽管存在这些差异，所有三相仍然是金属相。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 二元过渡金属硼化物中声子介导的超导性反映了金属 d 态、金属-硼键合以及与其耦合的晶格振动之间的平衡。在这里，我们在第一性原理框架内将 20 GPa 下的 P6/mmm TcB2 与 0 GPa 下的 I4/mcm Tc2B 和 P4/mmm Tc3B 进行比较。它们的机械响应明显不同：TcB2 在压缩条件下刚性最强，Tc2B 显示出最强的延展性，而 Tc3B 介于两者之间。尽管存在这些差异，所有三相仍然是金属相。费米能级的状态主要由 Tc-4d 特征决定，尽管 Tc-d/B-p 混合的程度因化合物而异。在 TcB2 中，电荷重新分布更具方向性且以 B 为中心，但在 Tc2B 和 Tc3B 中，电荷重新分布在 Tc 网络周围更加离域。自旋轨道耦合的包含使所有三种化合物都具有金属性。光学响应仍然依赖于金属和电场偏振，具有显着的可见光反射率和强紫外线吸收。低频 Tc 丰富的振动主导电子声子耦合 (EPC)。当μ* = 0.10时，TcB2、Tc2B和Tc3B的Tc值分别为24.92、11.07和15.12 K。尽管 Tc3B 在费米能级 N(EF) 处表现出较高的电子态密度，但 TcB2 与 EPC 活性低频模式的耦合最强，表明超导层次结构取决于电子声子匹配，而不仅仅是 DOS 幅度。

articles.title: AdsNet: A Graph Neural Network for Direct Adsorption Energy Prediction
articles.title_zh: AdsNet：用于直接吸附能量预测的图神经网络
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.25646v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Fast and accurate prediction of adsorption energies is critical for high-throughput computational catalyst screening, existing methods compromise either on evaluation speed (full-graph machine learning potentials) or geometric sensitivity (coordination-based models like the alpha-scheme). Here, we present AdsNet, an equivariant graph neural network that directly predicts adsorption energies in a single forward pass, which operates on a local graph restricted only to adsorbate atoms and its immediate surface neighbors within a cutoff radius. This local graph formulation decouples computational complexity from total system size while encoding continuous geometric features (interatomic distances and directional vectors) enabling sensitivity to subtle variations in local bonding environments. AdsNet adopts a message-passing architecture with scalar and vector node features over multiple interaction layers. Trained on AdsTraj, a dataset of 33,920 density functional theory (DFT) calculated structures spanning 26 transition metals and 6 adsorbates (H*, C*, O*, CO*, OH*, HOCO*), the model achieves an adsorption energy root-mean-square error (RMSE) of 0.032 eV and a force RMSE of 0.047 eV/A. Analytic forces obtained via automatic differentiation enable structure relaxation through a projected gradient descent algorithm with adaptive line search, eliminating entire geometry optimizations. Additionally, AdsNet uniquely decomposes predicted adsorption energies into contributions from individual atoms within the local adsorbate graph - an interpretability feature unattainable with conventional machine-learning potentials. AdsNet thus establishes an accurate, highly efficient, and interpretable framework for large-scale adsorption energy prediction and local interface relaxation across various material surfaces.
articles.abstract_zh: 快速准确地预测吸附能对于高通量计算催化剂筛选至关重要，现有方法在评估速度（全图机器学习潜力）或几何灵敏度（基于协调的模型，如 alpha 方案）上进行了妥协。在这里，我们提出了 AdsNet，一种等变图神经网络，可以直接预测单次前向传递中的吸附能，该网络在仅限于吸附原子及其在截止半径内的直接表面邻居的局部图上运行。这种局部图公式将计算复杂性与系统总尺寸解耦，同时对连续几何特征（原子间距离和方向向量）进行编码，从而能够对局部键合环境中的细微变化敏感。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 快速准确地预测吸附能对于高通量计算催化剂筛选至关重要，现有方法在评估速度（全图机器学习潜力）或几何灵敏度（基于协调的模型，如 alpha 方案）上进行了妥协。在这里，我们提出了 AdsNet，一种等变图神经网络，可以直接预测单次前向传递中的吸附能，该网络在仅限于吸附原子及其在截止半径内的直接表面邻居的局部图上运行。这种局部图公式将计算复杂性与系统总尺寸解耦，同时对连续几何特征（原子间距离和方向向量）进行编码，从而能够对局部键合环境中的细微变化敏感。 AdsNet 采用消息传递架构，在多个交互层上具有标量和向量节点特征。该模型在 AdsTraj（包含 33,920 个密度泛函理论 (DFT) 计算结构的数据集，涵盖 26 种过渡金属和 6 种吸附物（H*、C*、O*、CO*、OH*、HOCO*））上进行训练，实现了 0.032 eV 的吸附能均方根误差 (RMSE) 和 0.047 eV/A 的力 RMSE。通过自动微分获得的解析力可以通过具有自适应线搜索的投影梯度下降算法实现结构松弛，从而消除整个几何优化。此外，AdsNet 独特地将预测的吸附能分解为局部吸附图中各个原子的贡献——这是传统机器学习潜力无法实现的可解释性特征。因此，AdsNet 为各种材料表面的大规模吸附能预测和局部界面弛豫建立了一个准确、高效和可解释的框架。

articles.title: Field-free deterministic spin-orbit torque magnetization switching using monolayer WTe2
articles.title_zh: 使用单层 WTe2 的无场确定性自旋轨道扭矩磁化切换
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.25755v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: An important step towards the practical implementation of spin-orbit torque magnetic memory is the field-free switching of the magnetization vector. In this work, we investigate spin-orbit torque-driven magnetization dynamics and switching devices comprising monolayer WTe₂ as the spin-source material. We perform a comparative analysis of the two phases of WTe₂, namely the 1T_d and 1T' with the necessary symmetries for field-free deterministic magnetization switching. We demonstrate switching in both systems and analyse the dependence of the switching dynamics on the applied bias voltage, ribbon orientation and width of the magnetic layer. Modelling the ferromagnet as an exchange-coupled macrospin within a non-equilibrium Green's function framework, we find that the x-ribbon geometry of the 1T_d WTe₂ phase generates a significantly larger current-induced spin polarization than the 1T' phase, resulting in a larger damping-like torque on the adjacent magnetic layer and faster switching. The switching time of 1T' devices varies strongly and non-monotonically with the width of the magnetic layer. In 1T_d devices, it remains nearly constant over a broad range of widths, consistent with an edge-dominated torque. These results identify x-ribbon 1T_d-WTe₂ as a promising spin source for field-free SOT-MRAM.
articles.abstract_zh: 实现自旋轨道扭矩磁存储器的重要一步是磁化矢量的无场切换。在这项工作中，我们研究了自旋轨道扭矩驱动的磁化动力学和包含单层 WTe2 作为自旋源材料的开关器件。我们对 WTe2 的两个相（即 1T_d 和 1T'）进行了比较分析，具有无场确定性磁化翻转所需的对称性。我们演示了两个系统中的切换，并分析了切换动态对所施加的偏置电压、带方向和磁性层宽度的依赖性。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 实现自旋轨道扭矩磁存储器的重要一步是磁化矢量的无场切换。在这项工作中，我们研究了自旋轨道扭矩驱动的磁化动力学和包含单层 WTe2 作为自旋源材料的开关器件。我们对 WTe2 的两个相（即 1T_d 和 1T'）进行了比较分析，具有无场确定性磁化翻转所需的对称性。我们演示了两个系统中的切换，并分析了切换动态对所施加的偏置电压、带方向和磁性层宽度的依赖性。将铁磁体建模为非平衡格林函数框架内的交换耦合宏观自旋，我们发现 1T_d WTe 2 相的 x 带几何形状产生比 1T' 相大得多的电流感应自旋极化，从而在相邻磁性层上产生更大的阻尼类扭矩和更快的切换。 1T'器件的开关时间随磁性层的宽度强烈且非单调地变化。在 1T_d 器件中，它在很宽的宽度范围内几乎保持恒定，与边缘主导的扭矩一致。这些结果表明 x-ribbon 1T_d-WTe2 是一种有前途的无场 SOT-MRAM 自旋源。

articles.title: Current-driven resistive switching in high-field heavy fermion metal UTe2
articles.title_zh: 高场重费米子金属 UTe2 中的电流驱动电阻开关
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.25792v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In UTe₂, superconductivity persists up to 70 T for fields tilted by roughly 20-40deg from the b axis toward c. Its normal state is a field-polarized (FP) state, which emerges above a first-order metamagnetic transition when the field component along b exceeds sim35 T. Despite being the parent of this high-field superconductivity, the FP state remains poorly understood, including whether it shares underlying physics with the low-field paramagnetic (PM) state from which it is abruptly separated. Using microstructures fabricated by focused ion beam, we reach current densities of 30-60 kA/cm2 and observe a current-induced high-resistivity state in both the PM and FP regimes over a wide range of field angles in the bc plane. Above a critical current density of order 10 kA/cm2, the resistivity sharply rises to values comparable to those near the critical end point of the metamagnetic transition. The critical current density increases with temperature, opposite to the trend expected from Joule heating, ruling out a thermal origin. The emergence of the same instability on both sides of the metamagnetic transition reveals an unexpected commonality between the FP and PM states. More broadly, the observation of a current-induced transition in a heavy-fermion metal exposes the multitude of nearby electronic states in correlated electron systems and shows that electric current, like magnetic field and pressure, can switch between them.
articles.abstract_zh: 在 UTe2 中，当场从 b 轴向 c 倾斜大约 20-40 度时，超导性持续高达 70 T。它的正常状态是场极化 (FP) 状态，当沿 b 的场分量超过 sim35 T 时，它会出现在一阶变磁转变之上。尽管 FP 状态是这种高场超导性的母体，但人们对 FP 状态仍然知之甚少，包括它是否与它突然分离的低场顺磁 (PM) 状态共享基础物理。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在 UTe2 中，当场从 b 轴向 c 倾斜大约 20-40 度时，超导性持续高达 70 T。它的正常状态是场极化 (FP) 状态，当沿 b 的场分量超过 sim35 T 时，它会出现在一阶变磁转变之上。尽管 FP 状态是这种高场超导性的母体，但人们对 FP 状态仍然知之甚少，包括它是否与它突然分离的低场顺磁 (PM) 状态共享基础物理。使用聚焦离子束制造的微结构，我们达到了 30-60 kA/cm2 的电流密度，并在 bc 平面的各种视场角上观察到 PM 和 FP 状态下的电流感应高电阻率状态。高于 10 kA/cm2 数量级的临界电流密度时，电阻率急剧上升至与变磁转变临界终点附近的值相当的值。临界电流密度随温度增加，与焦耳热预期的趋势相反，排除了热源。变磁转变两侧出现相同的不稳定性揭示了 FP 和 PM 状态之间意想不到的共性。更广泛地说，对重费米子金属中电流引起的跃迁的观察暴露了相关电子系统中的大量附近电子态，并表明电流（如磁场和压力）可以在它们之间切换。

articles.title: Helices at Twisted Ferroelectric Interfaces
articles.title_zh: 扭曲铁电界面处的螺旋
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.25828v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We report that twisted interfaces, formed between two ferroelectric lithium niobate single crystals, contain arrays of coherently bonded and elastically deformed nanoscale structural helices, separated from one another by screw dislocations. The helices generate remarkable contrast in four dimensional scanning transmission electron microscopy (4D STEM) and through related differential phase contrast (DPC). Such images have been successfully rationalised by modelling the trajectory of electrons that channel along helical pathways as they traverse the interface, but the structural helices implied have also been directly imaged using electron ptychography. Importantly, as lithium niobate is a uniaxial ferroelectric, the torsional strain in these structural helices necessarily also causes dipolar helices to form, inferred through consideration of pertinent piezoelectric tensors and flexoelectric coefficients. Helices are topologically distinct from the more commonly reported vortices and, importantly, they are chiral. Helical (and hence chiral) character was confirmed by observing that DPC images were identical before and after the sample was inverted. Chirality was also established through second harmonic optical circularly-polarised dichroism measurements, in which unusually large interfacial signals were seen. It must be stressed that the arrays of helices observed are distinct from moiré patterns; they facilitate lattice rotation combining plastic and elastic deformation and are not simply a superposition of lattices, twisted with respect to one another. Thus, intimately bonded twisted oxide interfaces will have distinctly different characteristics from those of twisted stacks of two-dimensional van der Waals materials, opening up a new and distinct kind of twistronics.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们报告说，两个铁电铌酸锂单晶之间形成的扭曲界面包含连贯键合和弹性变形的纳米级结构螺旋阵列，通过螺旋位错彼此分开。螺旋在四维扫描透射电子显微镜 (4D STEM) 和相关微分相差 (DPC) 中产生显着的对比度。通过对电子穿过界面时沿螺旋路径传播的轨迹进行建模，这些图像已成功合理化，但隐含的结构螺旋也已使用电子叠层描记法直接成像。重要的是，由于铌酸锂是单轴铁电体，因此通过考虑相关压电张量和挠电系数推断，这些结构螺旋中的扭转应变也必然会导致偶极螺旋的形成。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们报告说，两个铁电铌酸锂单晶之间形成的扭曲界面包含连贯键合和弹性变形的纳米级结构螺旋阵列，通过螺旋位错彼此分开。螺旋在四维扫描透射电子显微镜 (4D STEM) 和相关微分相差 (DPC) 中产生显着的对比度。通过对电子穿过界面时沿螺旋路径传播的轨迹进行建模，这些图像已成功合理化，但隐含的结构螺旋也已使用电子叠层描记法直接成像。重要的是，由于铌酸锂是单轴铁电体，因此通过考虑相关压电张量和挠电系数推断，这些结构螺旋中的扭转应变也必然会导致偶极螺旋的形成。螺旋在拓扑上与更常见的涡旋不同，重要的是，它们是手性的。通过观察样品倒转前后的 DPC 图像相同，可以确认螺旋（因此也是手性）特征。手性也通过二次谐波光学圆偏振二色性测量来确定，其中观察到异常大的界面信号。必须强调的是，观察到的螺旋阵列与莫尔图案不同。它们促进晶格旋转，结合塑性和弹性变形，并且不仅仅是晶格的叠加，相对于彼此扭曲。因此，紧密结合的扭曲氧化物界面将具有与二维范德华材料的扭曲堆叠明显不同的特性，从而开辟了一种新的、独特的扭曲电子学。

articles.title: Molecular Dynamics Simulation of the Solidification of AlCoCuFeNi High-Entropy Alloy Nanowire
articles.title_zh: AlCoCuFeNi高熵合金纳米线凝固的分子动力学模拟
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.25836v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Molecular dynamics simulation of the solidification behavior of an AlCoCuFeNi high-entropy alloy nanowire was performed using an embedded atom model potential at cooling rates of 10¹¹, 10¹², and 10¹³ K/s. Periodic boundary conditions were applied along the nanowire axis to model an effectively infinite nanowire. The crystallization process was characterized through the temperature dependence of the potential energy. Structural evolution was analyzed using adaptive common-neighbor analysis (CNA) and radial distribution functions (RDF). The results show that the final structure changes from amorphous to crystalline with decreasing cooling rate, demonstrating the strong influence of cooling conditions on phase formation in nanoscale high-entropy alloy systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 使用嵌入原子模型电势在 10¹、10² 和 10³ K/s 的冷却速率下对 AlCoCuFeNi 高熵合金纳米线的凝固行为进行分子动力学模拟。沿着纳米线轴应用周期性边界条件来模拟有效的无限纳米线。结晶过程通过势能的温度依赖性来表征。使用自适应共邻分析（CNA）和径向分布函数（RDF）来分析结构演化。结果表明，随着冷却速率的降低，最终结构从非晶态转变为晶态，证明了冷却条件对纳米级高熵合金体系中相形成的强烈影响。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 使用嵌入原子模型电势在 10¹、10² 和 10³ K/s 的冷却速率下对 AlCoCuFeNi 高熵合金纳米线的凝固行为进行分子动力学模拟。沿着纳米线轴应用周期性边界条件来模拟有效的无限纳米线。结晶过程通过势能的温度依赖性来表征。使用自适应共邻分析（CNA）和径向分布函数（RDF）来分析结构演化。结果表明，随着冷却速率的降低，最终结构从非晶态转变为晶态，证明了冷却条件对纳米级高熵合金体系中相形成的强烈影响。

articles.title: Higher-order magnetic hopfions in uniaxial chiral magnets
articles.title_zh: 单轴手性磁体中的高阶磁霍芬子
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.25883v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Chiral magnets host hopfions, but their experimentally observed configurations are largely limited to hopfion rings, heliknotons, and their clusters. Here, we show that uniaxial anisotropy stabilizes a diverse family of knotted and linked hopfions with zero and arbitrary positive Hopf indices. We identify their stability regions in the anisotropy -- field parameter space and introduce a systematic construction based on mapping skyrmion braids into three-dimensional magnetic textures. We find that the minimum energy of stable hopfions increases approximately linearly with the Hopf index.
articles.abstract_zh: 手性磁体包含霍菲子，但其实验观察到的构型很大程度上局限于霍菲子环、螺旋子及其簇。在这里，我们证明单轴各向异性稳定了具有零和任意正 Hopf 指数的打结和连接的 hopfion 的多样化家族。我们确定了它们在各向异性场参数空间中的稳定区域，并引入了一种基于将斯格明子辫子映射到三维磁纹理的系统结构。我们发现稳定霍普夫离子的最小能量随着霍普夫指数近似线性增加。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 手性磁体包含霍菲子，但其实验观察到的构型很大程度上局限于霍菲子环、螺旋子及其簇。在这里，我们证明单轴各向异性稳定了具有零和任意正 Hopf 指数的打结和连接的 hopfion 的多样化家族。我们确定了它们在各向异性场参数空间中的稳定区域，并引入了一种基于将斯格明子辫子映射到三维磁纹理的系统结构。我们发现稳定霍普夫离子的最小能量随着霍普夫指数近似线性增加。

articles.title: Ab-initio study of magnetic interaction in RNiO2: role of rare-earth size and epitaxial strain
articles.title_zh: RNiO2 中磁相互作用的从头算研究：稀土尺寸和外延应变的作用
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.25907v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In this paper we present a systematic first-principles investigation of the structure and nearest-neighbor magnetic exchange interactions in the infinite-layer RNiO2 thin-film series (R = La-Lu), under the constrain of different substrates. Density functional theory calculations are first employed to optimize the crystal structures, while CAS+DDCI correlated wave-function calculations were used for the determination of the magnetic exchanges. This methodology allows to obtain magnetic interactions in good agreement with RIXS experimental estimations. In the pristine case, our results confirm that the structure of RNiO2 (except for R = La and Ce) adopts the I4/mcm space group, characterized by an out-of-plane rotation of the NiO4 plaquettes. This result remains valid under substrate constrains, even if compressive strain reduces the amplitude of the rotational distortion and leads to an enhancement of the magnetic exchange interaction relative to the pristine structures. The latter are found to depend sensitively on both the rare-earth ionic radius and the applied epitaxial strain. These results highlight the role of structural distortions and substrate-induced strain in tuning magnetic interactions in infinite-layer nickelates.
articles.abstract_zh: 在本文中，我们对不同基底约束下无限层 RNiO2 薄膜系列（R = La-Lu）的结构和最近邻磁交换相互作用进行了系统的第一性原理研究。首先采用密度泛函理论计算来优化晶体结构，同时使用CAS+DDCI相关波函数计算来确定磁交换。该方法允许获得与 RIXS 实验估计非常一致的磁相互作用。在原始情况下，我们的结果证实了 RNiO2 的结构（R = La 和 Ce 除外）采用 I4/mcm 空间群，其特征是 NiO4 板的面外旋转。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在本文中，我们对不同基底约束下无限层 RNiO2 薄膜系列（R = La-Lu）的结构和最近邻磁交换相互作用进行了系统的第一性原理研究。首先采用密度泛函理论计算来优化晶体结构，同时使用CAS+DDCI相关波函数计算来确定磁交换。该方法允许获得与 RIXS 实验估计非常一致的磁相互作用。在原始情况下，我们的结果证实了 RNiO2 的结构（R = La 和 Ce 除外）采用 I4/mcm 空间群，其特征是 NiO4 板的面外旋转。即使压缩应变降低了旋转变形的幅度并导致相对于原始结构的磁交换相互作用增强，该结果在基底约束下仍然有效。发现后者敏感地取决于稀土离子半径和所施加的外延应变。这些结果强调了结构变形和基底引起的应变在调节无限层镍酸盐磁相互作用中的作用。

articles.title: Alloying effects on the interface cohesion of grain boundaries in the Ni--Fe--Cr system
articles.title_zh: 合金化对Ni--Fe--Cr系晶界界面凝聚力的影响
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.25944v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Grain boundaries (GBs) in polycrystalline Ni-based alloys strongly influence mechanical strength and fracture behavior, yet the effect of alloying elements such as Fe and Cr on GB cohesion remains difficult to quantify systematically. Using density functional theory (DFT), we compute rigid-body separation (RBS) curves for six symmetric-tilt Ni GBs, extracting the work of separation Wₛₑₚ and maximum traction σₘₐₓ via the universal binding energy relation (UBER). We find that substitution of Cr or Fe into the GB plane increases both quantities relative to pure Ni GBs. To overcome the size limitations of DFT, we compare several machine-learning interatomic potential (MLIP) foundation models against the DFT dataset and identify a model achieving quantitative agreement with DFT for Wₛₑₚ and σₘₐₓ. This MLIP enables systematic sampling of alloying configurations at finer concentration steps. We show that alloying-induced changes in GB cohesion depend on both, element type and local structures, revealing trends that are inaccessible with DFT alone. Extending the analysis to a ternary Ni₅₆Fe₂₀Cr₂₄ composition, inspired by the principal constituents of the widely used commercial Alloy 718, shows that the binary trends provide a useful basis for interpreting the combined effect of both substitutes, while explicit ternary calculations are required to capture their interplay quantitatively. Together, these results provide a validated workflow for quantifying the effect of alloying elements on GB cohesion in multicomponent alloys. The resulting values may serve as input for continuum-scale fracture models, paving the way toward atomistically informed multiscale modeling.
articles.abstract_zh: 多晶镍基合金中的晶界 (GB) 强烈影响机械强度和断裂行为，但 Fe 和 Cr 等合金元素对晶界内聚力的影响仍然难以系统量化。使用密度泛函理论 (DFT)，我们计算了六个对称倾斜 Ni GB 的刚体分离 (RBS) 曲线，通过通用结合能关系 (UBER) 提取分离功 Wₛₑₚ 和最大牵引力 σₘₐₓ。我们发现，相对于纯镍晶界，将 Cr 或 Fe 替换到晶界平面中会增加这两个量。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 多晶镍基合金中的晶界 (GB) 强烈影响机械强度和断裂行为，但 Fe 和 Cr 等合金元素对晶界内聚力的影响仍然难以系统量化。使用密度泛函理论 (DFT)，我们计算了六个对称倾斜 Ni GB 的刚体分离 (RBS) 曲线，通过通用结合能关系 (UBER) 提取分离功 Wₛₑₚ 和最大牵引力 σₘₐₓ。我们发现，相对于纯镍晶界，将 Cr 或 Fe 替换到晶界平面中会增加这两个量。为了克服 DFT 的尺寸限制，我们将几种机器学习原子间势 (MLIP) 基础模型与 DFT 数据集进行比较，并确定一个在 Wₛₑₚ 和 σₘₐₓ 方面与 DFT 实现定量一致性的模型。该 MLIP 能够以更精细的浓度步骤对合金结构进行系统采样。我们表明，合金化引起的晶界内聚力的变化取决于元素类型和局部结构，揭示了单独使用 DFT 无法获得的趋势。受到广泛使用的商用合金 718 主要成分的启发，将分析扩展到三元 Ni56Fe20Cr24 成分，表明二元趋势为解释两种替代品的综合效应提供了有用的基础，而需要明确的三元计算来定量捕获它们的相互作用。总之，这些结果提供了一个经过验证的工作流程，用于量化合金元素对多组分合金中 GB 内聚力的影响。所得值可以作为连续尺度裂缝模型的输入，为原子信息多尺度建模铺平道路。

articles.title: Topology-Enabled Self-Verification of Quantum Hall Resistance Standards
articles.title_zh: 拓扑支持的量子霍尔电阻标准的自我验证
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.26016v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The scaling of multi-element quantized Hall array resistance standards necessitates rigorous validation that internal quantization has not broken down without relying on the verification of dissipationless edge state transport. One proposed solution is to use a Symmetric Precision Quantization Reliability criterion, a mathematical framework that statistically assures such validation strictly through outer terminal measurements of Cn-symmetric designs. This criterion essentially bounds the likelihood of hidden localized defects arising from quantum Hall breakdown and has potential uses in quantum computing and semiconductor testing but is presented in the context of its application toward quantum electrical standards.
articles.abstract_zh: 多元件量化霍尔阵列电阻标准的缩放需要严格验证内部量化在不依赖无耗散边缘状态传输验证的情况下没有崩溃。一种建议的解决方案是使用对称精度量化可靠性准则，这是一种数学框架，可以通过 Cn 对称设计的外部终端测量严格地在统计上确保这种验证。该标准本质上限制了量子霍尔击穿引起的隐藏局部缺陷的可能性，并且在量子计算和半导体测试中具有潜在用途，但在其应用于量子电标准的背景下提出。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 多元件量化霍尔阵列电阻标准的缩放需要严格验证内部量化在不依赖无耗散边缘状态传输验证的情况下没有崩溃。一种建议的解决方案是使用对称精度量化可靠性准则，这是一种数学框架，可以通过 Cn 对称设计的外部终端测量严格地在统计上确保这种验证。该标准本质上限制了量子霍尔击穿引起的隐藏局部缺陷的可能性，并且在量子计算和半导体测试中具有潜在用途，但在其应用于量子电标准的背景下提出。

articles.title: Three-mode chimera-like states in a minimal network of active camphor ribbons
articles.title_zh: 活性樟脑带最小网络中的三模嵌合态
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.26039v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Chimera states are a remarkable manifestation of symmetry breaking, wherein identical units spontaneously split into coherent and incoherent groups. The term "chimera" itself is inspired by the mythological creature having parts of different animals, reflecting the coexistence of distinct dynamical behaviors within a single system. Here, we experimentally demonstrate the existence of a three-mode chimera-like state in a system of four identical camphor-infused elliptical rotors, each pivoted at a corner of a square base. When placed on a water surface, the rotors self-propel and rotate due to Marangoni-driven flows. Chemical coupling mediated through the shared water interface gives rise to three distinct collective dynamical states, namely a synchronized one, an antisynchronized one and an incoherent one. Our results validate recent theoretical work about three-domain chimeras in reaction-diffusion models, providing new insights into nonlinear dynamics and suggesting that this new type of chimera may be observed in a broad class of physical systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 嵌合态是对称性破缺的显着表现，其中相同的单元自发地分裂成相干和不相干的组。 “嵌合体”一词本身的灵感来自具有不同动物部分的神话生物，反映了单一系统内不同动态行为的共存。在这里，我们通过实验证明了在四个相同的注入樟脑的椭圆形转子的系统中存在三模式嵌合体状态，每个转子都在方形底座的一个角上枢转。当放置在水面上时，转子会由于马兰戈尼驱动的水流而自行推进和旋转。通过共享水界面介导的化学耦合产生了三种不同的集体动力学状态，即同步状态、反同步状态和非相干状态。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 嵌合态是对称性破缺的显着表现，其中相同的单元自发地分裂成相干和不相干的组。 “嵌合体”一词本身的灵感来自具有不同动物部分的神话生物，反映了单一系统内不同动态行为的共存。在这里，我们通过实验证明了在四个相同的注入樟脑的椭圆形转子的系统中存在三模式嵌合体状态，每个转子都在方形底座的一个角上枢转。当放置在水面上时，转子会由于马兰戈尼驱动的水流而自行推进和旋转。通过共享水界面介导的化学耦合产生了三种不同的集体动力学状态，即同步状态、反同步状态和非相干状态。我们的结果验证了最近关于反应扩散模型中三域嵌合体的理论工作，为非线性动力学提供了新的见解，并表明这种新型嵌合体可以在广泛的物理系统中观察到。

articles.title: Onset of subdiffusion in dephased quasiperiodic lattices
articles.title_zh: 相移准周期晶格中亚扩散的开始
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.26082v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Dephasing is widely expected to induce diffusion in quasiperiodic lattices due to the loss of phase coherence. However, this expectation can fail dramatically in lattices possessing singular onsite potentials or vanishing hoppings which are expected to trivially localize the particle. Remarkably, we show that the transport in such lattices can be subdiffusive under proper conditions for which the "mean resistance" of the lattice diverges. As a result, we obtain a transition from diffusive to subdiffusive transport depending on the strength of quasiperiodic modulation. Even more strikingly, the transport is slowest not deep in the subdiffusive regime but precisely at its onset, forming a sharp "subdiffusive trench". Our analytical and numerical analysis reveal that the transport exponents are universal, fixed solely by the order of singularities (zeros) of the diagonal (off-diagonal) quasiperiodic modulation. In the end, we complement our findings through exact Lindblad simulations and provide possible experimental routes to realize such non-trivial transport.
articles.abstract_zh: 由于相位相干性的损失，人们普遍认为移相会引起准周期晶格中的扩散。然而，在具有奇异就位势或消失跳跃的晶格中，这种期望可能会戏剧性地失败，而这些晶格预计会微不足道地定位粒子。值得注意的是，我们表明，在晶格的“平均电阻”发散的适当条件下，此类晶格中的传输可以是亚扩散的。结果，我们根据准周期调制的强度获得从扩散传输到亚扩散传输的转变。更引人注目的是，传输最慢的不是在次扩散区域的深处，而是恰恰在其开始时，形成了一个尖锐的“次扩散沟槽”。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 由于相位相干性的损失，人们普遍认为移相会引起准周期晶格中的扩散。然而，在具有奇异就位势或消失跳跃的晶格中，这种期望可能会戏剧性地失败，而这些晶格预计会微不足道地定位粒子。值得注意的是，我们表明，在晶格的“平均电阻”发散的适当条件下，此类晶格中的传输可以是亚扩散的。结果，我们根据准周期调制的强度获得从扩散传输到亚扩散传输的转变。更引人注目的是，传输最慢的不是在次扩散区域的深处，而是恰恰在其开始时，形成了一个尖锐的“次扩散沟槽”。我们的分析和数值分析表明，输运指数是通用的，仅由对角线（非对角线）准周期调制的奇点（零）的阶数决定。最后，我们通过精确的 Lindblad 模拟补充了我们的发现，并提供了可能的实验路线来实现这种非平凡的运输。

articles.title: Sliding-ferroelectric control of dipolar and quadrupolar excitons in R-stacked WSe₂
articles.title_zh: R堆叠WSe2中偶极和四极激子的滑动铁电控制
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.26158v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: A fundamental property of interlayer excitons is their dipolar character, enabling electrical tunability, enhanced exciton-exciton interactions and extended lifetime. It is important for studying collective phenomena and realizing novel optoelectronic devices. However, in homo- or heterostructures based on two-dimensional semiconductors, the magnitude and orientation of the dipole moment are commonly locked due to spatially confined charges and nature of the band transition. Here, we use gate-dependent photoluminescence of few-layer R-WSe2 to harness sliding ferroelectricity for controlling the exciton dipole configuration of emerging layer-hybridised excitons. The sliding-ferroelectric control enables a pronounced on/off switching of the diffusive transport of hybrid dipolar excitons, while further facilitating gradual and abrupt dipole reconfigurations with emerging quadrupolar excitons. Our optical probe reveals intermediate states of vertically aligned interfacial polarisation with magnitudes that confirm cumulative polarisation in multilayers. Overall, our work presents sliding ferroelectricity as a powerful tool to tune interlayer coupling and layer hybridisation. These results represent a step toward ferroelectric-controlled exciton interconnects and novel multi-bit optical memories.
articles.abstract_zh: 层间激子的一个基本特性是其偶极特性，可实现电可调性、增强激子-激子相互作用并延长寿命。它对于研究集体现象和实现新型光电器件具有重要意义。然而，在基于二维半导体的同质或异质结构中，由于空间限制的电荷和能带跃迁的性质，偶极矩的大小和方向通常被锁定。在这里，我们使用少层 R-WSe2 的栅极相关光致发光来利用滑动铁电性来控制新兴层杂化激子的激子偶极子构型。滑动铁电控制能够实现混合偶极激子扩散传输的显着开/关切换，同时进一步促进新兴四极激子的渐进和突然偶极重构。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 层间激子的一个基本特性是其偶极特性，可实现电可调性、增强激子-激子相互作用并延长寿命。它对于研究集体现象和实现新型光电器件具有重要意义。然而，在基于二维半导体的同质或异质结构中，由于空间限制的电荷和能带跃迁的性质，偶极矩的大小和方向通常被锁定。在这里，我们使用少层 R-WSe2 的栅极相关光致发光来利用滑动铁电性来控制新兴层杂化激子的激子偶极子构型。滑动铁电控制能够实现混合偶极激子扩散传输的显着开/关切换，同时进一步促进新兴四极激子的渐进和突然偶极重构。我们的光学探针揭示了垂直排列的界面偏振的中间状态，其大小证实了多层中的累积偏振。总的来说，我们的工作将滑动铁电作为调整层间耦合和层杂化的强大工具。这些结果代表了朝着铁电控制激子互连和新型多位光学存储器迈出的一步。

articles.title: Spectral localizers in phase space: Z and Z₂ invariants for higher-order, semimetal, and valley modes
articles.title_zh: 相空间中的谱定位器：高阶、半金属和谷模的 Z 和 Z2 不变量
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.26160v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Topologically protected gapless modes emerge across multiple platforms, ranging from nodes in the band structure to boundary states in topologically non-trivial insulators, with each case governed by distinct topological classifications and invariants. Here, we generalize the spectral localizer method to establish a unified framework for topological gapless modes. The spectral localizer reduces the original Hamiltonian to a zero-dimensional operator by recursively applying quantum confining operators, which need not be diagonal in either position or momentum space, as previously assumed. In phase space, the zero-manifold of the semiclassical confining operators forms a shell enclosing the gapless mode of interest, analogous to the Teo-Kane framework for topological defects. The localizer yields a zero-dimensional invariant, such as a signature, a determinant sign, or a Pfaffian sign, capturing both Z and Z₂ classifications. This single construction thus encompasses diverse scenarios, including hinge modes in higher-order topological insulators, individual Dirac nodes in semimetals, and valley-selective topological boundary modes. We illustrate our approach using lattice models in symmetry classes A, AIII, AII, and D, verifying that topological transitions coincide with a vanishing gap in the spectral localizer operator.
articles.abstract_zh: 拓扑保护的无间隙模式出现在多个平台上，从能带结构中的节点到拓扑非平凡绝缘体中的边界态，每种情况都受到不同的拓扑分类和不变量的控制。在这里，我们推广了光谱定位器方法来建立拓扑无间隙模式的统一框架。谱定位器通过递归应用量子限制算子将原始哈密顿算子简化为零维算子，如先前假设的那样，量子限制算子在位置或动量空间中不需要是对角线。在相空间中，半经典限制算子的零流形形成一个包围感兴趣的无间隙模式的壳，类似于拓扑缺陷的 Teo-Kane 框架。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 拓扑保护的无间隙模式出现在多个平台上，从能带结构中的节点到拓扑非平凡绝缘体中的边界态，每种情况都受到不同的拓扑分类和不变量的控制。在这里，我们推广了光谱定位器方法来建立拓扑无间隙模式的统一框架。谱定位器通过递归应用量子限制算子将原始哈密顿算子简化为零维算子，如先前假设的那样，量子限制算子在位置或动量空间中不需要是对角线。在相空间中，半经典限制算子的零流形形成一个包围感兴趣的无间隙模式的壳，类似于拓扑缺陷的 Teo-Kane 框架。定位器产生零维不变量，例如签名、行列式符号或普法夫符号，捕获 Z 和 Z2 分类。因此，这种单一结构涵盖了多种场景，包括高阶拓扑绝缘体中的铰链模式、半金属中的单个狄拉克节点以及谷选择性拓扑边界模式。我们使用对称类 A、AIII、AII 和 D 中的晶格模型来说明我们的方法，验证拓扑转变与光谱定位算子中的消失间隙一致。

articles.title: Reward misalignment as an opportunity for materials discovery
articles.title_zh: 奖励错位作为材料发现的机会
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.26186v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Reward misalignment is usually regarded as a failure of artificial intelligence. In materials discovery with generative AI models, however, disagreement between predefined rewards and expert judgment may reveal materials that the rewards overlook. We investigate this possibility using electronic flat bands as a prime example. Experts mostly agree with a numerical bandwidth score, but their disagreements are systematic and cannot be explained by an estimated 5% rate of mistaken labels. We learn the experts' preferences from pairwise comparisons and use them to guide a crystal diffusion model. The learned preferences and numerical score agree on the flattest bands but diverge elsewhere. For example, the preferences favor KCo2As2 and CoGa, reported compounds with partially flat bands that the score would discard. The framework also extends to synthesizability and phonon properties. Our findings suggest that reward misalignment can expose opportunities for materials discovery beyond what fixed rewards are designed to find.
articles.abstract_zh: 奖励失调通常被视为人工智能的失败。然而，在使用生成式人工智能模型进行材料发现时，预定义奖励与专家判断之间的不一致可能会揭示奖励忽略的材料。我们使用电子平带作为主要示例来研究这种可能性。专家们大多同意数字带宽分数，但他们的分歧是系统性的，不能用估计的 5% 错误标签率来解释。我们通过成对比较了解专家的偏好，并用它们来指导晶体扩散模型。学习到的偏好和数值分数在最平坦的带上一致，但在其他地方有所不同。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 奖励失调通常被视为人工智能的失败。然而，在使用生成式人工智能模型进行材料发现时，预定义奖励与专家判断之间的不一致可能会揭示奖励忽略的材料。我们使用电子平带作为主要示例来研究这种可能性。专家们大多同意数字带宽分数，但他们的分歧是系统性的，不能用估计的 5% 错误标签率来解释。我们通过成对比较了解专家的偏好，并用它们来指导晶体扩散模型。学习到的偏好和数值分数在最平坦的带上一致，但在其他地方有所不同。例如，偏好有利于 KCo2As2 和 CoGa，报告的化合物具有部分平坦的谱带，分数将丢弃这些化合物。该框架还扩展到可合成性和声子特性。我们的研究结果表明，奖励错位可能会暴露材料发现的机会，超出固定奖励的设计目的。

articles.title: Fast extraction of universal data from temporal spectrum: Applications to Haagerup CFT and monopole scattering
articles.title_zh: 从时间谱中快速提取通用数据：Haagerup CFT 和单极散射的应用
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.26257v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Extracting precise universal data on conformal field theory (CFT) on the lattice traditionally requires large-scale simulations of the ground states and excitations of critical systems. Here, we propose an alternative accurate and fast algorithm, where we read off the CFT spectrum from the transfer matrix spectrum of an infinite matrix product state after a short imaginary-time evolution. We apply this method to extract the charge-resolved spectrum of a Haagerup CFT to higher levels and obtain a central charge c = 2.137(27). Moreover, we show that the Maldacena--Ludwig monopole boundary can be realized as the ground state of the Fidkowski--Kitaev Hamiltonian after space-time rotation.
articles.abstract_zh: 传统上，在晶格上提取共形场论（CFT）的精确通用数据需要对关键系统的基态和激励进行大规模模拟。在这里，我们提出了一种精确而快速的替代算法，在短虚数时间演化后，我们从无限矩阵乘积状态的转移矩阵谱中读出 CFT 谱。我们应用这种方法将 Haagerup CFT 的电荷分辨谱提取到更高水平，并获得中心电荷 c = 2.137(27)。此外，我们证明Maldacena-Ludwig单极子边界可以实现为时空旋转后Fidkowski-Kitaev哈密顿量的基态。

articles.title: Phase diagram of the attractive lattice Fermi polaron and the instability of Nagaoka ferromagnetism
articles.title_zh: 吸引晶格费米极化子的相图和长冈铁磁性的不稳定性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.26304v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: On the square lattice, the attractive polaron competes not only with the dimeron but also with Yang's η dimer, an exact eigenstate that maps onto the Nagaoka ferromagnet. With two-particle--hole Ansätze benchmarked by diagrammatic Monte Carlo, we find that the ground state evolves from polaron to dimeron to η dimer at low filling, and, beyond a triple point, directly from polaron to η dimer. Above 25% filling it stays a polaron. As the η dimer is exact, its boundary is a rigorous instability criterion for Nagaoka ferromagnetism, sharper than the previous best and logarithmic at low filling.
articles.abstract_zh: 在方晶格上，有吸引力的极化子不仅与二聚体竞争，还与杨的 η 二聚体竞争，后者是映射到长冈铁磁体上的精确本征态。通过以图解蒙特卡罗为基准的双粒子空穴 Ansätze，我们发现在低填充下基态从极化子演化为二聚体再演化为 η 二聚体，并且超过三相点时，直接从极化子演化为 η 二聚体。填充率高于 25% 时，它仍然是极化子。由于 η 二聚体是精确的，因此它的边界是长冈铁磁性的严格不稳定标准，比之前的最佳边界更尖锐，并且在低填充时为对数边界。

articles.title: Determining quantum phases of eight-fold quasicrystal optical lattices with angular structure factor
articles.title_zh: 用角结构因子确定八重准晶光学晶格的量子相
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.26320v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Quasicrystals have unique geometrical properties and are potential candidates to explore exotic states of matter. In this work, we explore the properties and the rotational symmetries of the quantum phases of ultracold atoms in the Ammann-Beenker quasicrystal optical lattice. We model the system with the quasicrystalline extended Bose-Hubbard model (qeBHM) and use mean field methods to identify the groundstate of qeBHM in the soft-core regime. To examine the diagonal long-range order of the groundstate quantum phases we develop a theoretical method to calculate the structure factor of the state. Our method clearly distinguishes various density wave (DW) and supersolid (SS) phases of the quasicrystal.
articles.abstract_zh: 准晶体具有独特的几何特性，是探索奇异物质态的潜在候选者。在这项工作中，我们探索了 Ammann-Beenker 准晶光学晶格中超冷原子量子相的性质和旋转对称性。我们使用准晶扩展 Bose-Hubbard 模型 (qeBHM) 对系统进行建模，并使用平均场方法来识别软核状态下 qeBHM 的基态。为了检查基态量子相的对角长程有序，我们开发了一种计算态结构因子的理论方法。我们的方法清楚地区分了准晶的各种密度波（DW）和超固体（SS）相。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 准晶体具有独特的几何特性，是探索奇异物质态的潜在候选者。在这项工作中，我们探索了 Ammann-Beenker 准晶光学晶格中超冷原子量子相的性质和旋转对称性。我们使用准晶扩展 Bose-Hubbard 模型 (qeBHM) 对系统进行建模，并使用平均场方法来识别软核状态下 qeBHM 的基态。为了检查基态量子相的对角长程有序，我们开发了一种计算态结构因子的理论方法。我们的方法清楚地区分了准晶的各种密度波（DW）和超固体（SS）相。

articles.title: Quantum Metric Control of Topological Superconductivity and Incommensurate Charge Density Wave in an Interacting Lieb-Kitaev Chain Model
articles.title_zh: 相互作用 Lieb-Kitaev 链模型中拓扑超导性和不相称电荷密度波的量子度量控制
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.26327v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study an interacting spinless Lieb-Kitaev chain model in the nearly flat-band regime, motivated by the recent observation that Majorana zero modes in the noninteracting Lieb-Kitaev system inherit two decay modes: an ordinary Bogoliubov-de Gennes (BdG) length and a longer geometric length controlled by the quantum metric. By tuning both the interaction strength and quantum metric, we identify a topological superconducting (TSC) phase, an incommensurate charge-density-wave (ICDW)phase, and a commensurate charge-density-wave (CDW) phase. Inside the TSC phase, the QML is enhanced when increasing the interactions. In the ICDW phase, the interactions are modulated by quantum metric to generate an effective chemical potential, leading to a discontinuous incommensurate-to-commensurate (IC-C) transition. We verify these phases and conclusions using low energy effective theory and density-matrix renormalization group (DMRG) calculations.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们研究了近平带状态下的相互作用无自旋李布-基塔耶夫链模型，其动机是最近观察到非相互作用李布-基塔耶夫系统中的马约拉纳零模式继承了两种衰变模式：普通的 Bogoliubov-de Gennes (BdG) 长度和由量子度量控制的较长几何长度。通过调整相互作用强度和量子度量，我们确定了拓扑超导（TSC）相、不相称电荷密度波（ICDW）相和相称电荷密度波（CDW）相。在 TSC 阶段内，QML 在增加交互时得到增强。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们研究了近平带状态下的相互作用无自旋李布-基塔耶夫链模型，其动机是最近观察到非相互作用李布-基塔耶夫系统中的马约拉纳零模式继承了两种衰变模式：普通的 Bogoliubov-de Gennes (BdG) 长度和由量子度量控制的较长几何长度。通过调整相互作用强度和量子度量，我们确定了拓扑超导（TSC）相、不相称电荷密度波（ICDW）相和相称电荷密度波（CDW）相。在 TSC 阶段内，QML 在增加交互时得到增强。在 ICDW 阶段，相互作用通过量子度量进行调制，以产生有效的化学势，从而导致不连续的不相称到相称（IC-C）转变。我们使用低能有效理论和密度矩阵重整化群（DMRG）计算验证了这些阶段和结论。

articles.title: Perfumer: A Large Language Model-based Agentic Framework Accelerating Structural Relaxation and Electronic Band Prediction for First-Principle Calculation
articles.title_zh: Perfumer：基于大型语言模型的代理框架，加速第一原理计算的结构松弛和电子频带预测
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.26349v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: First-principles structural relaxation and band calculations require substantial computation and expertise. Here we present Perfumer, a large language model-based agentic framework that couples Quantum ESPRESSO with two predictive models. Across tested structures, pre-relaxation with Perfumer-relax model followed by QE refinement yielded a 2.75-fold overall speedup over QE alone. Perfumer-band model combines a periodic graph neural network with a latent Hermitian spectral head returns 12 band energies at any requested wavevector, preserving reciprocal lattice periodicity and time-reversal symmetry without constructing Hamiltonian. Trained on 125,153 self-curated band structures, Perfumer-band model reaches a median per-material mean absolute error of 0.157 eV on 2,607 test materials, including lanthanide, actinide and magnetic compounds, from held-out composition families spanning 85 elements, taking about 97 ms per material on two consumer CPU cores. The agent turns natural-language requests into relaxation-to-band workflows, from a single uploaded structure to automatically constructed new candidates and returns predicted properties.
articles.abstract_zh: 第一原理结构松弛和能带计算需要大量的计算和专业知识。在这里，我们介绍 Perfumer，一个基于大型语言模型的代理框架，它将 Quantum ESPRESSO 与两个预测模型结合起来。在测试的结构中，使用 Perfumer-relax 模型进行预松弛，然后进行 QE 细化，其总体加速比单独使用 QE 提高了 2.75 倍。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 第一原理结构松弛和能带计算需要大量的计算和专业知识。在这里，我们介绍 Perfumer，一个基于大型语言模型的代理框架，它将 Quantum ESPRESSO 与两个预测模型结合起来。在测试的结构中，使用 Perfumer-relax 模型进行预松弛，然后进行 QE 细化，其总体加速比单独使用 QE 提高了 2.75 倍。 Perfumer-band 模型将周期图神经网络与潜在 Hermitian 谱头相结合，在任何请求的波矢量处返回 12 个能带能量，保留倒数晶格周期性和时间反转对称性，而无需构造哈密顿量。在 125,153 个自行设计的能带结构上进行训练后，Perfumer-band 模型在 2,607 种测试材料（包括镧系元素、锕系元素和磁性化合物）上达到了 0.157 eV 的每种材料平均绝对误差中值，这些测试材料来自跨越 85 个元素的保留成分族，每种材料在两个消费级 CPU 内核上花费了约 97 毫秒。该代理将自然语言请求转变为松弛带工作流程，从单个上传的结构到自动构建的新候选并返回预测的属性。

articles.title: Geometric formulation of the orbital magnetic susceptibility of periodic insulators
articles.title_zh: 周期性绝缘体轨道磁化率的几何公式
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.26356v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: A gauge-invariant projector-based expression for the orbital magnetic susceptibility of periodic insulators is obtained from a density-matrix perturbation expansion in a uniform magnetic field. It is shown that, within such an approach, it is natural to distinguish two contributions: the Van Vleck paramagnetic contribution and a geometric contribution. The latter can be expressed in terms of fundamental geometric quantities built from projector derivatives such as the curvature and metric operators, as well as the closely related magnetic moment operator. When applied to two-band and four-band models, the expression for the susceptibility reduces to a simplified formula expressed in terms of the quantum metric. The significance of quantum geometry for the orbital magnetic response is then examined within a lattice model in two dimensions describing the transition between two distinct insulators via a Dirac semimetallic phase.
articles.abstract_zh: 周期性绝缘体轨道磁化率的基于规范不变投影仪的表达式是从均匀磁场中的密度矩阵微扰展开获得的。结果表明，在这种方法中，很容易区分两种贡献：Van Vleck 顺磁贡献和几何贡献。后者可以用由投影导数构建的基本几何量来表示，例如曲率和度量算子，以及密切相关的磁矩算子。当应用于二波段和四波段模型时，磁化率的表达式简化为以量子度量表示的简化公式。然后在二维晶格模型中检查量子几何对轨道磁响应的重要性，该二维晶格模型描述了两个不同绝缘体之间通过狄拉克半金属相的转变。

articles.title: Are superfluidity and superconductivity related to the spontaneous breaking of U(1) symmetry?
articles.title_zh: 超流性和超导性与 U(1) 对称性的自发破缺有关吗？
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.26360v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: It is widely believed that superfluidity and superconductivity are caused by the spontaneous breaking of global U(1) symmetry. We investigate this question for quantum-mechanical systems using the following precise criterion for spontaneous symmetry breaking (SSB): the system's Hamiltonian and boundary conditions are invariant under transformations of a certain symmetry group, while the ground state is not. Through a simple analysis, we show that in real-world systems, which are always finite, spontaneous breaking of U(1) symmetry does not occur. Therefore, superfluidity and superconductivity can be related to SSB only in infinite systems, which do not exist in our Universe. We also discuss the relationship between the theory of SSB and reality.
articles.abstract_zh: 人们普遍认为，超流性和超导性是由整体U(1)对称性的自发破缺引起的。我们使用以下精确的自发对称破缺（SSB）标准来研究量子力学系统的这个问题：系统的哈密顿量和边界条件在特定对称群的变换下保持不变，而基态则不然。通过简单的分析，我们表明，在总是有限的现实系统中，U(1) 对称性的自发破缺不会发生。因此，超流性和超导性只能在无限系统中与单边带相关，而无限系统在我们的宇宙中并不存在。我们还讨论了SSB理论与现实之间的关系。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 人们普遍认为，超流性和超导性是由整体U(1)对称性的自发破缺引起的。我们使用以下精确的自发对称破缺（SSB）标准来研究量子力学系统的这个问题：系统的哈密顿量和边界条件在特定对称群的变换下保持不变，而基态则不然。通过简单的分析，我们表明，在总是有限的现实系统中，U(1) 对称性的自发破缺不会发生。因此，超流性和超导性只能在无限系统中与单边带相关，而无限系统在我们的宇宙中并不存在。我们还讨论了SSB理论与现实之间的关系。

articles.title: Imaginary-Time Density Correlations Encode Quantum Entropy and Free Energy
articles.title_zh: 虚时间密度相关性编码量子熵和自由能
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.26381v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In the classical limit, maximum-entropy inference yields an estimate of the excess entropy from the static structure factor through a single momentum sum. Quantum mechanically this estimate fails, because interactions also change the kinetic energy, while delocalization and exchange add information that equal-time correlations do not contain. We show that imaginary-time density correlations contain this information, and that with them the classical relation carries over to quantum systems. Such correlations are available from path-integral simulations and X-ray Thomson scattering. Relative-entropy inference over imaginary-time paths, with an ideal Bose or Fermi gas as reference, gives closed forms for the excess entropy and free energies, within the same Gaussian approximation as the classical relation. They recover the classical result and estimate entropy that the classical relation misses. We test them on weakly interacting bosons, interacting fermions on a ring, and the warm dense electron gas. The closed forms need only imaginary-time density correlations and their ideal-gas reference at a single state point, without using the interaction potential. Our approach can extend other classical entropy estimators to quantum systems.
