articles.abstract_zh: 在经典极限中，最大熵推断通过单个动量和从静态结构因子产生过量熵的估计。从量子力学角度来说，这种估计是失败的，因为相互作用也会改变动能，而离域和交换则增加了等时相关性所不包含的信息。我们证明虚数时间密度相关性包含这些信息，并且经典关系也随之转移到量子系统。这种相关性可以从路径积分模拟和 X 射线汤姆逊散射中获得。以理想玻色或费米气体为参考，虚数时间路径上的相对熵推断给出了过剩熵和自由能的封闭形式，与经典关系相同的高斯近似。他们恢复了经典结果并估计了经典关系遗漏的熵。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在经典极限中，最大熵推断通过单个动量和从静态结构因子产生过量熵的估计。从量子力学角度来说，这种估计是失败的，因为相互作用也会改变动能，而离域和交换则增加了等时相关性所不包含的信息。我们证明虚数时间密度相关性包含这些信息，并且经典关系也随之转移到量子系统。这种相关性可以从路径积分模拟和 X 射线汤姆逊散射中获得。以理想玻色或费米气体为参考，虚数时间路径上的相对熵推断给出了过剩熵和自由能的封闭形式，与经典关系相同的高斯近似。他们恢复了经典结果并估计了经典关系遗漏的熵。我们在弱相互作用的玻色子、环上相互作用的费米子以及温暖的致密电子气上测试它们。封闭形式仅需要虚数时间密度相关性及其在单个状态点的理想气体参考，而不使用相互作用势。我们的方法可以将其他经典熵估计器扩展到量子系统。

articles.title: Two distinct notions of speed in antiferromagnets
articles.title_zh: 反铁磁体中速度的两种不同概念
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.26482v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The terahertz resonance frequencies of antiferromagnets characterize their precessional dynamics but do not necessarily imply faster laser-induced quenching of magnetic order. Here, we investigate the distinct roles of magnetic compensation and electronic scattering phase space by comparing ultrafast demagnetization in the antiferromagnetic charge-transfer insulator NiO, the metallic antiferromagnet Mn2Au, and a ferromagnetic Ni reference. The extracted response in Mn2Au is approximately four times faster than in NiO and substantially faster than in Ni. These observations are consistent with exchange-mediated scattering between antiparallel sublattices enabling rapid loss of antiferromagnetic order without requiring net angular-momentum transfer to an external reservoir, provided sufficient electronic scattering phase space is available. In insulating NiO, restricted electronic scattering channels reduces the ultrafast response. Our results distinguish ultrafast demagnetization from exchange-enhanced precession and identify the interplay of spin-flip probability and electronic scattering rate as a key factor governing the nonequilibrium response of compensated magnets.
articles.abstract_zh: 反铁磁体的太赫兹共振频率表征了它们的进动动力学，但并不一定意味着更快的激光诱导磁序淬灭。在这里，我们通过比较反铁磁电荷转移绝缘体 NiO、金属反铁磁体 Mn2Au 和铁磁 Ni 参考中的超快退磁，研究磁补偿和电子散射相空间的不同作用。 Mn2Au 中提取的响应大约比 NiO 快四倍，并且比 Ni 快得多。这些观察结果与反平行子晶格之间的交换介导的散射一致，只要有足够的电子散射相空间，反铁磁序就能快速损失，而不需要将净角动量转移到外部储存库。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 反铁磁体的太赫兹共振频率表征了它们的进动动力学，但并不一定意味着更快的激光诱导磁序淬灭。在这里，我们通过比较反铁磁电荷转移绝缘体 NiO、金属反铁磁体 Mn2Au 和铁磁 Ni 参考中的超快退磁，研究磁补偿和电子散射相空间的不同作用。 Mn2Au 中提取的响应大约比 NiO 快四倍，并且比 Ni 快得多。这些观察结果与反平行子晶格之间的交换介导的散射一致，只要有足够的电子散射相空间，反铁磁序就能快速损失，而不需要将净角动量转移到外部储存库。在绝缘氧化镍中，受限的电子散射通道降低了超快响应。我们的结果区分了超快退磁和交换增强进动，并将自旋翻转概率和电子散射率的相互作用确定为控制补偿磁体非平衡响应的关键因素。

articles.title: Nonstandard quantum statistics for strongly correlated systems: Superexclusion in momentum space and comparison with exact results
articles.title_zh: 强相关系统的非标准量子统计：动量空间中的超排除以及与精确结果的比较
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.26489v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We analyze in detail nonstandard statistics for strongly correlated fermions, which comprise the statistical spin liquid (SSL) and model non-Fermi liquid (NFL) cases. Both of those cases are based on the total exclusion of local doubly occupancies (the~superexclusion) either in real space (SSL case) or in reciprocal (k) space (NFL). The results obtained on a purely physical ground are supplemented with the exact analysis of those coming from microscopic Hubbard-like model in k space. Specifically, we discuss the transmutation of those statistics to that of localized magnetic moments, as well as the transformation of the Fermi liquid into a strongly correlated fermionic liquid or Mott insulating state; the latter taking place for the half-filled-band situation. The role of exclusion of double occupancies in either real or reciprocal space in the appearance of the correlated phase is stressed. Conclusions concerning the universal features of the models, independence of either the real- or k-space representation, are also discussed. One of those is the boson to fermion statistics transmutation which in the limit of strong repulsive interboson interaction leads to the particle localization instead to the Bose-Einstein condensation.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们详细分析强相关费米子的非标准统计数据，其中包括统计自旋液体 (SSL) 和模型非费米液体 (NFL) 情况。这两种情况都基于真实空间（SSL 情况）或倒数（k）空间（NFL）中局部双重占用（超排除）的完全排除。在纯物理基础上获得的结果得到了对 k 空间中微观哈伯德模型的精确分析的补充。具体来说，我们讨论了这些统计数据到局域磁矩统计数据的嬗变，以及费米液体到强相关费米子液体或莫特绝缘态的转变；后者发生在半满带情况下。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们详细分析强相关费米子的非标准统计数据，其中包括统计自旋液体 (SSL) 和模型非费米液体 (NFL) 情况。这两种情况都基于真实空间（SSL 情况）或倒数（k）空间（NFL）中局部双重占用（超排除）的完全排除。在纯物理基础上获得的结果得到了对 k 空间中微观哈伯德模型的精确分析的补充。具体来说，我们讨论了这些统计数据到局域磁矩统计数据的嬗变，以及费米液体到强相关费米子液体或莫特绝缘态的转变；后者发生在半满带情况下。强调了在相关相的出现中排除实空间或倒易空间中的双重占据的作用。还讨论了有关模型的普遍特征、实数空间或 k 空间表示的独立性的结论。其中之一是玻色子到费米子统计嬗变，在强排斥性玻色子间相互作用的限制下，导致粒子局域化而不是玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚。

articles.title: Constitutive Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks in Finite Element Model Updating: Closed-Form Hyperelastic Strain Energies from Heterogeneous Experiments
articles.title_zh: 有限元模型更新中的本构柯尔莫哥洛夫-阿诺德网络：来自异质实验的闭式超弹应变能
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.26528v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Calibrating a hyperelastic constitutive model for a soft material traditionally poses two problems: an expert must choose its functional form, and several homogeneous tests must determine its parameters. Neural constitutive models solve the first, but either remain black boxes or draw on a library of candidate terms fixed in advance. Full-field measurements, such as those from digital image correlation (DIC), promise to solve the second, replacing those tests by a single heterogeneous one. Two gaps remain: flexibility during training with interpretability afterwards, and a way to train such a model on one heterogeneous test. Here we close both. We embed a constitutive Kolmogorov-Arnold network (CKAN) in finite element model updating (FEMU) and train it by minimizing the mismatch between the predicted and the measured kinematic fields and reaction forces. Pruning and symbolic regression then reduce the trained network to a compact closed-form strain energy that satisfies every constitutive requirement. On perforated natural-rubber membranes, the CKANs reproduce the DIC displacement fields with median errors between one and two percent, and transfer to a hole pattern withheld from training. On a perforated silicone plate, a CKAN trained on one stretch profile at a single load reproduces that profile and the measured reaction force to within a few percent. On an aortic specimen inflated under pressure, an anisotropic CKAN predicts the inflated three-dimensional shape. The discovered closed-form energies match the CKANs they replace on the training data and can be compared directly with established models.
articles.abstract_zh: 校准软材料的超弹性本构模型传统上会带来两个问题：专家必须选择其功能形式，并且必须通过多次齐次测试来确定其参数。神经本构模型解决了第一个问题，但要么保留黑匣子，要么利用预先固定的候选术语库。全场测量，例如数字图像相关 (DIC) 的测量，有望解决第二个问题，用单一异构测试取代这些测试。仍然存在两个差距：训练期间的灵活性和训练后的可解释性，以及在一个异构测试上训练此类模型的方法。在这里我们关闭两者。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 校准软材料的超弹性本构模型传统上会带来两个问题：专家必须选择其功能形式，并且必须通过多次齐次测试来确定其参数。神经本构模型解决了第一个问题，但要么保留黑匣子，要么利用预先固定的候选术语库。全场测量，例如数字图像相关 (DIC) 的测量，有望解决第二个问题，用单一异构测试取代这些测试。仍然存在两个差距：训练期间的灵活性和训练后的可解释性，以及在一个异构测试上训练此类模型的方法。在这里我们关闭两者。我们在有限元模型更新（FEMU）中嵌入了本构柯尔莫哥洛夫-阿诺德网络（CKAN），并通过最小化预测和测量的运动场和反作用力之间的不匹配来训练它。然后，修剪和符号回归将训练后的网络减少为满足每个本构要求的紧凑的封闭形式应变能。在穿孔天然橡胶膜上，CKAN 重现 DIC 位移场，中值误差在 1% 到 2% 之间，并转移到训练中保留的孔图案。在穿孔硅胶板上，CKAN 在单一负载下对一个拉伸曲线进行训练，可重现该曲线和测得的反作用力，误差在百分之几以内。在压力下膨胀的主动脉标本上，各向异性 CKAN 预测膨胀的三维形状。发现的闭合形式能量与它们在训练数据上替换的 CKAN 相匹配，并且可以直接与已建立的模型进行比较。

articles.title: Emergent Fatigue Dynamics from Foundational Interatomic Potentials
articles.title_zh: 基础原子间势的突现疲劳动力学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.26533v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Foundational machine-learned interatomic potentials are trained on large, diverse DFT datasets, but their validation rests on equilibrium states, which does not guarantee correct emergent behavior in large-scale molecular dynamics. Where no direct experimental validation is available, comparisons to physically motivated potentials are valuable for drawing insight. We distinguish static properties, which are thermally accessible, from emergent properties, which require work from an external fatigue stress to drive rare events, and compare the potentials on both. An EAM potential and the NequIP foundational potential both agree closely with reference data for many near-equilibrium properties, but NequIP predicts an anomalously low intrinsic stacking fault energy (sim7 times lower than EAM) and thus predicts far more plastic deformation under fatigue cycling of a nanoscale flaw modeled after the classical Griffith crack problem. Per-atom energy distributions after loading show that the two potentials differ most at energies far above what is thermally accessible. We also document memory-related crashes and silent extrapolation as practical concerns for practitioners of these foundational model forms.
articles.abstract_zh: 基础机器学习原子间势是在大型、多样化的 DFT 数据集上进行训练的，但它们的验证依赖于平衡状态，这并不能保证大规模分子动力学中正确的涌现行为。在没有直接实验验证的情况下，与物理激励潜力的比较对于获得洞察力很有价值。我们区分静态属性（可热访问）和紧急属性（需要外部疲劳应力来驱动罕见事件），并比较两者的潜力。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 基础机器学习原子间势是在大型、多样化的 DFT 数据集上进行训练的，但它们的验证依赖于平衡状态，这并不能保证大规模分子动力学中正确的涌现行为。在没有直接实验验证的情况下，与物理激励潜力的比较对于获得洞察力很有价值。我们区分静态属性（可热访问）和紧急属性（需要外部疲劳应力来驱动罕见事件），并比较两者的潜力。 EAM 势和 NequIP 基础势均与许多近平衡特性的参考数据非常一致，但 NequIP 预测异常低的本征堆垛层错能（比 EAM 低 sim7 倍），因此预测在经典格里菲斯裂纹问题建模的纳米级缺陷的疲劳循环下会有更大的塑性变形。加载后的每原子能量分布表明，两种电势在远高于热可达到的能量时差异最大。我们还记录了与内存相关的崩溃和无声推断，作为这些基础模型形式的实践者的实际问题。

articles.title: Activity-driven motion and deformation of a circular membrane domain
articles.title_zh: 圆形膜域的活动驱动运动和变形
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.26578v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Lipid bilayer membranes are nanometer-thin fluid interfaces characterized by both in-plane fluidity and lateral compositional heterogeneity. Cholesterol-rich liquid domains ("lipid rafts") are thought to regulate the spatial organization of membrane proteins and numerous cellular processes. While the passive diffusion and equilibrium shape fluctuations of membrane domains are well understood, much less is known about how the activity of molecular machines, such as protein pumps and enzymes, influences their mobility and deformation. Here, we analyze the dynamics of a membrane domain driven by an embedded molecular machine within the framework of two-dimensional Stokes flow. The molecular machine is modeled as a point singularity of the two-dimensional Stokes equations, including both rotational and irrotational singularities corresponding to force and source multipoles. We show that, despite being force-free, both force and source dipoles generate active flows that propel the membrane domain. For a force dipole undergoing rotational diffusion, the domain motion is diffusive at long times but exhibits a transient superdiffusive regime at intermediate times.
articles.abstract_zh: 脂质双层膜是纳米薄的流体界面，其特征是面内流动性和横向成分异质性。富含胆固醇的液体域（“脂筏”）被认为可以调节膜蛋白的空间组织和许多细胞过程。虽然膜域的被动扩散和平衡形状波动已被很好地理解，但人们对分子机器（例如蛋白质泵和酶）的活动如何影响其流动性和变形知之甚少。在这里，我们在二维斯托克斯流的框架内分析了由嵌入式分子机器驱动的膜域的动力学。分子机器被建模为二维斯托克斯方程的点奇点，包括与力和源多极相对应的旋转和无旋转奇点。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 脂质双层膜是纳米薄的流体界面，其特征是面内流动性和横向成分异质性。富含胆固醇的液体域（“脂筏”）被认为可以调节膜蛋白的空间组织和许多细胞过程。虽然膜域的被动扩散和平衡形状波动已被很好地理解，但人们对分子机器（例如蛋白质泵和酶）的活动如何影响其流动性和变形知之甚少。在这里，我们在二维斯托克斯流的框架内分析了由嵌入式分子机器驱动的膜域的动力学。分子机器被建模为二维斯托克斯方程的点奇点，包括与力和源多极相对应的旋转和无旋转奇点。我们表明，尽管是无力的，但力偶极子和源偶极子都会产生推动膜域的主动流。对于经历旋转扩散的力偶极子，域运动在长时间内是扩散的，但在中间时间时表现出瞬态超扩散状态。

articles.title: Magnon high-harmonic generation by nonlinearities of spin torque driven by phonon-mediated crossing of many-body energy levels of bright and dark excitons
articles.title_zh: 由声子介导的明激子和暗激子多体能级交叉驱动的自旋扭矩非线性产生磁振子高次谐波
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.26589v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Recent intense experimental focus on CrSBr, a two-dimensional (2D) antiferromagnetic semiconductor, has revealed numerous surprises in its response to ultrafast optical drive. We demonstrate that a single microscopic mechanism accounts for two of them---high-harmonic generation of magnons and persistence of magnon oscillations over mboxsim 1 ns time scale that is much longer than the femtosecond laser pulse (fsLP) pump duration. This mechanism arises from an unusually complex interplay of four different fundamental quasiparticles of condensed matter physics: magnons, optically bright and dark excitons, and phonons. By viewing magnons as the system and the other three quasiparticles as a quantum many-body bath, we derive an extended Landau-Lifshitz-Gilbert (eLLG) equation. Its new term generated by the bath is spatially nonlocal and time-dependent, as well as strongly em nonlinear when the em crossing of many-body energy levels of bright and dark excitons occurs via phonon mediation. It also resembles the so-called field-like spin-transfer torque (STT) in spintronics, but STT is driven there with current pulses, so it explains the microscopic origin of the recently experimentally conjectured em excitonic STT. Since dark excitons supply energy to magnons long after the fsLP is switched off, such a reservoir opens avenues for its engineering and applications in optospintronics and optomagnonics, neuromorphic computing, and quantum transduction.
articles.abstract_zh: 最近对 CrSBr（一种二维 (2D) 反铁磁半导体）的强烈实验关注揭示了其对超快光驱动的响应方面的许多惊喜。我们证明了一个单一的微观机制可以解释其中的两个问题——磁振子的高次谐波产生和磁振子振荡在 mboxsim 1 ns 时间尺度上的持久性，该时间尺度比飞秒激光脉冲 (fsLP) 泵浦持续时间长得多。这种机制源于凝聚态物理的四种不同基本准粒子（磁振子、光学明激子和暗激子以及声子）异常复杂的相互作用。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 最近对 CrSBr（一种二维 (2D) 反铁磁半导体）的强烈实验关注揭示了其对超快光驱动的响应方面的许多惊喜。我们证明了一个单一的微观机制可以解释其中的两个问题——磁振子的高次谐波产生和磁振子振荡在 mboxsim 1 ns 时间尺度上的持久性，该时间尺度比飞秒激光脉冲 (fsLP) 泵浦持续时间长得多。这种机制源于凝聚态物理的四种不同基本准粒子（磁振子、光学明激子和暗激子以及声子）异常复杂的相互作用。通过将磁振子视为系统，将其他三个准粒子视为量子多体浴，我们推导出扩展的朗道-利夫希茨-吉尔伯特（eLLG）方程。它由浴产生的新项在空间上是非局域的且与时间相关的，并且当明激子和暗激子的多体能级的电磁交叉通过声子介导发生时具有强烈的非线性。它也类似于自旋电子学中所谓的类场自旋转移矩（STT），但STT是由电流脉冲驱动的，因此它解释了最近实验推测的激子STT的微观起源。由于暗激子在 fsLP 关闭后很长时间内仍向磁振子提供能量，因此这种储库为其在光自旋电子学和光磁学、神经形态计算和量子转导中的工程和应用开辟了道路。

articles.title: Local orbital magnetization and Chern markers from equilibrium local currents
articles.title_zh: 平衡局部电流的局部轨道磁化强度和陈标记
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.26599v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Local currents carry the orbital magnetization of a macroscopic sample and are key for modeling inhomogeneous magnetic materials and for understanding magnetoelectric and topological responses. However, producing realistic simulated images of local currents in inhomogeneous systems remains challenging. Building upon recent work on stochastic estimation methods for tight-binding models, we show that all matrix elements of positive semidefinite operators defined on a lattice can be obtained at once from a single set of filtered random vectors. This eliminates the need for independent simulations previously required for off-diagonal elements, which significantly speeds up the calculation of spatial maps of local currents. Further, we express bond currents in terms of loop currents that obey a discrete Poisson equation, with the current vorticity acting as the source term. Its solution yields a local orbital magnetization. In analogy with the global Středa relation, the derivative of this magnetization with respect to the chemical potential defines a new local Chern marker. Built entirely from bond currents, it requires no position operator and is not bound by the zero-sum rule of projector markers in open samples. Hence, it is free of boundary-compensation artifacts, and its sample average converges to the bulk Chern number in a controlled fashion.
articles.abstract_zh: 局部电流携带宏观样品的轨道磁化强度，是模拟非均匀磁性材料以及理解磁电和拓扑响应的关键。然而，在非均匀系统中生成局部电流的真实模拟图像仍然具有挑战性。基于最近关于紧束缚模型的随机估计方法的工作，我们表明可以从一组过滤的随机向量中立即获得在格上定义的正半定算子的所有矩阵元素。这消除了以前对非对角线元素所需的独立模拟的需要，从而显着加快了局部电流空间图的计算速度。此外，我们用遵循离散泊松方程的环路电流来表达键合电流，其中电流涡度作为源项。其解产生局部轨道磁化强度。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 局部电流携带宏观样品的轨道磁化强度，是模拟非均匀磁性材料以及理解磁电和拓扑响应的关键。然而，在非均匀系统中生成局部电流的真实模拟图像仍然具有挑战性。基于最近关于紧束缚模型的随机估计方法的工作，我们表明可以从一组过滤的随机向量中立即获得在格上定义的正半定算子的所有矩阵元素。这消除了以前对非对角线元素所需的独立模拟的需要，从而显着加快了局部电流空间图的计算速度。此外，我们用遵循离散泊松方程的环路电流来表达键合电流，其中电流涡度作为源项。其解产生局部轨道磁化强度。与全局 Středa 关系类似，这种磁化强度相对于化学势的导数定义了一个新的局部 Chern 标记。它完全由键合电流构建，不需要位置运算符，并且不受开放样本中投影仪标记的零和规则的约束。因此，它没有边界补偿伪影，并且其样本平均值以受控方式收敛到大量陈数。

articles.title: Scalable Simulation of Strongly Correlated Fermions with Neural Gaussian Tensor Networks
articles.title_zh: 使用神经高斯张量网络对强相关费米子进行可扩展模拟
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.26604v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Accurate simulations of strongly correlated electrons remain a central challenge in computational physics. We introduce neural-network Gaussian projected entangled-pair states (NN-GPEPS), which exploit the locally-entangled subspace of Gaussian states to give an architecture more compatible with modern neural networks and an exact contraction cost of O(N³/²) on two-dimensional lattices. For the Hubbard model at U/t=8 and 1/8 hole doping, we obtain state-of-the-art variational energies in large lattices of up to 1024 sites. These results demonstrate an accurate approach to strongly correlated fermions by connecting neural networks with Gaussian tensor networks.
articles.abstract_zh: 强相关电子的精确模拟仍然是计算物理学的核心挑战。我们引入了神经网络高斯投影纠缠对态 (NN-GPEPS)，它利用高斯态的局部纠缠子空间来提供与现代神经网络更兼容的架构，并在二维晶格上实现 O(N3/2) 的精确收缩成本。对于 U/t=8 和 1/8 孔掺杂的 Hubbard 模型，我们在多达 1024 个位点的大晶格中获得了最先进的变分能量。这些结果证明了通过将神经网络与高斯张量网络连接来实现强相关费米子的准确方法。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 强相关电子的精确模拟仍然是计算物理学的核心挑战。我们引入了神经网络高斯投影纠缠对态 (NN-GPEPS)，它利用高斯态的局部纠缠子空间来提供与现代神经网络更兼容的架构，并在二维晶格上实现 O(N3/2) 的精确收缩成本。对于 U/t=8 和 1/8 孔掺杂的 Hubbard 模型，我们在多达 1024 个位点的大晶格中获得了最先进的变分能量。这些结果证明了通过将神经网络与高斯张量网络连接来实现强相关费米子的准确方法。

articles.title: Field theory and the biquadratic spin-1 chain
articles.title_zh: 场论和双二次自旋 1 链
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.26610v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The antiferromagnetic biquadratic spin-1 chain is gapped, SU(3) symmetric, and integrable. Standard arguments suggest that its low-energy physics is described by the CP² nonlinear sigma model at θ=π. Using the Bethe ansatz, we show that its low-energy excitations can be interpreted as deconfined domain walls, just as in the sigma model. However, the lattice model is integrable, whereas the field theory is generally believed not to be. We propose a solution to this mystery by finding an integrable field theory with the same low-energy limit but which is not Lorentz invariant. The integrability-preserving scaling limit is obtained by adding a higher conserved charge and tuning the chain to criticality. The gap closes quadratically, so that the limit must be described by some nonrelativistic field theory rather than the relativistic sigma model. We describe the two-particle scattering matrix of this field theory.
articles.abstract_zh: 反铁磁双二次自旋 1 链是有间隙的、SU(3) 对称且可积的。标准论证表明，其低能物理由 θ=π 处的 CP² 非线性 sigma 模型描述。使用 Bethe ansatz，我们表明它的低能激发可以解释为解除限制的畴壁，就像 sigma 模型一样。然而，晶格模型是可积的，而场论通常被认为不是可积的。我们通过寻找具有相同低能量极限但不是洛伦兹不变的可积场论来解决这个谜团。通过添加更高的守恒电荷并将链调整到临界点来获得可积保持的缩放限制。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 反铁磁双二次自旋 1 链是有间隙的、SU(3) 对称且可积的。标准论证表明，其低能物理由 θ=π 处的 CP² 非线性 sigma 模型描述。使用 Bethe ansatz，我们表明它的低能激发可以解释为解除限制的畴壁，就像 sigma 模型一样。然而，晶格模型是可积的，而场论通常被认为不是可积的。我们通过寻找具有相同低能量极限但不是洛伦兹不变的可积场论来解决这个谜团。通过添加更高的守恒电荷并将链调整到临界点来获得可积保持的缩放限制。差距以二次方的方式缩小，因此极限必须用某种非相对论场论而不是相对论西格玛模型来描述。我们描述了该场论的双粒子散射矩阵。

articles.title: Fractional Charge at Dislocations from Band-Inversion Cancellation
articles.title_zh: 来自能带反转抵消的位错处的分数电荷
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.26616v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Band inversions with opposite Chern numbers cancel in the Hall response and yield counterpropagating boundary modes that can gap out. However, a bulk probe of the topology that survives such a cancellation is lacking. We here show that dislocations in inversion-symmetric two-band crystals with cancelling band inversions bind a half-integer charge, which reveals the quantized bulk polarization of the bond-centered obstructed atomic limit realized by such crystals. To demonstrate this, we continuously deform a broad class of two-band lattice models into decoupled chains, without closing the bulk gap or breaking the inversion symmetry, where the dislocation charge follows from a count of occupied bonds. Notably, the fractional part of this charge is insensitive to local perturbations of the dislocation core, and it therefore persists after the in-gap core state is removed, as we show analytically in the chain limit and numerically away from it. In the Weyl-semimetal counterpart, the response to a magnetic flux separates this crystalline charge from the charge set by the Chern number of each momentum slice. We propose that a half-integer core charge that persists after the in-gap peak disappears from the local spectrum can be detected in artificial electronic and optical lattices, with metamaterials providing complementary access to the core modes.
articles.abstract_zh: 具有相反陈数的能带反转会抵消霍尔响应，并产生可能出现间隙的反向传播边界模式。然而，缺乏对在这种取消后仍然存在的拓扑的批量探测。我们在这里表明，具有抵消能带反转的反演对称双能带晶体中的位错结合了半整数电荷，这揭示了此类晶体实现的以键为中心的受阻原子极限的量子化体极化。为了证明这一点，我们不断地将一大类双能带晶格模型变形为解耦链，而不关闭体能隙或破坏反演对称性，其中位错电荷来自占据键的计数。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 具有相反陈数的能带反转会抵消霍尔响应，并产生可能出现间隙的反向传播边界模式。然而，缺乏对在这种取消后仍然存在的拓扑的批量探测。我们在这里表明，具有抵消能带反转的反演对称双能带晶体中的位错结合了半整数电荷，这揭示了此类晶体实现的以键为中心的受阻原子极限的量子化体极化。为了证明这一点，我们不断地将一大类双能带晶格模型变形为解耦链，而不关闭体能隙或破坏反演对称性，其中位错电荷来自占据键的计数。值得注意的是，该电荷的小数部分对位错核心的局部扰动不敏感，因此在带隙核心状态被移除后它仍然存在，正如我们在链极限中分析并在数值上远离它所示。在外尔半金属对应物中，对磁通量的响应将该晶体电荷与每个动量切片的陈数所设置的电荷分开。我们提出，在带隙内峰值从局部光谱中消失后，可以在人造电子和光学晶格中检测到持续存在的半整数核心电荷，其中超材料提供了对核心模式的补充访问。

articles.title: Accelerating Quantum Error Correction Simulations under Coherent Noise with Compiled Clifford-Augmented Matrix Product States
articles.title_zh: 使用编译的克利福德增广矩阵积状态加速相干噪声下的量子纠错模拟
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.24044v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Reliable assessment of quantum error correction requires understanding how coherent errors affect logical performance. Although tensor networks naturally capture coherent interference, entanglement growth and large qubit counts make repeated sampling costly. Here we develop a compiled Clifford-Augmented Matrix Product State (CAMPS) framework that reuses Clifford transformations across shots, recycles qubits released by measurements, evolves a compressed residual state, and accelerates sampling through rotation fusion and compilation tailored to the MPS layout. Surface-code benchmarks under fixed-sign coherent noise yield accurate logical error estimates at small bond dimensions, while random-sign simulations up to distance d=9 and on the [[72,12,6]] bivariate bicycle code match the Pauli-twirling approximation results. Compared with uncompiled CAMPS, compiled CAMPS converges at smaller bond dimensions and achieves order-of-magnitude sampling speedups at equal bond dimension, opening a scalable route to studying coherent error propagation in larger fault-tolerant circuits.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子纠错的可靠评估需要了解相干错误如何影响逻辑性能。尽管张量网络自然地捕获相干干扰，但纠缠增长和大量量子比特计数使得重复采样成本高昂。在这里，我们开发了一个编译的 Clifford 增强矩阵乘积状态 (CAMPS) 框架，该框架在各个镜头中重复使用 Clifford 变换、回收测量释放的量子位、演化压缩残余状态，并通过针对 MPS 布局定制的旋转融合和编译来加速采样。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 量子纠错的可靠评估需要了解相干错误如何影响逻辑性能。尽管张量网络自然地捕获相干干扰，但纠缠增长和大量量子比特计数使得重复采样成本高昂。在这里，我们开发了一个编译的 Clifford 增强矩阵乘积状态 (CAMPS) 框架，该框架在各个镜头中重复使用 Clifford 变换、回收测量释放的量子位、演化压缩残余状态，并通过针对 MPS 布局定制的旋转融合和编译来加速采样。固定符号相干噪声下的表面代码基准在小键尺寸下产生准确的逻辑误差估计，而距离 d=9 的随机符号模拟和 [[72,12,6]] 双变量自行车代码与泡利旋转近似结果匹配。与未编译的 CAMPS 相比，编译后的 CAMPS 在较小的键维数下收敛，并在相等的键维数下实现了数量级的采样加速，为研究较大容错电路中的相干错误传播开辟了一条可扩展的途径。

articles.title: Passive memories beyond the Ising model: from SFQ to GKP
articles.title_zh: 伊辛模型之外的被动记忆：从 SFQ 到 GKP
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.25030v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Self-correcting quantum memories are spin Hamiltonians that aim to generalize the classical memory of the magnetic hard disk (i.e. ferromagnetic Ising model) to protect against both bit flips and phase flips. Beyond the magnetic hard disk, there are other passive classical memories that are used in modern computers, notably: the flash memory in laptops (which traps charge on a conducting island), and the flux storage loop in single-flux quantum (SFQ) logic (which traps flux in a superconducting loop). In this paper we review how storage and writing work in these two classical memories, drawing analogies to the charge qubit and the flux qubit. Protection in these systems derives not from scaling a lattice to the thermodynamic limit, but from a large, tunable energy barrier that separates codewords during memory, yet can be suppressed during a write. Towards protecting a qubit: We introduce a 2D ``floating XY model'' that combines the exponential (phase-flip) protection of the floating charge island with the polynomial (bit-flip) protection of the ferromagnetic XY model. We also study a self-dual superconducting circuit that hosts GKP codewords as symmetry-broken ground states of a Z₂ × Z₂ -symmetric circuit, and discuss its protection and limitations.
articles.abstract_zh: 自校正量子存储器是自旋哈密顿量，旨在推广磁性硬盘的经典存储器（即铁磁伊辛模型）以防止位翻转和相位翻转。除了磁性硬盘之外，现代计算机中还使用了其他无源经典存储器，特别是：笔记本电脑中的闪存（将电荷捕获在导电岛上）和单通量量子（SFQ）逻辑中的通量存储环路（将通量捕获在超导环中）。在本文中，我们回顾了这两种经典存储器中的存储和写入工作方式，并与电荷量子位和通量量子位进行类比。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 自校正量子存储器是自旋哈密顿量，旨在推广磁性硬盘的经典存储器（即铁磁伊辛模型）以防止位翻转和相位翻转。除了磁性硬盘之外，现代计算机中还使用了其他无源经典存储器，特别是：笔记本电脑中的闪存（将电荷捕获在导电岛上）和单通量量子（SFQ）逻辑中的通量存储环路（将通量捕获在超导环中）。在本文中，我们回顾了这两种经典存储器中的存储和写入工作方式，并与电荷量子位和通量量子位进行类比。这些系统中的保护不是来自将晶格缩放到热力学极限，而是来自一个大的、可调的能量势垒，该能量势垒在内存期间分隔码字，但在写入期间可以被抑制。为了保护量子位：我们引入了一种 2D“浮动 XY 模型”，它将浮动电荷岛的指数（相位翻转）保护与铁磁 XY 模型的多项式（位翻转）保护相结合。我们还研究了一种自对偶超导电路，该电路将 GKP 码字作为 Z2 × Z2 对称电路的对称破缺基态，并讨论其保护和限制。

articles.title: Certified Discovery of Quantum Phase Diagrams
articles.title_zh: 量子相图的认证发现
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.25064v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Can a machine provably discover new quantum phases of matter? We show that the answer is yes under physically motivated assumptions. For any smooth family of geometrically local Hamiltonians, we construct an efficient quantum algorithm that outputs the phase diagram to prescribed accuracy and provides a verifiable certificate for every transition it reports. The algorithm takes as input only a classical description of the family together with unverified preparations of reference ground states; no order parameter, symmetry-breaking pattern, or training data are supplied. It succeeds provided that at least one preparation is correct in each gapped region of parameter space. The algorithm explores parameter space by quasi-adiabatically or adiabatically transporting each reference state, detecting the approach of a phase boundary by tapping the transported state with a frequency-filtered local probe: excitations created by the probe witness the closing of the energy gap. We prove that the gap closing for continuous phase transitions can always be detected using the frequency-filtered gradient of the Hamiltonian. The gap-detecting measurement is gentle, so when the ground state is unique a single reusable copy of each reference ground state supports the full exploration (for degenerate ground states, polynomially many copies suffice). The quantum algorithm runs in polynomial time at inverse-polynomial gap resolution. We also give a classical algorithm that runs in quasipolynomial time at constant gap resolution. Numerical experiments demonstrate how our algorithm accurately determines the phase structure of several model quantum systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 机器能否证明发现物质的新量子相？我们证明，在物理动机假设下，答案是肯定的。对于任何几何局部哈密顿量的平滑族，我们构建了一种高效的量子算法，该算法可以按照规定的精度输出相图，并为其报告的每个转变提供可验证的证书。该算法仅将族的经典描述以及未经验证的参考基态准备作为输入；不提供顺序参数、对称破缺模式或训练数据。只要在参数空间的每个间隙区域中至少有一个准备工作是正确的，它就会成功。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 机器能否证明发现物质的新量子相？我们证明，在物理动机假设下，答案是肯定的。对于任何几何局部哈密顿量的平滑族，我们构建了一种高效的量子算法，该算法可以按照规定的精度输出相图，并为其报告的每个转变提供可验证的证书。该算法仅将族的经典描述以及未经验证的参考基态准备作为输入；不提供顺序参数、对称破缺模式或训练数据。只要在参数空间的每个间隙区域中至少有一个准备工作是正确的，它就会成功。该算法通过准绝热或绝热传输每个参考状态来探索参数空间，通过用频率过滤的局部探针敲击传输状态来检测相边界的接近：探针产生的激励见证了能隙的闭合。我们证明，连续相变的间隙闭合始终可以使用哈密顿量的频率滤波梯度来检测。间隙检测测量是温和的，因此当基态是唯一的时，每个参考基态的单个可重用副本支持完整的探索（对于简并基态，多项式许多副本就足够了）。量子算法以逆多项式间隙分辨率在多项式时间内运行。我们还给出了一种在恒定间隙分辨率下以拟多项式时间运行的经典算法。数值实验证明了我们的算法如何准确确定几个模型量子系统的相结构。

articles.title: Learning Integer Winding Evolution Times in Quantum Phase Estimation
articles.title_zh: 学习量子相位估计中的整数绕组演化时间
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.25124v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Learning a Hamiltonian evolution time in Quantum Phase Estimation that produces phase distributions with low Shannon entropy circumvents the fundamental limit of digitization error of phase, independent of the number of phase qubits of accuracy. By introducing an optimization loop to minimize the Shannon entropy of measured eigenvalues produced by a QPE quantum circuit, minimum eigenvalue computation accuracy is greatly improved, which we show numerically on quantum magnet models. This technique works because standard QPE has a natural correspondence between entropy of the phase distribution and the analog accuracy of the minimum eigenvalue phase. This introduces for the first time a type of parameter learning to QPE, which makes near term practicality of QPE for fundamental sciences more feasible by using shorter depth QPE circuits.
articles.abstract_zh: 在量子相位估计中学习哈密顿演化时间，产生具有低香农熵的相位分布，规避了相位数字化误差的基本限制，与精度的相位量子位的数量无关。通过引入优化循环来最小化 QPE 量子电路产生的测量特征值的香农熵，最小特征值计算精度大大提高，我们在量子磁体模型上以数值方式显示了这一点。该技术之所以有效，是因为标准 QPE 在相位分布的熵和最小特征值相位的模拟精度之间具有自然的对应关系。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在量子相位估计中学习哈密顿演化时间，产生具有低香农熵的相位分布，规避了相位数字化误差的基本限制，与精度的相位量子位的数量无关。通过引入优化循环来最小化 QPE 量子电路产生的测量特征值的香农熵，最小特征值计算精度大大提高，我们在量子磁体模型上以数值方式显示了这一点。该技术之所以有效，是因为标准 QPE 在相位分布的熵和最小特征值相位的模拟精度之间具有自然的对应关系。这首次向 QPE 引入了一种参数学习类型，通过使用较短深度的 QPE 电路，使得 QPE 在基础科学中的近期实用性变得更加可行。

articles.title: textscMax-Cut on Token Graphs
articles.title_zh: textscMax-在代币图上进行切割
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.25153v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Let G be a graph on n vertices, with a positive weight assigned to each edge. A cut of G is a partition of its vertices into two sets X and Y; the weight of (X,Y) is the sum of the weight of the edges of G with one endpoint in X and the other endpoint in Y. The Max-Cut problem asks for the maximum weight, m(G), of a cut of G. The k-token graph of G, is the graph, Fₖ(G), whose vertices are the k-subsets of vertices of G, two of them being adjacent when their symmetric difference is an edge of G. The phase-reconstruction problem for Heisenberg antiferromagnets in physics can be rephrased as a Max-Cut problem on token graphs. Motivated by this, we study the Max-Cut problem on token graphs, mainly when all edges are assigned the same weight. Our main focus is to bound m(Fₖ(G)) in terms of m(G). We prove that m(Fₖ(G))≥binomn-2k-1m(G), and that this bound is tight up to a multiplicative factor of 1+O(k/n); in the case when k=c · n for some constant 0 < c < 1, we provide an example where this bound is off by a multiplicative constant factor. We also show bounds for m(Fₖ(G)) for various classes of graphs G. Finally, we consider the algorithmic complexity of finding m(Fₖ(G)), showing it to be NP-complete for a constant k, and giving evidence that, when the weights take finitely many values, it is not NP-hard for k≥ nδ for any constant δ>0.
articles.abstract_zh: 设 G 是一个有 n 个顶点的图，每条边都分配一个正的权重。 G 的割是将其顶点划分为两个集合 X 和 Y； (X,Y) 的权重是 G 的边的权重之和，其中一个端点在 X 中，另一个端点在 Y 中。最大割问题要求 G 的割的最大权重 m(G)。G 的 k 令牌图是图 Fₖ(G)，其顶点是 G 顶点的 k 子集，当它们的对称差是 G 的一条边时，其中两个顶点相邻。物理学中海森堡反铁磁体的相位重建问题可以重新表述为令牌图上的最大割问题。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 设 G 是一个有 n 个顶点的图，每条边都分配一个正的权重。 G 的割是将其顶点划分为两个集合 X 和 Y； (X,Y) 的权重是 G 的边的权重之和，其中一个端点在 X 中，另一个端点在 Y 中。最大割问题要求 G 的割的最大权重 m(G)。G 的 k 令牌图是图 Fₖ(G)，其顶点是 G 顶点的 k 子集，当它们的对称差是 G 的一条边时，其中两个顶点相邻。物理学中海森堡反铁磁体的相位重建问题可以重新表述为令牌图上的最大割问题。受此启发，我们研究了令牌图上的最大割问题，主要是当所有边都分配相同的权重时。我们的主要关注点是用 m(G) 来限制 m(Fₖ(G))。我们证明 m(Fₖ(G))≥binomn-2k-1m(G)，并且该界限严格达到乘法因子 1+O(k/n)；当 k=c · n 对于某个常数 0 0 时。

articles.title: Geometric control of diffusive relaxation: spectral design, transport bounds and transverse mode isolation
articles.title_zh: 扩散弛豫的几何控制：光谱设计、传输边界和横模隔离
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.25173v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Geometric confinement changes both thermal relaxation and heat throughput, but these effects need not be governed by the same conduction path. We establish a distinction between serial and parallel geometries for passive, homogeneous Fourier conductors at fixed material properties, volume and length. For a reduced variable-area conductor, two logarithmic shape harmonics independently tune two selected Bloch-rate pairs, and exact local transport level sets permit spectral redistribution at fixed effective diffusivity. A nonperturbative weighted Poincaré bound, however, requires the effective axial diffusivity to vanish if the first positive insulated rate tends to zero at fixed length. This obstruction is avoided by continuous parallel paths with weak transverse exchange. Capacity-weighted networks identify the exchange mechanism, and a three-dimensional product domain provides an exact bulk realization. Its axial conductance remains κ V/L², while exactly one positive insulated rate vanishes and the next approaches a positive limit set by axial, chamber and neck diffusion. The slow rate is asymptotically the transverse neck conductance times the sum of inverse chamber capacities. Spectral projection estimates translate this separation into a preparation- and readout-dependent observation window. The result is metastable retention of a temperature contrast under insulated conditions, not a second equilibrium state. It identifies when geometrical control of internal equilibration can be separated from macroscopic heat transport.
articles.abstract_zh: 几何约束会改变热弛豫和热通量，但这些效应不需要由相同的传导路径控制。我们在固定材料特性、体积和长度下，区分了无源同质傅立叶导体的串行和并行几何形状。对于减小的可变面积导体，两个对数形状谐波独立地调谐两个选定的布洛赫率对，并且精确的局部传输电平设置允许在固定的有效扩散率下进行频谱重新分布。然而，如果第一正绝缘率在固定长度处趋于零，则非微扰加权庞加莱界要求有效轴向扩散率消失。通过具有弱横向交换的连续平行路径可以避免这种阻碍。容量加权网络确定交换机制，三维产品域提供精确的批量实现。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 几何约束会改变热弛豫和热通量，但这些效应不需要由相同的传导路径控制。我们在固定材料特性、体积和长度下，区分了无源同质傅立叶导体的串行和并行几何形状。对于减小的可变面积导体，两个对数形状谐波独立地调谐两个选定的布洛赫率对，并且精确的局部传输电平设置允许在固定的有效扩散率下进行频谱重新分布。然而，如果第一正绝缘率在固定长度处趋于零，则非微扰加权庞加莱界要求有效轴向扩散率消失。通过具有弱横向交换的连续平行路径可以避免这种阻碍。容量加权网络确定交换机制，三维产品域提供精确的批量实现。其轴向电导保持为 κ V/L²，而恰好一个正绝缘率消失，下一个接近由轴向、腔室和颈部扩散设定的正极限。慢速渐进地是横向颈电导乘以逆室容量之和。光谱投影估计将这种分离转化为依赖于准备和读出的观察窗口。结果是在绝缘条件下保持温度对比的亚稳态，而不是第二平衡状态。它确定何时可以将内部平衡的几何控制与宏观热传输分开。

articles.title: Tunable source of entangled microwaves by nonlinear scattering of magnons
articles.title_zh: 通过磁振子非线性散射的可调谐纠缠微波源
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.25207v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We propose a route to prepare entangled states of microwaves propagating in spatially separated transmission lines using the intrinsic nonlinear dynamics of ferromagnetic spin waves (magnons). We first show that a driven magnon mode can produce entangled magnon pairs at low temperatures by spontaneous parametric down-conversion enabled by three-magnon processes. The anisotropic magnon properties in thin films result in strict phase-matching conditions which allow only a well-defined pair of magnon modes to be amplified. This mode selectivity allows to out-couple each amplified mode to an independent microwave transmission line, producing non-degenerate propagating microwave entanglement with current experimental parameters. In addition, we prove that the frequency difference between the two entangled microwaves can be dynamically tuned across a few-GHz range by changing the orientation of a bias magnetic field. Our figures of merit - .g., the amount of microwave entanglement - can be largely improved by optimizing material and geometry. Our work establishes that quantum states of propagating magnons can be created by their nonlinear dynamics alone, and opens a pathway toward integrating magnons in hybrid quantum platforms.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们提出了一种利用铁磁自旋波（磁振子）的固有非线性动力学来制备在空间分离的传输线中传播的微波纠缠态的路线。我们首先证明，驱动磁振子模式可以通过三磁振子过程实现的自发参数下转换在低温下产生纠缠磁振子对。薄膜中的各向异性磁振子特性导致严格的相位匹配条件，仅允许放大一对明确的磁振子模式。这种模式选择性允许将每个放大模式耦合到独立的微波传输线，从而产生与当前实验参数的非简并传播微波纠缠。此外，我们证明了两个纠缠微波之间的频率差可以通过改变偏置磁场的方向在几GHz范围内动态调整。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们提出了一种利用铁磁自旋波（磁振子）的固有非线性动力学来制备在空间分离的传输线中传播的微波纠缠态的路线。我们首先证明，驱动磁振子模式可以通过三磁振子过程实现的自发参数下转换在低温下产生纠缠磁振子对。薄膜中的各向异性磁振子特性导致严格的相位匹配条件，仅允许放大一对明确的磁振子模式。这种模式选择性允许将每个放大模式耦合到独立的微波传输线，从而产生与当前实验参数的非简并传播微波纠缠。此外，我们证明了两个纠缠微波之间的频率差可以通过改变偏置磁场的方向在几GHz范围内动态调整。我们的品质因数——例如微波纠缠的量——可以通过优化材料和几何形状来大大提高。我们的工作表明，传播磁子的量子态可以仅通过其非线性动力学来创建，并开辟了将磁子集成到混合量子平台中的途径。

articles.title: Resilience of emergent Hamiltonian quantum memories in the presence of noise
articles.title_zh: 新兴哈密顿量子存储器在噪声存在下的弹性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.25286v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Emergent Hamiltonians can freeze an entangled state prepared through coherent evolution, since that state is an eigenstate of the Hamiltonian under which it is then stored. We show that the freedom left in this construction allows the storage spectrum to be adapted to a noisy environment without changing the stored state. For a product of Bell pairs prepared from a density wave in an engineered chain, a selection rule prevents local density noise from connecting the target to any of its degenerate partners, so that rescaling the storage Hamiltonian by a factor α moves every transition this noise drives. Under 1/f noise, the storage time then grows in proportion to α, a result we confirm by evolving the memory under explicit classical 1/f fields, whereas for an Ohmic bath the most favorable scale depends on its cutoff. Fermionic loss, treated as a solvable model, includes a transition that rescaling leaves at zero frequency, and an energy shift μ per particle moves it away from zero, with an exact orbital solution giving the resulting lifetimes. Finally, among number-conserving quadratic reference Hamiltonians, α and μ are the only controls that keep the storage Hamiltonian nearest neighbor at every time along the preparation, so that the protocol combines local freezing with control over the storage spectrum.
articles.abstract_zh: 突现哈密顿量可以冻结通过相干演化准备的纠缠态，因为该状态是哈密顿量的本征态，然后将其存储在该状态下。我们表明，这种结构中留下的自由度允许存储频谱适应噪声环境而不改变存储状态。对于从工程链中的密度波准备的贝尔对的乘积，选择规则可以防止局部密度噪声将目标连接到其任何简并伙伴，以便通过因子 α 重新缩放存储哈密顿量来移动该噪声驱动的每个转换。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 突现哈密顿量可以冻结通过相干演化准备的纠缠态，因为该状态是哈密顿量的本征态，然后将其存储在该状态下。我们表明，这种结构中留下的自由度允许存储频谱适应噪声环境而不改变存储状态。对于从工程链中的密度波准备的贝尔对的乘积，选择规则可以防止局部密度噪声将目标连接到其任何简并伙伴，以便通过因子 α 重新缩放存储哈密顿量来移动该噪声驱动的每个转换。在 1/f 噪声下，存储时间与 α 成比例增长，我们通过在显式经典 1/f 场下演化内存来确认这一结果，而对于欧姆浴，最有利的尺度取决于其截止值。费米子损失被视为可解模型，包括在零频率下重新缩放叶的转变，以及每个粒子的能量偏移 μ 使其远离零，并通过精确的轨道解给出最终的寿命。最后，在数守恒二次参考哈密顿量中，α和μ是唯一在制备过程中每次都保持存储哈密顿量最近邻的控制，因此该协议将局部冻结与存储谱控制结合起来。

articles.title: Compiling Constraints into Neuromorphic Ising Machines
articles.title_zh: 将约束编译到神经形态 Ising 机器中
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.25352v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Most practical combinatorial optimization problems involve constraints, and an Ising machine that flips one spin at a time can respect them only through energy penalties that raise barriers between feasible solutions. Here we show that a higher-order neuromorphic Ising machine can enforce constraints through programmable transitions rather than penalties. In an autoencoder-like architecture, each inner-layer neuron represents a move, a family of multi-spin transitions that maps every feasible state to another feasible state, receives the energy change of its move through connections that outer-layer neurons multiplicatively switch on or off, and updates the state through the same connections. A compiler turns constraints into this wiring with a number of auxiliary clauses that grows only polynomially for parity, cardinality, one-hot, partition and permutation constraints. Restricting the search to feasible states reduces constraint handling to move design, and we show that the fastest-annealing moves are not those that mix fastest but those that lower the deepest energy barriers, and that moves chosen from the objective lower them further than random ones. On third-order graph matching, the machine needs orders of magnitude fewer iterations than penalty-based neuromorphic machines. Configured as a sampler on a field-programmable gate array, it decodes the surface code with maximum-likelihood accuracy up to code distance 15 within 52 μs per shot and, under noisy syndrome measurements, decodes in real time for millisecond measurement rounds up to distance 9 with fewer logical errors than belief-propagation decoders.
articles.abstract_zh: 大多数实际的组合优化问题都涉及约束，而一次翻转一个自旋的伊辛机只能通过能量惩罚来尊重它们，从而增加可行解决方案之间的障碍。在这里，我们展示了高阶神经拟态伊辛机可以通过可编程转换而不是惩罚来强制约束。在类似自动编码器的架构中，每个内层神经元代表一个移动，一系列多自旋转换，将每个可行状态映射到另一个可行状态，通过外层神经元乘法打开或关闭的连接接收其移动的能量变化，并通过相同的连接更新状态。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 大多数实际的组合优化问题都涉及约束，而一次翻转一个自旋的伊辛机只能通过能量惩罚来尊重它们，从而增加可行解决方案之间的障碍。在这里，我们展示了高阶神经拟态伊辛机可以通过可编程转换而不是惩罚来强制约束。在类似自动编码器的架构中，每个内层神经元代表一个移动，一系列多自旋转换，将每个可行状态映射到另一个可行状态，通过外层神经元乘法打开或关闭的连接接收其移动的能量变化，并通过相同的连接更新状态。编译器将约束转化为带有许多辅助子句的接线，这些辅助子句仅针对奇偶校验、基数、独热、分区和排列约束进行多项式增长。将搜索限制在可行状态可以减少对移动设计的约束处理，并且我们表明，最快的退火移动不是那些混合速度最快的移动，而是那些降低最深能垒的移动，并且从目标中选择的移动比随机移动进一步降低了它们。在三阶图匹配中，机器需要的迭代次数比基于惩罚的神经形态机器少几个数量级。配置为现场可编程门阵列上的采样器，它可以在每次发射 52 μs 内以最大似然精度解码高达代码距离 15 的表面代码，并且在噪声综合症测量下，实时解码毫秒测量舍入到距离 9，并且比置信传播解码器具有更少的逻辑错误。

articles.title: FamilySpace: From Emergent Chemical Semantics to Controllable Crystal Generation
articles.title_zh: FamilySpace：从新兴化学语义到可控晶体生成
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.25452v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Latent crystal generative models typically combine a variational autoencoder (VAE) for learning atom-wise representations with a flow model that transports a simple source distribution to the learned latent distribution. However, previous studies have mainly focused on the quality of generated crystals, leaving the structure and generative utility of the atom-wise latent space largely unexplored. In this work, we show that even a vanilla crystal VAE implicitly organizes atom-wise latent representations according to elemental families, with different families occupying largely separated regions of the latent space. We term this phenomenon emergent chemical semantics. This structure suggests that sampling from a family-specific latent region can bias the decoder toward atoms from the corresponding elemental family. Building on this insight, we propose FamilySpace, a framework for controlling the elemental-family composition of generated crystals. FamilySpace assigns each elemental family a distinct source component, forming a family-indexed multi-source distribution, and trains a flow model using source-target pairs matched by family. In inference, a user-specified family template selects the source component for each atom-wise representation, enabling direct control over the family composition of generated crystals. Experiments on MP-20 and MPTS-52 show that FamilySpace achieves competitive crystal-generation performance while matching prescribed elemental-family compositions. Moreover, selected family templates increase the fraction of generated crystals predicted to be stable or metastable, demonstrating that latent-space composition control can support targeted exploration of promising chemical regions without additional optimization techniques such as reinforcement learning. Code is available at https://github.com/hhw11/FamilySpace
articles.abstract_zh: 潜在晶体生成模型通常将用于学习原子级表示的变分自动编码器（VAE）与将简单源分布传输到学习的潜在分布的流模型相结合。然而，以前的研究主要集中在生成的晶体的质量上，而原子潜在空间的结构和生成效用在很大程度上尚未得到探索。在这项工作中，我们表明，即使是普通晶体 VAE 也会根据元素族隐式组织原子潜在表示，不同族占据潜在空间的大部分独立区域。我们将这种现象称为新兴化学语义。这种结构表明，从特定族的潜在区域采样可以使解码器偏向来自相应元素族的原子。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 潜在晶体生成模型通常将用于学习原子级表示的变分自动编码器（VAE）与将简单源分布传输到学习的潜在分布的流模型相结合。然而，以前的研究主要集中在生成的晶体的质量上，而原子潜在空间的结构和生成效用在很大程度上尚未得到探索。在这项工作中，我们表明，即使是普通晶体 VAE 也会根据元素族隐式组织原子潜在表示，不同族占据潜在空间的大部分独立区域。我们将这种现象称为新兴化学语义。这种结构表明，从特定族的潜在区域采样可以使解码器偏向来自相应元素族的原子。基于这一见解，我们提出了 FamilySpace，一个用于控制生成晶体的元素家族组成的框架。 FamilySpace 为每个元素族分配一个不同的源组件，形成族索引的多源分布，并使用与族匹配的源-目标对来训练流模型。在推论中，用户指定的族模板为每个原子表示选择源组件，从而能够直接控制生成的晶体的族组成。 MP-20 和 MPTS-52 上的实验表明，FamilySpace 在匹配规定的元素族组成的同时实现了有竞争力的晶体生成性能。此外，选定的族模板增加了预测为稳定或亚稳定的生成晶体的比例，这表明潜在空间成分控制可以支持有前途的化学区域的有针对性的探索，而无需额外的优化技术（例如强化学习）。代码可在 https://github.com/hhw11/FamilySpace 获取

articles.title: Theory of magneto-electrokinetics in unidirectional electrolyte flow: Hydrodynamic potential and Hall effect
articles.title_zh: 单向电解质流中的磁-电动力学理论：流体动力学电势和霍尔效应
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.26208v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We develop a theoretical framework for magneto-electrokinetic transport in dilute electrolytes under unidirectional flow and streaming current conditions. Unlike standard magnetohydrodynamics in liquid metals, where charge carriers are electrons and conductivity is typically uniform, electrolytes exhibit spatially varying ion densities and additional forces such as osmotic pressure. In steady state, the coupled Navier--Stokes, Nernst--Planck, and Poisson equations become analytically tractable. We derive a Boltzmann-like expression for ion distributions that incorporates both the electrostatic potential and a novel hydrodynamic potential arising from the magnetic field. This potential depends explicitly on the flow profile and is not screened close to the bounding walls. Applying the theory to Poiseuille flow, we derive expressions for the induced Hall potential and demonstrate its near-linear dependence on flow velocity and magnetic field strength, while remaining largely independent of salt concentration. To validate this one-dimensional framework, we analyze the two-dimensional spatial transients near the channel entrance. We demonstrate a separation of length scales: the Hall electric field and space charge adjust to the magnetic field almost instantaneously, whereas the macroscopic salt concentration wake develops over a much longer Graetz length dictated by the Péclet number. We also examine a similar flow with counterions only and no added salt, determining the resulting potential and ion distributions. This work offers new theoretical tools for understanding ion transport in microfluidic and electrochemical systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们开发了单向流和流动电流条件下稀电解质磁动电传输的理论框架。与液态金属中的标准磁流体动力学不同，其中电荷载体是电子并且电导率通常是均匀的，电解质表现出空间变化的离子密度和附加力，例如渗透压。在稳定状态下，耦合的纳维-斯托克斯、能斯特-普朗克和泊松方程在分析上变得易于处理。我们推导出离子分布的类玻尔兹曼表达式，其中包含静电势和由磁场产生的新型流体动力势。该电势明确取决于流动剖面，并且不会在靠近边界墙的地方被屏蔽。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们开发了单向流和流动电流条件下稀电解质磁动电传输的理论框架。与液态金属中的标准磁流体动力学不同，其中电荷载体是电子并且电导率通常是均匀的，电解质表现出空间变化的离子密度和附加力，例如渗透压。在稳定状态下，耦合的纳维-斯托克斯、能斯特-普朗克和泊松方程在分析上变得易于处理。我们推导出离子分布的类玻尔兹曼表达式，其中包含静电势和由磁场产生的新型流体动力势。该电势明确取决于流动剖面，并且不会在靠近边界墙的地方被屏蔽。将该理论应用于泊肃叶流，我们推导了感应霍尔电势的表达式，并证明了其对流速和磁场强度的近线性依赖性，同时在很大程度上与盐浓度无关。为了验证这个一维框架，我们分析了通道入口附近的二维空间瞬变。我们证明了长度尺度的分离：霍尔电场和空间电荷几乎立即适应磁场，而宏观盐浓度尾流则在由佩克莱数决定的更长的格雷兹长度上发展。我们还检查了仅使用抗衡离子且不添加盐的类似流程，确定了产生的电势和离子分布。这项工作为理解微流体和电化学系统中的离子传输提供了新的理论工具。

articles.title: To predict or to persist: how decoherence shapes learning in a spin-qubit quantum reservoir
articles.title_zh: 预测或坚持：退相干如何塑造自旋量子位量子库中的学习
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.26215v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: In this work we investigate how dephasing and the choice of measured observables affect learning in a simulated six-qubit spin chain with Markovian dissipation and exact expectation-value readout. For externally driven nonlinear autoregressive moving-average signals, combining single- and two-qubit observables gives better predictions than a population-only readout at comparable polynomial feature counts. Most of the configurations we tested become more accurate than a reference with relaxation and dephasing disabled, most strongly at T₂=1,μs, where total memory capacity drops, and still at T₂=5-10,μs, where memory is only redistributed across delays. For autonomous generation, we train the readout with scheduled sampling and iterative dataset aggregation to expose it to states reached under its own feedback. We do not find a clear systematic dependence of limit-cycle persistence on coherence across the reservoir ensemble. For chaotic forecasting, in contrast, prediction horizons at T₂=1,μs shorten in all 10 reservoir realizations relative to that reference. For the noise-driven strange non-chaotic attractor, the model produces a smooth, approximately closed orbit, and neither captures the target's scatter nor follows its trajectory pointwise. We conclude that, within this simulated reservoir, the impact of coherence depends strongly on the task.
articles.abstract_zh: 在这项工作中，我们研究了相移和测量可观测值的选择如何影响具有马尔可夫耗散和精确期望值读数的模拟六量子位自旋链中的学习。对于外部驱动的非线性自回归移动平均信号，在可比较的多项式特征计数下，结合单量子位和两个量子位可观测量可以比仅总体读数提供更好的预测。我们测试的大多数配置都比禁用松弛和移相的参考配置更准确，在 T2=1,μs 时最准确，此时总内存容量下降，并且仍然在 T2=5-10,μs 时，内存仅在延迟之间重新分配。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在这项工作中，我们研究了相移和测量可观测值的选择如何影响具有马尔可夫耗散和精确期望值读数的模拟六量子位自旋链中的学习。对于外部驱动的非线性自回归移动平均信号，在可比较的多项式特征计数下，结合单量子位和两个量子位可观测量可以比仅总体读数提供更好的预测。我们测试的大多数配置都比禁用松弛和移相的参考配置更准确，在 T2=1,μs 时最准确，此时总内存容量下降，并且仍然在 T2=5-10,μs 时，内存仅在延迟之间重新分配。对于自主生成，我们通过计划采样和迭代数据集聚合来训练读数，以使其暴露在其自身反馈下达到的状态。我们没有发现极限环持久性对整个储层集合的相干性存在明显的系统依赖性。相比之下，对于混沌预测，T2=1,μs 时的预测范围相对于该参考在所有 10 个储层实现中都缩短了。对于噪声驱动的奇异非混沌吸引子，该模型产生平滑、近似闭合的轨道，既不捕获目标的散射，也不逐点跟踪其轨迹。我们的结论是，在这个模拟水库中，一致性的影响很大程度上取决于任务。

articles.title: Tunable Ground-State Entanglement in Fully Connected Quantum Systems: From Logarithmic to Volume-Law Scaling
articles.title_zh: 全连接量子系统中的可调谐基态纠缠：从对数到体积定律缩放
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.26430v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Entanglement scaling is a central probe of the complexity of quantum many-body ground states, yet once geometric locality is absent, it can depend sensitively on the structure and normalization of interactions. For fully connected Hamiltonians with the natural Kac normalization, nondegenerate gapped ground states are known to obey a logarithmic entanglement bound. Here we ask how the ground-state entanglement changes when this interaction normalization is continuously relaxed away from the Kac scale. We answer this question by constructing an explicit all-to-all bipartite Hamiltonian of n qubits with Fourier pairing amplitudes and pairwise interaction strength proportional to n⁻κ. For sufficiently small fixed coupling, we prove that every pure ground state has entanglement entropy Θ(n²⁻²κ log n) for 1/2<κ≤1 and Θ(n) at κ=1/2. We further show that the ground state is unique and separated from the rest of the spectrum by a system-size-independent gap for 3/4 ≤ κ ≤ 1, while weak-coupling analysis and numerical calculations suggest that the gap remains open also for 1/2 ≤ κ < 3/4. Thus, varying only the interaction normalization yields a controlled hierarchy from logarithmic scaling at the natural Kac normalization κ=1 to increasingly strong subextensive entanglement and ultimately to a volume law, showing that even an arbitrarily weak relaxation of this normalization precludes a universal logarithmic entanglement bound.
articles.abstract_zh: 纠缠尺度是量子多体基态复杂性的核心探针，但一旦几何局部性不存在，它就会敏感地依赖于相互作用的结构和归一化。对于具有自然 Kac 归一化的完全连接的哈密顿量，已知非简并有隙基态服从对数纠缠界限。在这里，我们询问当这种相互作用归一化不断松弛远离 Kac 尺度时，基态纠缠如何变化。我们通过构建 n 个量子位的显式全对全二分哈密顿量来回答这个问题，其傅立叶配对幅度和成对相互作用强度与 n⁻κ 成正比。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 纠缠尺度是量子多体基态复杂性的核心探针，但一旦几何局部性不存在，它就会敏感地依赖于相互作用的结构和归一化。对于具有自然 Kac 归一化的完全连接的哈密顿量，已知非简并有隙基态服从对数纠缠界限。在这里，我们询问当这种相互作用归一化不断松弛远离 Kac 尺度时，基态纠缠如何变化。我们通过构建 n 个量子位的显式全对全二分哈密顿量来回答这个问题，其傅立叶配对幅度和成对相互作用强度与 n⁻κ 成正比。对于足够小的固定耦合，我们证明每个纯基态在 1/2<κ≤1 时具有纠缠熵 θ(n²⁻²κ log n)，在 κ=1/2 时具有 θ(n)。我们进一步表明，基态是唯一的，并且在 3/4 ≤ κ ≤ 1 的情况下通过与系统尺寸无关的间隙与其余光谱分开，而弱耦合分析和数值计算表明，在 1/2 ≤ κ < 3/4 的情况下，该间隙也保持开放。因此，仅改变相互作用归一化就会产生一个受控的层次结构，从自然 Kac 归一化 κ=1 处的对数缩放到越来越强的次广泛纠缠，最终到体积定律，表明即使这种归一化的任意弱松弛也排除了通用对数纠缠界限。

articles.title: High-Accuracy Neural-Network Quantum States via Randomized Real-Time Dynamics
articles.title_zh: 通过随机实时动力学实现高精度神经网络量子态
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.26587v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Neural-network quantum states (NQSs) exhibit a disparity in converging to the ground state during energy minimization: while the energy converges quadratically with the error in the variational wave function, other observables converge only linearly, which limits the accuracy of physical predictions. Here we show how to close this gap by introducing a new algorithm that improves the accuracy of NQSs. Our method, termed dynamical averaging, estimates expectation values by averaging over a state (or observable) evolved in real-time. Using insights from quantum information, we prove an up-to-quadratic suppression of error in arbitrary ground state observables, thus matching the fast convergence of the energy. Importantly, this improved accuracy requires neither further energy minimization nor increased model complexity, but rather exploits the effect of randomization on quantum states. We demonstrate dynamical averaging on non-integrable spin models, where it accelerates convergence and substantially reduces errors in observables.
articles.abstract_zh: 神经网络量子态（NQS）在能量最小化过程中表现出收敛到基态的差异：虽然能量随变分波函数的误差二次收敛，但其他可观测量仅线性收敛，这限制了物理预测的准确性。在这里，我们展示了如何通过引入一种提高 NQS 准确性的新算法来缩小这一差距。我们的方法称为动态平均，通过对实时演变的状态（或可观察的）进行平均来估计期望值。利用量子信息的见解，我们证明了任意基态可观测量中误差的高达二次抑制，从而匹配能量的快速收敛。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 神经网络量子态（NQS）在能量最小化过程中表现出收敛到基态的差异：虽然能量随变分波函数的误差二次收敛，但其他可观测量仅线性收敛，这限制了物理预测的准确性。在这里，我们展示了如何通过引入一种提高 NQS 准确性的新算法来缩小这一差距。我们的方法称为动态平均，通过对实时演变的状态（或可观察的）进行平均来估计期望值。利用量子信息的见解，我们证明了任意基态可观测量中误差的高达二次抑制，从而匹配能量的快速收敛。重要的是，这种提高的精度既不需要进一步的能量最小化，也不需要增加模型的复杂性，而是利用随机化对量子态的影响。我们在不可积自旋模型上演示了动态平均，它加速了收敛并大大减少了可观测值的误差。

articles.title: Altermagnets versus Antiferromagnets
articles.title_zh: 交变磁体与反铁磁体
articles.abstract: arXiv:2601.14878v5 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Altermagnets are substances with a momentum-dependent spin splitting of electron bands due to a specific crystal structure that is invariant under time reversal only in combination with rotations and reflections. The developed phenomenological approach allows to obtain a spectrum of electron bands in altermagnets corresponding to their magnetic group symmetry. We consider antiferromagnetic, weak ferromagnetic, and ferrimagnetic structures. The calculated Berry curvature of electron bands in the altermagnet with zero spontaneous magnetisation occurs an odd function of momentum components whereas it is even in a weak ferromagnetic state. The Berry curvature in ferrimagnetic state consists of sum of even and odd terms.
articles.abstract_zh: 交变磁体是一种具有与动量相关的电子带自旋分裂的物质，这是由于特定的晶体结构在时间反转下仅与旋转和反射相结合而保持不变。所开发的现象学方法允许获得互变磁体中与其磁组对称性相对应的电子带谱。我们考虑反铁磁、弱铁磁和亚铁磁结构。计算出的具有零自发磁化强度的互变磁体中电子带的贝里曲率是动量分量的奇函数，而在弱铁磁状态下是偶函数。亚铁磁态的贝里曲率由偶数项和奇数项之和组成。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 交变磁体是一种具有与动量相关的电子带自旋分裂的物质，这是由于特定的晶体结构在时间反转下仅与旋转和反射相结合而保持不变。所开发的现象学方法允许获得互变磁体中与其磁组对称性相对应的电子带谱。我们考虑反铁磁、弱铁磁和亚铁磁结构。计算出的具有零自发磁化强度的互变磁体中电子带的贝里曲率是动量分量的奇函数，而在弱铁磁状态下是偶函数。亚铁磁态的贝里曲率由偶数项和奇数项之和组成。

articles.title: Magnetic field control of the excitonic transition in Ta₂NiSe₅
articles.title_zh: Ta2NiSe5 激子跃迁的磁场控制
articles.abstract: arXiv:2601.23136v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The formation of excitonic insulator phases in quantum materials is often masked by structural distortions caused by the coupling between electronic and phononic order parameters. Here, for the candidate material Ta₂NiSe₅, we show that sufficiently high magnetic fields can stabilize an excitonic insulating phase in the absence of a lattice distortion. By considering the interplay between the excitonic and structural instabilities, we predict a magnetic field-induced transition from the low-temperature, structurally distorted, semiconducting phase to an undistorted excitonic insulator phase with ground-state loop currents. Before the transition, the magnetic field-softening of the phonon mode associated with the structural distortion reveals the existence of a latent excitonic phase under the structurally distorted one. These results highlight an unbiased route towards the disentanglement of the coupled excitonic-structural transition in Ta₂NiSe₅, and uncover a general mechanism for magnetic field control of competing phases in quantum materials.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子材料中激子绝缘体相的形成通常被电子和声子序参数之间的耦合引起的结构畸变所掩盖。在这里，对于候选材料 Ta2NiSe5，我们表明足够高的磁场可以在没有晶格畸变的情况下稳定激子绝缘相。通过考虑激子和结构不稳定性之间的相互作用，我们预测了磁场引起的从低温、结构扭曲的半导体相到具有基态环路电流的未扭曲激子绝缘体相的转变。在转变之前，与结构畸变相关的声子模式的磁场软化揭示了结构畸变下潜在激子相的存在。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 量子材料中激子绝缘体相的形成通常被电子和声子序参数之间的耦合引起的结构畸变所掩盖。在这里，对于候选材料 Ta2NiSe5，我们表明足够高的磁场可以在没有晶格畸变的情况下稳定激子绝缘相。通过考虑激子和结构不稳定性之间的相互作用，我们预测了磁场引起的从低温、结构扭曲的半导体相到具有基态环路电流的未扭曲激子绝缘体相的转变。在转变之前，与结构畸变相关的声子模式的磁场软化揭示了结构畸变下潜在激子相的存在。这些结果突出了 Ta2NiSe5 中耦合激子结构转变解开的无偏途径，并揭示了量子材料中竞争相的磁场控制的一般机制。

articles.title: Magneto-optical transport in type-II Weyl semimetals in the presence of orbital magnetic moment
articles.title_zh: 轨道磁矩存在下 II 型外尔半金属的磁光输运
articles.abstract: arXiv:2602.04781v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: In this work, we investigate the linear and nonlinear magnetoconductivity of tilted type-II Weyl semimetals within the semiclassical Boltzmann framework by incorporating both the Berry curvature (BC) and the orbital magnetic moment (OMM) corrections. In the linear response regime, we derive analytical expressions for the magnetoconductivity that explicitly include the previously ignored OMM contribution while in the nonlinear regime we obtain analytical expressions that account for the combined effects of the BC and OMM. We find that the open Fermi surface and finite density of states characteristic of the type-II phase qualitatively alter the BC and OMM-induced transport responses relative to the type-I case. Depending on the magnetic-field orientation and transport geometry, the OMM is shown to either suppress or enhance different magnetoconductivity components, in contrast to their monotonic behavior in type-I Weyl semimetals. Our results provide a comprehensive theoretical framework for magneto-optical transport in tilted type-II Weyl semimetals and identify experimentally accessible signatures of the interplay between cone tilt, BC and OMM in candidate materials such as WTe₂, MoTe₂ and TaIrTe₄.
articles.abstract_zh: 在这项工作中，我们通过结合贝里曲率 (BC) 和轨道磁矩 (OMM) 校正，研究半经典玻尔兹曼框架内倾斜 II 型外尔半金属的线性和非线性磁导率。在线性响应区域中，我们推导了磁导率的解析表达式，其中明确包括先前忽略的 OMM 贡献，而在非线性区域中，我们获得了解释 BC 和 OMM 综合效应的解析表达式。我们发现，相对于 I 型情况，II 型相的开放费米面和有限态密度特征定性地改变了 BC 和 OMM 诱导的输运响应。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在这项工作中，我们通过结合贝里曲率 (BC) 和轨道磁矩 (OMM) 校正，研究半经典玻尔兹曼框架内倾斜 II 型外尔半金属的线性和非线性磁导率。在线性响应区域中，我们推导了磁导率的解析表达式，其中明确包括先前忽略的 OMM 贡献，而在非线性区域中，我们获得了解释 BC 和 OMM 综合效应的解析表达式。我们发现，相对于 I 型情况，II 型相的开放费米面和有限态密度特征定性地改变了 BC 和 OMM 诱导的输运响应。根据磁场方向和输运几何形状，OMM 可以抑制或增强不同的磁导率成分，这与 I 型外尔半金属中的单调行为形成鲜明对比。我们的研究结果为倾斜 II 型外尔半金属中的磁光输运提供了一个全面的理论框架，并确定了候选材料（如 WTe2、MoTe2 和 TaIrTe4）中锥体倾斜、BC 和 OMM 之间相互作用的实验可用特征。

articles.title: Unconventional magnetic field response of X-ray magnetic circular dichroism in α-Fe₂O₃
articles.title_zh: α-Fe2O₃ 中 X 射线磁圆二色性的非常规磁场响应
articles.abstract: arXiv:2603.00442v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Altermagnets are compensated collinear magnets that break time-reversal symmetry without net magnetization, enabling unconventional magneto-optical responses. Here, we experimentally demonstrate X-ray magnetic circular dichroism (XMCD) in hematite α-Fe₂O₃ for X-rays incident along the [111] direction, perpendicular to the applied magnetic field and the weak ferromagnetic moment induced by the Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya interaction. The XMCD amplitude reaches approximately 10 % of the polarization-averaged X-ray absorption intensity, whereas it is nearly suppressed for Hparallel[1bar10] of 200 mT. This unique behavior is consistent with field-driven changes between configurations associated with different magnetic symmetries. Our results establish that XMCD in the altermagnet α-Fe₂O₃ exhibits a fundamentally distinct response compared to that of weak ferromagnetism. This study addresses how XMCD in altermagnets responds to external magnetic fields compared to conventional ferromagnets.
articles.abstract_zh: 交替磁体是补偿共线磁体，无需净磁化即可打破时间反转对称性，从而实现非常规磁光响应。在这里，我们通过实验证明了赤铁矿 α-Fe2O3 中 X 射线沿 [111] 方向入射、垂直于外加磁场以及 Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya 相互作用引起的弱铁磁矩的 X 射线磁圆二色性（XMCD）。 XMCD 振幅达到偏振平均 X 射线吸收强度的大约 10%，而对于 200 mT 的 Hparallel[1bar10]，它几乎被抑制。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 交替磁体是补偿共线磁体，无需净磁化即可打破时间反转对称性，从而实现非常规磁光响应。在这里，我们通过实验证明了赤铁矿 α-Fe2O3 中 X 射线沿 [111] 方向入射、垂直于外加磁场以及 Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya 相互作用引起的弱铁磁矩的 X 射线磁圆二色性（XMCD）。 XMCD 振幅达到偏振平均 X 射线吸收强度的大约 10%，而对于 200 mT 的 Hparallel[1bar10]，它几乎被抑制。这种独特的行为与不同磁对称性相关配置之间的场驱动变化一致。我们的结果表明，与弱铁磁性相比，交变磁体 α-Fe2O3 中的 XMCD 表现出根本不同的响应。这项研究探讨了与传统铁磁体相比，交流磁体中的 XMCD 如何响应外部磁场。

articles.title: Stealthy hyperuniform disorder: A new route to controlling electronic states and magnetic properties in correlated systems
articles.title_zh: 隐形超均匀无序：控制相关系统中电子态和磁特性的新途径
articles.abstract: arXiv:2604.19041v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We investigate how spatial correlations in bond disorder affect the electronic and magnetic properties of the Hubbard model on the honeycomb lattice. Hyperuniform structures, distinct from random and quasiperiodic ones, have recently attracted considerable interest due to their anomalous suppression of density fluctuations. By diagonalizing the noninteracting Hamiltonian, we show that a linear density of states (DOS) robustly emerges, while the stealth property of the bond distribution changes the wave functions in the higher-energy region extended and significantly modifies the DOS near the band edge. To clarify the impact on magnetism, we apply the real-space Hartree approximation to the Hubbard model. We find that, the phase transition always occurs between semimetallic and antiferromagnetically ordered states and the staggered magnetization in the ordered state is sensitive to the stealth property. A comparison with the quasiperiodic honeycomb tiling further highlights the role of structural correlations. These results demonstrate that stealthy hyperuniform disorder provides a novel route to controlling electronic states and magnetic properties in correlated systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们研究了键无序的空间相关性如何影响蜂窝晶格上哈伯德模型的电子和磁性。超均匀结构与随机结构和准周期结构不同，由于其对密度涨落的异常抑制，最近引起了人们的极大兴趣。通过对角化非相互作用哈密顿量，我们发现线性态密度（DOS）稳健地出现，而键分布的隐形特性改变了高能区域扩展中的波函数，并显着改变了带边缘附近的 DOS。为了阐明对磁性的影响，我们将实空间哈特里近似应用于哈伯德模型。我们发现，相变总是发生在半金属和反铁磁有序态之间，并且有序态的交错磁化强度对隐身性能敏感。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们研究了键无序的空间相关性如何影响蜂窝晶格上哈伯德模型的电子和磁性。超均匀结构与随机结构和准周期结构不同，由于其对密度涨落的异常抑制，最近引起了人们的极大兴趣。通过对角化非相互作用哈密顿量，我们发现线性态密度（DOS）稳健地出现，而键分布的隐形特性改变了高能区域扩展中的波函数，并显着改变了带边缘附近的 DOS。为了阐明对磁性的影响，我们将实空间哈特里近似应用于哈伯德模型。我们发现，相变总是发生在半金属和反铁磁有序态之间，并且有序态的交错磁化强度对隐身性能敏感。与准周期蜂窝状平铺的比较进一步凸显了结构相关性的作用。这些结果表明，隐形超均匀无序为控制相关系统中的电子态和磁特性提供了一条新途径。

articles.title: Valley enhanced Rabi frequency in n-type planar Silicon-MOS quantum dot
articles.title_zh: n 型平面硅-MOS 量子点中的谷增强拉比频率
articles.abstract: arXiv:2604.22547v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Electron spin resonance spectroscopy (ESR) of a single electron in planar Si-MOS quantum dot is reported in the vicinity of a valley level anti-crossing. A number of one and two-photon resonances are observed due to mixing of magnetic spin-flip and electric valley-flip transitions. This allows the reconstruction of the energy-level diagram of a four state system with two valley and two spin states. Near the anti-crossing, an enhancement of the Rabi frequency is observed. This is attributed to an electric-dipole transition activated by admixing of the upper energy level due to inter-valley spin coupling. The electric-dipole transition may be driven via capacitive coupling between the ESR antenna, and the confinement gate. To characterize spin-valley coupling responsible for the enhancement, we measure the anisotropy of the g-factor difference between the two valley states, the mean g-factor and the inter-valley spin coupling for both in and out-of-plane magnetic fields. The inter-valley spin coupling is strongly modulated by the direction of the B-field, and is strongest for out-of-plane B-field, consistent with an in-plane spin-valley field. In principle, this strong Electric dipole spin resonance (EDSR) effect could be utilized for fast all-electrical spin control in small-scale devices.
articles.abstract_zh: 据报道，平面 Si-MOS 量子点中单个电子的电子自旋共振光谱 (ESR) 位于谷级反交叉附近。由于磁自旋翻转和电谷翻转跃迁的混合，观察到许多一光子和二光子共振。这允许重建具有两个谷态和两个自旋态的四态系统的能级图。在反交叉附近，观察到拉比频率的增强。这归因于谷间自旋耦合导致高能级混合激活的电偶极跃迁。电偶极子转变可以通过ESR天线和限制栅极之间的电容耦合来驱动。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 据报道，平面 Si-MOS 量子点中单个电子的电子自旋共振光谱 (ESR) 位于谷级反交叉附近。由于磁自旋翻转和电谷翻转跃迁的混合，观察到许多一光子和二光子共振。这允许重建具有两个谷态和两个自旋态的四态系统的能级图。在反交叉附近，观察到拉比频率的增强。这归因于谷间自旋耦合导致高能级混合激活的电偶极跃迁。电偶极子转变可以通过ESR天线和限制栅极之间的电容耦合来驱动。为了表征导致增强的自旋谷耦合，我们测量了两个谷态之间的 g 因子差异的各向异性、平均 g 因子以及面内和面外磁场的谷间自旋耦合。谷间自旋耦合受到 B 场方向的强烈调制，并且平面外 B 场最强，与面内自旋谷场一致。原则上，这种强电偶极子自旋共振（EDSR）效应可用于小型设备中的快速全电自旋控制。

articles.title: Unusual critical currents in quasi-one-dimensional superconducting aluminum two-width structures in a magnetic field
articles.title_zh: 磁场中准一维超导铝双宽结构的异常临界电流
articles.abstract: arXiv:2604.27881v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We measured critical switching and retrapping currents as functions of temperature in the zero field and as functions of a magnetic field perpendicular to the substrate surface at a temperature close to the critical temperature in thin-film long quasi-one-dimensional superconducting aluminum two-width structures consisting of narrow and wide wires with different critical temperatures. It is found that the switching current as a function of the field is nonlocal (dependent on electron transport in the area containing the junction line between the narrow and wide wires). The unusual behavior of the switching current lies in the fact that it is poorly described by the classical Ginzburg-Landau theory. In low and intermediate fields, the switching current is determined mainly by the densities of critical currents in the narrow and wide wires, respectively, near the wire junction line. In high fields, the switching current is due to equilibrium fluctuations of the order parameter.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们在由具有不同临界温度的窄线和宽线组成的薄膜长准一维超导铝二维结构中，测量了零场中温度的临界开关电流和重新俘获电流作为温度的函数以及在接近临界温度的温度下作为垂直于衬底表面的磁场的函数。研究发现，开关电流作为场的函数是非局部的（取决于包含窄线和宽线之间的连接线的区域中的电子传输）。开关电流的异常行为在于经典的金兹堡-朗道理论对其描述很差。在低场和中场中，开关电流主要由靠近导线接合线的窄导线和宽导线中的临界电流密度决定。在高场中，开关电流是由于阶次参数的平衡波动引起的。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们在由具有不同临界温度的窄线和宽线组成的薄膜长准一维超导铝二维结构中，测量了零场中温度的临界开关电流和重新俘获电流作为温度的函数以及在接近临界温度的温度下作为垂直于衬底表面的磁场的函数。研究发现，开关电流作为场的函数是非局部的（取决于包含窄线和宽线之间的连接线的区域中的电子传输）。开关电流的异常行为在于经典的金兹堡-朗道理论对其描述很差。在低场和中场中，开关电流主要由靠近导线接合线的窄导线和宽导线中的临界电流密度决定。在高场中，开关电流是由于阶次参数的平衡波动引起的。

articles.title: First-principles finite-size correction schemes for point defects of Cu₃N
articles.title_zh: Cu₃N点缺陷的第一性原理有限尺寸修正方案
articles.abstract: arXiv:2605.25153v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Point defects play a key role in determining semiconductor properties, such as electrical conductivity and photoluminescence, and often enable functional behavior. Accurate first-principles supercell simulations of point defects require reliable finite-size corrections. In this study, we combine PBE+U structural relaxations with HSE hybrid-functional calculations to determine defect formation energies and thermodynamic transition levels of Cu₃N. Finite-size trends are quantified using Γ-point calculations in supercells containing 256, 864, and 2048 atoms. We assess and extend the Makov-Payne and Lany-Zunger correction schemes by introducing additional 1/Lⁿ terms, together with core-level potential alignment and defect-specific scaling models. Using Cu₃N as a case study, we show that charged vacancies are accurately described by the Makov-Payne-type scaling (1/L + 1/L³), whereas interstitial defects with shallow or weakly localized electronic character are better captured by a hydrogenic impurity model that accounts for defect-band dispersion. Residual trends for neutral or weakly localized defects are described by higher-order polynomial fits in 1/L³ and 1/L⁴. Hybrid-functional energetics corrected using PBE+U-based finite-size trends confirm the intrinsic p-n doping character of Cu₃N under the conditions considered and demonstrate that no single finite-size correction can be transferred across all defect types.
articles.abstract_zh: 点缺陷在确定半导体特性（例如导电性和光致发光）方面发挥着关键作用，并且通常能够实现功能行为。点缺陷的精确第一原理超晶胞模拟需要可靠的有限尺寸校正。在这项研究中，我们将 PBE+U 结构弛豫与 HSE 混合泛函计算相结合，以确定 Cu₃N 的缺陷形成能和热力学跃迁水平。使用包含 256、864 和 2048 个原子的超级晶胞中的 Γ 点计算来量化有限尺寸趋势。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 点缺陷在确定半导体特性（例如导电性和光致发光）方面发挥着关键作用，并且通常能够实现功能行为。点缺陷的精确第一原理超晶胞模拟需要可靠的有限尺寸校正。在这项研究中，我们将 PBE+U 结构弛豫与 HSE 混合泛函计算相结合，以确定 Cu₃N 的缺陷形成能和热力学跃迁水平。使用包含 256、864 和 2048 个原子的超级晶胞中的 Γ 点计算来量化有限尺寸趋势。我们通过引入额外的 1/Lⁿ 项以及核心级潜在对齐和特定缺陷缩放模型来评估和扩展 Makov-Payne 和 Lany-Zunger 校正方案。以 Cu₃N 作为案例研究，我们表明带电空位可以通过 Makov-Payne 型标度 (1/L + 1/L3) 准确描述，而具有浅层或弱局域电子特性的间隙缺陷可以通过考虑缺陷带色散的氢杂质模型更好地捕获。中性或弱局部缺陷的残余趋势由 1/L3 和 1/L4 中的高阶多项式拟合来描述。使用基于 PBE+U 的有限尺寸趋势校正的混合功能能量学证实了在所考虑的条件下 Cu₃N 的固有 p-n 掺杂特性，并证明没有单一的有限尺寸校正可以转移到所有缺陷类型。

articles.title: Domain wall drift in a ferrimagnet induced by a linearly oscillating in-plane magnetic field
articles.title_zh: 线性振荡面内磁场引起的亚铁磁体中的畴壁漂移
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.23831v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We investigate ferrimagnetic domain-wall dynamics under linearly oscillating in-plane magnetic fields. Starting from a ferrimagnetic Lagrangian that retains the field-dependent contribution to the kinetic energy, we derive collective-coordinate equations for the domain-wall position and azimuthal angle. This formulation makes explicit the field-induced inertial terms, including Coriolis-, Euler-, and centrifugal-like contributions, and clarifies how they couple translational and azimuthal dynamics. For an oscillating in-plane field supplemented by a weak static out-of-plane bias field, we show that periodic switching of the wall angle can be rectified into a finite average domain-wall velocity. At low drive frequencies, where the wall angle follows the oscillating field, the induced drift is proportional to the drive frequency rather than the field amplitude, and reversing the static field reverses it. Above a cutoff frequency, which we derive analytically, the wall angle can no longer follow the drive and the drift is suppressed. Micromagnetic simulations confirm the analytical predictions and demonstrate that the magnitude and direction of the drift can be tuned by the net spin density. These results identify linearly oscillating fields as a mechanism for frequency-controlled domain-wall motion in ferrimagnets and highlight the role of inertial spin dynamics near magnetic compensation.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们研究线性振荡面内磁场下的亚铁磁畴壁动力学。从保留了场相关的动能贡献的亚铁磁拉格朗日量开始，我们推导出磁畴壁位置和方位角的集体坐标方程。该公式明确了场引起的惯性项，包括科里奥利、欧拉和类离心贡献，并阐明了它们如何耦合平移和方位动力学。对于由弱静态面外偏置场补充的振荡面内场，我们表明壁角度的周期性切换可以被纠正为有限平均畴壁速度。在低驱动频率下，壁角跟随振荡场，引起的漂移与驱动频率而不是场幅度成正比，并且反转静态场会反转它。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们研究线性振荡面内磁场下的亚铁磁畴壁动力学。从保留了场相关的动能贡献的亚铁磁拉格朗日量开始，我们推导出磁畴壁位置和方位角的集体坐标方程。该公式明确了场引起的惯性项，包括科里奥利、欧拉和类离心贡献，并阐明了它们如何耦合平移和方位动力学。对于由弱静态面外偏置场补充的振荡面内场，我们表明壁角度的周期性切换可以被纠正为有限平均畴壁速度。在低驱动频率下，壁角跟随振荡场，引起的漂移与驱动频率而不是场幅度成正比，并且反转静态场会反转它。在我们通过分析得出的截止频率之上，壁角不再跟随驱动并且漂移被抑制。微磁模拟证实了分析预测，并证明漂移的幅度和方向可以通过净自旋密度来调节。这些结果将线性振荡场确定为亚铁磁体中频率控制畴壁运动的机制，并强调了磁补偿附近惯性自旋动力学的作用。

articles.title: Encoding Orbital-Projected Densities of States in Graph Neural Networks for Materials Property Prediction
articles.title_zh: 在图神经网络中编码轨道投影状态密度以进行材料特性预测
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.07339v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Graph neural networks have become the dominant machine-learning architecture for predicting materials properties from crystal structures. Yet the initialization of atomic node features has received comparatively little attention, and conventional approaches rely on static elemental descriptors that carry no information about the quantum-mechanical electronic environment of each atom in its crystalline host. Here we show that augmenting atomic node representations with site-projected orbital density of states (pDOS) fingerprints, computed directly from density functional theory calculations, yields systematic and substantial improvements in predictive performance.These representations are fused with Pettifor elemental embeddings at each atomic site before message passing. For the superconducting critical temperature T_c and the optical dielectric constant ϵᵢₙfₜy,the pDOS augmentation reduces prediction errors by 22.9% and 27.9%, respectively, relative to the elemental-descriptor baseline. These improvements are comparable to those achieved by doubling the training-set size. The gains are, however, contingent on training-set size. For the magnetic exchange energies of Heusler compounds, a substantially smaller dataset, the improvement is reduced,indicating that pDOS augmentation is most effective when the training data exceeds the length of the pDOS feature vector. We introduce an interpretable spectral attention-gating mechanism that reveals that the model autonomously learns to prioritize the orbital channels and energy windows most physically relevant to each target property. These results establish pDOS-augmented graph nodes as a broadly applicable strategy for infusing first-principles electronic-structure knowledge into graph networks, opening a practical route to high-accuracy property prediction in data-scarce regimes.
articles.abstract_zh: 图神经网络已成为从晶体结构预测材料特性的主要机器学习架构。然而，原子节点特征的初始化相对较少受到关注，传统方法依赖于静态元素描述符，这些描述符不携带有关其晶体主体中每个原子的量子力学电子环境的信息。在这里，我们表明，通过直接从密度泛函理论计算计算出的位点投影轨道态密度（pDOS）指纹来增强原子节点表示，可以在预测性能方面产生系统性和实质性的改进。在消息传递之前，这些表示与每个原子位点的 Pettifor 元素嵌入融合。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 图神经网络已成为从晶体结构预测材料特性的主要机器学习架构。然而，原子节点特征的初始化相对较少受到关注，传统方法依赖于静态元素描述符，这些描述符不携带有关其晶体主体中每个原子的量子力学电子环境的信息。在这里，我们表明，通过直接从密度泛函理论计算计算出的位点投影轨道态密度（pDOS）指纹来增强原子节点表示，可以在预测性能方面产生系统性和实质性的改进。在消息传递之前，这些表示与每个原子位点的 Pettifor 元素嵌入融合。对于超导临界温度 T_c 和光学介电常数 ϵᵢₙfₜy，相对于元素描述符基线，pDOS 增强分别将预测误差减少了 22.9% 和 27.9%。这些改进与通过将训练集大小加倍所实现的改进相当。然而，收益取决于训练集的大小。对于 Heusler 化合物的磁交换能，数据集要小得多，改进会减少，表明当训练数据超过 pDOS 特征向量的长度时，pDOS 增强最有效。我们引入了一种可解释的光谱注意门控机制，该机制揭示了模型自主学习优先考虑与每个目标属性最物理相关的轨道通道和能量窗口。这些结果将 pDOS 增强图节点确立为一种广泛适用的策略，用于将第一原理电子结构知识注入图网络，为数据稀缺状态下的高精度属性预测开辟了一条实用途径。

articles.title: Emergence and Detection of Surface altermagnetism in KV₂Se₂O
articles.title_zh: KV2Se2O表面交变磁性的出现与检测
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.03551v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We demonstrate the recent concept of emergent surface altermagnetism through its unique signatures in KV₂Se₂O. We show that for bulk antiferromagnetically ordered KV₂Se₂O, the (001) surface exhibits d-wave altermagnetism. Our results fully explain the recent seemingly contradicgting experimental evidence, independently showing both an antiferromagnetically ordered bulk from neutron diffraction, and d-wave spin splitting from photoemission spectroscopy. To fully verify this conecept, we predict, as a key experimental signature, a large nonlinear Edelstein response, which is localized at the surface, and follows the d-wave altermagnetic symmetry. These results are not only relevant for the metallic and room-temperature magnet KV₂Se₂O, but also for several other Lieb lattice systems. Our work expands the pool of techniques that can be used to detect altermagnetism emerging at the surfaces of antiferromagnets.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们通过 KV2Se2O 中独特的特征展示了新兴表面交变磁力的最新概念。我们证明，对于块体反铁磁有序 KV2Se2O，(001) 表面表现出 d 波交变磁性。我们的结果充分解释了最近看似矛盾的实验证据，独立地显示了中子衍射中的反铁磁有序体和光电发射光谱中的d波自旋分裂。为了充分验证这一概念，我们预测作为关键实验特征的大型非线性埃德尔斯坦响应，该响应位于表面，并遵循 d 波交磁对称性。这些结果不仅与金属和室温磁体 KV2Se2O 相关，而且还与其他几种利布晶格系统相关。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们通过 KV2Se2O 中独特的特征展示了新兴表面交变磁力的最新概念。我们证明，对于块体反铁磁有序 KV2Se2O，(001) 表面表现出 d 波交变磁性。我们的结果充分解释了最近看似矛盾的实验证据，独立地显示了中子衍射中的反铁磁有序体和光电发射光谱中的d波自旋分裂。为了充分验证这一概念，我们预测作为关键实验特征的大型非线性埃德尔斯坦响应，该响应位于表面，并遵循 d 波交磁对称性。这些结果不仅与金属和室温磁体 KV2Se2O 相关，而且还与其他几种利布晶格系统相关。我们的工作扩大了可用于检测反铁磁体表面出现的交变磁性的技术库。

articles.title: Quetzalcoatlite as a Disorder-Free Platform for Chiral Magnetism and Frustration
articles.title_zh: 羽蛇神作为手性磁力和挫败的无序平台
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.11301v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The natural mineral quetzalcoatlite Zn₆Cu₃(TeO₆)₂(OH)₆ · (AgₓPb_yClₓ₊₂y) is a structurally ideal kagome magnet, providing a platform for exploring the interplay of geometric frustration, chirality, and tunability in a disorder-free framework. Here, we present the (first) comprehensive ab initio study of its electronic and magnetic properties. The electronic structure is dominated by localized half-filled Cu dₓ^₂₋y^₂ orbitals that become insulating through electronic correlations. Mapping the low-energy physics onto a Heisenberg model reveals that the magnetism is governed primarily by two exchange interactions: a nearest-neighbor intralayer kagome coupling and a next-nearest-neighbor interlayer coupling. Their competition stabilizes an unconventional three-dimensional chiral magnetic state. Each kagome layer hosts a sqrt3×sqrt3 order, while adjacent layers are rotated by 60^circ, producing a right-handed spiral along the crystallographic c-axis. This intrinsic chiral order emerges naturally from the crystal structure and magnetic interactions, establishing quetzalcoatlite as a distinctive realization of chiral magnetism on a perfect kagome lattice. At the same time, the small energy scale of the exchange interactions places the material close to competing magnetic regimes, suggesting that moderate pressure, chemical substitution, or structural modifications may strongly enhance frustration, suppress long-range order, and potentially drive the system toward a quantum spin-liquid state.
articles.abstract_zh: 天然矿物 Zn₆Cu₃(TeO₆)2(OH)₆ · (AgₓPb_yClₓ₊₂y) 是一种结构理想的 kagome 磁体，为探索无序框架中几何挫败性、手性和可调性的相互作用提供了一个平台。在这里，我们提出了对其电子和磁性特性的（第一个）全面的从头开始研究。电子结构以局域半填充的 Cu dₓ²₋y² 轨道为主，这些轨道通过电子关联而变得绝缘。将低能物理映射到海森堡模型表明，磁性主要由两种交换相互作用控制：最近邻层内 kagome 耦合和次近邻层间耦合。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 天然矿物 Zn₆Cu₃(TeO₆)2(OH)₆ · (AgₓPb_yClₓ₊₂y) 是一种结构理想的 kagome 磁体，为探索无序框架中几何挫败性、手性和可调性的相互作用提供了一个平台。在这里，我们提出了对其电子和磁性特性的（第一个）全面的从头开始研究。电子结构以局域半填充的 Cu dₓ²₋y² 轨道为主，这些轨道通过电子关联而变得绝缘。将低能物理映射到海森堡模型表明，磁性主要由两种交换相互作用控制：最近邻层内 kagome 耦合和次近邻层间耦合。它们的竞争稳定了非常规的三维手性磁态。每个 kagome 层都有 sqrt3×sqrt3 阶，而相邻层旋转 60^circ，沿晶体 c 轴产生右手螺旋。这种内在的手性顺序自然地从晶体结构和磁相互作用中出现，使羽蛇纹石成为完美戈薇晶格上手性磁性的独特实现。与此同时，交换相互作用的小能量尺度使材料接近竞争的磁态，这表明适度的压力、化学替代或结构修饰可能会强烈增强挫败感，抑制长程有序，并有可能推动系统走向量子自旋液体状态。

articles.title: Electrically Switchable Spintronics in a Multiferroic Altermagnet
articles.title_zh: 多铁交变磁体中的电切换自旋电子学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.15953v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We introduce a minimal model of a two-dimensional lattice that, upon spontaneous symmetry breaking, simultaneously develops altermagnetic order, a finite electric polarization, and a spin-polarized transport response, all of which are controlled by an external electric field. By coupling a dimerized altermagnet to an external electric field, we show that the three order parameters are not merely compatible but dynamically entangled, so that switching one (for instance, reversing the polarization with an electric field) necessarily reconfigures the other two. We show that this model offers a clear physical blueprint for designing next-generation spintronic logic and pure spin current memdevices that merge the ultrafast, stray-field-free advantages of compensated magnets with the low-power switching architectures of ferroelectrics.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们引入了二维晶格的最小模型，该模型在自发对称性破缺时，同时产生交变磁序、有限电极化和自旋极化输运响应，所有这些都由外部电场控制。通过将二聚交变磁体耦合到外部电场，我们证明了三个阶参数不仅是兼容的，而且是动态纠缠的，因此切换一个参数（例如，用电场反转极化）必然会重新配置其他两个参数。我们证明，该模型为设计下一代自旋电子逻辑和纯自旋电流记忆器件提供了清晰的物理蓝图，将补偿磁体的超快、无杂散场的优点与铁电体的低功耗开关架构相结合。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们引入了二维晶格的最小模型，该模型在自发对称性破缺时，同时产生交变磁序、有限电极化和自旋极化输运响应，所有这些都由外部电场控制。通过将二聚交变磁体耦合到外部电场，我们证明了三个阶参数不仅是兼容的，而且是动态纠缠的，因此切换一个参数（例如，用电场反转极化）必然会重新配置其他两个参数。我们证明，该模型为设计下一代自旋电子逻辑和纯自旋电流记忆器件提供了清晰的物理蓝图，将补偿磁体的超快、无杂散场的优点与铁电体的低功耗开关架构相结合。

articles.title: Josephson effect in bipolar magnetic semiconductors
articles.title_zh: 双极磁性半导体中的约瑟夫森效应
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.24322v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We theoretically investigate equilibrium currents in a one-dimensional Josephson junction incorporating a bipolar magnetic semiconductor (BMS). We show that the intrinsic exchange splitting of the spin-resolved bands enables purely electrical control of the 0--π transition through gate-tunable modulation of the BMS chemical potential, eliminating the need for an external magnetic field. This provides a viable route toward electrically tunable π-junction behavior and highlights the potential of BMS-based Josephson devices for phase-controllable superconducting electronics. Furthermore, in the presence of Rashba spin--orbit coupling, we find an anomalous Josephson effect characterized by a finite equilibrium supercurrent at zero phase difference. This behavior originates from the intrinsic breaking of time-reversal symmetry associated with the spin-polarized electronic structure of the BMS. Interestingly, despite the simultaneous breaking of time-reversal and inversion symmetries---conditions often associated with nonreciprocal superconducting transport---we do not observe a Josephson diode effect. Our results therefore highlight an important distinction between anomalous Josephson transport and superconducting nonreciprocity: the former does not necessarily imply a finite critical-current asymmetry between opposite current directions.
