articles.title: Erratum: “Hall effect in electrolyte solutions: Self-consistent Debye–Hückel–Onsager theory” [J. Chem. Phys. 165, 064506 (2026)]
articles.abstract: Equations (32), (33), and (53)–(56) in the original article [Y. A. Budkov and N. N. Kalikin, J. Chem. Phys. 165 , 064506 (2026)] are incorrect, and Figs. 1, 3, 4, 6, 7, 9, 10, 12, and 13 do not provide the correct representation of the data. Here, we correct the Hall-current operator and recompute the corresponding numerical results. In the linear-in-magnetic-field expansion, the Lorentz force must act on the complete electric-field-induced ionic velocity, including the interaction-induced relaxation velocity and the electrophoretic solvent velocity. These two rotated-current vertices were omitted from the published Hall-current decomposition. The equation for the magnetic distortion of the ionic atmosphere, the mean-field Hall conductivity, and the equilibrium random-phase-approximation correlations remain unchanged. The correction doubles the nonhydrodynamic relaxation contribution in the point-charge limit and adds a second electrophoretic Hall contribution. With hydrodynamic contributions suppressed, the corrected dilute-limit relaxation contribution agrees exactly with the independent odd-SDFT result of Avni et al. and with the relaxation part of Friedman’s 1965 cluster-expansion result. We also correct a separate factor-of-two typographical inconsistency in the published finite-smearing electrophoretic formula.
articles.journal: The Journal of Chemical Physics Current Issue

articles.title: Enabling low-power Bloch–McConnell relaxation dispersion in solid-state NMR
articles.abstract: Bloch–McConnell relaxation dispersion nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR) is a key technique to probe micro- to millisecond molecular motions. It involves measuring the decay of transverse magnetization as a function of the field strength of an applied spin-lock. In solid-state NMR, the technique has so far experienced an important limitation: At low spin-lock field strengths, coherent contributions arising from unaveraged interactions between the N15 and the proton spin-bath can dominate the measured profiles, masking the dynamics. In this study, we demonstrate that these coherent contributions in H1 decoupled Bloch–McConnell Relaxation Dispersion (BMRD) profiles may be understood as being dominated by three-spin MIRROR recoupling effects, such that their limit is governed by the relaxation properties of local H1 spins in a quantifiable manner. With this understanding, we derive a quantitative criterion for understanding where these coherent effects begin to dominate. This allows us to faithfully measure BMRD profiles down to spin-lock fields significantly lower than previously possible and thereby gain access to slower molecular motions.
articles.journal: The Journal of Chemical Physics Current Issue

articles.title: From isolated molecules to solution: A discrete/continuum model with ellipsoidal non-periodic boundary conditions
articles.abstract: Accurate multispectroscopic studies in solution require stationary geometries and, for vibrational components, Hessians—both of which become impractical once the explicit solvent region grows large. We address this by extending an existing variational discrete/continuum model to a smooth ellipsoidal boundary, so that a compact, chemically specific solvent shell can be retained explicitly around anisotropic solutes without the excess solvent a spherical cavity would force into the transverse directions. The Ellipsoidal Polarizable Operator for Condensed Phases framework uses surface ellipsoidal harmonics and metric-weighted duals to represent the apparent surface charge, while Gaussian quantum-mechanical and molecular-mechanical potentials are projected directly on the physical boundary; the formulation has analytic molecular and shape derivatives, van der Waals confinement, and exact ellipsoidal cavitation and recovers the spherical model continuously. Benchmarks include off-center prolate and fully triaxial sources, ensemble sampling and hydrogen-bond clustering for a uracil–water system, representative-cluster optimization, frozen-solvent infrared analysis, and time-dependent density-functional ultraviolet spectra. At equal solvent depth, the ellipsoid needs far fewer explicit waters than the circumscribed sphere, and the same boundary supports a continuous morph between globular and extended solute shapes.
articles.journal: The Journal of Chemical Physics Current Issue

articles.title: Reconstructing and decomposing the boson peak from the dynamical structure factor of network- and packing-type glasses
articles.abstract: Glasses are structurally disordered solids that host, in addition to crystalline-like phonons, vibrational excitations with no direct phononic counterpart. A universal signature is the excess vibrational density of states (vDOS) over the Debye prediction, known as the boson peak (BP), which has been extensively reported via inelastic neutron and x-ray scattering measurements of the dynamical structure factor S ( q , ω ). Here, we reconstruct the vDOS from dynamical-structure-factor data and validate the reconstruction against the vDOS obtained from the eigenfrequencies. We contrast two routes to extract the vDOS from S ( q , ω ): (i) using high-wavenumber q data beyond the Debye wavenumber q D to access predominantly incoherent scattering and recover the vDOS in a manner analogous to velocity-autocorrelation-based approaches, and (ii) integrating S ( q , ω ) over the low- q regime below q D , which enables a decomposition of the vDOS into contributions from distinct wavenumber sectors and thereby provides direct access to the spatial character of vibrational modes. The first route reproduces the eigenfrequency-based vDOS over the full frequency range examined, while the second captures its overall low-frequency behavior, including the BP. Focusing on the second route, we separate phonon-branch and dispersionless-band contributions to the transverse vDOS, thereby quantifying the contribution of the latter to the BP excess. Our main results are obtained from molecular-dynamics simulations of both network- and packing-type glasses, and we further show that the same phenomenology is captured by an effective-medium theory for random spring networks, providing a unified interpretation that connects the excess vDOS to the wavenumber-resolved structure of vibrational excitations in glasses.
articles.journal: The Journal of Chemical Physics Current Issue

articles.title: Microkinetically informed library generation for modeling effective rate laws from kinetic data
articles.abstract: A profound methodological divide separates top-down macroscopic rate law identification from bottom-up, first-principles microkinetic modeling. While top-down macroscopic models often oversimplify underlying chemistry and fail to capture localized kinetic variations, bottom-up microkinetic simulations provide an exceptionally detailed look at elementary reaction pathways. However, these complex microscopic networks are frequently bottlenecked by uncertainties in both their kinetic parameters and topologies and remain too computationally demanding for full-scale reactor engineering. To bridge this gap, we present a methodology that leverages first-principles simulations for automated library generation, circumventing the bottleneck of scarce experimental data. Central to this pipeline is the novel Linearized Ensemble Motif Operator Network framework, which extracts the underlying effective kinetic information by filtering key kinetic motifs from symbolic expressions, effectively distilling intricate microkinetic networks down to simple, chemically interpretable macroscopic rate laws. This pre-compiled motif library is integrated into a sparse model identification architecture with derivative ensembles (SMIDE). To robustly handle experimental noise, SMIDE generates an ensemble of splines from heteroscedastic noise realizations to capture derivative uncertainty. Through multi-objective optimization, the framework maps out a comprehensive Pareto front of candidate models. This approach transforms rate law discovery from a simple curve-fitting exercise into a rigorous statistical analysis of the kinetic mechanisms supported by the physical system, eliminating the need for manually predefined structural libraries.
articles.journal: The Journal of Chemical Physics Current Issue

articles.title: Practical wavelength selection for Quantum-Augmented Networks (QuANets) over shared optical fiber
articles.abstract: Sharing optical fiber with classical traffic requires quantum wavelength selection to balance logical fidelity, block acceptance and classical reception. Here we develop a wavelength-selection framework for an error-corrected three-stage quantum communication protocol. Assuming independent thermal backgrounds, ideal one-photon acceptance and ideal recovery, we derive an accepted qubit channel and a key-independent lower bound on conditional logical entanglement fidelity. Combining this bound with block acceptance defines a yield bound for wavelength selection over evaluated candidates. For the Steane code at 5 km per traversal and −10 dBm per classical channel, the largest fidelity certificate occurs near 1537 nm, whereas the largest yield bound occurs near 1551 nm. Along the 1.25 Gb/s classical link-budget curve with 0.2% base error, the yield bound crosses 10⁻⁶ between 10 and 11 km, while fidelity remains certified at 0.99 or higher through 30 km. Yield therefore restricts certified coexistence before fidelity under these conditions.

articles.title: Simultaneous electrochemical detection of diclofenac, ascorbic acid, and uric acid using machine learning-assisted analysis of voltammetric fingerprints
articles.abstract: The simultaneous electrochemical quantification of diclofenac (DCF), uric acid (UA), and ascorbic acid (AA) is a challenging analytical task due to the overlapping oxidation responses of these electroactive compounds. Although individual analytes can be quantified using conventional peak-based calibration, their simultaneous presence can cause composition-dependent variations in peak position, intensity, and overall voltammetric shape, complicating the determination of individual concentrations. In this study, a bare screen-printed electrode (SPE) was combined with a chemometric approach to investigate the feasibility of simultaneous quantification of multiple components. Differential pulse voltammetry was employed to characterize the individual compounds, and a dataset of 148 voltammetric profiles from 48 compositions (single-compound, binary and ternary) was used. The resulting voltammetric fingerprints were processed via first-derivative transformation, followed by partial least squares regression coupled with support vector regression (PLSR–SVR). Model performance was evaluated by nested group-wise cross-validation, so that each composition was tested while absent from the training data. The approach demonstrated analyte-dependent predictive performance, with root mean square errors (RMSE) of 14.3, 35.2, and 21.9 µM for DCF, UA, and AA, respectively, UA being only modestly better than always predicting the mean concentration (about 41 µM). These results demonstrate that multivariate modeling is capable of extracting quantitative information from complex electrochemical fingerprints, particularly for DCF and AA, while also highlighting the limitations associated with composition-dependent signal variability and the coverage of the experimental concentration space. Overall, this study provides an assessment of both the potential and the current limitations of machine learning-assisted multicomponent electrochemical analysis using bare electrodes.

articles.title: Topology-dependent surface diffusion and structural relaxation in silicon membrane– cavity formation
articles.abstract: Surface-diffusion-driven morphological evolution is commonly described in terms of local geometric factors such as curvature, feature size, and diffusion distance, whereas the role of interface topology in long-range surface mass transport remains less understood. Here, we investigate topology-dependent buried cavity formation in periodic hole lattices using three-dimensional phase-field simulations combined with graph-based transport analysis. Square, triangular, and honeycomb lattices exhibit markedly different sealing kinetics and post-sealing structural relaxation despite identical material properties, feature dimensions, and annealing conditions, demonstrating that local geometric descriptors alone are insufficient to characterize their evolution. To quantify this topology dependence, we introduce transport accessibility as a topology-resolved descriptor of the interconnected pathways available for surface mass redistribution. By representing the evolving Si/void interface as a transport network and combining geodesic transport distance with equivalent network conductance, we formulate a conductance-corrected transport resistance that improves the quantitative description of characteristic relaxation kinetics across the investigated lattice geometries. Analysis of the evolving surface-transport field independently supports the network-based interpretation and reveals that post-sealing relaxation is jointly regulated by transport-path length and pathway accessibility. These findings demonstrate that interface connectivity, together with transport-path length, plays an important role in the surface-diffusion-driven relaxation of silicon membrane–cavity structures. The proposed transport analysis provides a physically motivated approach for interpreting topology-dependent morphological evolution and offers useful guidance for the design of diffusion-formed semiconductor architectures.

articles.title: Plasma-induced nanocluster structures enhances CO gas sensing properties of n-ZnO/p-CuO heterostructures
articles.abstract: In this study, radio frequency (RF) magnetron sputtering was primarily used to deposit heterostructure thin films of n-type zinc oxide (n-ZnO) and p-type copper oxide nanoclusters. By modulating the surface morphology of n-ZnO, the distribution of p-CuO nanoclusters was improved to enhance their characteristics for CO gas sensing applications. After depositing a ZnO seed layer, the oxygen flow rate, etching power, and duration of oxygen plasma etching were modulated to optimize the film surface morphology. Subsequently, p-CuO layers were deposited on the n-ZnO thin film, which not only increased the surface area for gas contact but also utilized the favorable electron transport properties of the heterojunction to enhance gas sensing characteristics. With this structural design, the study also aimed to perform sensing characteristic measurements at a relatively low operating temperature of 100°C, and to further improve CO sensing characteristics by optimizing the film surface morphology. After completing the fabrication process and before packaging, the crystalline properties and surface morphology of the heterostructure thin films were analyzed using high-resolution transmission electron microscope(HRTEM), field-emission scanning electron microscopy (FESEM), X-ray diffraction (XRD), and atomic force microscopy (AFM). The absorption characteristics of the film surface were measured using UV-VIS spectroscopy to analyze its surface porosity. The results show that after oxygen plasma etching on the n-ZnO surface with an oxygen flow rate of 10 sccm, etching power of 150 W, and etching time of 15 min, the heterostructure thin film with p-CuO nanoclusters exhibited better gas sensing sensitivity even at the relatively low operating temperature of 100°C, with the response time reduced from 90 seconds to approximately 10 seconds.

articles.title: The molecular nature of hydrodynamic forces for spherical and cubic particles
articles.abstract: Hydrodynamic forces on particles are routinely described by continuum theories, yet their applicability becomes uncertain when the dimension of the particle becomes comparable to that of solvent molecules. Here, we use molecular dynamics (MD) simulations to quantify molecular-scale drag and solvent-mediated near-contact hydrodynamic forces for spherical and cubic particles in a Lennard-Jones solvent, allowing us to investigate the reliability of continuum theories as a function of shape, size, and molecular interactions. Our study with equilibrium MD demonstrates the validity of scaling in Stokes’ drag over the particle-size range considered, although deviations in the prefactor depend strongly on molecular interactions for both spherical and cubic particles. Surface friction, introduced by surface binding at the molecular scale, reduces an apparent slip in the near-surface velocity profile, leading to an increase in the drag relative to uniformly attractive particles. More importantly, we develop a simple non-equilibrium MD approach to calculate hydrodynamic lubrication forces at the molecular scale. Our study shows that translational lubrication resistance for pairs of spherical and cubic particles grows sharply once the gap narrows to a few solvent diameters, with substantially stronger amplification for aligned cubic faces than for spheres. This behavior is qualitatively analogous to continuum hydrodynamics, although the resistance decays more slowly with particle separation. Moreover, a strong dependence on molecular interactions is observed for enhancement by frictional surfaces. These results provide a unified molecular picture linking particle shape and surface friction to drag, slip, and near-contact hydrodynamic resistance at the molecular scale, giving rise to physical insights into hydrodynamic forces specifically at O (1–10) nm.
articles.journal: The Journal of Chemical Physics Current Issue

articles.title: Preparation, Characterization, and CO2 Adsorption Performance of Activated Carbons Derived from Potato Peel Waste
articles.abstract: The valorization of agro-industrial residues into porous carbon materials offers a sustainable approach to CO2 capture. In this study, potato peel, an abundant biomass waste in Vietnam, was used as a precursor to prepare activated carbon by slow pyrolysis followed by KOH activation. Chemical activation substantially improved the textural properties, yielding a specific surface area of up to 969 m2 g-1. At 0 °C, the potato-peel-derived activated carbon exhibited a CO2 uptake of approximately 1.78 mmol g-1, higher than that of the corresponding okara-derived carbon (0.89 mmol g-1), highlighting the importance of precursor-dependent pore development. NH4OH treatment introduced nitrogen- and oxygen-containing surface functionalities, while CO2 adsorption was strongly influenced by the development of narrow micropores. Overall, the results demonstrate that potato peel can be effectively converted into porous carbon adsorbents with promising CO2 capture performance, highlighting the combined importance of pore structure and surface chemistry.

articles.title: Scalable photonic quantum computer provides new insights into the fundamentals that shape its performance
articles.title_zh: 可扩展的光子量子计算机为塑造其性能的基本原理提供了新的见解
articles.abstract: Photonics-based quantum computers open up new possibilities for investigating highly complex problems in mathematics and have the potential to revolutionize fields ranging from energy and chemical research to secure communications. By utilizing the unusual properties of light particles, they can perform calculations that pose enormous challenges even for the most powerful supercomputers—or remain entirely beyond their reach. At Paderborn University, researchers are now investigating a fundamental question using Germany's first scalable photonic quantum computer, a 'Gaussian boson sampler': which quantum resources are most important for the performance of these devices?
articles.abstract_zh: 基于光子学的量子计算机为研究高度复杂的数学问题开辟了新的可能性，并有可能彻底改变从能源和化学研究到安全通信等领域。通过利用光粒子的不寻常特性，他们可以执行即使对最强大的超级计算机也构成巨大挑战的计算，或者完全超出其能力范围。在帕德博恩大学，研究人员现在正在使用德国第一台可扩展的光子量子计算机“高斯玻色子采样器”研究一个基本问题：哪些量子资源对于这些设备的性能最重要？

articles.title: Cross-probing van der Waals multiferroics
articles.title_zh: 交叉探测范德华多铁性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.23337v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Multiferroic materials, with coupled electric and magnetic orders, hold the potential to enable low-power memory and logic devices by replacing electrical currents with electric fields for magnetic switching. Reducing the dimensionality of multiferroics, from 3D to 2D, has opened new frontiers in this already burgeoning field by enabling unprecedented control over magnetoelectric coupling that is beyond the reach of bulk counterparts, owing to reduced electrostatic screening and enhanced quantum fluctuations at the atomically thin limit. A notable example is a few-layer NiI2 multiferroic, which exhibits coexisting chiral spin textures and (anti)ferroelectricity, accompanied by strong magnetoelectric coupling; by simultaneously breaking time-reversal and spatial-inversion symmetry, NiI2 shows new physical properties such as unique mutual control of chiral magnetism and polarization with giant magnetoelectric coupling, ultrafast electromagnon excitations and odd-parity p-wave magnetism. However, there are experimental challenges in unambiguously identifying intrinsic multiferroicity. This Review critically examines the current landscape of 2D multiferroic materials, with an emphasis on experimental methodologies rather than material taxonomy. We assess different conventional probes for magnetism and ferroelectricity and identify key limitations in single-technique approaches. We emphasize the importance of magneto-opto-electric cross-correlative measurements in establishing intrinsic multiferroic behaviour and outline future research directions for both fundamental studies and device applications.

articles.abstract_zh_full: 具有耦合电序和磁序的多铁性材料具有通过用电场代替电流进行磁开关来实现低功耗存储器和逻辑器件的潜力。将多铁性材料的维数从 3D 降低到 2D，通过减少静电屏蔽和增强原子薄极限下的量子涨落，实现对磁电耦合的前所未有的控制，从而在这个已经蓬勃发展的领域开辟了新的前沿，这是块体对应物无法达到的。一个著名的例子是几层 NiI2 多铁性材料，它表现出共存的手性自旋结构和（反）铁电性，并伴有强磁电耦合；通过同时打破时间反转和空间反转对称性，NiI2显示出新的物理性质，例如通过巨磁电耦合对手性磁性和极化进行独特的相互控制、超快电磁子激发和奇宇称p波磁性。然而，在明确识别内在多铁性方面存在实验挑战。本综述批判性地审视了二维多铁材料的当前前景，重点是实验方法而不是材料分类学。我们评估了磁性和铁电性的不同传统探针，并确定了单一技术方法的关键局限性。我们强调磁光电互相关测量在建立内在多铁性行为中的重要性，并概述了基础研究和器件应用的未来研究方向。

articles.title: Trapped fermions frustrate multiterminal Josephson networks
articles.title_zh: 被困费米子挫败多端约瑟夫森网络
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.23390v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Coherent control of fermions has become a standard approach for engineering quantum devices. Here, we explore parity-induced frustration in multiterminal Josephson arrays. We focus on odd-parity Josephson trijunctions, where the presence of a trapped fermion induces a phase winding in each trijunction. Connecting these trijunctions constrains their shared phases, resulting in a long-distance phase coherence where the frustrated configurations dominate the low-energy physics. In the classical regime, these arrays map onto the Kagome XY antiferromagnet, whose established Berezinskii-Kosterlitz-Thouless (BKT) transition yields algebraically decaying 6e phase correlations. We show that the 6e phase coherence is manifested as a pronounced third harmonic in the current-phase relation of these arrays. While quantum phase fluctuations suppress the 6e coherence, we show that through spin-orbit coupling they also lead to spin correlations and entanglement between the trapped fermions. Our results establish fermion-induced frustration as a route to composite superconducting coherence and phase-mediated spin entanglement in superconductor-semiconductor artificial quantum materials.
articles.abstract_zh: 费米子的相干控制已成为工程量子设备的标准方法。在这里，我们探讨了多端约瑟夫森阵列中奇偶校验引起的挫败感。我们关注奇偶校验约瑟夫森三结，其中俘获费米子的存在会在每个三结中感应出相绕组。连接这些三结点会限制它们的共享相位，从而产生长距离相位相干性，其中受挫配置在低能物理中占主导地位。在经典体系中，这些阵列映射到 Kagome XY 反铁磁体上，其建立的 Berezinskii-Kosterlitz-Thouless (BKT) 转变产生代数衰减的 6e 相位相关性。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 费米子的相干控制已成为工程量子设备的标准方法。在这里，我们探讨了多端约瑟夫森阵列中奇偶校验引起的挫败感。我们关注奇偶校验约瑟夫森三结，其中俘获费米子的存在会在每个三结中感应出相绕组。连接这些三结点会限制它们的共享相位，从而产生长距离相位相干性，其中受挫配置在低能物理中占主导地位。在经典体系中，这些阵列映射到 Kagome XY 反铁磁体上，其建立的 Berezinskii-Kosterlitz-Thouless (BKT) 转变产生代数衰减的 6e 相位相关性。我们表明，6e 相位相干性在这些阵列的电流相位关系中表现为明显的三次谐波。虽然量子相位涨落抑制了 6e 相干性，但我们表明，通过自旋轨道耦合，它们也会导致捕获的费米子之间的自旋相关性和纠缠。我们的结果确立了费米子诱导挫败作为超导-半导体人造量子材料中复合超导相干性和相介自旋纠缠的途径。

articles.title: Nonlinear optical response with relaxation in the velocity gauge
articles.title_zh: 速度计中具有弛豫的非线性光学响应
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.23400v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We develop a framework for the evaluation of the nonlinear optical conductivity of electrons in crystals, driven by homogeneous optical fields, taking into account dissipation effects within the relaxation time approximation (RTA). The present formalism is based on Hamiltonians with minimal light-matter coupling within the velocity gauge, where the electric field is expressed in terms of a vector potential. The nonlinear conductivities are obtained by perturbatively solving the equation of motion for the single-particle reduced density matrix, which includes dissipative effects via the relaxation time approximation. We present a perturbative method to evaluate the reference equilibrium density matrix, towards which dissipation relaxes the system, which in the velocity gauge adiabatically follows the applied vector potential, and is also broadened by dissipative effects. Comparing with previous formulations based on the length gauge, the present approach has the benefit of avoiding the cumbersome evaluation of derivatives of Bloch states with respect to momentum. We test the presented method against length-gauge results, and calculate second- and third-order responses in a graphene-like tight-binding model with a staggered sublattice potential and a periodic modulation. We find that the relaxation time approximation gives results that deviate both quantitatively and qualitatively from the simple inclusion of an imaginary damping term in the frequencies, referred to as adiabatic switching. At equal relaxation parameter, the leading above-gap injection contribution differs by a factor of two; below the gap, the numerical results indicate a finite imaginary dc response in the small-relaxation limit of the relaxation-time calculation. These results show that adiabatic switching does not generally reproduce relaxation through the equation of motion, even in the small-relaxation limit.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们开发了一个框架，用于评估由均匀光场驱动的晶体中电子的非线性光学电导率，并考虑弛豫时间近似（RTA）内的耗散效应。目前的形式主义基于速度计内具有最小光-物质耦合的哈密顿量，其中电场以矢量势表示。非线性电导率是通过微扰求解单粒子约简密度矩阵的运动方程获得的，其中包括通过弛豫时间近似产生的耗散效应。我们提出了一种微扰方法来评估参考平衡密度矩阵，耗散使系统松弛，在速度计中绝热地遵循所施加的矢量势，并且也通过耗散效应而变宽。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们开发了一个框架，用于评估由均匀光场驱动的晶体中电子的非线性光学电导率，并考虑弛豫时间近似（RTA）内的耗散效应。目前的形式主义基于速度计内具有最小光-物质耦合的哈密顿量，其中电场以矢量势表示。非线性电导率是通过微扰求解单粒子约简密度矩阵的运动方程获得的，其中包括通过弛豫时间近似产生的耗散效应。我们提出了一种微扰方法来评估参考平衡密度矩阵，耗散使系统松弛，在速度计中绝热地遵循所施加的矢量势，并且也通过耗散效应而变宽。与之前基于长度规范的公式相比，本方法的优点是避免了布洛赫态关于动量的导数的繁琐评估。我们根据长度测量结果测试了所提出的方法，并计算具有交错亚晶格势和周期性调制的类石墨烯紧束缚模型中的二阶和三阶响应。我们发现，弛豫时间近似给出的结果在数量和质量上都偏离了在频率中简单包含虚数阻尼项（称为绝热切换）。在相同的弛豫参数下，领先的间隙上方注入贡献相差两倍；在间隙之下，数值结果表明在弛豫时间计算的小弛豫极限中存在有限虚数直流响应。这些结果表明，绝热切换通常不会通过运动方程再现弛豫，即使在小弛豫极限下也是如此。

articles.title: Real-Space Theory of Nonequilibrium Orbital Magnetization in Inhomogeneous Solids
articles.title_zh: 非均匀固体中非平衡轨道磁化的实空间理论
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.23404v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We put forward a real-space linear-response theory of orbital magnetization induced by a dc electric field in bulk materials lacking translation invariance. Starting from the current response to a slowly varying electromagnetic field, we show that the linear-in-wavevector conductivity tensor of non-interacting electrons in terms of single-particle Green's functions and the velocity and position operators. This provides a gauge-invariant real-space formulation of the long-wavelength non-equilibrium orbital magnetization of both perfect crystals and disordered systems. In the translationally invariant limit, the formalism recovers the established Bloch picture of orbital magneto-electric effects. We implement the formalism using large-scale Chebyshev expansions and illustrate its capabilities on a Haldane model in the presence of spatially uncorrelated disorder.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们提出了一种由直流电场在缺乏平移不变性的块体材料中引起的轨道磁化强度的实空间线性响应理论。从电流对缓慢变化的电磁场的响应开始，我们根据单粒子格林函数以及速度和位置算子证明了非相互作用电子的线性波矢量电导率张量。这提供了完美晶体和无序系统的长波长非平衡轨道磁化强度的规范不变的实空间公式。在平移不变极限下，形式主义恢复了轨道磁电效应的布洛赫图。我们使用大规模切比雪夫展开来实现形式主义，并在存在空间不相关无序的情况下在 Haldane 模型上说明其功能。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们提出了一种由直流电场在缺乏平移不变性的块体材料中引起的轨道磁化强度的实空间线性响应理论。从电流对缓慢变化的电磁场的响应开始，我们根据单粒子格林函数以及速度和位置算子证明了非相互作用电子的线性波矢量电导率张量。这提供了完美晶体和无序系统的长波长非平衡轨道磁化强度的规范不变的实空间公式。在平移不变极限下，形式主义恢复了轨道磁电效应的布洛赫图。我们使用大规模切比雪夫展开来实现形式主义，并在存在空间不相关无序的情况下在 Haldane 模型上说明其功能。

articles.title: Towards Defect Engineering of Orbital Magnetoelectric Effects
articles.title_zh: 轨道磁电效应缺陷工程
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.23405v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Orbital magnetization is a fundamental measure of time-reversal symmetry breaking in solids that is accessible by experiments. However, unlike the well-studied equilibrium case, the understanding of orbital magnetism resulting from external stimuli such as light and electric fields is still in its infancy. Here we employ a novel real-space framework to investigate charge-to-orbital conversion in a metallic orbital antiferromagnet beyond the conventional Bloch-band picture. We find that common point defects give rise to strongly enhanced time-odd magnetoelectric effects and, depending on their local symmetry, further activate otherwise-forbidden time-even responses. Moreover, we introduce a local marker that provides spatially resolved information on the orbital magnetization carried by non-equilibrium states. Real-space maps reveal that point defects create nanoscale hotspots of orbital magnetization leading to a profound modification of the bulk magnetoelectric response, including a sign reversal of the net orbital moment. Our findings may open up the possibility of engineering linear-response orbital moments with atomic-scale precision by point defects and impurities.
articles.abstract_zh: 轨道磁化强度是固体中时间反转对称性破缺的基本测量方法，可以通过实验获得。然而，与充分研究的平衡情况不同，对光和电场等外部刺激产生的轨道磁性的理解仍处于起步阶段。在这里，我们采用一种新颖的实空间框架来研究金属轨道反铁磁体中超越传统布洛赫带图的电荷到轨道转换。我们发现，公共点缺陷会引起强烈增强的奇时磁电效应，并且根据其局部对称性，进一步激活否则禁止的时偶响应。此外，我们引入了一个局部标记，它提供了非平衡态所携带的轨道磁化强度的空间分辨信息。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 轨道磁化强度是固体中时间反转对称性破缺的基本测量方法，可以通过实验获得。然而，与充分研究的平衡情况不同，对光和电场等外部刺激产生的轨道磁性的理解仍处于起步阶段。在这里，我们采用一种新颖的实空间框架来研究金属轨道反铁磁体中超越传统布洛赫带图的电荷到轨道转换。我们发现，公共点缺陷会引起强烈增强的奇时磁电效应，并且根据其局部对称性，进一步激活否则禁止的时偶响应。此外，我们引入了一个局部标记，它提供了非平衡态所携带的轨道磁化强度的空间分辨信息。真实空间图显示，点缺陷会产生轨道磁化的纳米级热点，从而导致体磁电响应的深刻改变，包括净轨道矩的符号反转。我们的发现可能开辟了通过点缺陷和杂质以原子级精度设计线性响应轨道矩的可能性。

articles.title: Analytical Interacting Tight-binding Model for Fractional Chern Insulators
articles.title_zh: 分数陈绝缘体的解析相互作用紧束缚模型
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.23409v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We construct a two-dimensional 2-band tight-binding model with two-body interactions and without magnetic lattice translation, in which both the hopping and interaction are exponentially local (with Gaussian decay) in real space. The interaction is built from pair annihilation operators whose coefficients are hopping amplitudes divided by positive powers of relative distance. Without any band projection, the ground states at 1/3 filling are exactly fractional Chern insulator (FCI) states (and thus have nonzero gap) for any finite lattice size with any periodic/twist boundary conditions. The FCI ground states are analogous to the discretized version of the Laughlin-like states in the continuum Chern-ideal band, though our FCI states do not require the onsite spinor structure that is necessary in the continuum. We further show analytically that, after adding one unit cell while keeping electron number fixed, the anyonic one-quasihole states are zero-energy ground states of the full Hamiltonian for any finite system size and any quasihole position, analogous to Laughlin quasiholes under the Haldane V₁ pseudopotential. Numerical evidence is provided for the possible nonzero gap of the FCI states at 1/3 filling in the thermodynamic limit, when interaction strength is much smaller than the single-particle band gap.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个具有二体相互作用且没有磁晶格平移的二维 2 能带紧束缚模型，其中跳跃和相互作用在真实空间中都是指数局部的（具有高斯衰减）。相互作用是由成对湮灭算子构建的，其系数是跳跃幅度除以相对距离的正幂。在没有任何能带投影的情况下，对于具有任何周期/扭曲边界条件的任何有限晶格尺寸，1/3 填充时的基态恰好是分数陈绝缘体 (FCI) 态（因此具有非零间隙）。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们构建了一个具有二体相互作用且没有磁晶格平移的二维 2 能带紧束缚模型，其中跳跃和相互作用在真实空间中都是指数局部的（具有高斯衰减）。相互作用是由成对湮灭算子构建的，其系数是跳跃幅度除以相对距离的正幂。在没有任何能带投影的情况下，对于具有任何周期/扭曲边界条件的任何有限晶格尺寸，1/3 填充时的基态恰好是分数陈绝缘体 (FCI) 态（因此具有非零间隙）。 FCI 基态类似于连续统陈理想带中类 Laughlin 态的离散版本，尽管我们的 FCI 态不需要连续统中必需的现场旋量结构。我们进一步分析表明，在保持电子数固定的情况下添加一个晶胞后，对于任何有限系统尺寸和任何准空穴位置，任意子一准空穴态都是完整哈密顿量的零能量基态，类似于 Haldane V₁ 赝势下的 Laughlin 准空穴。当相互作用强度远小于单粒子带隙时，在 1/3 填充热力学极限时，FCI 态可能存在非零带隙，提供了数值证据。

articles.title: Towards Cryogenic AI Hardware: Over 99% Precision In-Memory Computing at 4 K with 3-bit Ferroelectric Hf0.5Zr0.5O2 Capacitors
articles.title_zh: 迈向低温 AI 硬件：使用 3 位铁电 Hf0.5Zr0.5O2 电容器在 4 K 下实现超过 99% 的精度内存计算
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.23489v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: High-accuracy cryogenic hyperdimensional computing (HDC) is demonstrated using Hf0.5Zr0.5O2 (HZO) ferroelectric capacitors (FeCAPs) as multilevel analog memories for capacitive compute in-memory (CIM) architectures. On the ISOLET spoken-word dataset, FeCAP-stored vectors achieve up to 92% classification accuracy at 4 K, while charge-domain matrix-vector multiplication (MVM) exhibits near-ideal behaviour with linearity of 1 and error probability below 1% for 4x4 and 4x8 configurations, operating below 3 V. Unlike the performance at 300 K, HDC and CIM at 4 K remains resilient to electric-field-cycling-induced fatigue, thanks to enhanced cryogenic device characteristics, including reduced state variability, strongly suppressed leakage current and stable retention, as well as 78% faster switching. Furthermore, these multibit FeCAPs exhibit endurance beyond 1E9 cycles with polarization degradation below 8%, preserving multilevel integrity. Benefits can also be observed at 300 K, following cooldown and wake-up pulsing at 4 K and subsequent warming up. These results establish multibit FeCAPs as a highly reliable, ultra-low-energy, and accurate analog CIM platform for future cryogenic AI-computing hardware.
articles.abstract_zh: 使用 Hf0.5Zr0.5O2 (HZO) 铁电电容器 (FeCAP) 作为电容计算内存 (CIM) 架构的多级模拟存储器来演示高精度低温超维计算 (HDC)。在 ISOLET 口语数据集上，FeCAP 存储的向量在 4 K 时实现高达 92% 的分类精度，而电荷域矩阵向量乘法 (MVM) 表现出近乎理想的行为，对于 4x4 和 4x8 配置，在 3 V 以下运行时，线性度为 1，错误概率低于 1%。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 使用 Hf0.5Zr0.5O2 (HZO) 铁电电容器 (FeCAP) 作为电容计算内存 (CIM) 架构的多级模拟存储器来演示高精度低温超维计算 (HDC)。在 ISOLET 口语数据集上，FeCAP 存储的向量在 4 K 时实现高达 92% 的分类精度，而电荷域矩阵向量乘法 (MVM) 表现出近乎理想的行为，对于 4x4 和 4x8 配置，在 3 V 以下运行时，线性度为 1，错误概率低于 1%。与 300 K 时的性能不同，HDC 和 CIM 在 4 K 时仍然能够抵抗电场循环引起的疲劳，这要归功于增强型低温器件特性，包括减少状态变化、强烈抑制泄漏电流和稳定保持，以及加快 78% 的开关速度。此外，这些多位 FeCAP 的耐用性超过 1E9 次循环，极化衰减低于 8%，从而保持多级完整性。在 4 K 冷却和唤醒脉冲以及随后的预热之后，在 300 K 下也可以观察到好处。这些结果使多位 FeCAP 成为未来低温 AI 计算硬件的高度可靠、超低能耗和精确的模拟 CIM 平台。

articles.title: Synthesis-route-dependent state selection in the frustrated spinel ZnV₂O₄
articles.title_zh: 受挫尖晶石 ZnV2O₄ 中合成路线依赖的状态选择
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.23500v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The emergent properties of strongly correlated materials can be highly sensitive to how they are made, yet synthesis pathway is rarely treated as a fundamental variable governing their ground states. The spinel ZnV₂O₄ provides a model system in which to test this idea: its pyrochlore lattice of antiferromagnetically coupled V³⁺ S=1 moments hosts competing spin and orbital degeneracies, while different synthesis routes yield markedly different low-temperature behaviour. Here, we show that changing the solid-state synthesis pathway reproducibly selects a distinct structural and magnetic ground state. Microwave-assisted solid-state synthesis (MASS) stabilises the cubic spinel structure to low temperature, suppressing the conventional cubic-to-tetragonal transition and preserving the highly frustrated S=1 pyrochlore lattice. Combining high-resolution diffraction, magnetometry and inelastic neutron scattering, we find a magnetic ground state exhibiting persistent spin-liquid-like dynamics together with partial spin freezing. Our results establish synthesis pathway as an experimental variable for selecting between competing emergent states in strongly correlated materials, revealing a route to accessing ground states not realised by conventional synthesis.
articles.abstract_zh: 强相关材料的新特性可能对其制造方式高度敏感，但合成途径很少被视为控制其基态的基本变量。尖晶石 ZnV2O₄ 提供了一个模型系统来测试这一想法：其反铁磁耦合 V3⁺ S=1 矩的烧绿石晶格具有竞争性的自旋和轨道简并性，而不同的合成路线会产生明显不同的低温行为。在这里，我们表明，可重复地改变固态合成途径会选择不同的结构和磁性基态。微波辅助固态合成（MASS）将立方尖晶石结构稳定在低温下，抑制了传统的立方到四方的转变，并保留了高度受挫的S=1烧绿石晶格。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 强相关材料的新特性可能对其制造方式高度敏感，但合成途径很少被视为控制其基态的基本变量。尖晶石 ZnV2O₄ 提供了一个模型系统来测试这一想法：其反铁磁耦合 V3⁺ S=1 矩的烧绿石晶格具有竞争性的自旋和轨道简并性，而不同的合成路线会产生明显不同的低温行为。在这里，我们表明，可重复地改变固态合成途径会选择不同的结构和磁性基态。微波辅助固态合成（MASS）将立方尖晶石结构稳定在低温下，抑制了传统的立方到四方的转变，并保留了高度受挫的S=1烧绿石晶格。结合高分辨率衍射、磁力测量和非弹性中子散射，我们发现磁性基态表现出持久的类自旋液体动力学以及部分自旋冻结。我们的结果将合成途径建立为一个实验变量，用于在强相关材料中的竞争性涌现态之间进行选择，揭示了一条通向常规合成无法实现的基态的途径。

articles.title: Application of Pretrained Universal Machine Learning Force-Fields for Phase Transitions Prediction in ZrO2
articles.title_zh: 预训练通用机器学习力场在 ZrO2 相变预测中的应用
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.23535v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Pretrained universal machine-learning force fields can reduce the cost of finite-temperature molecular dynamics relative to density functional theory. However, most benchmarks test only static properties and do not assess whether these models reproduce the correct phase-transition sequence. Here, we benchmark ten open-source universal machine-learning force fields for zirconia (ZrO₂) using phonon dispersion calculations and variable-cell isothermal-isobaric molecular dynamics. Zirconia is a useful test because it has three thermodynamically stable crystalline phases prior to melting, following the sequence monoclinic-tetragonal-cubic. Four models reproduce this sequence: 7net-l3i5, MatterSim-v1.0.0-1M, MACE-mpa, and MACE-D3. Models with orthorhombic-tetragonal energy errors above about 10 meV/atom (7net-0, CHGNet, and MACE) instead produce an orthorhombic intermediate and predict monoclinic-orthorhombic-tetragonal-cubic-liquid upon heating. ORB-based models fail to sustain stable variable-cell dynamics because their phonon frequencies are compressed by 30-60% relative to the density functional theory reference. Across all ten models, two ground-state diagnostics predict finite-temperature behavior. Relative polymorph energetics should agree with the matched density functional theory reference within about 6 meV/atom, and the phonon spectrum should not show systematic softening. These diagnostics are practical screening metrics for assessing pretrained force fields for phase-transition predictions.
articles.abstract_zh: 相对于密度泛函理论，预训练的通用机器学习力场可以降低有限温度分子动力学的成本。然而，大多数基准测试仅测试静态属性，并且不评估这些模型是否再现了正确的相变序列。在这里，我们使用声子色散计算和可变单元等温等压分子动力学对氧化锆 (ZrO2) 的十个开源通用机器学习力场进行基准测试。氧化锆是一种有用的测试，因为它在熔化前具有三个热力学稳定的结晶相，遵循单斜晶系-四方晶系-立方晶系的顺序。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 相对于密度泛函理论，预训练的通用机器学习力场可以降低有限温度分子动力学的成本。然而，大多数基准测试仅测试静态属性，并且不评估这些模型是否再现了正确的相变序列。在这里，我们使用声子色散计算和可变单元等温等压分子动力学对氧化锆 (ZrO2) 的十个开源通用机器学习力场进行基准测试。氧化锆是一种有用的测试，因为它在熔化前具有三个热力学稳定的结晶相，遵循单斜晶系-四方晶系-立方晶系的顺序。四个模型重现了此序列：7net-l3i5、MatterSim-v1.0.0-1M、MACE-mpa 和 MACE-D3。正交四方能量误差高于约 10 meV/原子的模型（7net-0、CHGNet 和 MACE）反而会产生正交中间体，并预测加热后单斜方四方立方液体。基于 ORB 的模型无法维持稳定的可变晶胞动力学，因为它们的声子频率相对于密度泛函理论参考压缩了 30-60%。在所有十个模型中，两种基态诊断预测有限温度行为。相对多晶型能量学应与匹配的密度泛函理论参考一致在约 6 meV/原子内，并且声子谱不应显示系统软化。这些诊断是评估相变预测的预训练力场的实用筛选指标。

articles.title: Topological signatures of criticality: the Ising case
articles.title_zh: 临界性的拓扑特征：伊辛案例
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.23586v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Topological properties of microscopic configurations may provide additional insight into phase transitions beyond conventional thermodynamic observables. We investigate this idea in the two-dimensional Ising model on square and triangular lattices by associating cell complexes with the positive and negative spin domains and constructing an Euler-characteristic observable from their difference. We provide the expression relating this quantity to conventional observables of the Ising model. This derivation allows us to understand its expected behavior physically. As a byproduct, we show that at any finite positive temperature the expectation of the Euler characteristic exceeds a positive, lattice-size-independent bound, hence disproving a previously suggested conjecture. Monte Carlo simulations combined with multihistogram reweighting show that this spin-odd topological observable exhibits order-parameter-like behavior near the ferromagnetic transition. Finite-size scaling of its susceptibility yields pseudocritical temperatures that converge to the known critical temperature for both lattice geometries. On the square lattice, the leading-order estimate of the critical exponent obtained from the topological observable depends more strongly on the fitting range than the magnetization estimate. This behavior is consistent with stronger subleading finite-size corrections, as supported by fits including an additional correction term. On the triangular lattice, the corresponding estimate remains consistent with the theoretical Ising value. Our study suggests that topologically defined quantities such as the Euler characteristic can provide an alternative way to locate order-disorder phase transitions in the systems considered here. Since the definition of these observables is purely geometrical, they can provide useful insights in cases in which order parameters cannot be constructed.
articles.abstract_zh: 微观结构的拓扑性质可以为传统热力学可观测值之外的相变提供额外的见解。我们通过将细胞复合体与正自旋域和负自旋域相关联，并根据它们的差异构建欧拉特征可观测量，在方形和三角形晶格的二维伊辛模型中研究了这一想法。我们提供了将该量与伊辛模型的常规可观测量相关的表达式。这种推导使我们能够从物理上理解其预期行为。作为副产品，我们表明在任何有限的正温度下，欧拉特征的期望超过了与晶格尺寸无关的正界限，因此反驳了之前提出的猜想。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 微观结构的拓扑性质可以为传统热力学可观测值之外的相变提供额外的见解。我们通过将细胞复合体与正自旋域和负自旋域相关联，并根据它们的差异构建欧拉特征可观测量，在方形和三角形晶格的二维伊辛模型中研究了这一想法。我们提供了将该量与伊辛模型的常规可观测量相关的表达式。这种推导使我们能够从物理上理解其预期行为。作为副产品，我们表明在任何有限的正温度下，欧拉特征的期望超过了与晶格尺寸无关的正界限，因此反驳了之前提出的猜想。蒙特卡洛模拟与多直方图重新加权相结合表明，这种自旋奇数拓扑可观测量在铁磁转变附近表现出类似有序参数的行为。其磁化率的有限尺寸缩放产生伪临界温度，该温度收敛到两种晶格几何形状的已知临界温度。在方晶格上，从拓扑可观测量获得的临界指数的前序估计比磁化强度估计更依赖于拟合范围。此行为与更强的次领先有限尺寸校正一致，如包含附加校正项的拟合所支持。在三角晶格上，相应的估计与理论 Ising 值保持一致。我们的研究表明，拓扑定义的量（例如欧拉特征）可以提供另一种方法来定位此处考虑的系统中的有序-无序相变。由于这些可观测量的定义纯粹是几何的，因此它们可以在无法构造顺序参数的情况下提供有用的见解。

articles.title: Persistent Hydration and Ionic Mobility: When the Ion Is Not the Only Transported Species
articles.title_zh: 持久水合和离子迁移率：当离子不是唯一的传输物质时
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.23605v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Small-ion transport in water remains only partially understood despite more than a century of theoretical work. The difficulty is especially acute for strongly hydrated ions such as Li⁺, Mg²⁺, and Ca²⁺, whose first hydration shells can persist on timescales comparable to or longer than translational motion. We develop a molecular framework in which the ion, its first hydration shell, and the outer solvent are treated as dynamically coupled components. Local hydration structure and exchange are represented through a potential of mean force and coordination dynamics, while collective solvent response is described through molecular memory functions. The theory clarifies why hydration cannot generally be represented by an additive friction or a single enlarged radius, and provides a route beyond conventional continuum and molecular descriptions.
articles.abstract_zh: 尽管进行了一个多世纪的理论工作，但对水中小离子传输的了解仍然只有部分。对于 Li⁺、Mg2⁺ 和 Ca2⁺ 等强水合离子来说，这一困难尤其严重，它们的第一个水合壳层可以在与平移运动相当或更长的时间尺度上持续存在。我们开发了一种分子框架，其中离子、其第一个水合壳和外部溶剂被视为动态耦合组件。局部水合结构和交换通过平均力和配位动力学的潜力来表示，而集体溶剂响应通过分子记忆功能来描述。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 尽管进行了一个多世纪的理论工作，但对水中小离子传输的了解仍然只有部分。对于 Li⁺、Mg2⁺ 和 Ca2⁺ 等强水合离子来说，这一困难尤其严重，它们的第一个水合壳层可以在与平移运动相当或更长的时间尺度上持续存在。我们开发了一种分子框架，其中离子、其第一个水合壳和外部溶剂被视为动态耦合组件。局部水合结构和交换通过平均力和配位动力学的潜力来表示，而集体溶剂响应通过分子记忆功能来描述。该理论阐明了为什么水合作用通常不能用附加摩擦力或单个放大半径来表示，并提供了一条超越传统连续体和分子描述的途径。

articles.title: Two-Dimensional Ferromagnetic Weyl Half-Semimetal
articles.title_zh: 二维铁磁外尔半金属
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.23688v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Two-dimensional (2D) ferromagnetic topological materials provide appealing platforms for realizing spin-polarized topological states, yet the coexistence of Weyl fermions and robust high-temperature ferromagnetism remains elusive. Here, based on first-principles calculations and Monte Carlo simulations, we predict monolayer BaMn₄O₈ to be a dynamically, thermally, and mechanically stable ferromagnetic Weyl half-semimetal. textcolorblue{An anisotropic Monte Carlo simulation on a 20×20×1 lattice yields a finite-size transition estimate of approximately 1446~K.} The spin-resolved electronic structure reveals a fully spin-polarized state, in which the spin-up channel hosts linear Weyl band crossings near the Fermi level, whereas the spin-down channel remains insulating. Corresponding Fermi-arc edge states connecting the projected Weyl points (WPs) are clearly observed along the (100) boundary, confirming the nontrivial topology. Importantly, both the Weyl points and their associated Fermi arcs remain robust in the presence of spin--orbit coupling (SOC). textcolorblue{These results identify monolayer BaMn₄O₈ as a candidate for fully spin-polarized topological transport.
articles.abstract_zh: 二维（2D）铁磁拓扑材料为实现自旋极化拓扑态提供了有吸引力的平台，但外尔费米子和强大的高温铁磁性的共存仍然难以捉摸。在这里，基于第一性原理计算和蒙特卡罗模拟，我们预测单层 BaMn₄O₈ 是一种动态、热和机械稳定的铁磁 Weyl 半金属。 textcolorblue{对 20×20×1 晶格进行各向异性蒙特卡罗模拟，得到大约 1446~K 的有限尺寸跃迁估计。} 自旋分辨电子结构揭示了完全自旋极化状态，其中自旋向上通道在费米能级附近具有线性韦尔带交叉，而自旋向下通道保持绝缘。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 二维（2D）铁磁拓扑材料为实现自旋极化拓扑态提供了有吸引力的平台，但外尔费米子和强大的高温铁磁性的共存仍然难以捉摸。在这里，基于第一性原理计算和蒙特卡罗模拟，我们预测单层 BaMn₄O₈ 是一种动态、热和机械稳定的铁磁 Weyl 半金属。 textcolorblue{对 20×20×1 晶格进行各向异性蒙特卡罗模拟，得到大约 1446~K 的有限尺寸跃迁估计。} 自旋分辨电子结构揭示了完全自旋极化状态，其中自旋向上通道在费米能级附近具有线性韦尔带交叉，而自旋向下通道保持绝缘。沿（100）边界清晰地观察到连接投影外尔点（WP）的相应费米弧边缘态，证实了非平凡的拓扑。重要的是，外尔点及其相关的费米弧在存在自旋轨道耦合（SOC）的情况下仍然保持稳健。 textcolorblue{这些结果将单层 BaMn₄O₈ 确定为完全自旋极化拓扑输运的候选者。

articles.title: Physics-Guided Crystal Structure Elucidation from Powder X-Ray Diffraction with Universal Machine-Learning Interatomic Potentials
articles.title_zh: 利用通用机器学习原子间势通过粉末 X 射线衍射进行物理引导晶体结构解析
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.23760v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Determining unique atomic coordinates from powder X-ray diffraction (PXRD) remains challenging because peak overlap, weak scattering from light elements, limited scattering contrast between elements with similar atomic numbers, and experimental noise render the inverse problem underdetermined. Here, we present XCAPE (XRD-Constrained Accelerated Prediction Engine), a crystal structure prediction (CSP) framework that integrates experimentally derived composition, unit cell parameters, space group, and PXRD data into a symmetry-aware evolutionary search. XCAPE explores Wyckoff-site configurations using tailored mutation operations, evaluates candidates by both energetic stability and diffraction agreement, and accelerates geometry optimization using a universal machine-learning interatomic potential (MLIP). The framework recovered 71 of 77 database-derived benchmark structures (92.2%) from simulated PXRD patterns and all 12 reference structures from experimental PXRD patterns. It further identified 12 candidate structure assignments that are consistent with experimental PXRD patterns, lack matching entries in the Inorganic Crystal Structure Database (ICSD), and are thermodynamically competitive at the MLIP level. Density functional theory (DFT) calculations showed that 10 of these 12 candidates lie within 10 meV/atom of the convex hull. By bridging experimental diffraction data and physically plausible atomistic models, XCAPE can provide structural insight into previously unresolved materials and support accelerated materials discovery in automated research workflows.
articles.abstract_zh: 从粉末 X 射线衍射 (PXRD) 中确定独特的原子坐标仍然具有挑战性，因为峰重叠、轻元素的弱散射、具有相似原子序数的元素之间有限的散射对比度以及实验噪声使得逆问题无法确定。在这里，我们提出了 XCAPE（XRD 约束加速预测引擎），这是一种晶体结构预测 (CSP) 框架，它将实验得出的成分、晶胞参数、空间群和 PXRD 数据集成到对称感知进化搜索中。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 从粉末 X 射线衍射 (PXRD) 中确定独特的原子坐标仍然具有挑战性，因为峰重叠、轻元素的弱散射、具有相似原子序数的元素之间有限的散射对比度以及实验噪声使得逆问题无法确定。在这里，我们提出了 XCAPE（XRD 约束加速预测引擎），这是一种晶体结构预测 (CSP) 框架，它将实验得出的成分、晶胞参数、空间群和 PXRD 数据集成到对称感知进化搜索中。 XCAPE 使用定制的突变操作探索威科夫位点配置，通过能量稳定性和衍射一致性评估候选者，并使用通用机器学习原子间势 (MLIP) 加速几何优化。该框架从模拟的 PXRD 图案中恢复了 77 个数据库衍生的基准结构中的 71 个（92.2%），并从实验 PXRD 图案中恢复了所有 12 个参考结构。它还进一步确定了 12 个候选结构分配，这些结构分配与实验 PXRD 模式一致，在无机晶体结构数据库 (ICSD) 中缺乏匹配条目，并且在 MLIP 水平上具有热力学竞争力。密度泛函理论 (DFT) 计算表明，这 12 个候选者中有 10 个位于凸包的 10 meV/原子范围内。通过连接实验衍射数据和物理上合理的原子模型，XCAPE 可以提供对以前未解决的材料的结构洞察，并支持自动化研究工作流程中加速材料发现。

articles.title: Materials representations organize transferable supervision for chemical extrapolation
articles.title_zh: 材料表示组织化学外推的可转移监督
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.23837v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Materials discovery often requires chemical extrapolation beyond labeled data. When target compounds contain elements absent from training, which compounds of other elements provide transferable supervision remains unclear. Here we show that, without target-property labels, materials representations rank other elements by the supervision their compounds provide. Engineered descriptors rank them largely by elemental-property similarity, whereas a pretrained crystal-graph encoder ranks them by the geometry of its learned representation. At fixed training-set size, excluding the compounds of the encoder's six top-ranked elements raises formation-energy and bandgap errors by 100-110 meV per atom and 42-85 meV, versus little change for six lower-ranked elements. The rankings hold across properties, regressors and datasets. The encoder's ranking outperforms elemental-property similarity and periodic groups, suggesting that it captures how elements behave within compounds. Materials representations thus organize transferable supervision, which can be identified before model training, informing dataset assessment and label acquisition.
articles.abstract_zh: 材料发现通常需要超出标记数据的化学外推。当目标化合物含有训练中缺少的元素时，其他元素的哪些化合物提供可转移的监督仍不清楚。在这里，我们表明，在没有目标属性标签的情况下，材料表示通过其化合物提供的监督对其他元素进行排序。工程描述符主要根据元素属性相似性对它们进行排序，而预训练的晶体图编码器则根据其学习表示的几何形状对它们进行排序。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 材料发现通常需要超出标记数据的化学外推。当目标化合物含有训练中缺少的元素时，其他元素的哪些化合物提供可转移的监督仍不清楚。在这里，我们表明，在没有目标属性标签的情况下，材料表示通过其化合物提供的监督对其他元素进行排序。工程描述符主要根据元素属性相似性对它们进行排序，而预训练的晶体图编码器则根据其学习表示的几何形状对它们进行排序。在固定的训练集大小下，排除编码器的六个排名靠前的元素的化合物会使形成能量和带隙误差增加每个原子 100-110 meV 和 42-85 meV，而六个排名较低的元素几乎没有变化。该排名适用于属性、回归量和数据集。编码器的排名优于元素属性相似性和周期组，这表明它捕获了元素在化合物内的行为方式。因此，材料表示组织可转移的监督，可以在模型训练之前进行识别，为数据集评估和标签获取提供信息。

articles.title: Tuning spreading transport in GaN HEMTs with an AlN space layer under non-equilibrium heating
articles.title_zh: 在非平衡加热下调节具有 AlN 空间层的 GaN HEMT 中的扩散传输
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.23866v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Lateral spreading transport dominates near-junction heat dissipation in GaN high-electron-mobility transistors, yet thermal control has largely overlooked this geometry. It neither reaches the core AlGaN/GaN region nor, beyond the spatial spreading itself, accounts for the spectral non-equilibrium of the heat source. Here we tune the spreading resistance directly by inserting a thin, highly conducting AlN space layer above the source to intercept heat and divert it laterally. We test this approach across GaN, AlGaN/GaN, and AlGaN/AlN/GaN structures under both equilibrium and longitudinal-optical (LO)-pumped non-equilibrium heating, pairing non-equilibrium molecular dynamics (NEMD) with full-band phonon Monte Carlo (MC). In equilibrium, the AlN layer lowers the spreading resistance by 38% relative to the AlGaN-capped structure and by 17% relative to bare GaN, with little change in the one-dimensional resistance. The equilibrium color map over AlN thickness and interfacial bonding shows a strong interface effect but a weak thickness trend that reverses, so the gain is set by interface admission rather than solely by thickness or bulk conductivity. This ordering is independently confirmed by gray MC simulations. Under LO pumping, the spreading resistance rises by 58-83% in NEMD and by 9-20% in MC, and the equilibrium spatial optimum weakens or even reverses. This is because an optical-to-acoustic conversion gate now precedes every spatial gate and locks energy in slow optical modes. The three gates in series (optical-to-acoustic conversion, interface admission, and lateral diversion) close into a single non-equilibrium resistance network that predicts the full-band MC cases and frames the AlN space layer as a design variable within the non-equilibrium source state.
articles.abstract_zh: 横向扩散传输在 GaN 高电子迁移率晶体管的近结散热中占主导地位，但热控制在很大程度上忽略了这种几何形状。它既没有到达核心 AlGaN/GaN 区域，也没有超出空间扩散本身，无法解释热源的光谱不平衡。在这里，我们通过在源上方插入薄的、高导电性的 AlN 空间层来拦截热量并横向转移热量，从而直接调节扩散电阻。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 横向扩散传输在 GaN 高电子迁移率晶体管的近结散热中占主导地位，但热控制在很大程度上忽略了这种几何形状。它既没有到达核心 AlGaN/GaN 区域，也没有超出空间扩散本身，无法解释热源的光谱不平衡。在这里，我们通过在源上方插入薄的、高导电性的 AlN 空间层来拦截热量并横向转移热量，从而直接调节扩散电阻。我们在平衡和纵向光学 (LO) 泵浦非平衡加热下，将非平衡分子动力学 (NEMD) 与全带声子蒙特卡罗 (MC) 配对，在 GaN、AlGaN/GaN 和 AlGaN/AlN/GaN 结构上测试了这种方法。在平衡状态下，AlN 层相对于 AlGaN 覆盖结构将扩展电阻降低了 38%，相对于裸露 GaN 降低了 17%，而一维电阻几乎没有变化。 AlN 厚度和界面键合的平衡颜色图显示出很强的界面效应，但厚度趋势却相反，因此增益是由界面准入决定的，而不是仅由厚度或体电导率决定。该排序由灰色 MC 模拟独立确认。在LO泵浦作用下，NEMD中的铺展阻力增加了58-83%，MC中的铺展阻力增加了9-20%，并且平衡空间最优减弱甚至逆转。这是因为光声转换门现在位于每个空间门之前并将能量锁定在慢光模式中。串联的三个门（光声转换、界面准入和横向转移）接近于单个非平衡电阻网络，该网络预测全带 MC 情况并将 AlN 空间层框架为非平衡源状态内的设计变量。

articles.title: Technical Note on Matlantis PFP v9: Extending the Element and Domain Coverage of the r2SCAN Training Data
articles.title_zh: Matlantis PFP v9 技术说明：扩展 r2SCAN 训练数据的元素和域覆盖范围
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.23873v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Universal machine learning interatomic potentials (uMLIPs) make atomistic simulations possible at scales beyond the reach of density functional theory (DFT). Matlantis PFP is a uMLIP that treats a variety of domains, including crystals, molecules, and surfaces, with a single model. PFP v8 incorporated a training dataset computed with the r2SCAN functional, chosen for its good agreement with experiment, but the elements and domains covered by that dataset were limited. Here we present Matlantis PFP v9, in which the training data computed with the r2SCAN functional are extended to the lanthanides from Pr to Lu and to the elements from Po to Cm, for a total of 96 elements, and to additional domains such as clusters and adsorption structures. The formation energies of crystals containing the newly supported elements reproduce experimental standard enthalpies of formation with the same level of accuracy as crystals composed only of previously supported elements, and the adsorption energies of molecules on transition-metal surfaces have an overall error against experiment comparable to that of DFT-PBE, although chemisorbed species are overbound. On the same type of GPU (A100), the inference speed and the maximum system size exceed those of SevenNet-Omni, a public uMLIP trained on r2SCAN data: forces are evaluated three to four times faster, and five to ten times as many atoms can be handled. As a result, PFP-R2SCAN is now applicable to systems containing rare-earth and actinide elements and to adsorption on surfaces.
articles.abstract_zh: 通用机器学习原子间势 (uMLIP) 使原子模拟的规模超出了密度泛函理论 (DFT) 的范围。 Matlantis PFP 是一种 uMLIP，可使用单一模型处理各种领域，包括晶体、分子和表面。 PFP v8 合并了一个用 r2SCAN 函数计算的训练数据集，之所以选择它是因为它与实验吻合良好，但该数据集涵盖的元素和领域有限。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 通用机器学习原子间势 (uMLIP) 使原子模拟的规模超出了密度泛函理论 (DFT) 的范围。 Matlantis PFP 是一种 uMLIP，可使用单一模型处理各种领域，包括晶体、分子和表面。 PFP v8 合并了一个用 r2SCAN 函数计算的训练数据集，之所以选择它是因为它与实验吻合良好，但该数据集涵盖的元素和领域有限。在这里，我们提出了 Matlantis PFP v9，其中使用 r2SCAN 函数计算的训练数据扩展到从 Pr 到 Lu 的镧系元素以及从 Po 到 Cm 的元素，总共 96 个元素，以及其他域，例如簇和吸附结构。含有新负载元素的晶体的形成能以与仅由先前负载元素组成的晶体相同的精度再现了实验标准形成焓，并且过渡金属表面上的分子的吸附能与实验相比具有与DFT-PBE相当的总体误差，尽管化学吸附物质是过量的。在相同类型的 GPU (A100) 上，推理速度和最大系统规模超过了 SevenNet-Omni（一种在 r2SCAN 数据上训练的公共 uMLIP）：力的评估速度快了三到四倍，并且可以处理的原子数量是其五到十倍。因此，PFP-R2SCAN 现在适用于含有稀土和锕系元素的系统以及表面吸附。

articles.title: Local spin constraints and symmetry in single-Q spiral magnets
articles.title_zh: 单 Q 螺旋磁体中的局部自旋约束和对称性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.23882v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The Luttinger--Tisza (LT) method provides a lower bound on the energy of classical spin models but relaxes the local spin-length constraints. For a generic incommensurate single-Q spiral, fixed spin length requires circular polarization on every magnetic sublattice, a condition not guaranteed by equal sublattice weights in the lowest LT eigenmode. We develop a constrained formulation for general bilinear classical spin Hamiltonians with one or two magnetic sublattices. For one sublattice, minimization reduces to a secular equation for the spiral-plane normal. For two sublattices, exact elimination of the relative phase gives a frame-independent energy on the space of two unit normals. We derive symmetry constraints by distinguishing operations that preserve or reverse the Fourier arm and those that preserve or exchange sublattices. For a model with symmetric anisotropy, numerical optimization over both spiral-plane normals yields a lower energy than either constrained pure exchange-sector state, despite the block diagonalization of the linear Hamiltonian. A separate anisotropic two-sublattice benchmark demonstrates that enforcing local circularity can shift the preferred ordering wave vector even when the lowest LT eigenmode has equal sublattice weights.
articles.abstract_zh: Luttinger-Tisza (LT) 方法提供了经典自旋模型能量的下限，但放宽了局部自旋长度约束。对于一般的不相称单 Q 螺旋，固定自旋长度需要每个磁性子晶格上的圆极化，而最低 LT 本征模中的相等子晶格权重不能保证这一条件。我们为具有一个或两个磁性子晶格的一般双线性经典自旋哈密顿量开发了一种约束公式。对于一个子晶格，最小化可简化为螺旋平面法线的长期方程。对于两个子晶格，精确消除相对相位会在两个单位法线的空间上给出与框架无关的能量。
articles.abstract_zh_full: Luttinger-Tisza (LT) 方法提供了经典自旋模型能量的下限，但放宽了局部自旋长度约束。对于一般的不相称单 Q 螺旋，固定自旋长度需要每个磁性子晶格上的圆极化，而最低 LT 本征模中的相等子晶格权重不能保证这一条件。我们为具有一个或两个磁性子晶格的一般双线性经典自旋哈密顿量开发了一种约束公式。对于一个子晶格，最小化可简化为螺旋平面法线的长期方程。对于两个子晶格，精确消除相对相位会在两个单位法线的空间上给出与框架无关的能量。我们通过区分保留或反转傅立叶臂的操作和保留或交换子晶格的操作来导出对称约束。对于具有对称各向异性的模型，尽管线性哈密顿量是块对角化的，但两个螺旋平面法线的数值优化产生的能量比任一受约束的纯交换扇区状态都要低。单独的各向异性双子晶格基准表明，即使最低 LT 本征模具有相等的子晶格权重，强制局部圆性也可以改变首选有序波矢量。

articles.title: Blanket theory for dense networks
articles.title_zh: 密集网络的毯子理论
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.23960v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We show how Blanket theory provides a constructive method for calculating cavity functionals in dense spin networks. Building on the description through interfaces and magnetization shells, we develop the calculation from the low-temperature fluctuations around the ground state. In this regime, dilute defects reveal the mechanism of random energy model (REM) universality for linear energies, while their sharing and renewal across layers organize the energies and Gibbs weights into a hierarchy. Because the same configurations determine the covariances of the fresh cavity fields, this construction identifies the fields and weights with an Aizenman-Sims-Starr random overlap structure. The cavity contributions can then be evaluated through recursive fractional means, yielding an explicit free-energy functional parametrized by layer magnetizations and hierarchical exponents, with coefficients determined by the interaction variances and the network normalization. Under the stated moment and normalization conditions, comparison of pressures transfers the limiting mean pressure from the Gaussian representative to networks with independent centered non-Gaussian couplings having the same variances. We illustrate the method with the deterministic Curie-Weiss model, recover the Parisi functional for the Sherrington-Kirkpatrick model, and derive the functionals for restricted and deep Boltzmann machines, including the full replica symmetry breaking (fullRSB) limit.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们展示了毯子理论如何提供一种计算密集自旋网络中的空腔泛函的建设性方法。基于界面和磁化壳的描述，我们根据基态周围的低温波动进行了计算。在这种情况下，稀释缺陷揭示了线性能量的随机能量模型（REM）普遍性的机制，而它们跨层的共享和更新将能量和吉布斯权重组织成一个层次结构。由于相同的配置决定了新鲜空腔场的协方差，因此该结构使用 Aizenman-Sims-Starr 随机重叠结构来识别场和权重。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们展示了毯子理论如何提供一种计算密集自旋网络中的空腔泛函的建设性方法。基于界面和磁化壳的描述，我们根据基态周围的低温波动进行了计算。在这种情况下，稀释缺陷揭示了线性能量的随机能量模型（REM）普遍性的机制，而它们跨层的共享和更新将能量和吉布斯权重组织成一个层次结构。由于相同的配置决定了新鲜空腔场的协方差，因此该结构使用 Aizenman-Sims-Starr 随机重叠结构来识别场和权重。然后可以通过递归分数均值来评估空腔贡献，产生由层磁化强度和分层指数参数化的显式自由能函数，其系数由相互作用方差和网络归一化确定。在规定的力矩和归一化条件下，压力比较将极限平均压力从高斯代表转移到具有相同方差的独立中心非高斯耦合的网络。我们用确定性 Curie-Weiss 模型说明该方法，恢复 Sherrington-Kirkpatrick 模型的 Parisi 泛函，并导出受限玻尔兹曼机和深度玻尔兹曼机的泛函，包括完全复制对称破缺 (fullRSB) 极限。

articles.title: Light-Induced Odd-Parity h-Wave Magnetism in Penrose Quasicrystals
articles.title_zh: 彭罗斯准晶体中的光致奇宇称 h 波磁力
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.23992v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Noncrystallographic rotational symmetry offers a route to unconventional spin splitting beyond the constraints of periodic crystals. We show that circularly polarized light induces odd-parity h-wave magnetism in a collinear antiferromagnetic Penrose quasicrystal without spin-orbit coupling. Light-induced chiral hopping, generated by virtual two-step processes, combines with staggered exchange to lift the spin degeneracy of the undriven system. Quasicrystalline spin-group symmetry enforces odd-parity spin splitting and selects h-wave as its leading angular harmonic. An analytical effective quasi-band theory relates this splitting to the geometry of local hopping paths and predicts its reversal upon switching the light helicity. Momentum-resolved spectral calculations reveal the characteristic alternating spin contrast, for which we propose spin-resolved time- and angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy as an experimental probe. Our results establish a mechanism for optically controlling higher-harmonic odd-parity magnetism and demonstrate how quasicrystalline order extends Floquet engineering beyond crystallographic symmetry constraints.
articles.abstract_zh: 非晶体旋转对称性提供了一条超越周期性晶体限制的非常规自旋分裂的途径。我们证明，圆偏振光在没有自旋轨道耦合的共线反铁磁彭罗斯准晶体中诱发奇宇称 h 波磁性。由虚拟两步过程产生的光诱导手性跳跃与交错交换相结合，以提高非驱动系统的自旋简并性。准晶自旋群对称性强制奇宇称自旋分裂，并选择 h 波作为其主导角谐波。有效分析准带理论将这种分裂与局部跳跃路径的几何形状联系起来，并预测其在切换光螺旋性时的反转。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 非晶体旋转对称性提供了一条超越周期性晶体限制的非常规自旋分裂的途径。我们证明，圆偏振光在没有自旋轨道耦合的共线反铁磁彭罗斯准晶体中诱发奇宇称 h 波磁性。由虚拟两步过程产生的光诱导手性跳跃与交错交换相结合，以提高非驱动系统的自旋简并性。准晶自旋群对称性强制奇宇称自旋分裂，并选择 h 波作为其主导角谐波。有效分析准带理论将这种分裂与局部跳跃路径的几何形状联系起来，并预测其在切换光螺旋性时的反转。动量分辨光谱计算揭示了特征性的交替自旋对比度，为此我们提出自旋分辨时间和角度分辨光电子能谱作为实验探针。我们的研究结果建立了一种光学控制高次谐波奇宇称磁性的机制，并证明了准晶序如何将 Floquet 工程扩展到晶体学对称性约束之外。

articles.title: Ultrafast Successive Control and Electrical Detection of Long-Lived Valley Polarization in Room-Temperature Germanium
articles.title_zh: 室温锗中长寿命谷极化的超快连续控制和电检测
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.23998v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Germanium (Ge) hosts four degenerate valleys in the conduction band minima, and their highly anisotropic effective masses offer a valley degree of freedom in transport phenomena via anisotropic conductivity. Using time- and polarization-resolved terahertz spectroscopy combined with deformation potential theory, we reveal a valley relaxation time reaching 10 ps near the band edge of Ge(001) at room temperature, long enough to detect the valley polarization in electrical transport measurements. We also demonstrate sub-picosecond complete reversal of valley polarization by off-resonant light pulses at extremely low energy consumption. These results pave the way for room-temperature valleytronics based on bulk indirect-gap semiconductors compatible with existing electronics.
articles.abstract_zh: 锗 (Ge) 在导带最小值处有四个简并谷，其高度各向异性的有效质量通过各向异性电导率在输运现象中提供谷自由度。利用时间和偏振分辨太赫兹光谱与形变势理论相结合，我们揭示了室温下 Ge(001) 能带边缘附近的谷弛豫时间达到 10 ps，足以在电输运测量中检测谷极化。我们还演示了通过非共振光脉冲以极低的能耗实现亚皮秒完全反转谷偏振。这些结果为基于与现有电子设备兼容的体间接带隙半导体的室温谷电子学铺平了道路。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 锗 (Ge) 在导带最小值处有四个简并谷，其高度各向异性的有效质量通过各向异性电导率在输运现象中提供谷自由度。利用时间和偏振分辨太赫兹光谱与形变势理论相结合，我们揭示了室温下 Ge(001) 能带边缘附近的谷弛豫时间达到 10 ps，足以在电输运测量中检测谷极化。我们还演示了通过非共振光脉冲以极低的能耗实现亚皮秒完全反转谷偏振。这些结果为基于与现有电子设备兼容的体间接带隙半导体的室温谷电子学铺平了道路。

articles.title: Two-Color Coherent Control of the Spin Photovoltaic Effect in Centrosymmetric Crystals
articles.title_zh: 中心对称晶体自旋光伏效应的双色相干控制
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.24045v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Spatial inversion forbids the conventional electric-dipole second-order bulk charge and spin photovoltaic responses in centrosymmetric crystals. Here we show that a phase-coherent two-color field at frequencies ω and 2ω can generate symmetry-selected charge and spin photocurrents through an inversion-even third-order dc response. More importantly, the polarization direction and relative phase of the two-color field provide direct control over the current direction and can isolate transport channels in which the charge current vanishes while a finite spin current remains. A systematic symmetry analysis of centrosymmetric magnetic point groups and collinear antiferromagnetic spin point groups shows that pure-spin channels are allowed in a broad class of such systems under appropriate two-color driving. Furthermore, the relative optical phase governs both the magnitude and sign of the response. Our calculations on inversion-stacked bilayer 2H-MoS₂ and a centrosymmetric collinear altermagnet demonstrate resonantly enhanced, phase-tunable spin photocurrents in these complementary systems with strong and weak spin-orbit coupling, respectively. Our results establish the polarization direction and phase of coherent two-color light as active control parameters for spin transport in centrosymmetric materials.
articles.abstract_zh: 空间反转禁止中心对称晶体中传统的电偶极子二阶体电荷和自旋光伏响应。在这里，我们证明频率 ω 和 2ω 的相位相干双色场可以通过反转偶三阶直流响应产生对称选择的电荷和自旋光电流。更重要的是，双色场的偏振方向和相对相位提供了对电流方向的直接控制，并且可以隔离传输通道，其中电荷电流消失，而有限的自旋电流仍然存在。对中心对称磁点组和共线反铁磁自旋点组的系统对称分析表明，在适当的双色驱动下，在广泛的此类系统中允许存在纯自旋通道。此外，相对光学相位控制响应的幅度和符号。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 空间反转禁止中心对称晶体中传统的电偶极子二阶体电荷和自旋光伏响应。在这里，我们证明频率 ω 和 2ω 的相位相干双色场可以通过反转偶三阶直流响应产生对称选择的电荷和自旋光电流。更重要的是，双色场的偏振方向和相对相位提供了对电流方向的直接控制，并且可以隔离传输通道，其中电荷电流消失，而有限的自旋电流仍然存在。对中心对称磁点组和共线反铁磁自旋点组的系统对称分析表明，在适当的双色驱动下，在广泛的此类系统中允许存在纯自旋通道。此外，相对光学相位控制响应的幅度和符号。我们对反转堆叠双层 2H-MoS2 和中心对称共线交替磁体的计算表明，在这些具有强自旋轨道耦合和弱自旋轨道耦合的互补系统中，分别具有共振增强的相位可调自旋光电流。我们的结果将相干双色光的偏振方向和相位确立为中心对称材料中自旋输运的主动控制参数。

articles.title: A GPU-Native Nested Sampling Framework for Finite-Temperature Materials Modelling with Machine-Learned Interatomic Potentials
articles.title_zh: 用于具有机器学习原子间势的有限温度材料建模的 GPU 原生嵌套采样框架
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.24088v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Modern equivariant machine-learned interatomic potentials (MLIPs) have dramatically improved the accuracy of and the scales accessible to atomistic simulation, yet the thermodynamic sampling methods needed to turn those potentials into finite-temperature phase stability predictions have not kept pace computationally. We present the GPU-native, massively parallel nested sampling framework JAXRENS, implemented on top of JAX, which removes the practical bottlenecks preventing atomistic nested sampling from being combined with state-of-the-art MLIPs. The framework provides distributed multi-GPU execution, vectorised ensembles of walkers, and direct interoperability with modern force fields. We demonstrate the highly beneficial scaling of JAXRENS on hardware accelerators, and apply it to the simulation of the ZnS phase diagram based on a MACE foundation model, a procedure previously computationally inaccessible. Despite requiring in the order of 10¹⁰ model evaluations, the final converged simulation completed within six days on four GPUs, marking an important step towards routine, first-principles-quality predictions of finite-temperature phase stability using machine-learned interatomic potentials.
articles.abstract_zh: 现代等变机器学习原子间势（MLIP）极大地提高了原子模拟的准确性和可达到的尺度，但将这些势转化为有限温度相稳定性预测所需的热力学采样方法在计算方面却未能跟上。我们提出了 GPU 原生的大规模并行嵌套采样框架 JAXRENS，它在 JAX 之上实现，消除了阻止原子嵌套采样与最先进的 MLIP 相结合的实际瓶颈。该框架提供分布式多 GPU 执行、步行者矢量化集合以及与现代力场的直接互操作性。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 现代等变机器学习原子间势（MLIP）极大地提高了原子模拟的准确性和可达到的尺度，但将这些势转化为有限温度相稳定性预测所需的热力学采样方法在计算方面却未能跟上。我们提出了 GPU 原生的大规模并行嵌套采样框架 JAXRENS，它在 JAX 之上实现，消除了阻止原子嵌套采样与最先进的 MLIP 相结合的实际瓶颈。该框架提供分布式多 GPU 执行、步行者矢量化集合以及与现代力场的直接互操作性。我们展示了 JAXRENS 在硬件加速器上的非常有益的扩展，并将其应用于基于 MACE 基础模型的 ZnS 相图模拟，这是以前无法通过计算实现的过程。尽管需要进行 1010 个模型评估，最终的收敛模拟还是在 4 个 GPU 上于六天内完成，这标志着朝着使用机器学习原子间势对有限温度相稳定性进行常规、第一性原理质量预测迈出了重要一步。

articles.title: Observation of room-temperature intrinsic antiferroelectricity in van der Waals NbOCl2
articles.title_zh: 范德华 NbOCl2 室温本征反铁电性的观察
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.24092v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In recent years, two-dimensional (2D) ferroelectricity has been extensively investigated across a wide range of 2D materials, while intrinsic 2D antiferroelectricity remains exceptionally rare, limiting its implementation in next-generation photonic and electronic devices. Here, we report the observation of room-temperature-stable antiferroelectricity in the layered transition metal oxyhalide NbOCl2, and demonstrate a reversible, stimuli-driven antiferroelectric-to-ferroelectric (AFE-to-FE) phase transition in this material. Second-harmonic generation (SHG) mapping reveals a well-defined stripe-like spatial distribution of SHG intensity across as-grown NbOCl2 flakes spanning thickness from few-layer to bulk-like configurations. This distinctive SHG signature originates from the existence of antiferroelectric phase and the coexistence of antiferroelectric and ferroelectric phases within individual crystals, as evidenced by a combined incident-angle-dependent SHG measurement and Raman spectroscopy. By integrating NbOCl2 with one-dimensional silver nanowires, we achieve spatially selective, strain-mediated AFE-to-FE phase transition. Moreover, an ultralow electric field (~20 kV/cm) induces a reversible SHG response, consistent with switching from the centrosymmetric antiferroelectric state (SHG-silent) to the non-centrosymmetric ferroelectric state (SHG-active). This study not only expands the family of room-temperature 2D antiferroelectrics but also establishes a versatile platform for dynamic manipulation of nonlinear light, paving the way toward electric-field-programmable nonlinear photonics and optical information processing.
articles.abstract_zh: 近年来，二维 (2D) 铁电性已在各种 2D 材料中得到了广泛研究，而本征 2D 反铁电性仍然异常罕见，限制了其在下一代光子和电子器件中的应用。在这里，我们报告了在层状过渡金属卤氧化物 NbOCl2 中观察到的室温稳定反铁电性，并证明了该材料中可逆的、刺激驱动的反铁电到铁电（AFE-to-FE）相变。二次谐波产生 (SHG) 映射揭示了生长的 NbOCl2 薄片中 SHG 强度的明确的条状空间分布，跨越厚度从几层到块状结构。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 近年来，二维 (2D) 铁电性已在各种 2D 材料中得到了广泛研究，而本征 2D 反铁电性仍然异常罕见，限制了其在下一代光子和电子器件中的应用。在这里，我们报告了在层状过渡金属卤氧化物 NbOCl2 中观察到的室温稳定反铁电性，并证明了该材料中可逆的、刺激驱动的反铁电到铁电（AFE-to-FE）相变。二次谐波产生 (SHG) 映射揭示了生长的 NbOCl2 薄片中 SHG 强度的明确的条状空间分布，跨越厚度从几层到块状结构。这种独特的倍频信号源自反铁电相的存在以及单个晶体内反铁电相和铁电相的共存，这一点可以通过入射角相关倍频测量和拉曼光谱的组合来证明。通过将 NbOCl2 与一维银纳米线集成，我们实现了空间选择性、应变介导的 AFE 到 FE 相变。此外，超低电场（~20 kV/cm）会引起可逆的倍频响应，这与从中心对称反铁电态（SHG-silent）到非中心对称铁电态（SHG-active）的切换一致。这项研究不仅扩展了室温二维反铁电体家族，还建立了动态操纵非线性光的通用平台，为电场可编程非线性光子学和光学信息处理铺平了道路。

articles.title: Uncovering the Structural, Electronic, and Electrostatic Landscapes of SrTiO₃ Grain Boundaries via Grand Canonical Monte Carlo with a Machine-Learning Interatomic Potential
articles.title_zh: 通过具有机器学习原子间势的大正则蒙特卡罗揭示 SrTiO₃ 晶界的结构、电子和静电景观
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.24097v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Grain boundaries in perovskites exhibit a rich variety of electronic, polar and magnetic properties, yet identifying their atomic structures and compositions remains challenging. Here, we combine the Grand Canonical Monte Carlo (GCMC) method with a universal machine-learning interatomic potential to explore the coupled compositional and structural phase space of Σ5(310)[001] SrTiO₃ grain boundaries. The resulting chemical potential phase diagram identifies ten stable structures belonging to four motif families: large Sr kite, small Sr kite, incomplete Sr large kite, and Ti-rich structures. Extending the GCMC method to the Sigma5(210)[001] and Sigma17(410)[001] grain boundaries reveals how grain boundary plane and inclination angle influence the competition between small- and large-kite motifs. Density functional theory calculations of the predicted Sigma5(310)[001] grain boundaries show that the composition and atomic structure strongly govern the spatial distribution of conduction and valence band edge states, interfacial band alignment, and carrier localization. Four distinct electronic regimes emerge: localized electron-doped, delocalized electron-doped, insulating, and hole-attracting states. Our electrostatics analysis reveals the coexistence of the short-range electric fields at the reconstructed GB core associated with local atomic density and bonding, and the longer-range fields outside the core arising from the space charge. These fields can also couple to local polar distortions and generate composition-dependent polarization patterns. These results establish an efficient framework for exploring oxide perovskite grain boundary structures and reveal how stoichiometry and atomic reconstruction couple to electronic structure, electrostatics, and local polarization, providing a route toward predictive grain boundary engineering in functional perovskites.
articles.abstract_zh: 钙钛矿的晶界表现出丰富的电子、极性和磁性特性，但识别其原子结构和成分仍然具有挑战性。在这里，我们将大正则蒙特卡罗（GCMC）方法与通用机器学习原子间势相结合，探索 Σ5(310)[001] SrTiO₃ 晶界的耦合成分和结构相空间。由此产生的化学势相图确定了属于四个基序家族的十个稳定结构：大型 Sr 风筝、小型 Sr 风筝、不完整的 Sr 大风筝和富钛结构。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 钙钛矿的晶界表现出丰富的电子、极性和磁性特性，但识别其原子结构和成分仍然具有挑战性。在这里，我们将大正则蒙特卡罗（GCMC）方法与通用机器学习原子间势相结合，探索 Σ5(310)[001] SrTiO₃ 晶界的耦合成分和结构相空间。由此产生的化学势相图确定了属于四个基序家族的十个稳定结构：大型 Sr 风筝、小型 Sr 风筝、不完整的 Sr 大风筝和富钛结构。将 GCMC 方法扩展到 Sigma5(210)[001] 和 Sigma17(410)[001] 晶界，揭示了晶界平面和倾角如何影响小型和大型风筝图案之间的竞争。预测的 Sigma5(310)[001] 晶界的密度泛函理论计算表明，成分和原子结构强烈控制导带和价带边缘态的空间分布、界面带排列和载流子局域化。出现了四种不同的电子状态：局域电子掺杂态、离域电子掺杂态、绝缘态和空穴吸引态。我们的静电学分析揭示了与局部原子密度和键合相关的重建 GB 核心的短程电场以及由空间电荷产生的核心外部的较长程场的共存。这些场还可以耦合到局部极性畸变并生成与成分相关的偏振图案。这些结果为探索氧化物钙钛矿晶界结构建立了一个有效的框架，并揭示了化学计量和原子重构如何与电子结构、静电和局部极化耦合，为功能钙钛矿的预测晶界工程提供了一条途径。

articles.title: Electrostatic and Quantum Transport Engineering of Multilayer Ferroelectric Tunnel Junctions for Improved TER and RA Trade off
articles.title_zh: 用于改进 TER 和 RA 权衡的多层铁电隧道结的静电和量子传输工程
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.24103v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Ferroelectric tunnel junctions (FTJs) are promising for non-volatile memory and neuromorphic computing, but achieving a high tunnel electroresistance ratio (TER) with a low resistance-area (RA) product remains challenging. In this work, TiN/Hf₀.₅Zr₀.₅O₂ (HZO)-based FTJs containing zero to three TiO₂ and IGZO-based quantum wells (QWs) are analyzed using the Miller ferroelectric (FE) polarization model integrated with the non-equilibrium Green's function (NEGF) formalism to examine the effects of QW material and thickness on polarization and transport. TiO₂-based structures exhibit higher polarization and TER than IGZO-based structures. At a read bias of 0.1 V, the uniform TiO₂ double-QW structure, with 1-nm-thick QW and insulating layer (IL) layers, gives a TER of 2.71×10¹⁰% and an RA product of 5×10⁴~Ωcdotcm², compared with 5.95×10⁷% and 2×10⁵~Ωcdotcm², respectively, for IGZO. Both uniform and non-uniform TiO₂ double-QW structures exhibit resonant tunneling (RT) and negative differential resistance (NDR) associated with QW-confined states. Increasing the first QW thickness to 1.38 nm, while keeping the second QW and both IL layers at 1 nm, shifts the confined-state energies and modifies resonant transport. The selected non-uniform structure achieves a TER of 2.95×10¹¹% and an RA product of 1.25×10³~Ωcdotcm² at a read bias of 0.1 V. Elastic scattering changes the amplitude and width of QW resonant-transmission peaks, with a stronger effect on the low resistance state (LRS) than on the high resistance state (HRS). These results show that QW material and thickness optimization can improve the TER--RA trade-off, while electrode screening and elastic scattering further influence polarization-dependent transport in multilayer FTJs.
articles.abstract_zh: 铁电隧道结 (FTJ) 在非易失性存储器和神经形态计算方面很有前景，但利用低电阻面积 (RA) 产品实现高隧道电阻比 (TER) 仍然具有挑战性。在这项工作中，使用与非平衡格林函数 (NEGF) 形式相结合的米勒铁电 (FE) 极化模型分析了包含零到三个 TiO2 的基于 TiN/Hf₀.₅Zr₀.₅O2 (HZO) 的 FTJ 和基于 IGZO 的量子阱 (QW)，以检查 QW 材料和厚度对极化和传输的影响。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 铁电隧道结 (FTJ) 在非易失性存储器和神经形态计算方面很有前景，但利用低电阻面积 (RA) 产品实现高隧道电阻比 (TER) 仍然具有挑战性。在这项工作中，使用与非平衡格林函数 (NEGF) 形式相结合的米勒铁电 (FE) 极化模型分析了包含零到三个 TiO2 的基于 TiN/Hf₀.₅Zr₀.₅O2 (HZO) 的 FTJ 和基于 IGZO 的量子阱 (QW)，以检查 QW 材料和厚度对极化和传输的影响。 TiO2 基结构比 IGZO 基结构表现出更高的极化率和 TER。在 0.1 V 的读取偏压下，具有 1 nm 厚 QW 和绝缘层 (IL) 层的均匀 TiO2 双 QW 结构的 TER 为 2.71×10¹⁰%，RA 乘积为 5×10⁴~Ωcdotcm2，而 IGZO 的 RA 乘积分别为 5.95×10^% 和 2×105~Ωcdotcm²。均匀和非均匀 TiO2 双 QW 结构均表现出与 QW 限制态相关的谐振隧道 (RT) 和负微分电阻 (NDR)。将第一个 QW 厚度增加到 1.38 nm，同时将第二个 QW 和两个 IL 层保持在 1 nm，从而改变约束态能量并修改谐振传输。所选择的非均匀结构在0.1 V的读取偏置下实现了2.95×10¹%的TER和1.25×10^Ωcdotcm^的RA乘积。弹性散射改变了QW谐振传输峰的幅度和宽度，对低电阻状态（LRS）的影响比对高电阻状态（HRS）的影响更强。这些结果表明，QW 材料和厚度优化可以改善 TER--RA 权衡，而电极屏蔽和弹性散射进一步影响多层 FTJ 中的偏振相关传输。

articles.title: Rabi-Engineered spin-selective transport of bright soliton in a binary spin-1/2 condensate
articles.title_zh: Rabi 设计的二元自旋 1/2 凝聚态中亮孤子的自旋选择性传输
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.24112v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Spintronics is usually concentrated on spin-dependent dynamics of single particles such as electrons or holes in solids. Extending this concept to nonlinear matter waves offers an interesting possibility of controlling the transport of collective, particle-like excitations through their spin degrees of freedom. Recent advances in Bose-Einstein condensates have provided a versatile platform for realizing nonlinear spin-1/2 systems that support particle-like objects such as bright solitons, making studies of the motion of these solitons under external fields an interesting and important problem. Here, we study the dynamics of bright solitons with different spin symmetries moving in a coordinate-dependent Rabi field, which acts analogously to a spatially varying magnetic field. In that setup, the velocity perturbed soliton motion possesses very interesting scattering dynamics for both perfect and lifted Manakov symmetry. Lastly, we compare both the velocity-controlled scattering problem with the well-known Rabi quenching protocol. This comparison provides a powerful approach to control the soliton dynamics that may open an avenue to control nonlinear spintronics with solitons as spin carriers.
articles.abstract_zh: 自旋电子学通常专注于单个粒子的自旋相关动力学，例如固体中的电子或空穴。将这一概念扩展到非线性物质波，提供了一种有趣的可能性，即通过自旋自由度控制集体类粒子激发的传输。玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚态的最新进展为实现非线性自旋 1/2 系统提供了一个通用平台，该系统支持亮孤子等粒子状物体，使得研究这些孤子在外部场下的运动成为一个有趣且重要的问题。在这里，我们研究了具有不同自旋对称性的亮孤子在坐标相关的拉比场中移动的动力学，其作用类似于空间变化的磁场。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 自旋电子学通常专注于单个粒子的自旋相关动力学，例如固体中的电子或空穴。将这一概念扩展到非线性物质波，提供了一种有趣的可能性，即通过自旋自由度控制集体类粒子激发的传输。玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚态的最新进展为实现非线性自旋 1/2 系统提供了一个通用平台，该系统支持亮孤子等粒子状物体，使得研究这些孤子在外部场下的运动成为一个有趣且重要的问题。在这里，我们研究了具有不同自旋对称性的亮孤子在坐标相关的拉比场中移动的动力学，其作用类似于空间变化的磁场。在该设置中，速度扰动的孤子运动对于完美对称和提升马纳科夫对称都具有非常有趣的散射动力学。最后，我们将速度控制散射问题与著名的拉比淬火协议进行比较。这种比较提供了一种强大的方法来控制孤子动力学，这可能开辟一条控制以孤子作为自旋载流子的非线性自旋电子学的途径。

articles.title: Properties of [111]-oriented ferroelectric superlattices based on oxides with a perovskite structure
articles.title_zh: 基于钙钛矿结构氧化物的[111]取向铁电超晶格的性能
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.24129v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The ground-state structures of fifteen free-standing [111]-oriented ferroelectric superlattices (SLs) based on perovskite oxides and involving a single-atom substitution---BaTiO₃/SrTiO₃, PbTiO₃/SrTiO₃, PbTiO₃/PbZrO₃, SrZrO₃/SrTiO₃, PbZrO₃/BaZrO₃, BaTiO₃/BaZrO₃, PbTiO₃/BaTiO₃, BaTiO₃/CaTiO₃, KNbO₃/KTaO₃, KNbO₃/NaNbO₃, SrTiO₃/SrHfO₃, BaTiO₃/BaSnO₃, PbTiO₃/CaTiO₃, SrTiO₃/CaTiO₃, and PbZrO₃/SrZrO₃---are calculated from first principles. It is shown that in eleven considered SLs the ground state is ferroelectric. A distinctive feature of the structure of the superlattices is that both the ferroelectric distortions and the distortions associated with octahedral rotations are described by phonons at the Γ~point of the Brillouin zone. The importance of taking into account structural distortions associated with octahedral rotations, which in some cases lead to significant changes in the ferroelectric properties of SLs, is demonstrated.
