The thermodynamic stability of superlattices grown in the [111] and [100] directions is compared. An analysis of the force constants of the superlattices helps to explain the peculiarities of the ferroelectric properties of the superlattices and the corresponding solid solutions.
articles.abstract_zh: 基于钙钛矿氧化物并涉及单原子取代的十五种独立的[111]取向铁电超晶格（SL）的基态结构——BaTiO₃/SrTiO₃，PbTiO₃/SrTiO₃，PbTiO₃/PbZrO₃，SrZrO₃/SrTiO₃， PbZrO₃/BaZrO₃、BaTiO₃/BaZrO₃、PbTiO₃/BaTiO₃、BaTiO₃/CaTiO₃、KNbO₃/KTaO₃、KNbO₃/NaNbO₃、SrTiO₃/SrHfO₃、BaTiO₃/BaSnO₃、 PbTiO₃/CaTiO₃、SrTiO₃/CaTiO₃…
articles.abstract_zh_full: 基于钙钛矿氧化物并涉及单原子取代的十五种独立的[111]取向铁电超晶格（SL）的基态结构——BaTiO₃/SrTiO₃，PbTiO₃/SrTiO₃，PbTiO₃/PbZrO₃，SrZrO₃/SrTiO₃， PbZrO₃/BaZrO₃、BaTiO₃/BaZrO₃、PbTiO₃/BaTiO₃、BaTiO₃/CaTiO₃、KNbO₃/KTaO₃、KNbO₃/NaNbO₃、SrTiO₃/SrHfO₃、BaTiO₃/BaSnO₃、 PbTiO₃/CaTiO₃、SrTiO₃/CaTiO₃和PbZrO₃/SrZrO₃---根据第一原理计算。结果表明，在十一个考虑的 SL 中，基态是铁电的。超晶格结构的一个显着特征是铁电畸变和与八面体旋转相关的畸变均由布里渊区 Γ~点处的声子描述。论证了考虑与八面体旋转相关的结构扭曲的重要性，在某些情况下，八面体旋转会导致 SL 铁电特性的显着变化。比较了在[111]和[100]方向生长的超晶格的热力学稳定性。对超晶格力常数的分析有助于解释超晶格和相应固溶体的铁电性质的特性。

articles.title: A Universal Diffusion Model for the Quantum Position Operator
articles.title_zh: 量子位置算子的通用扩散模型
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.24130v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The quantum position operator and its response to perturbations underpin the functional properties of insulating materials. In the modern theory of polarization, Wannier charge centres encode Berry-phase polarization, while their structural derivatives determine key response functions. Here we introduce a universal diffusion model based on E(3)-equivariant graph neural networks for moments of the position operator, with the first moment defining Wannier centres and the second central moment their real-space localization. We demonstrate the framework for liquid water, amorphous silicon and crystalline BaTiO₃, and train a universal model that generalizes to 100 unseen crystals spanning a 67-species chemical space. The predicted centres reproduce infrared spectra in large liquid and amorphous cells beyond routine first-principles reach and enable finite-difference calculations of Born effective charges and piezoelectric tensors. This framework provides a scalable route to electronic polarization and localization in complex materials, supporting high-throughput screening and finite-temperature simulations.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子位置算子及其对扰动的响应支撑着绝缘材料的功能特性。在现代极化理论中，万尼尔电荷中心编码贝里相极化，而它们的结构导数决定了关键的响应函数。在这里，我们介绍了一种基于 E(3) 等变图神经网络的位置算子矩的通用扩散模型，其中第一个矩定义了 Wannier 中心，第二个中心矩定义了它们的真实空间定位。我们展示了液态水、非晶硅和晶体 BaTiO₃ 的框架，并训练了一个通用模型，该模型可推广到跨越 67 种化学空间的 100 种看不见的晶体。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 量子位置算子及其对扰动的响应支撑着绝缘材料的功能特性。在现代极化理论中，万尼尔电荷中心编码贝里相极化，而它们的结构导数决定了关键的响应函数。在这里，我们介绍了一种基于 E(3) 等变图神经网络的位置算子矩的通用扩散模型，其中第一个矩定义了 Wannier 中心，第二个中心矩定义了它们的真实空间定位。我们展示了液态水、非晶硅和晶体 BaTiO₃ 的框架，并训练了一个通用模型，该模型可推广到跨越 67 种化学空间的 100 种看不见的晶体。预测的中心在大型液体和非晶电池中再现了超出常规第一原理所能达到的红外光谱，并能够对玻恩有效电荷和压电张量进行有限差分计算。该框架提供了复杂材料中电子极化和定位的可扩展途径，支持高通量筛选和有限温度模拟。

articles.title: Non-Abelian Hall Effects of Flavor-Waves in CP² Skyrmions
articles.title_zh: CP² 斯格明子中风味波的非阿贝尔霍尔效应
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.24134v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We investigate the collective excitations of isolated and crystalline CP² skyrmions in a two-dimensional triangular-lattice spin-1 magnet. Within an SU(3) coherent-state framework, fluctuations of the magnetic dipole and quadrupole moments are described by two coupled bosonic flavors. In a uniform spin-polarized state, these flavors can be identified with single-spin-flip and double-spin-flip excitations, whereas a nonuniform CP² texture mixes their character. We formulate the corresponding bosonic Bogoliubov--de Gennes problem and examine the matrix-valued gauge connection governing flavor-wave propagation. For isolated skyrmions, the calculated spectrum contains localized modes, and the scattering dynamics exhibit transverse deflection accompanied by isospin precession. For a numerically relaxed skyrmion crystal, we obtain collective-mode bands with nonzero Chern numbers and calculate the associated thermal Hall response. These findings illustrate how projective magnetic textures couple multipolar excitations to non-Abelian transport and topological band phenomena.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们研究了二维三角晶格自旋 1 磁体中孤立和晶体 CP² 斯格明子的集体激发。在 SU(3) 相干态框架内，磁偶极子和四极矩的波动由两个耦合的玻色子风味来描述。在均匀的自旋极化状态下，这些味道可以通过单自旋翻转和双自旋翻转激发来识别，而不均匀的 CP² 纹理混合了它们的特性。我们制定了相应的玻色子 Bogoliubov-de Gennes 问题，并检查了控制味道波传播的矩阵值规范连接。对于孤立的斯格明子，计算的光谱包含局域模式，并且散射动力学表现出伴随同位旋进动的横向偏转。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们研究了二维三角晶格自旋 1 磁体中孤立和晶体 CP² 斯格明子的集体激发。在 SU(3) 相干态框架内，磁偶极子和四极矩的波动由两个耦合的玻色子风味来描述。在均匀的自旋极化状态下，这些味道可以通过单自旋翻转和双自旋翻转激发来识别，而不均匀的 CP² 纹理混合了它们的特性。我们制定了相应的玻色子 Bogoliubov-de Gennes 问题，并检查了控制味道波传播的矩阵值规范连接。对于孤立的斯格明子，计算的光谱包含局域模式，并且散射动力学表现出伴随同位旋进动的横向偏转。对于数值松弛的斯格明子晶体，我们获得具有非零陈数的集体模带并计算相关的热霍尔响应。这些发现说明了投影磁纹理如何将多极激励与非阿贝尔输运和拓扑带现象耦合起来。

articles.title: Machine learning interatomic potentials and orientational defects in polymers
articles.title_zh: 机器学习聚合物中的原子间势和取向缺陷
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.24148v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Photopolymerization of acrylated epoxidized soybean oil (AESO) is a convenient model of a self-organizing process in a soft, bio-based material: ultraviolet light starts a free-radical chain reaction, the growing network releases heat, and the mobility of molecular groups changes on several time scales at once. We follow this process from two sides. Experimentally, the real and imaginary parts of the dielectric permittivity of an AESO:VDM (1:0.5) mixture with 3 mol% of the photoinitiator DMPA were recorded at 500-5000 Hz under an intermittent on/off illumination protocol, and the resulting time series were analysed with a sliding-window Shannon entropy and the Grassberger-Procaccia correlation integral. Both measures show that short light pulses at the start of curing trigger strongly correlated, collective relaxation, which fades as the network forms, leaving only localized reorientations active. We describe these reorientations as orientational defects and quantify their energetics with the MACE-OFF23 machine learning interatomic potential, using relaxed dihedral scans of five rotational modes (α, α/β, β, γ, δ) of an AESO fragment. Compared with density functional theory (DFT) reference profiles, MACE reproduces the shape of all five profiles (Pearson r=0.95-0.98) and the hierarchy of barriers - from 2.9 eV for the constrained main-chain rotation, through 0.54-0.81 eV for the acrylate rotations, to 0.16-0.18 eV for the methyl and 0.06 eV for the hydroxyl rotation - while underestimating the barrier heights by 3-20%. A simple Arrhenius estimate shows that the acrylate rotations are the modes closest to the frequency window of the dielectric measurement.
articles.abstract_zh: 丙烯酸酯环氧化大豆油 (AESO) 的光聚合是一种柔软的生物基材料中自组织过程的便捷模型：紫外线引发自由基链式反应，不断增长的网络释放热量，分子团的迁移率同时在多个时间尺度上发生变化。我们从两个方面跟踪这个过程。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 丙烯酸酯环氧化大豆油 (AESO) 的光聚合是一种柔软的生物基材料中自组织过程的便捷模型：紫外线引发自由基链式反应，不断增长的网络释放热量，分子团的迁移率同时在多个时间尺度上发生变化。我们从两个方面跟踪这个过程。实验上，在间歇开/关照明方案下，以 500-5000 Hz 的频率记录了含有 3 mol% 光引发剂 DMPA 的 AESO:VDM (1:0.5) 混合物的介电常数的实部和虚部，并使用滑动窗口香农熵和 Grassberger-Procaccia 相关积分对所得时间序列进行了分析。这两项测量都表明，固化开始时的短光脉冲会触发强相关的集体松弛，这种松弛会随着网络的形成而消失，只留下局部重新定向活跃。我们将这些重新定向描述为定向缺陷，并使用 AESO 片段的五种旋转模式（α、α/β、β、γ、δ）的松弛二面角扫描，通过 MACE-OFF23 机器学习原子间势来量化其能量。与密度泛函理论 (DFT) 参考剖面相比，MACE 再现了所有五个剖面的形状 (Pearson r=0.95-0.98) 和势垒层次 - 从受约束主链旋转的 2.9 eV，通过丙烯酸酯旋转的 0.54-0.81 eV，到甲基的 0.16-0.18 eV 和羟基旋转的 0.06 eV - 同时低估了势垒高度提高 3-20%。简单的阿伦尼乌斯估计表明，丙烯酸酯旋转是最接近介电测量频率窗口的模式。

articles.title: Conformal defects in a quasi-one-dimensional Kitaev chain: an exactly parametrized Ising defect line and a relevant vacancy
articles.title_zh: 准一维 Kitaev 链中的共形缺陷：精确参数化的 Ising 缺陷线和相关空位
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.24312v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The quasi-one-dimensional Kitaev chain of coupled hexagonal plaquettes recently introduced by Majumder is exactly solvable in terms of free Majorana fermions and undergoes a topological transition at the exchange anisotropy Jₓ=sqrt2,J. By eliminating the two-coordinated sites of each plaquette we reduce the zero-energy problem to a uniform Majorana chain, which yields the critical point, a single Majorana cone at k=0 (hence an Ising critical point with central charge c=tfrac12), and closed forms for every defect quantity that follows. A weakened inter-plaquette bond λ Jₓ is an exactly marginal defect with transmission T=4λ²/(1+λ²)² at low energy, that is, T=sin² 2φ with tanφ=λ: the bond traverses the ferromagnetic defect line of the Ising conformal field theory from the transparent point to the cut chain, and we give its exact energy dependence on the lattice. The intra-plaquette bonds land on the same line with different parametrizations: a y or z bond has tanφ=(1+λ)/2 and covers only Tin[0.64,1], because the plaquette provides a parallel path, whereas an x bond has tanφ=(1+λ)/2λ and covers the strong-link half of the line, φin(π/4,π/2). The identification is closed by an independent observable: the coefficient of ln L in the entanglement entropy across the defect follows the conformal-field-theory function σ(sqrt T)/2 of Brehm and Brunner to within 0.4% along the whole line, with no adjustable parameter. A vacancy behaves in the opposite way. It never binds a plaquette flux, because plaquettes share no sites, but it leaves its singly bonded neighbor as a conserved classical spin whose dangling Majorana is a zero-energy resonance.
articles.abstract_zh: Majumder 最近提出的准一维 Kitaev 链耦合六边形斑块完全可解为自由马约拉纳费米子，并在交换各向异性 Jₓ=sqrt2,J 处经历拓扑转变。通过消除每个斑块的两个配位位点，我们将零能量问题简化为均匀的马约拉纳链，从而产生临界点，即 k=0 处的单个马约拉纳锥体（因此具有中心电荷 c=tfrac12 的伊辛临界点），以及随后的每个缺陷量的闭合形式。
authors: R. L. Silva. R. C. Silva
articles.abstract_zh_full: Majumder 最近提出的准一维 Kitaev 链耦合六边形斑块完全可解为自由马约拉纳费米子，并在交换各向异性 Jₓ=sqrt2,J 处经历拓扑转变。通过消除每个斑块的两个配位位点，我们将零能量问题简化为均匀的马约拉纳链，从而产生临界点，即 k=0 处的单个马约拉纳锥体（因此具有中心电荷 c=tfrac12 的伊辛临界点），以及随后的每个缺陷量的闭合形式。弱化的板间键 λ Jₓ 是一个精确的边缘缺陷，在低能量下具有透射 T=4λ²/(1+λ²)²，即 T=sin² 2φ 且 tanφ=λ：该键从透明点到切割链穿过伊辛共形场理论的铁磁缺陷线，我们给出了其对晶格的精确能量依赖性。板内键落在具有不同参数化的同一条线上：y 或 z 键具有 tanφ=(1+λ)/2 并且仅覆盖 Tin[0.64,1]，因为板提供了平行路径，而 x 键具有 tanφ=(1+λ)/2λ 并且覆盖了线的强连接一半，φin(π/4,π/2)。识别由一个独立的可观测量完成：缺陷上纠缠熵中的 ln L 系数遵循 Brehm 和 Brunner 的共形场理论函数 σ(sqrt T)/2，沿整条线的误差在 0.4% 以内，没有可调整的参数。空缺的表现则相反。它从不结合小片通量，因为小片通量不共享位点，但它留下其单键邻居作为保守的经典自旋，其悬挂的马约拉纳是零能量共振。

articles.title: Spin dynamics in disordered systems with generic spin-momentum couplings: A matrix-rational formulation
articles.title_zh: 具有通用自旋动量耦合的无序系统中的自旋动力学：矩阵有理公式
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.24346v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We develop a microscopic framework for the disorder-averaged density-matrix dynamics of pseudospin-1/2 systems with anisotropic and nonlinear spin-momentum couplings. Starting from the Diffuson, we introduce a matrix-valued rational approximation for its frequency dependence that does not rely on a low-frequency or weak-coupling expansion. The resulting pole equation is recast as a quadratic eigenvalue problem, from which the real-time evolution of the disorder-averaged density matrix is constructed. We apply the formulation to a two-dimensional electron gas with Rashba and linear and cubic Dresselhaus couplings, a d-wave altermagnet with Rashba coupling, and a three-dimensional double-Weyl model. Comparisons with direct numerical simulations demonstrate quantitative agreement for both the post-quench spin dynamics and spin relaxation times across a broad range of coupling strengths, extending beyond the diffusive regime. The matrix-rational formulation provides a unified description of ultrafast spin dynamics and long-time relaxation.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们开发了一个微观框架，用于具有各向异性和非线性自旋动量耦合的赝自旋 1/2 系统的无序平均密度矩阵动力学。从扩散子开始，我们引入了一种矩阵值有理近似来描述其频率依赖性，该近似不依赖于低频或弱耦合扩展。由此产生的极方程被改写为二次特征值问题，从中构造无序平均密度矩阵的实时演化。我们将该公式应用于具有 Rashba 和线性和立方 Dresselhaus 耦合的二维电子气、具有 Rashba 耦合的 d 波交流磁体以及三维双 Weyl 模型。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们开发了一个微观框架，用于具有各向异性和非线性自旋动量耦合的赝自旋 1/2 系统的无序平均密度矩阵动力学。从扩散子开始，我们引入了一种矩阵值有理近似来描述其频率依赖性，该近似不依赖于低频或弱耦合扩展。由此产生的极方程被改写为二次特征值问题，从中构造无序平均密度矩阵的实时演化。我们将该公式应用于具有 Rashba 和线性和立方 Dresselhaus 耦合的二维电子气、具有 Rashba 耦合的 d 波交流磁体以及三维双 Weyl 模型。与直接数值模拟的比较表明，在广泛的耦合强度范围内，淬火后自旋动力学和自旋弛豫时间都具有定量一致性，超出了扩散范围。矩阵有理公式提供了超快自旋动力学和长时间弛豫的统一描述。

articles.title: Hidden topological signatures in a van der Waals ferromagnet revealed by spin-resolved circular-dichroic photoemission
articles.title_zh: 自旋分辨圆二向色光发射揭示了范德华铁磁体中隐藏的拓扑特征
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.24468v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Layered ferromagnets with strongly correlated electrons provide a platform for exploring the interplay among magnetism, spin-orbit coupling, and nontrivial band topology. Ni₁/₄TaSe₂ is a correlated van der Waals ferromagnet with a transition temperature of 58 K that lies close in composition to a superconducting phase that emerges upon Ni depletion. Here, we combine spin- and angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy, circular-dichroism measurements, and density functional theory calculations to investigate its spin-resolved electronic structure. We observe spin-polarized states crossing the Fermi level and signatures of broken time-reversal symmetry in the ferromagnetic state. Spin-resolved circular-dichroism measurements further reveal a helicity-dependent spin response consistent with a finite spin Berry curvature and suggestive of local topological character. Together, these results establish an experimental connection between ferromagnetism, spin-polarized electronic states, and topological signatures in Ni₁/₄TaSe₂, providing a foundation for investigating how these properties may relate to the emergence of superconductivity upon Ni depletion.
articles.abstract_zh: 具有强相关电子的层状铁磁体为探索磁性、自旋轨道耦合和非平凡能带拓扑之间的相互作用提供了一个平台。 Ni₁/4TaSe2 是相关范德华铁磁体，转变温度为 58 K，其成分与 Ni 耗尽时出现的超导相接近。在这里，我们结合自旋和角分辨光电子能谱、圆二色性测量和密度泛函理论计算来研究其自旋分辨电子结构。我们观察到跨越费米能级的自旋极化态以及铁磁态中时间反转对称性破缺的特征。自旋分辨圆二色性测量进一步揭示了与有限自旋贝里曲率一致的螺旋度相关的自旋响应，并暗示了局部拓扑特征。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 具有强相关电子的层状铁磁体为探索磁性、自旋轨道耦合和非平凡能带拓扑之间的相互作用提供了一个平台。 Ni₁/4TaSe2 是相关范德华铁磁体，转变温度为 58 K，其成分与 Ni 耗尽时出现的超导相接近。在这里，我们结合自旋和角分辨光电子能谱、圆二色性测量和密度泛函理论计算来研究其自旋分辨电子结构。我们观察到跨越费米能级的自旋极化态以及铁磁态中时间反转对称性破缺的特征。自旋分辨圆二色性测量进一步揭示了与有限自旋贝里曲率一致的螺旋度相关的自旋响应，并暗示了局部拓扑特征。总之，这些结果在 Ni₁/₄TaSe2 中的铁磁性、自旋极化电子态和拓扑特征之间建立了实验联系，为研究这些特性与 Ni 耗尽时超导性的出现之间的关系奠定了基础。

articles.title: Compositional Mapping of Martensitic and Magnetic Transitions in Ni-Fe-Ga Bulk Alloys and Microwires
articles.title_zh: Ni-Fe-Ga 块体合金和微丝中马氏体和磁转变的成分映射
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.24503v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Despite extensive research on Ni-Fe-Ga magnetic shape-memory alloys, the compositional dependence of their martensitic and magnetic transition temperatures remains unclear. We analyze published bulk-alloy data alongside two complementary microwire series. While the pooled data show no unique dependence on e/a, elemental-concentration analysis reveals that Ni and Fe are the primary compositional controls of Mₛ and T_c, respectively, within 26-28 at.% Ga: Mₛ = 43.6 c_Ni - 2079 K and T_c = 17.4 c_Fe - 30 K. At fixed Ga, this creates a trade-off: raising Mₛ generally lowers T_c and vice versa, making it difficult to keep both above room temperature. Around 25 at.% Ga, bulk data exhibit considerable scatter, partly attributable to gamma-phase formation. Glass-coated microwires produced by the Taylor-Ulitovsky method, in which the gamma phase has generally not been reported, extend the accessible composition range toward lower Ga contents. The Ni(73-x)Fe(x)Ga27 (x = 18-22) series and the Ga-rich Ni50Fe21Ga29 and Ni50Fe23Ga27 microwires broadly follow the corresponding bulk trends. Remarkably, Ni50Fe25Ga25 and Ni50Fe27Ga23 microwires depart sharply from these trends, combining Mₛ at or above room temperature with T_c > 395 K. Their functional potential is demonstrated by approximately 10% reversible strain in Ni50Fe27Ga23 microwire during thermal cycling under constant tensile stresses up to 200 MPa.
articles.abstract_zh: 尽管对 Ni-Fe-Ga 磁性形状记忆合金进行了广泛的研究，但其马氏体和磁转变温度的成分依赖性仍不清楚。我们分析已发布的散装合金数据以及两个互补的微丝系列。虽然汇总数据显示对 e/a 没有唯一的依赖性，但元素浓度分析表明 Ni 和 Fe 分别是 Mₛ 和 T_c 的主要成分控制，在 26-28 at.% Ga 范围内：Mₛ = 43.6 c_Ni - 2079 K 和 T_c = 17.4 c_Fe - 30 K。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 尽管对 Ni-Fe-Ga 磁性形状记忆合金进行了广泛的研究，但其马氏体和磁转变温度的成分依赖性仍不清楚。我们分析已发布的散装合金数据以及两个互补的微丝系列。虽然汇总数据显示对 e/a 没有唯一的依赖性，但元素浓度分析表明 Ni 和 Fe 分别是 Mₛ 和 T_c 的主要成分控制，在 26-28 at.% Ga 范围内：Mₛ = 43.6 c_Ni - 2079 K 和 T_c = 17.4 c_Fe - 30 K。在固定 Ga 下，这会产生一个权衡：提高 Mₛ 通常会降低 T_c反之亦然，因此很难将两者保持在室温以上。大约 25 at.% Ga 时，大量数据表现出相当大的分散性，部分归因于伽玛相的形成。采用 Taylor-Ulitovsky 方法生产的玻璃涂层微丝（其中伽玛相通常没有被报道）将可接近的成分范围扩展到更低的 Ga 含量。 Ni(73-x)Fe(x)Ga27 (x = 18-22) 系列和富 Ga Ni50Fe21Ga29 和 Ni50Fe23Ga27 微丝大致遵循相应的整体趋势。值得注意的是，Ni50Fe25Ga25 和 Ni50Fe27Ga23 微丝与这些趋势截然不同，它们将室温或高于室温的 Mₛ 与 T_c > 395 K 相结合。在高达 200 MPa 的恒定拉伸应力的热循环过程中，Ni50Fe27Ga23 微丝中约 10% 的可逆应变证明了它们的功能潜力。

articles.title: Machine-learned potentials for iron oxides at extreme conditions
articles.title_zh: 极端条件下氧化铁的机器学习潜力
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.24525v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Reliable phase stability requires accurate relative free energies, which small force errors alone do not guarantee. We develop atomic-cluster-expansion potentials for five iron oxides from Fe₂O to Fe₂O₃, covering crystalline and liquid states at 140--260,GPa and 1000--11000,K, with electronic and ionic temperatures matched. Force-dominated training leaves systematic energy offsets between structure families of up to 41,meV/atom that persist despite additional training data. Stronger energy weighting and weaker regularization largely remove these offsets, while converged k-point sampling prevents further composition-dependent biases. The final potentials achieve held-out energy errors of 2.0--5.5,meV/atom and first-order free-energy errors within 3.4,meV/atom for liquids at 5000--9000,K. However, an untrained NiAs-type FeO phase exhibits a free-energy error of 57,meV/atom despite a low extrapolation grade. These results show that reliable phase-diagram calculations require control of relative energy offsets and explicit free-energy validation of every competing phase.
articles.abstract_zh: 可靠的相位稳定性需要精确的相对自由能，仅靠较小的力误差并不能保证这一点。我们开发了从 Fe2O 到 Fe2O₃ 的五种铁氧化物的原子团膨胀势，涵盖 140--260 GPa 和 1000--11000 K 下的晶态和液态，电子和离子温度匹配。力主导的训练在结构族之间留下高达 41,meV/原子的系统能量偏移，尽管有额外的训练数据，但这种能量偏移仍然存在。更强的能量加权和更弱的正则化在很大程度上消除了这些偏移，而收敛的 k 点采样可以防止进一步的与成分相关的偏差。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 可靠的相位稳定性需要精确的相对自由能，仅靠较小的力误差并不能保证这一点。我们开发了从 Fe2O 到 Fe2O₃ 的五种铁氧化物的原子团膨胀势，涵盖 140--260 GPa 和 1000--11000 K 下的晶态和液态，电子和离子温度匹配。力主导的训练在结构族之间留下高达 41,meV/原子的系统能量偏移，尽管有额外的训练数据，但这种能量偏移仍然存在。更强的能量加权和更弱的正则化在很大程度上消除了这些偏移，而收敛的 k 点采样可以防止进一步的与成分相关的偏差。对于 5000--9000,K 的液体，最终电势实现了 2.0--5.5,meV/atom 的保留能量误差和 3.4,meV/atom 以内的一阶自由能误差。然而，尽管外推等级较低，但未经训练的 NiAs 型 FeO 相仍表现出 57,meV/原子的自由能误差。这些结果表明，可靠的相图计算需要控制相对能量偏移并对每个竞争相进行明确的自由能验证。

articles.title: Orientation-Tunable Interfacial Thermal Conductance in Lateral MoSe2/MoS2 Heterostructures: A Deep Potential Molecular Dynamics Study
articles.title_zh: 横向 MoSe2/MoS2 异质结构中方向可调的界面热导：深势分子动力学研究
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.24547v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Managing heat flow across interfaces in lateral 2D transition-metal dichalcogenide (TMD) heterostructures is a key challenge for next-generation nanoelectronic and optoelectronic devices. To tackle this, we trained a deep learning interatomic potential (DLP) using DeePMD-kit on density functional theory (DFT) data, then paired it with non-equilibrium molecular dynamics (NEMD) simulations to study interfacial thermal conductance (ITC) in lateral MoSe₂/MoS₂ heterostructures, considering both armchair and zigzag interface orientations. The potential we trained closely matches DFT energies, forces, and phonon dispersion relations, which confirms its reliability for thermal transport simulations. Examining cell lengths from 10 to 40 nm and extrapolating to infinite length, the armchair interface shows a higher ITC (473 MW/m²K) than the zigzag interface (387 MW/m²K), and the armchair interface remains higher at every length considered. Both increase further as temperature rises. At 300 K, the vibrational density of states shows greater phonon spectral overlap at the armchair interface than at the zigzag interface. Together, these results offer a solid machine-learning framework for studying heat transport in lateral TMD heterostructures, and identify interface orientation as an effective means of controlling heat dissipation at these junctions.
articles.abstract_zh: 管理横向二维过渡金属二硫属化物 (TMD) 异质结构中界面的热流是下一代纳米电子和光电器件的关键挑战。为了解决这个问题，我们使用 DeePMD-kit 在密度泛函理论 (DFT) 数据上训练了深度学习原子间势 (DLP)，然后将其与非平衡分子动力学 (NEMD) 模拟配对，以研究横向 MoSe2/MoS2 异质结构中的界面热导 (ITC)，同时考虑扶手椅和锯齿形界面方向。我们训练的势与 DFT 能量、力和声子色散关系密切匹配，这证实了其热传输模拟的可靠性。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 管理横向二维过渡金属二硫属化物 (TMD) 异质结构中界面的热流是下一代纳米电子和光电器件的关键挑战。为了解决这个问题，我们使用 DeePMD-kit 在密度泛函理论 (DFT) 数据上训练了深度学习原子间势 (DLP)，然后将其与非平衡分子动力学 (NEMD) 模拟配对，以研究横向 MoSe2/MoS2 异质结构中的界面热导 (ITC)，同时考虑扶手椅和锯齿形界面方向。我们训练的势与 DFT 能量、力和声子色散关系密切匹配，这证实了其热传输模拟的可靠性。检查从 10 到 40 nm 的电池长度并推断到无限长度，扶手椅界面显示出比之字形界面 (387 MW/m²K) 更高的 ITC (473 MW/m²K)，并且扶手椅界面在考虑的每个长度上都保持较高。随着温度升高，两者都会进一步增加。在 300 K 时，状态的振动密度在扶手椅界面处显示出比锯齿形界面处更大的声子谱重叠。总之，这些结果为研究横向 TMD 异质结构中的热传输提供了坚实的机器学习框架，并将界面方向确定为控制这些结处散热的有效手段。

articles.title: Unified Theory for Momentum-Space Nonsymmorphic Symmetry of Spin Space Groups
articles.title_zh: 自旋空间群动量空间非对称性的统一理论
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.24629v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Projective crystal symmetry provides a route to nonsymmorphic symmetry structures in momentum space, but a general theory for their realization in spin space groups has been lacking. We show that a nonsymmorphic momentum-space action is possible only when the unitary translation subgroup is combined with rotations about a common axis for a coplanar or noncoplanar spin space group of spin-1/2 systems. Its factor system originates entirely from the double cover Spin(2)→ SO(2), yielding a general formula for the fractional reciprocal-lattice translations and hence for the point-group action on the Brillouin zone. We further prove that a momentum-space nonsymmorphic group is realizable by a spin space group if and only if its Brillouin-zone action contains a two-point orbit. Consequently, 842 of the 1,357 nonsymmorphic magnetic space groups are realizable by spin space groups. Applying this theory, we construct a database covering all 67,475 SSGs that can be queried bidirectionally: from an SSG to its momentum-space magnetic group, or from a given momentum-space magnetic group to all SSGs that realize it. Together, these results establish the momentum-space symmetry foundation for a systematic band theory of SSGs in spin-1/2 systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 射影晶体对称性为动量空间中的非对称对称结构提供了一条途径，但一直缺乏在自旋空间群中实现非对称对称结构的一般理论。我们表明，只有当酉平移子群与自旋 1/2 系统的共面或非共面自旋空间群绕公共轴的旋转相结合时，非对称动量空间作用才有可能。它的因子系统完全源自双覆盖 Spin(2)→ SO(2)，产生分数互易晶格平移的通用公式，从而产生布里渊区上的点群作用。我们进一步证明，当且仅当其布里渊区作用包含两点轨道时，动量空间非对称群可以通过自旋空间群实现。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 射影晶体对称性为动量空间中的非对称对称结构提供了一条途径，但一直缺乏在自旋空间群中实现非对称对称结构的一般理论。我们表明，只有当酉平移子群与自旋 1/2 系统的共面或非共面自旋空间群绕公共轴的旋转相结合时，非对称动量空间作用才有可能。它的因子系统完全源自双覆盖 Spin(2)→ SO(2)，产生分数互易晶格平移的通用公式，从而产生布里渊区上的点群作用。我们进一步证明，当且仅当其布里渊区作用包含两点轨道时，动量空间非对称群可以通过自旋空间群实现。因此，1,357 个非对称磁空间群中的 842 个可以通过自旋空间群来实现。应用这一理论，我们构建了一个涵盖所有 67,475 个 SSG 的数据库，这些 SSG 可以双向查询：从 SSG 到其动量空间磁组，或从给定的动量空间磁组到实现它的所有 SSG。这些结果共同为自旋 1/2 系统中 SSG 的系统能带理论奠定了动量空间对称性基础。

articles.title: The Long and Winding Pore: Tuning Porosity in Templated Nanoporous Carbons
articles.title_zh: 漫长而曲折的孔隙：调控模板化纳米多孔碳的孔隙度
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.24707v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Disordered materials pose a recurring challenge for molecular simulation: realistic structural models are often generated through thermal protocols in which several structural descriptors emerge simultaneously and cannot easily be varied independently. Nanoporous carbons constitute a particularly relevant example: pore size, wall order, curvature, and network tortuosity generally emerge as outcomes of the thermal preparation protocol, rather than being independently prescribed structural parameters. Moreover, for practical applications, models of porous materials should ideally exhibit a percolating pore network, capable of supporting end-to-end transport of adsorbed species through the material. To this end, here we introduce a hierarchy of templating strategies, built around a common melt-quench-anneal protocol driven by a machine-learned interatomic potential for carbon, that progressively separates these variables. A rigid cylindrical template interacting with the environment through a tunable Lennard-Jones potential provides independent control over pore size and local wall organization, while leaving the structural disorder of the surrounding carbon matrix essentially unchanged. Generalizing the template to a spring-connected, tortuous backbone further allows pore geometry and curvature to be prescribed without qualitatively altering the local templating mechanism established for the straight pore. Finally, making the template mobile lets the growing carbon network reshape it in turn, which sharpens pore boundaries and allows sub-nanometer pore sizes to be targeted precisely, as needed for applications such as supercapacitor electrodes. Ultimately, this approach enables systematic studies of structure-property relationships in porous materials for applications such as energy storage, desalination and gas capture.
articles.abstract_zh: 无序材料对分子模拟提出了反复出现的挑战：真实的结构模型通常是通过热协议生成的，其中多个结构描述符同时出现，并且不能轻易地独立变化。纳米多孔碳构成了一个特别相关的例子：孔径、壁序、曲率和网络弯曲度通常作为热制备方案的结果出现，而不是独立规定的结构参数。此外，对于实际应用，多孔材料模型应该理想地表现出渗透孔网络，能够支持吸附物质通过材料的端到端传输。为此，我们在这里引入了模板策略的层次结构，该策略围绕由机器学习的碳原子间势驱动的通用熔化淬火退火协议构建，逐步分离这些变量。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 无序材料对分子模拟提出了反复出现的挑战：真实的结构模型通常是通过热协议生成的，其中多个结构描述符同时出现，并且不能轻易地独立变化。纳米多孔碳构成了一个特别相关的例子：孔径、壁序、曲率和网络弯曲度通常作为热制备方案的结果出现，而不是独立规定的结构参数。此外，对于实际应用，多孔材料模型应该理想地表现出渗透孔网络，能够支持吸附物质通过材料的端到端传输。为此，我们在这里引入了模板策略的层次结构，该策略围绕由机器学习的碳原子间势驱动的通用熔化淬火退火协议构建，逐步分离这些变量。刚性圆柱形模板通过可调的伦纳德-琼斯势与环境相互作用，提供对孔径和局部壁组织的独立控制，同时使周围碳基质的结构无序基本不变。将模板推广到弹簧连接的曲折骨架进一步允许指定孔的几何形状和曲率，而无需定性地改变为直孔建立的局部模板机制。最后，使模板可移动，让不断增长的碳网络反过来重塑它，从而锐化孔隙边界，并允许精确定位亚纳米孔径，以满足超级电容器电极等应用的需要。最终，这种方法能够系统地研究多孔材料的结构-性能关系，用于储能、海水淡化和气体捕获等应用。

articles.title: Atomic-scale assembly of sulfur vacancy complexes for tailored in-gap states in monolayer WS₂
articles.title_zh: 单层 WS2 中定制带隙状态的硫空位配合物的原子级组装
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.24754v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Atomic-scale defects in two-dimensional semiconductors are quasi-isolated quantum systems with promise for emerging technologies. Although their potential as spin qubits, quantum sensors and single-photon emitters has been demonstrated experimentally, creating them deterministically and identifying them chemically remains challenging, which limits control over their electronic states. In this work we assemble sulfur vacancies in monolayer WS₂ into complexes of different sizes and geometries using the tip of a scanning tunneling microscope. We study their electronic properties by a combination of scanning tunneling spectroscopy and density functional theory, revealing the intricate influences of geometry, underlying point group symmetries and spin-orbit coupling on hybridized states. Among the realized sulfur vacancy complexes, we characterize two configurations that are candidates for bright single photon emitters. Our findings demonstrate an atomic-scale method for engineering quantum states within the band gap of two-dimensional semiconductors.
articles.abstract_zh: 二维半导体中的原子尺度缺陷是准孤立的量子系统，有望成为新兴技术。尽管它们作为自旋量子位、量子传感器和单光子发射器的潜力已通过实验得到证明，但确定性地制造它们并以化学方式识别它们仍然具有挑战性，这限制了对其电子态的控制。在这项工作中，我们使用扫描隧道显微镜的尖端将单层 WS2 中的硫空位组装成不同尺寸和几何形状的复合物。我们通过扫描隧道光谱和密度泛函理论的结合来研究它们的电子特性，揭示了几何形状、基础点群对称性和自旋轨道耦合对杂化态的复杂影响。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 二维半导体中的原子尺度缺陷是准孤立的量子系统，有望成为新兴技术。尽管它们作为自旋量子位、量子传感器和单光子发射器的潜力已通过实验得到证明，但确定性地制造它们并以化学方式识别它们仍然具有挑战性，这限制了对其电子态的控制。在这项工作中，我们使用扫描隧道显微镜的尖端将单层 WS2 中的硫空位组装成不同尺寸和几何形状的复合物。我们通过扫描隧道光谱和密度泛函理论的结合来研究它们的电子特性，揭示了几何形状、基础点群对称性和自旋轨道耦合对杂化态的复杂影响。在实现的硫空位配合物中，我们表征了两种作为明亮单光子发射器候选结构的特征。我们的研究结果展示了一种在二维半导体带隙内设计量子态的原子尺度方法。

articles.title: Grain-size distribution characterization from single-shot x-ray diffraction using hierarchical Bayesian multi-emitter analysis
articles.title_zh: 使用分层贝叶斯多发射器分析通过单次 X 射线衍射表征晶粒尺寸分布
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.24755v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The distribution of grain sizes in a polycrystalline material can be determined from a 2D x-ray diffraction pattern by counting and characterizing diffraction spots, so long as the spots are discrete. This approach breaks down if there is substantial overlap of the reflections due to either a large number of grains in the scattering volume or crowding of spots caused by crystallographic texture. As a result, the spot-counting approach to grain size determination is infeasible for many situations of practical interest. We address this limitation by applying hierarchical probabilistic learning using a reversible-jump Markov chain Monte Carlo framework to jointly infer diffraction spot populations and their intensity distributions. Using synthetic diffraction patterns, we show how this hierarchical model allows recovery of diffraction peak intensities across a wide variety of grain-size distributions and crystallographic textures. From the recovered peak intensities we infer grain-size distributions themselves and characterize the regimes of grain size and texture for which this approach is practical. Finally, we demonstrate the application of our technique by comparing grain-size distributions in Cu-Ti alloy specimens obtained from 2D x-ray diffraction patterns with those from electron backscatter diffraction (EBSD). This method of grain-size distribution determination is expected to be particularly useful in the context of high-throughput experimentation, where the minimal sample preparation requirements and short exposure times of single-shot x-ray diffraction are substantial advantages relative to microscopy techniques.
articles.abstract_zh: 多晶材料中晶粒尺寸的分布可以通过计算和表征衍射点来从 2D X 射线衍射图确定，只要这些点是离散的。如果由于散射体积中存在大量颗粒或晶体结构引起的斑点拥挤而导致反射大量重叠，则这种方法就会失败。因此，点计数法测定晶粒尺寸对于许多实际情况来说是不可行的。我们通过使用可逆跳跃马尔可夫链蒙特卡罗框架应用分层概率学习来共同推断衍射斑群及其强度分布，从而解决了这一限制。使用合成衍射图，我们展示了这种分层模型如何允许在各种晶粒尺寸分布和晶体结构中恢复衍射峰强度。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 多晶材料中晶粒尺寸的分布可以通过计算和表征衍射点来从 2D X 射线衍射图确定，只要这些点是离散的。如果由于散射体积中存在大量颗粒或晶体结构引起的斑点拥挤而导致反射大量重叠，则这种方法就会失败。因此，点计数法测定晶粒尺寸对于许多实际情况来说是不可行的。我们通过使用可逆跳跃马尔可夫链蒙特卡罗框架应用分层概率学习来共同推断衍射斑群及其强度分布，从而解决了这一限制。使用合成衍射图，我们展示了这种分层模型如何允许在各种晶粒尺寸分布和晶体结构中恢复衍射峰强度。根据恢复的峰值强度，我们推断出晶粒尺寸分布本身，并表征了该方法实用的晶粒尺寸和纹理的状态。最后，我们通过比较从 2D X 射线衍射图案和电子背散射衍射 (EBSD) 获得的铜钛合金样品中的晶粒尺寸分布，展示了我们的技术的应用。这种粒度分布测定方法预计在高通量实验中特别有用，其中单次 X 射线衍射的最小样品制备要求和短曝光时间是相对于显微镜技术的显着优势。

articles.title: Characterizing adsorption thermodynamics in carbon capture materials: an efficient first-principles approach
articles.title_zh: 表征碳捕获材料的吸附热力学：一种有效的第一原理方法
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.24759v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Porous materials offer a vast design space for CO₂ capture, whose exploration hinges on efficient and accurate first-principles predictions of the thermodynamics governing adsorption. However, simulating isotherms and heats of adsorption using grand canonical molecular simulations is extremely computationally expensive when combined with accurate ab initio treatments of the molecular interactions, limiting screening to low-pressure uptake encoded in the Henry constant. Identifying and designing the best CO₂ capture materials requires a strategy that can efficiently calculate their adsorption properties using ab initio potential energy surfaces such as those now available from foundational machine-learned interatomic potentials (MLIPs). Here we develop a neural classical density functional (cDFT) framework for carbon capture processes that allows direct calculation of adsorption isotherms from low to high loading limits of metal-organic frameworks (MOFs) without grand canonical simulations. We demonstrate the success of our approach by calculating the ab initio adsorption isotherms for over 5,000 experimentally reported MOFs. From our screening, we show how these materials can be characterized using four isotherm shapes, arising from their pore size and binding sites, which the Henry constant cannot distinguish. We show that these shapes, rather than the binding strength alone, decide which MOFs suit which process: small pores with strong binding sites for vacuum and temperature swings at low pressure, large pores with weakly binding walls for pressure swings. Finally, we identify the most promising candidates by weighing their working capacity against the energy needed for regeneration.
articles.abstract_zh: 多孔材料为二氧化碳捕获提供了广阔的设计空间，其探索取决于控制吸附的热力学的高效和准确的第一原理预测。然而，当与分子相互作用的精确从头计算处理相结合时，使用大规范分子模拟来模拟等温线和吸附热在计算上极其昂贵，从而限制了对亨利常数编码的低压吸收的筛选。识别和设计最佳的二氧化碳捕获材料需要一种能够使用从头计算势能表面（例如现在可从基础机器学习原子间势能 (MLIP) 获得的势能表面）有效计算其吸附特性的策略。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 多孔材料为二氧化碳捕获提供了广阔的设计空间，其探索取决于控制吸附的热力学的高效和准确的第一原理预测。然而，当与分子相互作用的精确从头计算处理相结合时，使用大规范分子模拟来模拟等温线和吸附热在计算上极其昂贵，从而限制了对亨利常数编码的低压吸收的筛选。识别和设计最佳的二氧化碳捕获材料需要一种能够使用从头计算势能表面（例如现在可从基础机器学习原子间势能 (MLIP) 获得的势能表面）有效计算其吸附特性的策略。在这里，我们开发了一种用于碳捕获过程的神经经典密度泛函（cDFT）框架，该框架允许直接计算金属有机框架（MOF）从低到高负载极限的吸附等温线，而无需进行大规范模拟。我们通过计算 5,000 多个实验报告的 MOF 的从头算吸附等温线来证明我们的方法是成功的。通过我们的筛选，我们展示了如何使用四种等温线形状来表征这些材料，这些等温线形状由它们的孔径和结合位点产生，而亨利常数无法区分。我们表明，这些形状，而不是单独的结合强度，决定了哪种 MOF 适合哪种过程：小孔具有强结合位点，用于真空和低压温度波动，大孔具有弱结合壁，用于压力波动。最后，我们通过权衡其工作能力与再生所需的能量来确定最有前途的候选者。

articles.title: From geometric curvature to effective backgrounds: a dictionary for Dirac fermions in one, two and three spatial dimensions
articles.title_zh: 从几何曲率到有效背景：一维、二维和三维狄拉克费米子字典
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.24878v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Dirac equation on curved backgrounds can be rewritten as a flat-space equation in which geometry appears as a tensorial Fermi velocity together with a set of background fields. We derive this correspondence from a single Clifford-algebra identity and follow it through one, two, and three spatial dimensions. Once the spin connection is written in terms of Ricci rotation coefficients, only two contractions can occur. The trace produces a term with the index structure of a vector potential in every dimensionality; it enters with an imaginary factor i and is precisely the term that keeps the operator Hermitian when the Fermi velocity depends on position. The totally antisymmetric contraction produces an object that depends on the number of indices available to the Levi-Civita symbol: a trace on a line, a pseudoscalar mass on a surface, and an axial vector potential in a volume. Neither contraction is invariant under local rotations of the frame, and we give the transformation laws. On a surface, the curl of the trace term can always be removed by a frame rotation, while its divergence is proportional to the Gaussian curvature. We apply the correspondence to a Gaussian bump, where the local density of states at the center falls below its flat value and obeys a closed form at low energy; to a wire, where a nonuniform lapse binds states inside the gap and a nonuniform velocity cannot; to stationary frames on a surface, where a circulating drag shifts the Dirac mass locally with either sign; and to twisted and rotating frames in a volume, where the axial term takes the form of a chiral chemical potential produced by the frame alone, or separates Weyl nodes in a rotating sample. We separate the geometric contribution from the lattice pseudogauge field that dominates the response of strained samples
articles.abstract_zh: 弯曲背景上的狄拉克方程可以重写为平坦空间方程，其中几何形状表现为张量费米速度和一组背景场。我们从单个克利福德代数恒等式中推导出这种对应关系，并通过一维、二维和三维空间来追踪它。一旦自旋连接被写成里奇旋转系数，就只能发生两次收缩。该迹产生一个项，该项具有每个维度的矢量势的索引结构；它以虚数因子 i 进入，并且正是当费米速度取决于位置时保持算子埃尔米特式的项。完全反对称收缩产生的对象取决于列维-奇维塔符号可用的索引数量：线上的迹线、表面上的赝标量质量以及体积中的轴向矢量势。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 弯曲背景上的狄拉克方程可以重写为平坦空间方程，其中几何形状表现为张量费米速度和一组背景场。我们从单个克利福德代数恒等式中推导出这种对应关系，并通过一维、二维和三维空间来追踪它。一旦自旋连接被写成里奇旋转系数，就只能发生两次收缩。该迹产生一个项，该项具有每个维度的矢量势的索引结构；它以虚数因子 i 进入，并且正是当费米速度取决于位置时保持算子埃尔米特式的项。完全反对称收缩产生的对象取决于列维-奇维塔符号可用的索引数量：线上的迹线、表面上的赝标量质量以及体积中的轴向矢量势。在框架的局部旋转下，这两种收缩都不是不变的，我们给出了变换定律。在表面上，迹项的旋度总是可以通过坐标系旋转来消除，而其散度与高斯曲率成正比。我们将对应关系应用于高斯凹凸，其中中心的局部态密度低于其平坦值并遵循低能量的封闭形式；到一根电线，其中不均匀的失效会束缚间隙内的状态，而不均匀的速度则不能；到表面上的固定框架，其中循环阻力以任一符号局部移动狄拉克质量；以及体积中扭曲和旋转的框架，其中轴向项采用框架单独产生的手性化学势的形式，或分隔旋转样本中的韦尔节点。我们将几何贡献与主导应变样本响应的晶格赝规范场分开

articles.title: Prediction and Screening of η-carbide-type Nitrides for Ammonia Synthesis
articles.title_zh: 氨合成用η-碳化物型氮化物的预测与筛选
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.24909v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Synthesis of ammonia is of critical importance to applications in energy, industrial chemistry, and especially agriculture, and is accomplished industrially using the carbon- and energy-intensive Haber-Bosch process. η-carbide-type nitrides such as Co3Mo3N have gained attention in recent years as alternative ammonia synthesis catalysts with the potential to lower these energy demands. Co3Mo3N is experimentally observed to undergo a reversible phase transition from Co3Mo3N to Co6Mo6N, offering a chemical looping-based NH3 synthesis route that has not been fully explored. In this work, we present a first-principles exploration of phase change in the Co3Mo3N/Co6Mo6N system as a prototype η-carbide-type nitride and fit a cluster expansion to predict the energy of Co3Mo3Nx systems. We use our results to identify the phase energy difference as a useful screening criterion for the phase change process. We then apply this methodology to screen a broad range of η-carbide-type nitrides that combine group 4-6 transition metals with Cr, Fe, Co, Ni, or Zn. We report strong periodic trends in phase energy difference, which increases with decreasing period and group number of the group 4-6 transition metal and with distance from group 9 for the other metal. We identify Co3W3N, Fe3W3N, and several quaternary nitrides as promising candidates for NH3 synthesis via a phase change mechanism.
articles.abstract_zh: 氨的合成对于能源、工业化学、特别是农业中的应用至关重要，并且在工业上使用碳和能源密集型哈伯-博世工艺来完成。近年来，诸如 Co3Mo3N 等 η-碳化物型氮化物作为具有降低这些能源需求潜力的替代氨合成催化剂而受到关注。实验观察到 Co3Mo3N 经历从 Co3Mo3N 到 Co6Mo6N 的可逆相变，提供了一种尚未完全探索的基于化学循环的 NH3 合成路线。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 氨的合成对于能源、工业化学、特别是农业中的应用至关重要，并且在工业上使用碳和能源密集型哈伯-博世工艺来完成。近年来，诸如 Co3Mo3N 等 η-碳化物型氮化物作为具有降低这些能源需求潜力的替代氨合成催化剂而受到关注。实验观察到 Co3Mo3N 经历从 Co3Mo3N 到 Co6Mo6N 的可逆相变，提供了一种尚未完全探索的基于化学循环的 NH3 合成路线。在这项工作中，我们对 Co3Mo3N/Co6Mo6N 系统中的相变作为原型 η-碳化物型氮化物进行了第一性原理探索，并拟合簇展开来预测 Co3Mo3Nx 系统的能量。我们利用我们的结果来识别相能差，作为相变过程的有用筛选标准。然后，我们应用这种方法来筛选各种将 4-6 族过渡金属与 Cr、Fe、Co、Ni 或 Zn 结合的 η-碳化物型氮化物。我们报告了相位能量差的强烈周期性趋势，该趋势随着第 4-6 族过渡金属的周期和族数的减少以及其他金属与第 9 族的距离的增加而增加。我们认为 Co3W3N、Fe3W3N 和几种四元氮化物是通过相变机制合成 NH3 的有希望的候选物。

articles.title: Exact Parent Hamiltonians for Partially Magnetized Chiral Spin Liquids
articles.title_zh: 部分磁化手性自旋液体的精确母哈密顿量
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.24935v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Chiral spin liquids (CSLs) are paradigmatic fractionalized phases, yet simple exact parent Hamiltonians for them remain scarce. In this work, we construct exact spin parent Hamiltonians for partially magnetized CSLs realizing various bosonic topological orders. Our construction relies on an exact Hubbard-type parent Hamiltonian for bosonic lattice fractional quantum Hall (FQH) states, valid at arbitrary repulsive interaction strengths. Taking the on-site repulsion to infinity and applying local boson-spin mappings yields exact parent Hamiltonians for the CSLs. Our two-spin construction generalizes the Kalmeyer-Laughlin spin Hamiltonian to a broader class of bosonic FQH model states, including Abelian states and non-Abelian parton states. We derive controlled microscopic realizations of these two-spin Hamiltonians via second-order superexchange in generalized spinful Hofstadter-Hubbard models with tailored hoppings and interactions. With more general local constraints and interactions, boson-spin mappings yield exact higher-spin and multispin parent Hamiltonians for partially magnetized CSLs.
articles.abstract_zh: 手性自旋液体（CSL）是典型的分馏相，但它们的简单精确母哈密顿量仍然很少。在这项工作中，我们为部分磁化的 CSL 构造了精确的自旋母哈密顿量，实现了各种玻色子拓扑序。我们的构造依赖于玻色晶格分数量子霍尔（FQH）态的精确哈伯德型父哈伯德量，在任意排斥相互作用强度下有效。将现场排斥力设为无穷大并应用局部玻色子自旋映射可产生 CSL 的精确父哈密顿量。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 手性自旋液体（CSL）是典型的分馏相，但它们的简单精确母哈密顿量仍然很少。在这项工作中，我们为部分磁化的 CSL 构造了精确的自旋母哈密顿量，实现了各种玻色子拓扑序。我们的构造依赖于玻色晶格分数量子霍尔（FQH）态的精确哈伯德型父哈伯德量，在任意排斥相互作用强度下有效。将现场排斥力设为无穷大并应用局部玻色子自旋映射可产生 CSL 的精确父哈密顿量。我们的双自旋构造将 Kalmeyer-Laughlin 自旋哈密顿量推广到更广泛的玻色 FQH 模型状态，包括阿贝尔状态和非阿贝尔部分子状态。我们通过具有定制跳跃和相互作用的广义自旋 Hofstadter-Hubbard 模型中的二阶超交换，推导出这些双自旋哈密顿量的受控微观实现。通过更一般的局部约束和相互作用，玻色子自旋映射为部分磁化的 CSL 产生精确的高自旋和多自旋父哈密顿量。

articles.title: Confidence-Based Materials Data Quality Assessment via Domain Knowledge and Graph-Structured Learning
articles.title_zh: 通过领域知识和图结构学习进行基于置信度的材料数据质量评估
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.23342v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: The rapid development of materials machine learning relies on large-scale, heterogeneous datasets, yet model reliability is often compromised by imperfect data from diverse experiments, simulations, and database integration. Real-world materials databases may contain measurement errors, failed calculations, missing or duplicate records, and hidden violations of physicochemical constraints. Such problems are difficult to identify because corrupted samples may remain statistically plausible rather than appearing as explicit outliers. In this paper, we propose a confidence-based materials data quality assessment framework that integrates domain knowledge with graph-structured learning. Data quality is formulated as a continuous confidence estimation problem rather than a binary anomaly identification task, enabling sample-level assessment and historical-reference-based batch comparison. A nine-dimensional feature-quality prior and duplicate-aware sample initialization are calibrated using materials domain rules and statistical evidence. Confidence is further refined through sample-feature bipartite graph propagation and weakly supervised graph attention, while a Memory-GAT module provides historical reference scoring. Experiments on 23 ODDS benchmark datasets show that the generic module achieves an average AUC-ROC of 0.866. In five repeated mixed-contamination experiments on mp₂₀, rule calibration improves HistGradientBoostingRegressor test R² from 0.538±0.008 to 0.616±0.014. Graph refinement increases average precision from 0.943±0.004 to 0.953±0.004, while the rule-calibrated configuration has the highest mean test R² among the evaluated screening configurations. Five repeated MACE subset experiments further show an increase in R² from 0.590±0.053 to 0.880±0.027 after rule-based screening.
articles.abstract_zh: 材料机器学习的快速发展依赖于大规模、异构的数据集，但模型的可靠性常常受到来自不同实验、模拟和数据库集成的不完美数据的影响。现实世界的材料数据库可能包含测量错误、计算失败、记录丢失或重复以及隐藏的物理化学约束违规行为。此类问题很难识别，因为损坏的样本可能在统计上仍然合理，而不是显示为明显的异常值。在本文中，我们提出了一种基于置信度的材料数据质量评估框架，它将领域知识与图结构学习相结合。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 材料机器学习的快速发展依赖于大规模、异构的数据集，但模型的可靠性常常受到来自不同实验、模拟和数据库集成的不完美数据的影响。现实世界的材料数据库可能包含测量错误、计算失败、记录丢失或重复以及隐藏的物理化学约束违规行为。此类问题很难识别，因为损坏的样本可能在统计上仍然合理，而不是显示为明显的异常值。在本文中，我们提出了一种基于置信度的材料数据质量评估框架，它将领域知识与图结构学习相结合。数据质量被表述为连续置信度估计问题，而不是二元异常识别任务，从而实现样本级评估和基于历史参考的批量比较。使用材料域规则和统计证据来校准九维特征质量先验和重复感知样本初始化。通过样本特征二分图传播和弱监督图注意力进一步完善置信度，同时 Memory-GAT 模块提供历史参考评分。在 23 个 ODDS 基准数据集上的实验表明，通用模块的平均 AUC-ROC 为 0.866。在 mp2₀ 上进行的五次重复混合污染实验中，规则校准将 HistGradientBoostingRegressor 测试 R2 从 0.538±0.008 提高到 0.616±0.014。图形细化将平均精度从 0.943±0.004 提高到 0.953±0.004，而规则校准配置在评估的筛选配置中具有最高的平均测试 R²。五次重复的 MACE 子集实验进一步表明，基于规则的筛选后，R² 从 0.590±0.053 增加到 0.880±0.027。

articles.title: Quantum resources and the onset of the quantum Monte Carlo sign problem
articles.title_zh: 量子资源和量子蒙特卡罗符号问题的出现
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.23514v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: The Monte Carlo sign problem poses a fundamental obstacle to classical simulation of quantum many-body systems, yet its connection to quantum resources remains poorly understood. We probe this connection by systematically tuning the degree of nonstoquasticity in random k-local Hamiltonians. In numerical tensor-network studies, we find the sign complexity and the quantum resources of entanglement and nonstabilizerness of the ground state to be strongly suppressed in a broad regime up to substantial nonstoquasticity. As nonstoquasticity is further increased, the considered quantum resources experience sharp crossovers into a regime where they are strongly enhanced. Surprisingly, numerical quantum Monte Carlo (QMC) simulations drastically deteriorate in the same region, even though the Hamiltonian is already considerably nonstoquastic well before it, indicating that the failure of ground-state QMC is correlated more with the resource content of the state than the sign structure of the Hamiltonian. We corroborate these findings analytically by constructing an approximate ground state of k-local Hamiltonians in the stoquastic limit. Moreover, we identify a distinct behaviour in graph states. Their nonstabilizerness always vanishes, but, as we demonstrate analytically, on bipartite graphs the sign can be easily cured while in multipartite graph states it cannot. Our results thus shed light on the highly subtle interplay between quantum resources and the computational difficulty encountered by QMC methods.
articles.abstract_zh: 蒙特卡罗符号问题对量子多体系统的经典模拟构成了根本障碍，但其与量子资源的联系仍然知之甚少。我们通过系统地调整随机 k 局部哈密顿量的非随机性程度来探讨这种联系。在数值张量网络研究中，我们发现基态的符号复杂性以及纠缠和非稳定性的量子资源在高达非随机性的广泛范围内受到强烈抑制。随着非随机性的进一步增加，所考虑的量子资源经历了急剧的交叉，进入了它们被强烈增强的状态。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 蒙特卡罗符号问题对量子多体系统的经典模拟构成了根本障碍，但其与量子资源的联系仍然知之甚少。我们通过系统地调整随机 k 局部哈密顿量的非随机性程度来探讨这种联系。在数值张量网络研究中，我们发现基态的符号复杂性以及纠缠和非稳定性的量子资源在高达非随机性的广泛范围内受到强烈抑制。随着非随机性的进一步增加，所考虑的量子资源经历了急剧的交叉，进入了它们被强烈增强的状态。令人惊讶的是，数值量子蒙特卡罗（QMC）模拟在同一区域急剧恶化，尽管哈密顿量早在它之前就已经相当非随机，这表明基态 QMC 的失败与状态的资源含量的相关性大于与哈密顿量的符号结构的相关性。我们通过在随机极限内构建 k 局部哈密顿量的近似基态来分析证实这些发现。此外，我们还发现了图状态中的独特行为。它们的非稳定性总是消失，但是，正如我们分析证明的那样，在二分图上，符号可以很容易地被治愈，而在多分图上却不能。因此，我们的结果揭示了量子资源与 QMC 方法遇到的计算困难之间高度微妙的相互作用。

articles.title: Fe²⁺:forsterite Qubit System
articles.title_zh: Fe²⁺：镁橄榄石量子比特系统
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.23550v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Quantum Computing uses quantum mechanical phenomena, such as superposition and entanglement of quantum bits (qubits), to represent and manipulate information in multidimensional state spaces. This approach allows complex mathematical functions to be executed simultaneously rather than sequentially, making them much more efficient than classical computers. However, current quantum computers suffer from quantum decoherence, where small changes to their environment, such as thermal fluctuations and vibrations, affect the systems' fragile states. The goal of this study is to discuss the functionality of a proposed Fe²⁺:forsterite qubit system by solving the unitary time-evolution of a quantum state vector for the system's Hamiltonian, using known axial and traverse anisotropy terms at temperatures up to 10 K. The system can effectively transfer population between its two lowest states at rates predicted by the Rabi half-period, with 99.9% fidelity. Additionally, it can hold the population at a desired state without docohering. The results remained consistent for temperatures up to 10 K, meaning, unlike many common qubit systems, the proposed qubit system could function without a dilution fridge and is not fragile to thermal noise.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子计算利用量子力学现象，例如量子比特（qubit）的叠加和纠缠，来表示和操纵多维状态空间中的信息。这种方法允许同时而不是顺序执行复杂的数学函数，使它们比传统计算机更加高效。然而，当前的量子计算机存在量子退相干问题，其中环境的微小变化（例如热波动和振动）会影响系统的脆弱状态。本研究的目的是通过在高达 10 K 的温度下使用已知的轴向和横向各向异性项求解系统哈密顿量的量子态向量的酉时间演化来讨论所提出的 Fe²⁺:镁橄榄石量子位系统的功能。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 量子计算利用量子力学现象，例如量子比特（qubit）的叠加和纠缠，来表示和操纵多维状态空间中的信息。这种方法允许同时而不是顺序执行复杂的数学函数，使它们比传统计算机更加高效。然而，当前的量子计算机存在量子退相干问题，其中环境的微小变化（例如热波动和振动）会影响系统的脆弱状态。本研究的目的是通过在高达 10 K 的温度下使用已知的轴向和横向各向异性项求解系统哈密顿量的量子态向量的酉时间演化来讨论所提出的 Fe²⁺:镁橄榄石量子位系统的功能。该系统可以以拉比半周期预测的速率在其两个最低状态之间有效地转移粒子数，保真度为 99.9%。此外，它可以将群体保持在所需的状态而不发生凝聚。在高达 10 K 的温度下，结果保持一致，这意味着，与许多常见的量子位系统不同，所提出的量子位系统可以在没有稀释冰箱的情况下运行，并且不易受到热噪声的影响。

articles.title: Hierarchical coupling in tripartite van der Waals cavity magnonics for a low-loss and tunable coupled-mode Hamiltonian
articles.title_zh: 三方范德华腔磁振子学中的分层耦合，用于低损耗和可调谐耦合模式哈密顿量
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.23756v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: One of the greatest merits of cavity magnonics (CM) is the ability to explore rich coupled-mode physics, driven by the large in situ flux tunability of magnonic resonances and magnon--photon coupling. Meanwhile, van der Waals (vdW) magnets offer an ultra-compact and highly integrated implementation of CM without complex fabrication processes. Nonetheless, the substantial magnon losses significantly hinder the combination of all these advantages. Here, we realize a hierarchical anti-crossing structure in a tripartite vdW CM with CrCl3 and realize an effective coupled-dual-mode Hamiltonian. We achieve an order-of-magnitude reduction in loss while maintaining a strong coupling condition. Additionally, we theoretically confirm the feasibility of simultaneous and in situ tuning of both loss and coupling by varying the magnetic field direction and strength. Featuring a micrometer-scale thickness and a width of a few millimeters, our device is significantly smaller than those based on bulk crystals or crystal arrays. Our results establish vdW cavity magnonics as versatile platform for investigating intriguing phenomena predicted in coupled-mode systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 腔磁振子学 (CM) 的最大优点之一是能够探索丰富的耦合模式物理，由磁振子共振和磁子-光子耦合的大原位通量可调性驱动。同时，范德华 (vdW) 磁体无需复杂的制造工艺即可实现超紧凑且高度集成的 CM 实施。尽管如此，大量的磁振子损失严重阻碍了所有这些优点的结合。在这里，我们利用 CrCl3 在三方 vdW CM 中实现了分层反交叉结构，并实现了有效的耦合双模哈密顿量。我们在保持强耦合条件的同时实现了损耗的数量级降低。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 腔磁振子学 (CM) 的最大优点之一是能够探索丰富的耦合模式物理，由磁振子共振和磁子-光子耦合的大原位通量可调性驱动。同时，范德华 (vdW) 磁体无需复杂的制造工艺即可实现超紧凑且高度集成的 CM 实施。尽管如此，大量的磁振子损失严重阻碍了所有这些优点的结合。在这里，我们利用 CrCl3 在三方 vdW CM 中实现了分层反交叉结构，并实现了有效的耦合双模哈密顿量。我们在保持强耦合条件的同时实现了损耗的数量级降低。此外，我们从理论上证实了通过改变磁场方向和强度来同时原位调节损耗和耦合的可行性。我们的设备具有微米级的厚度和几毫米的宽度，比基于块状晶体或晶体阵列的设备小得多。我们的结果将 vdW 腔磁振子学确立为多功能平台，用于研究耦合模式系统中预测的有趣现象。

articles.title: Efficient Spectra and Dynamics with Tangent-Space Chebyshev Tree Tensor Networks
articles.title_zh: 利用切线空间切比雪夫树张量网络实现高效光谱和动力学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.23975v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We present a tangent-space Chebyshev method (TaChe), which combines tree tensor network states with Chebyshev recursion and maximum entropy spectral analysis in a tree tensor network tangent space, for quantum many-body spectra and dynamics. Implemented tensor network state calculations in the tangent space of the ground state, the core advantage of TaChe is that it can substantially reduce the computational complexity, memory usage, and numerical instability associated with tensor network state compression. Implemented on the GPU platform, it produces accurate spectra with speedups of up to 46.8 over the previous Chebyshev tensor network method and 13.7 over one-site time-dependent variational principle propagation in the reported benchmarks. Applications to acetonitrile, thermal aggregate emission, finite-temperature charge transport on a (6×6) lattice, and internal conversion in aggregates of up to 100 molecules demonstrate the efficiency and versatility of TaChe in simulating complex molecular systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们提出了一种切比雪夫方法（TaChe），它将树张量网络状态与切比雪夫递归和树张量网络切空间中的最大熵谱分析相结合，用于量子多体谱和动力学。在基态切线空间中实现张量网络状态计算，TaChe的核心优势在于可以大幅降低与张量网络状态压缩相关的计算复杂度、内存占用以及数值不稳定性。它在 GPU 平台上实现，可生成准确的光谱，在报告的基准测试中，比之前的切比雪夫张量网络方法加速高达 46.8，比单点时间相关变分原理传播加速高达 13.7。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们提出了一种切比雪夫方法（TaChe），它将树张量网络状态与切比雪夫递归和树张量网络切空间中的最大熵谱分析相结合，用于量子多体谱和动力学。在基态切线空间中实现张量网络状态计算，TaChe的核心优势在于可以大幅降低与张量网络状态压缩相关的计算复杂度、内存占用以及数值不稳定性。它在 GPU 平台上实现，可生成准确的光谱，在报告的基准测试中，比之前的切比雪夫张量网络方法加速高达 46.8，比单点时间相关变分原理传播加速高达 13.7。在乙腈、热聚集发射、(6×6) 晶格上的有限温度电荷传输以及多达 100 个分子聚集体的内部转换中的应用证明了 TaChe 在模拟复杂分子系统方面的效率和多功能性。

articles.title: Topological Quantum Reservoir Computing
articles.title_zh: 拓扑量子储层计算
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.24013v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Scaling universal quantum computation and implementing quantum machine learning with protected logical qubits remain challenging. To harness the computational potential of existing fault-tolerant quantum platforms, we introduce topological quantum reservoir computing, a novel approach using protected degrees of freedom for storage and the host system's intrinsic dynamics for information processing. Using a one-dimensional Kitaev chain, we show how long-lived Majorana edge modes and fast bulk responses support these complementary functions within the same many-body system. We identify the tradeoffs governing access to protected memory and show how matched interfaces enable programmable writing and interactions enable autonomous information consolidation from the bulk to the edge. These mechanisms improve performance on tasks requiring long-term retention of temporal information. Our results establish topology as a new resource for quantum reservoir computing and open a route toward near-term quantum computing and quantum machine learning.
articles.abstract_zh: 扩展通用量子计算并使用受保护的逻辑量子位实现量子机器学习仍然具有挑战性。为了利用现有容错量子平台的计算潜力，我们引入了拓扑量子库计算，这是一种利用受保护的存储自由度和主机系统的内在动态进行信息处理的新颖方法。使用一维 Kitaev 链，我们展示了长寿命的马约拉纳边缘模式和快速批量响应如何在同一多体系统中支持这些互补功能。我们确定了管理对受保护内存的访问的权衡，并展示了匹配的接口如何实现可编程写入和交互，从而实现从大量到边缘的自主信息整合。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 扩展通用量子计算并使用受保护的逻辑量子位实现量子机器学习仍然具有挑战性。为了利用现有容错量子平台的计算潜力，我们引入了拓扑量子库计算，这是一种利用受保护的存储自由度和主机系统的内在动态进行信息处理的新颖方法。使用一维 Kitaev 链，我们展示了长寿命的马约拉纳边缘模式和快速批量响应如何在同一多体系统中支持这些互补功能。我们确定了管理对受保护内存的访问的权衡，并展示了匹配的接口如何实现可编程写入和交互，从而实现从大量到边缘的自主信息整合。这些机制提高了需要长期保留时间信息的任务的性能。我们的结果将拓扑确立为量子库计算的新资源，并为近期量子计算和量子机器学习开辟了道路。

articles.title: Quantum Annealing with a Quantum Neural Network: Width of Annealing Matters
articles.title_zh: 使用量子神经网络进行量子退火：退火的宽度很重要
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.24089v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Quantum annealing is a promising quantum algorithm for dealing with computationally hard optimization problems. Currently available hardware can implement the algorithm for a significant class of Hamiltonian problems. However, its performance is especially limited in discontinuous quantum phase transitions, where the energy gap shrinks exponentially with system size. In this paper, we introduce an extension of quantum annealing to a quantum neural network and study its performance in a number of prototypical optimization problems. In particular, we observe that already a random quantum annealing network of width W = 2 can exponentially reduce the number of evolution layers or depth of the annealing process in the quantum search problem. By tuning the network parameters the search problem can be solved with exponentially small errors by a quantum perceptron of depth L = 1 and width W = 2. The findings show that width of a quantum annealing network is critical to enhance the success probability of the algorithm by providing a larger and learnable evolution space for the annealing process.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子退火是一种很有前途的量子算法，用于处理计算困难的优化问题。目前可用的硬件可以实现针对一类重要的哈密顿问题的算法。然而，它的性能在不连续量子相变中尤其受到限制，其中能隙随着系统尺寸呈指数级缩小。在本文中，我们将量子退火引入到量子神经网络中，并研究了其在许多原型优化问题中的性能。特别是，我们观察到宽度 W = 2 的随机量子退火网络可以指数级减少量子搜索问题中的演化层数或退火过程的深度。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 量子退火是一种很有前途的量子算法，用于处理计算困难的优化问题。目前可用的硬件可以实现针对一类重要的哈密顿问题的算法。然而，它的性能在不连续量子相变中尤其受到限制，其中能隙随着系统尺寸呈指数级缩小。在本文中，我们将量子退火引入到量子神经网络中，并研究了其在许多原型优化问题中的性能。特别是，我们观察到宽度 W = 2 的随机量子退火网络可以指数级减少量子搜索问题中的演化层数或退火过程的深度。通过调整网络参数，可以通过深度 L = 1 和宽度 W = 2 的量子感知器以指数级小误差解决搜索问题。研究结果表明，量子退火网络的宽度对于通过为退火过程提供更大且可学习的演化空间来提高算法的成功概率至关重要。

articles.title: 1/N corrections to langle TJJrangle and langle TTTrangle in QED₃, QED₃--GNY and scalar QED₃
articles.title_zh: 对 QED₃、QED₃--GNY 和标量 QED₃ 中的 langle TJJrangle 和 langle TTTrangle 进行 1/N 修正
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.24531v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Three-dimensional Abelian gauge theories have broad applications in deconfined quantum criticality, Dirac spin liquids and cuprate superconductivity. Correlation functions of conserved currents J and the stress tensor T carry fundamental information about these theories. We compute the first subleading large-flavor corrections to the parity-even three-point functions langle TJJrangle and langle TTTrangle in QED₃, QED₃--Gross--Neveu--Yukawa, and critical scalar QED₃. For langle TJJrangle, we study both global flavor currents and the topological U(1) current, which measures the magnetic flux of the dynamical gauge field. We evaluate the flat-space energy flux in directions where the leading free-field profile vanishes. At first subleading order the flux in these directions is determined by four-particle production, yielding analytic corrections to the conformal collider parameters. We reproduce the corrections independently from squashed-sphere free-energy derivatives. Together with known two-point normalizations, the collider parameters fix the coefficients of both independent tensor structures in each correlator. Our results are useful for studying conductivity and shear response near quantum critical points and for conformal bootstrap studies of conserved-current and stress-tensor correlators in strongly coupled gauge theories.
articles.abstract_zh: 三维阿贝尔规范理论在解禁量子临界性、狄拉克自旋液体和铜酸盐超导方面有着广泛的应用。守恒电流 J 和应力张量 T 的相关函数携带了这些理论的基本信息。我们计算了 QED₃、QED₃--Gross--Neveu--Yukawa 和临界标量 QED₃ 中奇偶偶数三点函数 langle TJJrangle 和 langle TTTrangle 的第一个次领先大风味校正。对于 langle TJJrangle，我们研究了全局风味电流和拓扑 U(1) 电流，后者测量动态规范场的磁通量。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 三维阿贝尔规范理论在解禁量子临界性、狄拉克自旋液体和铜酸盐超导方面有着广泛的应用。守恒电流 J 和应力张量 T 的相关函数携带了这些理论的基本信息。我们计算了 QED₃、QED₃--Gross--Neveu--Yukawa 和临界标量 QED₃ 中奇偶偶数三点函数 langle TJJrangle 和 langle TTTrangle 的第一个次领先大风味校正。对于 langle TJJrangle，我们研究了全局风味电流和拓扑 U(1) 电流，后者测量动态规范场的磁通量。我们评估领先自由场轮廓消失的方向上的平坦空间能量通量。首先，这些方向上的通量由四粒子产生确定，从而对共形对撞机参数进行分析校正。我们独立于压扁球自由能导数来重现校正。与已知的两点归一化一起，对撞机参数固定每个相关器中两个独立张量结构的系数。我们的结果对于研究量子临界点附近的电导率和剪切响应以及强耦合规范理论中守恒电流和应力张量相关器的共形自举研究非常有用。

articles.title: Gutzwiller Quantum-Classical Embedding for Dynamics Simulations of Correlated Electron Systems
articles.title_zh: 用于相关电子系统动力学模拟的 Gutzwiller 量子经典嵌入
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.24592v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Simulating the real-time dynamics of correlated electron systems requires a nonperturbative treatment of local correlations over long times, a challenge for classical methods. We present the time-dependent Gutzwiller quantum-classical embedding framework, t-GQCE, for generic multi-orbital lattice models with time-dependent Hamiltonians. Within the time-dependent ghost Gutzwiller approximation, the lattice dynamics is mapped onto a noninteracting quasiparticle lattice, propagated classically, coupled to finite interacting embedding models propagated on quantum processors. The two parts exchange only embedding Hamiltonian parameters and single-particle density matrices, and the framework is agnostic to the quantum dynamics solver. We demonstrate it with adaptive variational quantum dynamics simulations of interaction quenches in the Hubbard model on the Bethe lattice. Without ghost orbitals, the embedding problem reduces to a single qubit, simulated on IBM quantum hardware with two qubits, including an ancilla. With more ghost orbitals, t-GQCE suppresses the artificial undamped oscillations of the conventional Gutzwiller approximation and approaches nonequilibrium dynamical mean-field theory results for weak and strong quenches. Statevector simulations with 2, 4 and 6 ghost orbitals per spin, or 8, 12 and 16 qubits, give adaptive circuits that follow the embedding states with infidelities below 5×10⁻⁴. Under trapped-ion noise models, circuit compression, measurements in rotated orbital bases with post-selection, and noise mitigation reduce the measurement errors severalfold. At one third of the error rates of a hardware-benchmarked noise model, they reach an accuracy of 0.01 for the single-particle density matrix and the double occupancy with 10⁵ shots per time step, and the Quantinuum H2-Emulator gives similar accuracy.
articles.abstract_zh: 模拟相关电子系统的实时动态需要长时间对局部相关性进行非微扰处理，这对经典方法来说是一个挑战。我们提出了时间相关的 Gutzwiller 量子经典嵌入框架 t-GQCE，用于具有时间相关哈密顿量的通用多轨道晶格模型。在与时间相关的幽灵古茨威勒近似中，晶格动力学被映射到非相互作用准粒子晶格上，以经典方式传播，耦合到在量子处理器上传播的有限相互作用嵌入模型。这两部分仅交换嵌入哈密顿参数和单粒子密度矩阵，并且该框架与量子动力学求解器无关。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 模拟相关电子系统的实时动态需要长时间对局部相关性进行非微扰处理，这对经典方法来说是一个挑战。我们提出了时间相关的 Gutzwiller 量子经典嵌入框架 t-GQCE，用于具有时间相关哈密顿量的通用多轨道晶格模型。在与时间相关的幽灵古茨威勒近似中，晶格动力学被映射到非相互作用准粒子晶格上，以经典方式传播，耦合到在量子处理器上传播的有限相互作用嵌入模型。这两部分仅交换嵌入哈密顿参数和单粒子密度矩阵，并且该框架与量子动力学求解器无关。我们通过贝特晶格上哈伯德模型中相互作用猝灭的自适应变分量子动力学模拟来证明这一点。如果没有鬼轨道，嵌入问题就会简化为单个量子位，并在具有两个量子位（包括一个辅助）的 IBM 量子硬件上进行模拟。凭借更多的鬼轨道，t-GQCE 抑制了传统 Gutzwiller 近似的人工无阻尼振荡，并接近弱和强猝灭的非平衡动态平均场理论结果。每个自旋具有 2、4 和 6 个鬼轨道或 8、12 和 16 个量子位的状态向量模拟给出了遵循嵌入状态的自适应电路，其不保真度低于 5×10⁻⁴。在俘获离子噪声模型下，电路压缩、旋转轨道基中的后选择测量以及噪声抑制可将测量误差减少数倍。在硬件基准噪声模型的错误率三分之一的情况下，单粒子密度矩阵和每个时间步长 10⁵ 次发射的双粒子占用精度达到 0.01，Quantinuum H2 仿真器也能提供类似的精度。

articles.title: Learning the Anyon Atlas
articles.title_zh: 学习 Anyon Atlas
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.24752v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We extend our previous search for the modular data of topological quantum field theories in 2+1 dimensions from 22 to 42 anyons, identifying 150,679 new modular data. We do so by adding to our algorithm three rejection gates, two of them based on logistic regression, that discard representations of SL(2,Z) unlikely to yield modular data. We estimate that roughly 80% of the modular data between ranks 23 and 42 has been identified after closing under known constructions. With this data, we find counterexamples to a conjecture of Geiko and Moore that the reality of the higher Gauss sums suffices for time-reversal symmetry in Chern-Simons theories, and propose a refined criterion. We demonstrate the scalability of this gated implementation by identifying prime modular data at rank 100 that is not realized by any Chern-Simons theory. The identified data through rank 42 has been made available at https://AnyonAtlas.org, to which further data will be added as it is found.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们将之前对 2+1 维度拓扑量子场论模块化数据的搜索从 22 个任意子扩展到 42 个任意子，识别出 150,679 个新的模块化数据。为此，我们在算法中添加了三个拒绝门，其中两个基于逻辑回归，丢弃不太可能产生模块化数据的 SL(2,Z) 表示。我们估计，在已知结构下关闭后，大约 80% 的 23 到 42 级之间的模块化数据已被识别。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们将之前对 2+1 维度拓扑量子场论模块化数据的搜索从 22 个任意子扩展到 42 个任意子，识别出 150,679 个新的模块化数据。为此，我们在算法中添加了三个拒绝门，其中两个基于逻辑回归，丢弃不太可能产生模块化数据的 SL(2,Z) 表示。我们估计，在已知结构下关闭后，大约 80% 的 23 到 42 级之间的模块化数据已被识别。利用这些数据，我们找到了 Geiko 和 Moore 的猜想的反例，即更高的高斯和的现实足以满足 Chern-Simons 理论中的时间反转对称性，并提出了一个改进的标准。我们通过识别任何 Chern-Simons 理论都无法实现的 100 级素数模块化数据来证明这种门控实现的可扩展性。排名 42 的已识别数据已在 https://AnyonAtlas.org 上提供，发现更多数据后将添加到其中。

articles.title: Low- and high-energy localization landscapes for tight-binding Hamiltonians in two-dimensional lattices
articles.title_zh: 二维晶格中紧束缚哈密顿量的低能和高能局域化景观
articles.abstract: arXiv:2210.00806v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Localization of electronic wave functions in modern two-dimensional (2D) materials such as graphene can impact drastically their transport and magnetic properties. The recent localization landscape (LL) theory has brought many tools and theoretical results to understand such localization phenomena in the continuous setting, but with very few extensions so far to the discrete realm or to tight-binding Hamiltonians. In this paper, we show how this approach can be extended to almost all known 2D~lattices, and propose a systematic way of designing LL even for higher dimensions. We demonstrate in detail how this LL theory works and predicts accurately not only the locations, but also the energies of localized eigenfunctions in the low and high energy regimes for the honeycomb and hexagonal lattices, making it a highly promising tool for investigating the role of disorder in these materials.
articles.abstract_zh: 现代二维 (2D) 材料（例如石墨烯）中电子波函数的局域化会极大地影响其输运和磁性。最近的定位景观（LL）理论带来了许多工具和理论成果来理解连续环境中的这种定位现象，但迄今为止很少扩展到离散领域或紧束缚哈密顿量。在本文中，我们展示了如何将这种方法扩展到几乎所有已知的 2D 晶格，并提出一种甚至对于更高维度的 LL 设计系统方法。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 现代二维 (2D) 材料（例如石墨烯）中电子波函数的局域化会极大地影响其输运和磁性。最近的定位景观（LL）理论带来了许多工具和理论成果来理解连续环境中的这种定位现象，但迄今为止很少扩展到离散领域或紧束缚哈密顿量。在本文中，我们展示了如何将这种方法扩展到几乎所有已知的 2D 晶格，并提出一种甚至对于更高维度的 LL 设计系统方法。我们详细演示了这种 LL 理论如何工作，不仅准确地预测位置，而且还准确预测蜂窝状和六方晶格的低能和高能区域中局部本征函数的能量，使其成为研究这些材料中无序作用的非常有前途的工具。

articles.title: Strong localization of microwaves beyond two dimensions in aperiodic Vogel spirals
articles.title_zh: 非周期沃格尔螺旋中微波超二维的强局域化
articles.abstract: arXiv:2307.12638v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Despite extensive studies, strong localization of electromagnetic waves in three dimensions has never been experimentally achieved. Stepping out of the paradigm of disordered systems, we carry out microwave transport experiments in planar aperiodic Vogel spiral arrays of cylinders with high dielectric permittivity. We characterize the electromagnetic modal structure in real space showing mixtures of long-lived modes with Gaussian, exponential, and power law spatial decay. This unique modal structure, which cannot be found in traditional periodic or disordered photonic materials, is shown to be at the origin of strong localization of electromagnetic waves that survives even in a three dimensional environment.
articles.abstract_zh: 尽管进行了广泛的研究，但电磁波在三维空间中的强局域化从未通过实验实现。走出无序系统的范式，我们在具有高介电常数的平面非周期沃格尔螺旋圆柱阵列中进行微波传输实验。我们描述了真实空间中的电磁模态结构，显示了长寿命模式与高斯、指数和幂律空间衰减的混合。这种独特的模态结构在传统的周期性或无序光子材料中是找不到的，它是电磁波强局域化的根源，即使在三维环境中也能存在。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 尽管进行了广泛的研究，但电磁波在三维空间中的强局域化从未通过实验实现。走出无序系统的范式，我们在具有高介电常数的平面非周期沃格尔螺旋圆柱阵列中进行微波传输实验。我们描述了真实空间中的电磁模态结构，显示了长寿命模式与高斯、指数和幂律空间衰减的混合。这种独特的模态结构在传统的周期性或无序光子材料中是找不到的，它是电磁波强局域化的根源，即使在三维环境中也能存在。

articles.title: Selective switch for band-edge alignments in pentagonal CdSeTe monolayer: Atom-valley locking
articles.title_zh: 五边形 CdSeTe 单层带边对准的选择性开关：原子谷锁定
articles.abstract: arXiv:2409.09625v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We propose an interesting concept named atom-valley locking (AVL) based on a two-dimensional nonmagnetic pentagonal CdSe2 monolayer. Here, "locking" refers to an atom-dependent valley distribution. Protected by the fourfold rotational reflection symmetry solely, two sets of valley electrons can be distinguished both in real space and momentum space. Next, we construct a ternary CdSeTe monolayer to introduce an intrinsic electric field into the structure without destroying the AVL feature. In momentum space, a spontaneous valley polarization of 187 meV that does not involve time-reversal symmetry can be observed. In real space, each set of the valley electrons can be associated with a distinct band-edge alignment (BEA). Then, we design a selective switch for BEAs via strain engineering, offering precise control of the valley-selective and face-specific hydrogen evolution reaction site. These results suggest that valleytronics holds great potential in the field of photocatalytic water splitting.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们提出了一个有趣的概念，称为基于二维非磁性五边形 CdSe2 单层的原子谷锁定（AVL）。这里，“锁定”是指依赖于原子的谷分布。仅在四重旋转反射对称性的保护下，两组谷电子在实空间和动量空间中都可以区分。接下来，我们构建了三元 CdSeTe 单层，在不破坏 AVL 特征的情况下将本征电场引入结构中。在动量空间中，可以观察到不涉及时间反转对称性的 187 meV 自发谷极化。在真实空间中，每组谷电子都可以与不同的带边排列（BEA）相关联。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们提出了一个有趣的概念，称为基于二维非磁性五边形 CdSe2 单层的原子谷锁定（AVL）。这里，“锁定”是指依赖于原子的谷分布。仅在四重旋转反射对称性的保护下，两组谷电子在实空间和动量空间中都可以区分。接下来，我们构建了三元 CdSeTe 单层，在不破坏 AVL 特征的情况下将本征电场引入结构中。在动量空间中，可以观察到不涉及时间反转对称性的 187 meV 自发谷极化。在真实空间中，每组谷电子都可以与不同的带边排列（BEA）相关联。然后，我们通过应变工程设计了 BEA 选择性开关，提供对谷选择性和面特异性析氢反应位点的精确控制。这些结果表明谷电子学在光催化水分解领域具有巨大的潜力。

articles.title: Current-induced torque in a MoS2-based device operating at room temperature
articles.title_zh: 室温下运行的 MoS2 基器件中的电流感应扭矩
articles.abstract: arXiv:2502.08483v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Charge-to-spin and spin-to-charge conversion mechanisms in high spin-orbit materials are the new frontier of memory devices. They operate via spin-orbit torque (SOT) switching of a magnetic electrode, driven by an applied charge current. In this work, we propose a novel memory device based on the semiconducting two-dimensional centrosymmetric transition metal dichalcogenide (TMD) MoS2, that operates as a SOT device in the writing process and as a non-local spin valve in the reading process. We demonstrate that stable voltage states at room temperature can be controlled by applied current and magnetic fields, owed to a locally tilted geometry and a differential voltage architecture. Ab initio calculations of orbital Hall effect (OHE) and spin Hall effect (SHE) indicate that the orbital Hall conductivity is constant and sizeable (750x(hbar/e) ohm-1 cm-1) throughout the conduction gap, while the spin Hall conductivity vanishes in the gap, thus pointing to the former as the most likely responsible for the generation of the SOT in the magnetic electrode, among intrinsic mechanisms. However, also extrinsic and interface spin-orbit mechanisms likely play a role. Our device concept may be competitive in terms of energy efficiency if an acceptable trade off with stability is obtained.
articles.abstract_zh: 高自旋轨道材料中的电荷到自旋和自旋到电荷转换机制是存储器件的新领域。它们通过磁性电极的自旋轨道扭矩（SOT）开关进行工作，并由所施加的充电电流驱动。在这项工作中，我们提出了一种基于半导体二维中心对称过渡金属二硫化物（TMD）MoS2的新型存储器件，该器件在写入过程中作为SOT器件，在读取过程中作为非局部自旋阀运行。我们证明，由于局部倾斜的几何结构和差分电压架构，可以通过施加的电流和磁场来控制室温下的稳定电压状态。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 高自旋轨道材料中的电荷到自旋和自旋到电荷转换机制是存储器件的新领域。它们通过磁性电极的自旋轨道扭矩（SOT）开关进行工作，并由所施加的充电电流驱动。在这项工作中，我们提出了一种基于半导体二维中心对称过渡金属二硫化物（TMD）MoS2的新型存储器件，该器件在写入过程中作为SOT器件，在读取过程中作为非局部自旋阀运行。我们证明，由于局部倾斜的几何结构和差分电压架构，可以通过施加的电流和磁场来控制室温下的稳定电压状态。轨道霍尔效应（OHE）和自旋霍尔效应（SHE）的从头计算表明，在整个导通间隙中，轨道霍尔电导率是恒定且相当大的（750x(hbar/e) ohm-1 cm-1），而自旋霍尔电导率在间隙中消失，因此表明在内在机制中，前者最有可能是磁性电极中SOT生成的原因。然而，外在和界面自旋轨道机制也可能发挥作用。如果获得可接受的稳定性权衡，我们的设备概念在能源效率方面可能具有竞争力。

articles.title: Coherent shear wave in crystalline Si upon sub-threshold femtosecond laser-induced excitation
articles.title_zh: 亚阈值飞秒激光诱导激发晶体硅中的相干剪切波
articles.abstract: arXiv:2503.10420v5 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Material processing with femtosecond lasers has attracted enormous attention because of its potential for technology and industrial applications. In parallel, time-resolved x-ray diffraction has been successfully used to study ultrafast structural distortion dynamics in semiconductor thin films or surface layers. However, real-world processing applications mostly are concerned with bulk materials, which prevents the use of x-ray surface based techniques. For processing applications, a fast and depth-sensitive probe is needed. To address this, we present a novel technique based on ultrafast x-ray dynamical diffraction (UDD) capable of imaging transient strain distributions inside bulk crystals upon laser excitation. This pump-probe technique provides a complete picture of thetemporal evolution of ultrafast distorted lattice depth profiles. We demonstrate the potential of UDD by studying a thin Si single crystal upon single pulse femtosecond optical excitation. Our study reveals that below the melting threshold strong lattice distortions not only longitudinal, but also transversal to the propagation of the strain wave appear on picosecond time scales along the single crystal. The observation of this transversal deformation after laser excitation contradicts previous work that were not able to observed it, what could be related to the high sensitivity of dynamical diffraction with respect to the lattice distortions. The speed of propagation of this ultrafast transversal strain deformation is observed to be slower to the longitudinal sound speed for Si as described in the bibliography.
articles.abstract_zh: 飞秒激光材料加工因其技术和工业应用的潜力而引起了极大的关注。与此同时，时间分辨 X 射线衍射已成功用于研究半导体薄膜或表面层的超快结构畸变动力学。然而，现实世界的加工应用主要涉及散装材料，这阻碍了基于 X 射线表面的技术的使用。对于加工应用，需要快速且对深度敏感的探头。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了一种基于超快 X 射线动态衍射 (UDD) 的新技术，能够在激光激发下对块状晶体内部的瞬态应变分布进行成像。这种泵浦探测技术提供了超快扭曲晶格深度分布的时间演化的完整图像。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 飞秒激光材料加工因其技术和工业应用的潜力而引起了极大的关注。与此同时，时间分辨 X 射线衍射已成功用于研究半导体薄膜或表面层的超快结构畸变动力学。然而，现实世界的加工应用主要涉及散装材料，这阻碍了基于 X 射线表面的技术的使用。对于加工应用，需要快速且对深度敏感的探头。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了一种基于超快 X 射线动态衍射 (UDD) 的新技术，能够在激光激发下对块状晶体内部的瞬态应变分布进行成像。这种泵浦探测技术提供了超快扭曲晶格深度分布的时间演化的完整图像。我们通过研究单脉冲飞秒光激发下的薄硅单晶来展示 UDD 的潜力。我们的研究表明，低于熔化阈值，沿着单晶的皮秒时间尺度上不仅会出现纵向的应变波传播，而且会出现横向的应变波传播的横向晶格畸变。激光激发后对这种横向变形的观察与之前无法观察到它的工作相矛盾，这可能与动态衍射对晶格畸变的高灵敏度有关。如参考文献中所述，观察到这种超快横向应变变形的传播速度比 Si 的纵向声速慢。

articles.title: Millisecond-long electron spin lifetime in CsPbI₃ perovskite nanocrystals revealed by optically detected magnetic resonance
articles.title_zh: 通过光学检测磁共振揭示 CsPbI₃ 钙钛矿纳米晶体中毫秒长的电子自旋寿命
articles.abstract: arXiv:2603.03038v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Perovskite nanocrystals are a convenient model system for optical spin orientation and manipulation. However, its real potential might be underestimated due to the incomplete knowledge on spin relaxation times, which are obscured by the limited sensitivity of measurement techniques as well as by the insufficient understanding of the spin relaxation mechanisms in perovskites. In this work, we study the spin relaxation of charge carriers in perovskite nanocrystals both experimentally and theoretically. We address the electron and hole spins in CsPbI₃ nanocrystals embedded in a glass matrix by the resonant spin inertia technique based on optically detected magnetic resonance. It allows us to determine the longitudinal spin relaxation time T₁ separately for electrons and holes, the g factors, and the effective Overhauser field of the nuclear spin bath. At a temperature of 1.6 K, the T₁ time for electrons can be as long as 0.9 ms. We reveal the effect of the time-varying nuclear field fluctuations, which enhances the electron spin relaxation at low magnetic fields, and measure a rather long nuclear spin correlation time of about 56 μs. We develop a model of the spin relaxation in nanocrystals based on a two-LO-phonon Raman process, which explains the observed temperature dependence of the time T₁.
articles.abstract_zh: 钙钛矿纳米晶体是用于光学自旋定向和操纵的便捷模型系统。然而，由于对自旋弛豫时间的了解不完整，测量技术的灵敏度有限以及对钙钛矿自旋弛豫机制的了解不足，其真正潜力可能被低估。在这项工作中，我们从实验和理论上研究了钙钛矿纳米晶体中电荷载流子的自旋弛豫。我们通过基于光学检测磁共振的自旋惯性共振技术来解决嵌入玻璃基体中的 CsPbI₃ 纳米晶体中的电子和空穴自旋问题。它使我们能够分别确定电子和空穴的纵向自旋弛豫时间 T1、g 因子以及核自旋浴的有效 Overhauser 场。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 钙钛矿纳米晶体是用于光学自旋定向和操纵的便捷模型系统。然而，由于对自旋弛豫时间的了解不完整，测量技术的灵敏度有限以及对钙钛矿自旋弛豫机制的了解不足，其真正潜力可能被低估。在这项工作中，我们从实验和理论上研究了钙钛矿纳米晶体中电荷载流子的自旋弛豫。我们通过基于光学检测磁共振的自旋惯性共振技术来解决嵌入玻璃基体中的 CsPbI₃ 纳米晶体中的电子和空穴自旋问题。它使我们能够分别确定电子和空穴的纵向自旋弛豫时间 T1、g 因子以及核自旋浴的有效 Overhauser 场。在 1.6 K 的温度下，电子的 T1 时间可长达 0.9 ms。我们揭示了时变核场波动的影响，它增强了低磁场下的电子自旋弛豫，并测量了约 56 μs 的相当长的核自旋相关时间。我们开发了一个基于双 LO 声子拉曼过程的纳米晶体自旋弛豫模型，该模型解释了观察到的时间 T₁ 的温度依赖性。

articles.title: UniMatSim: A High-Throughput Materials Simulation Automation Framework Based on Universal Machine Learning Potentials
articles.title_zh: UniMatSim：基于通用机器学习潜力的高通量材料模拟自动化框架
articles.abstract: arXiv:2603.15294v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Universal machine learning interatomic potentials (UMLIPs) offer accuracy close to first-principles calculations at a fraction of the cost, showing significant potential for large-scale material simulations. However, the fragmented UMLIPs ecosystem lacks unified interface standards and integration frameworks, hindering their automated deployment in high-throughput workflows. To address this, we present UniMatSim, a modular Python framework. It systematically integrates various UMLIPs (e.g., CHGNet, M3GNet, MACE) and automates workflows from structural optimization to stability verification. The framework enables seamless model switching via abstracted interfaces, incorporates task orchestration, and provides standardized modules for key properties (elasticity, phonons, molecular dynamics), including automated handling for low-dimensional materials. As a test case, using the 2D Lieb lattice system, we constructed a multi-stage high-throughput screening workflow covering structural optimization, elastic stability, and phonon spectrum calculations. Starting from 1,176 candidate compositions, a four-model consensus pipeline yields 393 stable structures. These are refined by magnetic-state screening and DFT band-structure calculations to 59 Lieb-lattice candidates with staggered-magnetic-band characteristics. Results show UniMatSim significantly improves computational efficiency and reproducibility, providing a reliable infrastructure for data-driven materials discovery and design.
articles.abstract_zh: 通用机器学习原子间势 (UMLIP) 的精度接近第一性原理计算，而成本却很低，显示出大规模材料模拟的巨大潜力。然而，碎片化的UMLIP生态系统缺乏统一的接口标准和集成框架，阻碍了它们在高吞吐量工作流程中的自动化部署。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了 UniMatSim，一个模块化的 Python 框架。它系统地集成了各种 UMLIP（例如 CHGNet、M3GNet、MACE），并自动化了从结构优化到稳定性验证的工作流程。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 通用机器学习原子间势 (UMLIP) 的精度接近第一性原理计算，而成本却很低，显示出大规模材料模拟的巨大潜力。然而，碎片化的UMLIP生态系统缺乏统一的接口标准和集成框架，阻碍了它们在高吞吐量工作流程中的自动化部署。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了 UniMatSim，一个模块化的 Python 框架。它系统地集成了各种 UMLIP（例如 CHGNet、M3GNet、MACE），并自动化了从结构优化到稳定性验证的工作流程。该框架可以通过抽象接口实现无缝模型切换，整合任务编排，并为关键属性（弹性、声子、分子动力学）提供标准化模块，包括低维材料的自动处理。作为测试用例，我们使用 2D Lieb 晶格系统构建了一个多阶段高通量筛选工作流程，涵盖结构优化、弹性稳定性和声子谱计算。从 1,176 个候选组合开始，四模型共识管道产生 393 个稳定结构。这些通过磁态筛选和 DFT 能带结构计算进行细化，得到具有交错磁带特性的 59 个李布晶格候选者。结果表明 UniMatSim 显着提高了计算效率和再现性，为数据驱动的材料发现和设计提供了可靠的基础设施。

articles.title: Millisecond spin relaxation times of distinct electron and hole subensembles in MAₓFA₁₋ₓPbI₃ perovskite crystals
articles.title_zh: MAₓFA₁₋ₓPbI₃钙钛矿晶体中不同电子和空穴子系综的毫秒自旋弛豫时间
articles.abstract: arXiv:2604.06887v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The unique combination of outstanding optical quality and attractive spin properties opens new avenues for optical spin control in hybrid organic-inorganic perovskite semiconductors. Using the optically detected magnetic resonance technique, we study the spins of electrons and holes in mixed-cation MAₓFA₁₋ₓPbI₃ single crystals with x = 0.4 and 0.8. Multiple distinct spin subensembles with absolute values of g-factor spanning from 2.9 to 3.5 for electrons and from 0.5 to 1.6 for holes are resolved, revealing diverse localization environments. We measure the longitudinal spin relaxation times, T₁, reaching 2 ms and remaining in the μs range even for weakly localized carriers at cryogenic temperatures. The magnetic-field dependence of T₁ is dominated by the random nuclear (Overhauser) fields with strengths of sim 0.5 mT for electrons and sim 5-12 mT for holes. The corresponding correlation times of the hyperfine field are determined by carrier hopping between shallow localization sites. The temperature dependence of T₁ reveals a weak localization potential of the charge carriers and shows a correlation between T₁ and the inhomogeneity of the spin ensemble. These results establish mixed-A-site perovskite single crystals as a promising solid-state platform with long-lived spin states for quantum information applications.
articles.abstract_zh: 出色的光学质量和有吸引力的自旋特性的独特结合，为有机-无机杂化钙钛矿半导体的光学自旋控制开辟了新途径。利用光学检测磁共振技术，我们研究了 x = 0.4 和 0.8 的混合阳离子 MAₓFA₁₋ₓPbI₃ 单晶中电子和空穴的自旋。解析了多个不同的自旋子系综，电子的 g 因子绝对值从 2.9 到 3.5，空穴的 g 因子绝对值从 0.5 到 1.6，揭示了不同的局域环境。我们测量了纵向自旋弛豫时间 T₁，即使对于低温下的弱局域载流子，也达到 2 ms 并保持在 μs 范围内。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 出色的光学质量和有吸引力的自旋特性的独特结合，为有机-无机杂化钙钛矿半导体的光学自旋控制开辟了新途径。利用光学检测磁共振技术，我们研究了 x = 0.4 和 0.8 的混合阳离子 MAₓFA₁₋ₓPbI₃ 单晶中电子和空穴的自旋。解析了多个不同的自旋子系综，电子的 g 因子绝对值从 2.9 到 3.5，空穴的 g 因子绝对值从 0.5 到 1.6，揭示了不同的局域环境。我们测量了纵向自旋弛豫时间 T₁，即使对于低温下的弱局域载流子，也达到 2 ms 并保持在 μs 范围内。 T₁ 的磁场依赖性主要由随机核 (Overhauser) 场主导，电子强度为 sim 0.5 mT，空穴强度为 sim 5-12 mT。超精细场的相应相关时间由浅层定位位点之间的载流子跳跃确定。 T₁的温度依赖性揭示了载流子的弱局域化潜力，并显示了T₁和自旋系综的不均匀性之间的相关性。这些结果确立了混合 A 位钙钛矿单晶作为一种有前途的固态平台，具有长寿命的自旋态，适用于量子信息应用。

articles.title: Textured phase diagrams of featureless insulators
articles.title_zh: 无特征绝缘体的纹理相图
articles.abstract: arXiv:2605.20339v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We study phase diagrams of charge-conserving `class A' non-interacting fermions, focusing on the trivial phase in various dimensions. Such phases are usually termed `featureless' to distinguish them from those others with either symmetry-broken or topological order. We show that the presence of non-trivial topological families of states, including charge pumps and their generalizations, results in phase diagrams being endowed with non-trivial topological textures that can be visualized through Berry phases and their higher-dimensional generalizations. We show that for non-interacting fermion systems with translation invariance, these `higher' Berry phases can be computed using integrals of non-abelian Chern-Simons forms of the Berry-Bloch connection over momentum and parameter spaces. Singularities in these textures correspond to gap-closing loci of `diabolical points', which represent the obstruction to contracting topologically non-trivial families of states, and bulk-boundary correspondence results in a locus of robust boundary modes that terminate at the bulk diabolical points. In the presence of finite chemical potential, we argue that the edge modes are generically robust without any need for fine-tuning for two and higher dimensions, whereas in one dimension they are `estranged' in the phase diagram, i.e. appearing at different parameter values for different edges. We demonstrate our results by constructing several microscopic models of non-interacting fermions.
