We argue stability to interactions and explore proximate phase diagrams by mapping to continuum field theories.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们研究电荷守恒“A 类”非相互作用费米子的相图，重点关注各个维度的平凡相。这些相通常被称为“无特征”，以将它们与其他具有对称破缺或拓扑顺序的相区分开来。我们证明，非平凡拓扑族的存在，包括电荷泵及其概括，导致相图被赋予非平凡的拓扑纹理，可以通过贝里相及其高维概括来可视化。我们证明，对于具有平移不变性的非相互作用费米子系统，这些“更高”的 Berry 相位可以使用 Berry-Bloch 连接在动量和参数空间上的非阿贝尔 Chern-Simons 形式的积分来计算。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们研究电荷守恒“A 类”非相互作用费米子的相图，重点关注各个维度的平凡相。这些相通常被称为“无特征”，以将它们与其他具有对称破缺或拓扑顺序的相区分开来。我们证明，非平凡拓扑族的存在，包括电荷泵及其概括，导致相图被赋予非平凡的拓扑纹理，可以通过贝里相及其高维概括来可视化。我们证明，对于具有平移不变性的非相互作用费米子系统，这些“更高”的 Berry 相位可以使用 Berry-Bloch 连接在动量和参数空间上的非阿贝尔 Chern-Simons 形式的积分来计算。这些纹理中的奇点对应于“恶魔点”的间隙闭合轨迹，它代表了收缩拓扑非平凡状态族的障碍，而体边界对应导致了终止于体恶魔点的鲁棒边界模式轨迹。在存在有限化学势的情况下，我们认为边缘模式通常是鲁棒的，不需要对二维和更高维度进行微调，而在一维中，它们在相图中“疏远”，即出现在不同边缘的不同参数值处。我们通过构建几个非相互作用费米子的微观模型来展示我们的结果。我们论证相互作用的稳定性，并通过映射到连续介质场理论来探索近似相图。

articles.title: Irreversibility Enhances Quantum-Enhanced Markov-Chain Monte Carlo
articles.title_zh: 不可逆性增强了量子增强马尔可夫链蒙特卡罗
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.23350v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Detailed balance underlies conventional Markov-chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) algorithms. Yet in classical systems, breaking detailed balance generates irreversible probability currents and can accelerate sampling. Whether irreversibility can similarly enhance quantum MCMC remains an intriguing question. Here we show that irreversibility provides a new route to improving the quantum-enhanced MCMC (QEMC), which combines quantum proposals with classical acceptance. By integrating quantum-generated candidate paths with allocations of probability flows, we develop an irreversible quantum-enhanced Monte Carlo (IQEMC). On spin-glass benchmarks, IQEMC improves the spectral gap over QEMC with a polynomial scaling advantage as the system size increases. In addition to numerically demonstrating faster convergence of magnetization estimates, we verify this improvement experimentally on a quantum processor. The results establish irreversibility as a physically grounded mechanism for enhancing quantum MCMC.
articles.abstract_zh: 详细的平衡是传统马尔可夫链蒙特卡罗 (MCMC) 算法的基础。然而在经典系统中，打破细节平衡会产生不可逆的概率电流，并可以加速采样。不可逆性是否能够同样增强量子 MCMC 仍然是一个有趣的问题。在这里，我们证明不可逆性为改进量子增强 MCMC（QEMC）提供了一条新途径，它将量子提议与经典接受相结合。通过将量子生成的候选路径与概率流分配相结合，我们开发了一种不可逆的量子增强蒙特卡罗（IQEMC）。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 详细的平衡是传统马尔可夫链蒙特卡罗 (MCMC) 算法的基础。然而在经典系统中，打破细节平衡会产生不可逆的概率电流，并可以加速采样。不可逆性是否能够同样增强量子 MCMC 仍然是一个有趣的问题。在这里，我们证明不可逆性为改进量子增强 MCMC（QEMC）提供了一条新途径，它将量子提议与经典接受相结合。通过将量子生成的候选路径与概率流分配相结合，我们开发了一种不可逆的量子增强蒙特卡罗（IQEMC）。在自旋玻璃基准测试中，随着系统尺寸的增加，IQEMC 可以通过多项式缩放优势改善 QEMC 的光谱间隙。除了在数值上证明磁化估计的更快收敛之外，我们还在量子处理器上通过实验验证了这种改进。结果将不可逆性确立为增强量子 MCMC 的物理基础机制。

articles.title: Bobkingite, a new coupled sawtooth chain platform
articles.title_zh: Bobkingite，新型耦合锯齿链平台
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.26243v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We investigate the mineral bobkingite, Cu₅(OH)₈Cl₂(H₂O)₂, as a potential realization of the sawtooth chain. Using ab initio methods, we estimate the magnetic exchange couplings and find that bobkingite hosts quasi-one-dimensional sawtooth chains, with residual three-dimensional interactions strongly suppressed by the crystal geometry. Examining the full exchange network, we find that the classical model exhibits an extensive manifold of nearly degenerate states with emergent two-dimensional character, which spin-wave theory shows to persist as Ising degrees of freedom. Unlike other sawtooth candidates, bobkingite has negligible vertical interchain coupling, preserving a one-dimensional degeneracy even in the presence of ordering, suggesting that any long-range order is weak. Thermal fluctuations stabilize a finite-temperature regime of multiplanar fluctuations rooted in the classical chain degeneracy, whose spin correlations resemble those of the quantum sawtooth chain, suggesting the persistence of quantum features in the full model. This makes bobkingite a compelling platform for exploring sawtooth chain physics.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们研究了矿物铁矿，Cu₅(OH)₈Cl2(H2O)2，作为锯齿链的潜在实现。使用从头算方法，我们估计了磁交换耦合，发现 bobkingite 具有准一维锯齿链，残余的三维相互作用受到晶体几何形状的强烈抑制。检查完整的交换网络，我们发现经典模型表现出大量具有新兴二维特征的近简并态，自旋波理论表明其以伊辛自由度持续存在。与其他锯齿候选者不同，bobkingite 的垂直链间耦合可以忽略不计，即使在存在有序的情况下也保持一维简并性，这表明任何长程有序都很弱。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们研究了矿物铁矿，Cu₅(OH)₈Cl2(H2O)2，作为锯齿链的潜在实现。使用从头算方法，我们估计了磁交换耦合，发现 bobkingite 具有准一维锯齿链，残余的三维相互作用受到晶体几何形状的强烈抑制。检查完整的交换网络，我们发现经典模型表现出大量具有新兴二维特征的近简并态，自旋波理论表明其以伊辛自由度持续存在。与其他锯齿候选者不同，bobkingite 的垂直链间耦合可以忽略不计，即使在存在有序的情况下也保持一维简并性，这表明任何长程有序都很弱。热涨落稳定了源于经典链简并性的多平面涨落的有限温度状态，其自旋相关性类似于量子锯齿链，表明量子特征在整个模型中的持久性。这使得 bobkingite 成为探索锯齿链物理的引人注目的平台。

articles.title: Delayed Formation of Landau Polaritons in Phase-Resolved THz Spectroscopy
articles.title_zh: 相位分辨太赫兹光谱中朗道极化子的延迟形成
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.29501v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Strong light-matter coupling gives rise to polaritons through coherent and periodic energy exchange between electromagnetic cavity fields and material excitations. While this interaction is typically inferred from spectral mode splitting, its dynamics remain largely unexplored. Here, using phase-resolved terahertz time-domain spectroscopy, we observe vacuum Rabi oscillations of Landau polaritons formed by coupling the cyclotron resonance in a GaAs/AlGaAs two-dimensional electron gas with Fabry-Perot cavity modes. By employing cross-polarized spectroscopy and magnetic-field differential, we resolve the temporal beating of the cyclotron resonance oscillations. Supported by a quantum electrodynamic model, we show that the vacuum Rabi oscillations start after a delay corresponding to one cavity round-trip time. This demonstrates that the strong coupling regime sets up only after the formation of the cavity mode field. Our results provide direct insight into the dynamics of hybrid light-matter states in the THz regime.
articles.abstract_zh: 强光-物质耦合通过电磁腔场和材料激发之间的相干和周期性能量交换产生极化激元。虽然这种相互作用通常是从光谱模式分裂中推断出来的，但其动力学在很大程度上仍未被探索。在这里，我们使用相位分辨太赫兹时域光谱，观察了通过将 GaAs/AlGaAs 二维电子气中的回旋共振与法布里-珀罗腔模式耦合而形成的朗道极化激元的真空拉比振荡。通过采用交叉偏振光谱和磁场微分，我们解决了回旋加速器共振振荡的时间跳动。在量子电动力学模型的支持下，我们表明真空拉比振荡在对应于一个腔往返时间的延迟后开始。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 强光-物质耦合通过电磁腔场和材料激发之间的相干和周期性能量交换产生极化激元。虽然这种相互作用通常是从光谱模式分裂中推断出来的，但其动力学在很大程度上仍未被探索。在这里，我们使用相位分辨太赫兹时域光谱，观察了通过将 GaAs/AlGaAs 二维电子气中的回旋共振与法布里-珀罗腔模式耦合而形成的朗道极化激元的真空拉比振荡。通过采用交叉偏振光谱和磁场微分，我们解决了回旋加速器共振振荡的时间跳动。在量子电动力学模型的支持下，我们表明真空拉比振荡在对应于一个腔往返时间的延迟后开始。这表明强耦合机制仅在腔模场形成后才建立。我们的结果提供了对太赫兹范围内混合光物质态动力学的直接见解。

articles.title: XPCS-Echo and broad relaxation measurements using a bunch-mode data acquisition scheme
articles.title_zh: 使用束模式数据采集方案的 XPCS-Echo 和宽弛豫测量
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.02645v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Echoes observed in the intensity-intensity autocorrelation functions [g₂(q, τ)] is a powerful method for probing nonaffine deformations and yielding behavior of soft viscoelastic materials subjected to an oscillatory shear. Multispeckle X-ray photon correlation spectroscopy (XPCS) measurements of large number of echoes with high time resolution impose severe constraints in terms of the computational hardware and potential degradation of the sample. These issues are alleviated by implementing a bunch-mode data acquisition scheme in which the highest resolution frames or bunches centered at the echo peaks. In addition, by placing the bunches in an aperiodic Fibonacci sequence, g₂(q, τ) over a long time span can be measured with orders of magnitude lesser number of frames. The performance of these XPCS acquisition schemes is demonstrated using slowly relaxing model colloidal suspensions. Furthermore, an analytical expression is provided for the quantitative description of full g₂(q, τ).
articles.abstract_zh: 在强度-强度自相关函数 [g2(q, τ)] 中观察到的回波是探测软粘弹性材料在振荡剪切作用下的非仿射变形和屈服行为的有效方法。具有高时间分辨率的大量回波的多斑 X 射线光子相关光谱 (XPCS) 测量在计算硬件和样品的潜在退化方面施加了严格的限制。通过实施束模式数据采集方案可以缓解这些问题，其中最高分辨率的帧或束以回波峰值为中心。此外，通过将束放置在非周期斐波那契序列中，可以使用较少数量的帧来测量较长时间跨度内的 g2(q, τ)。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在强度-强度自相关函数 [g2(q, τ)] 中观察到的回波是探测软粘弹性材料在振荡剪切作用下的非仿射变形和屈服行为的有效方法。具有高时间分辨率的大量回波的多斑 X 射线光子相关光谱 (XPCS) 测量在计算硬件和样品的潜在退化方面施加了严格的限制。通过实施束模式数据采集方案可以缓解这些问题，其中最高分辨率的帧或束以回波峰值为中心。此外，通过将束放置在非周期斐波那契序列中，可以使用较少数量的帧来测量较长时间跨度内的 g2(q, τ)。这些 XPCS 采集方案的性能通过缓慢松弛模型胶体悬浮液进行了演示。此外，还提供了完整的g2(q,τ)的定量描述的解析表达式。

articles.title: Landscape geometry of Majorana zero modes in inhomogeneous superconductors
articles.title_zh: 非均匀超导体中马约拉纳零模的景观几何
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.18138v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Conventional methods for characterizing Majorana zero modes in inhomogeneous superconductors generally cannot be applied directly when the potential profile is unknown. To address this limitation, we propose a real-space approach based on a landscape for the zero-energy spatial dynamics. The landscape geometry determines the number of Majorana zero modes, and the conventional topological phase transition is recovered as a geometric transition of the landscape in the homogeneous limit. Without specifying detailed spatial profiles, the approach yields analytical bounds on Hamiltonian parameters and their spatial gradients that guarantee Majorana zero modes. Application to nanowire--superconductor systems demonstrates the predictive power of this profile-independent criterion and quantifies tolerable electrostatic inhomogeneity for Majorana-device design. Landscape geometry thus offers a dynamical perspective with broad applicability to topological boundary states.
articles.abstract_zh: 当电势分布未知时，通常不能直接应用表征非均匀超导体中马约拉纳零模式的传统方法。为了解决这个限制，我们提出了一种基于零能量空间动力学景观的实空间方法。景观几何决定了马约拉纳零模的数量，传统的拓扑相变被恢复为均匀极限下景观的几何转变。在不指定详细空间剖面的情况下，该方法产生哈密顿参数及其空间梯度的分析界限，保证马约拉纳零模式。纳米线-超导体系统的应用证明了这种与轮廓无关的标准的预测能力，并量化了马约拉纳器件设计的可容忍静电不均匀性。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 当电势分布未知时，通常不能直接应用表征非均匀超导体中马约拉纳零模式的传统方法。为了解决这个限制，我们提出了一种基于零能量空间动力学景观的实空间方法。景观几何决定了马约拉纳零模的数量，传统的拓扑相变被恢复为均匀极限下景观的几何转变。在不指定详细空间剖面的情况下，该方法产生哈密顿参数及其空间梯度的分析界限，保证马约拉纳零模式。纳米线-超导体系统的应用证明了这种与轮廓无关的标准的预测能力，并量化了马约拉纳器件设计的可容忍静电不均匀性。因此，景观几何提供了一种对拓扑边界态具有广泛适用性的动态视角。

articles.title: Surface Charge--Potential Relation for Spherical Particles in Electrolyte Solutions
articles.title_zh: 表面电荷--电解质溶液中球形颗粒的电势关系
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.03613v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Predicting the relationship between surface charge density and electrostatic potential for spherical particles remains a fundamental challenge in colloid science. Because the governing non-linear Poisson--Boltzmann equation lacks a general exact analytical solution, researchers typically rely on numerical calculations or various semi-empirical approximations. In this paper, we overcome these limitations by developing a dual-asymptotic framework that provides explicit, closed-form expressions for this surface charge--potential relationship across the entire spectrum of particle curvature. For weakly curved systems, where the Debye length λ_D is much smaller than the particle radius R (λ_D/R ll 1), a formal mathematical derivation rigorously establishes the Ohshima--Healy--White formula as an exact regular perturbation expansion. Conversely, for highly curved spheres (R/λ_D ll 1), we employ singular perturbation analysis using the scaled particle radius as the small parameter. This approach provides a first-principles mathematical justification for the spherical Debye--Hückel theory, proving that its leading-order expansion remains asymptotically exact within the full non-linear Poisson--Boltzmann framework due to the geometric deactivation of non-linearity. Crucially, we map the exact limits of this geometric regulation, demonstrating how non-linear screening re-emerges as the particle radius increases, with the breakdown threshold governed by the interplay between curvature and surface charge density.
articles.abstract_zh: 预测球形颗粒的表面电荷密度和静电势之间的关系仍然是胶体科学中的一个基本挑战。由于控制非线性泊松-玻尔兹曼方程缺乏通用的精确解析解，研究人员通常依赖于数值计算或各种半经验近似。在本文中，我们通过开发一个双渐近框架克服了这些限制，该框架为整个粒子曲率谱上的表面电荷-电势关系提供了明确的封闭式表达式。对于弱弯曲系统，德拜长度 λ_D 远小于粒子半径 R (λ_D/R ll 1)，形式数学推导严格将 Ohshima--Healy--White 公式建立为精确的正则扰动展开式。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 预测球形颗粒的表面电荷密度和静电势之间的关系仍然是胶体科学中的一个基本挑战。由于控制非线性泊松-玻尔兹曼方程缺乏通用的精确解析解，研究人员通常依赖于数值计算或各种半经验近似。在本文中，我们通过开发一个双渐近框架克服了这些限制，该框架为整个粒子曲率谱上的表面电荷-电势关系提供了明确的封闭式表达式。对于弱弯曲系统，德拜长度 λ_D 远小于粒子半径 R (λ_D/R ll 1)，形式数学推导严格将 Ohshima--Healy--White 公式建立为精确的正则扰动展开式。相反，对于高度弯曲的球体 (R/λ_D ll 1)，我们采用奇异摄动分析，使用缩放粒子半径作为小参数。这种方法为球面德拜-休克尔理论提供了第一性原理数学论证，证明由于非线性的几何失活，其主阶展开式在完全非线性泊松-玻尔兹曼框架内保持渐近精确。至关重要的是，我们绘制了这种几何规则的精确极限，展示了随着粒子半径的增加，非线性筛选如何重新出现，击穿阈值由曲率和表面电荷密度之间的相互作用决定。

articles.title: Defect-limited thermal transport in AlN using pretrained machine-learning interatomic potentials
articles.title_zh: 使用预训练的机器学习原子间势在 AlN 中进行缺陷限制热传输
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.08013v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Aluminum nitride (AlN) is an important thermal management material whose high lattice thermal conductivity is strongly suppressed by oxygen impurities. We investigate phonon scattering by oxygen-related defects using pretrained universal machine-learning interatomic potentials (MLIPs), molecular dynamics (MD), and phonon Boltzmann transport calculations. Several pretrained MLIPs are benchmarked against density functional theory for phonon dispersions and pristine thermal conductivity. To balance accuracy and computational speed, we use a fine-tuned version of the compact SevenNet-Nano model for MD simulations. Monte Carlo annealing supports the formation of bound VAₗ(O_N)₃ complexes, whose scattering differs from that of their isolated constituents. Defect scattering rates extracted from excess spectral energy density (SED) linewidths agree reasonably with harmonic T-matrix predictions at low oxygen contents, supporting the independent-scatterer approximation. Incorporating these rates into an iterative Boltzmann transport equation with Bose--Einstein statistics yields thermal conductivities comparable to experimental values and captures their observed decrease with oxygen content. At high concentrations, however, the scattering rate deviates from linear scaling with oxygen content, suggesting limitations of independent-defect and pristine-phonon descriptions. These results demonstrate an efficient approach using pretrained MLIPs to quantify defect-limited thermal transport and provide insights into impurity effects beyond the dilute-defect approximation.
articles.abstract_zh: 氮化铝（AlN）是一种重要的热管理材料，其高晶格热导率受到氧杂质的强烈抑制。我们使用预先训练的通用机器学习原子间势 (MLIP)、分子动力学 (MD) 和声子玻尔兹曼输运计算来研究与氧相关的缺陷引起的声子散射。几个预训练的 MLIP 以声子色散和原始热导率的密度泛函理论为基准。为了平衡精度和计算速度，我们使用紧凑 SevenNet-Nano 模型的微调版本进行 MD 模拟。蒙特卡罗退火支持结合 VAₗ(O_N)₃ 配合物的形成，其散射与其孤立成分的散射不同。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 氮化铝（AlN）是一种重要的热管理材料，其高晶格热导率受到氧杂质的强烈抑制。我们使用预先训练的通用机器学习原子间势 (MLIP)、分子动力学 (MD) 和声子玻尔兹曼输运计算来研究与氧相关的缺陷引起的声子散射。几个预训练的 MLIP 以声子色散和原始热导率的密度泛函理论为基准。为了平衡精度和计算速度，我们使用紧凑 SevenNet-Nano 模型的微调版本进行 MD 模拟。蒙特卡罗退火支持结合 VAₗ(O_N)₃ 配合物的形成，其散射与其孤立成分的散射不同。从过量光谱能量密度 (SED) 线宽中提取的缺陷散射率与低氧含量下的谐波 T 矩阵预测相当一致，支持独立散射体近似。将这些速率与玻色-爱因斯坦统计数据结合到迭代玻尔兹曼传输方程中，可得到与实验值相当的热导率，并捕获观察到的热导率随氧含量的变化。然而，在高浓度下，散射率偏离与氧含量的线性比例，这表明独立缺陷和原始声子描述的局限性。这些结果证明了一种使用预训练的 MLIP 来量化缺陷限制热传输的有效方法，并提供了对稀缺陷近似之外的杂质影响的深入了解。

articles.title: Native-oxide-driven layer asymmetry, two-step switching and exchange bias in Co/Ir/Co trilayers
articles.title_zh: Co/Ir/Co三层结构中由原生氧化物驱动的层不对称性、两步开关和交换偏置
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.33595v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Uncapped heavy-metal/ferromagnet stacks carry a native oxide on the top ferromagnetic layer. We show that this oxide makes the nominally identical Co layers of sputtered Si/Co/Ir/Co trilayers (tCₒ = 2--10~nm) magnetically inequivalent and governs their reversal. X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy shows oxidation confined to the top surface, where about 1.1~nm of Co forms a CoO-rich layer about 2~nm thick, making the top layer's magnetic thickness about 1.1~nm smaller than the bottom layer's. On warming in 200~Oe after zero-field cooling, the magnetization rises in sharp steps between 171 and 248~K, marking thermally activated switching of continuous layers rather than superparamagnetic blocking; 4 and 6~nm stacks switch their layers separately. Below about 250~K, the antiferromagnetic oxide pins the metallic Co beneath it strongly when 1--2~nm remain (4~nm stack), giving coercivity above 1~kOe and loop shifts of about 50~Oe. A native oxide produces layer asymmetry, two-step switching, and low-temperature exchange bias.
articles.abstract_zh: 未覆盖的重金属/铁磁体叠层在顶部铁磁层上带有天然氧化物。我们表明，这种氧化物使得溅射 Si/Co/Ir/Co 三层 (tCₒ = 2--10~nm) 中名义上相同的 Co 层磁力不相等，并控制它们的反转。 X射线光电子能谱显示氧化仅限于顶面，其中约1.1~nm的Co形成约2~nm厚的富CoO层，使得顶层的磁性厚度比底层的磁性厚度小约1.1~nm。零场冷却后升温至 200~Oe 时，磁化强度在 171 至 248~K 之间急剧上升，标志着连续层的热激活切换而不是超顺磁阻挡；
articles.abstract_zh_full: 未覆盖的重金属/铁磁体叠层在顶部铁磁层上带有天然氧化物。我们表明，这种氧化物使得溅射 Si/Co/Ir/Co 三层 (tCₒ = 2--10~nm) 中名义上相同的 Co 层磁力不相等，并控制它们的反转。 X射线光电子能谱显示氧化仅限于顶面，其中约1.1~nm的Co形成约2~nm厚的富CoO层，使得顶层的磁性厚度比底层的磁性厚度小约1.1~nm。零场冷却后升温至 200~Oe 时，磁化强度在 171 至 248~K 之间急剧上升，标志着连续层的热激活切换而不是超顺磁阻挡； 4 和 6~nm 堆栈分别交换它们的层。低于约 250~K，当 1--2~nm 剩余时（4~nm 堆叠），反铁磁氧化物将金属 Co 牢固地固定在其下方，从而提供高于 1~kOe 的矫顽力和约 50~Oe 的环位移。原生氧化物会产生层不对称、两步切换和低温交换偏压。

articles.title: Enhancement of Weak Interactions in Phase Transitions in Condensed Matter and Early Universe
articles.title_zh: 凝聚态和早期宇宙相变中弱相互作用的增强
articles.abstract: arXiv:2509.14701v4 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Parity-violating weak interactions produce extremely small energy differences between left- and right-handed chiral systems. We show that these microscopic effects may be amplified during collective phenomena such as phase transitions. The enhancement factor is proportional to the critical number of atoms, N_c, in the nucleus of the new phase. Measurement of the ratio of produced left- and right-handed chiral structures may provide a way to determine N_c. Experiments in which spin-chiral structures are formed in ZnCr₂Se₄ during a phase transition in crossed electric and magnetic fields indicate an effective amplification corresponding to N_csim 10⁹-10¹⁰. We emphasize, however, that such large values cannot be inferred from homogeneous capillary nucleation alone, since the same parameters imply a very large nucleation barrier; in real crystals heterogeneous nucleation, defects, strain, and domain-growth dynamics may be essential. We also discuss, more cautiously, whether analogous collective enhancement could operate in first-order cosmological phase transitions beyond the Standard Model. The Standard-Model electroweak transition for the observed Higgs mass is a crossover and therefore has no critical bubble nucleus.
articles.abstract_zh: 违反宇称的弱相互作用在左手性和右手性手性系统之间产生极小的能量差异。我们表明，这些微观效应可能在相变等集体现象中被放大。增强因子与新相核中原子的临界数量 N_c 成正比。测量产生的左手性和右手性手性结构的比率可以提供一种确定 N_c 的方法。在交叉电场和磁场中相变过程中 ZnCr2Se4 中形成自旋手性结构的实验表明，对应于 N_csim 10⁹-1010 的有效放大。然而，我们强调，如此大的值不能仅从均匀毛细管成核推断出来，因为相同的参数意味着非常大的成核势垒；
articles.abstract_zh_full: 违反宇称的弱相互作用在左手性和右手性手性系统之间产生极小的能量差异。我们表明，这些微观效应可能在相变等集体现象中被放大。增强因子与新相核中原子的临界数量 N_c 成正比。测量产生的左手性和右手性手性结构的比率可以提供一种确定 N_c 的方法。在交叉电场和磁场中相变过程中 ZnCr2Se4 中形成自旋手性结构的实验表明，对应于 N_csim 10⁹-1010 的有效放大。然而，我们强调，如此大的值不能仅从均匀毛细管成核推断出来，因为相同的参数意味着非常大的成核势垒；在真实晶体中，异质成核、缺陷、应变和域生长动力学可能至关重要。我们还更谨慎地讨论类似的集体增强是否可以在标准模型之外的一阶宇宙相变中运行。观察到的希格斯质量的标准模型电弱跃迁是交叉的，因此不存在临界气泡核。

articles.title: Spin disorder competing with positional symmetry breaking governs the metal-insulator behavior in oxide paramagnets
articles.title_zh: 自旋无序与位置对称性破缺竞争控制着氧化物顺磁体中的金属-绝缘体行为
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.14624v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Numerous transition-metal oxides have low-temperature, long-range-ordered antiferromagnetic (AFM) states that are generally insulating, and high-temperature, disordered paramagnetic (PM) phases. The latter can be either insulating (predicted here for NaFeO3), or metallic (predicted here and previously observed in NaOsO3). Similar distinctions have been traditionally affected in strongly correlated models by the value used for Coulomb repulsion U. Here we show an alternative, strong-correlation-free (U=0) view suggesting that the distinction between insulating and metallic PM phases is governed by the competition between local magnetic moment disorder and the polymorphous distribution of off-center atomic displacements. Such parameter-free, energy-lowering symmetry breaking density functional calculations provide a framework for understanding metal-insulator behaviors across different quantum materials in terms of measurable local structural and magnetic parameters.
articles.abstract_zh: 许多过渡金属氧化物具有通常绝缘的低温长程有序反铁磁 (AFM) 态和高温无序顺磁 (PM) 相。后者可以是绝缘的（此处预测为 NaFeO3），也可以是金属的（此处预测且之前在 NaOsO3 中观察到）。传统上，在强相关模型中，库仑斥力 U 所用的值会影响类似的区别。在这里，我们展示了另一种无强相关性 (U=0) 的观点，表明绝缘相和金属 PM 相之间的区别是由局部磁矩无序与偏心原子位移的多态分布之间的竞争决定的。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 许多过渡金属氧化物具有通常绝缘的低温长程有序反铁磁 (AFM) 态和高温无序顺磁 (PM) 相。后者可以是绝缘的（此处预测为 NaFeO3），也可以是金属的（此处预测且之前在 NaOsO3 中观察到）。传统上，在强相关模型中，库仑斥力 U 所用的值会影响类似的区别。在这里，我们展示了另一种无强相关性 (U=0) 的观点，表明绝缘相和金属 PM 相之间的区别是由局部磁矩无序与偏心原子位移的多态分布之间的竞争决定的。这种无参数、能量降低的对称破缺密度泛函计算提供了一个框架，用于根据可测量的局部结构和磁性参数来理解不同量子材料的金属-绝缘体行为。

articles.title: Electrons Hopping across a Molecular Network: Spectra and Symmetries
articles.title_zh: 电子在分子网络中的跃迁：谱和对称性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.14687v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: We investigate interacting spinless electrons on finite molecular networks described by a tight-binding Hubbard Hamiltonian. The interplay between network geometry, Coulomb interactions and discrete symmetries is analysed for rings with L=3,4,5,6 nodes, filled with one, two or three electrons. Special attention is devoted to the role of the network symmetries in determining the structure of the many-body spectrum and the Mulliken classification of the eigenstates. Using group-theoretical methods, we examine the evolution of the spectra in the presence of an external magnetic flux. The Zeeman effect lifts degeneracies and results in combination with the Coulomb interaction to avoided crossings in symmetry sectors. We identify a qualitatively distinction between systems with an even and odd number of particles. At half-filling, particle-hole symmetry (duality) protects selected symmetry sectors against Zeeman splitting.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们研究了由紧束缚哈伯德哈密顿量描述的有限分子网络上相互作用的无自旋电子。对具有L=3、4、5、6个节点且填充一个、两个或三个电子的环，分析了网络几何结构、库仑相互作用和离散对称性之间的相互作用。特别关注网络对称性在确定多体谱结构和本征态的穆肯分类方面的作用。我们使用群论方法，研究了在存在外部磁通量的情况下谱的演化。塞曼效应消除了简并性，并与库仑相互作用相结合，避免了对称扇区中的交叉。我们确定了粒子数为偶数和奇数的系统之间的定性区别。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们研究了由紧束缚哈伯德哈密顿量描述的有限分子网络上相互作用的无自旋电子。对具有L=3、4、5、6个节点且填充一个、两个或三个电子的环，分析了网络几何结构、库仑相互作用和离散对称性之间的相互作用。特别关注网络对称性在确定多体谱结构和本征态的穆肯分类方面的作用。我们使用群论方法，研究了在存在外部磁通量的情况下谱的演化。塞曼效应消除了简并性，并与库仑相互作用相结合，避免了对称扇区中的交叉。我们确定了粒子数为偶数和奇数的系统之间的定性区别。在半填充时，粒子-空穴对称性（对偶性）保护选定的对称性扇区免受塞曼裂分的影响。

articles.title: Flip rate prediction in the double pendulum
articles.title_zh: 双摆的翻转率预测
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.20276v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: The intermediate-energy double pendulum is a prototypical chaotic system. Despite its irregular motion, it exhibits recurrent flips--events in which one of the arms passes over the top. We develop a statistical prediction for the mean flip rate in terms of phase-space flux. Applying this flux-based approach to the equal-mass, equal-arm ("egalitarian") double pendulum, we find excellent agreement between the statistical prediction and numerical simulations: ensemble-averaged flip rates agree to within 1%, while even the statistics of individual chaotic trajectories agree at the few-percent level, quantifying the validity of the ergodic approximation. This agreement holds for flips of either arm and over a broad range of energies. This flux-based approach is closely related to that used for the egalitarian three-body system. A central role is played by the saddle orbits: periodic orbits that tend to the periodic saddle eigenmode as the energy approaches the saddle energy from above and approximately follow the ridge of the potential at higher energies. These orbits provide a natural dividing surface for defining flips while avoiding recrossings. Indeed, the resulting distribution of crossing times exhibits a distinct gap. It is argued that the corresponding flux-over-a-saddle prediction provides a preferred realization of the flux-based approach. We also present two simplified alternative dividing surfaces, including one based on a remarkably accurate analytic approximation to the saddle orbits, and show that both yield statistical predictions in agreement with the corresponding simulated rates.
articles.abstract_zh: 中等能量双摆是一种典型的混沌系统。尽管其运动不规则，但它会表现出反复翻转——即其中一个摆臂越过顶部的事件。我们从相空间通量的角度，对平均翻转率进行了统计预测。将这种基于通量的方法应用于等质量、等臂（“平等”）双摆，我们发现统计预测与数值模拟之间具有极佳的一致性：系综平均翻转率的一致性在1%以内，即使单个混沌轨迹的统计数据也具有几个百分点的一致性，从而量化了遍历近似的有效性。这种一致性适用于任一摆臂的翻转，并且适用于广泛的能量范围。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 中等能量双摆是一种典型的混沌系统。尽管其运动不规则，但它会表现出反复翻转——即其中一个摆臂越过顶部的事件。我们从相空间通量的角度，对平均翻转率进行了统计预测。将这种基于通量的方法应用于等质量、等臂（“平等”）双摆，我们发现统计预测与数值模拟之间具有极佳的一致性：系综平均翻转率的一致性在1%以内，即使单个混沌轨迹的统计数据也具有几个百分点的一致性，从而量化了遍历近似的有效性。这种一致性适用于任一摆臂的翻转，并且适用于广泛的能量范围。这种基于通量的方法与用于平等三体系统的方法密切相关。鞍点轨道起着核心作用：当能量从上方接近鞍点能量时，这些周期轨道趋向于周期鞍点本征模，并在较高能量下大致沿着势能的脊线。这些轨道为定义翻转提供了一个天然的分界面，同时避免了再次穿越。事实上，由此产生的穿越时间分布显示出明显的间隙。有人认为，相应的鞍点通量预测提供了基于通量方法的首选实现方式。我们还提出了两个简化的替代分界面，其中一个基于鞍点轨道的极其精确的解析近似，并表明这两个分界面均可得出与相应模拟速率一致的统计预测。

articles.title: Multi-Species Multi-Reaction Model Parametrization of a Commercial NCA Positive Electrode from Half-Cell Open-Circuit Potential Data
articles.title_zh: 基于半电池开路电位数据的商用NCA正极多组分多反应模型参数化
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.24922v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Physics-based models of lithium-ion batteries require the open-circuit potential (OCP) of each electrode as a function of its lithiation. The multi-species multi-reaction (MSMR) model provides a compact, thermodynamically grounded description of this relationship, representing each insertion reaction by a standard potential, a site fraction and a disorder parameter. Here, we parametrize the MSMR model for nickel-cobalt-aluminum oxide (NCA), a cathode chemistry widespread in automotive cells, using the positive electrode of a commercial silicon-graphite/NCA cell. Cathode material was harvested from a pristine cell and from cells cycle-aged to the end of life under two state-of-charge windows, and its half-cell OCP was measured by slow galvanostatic cycling. Smooth differential-capacity curves were obtained by histogram counting, and the charge and discharge branches were fitted with a constrained, scale-invariant optimization that keeps every reaction anchored to a visible peak. We report the first MSMR parameter set for an NCA cathode and show, through a differential-capacity peak analysis across aging states, that its thermodynamic signature is essentially unchanged by aging. This finding supports the common modeling practice of holding the electrode's intrinsic parameters fixed and ascribing aging to electrode-level capacity and alignment changes.
articles.abstract_zh: 基于物理学的锂离子电池模型需要每个电极的开路电位（OCP）作为其锂化的函数。多物种多反应（MSMR）模型对这种关系提供了简洁、基于热力学的描述，用标准电势、位点分数和无序参数来表示每种嵌入反应。在这里，我们使用商用硅-石墨/NCA电池的正极对镍钴铝氧化物（NCA）的MSMR模型进行参数化，NCA是一种在汽车电池中广泛使用的正极材料。阴极材料取自全新电池以及在两个充电状态窗口下循环老化至报废的电池，并通过慢速恒电流循环测量其半电池OCP。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 基于物理学的锂离子电池模型需要每个电极的开路电位（OCP）作为其锂化的函数。多物种多反应（MSMR）模型对这种关系提供了简洁、基于热力学的描述，用标准电势、位点分数和无序参数来表示每种嵌入反应。在这里，我们使用商用硅-石墨/NCA电池的正极对镍钴铝氧化物（NCA）的MSMR模型进行参数化，NCA是一种在汽车电池中广泛使用的正极材料。阴极材料取自全新电池以及在两个充电状态窗口下循环老化至报废的电池，并通过慢速恒电流循环测量其半电池OCP。通过直方图计数获得了平滑的差分容量曲线，并对充电和放电分支进行了受约束的、尺度不变的优化拟合，使每个反应都锚定在一个可见的峰值上。我们报告了NCA正极的第一个MSMR参数集，并通过对不同老化状态下的差分容量峰值分析表明，其热力学特征基本不受老化影响。这一发现支持了将电极的固有参数保持不变并将老化归因于电极水平的容量和排列变化的常见建模做法。

articles.title: Reusing formal Vlasov-Maxwell proofs to certify plasma solver outputs
articles.title_zh: 重复使用形式化的弗拉索夫-麦克斯韦证明来验证等离子体求解器的输出
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.23319v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: AI now produces machine-checked mathematics faster than researchers can read it. Can such theorems do practical computational work? We reuse one from mboxOpenAI's Lean~4 relativistic Vlasov--Maxwell library: initial fields determine the field at an outside point until plasma signals reach it, and the energy leaving a surrounding box before they reach its faces. New Lean proofs and numerical bounds give particle-free references for particle-in-cell simulations across three tasks. Domain size follows analytically from observation time, exposing boundary and initialization errors in WarpX and Smilei that global energy checks missed. Grid choice can be tested directly: combining two coarse grids recovers unknown plasma inputs within tolerance at a median 14.9-fold speedup over a fine grid, where the medium grid alone fails. For reduced models, the bounds establish the minimum number of time curves needed to predict energy loss.
articles.abstract_zh: 现在，人工智能生成机器检查的数学结果的速度比研究人员阅读的速度更快。这样的定理能否用于实际的计算工作？我们复用了mboxOpenAI的Lean~4相对论Vlasov-Maxwell库中的一个定理：初始场决定了外部一点的场，直到等离子体信号到达该点，以及能量在到达周围盒子的面之前离开该盒子。新的Lean证明和数值界限为三项任务中的粒子团模拟提供了无粒子参考。域大小可从观测时间中解析得出，从而揭示了WarpX和Smilei中被全局能量检查所遗漏的边界和初始化误差。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 现在，人工智能生成机器检查的数学结果的速度比研究人员阅读的速度更快。这样的定理能否用于实际的计算工作？我们复用了mboxOpenAI的Lean~4相对论Vlasov-Maxwell库中的一个定理：初始场决定了外部一点的场，直到等离子体信号到达该点，以及能量在到达周围盒子的面之前离开该盒子。新的Lean证明和数值界限为三项任务中的粒子团模拟提供了无粒子参考。域大小可从观测时间中解析得出，从而揭示了WarpX和Smilei中被全局能量检查所遗漏的边界和初始化误差。网格选择可以直接进行测试：将两个粗网格相结合，可以在容差范围内恢复未知的等离子体输入，与细网格相比，速度提高了14.9倍，而仅使用中等网格则无法做到这一点。对于简化模型，边界确定了预测能量损失所需的时间曲线的最小数量。

articles.title: The Barrel Imaging Calorimeter of the ePIC detector at the Electron-Ion Collider
articles.title_zh: 电子离子对撞机ePIC探测器的桶形成像量热仪
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.23457v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The Electron-Ion Collider (EIC) is a next-generation facility expected to address fundamental open questions in nuclear physics, including the structure and dynamics of gluons in nucleons and nuclei. The Barrel Imaging Calorimeter (BIC) is the electromagnetic calorimeter of the ePIC detector, designed to meet the stringent performance requirements of the EIC, providing precise measurements and particle identification of scattered electrons, photons, and neutral mesons. The BIC is a high-granularity sampling calorimeter based on lead absorbers interleaved with scintillating fibers, complemented by pixelated imaging layers based on the AstroPix monolithic active pixel sensor. This hybrid design enables both accurate energy and position measurements, as well as three-dimensional shower reconstruction, making it a key component for realizing the full physics potential of the EIC. The BIC has successfully completed its Preliminary Design Review last year and is currently progressing toward the Final Design Review. In this talk, I will present an overview of the BIC concept and focus on its current status and performance results from bench tests, system integration studies, and recent beam tests.
articles.abstract_zh: 电子离子对撞机（EIC）是一座新一代设施，有望解决核物理学中的基本未决问题，包括核子和原子核中胶子的结构和动力学。桶形成像量热仪（BIC）是ePIC探测器的电磁量热仪，旨在满足EIC的严格性能要求，为散射电子、光子和中性介子提供精确的测量和粒子鉴别。BIC是一种高粒度采样量热仪，基于铅吸收体与闪烁纤维交错排列，并辅以基于AstroPix单片有源像素传感器的像素化成像层。这种混合设计既能实现精确的能量和位置测量，又能实现三维簇射重建，因此成为EIC充分发挥物理潜力的关键组件。
authors: for the ePIC Barrel Imaging Calorimeter
articles.abstract_zh_full: 电子离子对撞机（EIC）是一座新一代设施，有望解决核物理学中的基本未决问题，包括核子和原子核中胶子的结构和动力学。桶形成像量热仪（BIC）是ePIC探测器的电磁量热仪，旨在满足EIC的严格性能要求，为散射电子、光子和中性介子提供精确的测量和粒子鉴别。BIC是一种高粒度采样量热仪，基于铅吸收体与闪烁纤维交错排列，并辅以基于AstroPix单片有源像素传感器的像素化成像层。这种混合设计既能实现精确的能量和位置测量，又能实现三维簇射重建，因此成为EIC充分发挥物理潜力的关键组件。BIC去年已成功完成初步设计评审，目前正在推进最终设计评审。在本次演讲中，我将概述BIC的概念，并重点介绍其当前状态以及台架试验、系统集成研究和近期束流试验的性能结果。

articles.title: Sub-Doppler Cooling of Potassium-41 in a Hybrid Quadrupole-Octupole Symmetry Magneto-Optical Trap
articles.title_zh: 混合四极-八极对称性磁光阱中的钾-41亚多普勒冷却
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.23466v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Sub-Doppler cooling processes rely on the near-degeneracy of the Zeeman sub-levels of the atom. Effective sub-Doppler cooling is only achieved when the ac-Stark shift of the molasses light is significantly larger than the Zeeman shift. This condition is typically achieved by switching off all magnetic gradients, and using Helmholtz coils to cancel Earth's magnetic field. Another way to achieve a nearly zero magnetic field gradient is to superimpose a second pair of oppositely oriented quadrupole coils with a different spatial geometry. At the ideal current ratio, this creates an octupole-symmetry magnetic field for the atoms. The resulting octupole magnetic field has a gradient increasing quadratically from zero at the center. In this work, the effectiveness of sub-Doppler cooling and trapping using D2 and D1 light is evaluated in such a hybrid trap for ⁴¹K. The temperature, lifetime, and phase-space density of the atoms are measured. For both D2 and D1 light, the octupole MOT is found to have a longer lifetime, while maintaining a similar temperature to the zero-field case. D1 gray-molasses temperatures down to 3.8(1)~μK and phase-space density up to 5.3(4)×10⁻⁵ are measured for 14.3(1)×10⁶ ⁴¹ atoms. The effectiveness of the hybrid quadrupole-octupole trap suggests the possibility of increasing the loading time for atoms into an optical dipole trap with active sub-Doppler cooling.
articles.abstract_zh: 亚多普勒冷却过程依赖于原子塞曼子能级的近简并性。只有当 molasses 光的交流斯塔克位移显著大于塞曼位移时，才能实现有效的亚多普勒冷却。通常通过关闭所有磁梯度并使用亥姆霍兹线圈抵消地磁场来实现这一条件。实现近乎零磁场梯度的另一种方法是叠加第二对方向相反、空间几何形状不同的四极线圈。在理想的电流比下，这会为原子产生一个八极对称磁场。由此产生的八极磁场的梯度从中心的零开始以二次方式增加。在本文中，我们评估了在这种⁴¹K混合阱中使用D2和D1光进行亚多普勒冷却和俘获的有效性。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 亚多普勒冷却过程依赖于原子塞曼子能级的近简并性。只有当 molasses 光的交流斯塔克位移显著大于塞曼位移时，才能实现有效的亚多普勒冷却。通常通过关闭所有磁梯度并使用亥姆霍兹线圈抵消地磁场来实现这一条件。实现近乎零磁场梯度的另一种方法是叠加第二对方向相反、空间几何形状不同的四极线圈。在理想的电流比下，这会为原子产生一个八极对称磁场。由此产生的八极磁场的梯度从中心的零开始以二次方式增加。在本文中，我们评估了在这种⁴¹K混合阱中使用D2和D1光进行亚多普勒冷却和俘获的有效性。测量了原子的温度、寿命和相空间密度。对于D2和D1光，八极磁场MOT的寿命更长，同时保持与零磁场情况相似的温度。对14.3(1)×10⁶个⁴¹K原子测量到D1灰 molasses冷却温度低至3.8(1)~μK，相空间密度高达5.3(4)×10⁻⁵。混合四极-八极阱的有效性表明，有可能通过主动亚多普勒冷却来延长原子进入光学偶极阱的加载时间。

articles.title: Galilean invariance of Hamiltonian guiding center theory
articles.title_zh: 哈密顿导向中心理论的伽利略不变性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.23468v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Galilean invariance is a desired property for classical non-relativistic theories. Guiding center theory describes the slow drift motion of charged particles in strong magnetic fields. While one can guarantee a Hamiltonian formulation to all orders, it was previously unknown whether such a theory can possess Galilean symmetry. We show that specific first- and second-order guiding center models are Galilean invariant. Furthermore, we prove that one can ensure Galilean invariance to all orders.
articles.abstract_zh: 伽利略不变性是经典非相对论理论的理想性质。导向中心理论描述了带电粒子在强磁场中的缓慢漂移运动。虽然可以保证所有阶的哈密顿表述，但此前尚不清楚此类理论是否具有伽利略对称性。我们证明了特定的一阶和二阶导向中心模型具有伽利略不变性。此外，我们证明了可以确保所有阶的伽利略不变性。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 伽利略不变性是经典非相对论理论的理想性质。导向中心理论描述了带电粒子在强磁场中的缓慢漂移运动。虽然可以保证所有阶的哈密顿表述，但此前尚不清楚此类理论是否具有伽利略对称性。我们证明了特定的一阶和二阶导向中心模型具有伽利略不变性。此外，我们证明了可以确保所有阶的伽利略不变性。

articles.title: Analytic guiding center formulas for bounce-transit motion in a concentric circular, finite inverse aspect ratio tokamak geometry
articles.title_zh: 同心圆有限反向纵横比托卡马克几何结构中反跳-穿越运动的解析导向中心公式
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.23481v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Bounce-transit motion in concentric circular magnetic geometry is typically analyzed in the limit that the inverse aspect ratio, ε, is small. We prove that this approximation is not necessary to study a concentric circular geometry by deriving new analytical formulas while retaining a non-zero ε. We use these formulas to demonstrate that the approximation is robust for ε lesssim 0.3.
articles.abstract_zh: 同心圆形磁性几何结构中的反弹-穿越运动通常在反长宽比ε很小的极限条件下进行分析。我们通过在保留非零ε的同时推导出新的解析公式，证明了这种近似对于研究同心圆形几何形状来说并非必要。我们使用这些公式来证明，当ε小于或等于0.3时，该近似值是稳健的。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 同心圆形磁性几何结构中的反弹-穿越运动通常在反长宽比ε很小的极限条件下进行分析。我们通过在保留非零ε的同时推导出新的解析公式，证明了这种近似对于研究同心圆形几何形状来说并非必要。我们使用这些公式来证明，当ε小于或等于0.3时，该近似值是稳健的。

articles.title: DIVO: a direct divertor configuration plasma start-up scheme aimed at tokamak fusion reactors
articles.title_zh: DIVO：一种针对托卡马克聚变反应堆的直接偏滤器配置等离子体启动方案
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.23895v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The tokamak, one of the mainstream approaches to magnetic confinement in nuclear fusion devices, will be the first approach to reach reactor class prototyping. Plasma start-up is expected to be more challenging in large superconducting next-step tokamaks such as ITER due to the low inductive toroidal electric field and potentially long durations in limiter configuration when plasma-wall interactions lead to easier impurity contamination of the confined plasma. Such limiter start-up is the standard way of early plasma formation in the vast majority of today's experimental devices and is planned on ITER. To mitigate these issues, a novel plasma start-up scheme with divertor geometry only (DIVO start-up) was recently developed for the first time on the EAST superconducting tokamak. The key breakthrough in this work is the use of a non-inductive, electron cyclotron wave generated plasma formed in a poloidal field configuration which is a superposition of a barrel-like geometry around the centre of the vacuum vessel and a mirror-like geometry across the whole vessel cross-section. Such a non-inductive discharge avoids the drawback of low inductive electric field which is unavoidable in large superconducting devices as a consequence of the relatively low voltages which can be applied to the magnet coils. In addition to the low toroidal electric field, the DIVO start-up scheme as demonstrated on EAST significantly reduces impurity sources compared to the conventional limiter phase approach, even in cases with relatively poorly conditioned plasma-facing surfaces. The robustness of the DIVO start-up has also been verified on EAST with varying prefill gas pressure, impurity level and inductive electric field. It thus offers a potential solution to one of the main issues facing routine successful start-up on large tokamak reactors.
articles.abstract_zh: 托卡马克是核聚变装置中磁约束的主流方法之一，将是首个达到反应堆级原型制造的方法。在ITER等大型超导下一代托卡马克中，等离子体起动预计将更具挑战性，原因在于感应环形电场较低，且在限制器配置中可能持续时间较长，此时等离子体与壁的相互作用会导致被约束的等离子体更容易受到杂质污染。这种限幅器起动是当今绝大多数实验装置中早期等离子体形成的标准方式，并且计划在ITER上采用。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 托卡马克是核聚变装置中磁约束的主流方法之一，将是首个达到反应堆级原型制造的方法。在ITER等大型超导下一代托卡马克中，等离子体起动预计将更具挑战性，原因在于感应环形电场较低，且在限制器配置中可能持续时间较长，此时等离子体与壁的相互作用会导致被约束的等离子体更容易受到杂质污染。这种限幅器起动是当今绝大多数实验装置中早期等离子体形成的标准方式，并且计划在ITER上采用。为了缓解这些问题，最近在EAST超导托卡马克上首次开发了一种仅采用偏滤器几何形状的新型等离子体起动方案（DIVO起动）。这项工作的关键突破在于使用非感应电子回旋波产生的等离子体，该等离子体形成于箍场配置中，该配置是真空容器中心周围桶状几何形状与整个容器横截面镜面状几何形状的叠加。这种非感应放电避免了低感应电场的缺点，而由于可以施加到磁线圈的电压相对较低，这种缺点在大型超导器件中是不可避免的。除了低环向电场外，正如在EAST上所展示的那样，与传统的限幅器阶段方法相比，DIVO起动方案显著减少了杂质源，即使在面向等离子体的表面条件相对较差的情况下也是如此。在EAST上，通过改变预充气体压力、杂质水平和感应电场，也验证了DIVO起动的稳健性。因此，它为大型托卡马克反应堆常规成功启动所面临的主要问题之一提供了一种潜在的解决方案。

articles.title: Scattering features of a self-dual spectral singularity in coupled ring resonators with balanced gain and loss
articles.title_zh: 具有平衡增益和损耗的耦合环形谐振器中自对偶谱奇点的散射特性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.23959v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We theoretically and numerically discuss the general scattering property of a coupled two-ring-resonators externally coupled to a straight bus waveguide. Specifically, we require one ring resonator to be light field amplifying and another to be that dissipative, where the associated attenuation and gain factors for a field amplitude after one-round trip are formed in a reciprocal pair as well as the effective wave propagation constants are same. Obtained from reciprocity and an effective PT-symmetric transfer matrix, we exploit parametrization to propose a general phase diagram, identifying overall scattering outcomes. Especially, we find that the formation of a self-dual spectral singularity, namely coherent perfect absorption-lasing (CPAL), is occurred at a certain relation of a coupling coefficient and an attenuation factor as well as resonant whispering gallery modes. Reducing light amplification and dissipation strengths in each rings narrows the spectral bandwidth associated with CPAL. We further discover that any system with the CPAL parameters would exhibit a same scattering feature: transmission extinction, CPAL, and uni-directional reflectionless at the loss ring side, with respect to an incident wavelength. Additionally, a transmission extinction can be away from the resonance. These analytical predictions are verified by electromagnetic simulations.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们从理论和数值上讨论了两个耦合环形谐振器外部耦合到一条直线总线波导的一般散射特性。具体而言，我们要求一个环形谐振器是光场放大器，另一个是耗散器，其中，经过一圈往返后，场振幅的关联衰减系数和增益系数以互易对的形式形成，并且有效波传播常数相同。我们从互易性和有效的PT对称转移矩阵出发，利用参数化方法提出了一个通用的相图，从而确定了整体散射结果。特别地，我们发现，自对偶谱奇点的形成，即相干完美吸收-激光（CPAL），发生在耦合系数和衰减系数以及谐振绕射模的某种关系下。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们从理论和数值上讨论了两个耦合环形谐振器外部耦合到一条直线总线波导的一般散射特性。具体而言，我们要求一个环形谐振器是光场放大器，另一个是耗散器，其中，经过一圈往返后，场振幅的关联衰减系数和增益系数以互易对的形式形成，并且有效波传播常数相同。我们从互易性和有效的PT对称转移矩阵出发，利用参数化方法提出了一个通用的相图，从而确定了整体散射结果。特别地，我们发现，自对偶谱奇点的形成，即相干完美吸收-激光（CPAL），发生在耦合系数和衰减系数以及谐振绕射模的某种关系下。降低每个环中的光放大和耗散强度会使与CPAL相关的光谱带宽变窄。我们进一步发现，对于入射波长，任何具有CPAL参数的系统都会表现出相同的散射特征：透射消光、CPAL以及损耗环侧的单向无反射。此外，透射消光可以远离共振。这些分析预测已通过电磁仿真得到验证。

articles.title: A Lie-Group Approach to Alfvénic Turbulence: The SO(3) Rotational p-model
articles.title_zh: 阿尔文湍流的李群方法：SO(3)旋转p模型
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.24009v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The inner heliosphere is permeated by fully developed, highly intermittent nonlinear turbulence. Conventional stochastic models synthesize these multiscale fluctuations by injecting additive noise within a flat Euclidean space. However, such approaches fundamentally violate the topological constraints of ideal magnetohydrodynamics, inadvertently breaking the kinetic incompressibility of the plasma and introducing spurious magnetic compressibility. To preserve the exact geometrical invariants of Alfvénic fluctuations, a novel mathematical framework is presented: the rotational p-model. By mapping a multifractal singular measure directly into the Lie algebra mathfrakso(3) and integrating the associated stochastic differential equations in the Stratonovich sense on the spherical manifold S², the model generates highly intermittent, scale-dependent rotational dynamics. This Lie-group formulation conserves the magnetic field modulus while perfectly reproducing the fractional spectral envelopes and the non-Gaussian directional intermittency observed in space plasmas. Furthermore, by isolating purely directional reorientations, the framework provides exact analytical control over the waiting time statistics of magnetic intermittent bursts and the multifractal scaling exponents of angular deflections, offering a powerful new paradigm for the study of nonlinear turbulent phenomena.
articles.abstract_zh: 内日球层充满了充分发展、高度间歇性的非线性湍流。传统的随机模型通过在平坦的欧几里得空间内注入加性噪声来合成这些多尺度波动。然而，这种方法从根本上违反了理想磁流体动力学的拓扑约束，无意中破坏了等离子体的动力学不可压缩性，并引入了虚假的磁性可压缩性。为了保留阿尔文波涨落的确切几何不变量，本文提出了一种新颖的数学框架：旋转p模型。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 内日球层充满了充分发展、高度间歇性的非线性湍流。传统的随机模型通过在平坦的欧几里得空间内注入加性噪声来合成这些多尺度波动。然而，这种方法从根本上违反了理想磁流体动力学的拓扑约束，无意中破坏了等离子体的动力学不可压缩性，并引入了虚假的磁性可压缩性。为了保留阿尔文波涨落的确切几何不变量，本文提出了一种新颖的数学框架：旋转p模型。该模型将多重分形奇异测度直接映射到李代数 mathfrakso(3)，并在球面流形 S² 上以斯特拉托诺维奇意义积分相关的随机微分方程，从而产生高度间歇性、尺度相关的旋转动力学。这种李群表述在完美再现空间等离子体中观察到的分数谱包络和非高斯方向间歇性的同时，保留了磁场模。此外，通过分离纯方向性重定向，该框架对磁性间歇性爆发的等待时间统计和角度偏转的多重分形标度指数提供了精确的分析控制，为非线性湍流现象的研究提供了强大的新范式。

articles.title: Polarized positron generation via laser-engineered quasistatic magnetic fields in a spatially extended herringbone target
articles.title_zh: 通过激光工程准静态磁场在空间扩展的鱼骨形靶中产生极化正电子
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.24069v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Polarized positron sources are of interest for precision studies of spin-dependent interactions and future high-energy colliders, motivating laser-driven approaches for producing relativistic polarized positrons. Here, we propose a scheme in which a herringbone plasma target organizes laser-driven return currents to generate spatially extended quasi-static magnetic fields. Three-dimensional spin-resolved quantum electrodynamics particle-in-cell simulations show that a 3.4-PW laser produces magnetic fields exceeding 10⁶ T, with opposite polarities on the two sides of the target and a duration exceeding 100 fs. A delayed 10-GeV electron beam generates high-energy photons through nonlinear Compton scattering, followed by positron production via the nonlinear Breit--Wheeler process. The resulting positrons exhibit opposite spin polarizations and deflection directions in the two magnetic-field regions, enabling angular selection of positrons with polarization exceeding 63% at a yield of approximately 0.007 positrons per incident electron, compared with a total yield of 0.029. More restrictive angular selection can further increase the polarization to nearly 90%, albeit at a substantially reduced yield. These results suggest a route to polarized positron generation through the spatial organization of laser-driven quasi-static magnetic fields.
articles.abstract_zh: 偏振正电子源对于自旋相关相互作用和未来高能对撞机的精确研究很有意义，激发了激光驱动的方法来产生相对论偏振正电子。在这里，我们提出了一种方案，其中人字形等离子体目标组织激光驱动的返回电流以产生空间扩展的准静态磁场。三维自旋分辨量子电动力学粒子内模拟表明，3.4-PW 激光器产生超过 10⁶ T 的磁场，目标两侧极性相反，持续时间超过 100 fs。延迟的 10 GeV 电子束通过非线性康普顿散射产生高能光子，然后通过非线性 Breit-Wheeler 过程产生正电子。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 偏振正电子源对于自旋相关相互作用和未来高能对撞机的精确研究很有意义，激发了激光驱动的方法来产生相对论偏振正电子。在这里，我们提出了一种方案，其中人字形等离子体目标组织激光驱动的返回电流以产生空间扩展的准静态磁场。三维自旋分辨量子电动力学粒子内模拟表明，3.4-PW 激光器产生超过 10⁶ T 的磁场，目标两侧极性相反，持续时间超过 100 fs。延迟的 10 GeV 电子束通过非线性康普顿散射产生高能光子，然后通过非线性 Breit-Wheeler 过程产生正电子。由此产生的正电子在两个磁场区域中表现出相反的自旋极化和偏转方向，从而能够对极化率超过 63% 的正电子进行角度选择，每个入射电子的产量约为 0.007 个正电子，而总产量为 0.029 个。更严格的角度选择可以进一步将偏振率提高到接近 90%，尽管产量会大幅降低。这些结果提出了通过激光驱动准静态磁场的空间组织产生偏振正电子的途径。

articles.title: Evaluation of tracking plane pitch and xenon-helium gas mixtures for the NEXT experiment
articles.title_zh: NEXT 实验中跟踪平面间距和氙氦混合气体的评估
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.24082v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: NEXT is an experimental program to search for neutrinoless double-beta decay (ββ 0ν) in high-pressure xenon gas using electroluminescent time projection chambers. A key feature of the NEXT technology is the reconstruction of MeV-scale electron tracks, which plays a key role in identifying ββ 0ν events. This work presents a Monte Carlo study aimed at determining the optimal configuration for NEXT detectors employing SiPM-based tracking planes. The simulations are carried out in the NEXT-100 detector geometry, and to classify the events as signal or background, we use a Sparse Convolutional Neural Network. We find that topological rejection power improves by approximately a factor of two at the lower pressure studied (5 bar) compared to the baseline design (13.5 bar). A finer pitch also offers consistent improvement, where reducing pitch from 15 mm to 5 mm decreased the accepted background fraction by a factor of approximately 1.4 at 13.5 bar for a fixed signal efficiency in the different configurations studied. The addition of helium to reduce electron diffusion provides a comparable enhancement, reducing the accepted background fraction by up to a factor of 1.5 at 13.5 bar. We highlight two key practical configurations at 13.5 bar pressure: the present NEXT-100 (pure Xe with a 15 mm tracking plane pitch) and an upgraded NEXT-100 (a Xe-He gas mixture and a 10 mm tracking plane pitch). These results provide quantitative guidance for the design and optimisation of future NEXT detectors, balancing physics performance with technical and financial constraints.
articles.abstract_zh: NEXT 是一个利用电致发光时间投影室寻找高压氙气中的无中微子双 β 衰变 (ββ 0ν) 的实验程序。 NEXT技术的一个关键特点是MeV级电子轨迹的重建，这对于识别ββ 0ν事件起着关键作用。这项工作提出了一项蒙特卡罗研究，旨在确定采用基于 SiPM 的跟踪平面的 NEXT 探测器的最佳配置。模拟在 NEXT-100 探测器几何结构中进行，为了将事件分类为信号或背景，我们使用稀疏卷积神经网络。
articles.abstract_zh_full: NEXT 是一个利用电致发光时间投影室寻找高压氙气中的无中微子双 β 衰变 (ββ 0ν) 的实验程序。 NEXT技术的一个关键特点是MeV级电子轨迹的重建，这对于识别ββ 0ν事件起着关键作用。这项工作提出了一项蒙特卡罗研究，旨在确定采用基于 SiPM 的跟踪平面的 NEXT 探测器的最佳配置。模拟在 NEXT-100 探测器几何结构中进行，为了将事件分类为信号或背景，我们使用稀疏卷积神经网络。我们发现，与基线设计 (13.5 bar) 相比，在研究的较低压力 (5 bar) 下，拓扑抑制功率提高了大约两倍。更细的间距还提供了一致的改进，其中将间距从 15 毫米减小到 5 毫米，在 13.5 巴下将可接受的背景分数降低了大约 1.4 倍，从而在所研究的不同配置中实现固定信号效率。添加氦气以减少电子扩散可提供类似的增强效果，在 13.5 bar 下将可接受的背景分数降低多达 1.5 倍。我们重点介绍 13.5 bar 压力下的两种关键实用配置：当前的 NEXT-100（具有 15 毫米跟踪平面间距的纯氙气）和升级版的 NEXT-100（氙气混合气体和 10 毫米跟踪平面间距）。这些结果为未来 NEXT 探测器的设计和优化提供定量指导，平衡物理性能与技术和财务限制。

articles.title: Beam-Driven Active Plasma Dechirper for Energy Stabilization of High-Charge Bunches
articles.title_zh: 用于高电荷束能量稳定的光束驱动主动等离子体解调器
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.24289v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Plasma-based accelerators offer ultrahigh electric field gradients, yet delivering high-charge bunches with simultaneously low energy jitter and narrow energy spread remains a critical challenge. We propose a beam-driven active plasma dechirper integrated with a magnetic chicane to suppress both imperfections. By operating in the blowout regime at low plasma density, the dechirper accommodates a stretched witness bunch, thereby mitigating beam-loading effects and preserving the linear slope of the longitudinal wakefield for precise energy stabilization. Furthermore, a tailored initial energy chirp is introduced to reconcile the disparate optimal plasma lengths required for correcting jitter and spread. Three-dimensional simulations demonstrate that for a 1~GeV, 1~nC electron bunch, this scheme simultaneously reduces the energy jitter and spread from ±2% and 1% to ±0.05% and 0.05%, respectively, while maintaining nearly 100% transmission.
articles.abstract_zh: 基于等离子体的加速器提供超高电场梯度，但同时提供低能量抖动和窄能量扩散的高电荷束仍然是一个关键挑战。我们提出了一种与磁性减速通道集成的光束驱动主动等离子体去线性调频器，以抑制这两种缺陷。通过在低等离子体密度的井喷状态下运行，去线性调频器可容纳拉伸的见证束，从而减轻束负载效应并保持纵向尾场的线性斜率以实现精确的能量稳定。此外，还引入了定制的初始能量线性调频脉冲，以协调校正抖动和扩散所需的不同最佳等离子体长度。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 基于等离子体的加速器提供超高电场梯度，但同时提供低能量抖动和窄能量扩散的高电荷束仍然是一个关键挑战。我们提出了一种与磁性减速通道集成的光束驱动主动等离子体去线性调频器，以抑制这两种缺陷。通过在低等离子体密度的井喷状态下运行，去线性调频器可容纳拉伸的见证束，从而减轻束负载效应并保持纵向尾场的线性斜率以实现精确的能量稳定。此外，还引入了定制的初始能量线性调频脉冲，以协调校正抖动和扩散所需的不同最佳等离子体长度。三维模拟表明，对于1~GeV、1~nC电子束团，该方案同时将能量抖动和扩散从±2%和1%分别降低到±0.05%和0.05%，同时保持近100%的传输。

articles.title: Delay Mismatches Shape the Spectra of Three Synchronized Semiconductor Lasers
articles.title_zh: 延迟失配塑造了三个同步半导体激光器的光谱
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.24306v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study a network of three synchronized chaotic lasers and the radio frequency spectra of the intensity fluctuations. The position and morphology of the peaks are significantly different depending on the set of lasers being synchronized. The lasers and coupling paths are similar but not identical in all parameters, including their feedback and coupling delay times. The inverse of the delay mismatch between each pair of lasers introduces characteristic frequencies that shape the spectral response of the synchronized system. By studying two different three-laser configurations, we find that peaks appear whenever multiple harmonic contributions overlap in frequency, resulting in constructive enhancement of the spectral power. Numerical simulations performed with the same delay configurations show a clear agreement with the experimental measurements, reproducing both the peak positions and the overall spectral structure. These results indicate that the frequency content of the synchronized dynamics is largely determined by the delay-mismatch network and its harmonics.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们研究了三个同步混沌激光器的网络和强度波动的射频频谱。根据同步的激光组，峰的位置和形态显着不同。激光器和耦合路径相似，但所有参数并不相同，包括它们的反馈和耦合延迟时间。每对激光器之间的延迟失配的倒数引入了塑造同步系统光谱响应的特征频率。通过研究两种不同的三激光器配置，我们发现只要多个谐波贡献在频率上重叠，就会出现峰值，从而导致光谱功率的建设性增强。使用相同延迟配置进行的数值模拟显示与实验测量结果明显一致，再现了峰值位置和整体光谱结构。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们研究了三个同步混沌激光器的网络和强度波动的射频频谱。根据同步的激光组，峰的位置和形态显着不同。激光器和耦合路径相似，但所有参数并不相同，包括它们的反馈和耦合延迟时间。每对激光器之间的延迟失配的倒数引入了塑造同步系统光谱响应的特征频率。通过研究两种不同的三激光器配置，我们发现只要多个谐波贡献在频率上重叠，就会出现峰值，从而导致光谱功率的建设性增强。使用相同延迟配置进行的数值模拟显示与实验测量结果明显一致，再现了峰值位置和整体光谱结构。这些结果表明，同步动态的频率内容很大程度上取决于延迟失配网络及其谐波。

articles.title: Orbital-weighted learning for transition metal complexes
articles.title_zh: 过渡金属配合物的轨道加权学习
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.24421v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Frontier orbital energies are key to the description of molecular light-matter interaction and pose a challenge both for electronic structure calculations and for machine learning approaches, especially for transition metal complexes (TMC). These are highly relevant since the gap between the highest occupied molecular orbital (HOMO) and the lowest unoccupied molecular orbital (LUMO) is in the range of visible light. For TMCs, gap position and magnitude are determined by the metal center, its coordination and ligand identity. Since the systems exhibit a wide range of charge and spin states, frontier orbital energies can only be predicted with machine learning models that explicitly incorporate spin and charge. In this work, we show that a semi-empirical orbital population as a weight rather than a feature can increase efficiency for both physics-based and neural-network-based atomic representations. Because orbital populations are highly sensitive to both charge and spin, they offer a general pathway to render existing geometry-based machine learning representations useful for orbital energies. On TMC datasets, our approach reduces the required training data by up to 95 %, and improves physics-based representations to almost match the accuracy of pre-trained neural network representations at 12% of the inference compute cost. This greatly reduces the data and compute requirements to accurately model frontier orbitals in TMCs
articles.abstract_zh: 前沿轨道能量是描述分子光与物质相互作用的关键，并且对电子结构计算和机器学习方法，特别是过渡金属配合物（TMC）提出了挑战。这些是高度相关的，因为最高占据分子轨道（HOMO）和最低未占据分子轨道（LUMO）之间的差距在可见光范围内。对于 TMC，间隙位置和大小由金属中心、其配位和配体身份决定。由于系统表现出广泛的电荷和自旋状态，因此只能通过明确包含自旋和电荷的机器学习模型来预测前沿轨道能量。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 前沿轨道能量是描述分子光与物质相互作用的关键，并且对电子结构计算和机器学习方法，特别是过渡金属配合物（TMC）提出了挑战。这些是高度相关的，因为最高占据分子轨道（HOMO）和最低未占据分子轨道（LUMO）之间的差距在可见光范围内。对于 TMC，间隙位置和大小由金属中心、其配位和配体身份决定。由于系统表现出广泛的电荷和自旋状态，因此只能通过明确包含自旋和电荷的机器学习模型来预测前沿轨道能量。在这项工作中，我们表明，半经验轨道布居作为权重而不是特征可以提高基于物理和基于神经网络的原子表示的效率。由于轨道布居对电荷和自旋都高度敏感，因此它们提供了一条通用途径，使现有的基于几何的机器学习表示对轨道能量有用。在 TMC 数据集上，我们的方法将所需的训练数据减少了高达 95%，并改进了基于物理的表示，以几乎与预训练神经网络表示的准确性相匹配，而推理计算成本仅为 12%。这大大减少了在 TMC 中精确模拟前沿轨道的数据和计算要求

articles.title: Raman-induced Kerr effect and heating in diamond
articles.title_zh: 金刚石中的拉曼诱导克尔效应和加热
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.24856v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We fully characterize the polarization-dependent third-order nonlinear susceptibility in a diamond crystal using phase-sensitive nondegenerate pump-probe spectroscopy near 1~μm wavelength. Measuring the frequency-domain phase shift and amplitude change of the probe pulse as a function of polarization and probe wavelength allows direct extraction of the full anisotropic χ⁽³⁾ response, including the Raman contribution. We find that the polarization dependence of the two-beam coupling contribution for the Raman component differs from that predicted solely using one-beam selection rules. We measure a Kerr coefficient that is within the range of reported values in the literature, and our measured anisotropy parameters satisfy Kleinman symmetry, as expected. Our measured Raman polarizability agrees, after scaling for its dispersion, with a Brillouin-referenced measurement at 514.5~nm [Grimsditch and Ramdas, Phys. Rev. B 11, 3139 (1975)], but is lower than measurements from absolute Raman cross sections. The same technique could be used to measure other materials with relatively high phonon frequencies, and it complements measurements of the Kerr contribution of low-frequency modes using impulsive stimulated Raman scattering (ISRS). When the pump-probe difference frequency matches the phonon resonance, Raman-enabled two-photon absorption occurs; we directly measure the resulting heat deposition in diamond using time-resolved beam deflection of a continuous-wave laser. The measurement technique demonstrated here is capable of precise absolute χ⁽³⁾ measurements and will enable quantitative stimulated Raman heating microscopy, with potential extensions to thermal conductivity metrology.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们使用 1~μm 波长附近的相敏非简并泵浦探针光谱充分表征了金刚石晶体中偏振相关的三阶非线性磁化率。测量探针脉冲的频域相移和幅度变化作为偏振和探针波长的函数，可以直接提取完整的各向异性 χ⁽3⁾ 响应，包括拉曼贡献。我们发现，拉曼分量的两光束耦合贡献的偏振依赖性与仅使用一光束选择规则预测的不同。我们测量的克尔系数在文献中报道的值范围内，并且我们测量的各向异性参数满足克莱曼对称性，正如预期的那样。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们使用 1~μm 波长附近的相敏非简并泵浦探针光谱充分表征了金刚石晶体中偏振相关的三阶非线性磁化率。测量探针脉冲的频域相移和幅度变化作为偏振和探针波长的函数，可以直接提取完整的各向异性 χ⁽3⁾ 响应，包括拉曼贡献。我们发现，拉曼分量的两光束耦合贡献的偏振依赖性与仅使用一光束选择规则预测的不同。我们测量的克尔系数在文献中报道的值范围内，并且我们测量的各向异性参数满足克莱曼对称性，正如预期的那样。我们测得的拉曼极化率在对其色散进行缩放后，与 514.5 nm 处的布里渊参考测量结果一致 [Grimsditch 和 Ramdas，Phys。 Rev. B 11, 3139 (1975)]，但低于绝对拉曼截面的测量值。相同的技术可用于测量具有相对较高声子频率的其他材料，并且它补充了使用脉冲受激拉曼散射 (ISRS) 测量低频模式的克尔贡献的方法。当泵浦-探针差频与声子共振匹配时，发生拉曼双光子吸收；我们使用连续波激光的时间分辨光束偏转直接测量金刚石中产生的热沉积。这里演示的测量技术能够进行精确的绝对 χ⁽³⁾ 测量，并将实现定量受激拉曼加热显微镜，并有可能扩展到热导率计量。

articles.title: Does a label survive the loop? A screen of necessary physical conditions for a self-measuring system, with a pre-registered test on fly connectomes
articles.title_zh: 标签能在循环中存活下来吗？自我测量系统所需物理条件的屏幕，以及预先注册的飞行连接体测试
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.23320v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Theories that tie experience to a system that re-reads its own state rarely say what a physical substrate must supply for such a loop to run. We state necessary conditions as measurable bounds in one currency: the number of rounds, each one write, hold and re-read, that a written label survives.A floor follows from fundamental constants. Tier 1 asks whether a carrier can hold the label; it is the published quality-factor screen, restated in rounds and extended to a population code. Tier 2 bounds how many rounds a quantum resource survives in a loop that keeps a record. Tier 3 asks whether a network contains a compartment, a set of neurons that a random walk leaves more slowly than it mixes inside. Tier 4 compares what the loop and an outside observer can recover. We implement Tiers 3 and 4 on three connectomes of Drosophila. Exploration of two animals singled out the heading system of the ellipsoid body. Five criteria were then registered and run once on a third animal, and all were met with all connections counted. One was met narrowly, and two fail in that data set when connections of one or two synapses are removed, which we trace in part to synapse detection. As a population code the heading label holds about two bits for seven seconds. The screen can exclude substrates. Passing it is not evidence of experience.
articles.abstract_zh: 将经验与重新读取自身状态的系统联系起来的理论很少说明物理基质必须为这样的循环运行提供什么。我们将必要条件表述为一种货币的可测量范围：书面标签得以生存的轮数，每次写入、持有和重读。下限由基本常数得出。第 1 级询问承运商是否可以持有该标签；它是已发布的质量因数筛选，逐轮重述并扩展到人口代码。第 2 层限制了量子资源在保留记录的循环中存活的轮次。第三层询问网络是否包含一个隔室，即随机游走离开的一组神经元比在内部混合的速度慢的神经元。第 4 层比较循环和外部观察者可以恢复的内容。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 将经验与重新读取自身状态的系统联系起来的理论很少说明物理基质必须为这样的循环运行提供什么。我们将必要条件表述为一种货币的可测量范围：书面标签得以生存的轮数，每次写入、持有和重读。下限由基本常数得出。第 1 级询问承运商是否可以持有该标签；它是已发布的质量因数筛选，逐轮重述并扩展到人口代码。第 2 层限制了量子资源在保留记录的循环中存活的轮次。第三层询问网络是否包含一个隔室，即随机游走离开的一组神经元比在内部混合的速度慢的神经元。第 4 层比较循环和外部观察者可以恢复的内容。我们在果蝇的三个连接体上实施了第 3 层和第 4 层。对两种动物的探索找出了椭球体的航向系统。然后注册五个标准并在第三只动物上运行一次，并且所有连接都得到满足。当一两个突触的连接被移除时，其中一个勉强满足，而另外两个在该数据集中失败，我们将其部分追溯到突触检测。作为人口代码，标题标签在七秒内保留大约两位。丝网可以排除基材。通过它并不是经验的证据。

articles.title: The Price of Discovery: Cost-Optimized Detectors for the GUT-Scale QCD Axion
articles.title_zh: 发现的代价：GUT 规模 QCD Axion 的成本优化探测器
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.23374v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Grand unification and string theory point to a quantum chromodynamics (QCD) axion with mass between 10⁻¹¹ and 10⁻⁸ eV, while heterotic string theory suggests a mass of 0.5-0.8 neV. We study which laboratory experiment could discover or exclude DFSZ-strength QCD axion dark matter at and above 0.5 neV at the lowest cost, which we estimate from scaling laws calibrated to historical data. We find that a lumped-element detector, building on the ABRACADABRA concept, can do so with demonstrated readout technology; an example is a shielded toroid about 14 m across with a 6 T NbTi magnet, whose magnet and cryostat we estimate at around 120 million Swiss francs (MCHF). If projected readout targets are met, a 5 m toroid at 25 MCHF suffices. We find these designs by optimizing the toroid, solenoid, and core lumped-element topologies under a common cost metric. The toroid emerges as the most promising and cost-effective topology. The optimal field of the toroid detector is far below the 16 T of the proposed DMRadio-GUT design, which would cost nearly twice as much as our optimum. Heterodyne searches with superconducting radio-frequency cavities, with cavity shapes that we optimize for price, cost between about the same as and twice as much as the lumped-element detectors, but require cavities of volumes sim50-2000 m³. We find that nuclear-magnetic-resonance searches (CASPEr) need orders-of-magnitude gains in spin polarization and coherence. We release axionMultiPhysics, an open-source finite-element and multiphysics package for, e.g., magnetoquasistatic and full-wave electromagnetics, superconductors, readout circuits, and mechanics, from which most of our numerical results were obtained.
articles.abstract_zh: 大统一和弦理论指出量子色动力学（QCD）轴子的质量在 10 -11 和 10 -8 eV 之间，而异质弦理论表明质量为 0.5-0.8 neV。我们研究哪种实验室实验能够以最低的成本发现或排除 0.5 neV 及以上的 DFSZ 强度 QCD 轴子暗物质，这是我们根据历史数据校准的标度定律估计的。我们发现，基于 ABRACADABRA 概念的集总元件探测器可以通过经过验证的读出技术来实现这一点；
articles.abstract_zh_full: 大统一和弦理论指出量子色动力学（QCD）轴子的质量在 10 -11 和 10 -8 eV 之间，而异质弦理论表明质量为 0.5-0.8 neV。我们研究哪种实验室实验能够以最低的成本发现或排除 0.5 neV 及以上的 DFSZ 强度 QCD 轴子暗物质，这是我们根据历史数据校准的标度定律估计的。我们发现，基于 ABRACADABRA 概念的集总元件探测器可以通过经过验证的读出技术来实现这一点；例如，一个直径约 14 m 且带有 6 T NbTi 磁体的屏蔽环形线圈，我们估计其磁体和低温恒温器的成本约为 1.2 亿瑞士法郎 (MCHF)。如果达到预计的读出目标，25 MCHF 下的 5 m 环形线圈就足够了。我们通过在通用成本指标下优化环形线圈、螺线管和核心集总元件拓扑来找到这些设计。环形线圈成为最有前途和最具成本效益的拓扑结构。环形探测器的最佳场远低于所提出的 DMRadio-GUT 设计的 16 T，其成本几乎是我们最佳方案的两倍。外差搜索采用超导射频腔，我们针对腔体形状进行了价格优化，成本与集总元件探测器的成本大致相同至两倍，但需要体积为 sim50-2000 m3 的腔体。我们发现核磁共振搜索（CASPEr）需要在自旋极化和相干性方面获得数量级的增益。我们发布了 axionMultiPhysics，这是一个开源有限元和多物理场软件包，用于磁准静态和全波电磁学、超导体、读出电路和力学等领域，我们的大部分数值结果都是从中获得的。

articles.title: Collective Superconducting-Qubit Interfaces for Microwave-to-Optical Quantum Transduction
articles.title_zh: 用于微波到光量子传导的集体超导量子位接口
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.23383v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Microwave-to-optical quantum transduction is essential for connecting superconducting quantum processors through optical networks. Mechanically mediated transducers, however, remain limited by weak electromechanical coupling, dissipation, and added noise. In this work, we study a transducer in which an ensemble of superconducting qubits couples collectively to a shared optomechanical resonator. For weak signals, we show that ensemble size and optical pump strength together set the conversion efficiency, added noise, and bandwidth, with pump heating limiting efficiency to a finite optimal pump strength. Near half excitation, the collective coupling grows nearly linearly with ensemble size, accelerating transfer of an excitation into the mechanics. We show that this speedup is offset by relaxation of the additional excited qubits, so the single-qubit coupling and lifetime still set the coherence requirement. Transferring exactly one excitation also requires an anharmonic mechanical mode, which an auxiliary qubit coupled to the mechanics can provide. In a lossless prescribed-Kerr benchmark with four qubits and gᵣₘ ₛₘ/(2π)=3.81,kHz, a mechanical anharmonicity of 100,kHz raises the final joint single-photon intracavity target probability from 19.6% to 99.7%. Finally, we quantify the effects of decoherence, disorder, residual qubit--qubit interactions, and pump-induced qubit noise, finding that pair-dependent interactions reduce the optical retrieval efficiency from 58% to 35%. These results establish the coherence and selectivity requirements for collective quantum transduction.
articles.abstract_zh: 微波到光量子转换对于通过光网络连接超导量子处理器至关重要。然而，机械介导的换能器仍然受到弱机电耦合、耗散和附加噪声的限制。在这项工作中，我们研究了一种传感器，其中超导量子位集合共同耦合到共享光机械谐振器。对于弱信号，我们表明，整体尺寸和光泵浦强度共同决定了转换效率、增加的噪声和带宽，而泵浦加热将效率限制在有限的最佳泵浦强度。接近半激励时，集体耦合随着系综尺寸几乎呈线性增长，加速了激励向力学的转移。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 微波到光量子转换对于通过光网络连接超导量子处理器至关重要。然而，机械介导的换能器仍然受到弱机电耦合、耗散和附加噪声的限制。在这项工作中，我们研究了一种传感器，其中超导量子位集合共同耦合到共享光机械谐振器。对于弱信号，我们表明，整体尺寸和光泵浦强度共同决定了转换效率、增加的噪声和带宽，而泵浦加热将效率限制在有限的最佳泵浦强度。接近半激励时，集体耦合随着系综尺寸几乎呈线性增长，加速了激励向力学的转移。我们表明，这种加速可以通过额外激发量子位的弛豫来抵消，因此单量子位耦合和寿命仍然设定了相干性要求。精确地传递一个激励还需要一种非谐波机械模式，而与机械耦合的辅助量子位可以提供这种模式。在具有四个量子位和 gᵣₘ ₛₘ/(2π)=3.81,kHz 的无损规定 Kerr 基准中，100,kHz 的机械非谐性将最终联合单光子腔内目标概率从 19.6% 提高到 99.7%。最后，我们量化了退相干、无序、残余量子位-量子位相互作用和泵浦引起的量子位噪声的影响，发现成对依赖的相互作用将光学检索效率从 58% 降低到 35%。这些结果确立了集体量子传导的相干性和选择性要求。

articles.title: How the material world of the brain, as a complex system governed by intermittent dynamics, gives rise to the supposedly "immaterial" world of mental processes such as thought
articles.title_zh: 大脑的物质世界作为一个受间歇性动态控制的复杂系统，如何产生所谓的“非物质”心理过程世界，例如思想
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.23486v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: In this paper, we argue that the brain is a complex dynamical system in a critical state similar to that of the 3D Ising model. We highlight several properties of the brain, including resonance phenomena within this critical state, long-range autocorrelations consistent with long memory, a hysteresis zone suggesting the presence of an as yet undetected "exotic" type of matter within the brain, and possible quantum phenomena within the microtubules of neural networks. The latter suggests that these structures exhibit a combined form of "logical superposition". In the proposed model, "AND" logic would require two distinct quantum states to be occupied simultaneously. The proposed "OR" logic allows any one of several quantum states to be occupied at a time. Moreover, we propose that kink and antikink solitons could mediate coupling between occupied quantum states in the microtubules and thereby contribute to pattern formation in neural networks. This mechanism may well be what gives the brain the flexibility to support complex thought and other cognitive functions.
articles.abstract_zh: 在本文中，我们认为大脑是一个处于类似于 3D Ising 模型的临界状态的复杂动力系统。我们强调了大脑的几个特性，包括这种临界状态内的共振现象、与长期记忆一致的长程自相关、表明大脑内存在尚未检测到的“奇异”物质的滞后区，以及神经网络微管内可能存在的量子现象。后者表明这些结构表现出“逻辑叠加”的组合形式。在所提出的模型中，“与”逻辑需要同时占据两个不同的量子态。所提出的“OR”逻辑允许同时占据多个量子态中的任何一个。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在本文中，我们认为大脑是一个处于类似于 3D Ising 模型的临界状态的复杂动力系统。我们强调了大脑的几个特性，包括这种临界状态内的共振现象、与长期记忆一致的长程自相关、表明大脑内存在尚未检测到的“奇异”物质的滞后区，以及神经网络微管内可能存在的量子现象。后者表明这些结构表现出“逻辑叠加”的组合形式。在所提出的模型中，“与”逻辑需要同时占据两个不同的量子态。所提出的“OR”逻辑允许同时占据多个量子态中的任何一个。此外，我们提出扭结和反扭结孤子可以介导微管中占据的量子态之间的耦合，从而有助于神经网络中的模式形成。这种机制很可能赋予大脑支持复杂思维和其他认知功能的灵活性。

articles.title: Quantitative Modeling of Action-Potential-Driven Sodium Dynamics in Neurons: From Sodium Influx to Sodium MRI
articles.title_zh: 神经元中动作电位驱动的钠动力学的定量建模：从钠流入到钠 MRI
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.23549v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Neuronal action potentials are accompanied by the influx of extracellular sodium ions (Na+) into axons through voltage-gated sodium channels. Repetitive neuronal firing can lead to activity-dependent increases in intracellular sodium concentration, which are subsequently reversed primarily through the Na+/K+-ATPase. Quantifying these dynamic changes provides a biophysical foundation for investigating neuronal activity using sodium (23Na) magnetic resonance imaging (MRI). This mini-review examines the relationships among firing frequency, action-potential-driven sodium influx, and intracellular sodium accumulation, to establish a quantitative framework linking neuronal activity to sodium MRI. The potential sensitivity and limitation of conventional and compartment-sensitive sodium MRI for detecting activity-dependent sodium changes are also discussed. Keywords: Sodium MRI; neuronal firing; action potential; sodium influx; intracellular sodium concentration.
articles.abstract_zh: 神经元动作电位伴随着细胞外钠离子 (Na+) 通过电压门控钠通道流入轴突。重复的神经元放电可导致细胞内钠浓度的活动依赖性增加，随后主要通过 Na+/K+-ATP 酶逆转。量化这些动态变化为使用钠 (23Na) 磁共振成像 (MRI) 研究神经元活动提供了生物物理基础。这篇小型综述研究了放电频率、动作电位驱动的钠流入和细胞内钠积累之间的关系，以建立将神经元活动与钠 MRI 联系起来的定量框架。还讨论了传统和隔室敏感钠 MRI 用于检测活性依赖性钠变化的潜在敏感性和局限性。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 神经元动作电位伴随着细胞外钠离子 (Na+) 通过电压门控钠通道流入轴突。重复的神经元放电可导致细胞内钠浓度的活动依赖性增加，随后主要通过 Na+/K+-ATP 酶逆转。量化这些动态变化为使用钠 (23Na) 磁共振成像 (MRI) 研究神经元活动提供了生物物理基础。这篇小型综述研究了放电频率、动作电位驱动的钠流入和细胞内钠积累之间的关系，以建立将神经元活动与钠 MRI 联系起来的定量框架。还讨论了传统和隔室敏感钠 MRI 用于检测活性依赖性钠变化的潜在敏感性和局限性。关键词：钠 MRI；神经元放电；动作电位；钠流入；细胞内钠浓度。

articles.title: General Noise Channels and Mid-Circuit Measurements for Pre-Trajectory Sampling with Batched Execution
articles.title_zh: 用于批量执行的轨迹前采样的通用噪声通道和中电路测量
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.23923v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Many studies of quantum protocols require fast sampling of large amounts of measurement data from noisy quantum circuits, such as for training machine-learning decoders for quantum error correction. Exact simulation of realistic noise is expensive, while stabilizer-based simulators are fast but approximate, for example through Pauli twirling, which generally alters the output statistics. Pre-trajectory sampling with batched execution (PTSBE) accelerates exact trajectory simulation by sampling noise before state evolution. This method requires the outcome probability of every stochastic event to be independent of the state, which excludes mid-circuit measurements and general Kraus channels. We present a generalization of PTSBE to measurement and Kraus operators without approximation. Each event is partially pre-sampled, while deferred outcomes are drawn during grouped execution via multinomial branching and cached-state reuse. We implement the method for GPUs as an extension of CUDA-Q. On distance-3 topological code memories under amplitude damping, it is up to 24x faster than conventional trajectory sampling in CUDA-Q. On 30-qubit random circuits with mid-circuit measurements, it is up to 83x faster and outperforms the near-Clifford simulator Clifft when more than about 25% of the gates are non-Clifford. With repeated sampling of each final state, its sampling rate per trajectory exceeds that of CUDA-Q by nearly five orders of magnitude. Our method also allows us to compare exact amplitude damping with its Pauli-twirled channel on a surface-code memory, revealing that twirling overestimates the detection rate by 21% and raises the logical error rate of a lookup decoder by 8%. This work makes exact, high-throughput simulation practical for general noisy circuits, from data generation for training decoders to studying measurement-based fault-tolerant protocols under realistic noise.
articles.abstract_zh: 许多量子协议研究需要从噪声量子电路中快速采样大量测量数据，例如用于训练机器学习解码器以进行量子纠错。对现实噪声的精确模拟成本高昂，而基于稳定器的模拟器速度快但近似，例如通过泡利旋转，这通常会改变输出统计数据。批量执行的轨迹前采样 (PTSBE) 通过在状态演化之前采样噪声来加速精确的轨迹模拟。该方法要求每个随机事件的结果概率独立于状态，其中不包括中电路测量和一般克劳斯通道。我们将 PTSBE 推广到测量和 Kraus 算子，无需近似。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 许多量子协议研究需要从噪声量子电路中快速采样大量测量数据，例如用于训练机器学习解码器以进行量子纠错。对现实噪声的精确模拟成本高昂，而基于稳定器的模拟器速度快但近似，例如通过泡利旋转，这通常会改变输出统计数据。批量执行的轨迹前采样 (PTSBE) 通过在状态演化之前采样噪声来加速精确的轨迹模拟。该方法要求每个随机事件的结果概率独立于状态，其中不包括中电路测量和一般克劳斯通道。我们将 PTSBE 推广到测量和 Kraus 算子，无需近似。每个事件都经过部分预采样，而延迟结果是在分组执行期间通过多项分支和缓存状态重用绘制的。我们将 GPU 的方法作为 CUDA-Q 的扩展来实现。在振幅阻尼下的距离 3 拓扑代码存储器上，它比 CUDA-Q 中的传统轨迹采样快 24 倍。在具有中间电路测量的 30 量子位随机电路上，当超过约 25% 的门是非 Clifford 时，它的速度提高了 83 倍，并且优于近 Clifford 模拟器 Clifft。通过对每个最终状态进行重复采样，其每条轨迹的采样率超过 CUDA-Q 近五个数量级。我们的方法还允许我们将精确振幅阻尼与其表面代码存储器上的泡利旋转通道进行比较，结果表明旋转将检测率高估了 21%，并将查找解码器的逻辑错误率提高了 8%。这项工作使得精确的高吞吐量模拟适用于一般噪声电路，从训练解码器的数据生成到研究现实噪声下基于测量的容错协议。

articles.title: Quantum Mpemba effect in a driven-dissipative atom-waveguide coupled system
articles.title_zh: 驱动耗散原子波导耦合系统中的量子 Mpemba 效应
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.23971v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: The quantum Mpemba effect (QME) describes the counterintuitive phenomenon in which a more strongly perturbed quantum system relaxes toward its steady state faster than a less perturbed one. Here, we investigate the QME in a weakly driven-dissipative atomic array coupled to a one-dimensional chiral waveguide. Starting from the steady state, we introduce a local quench by resetting a single atom to its ground state and examine the subsequent relaxation dynamics. We find that quenching atoms near the array boundaries induces faster initial relaxation through enhanced coupling to superradiant modes and direct photon emission into the waveguide, giving rise to an edge-enhanced QME. Strong directional decay further amplifies this effect by promoting the spatial accumulation of superradiant modes near the preferred boundary, leading to a skin-enhanced QME. At later times, relaxation is increasingly governed by long-lived subradiant modes localized predominantly in the bulk of the array. By coupling two atomic arrays with different interparticle spacings, we further demonstrate an interface-induced QME, where quenching an atom near the interface makes the system relax more slowly at early times but approach its steady state faster at later times, owing to weak participation in both superradiant and subradiant modes. Our findings reveal how the spatial structure of collective decay modes and directional dissipation jointly govern anomalous quantum relaxation, offering potential routes toward accelerated steady-state preparation in waveguide QED systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子姆彭巴效应 (QME) 描述了一种违反直觉的现象，其中扰动较强的量子系统比扰动较小的量子系统更快地松弛到稳态。在这里，我们研究了耦合到一维手性波导的弱驱动耗散原子阵列中的 QME。从稳态开始，我们通过将单个原子重置为其基态来引入局部淬灭，并检查随后的弛豫动力学。我们发现，阵列边界附近的淬灭原子通过增强与超辐射模式的耦合和直接光子发射到波导中来诱导更快的初始弛豫，从而产生边缘增强的 QME。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 量子姆彭巴效应 (QME) 描述了一种违反直觉的现象，其中扰动较强的量子系统比扰动较小的量子系统更快地松弛到稳态。在这里，我们研究了耦合到一维手性波导的弱驱动耗散原子阵列中的 QME。从稳态开始，我们通过将单个原子重置为其基态来引入局部淬灭，并检查随后的弛豫动力学。我们发现，阵列边界附近的淬灭原子通过增强与超辐射模式的耦合和直接光子发射到波导中来诱导更快的初始弛豫，从而产生边缘增强的 QME。强方向衰减通过促进首选边界附近超辐射模式的空间积累进一步放大了这种效应，从而导致趋肤增强的 QME。后来，弛豫越来越受到主要集中在阵列主体中的长寿命次辐射模式的控制。通过耦合具有不同粒子间间距的两个原子阵列，我们进一步证明了界面诱导的 QME，其中界面附近的原子淬火使得系统在早期松弛得更慢，但由于对超辐射和次辐射模式的参与较弱，因此在后期更快地接近其稳态。我们的研究结果揭示了集体衰变模式和定向耗散的空间结构如何共同控制反常量子弛豫，为波导 QED 系统中加速稳态制备提供了潜在途径。

articles.title: In-memory measurement-device-independent quantum key distribution
articles.title_zh: 内存测量与设备无关的量子密钥分发
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.24255v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Quantum memories offer to significantly extend the performance of quantum networks, but their complexity and limited performance at telecommunication wavelengths have so far hindered practical deployment. We propose a new memory-assisted measurement device independent quantum key distribution (MDI-QKD) protocol based on in-memory interference. Our approach leverages progress in atomic ensemble memories that enable the interference of a stationary matter qubit and a travelling photonic qubit inside a single quantum memory. We quantitatively evaluate the performance of this scheme against memoryless MDI-QKD and existing two-memory architectures, showing that it not only achieves superior secret key rates and surpasses the memoryless bound at substantially shorter distances, but also reduces hardware requirements by halving the number of memories and detectors. Our results further indicate that off resonant cascaded absorption (ORCA) memories are a particularly promising platform for implementing this protocol, and we outline a concrete design compatible with their capabilities. These findings demonstrate that in-memory interference provides a higher performance, and resource efficient route toward near term memory enhanced quantum secure communications.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子存储器可以显着扩展量子网络的性能，但其复杂性和在电信波长上的有限性能迄今为止阻碍了实际部署。我们提出了一种基于内存干扰的新型内存辅助测量设备独立量子密钥分发（MDI-QKD）协议。我们的方法利用原子系综存储器的进步，使单个量子存储器内的静止物质量子位和移动光子量子位能够发生干涉。我们针对无记忆 MDI-QKD 和现有的双存储器架构定量评估了该方案的性能，表明它不仅实现了卓越的密钥率并在更短的距离内超越了无记忆界限，而且还通过将存储器和检测器的数量减半来降低了硬件要求。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 量子存储器可以显着扩展量子网络的性能，但其复杂性和在电信波长上的有限性能迄今为止阻碍了实际部署。我们提出了一种基于内存干扰的新型内存辅助测量设备独立量子密钥分发（MDI-QKD）协议。我们的方法利用原子系综存储器的进步，使单个量子存储器内的静止物质量子位和移动光子量子位能够发生干涉。我们针对无记忆 MDI-QKD 和现有的双存储器架构定量评估了该方案的性能，表明它不仅实现了卓越的密钥率并在更短的距离内超越了无记忆界限，而且还通过将存储器和检测器的数量减半来降低了硬件要求。我们的结果进一步表明，非谐振级联吸收（ORCA）存储器是实现该协议的特别有前途的平台，并且我们概述了与其功能兼容的具体设计。这些发现表明，内存中的干扰为近期内存增强的量子安全通信提供了更高的性能和资源效率的途径。

articles.title: Quantum Simulation of First-Quantised Chemistry with a Sum-of-Squares Representation
articles.title_zh: 用平方和表示的第一量子化化学的量子模拟
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.24885v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Calculating molecular energies is expected to be an important application of quantum computers, but the most efficient algorithms to achieve this typically have significant space requirements. Scaling quantum processors to thousands of logical qubits is a daunting engineering challenge, so developing algorithms that run with reduced qubit requirements is of particular importance. Moreover, most algorithms are benchmarked on active spaces with about as many orbitals as electrons, missing dynamical correlation which is necessary to describe real chemistry. Capturing this correlation requires several times more orbitals than electrons, even in compact atomic-orbital basis sets. This low-filling regime favours first quantisation, where each electron is represented by a number of qubits that grows only logarithmically with the number of orbitals. Whether this approach translates into a practical advantage in orbital basis sets of realistic size, however, has been unclear. Here, we develop a first-quantised phase estimation algorithm for generic orbital basis sets, based on a non-convex sum-of-squares representation of the Hamiltonian and spectral-gap amplification. We compare it with the state-of-the-art second-quantised algorithm, compiling both with the same techniques at the logical level. For six molecules with 4 to 24 electrons in 5 to 14 times as many orbitals, our first-quantised method needs up to 16 times fewer Toffoli gates than the second-quantised algorithm in the low-qubit regime, where only a few hundred logical qubits are available. It stays cheaper up to between several hundred and about 1,400 qubits, and its smallest qubit count is 1.4 to 2 times lower than in second quantisation. In the low-qubit and low-filling regime, our algorithm is therefore the method of choice for chemistry in orbital basis sets.
articles.abstract_zh: 计算分子能量预计将成为量子计算机的一个重要应用，但实现这一目标的最有效算法通常需要大量空间。将量子处理器扩展到数千个逻辑量子位是一项艰巨的工程挑战，因此开发以减少的量子位要求运行的算法尤为重要。此外，大多数算法都是在活性空间上进行基准测试，其轨道数量与电子差不多，缺少描述真实化学所必需的动态相关性。即使在紧凑的原子轨道基组中，捕获这种相关性也需要比电子多几倍的轨道。这种低填充状态有利于第一次量子化，其中每个电子由多个量子位表示，这些量子位仅随轨道数量呈对数增长。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 计算分子能量预计将成为量子计算机的一个重要应用，但实现这一目标的最有效算法通常需要大量空间。将量子处理器扩展到数千个逻辑量子位是一项艰巨的工程挑战，因此开发以减少的量子位要求运行的算法尤为重要。此外，大多数算法都是在活性空间上进行基准测试，其轨道数量与电子差不多，缺少描述真实化学所必需的动态相关性。即使在紧凑的原子轨道基组中，捕获这种相关性也需要比电子多几倍的轨道。这种低填充状态有利于第一次量子化，其中每个电子由多个量子位表示，这些量子位仅随轨道数量呈对数增长。然而，这种方法是否转化为实际尺寸的轨道基组的实际优势尚不清楚。在这里，我们基于哈密顿量和谱间隙放大的非凸平方和表示，为通用轨道基组开发了一种第一量化相位估计算法。我们将其与最先进的第二量化算法进行比较，在逻辑级别上使用相同的技术进行编译。对于在 5 到 14 倍轨道上具有 4 到 24 个电子的 6 个分子，我们的第一量化方法需要的 Toffoli 门比低量子位体系中的第二量化算法少 16 倍，低量子位体系中只有几百个逻辑量子位可用。它在数百至约 1,400 个量子位之间保持更便宜，并且其最小量子位计数比第二次量化低 1.4 至 2 倍。因此，在低量子位和低填充状态下，我们的算法是轨道基组化学的首选方法。

articles.title: A Quantum Chemistry Dataset of 120 Kilo Organic Molecules with 20 Million Conformations
articles.title_zh: 包含 120 公斤有机分子和 2000 万种构象的量子化学数据集
articles.abstract: arXiv:2410.19316v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Quantum-chemical datasets of molecular geometries, electronic energies and atomic forces support the development of atomistic machine-learning models. Here we present QO2Mol, comprising 116,127 organic molecular fragments and more than 20 million three-dimensional conformations. The fragments were obtained by bond cleavage and capping of source compounds and contain H, C, N, O, F, P, S, Cl, Br and I. The geometries include optimized structures and configurations generated through torsional sampling and local bond-length and bond-angle perturbations. Electronic energies and atomic forces were calculated at the B3LYP/def2-SVP level of theory. Each conformational record also contains dipole moments, isotropic polarizabilities, electronic spatial extents and frequency-derived correction values. The dataset and its documented generation and validation procedures support molecular energy and force modelling and studies of geometry-dependent molecular properties.
articles.abstract_zh: 分子几何、电子能量和原子力的量子化学数据集支持原子机器学习模型的开发。在这里，我们展示了 QO2Mol，包含 116,127 个有机分子片段和超过 2000 万个三维构象。这些片段是通过源化合物的键断裂和封端获得的，含有 H、C、N、O、F、P、S、Cl、Br 和 I。几何形状包括通过扭转采样以及局部键长和键角扰动生成的优化结构和配置。电子能量和原子力是在 B3LYP/def2-SVP 理论水平上计算的。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 分子几何、电子能量和原子力的量子化学数据集支持原子机器学习模型的开发。在这里，我们展示了 QO2Mol，包含 116,127 个有机分子片段和超过 2000 万个三维构象。这些片段是通过源化合物的键断裂和封端获得的，含有 H、C、N、O、F、P、S、Cl、Br 和 I。几何形状包括通过扭转采样以及局部键长和键角扰动生成的优化结构和配置。电子能量和原子力是在 B3LYP/def2-SVP 理论水平上计算的。每个构象记录还包含偶极矩、各向同性极化率、电子空间范围和频率导出的校正值。该数据集及其记录的生成和验证程序支持分子能量和力建模以及几何相关分子特性的研究。

articles.title: The Numerics of VMEC++
articles.title_zh: VMEC++ 的数值
articles.abstract: arXiv:2502.04374v4 Announce Type: replace Abstract: VMEC++ is a Python-friendly, from-scratch reimplementation in C++ of the Variational Moments Equilibrium Code (VMEC), a fixed- and free-boundary ideal-MHD equilibrium solver for stellarators and tokamaks. The first VMEC implementation was written by Steven P.
