Hirshman and colleagues in the 1980s and 1990s and its latest Fortran incarnation (PARVMEC, https://github.com/ORNL-Fusion/PARVMEC) is widely used in stellarator optimization systems. Our work improves on previous implementations with regard to various critical aspects: special care has been put in providing an idiomatic Python experience, from installation to actual usage; VMEC++ has a zero-crash policy; it supports inputs in the classic INDATA format as well as friendlier JSON files. VMEC++ execution times are typically less than or equal to previous implementations, and time to convergence can be decreased dramatically by leveraging its hot-restart feature: by providing the output of a VMEC++ run as initial state for a subsequent one, VMEC++ is initialized using the previously converged equilibrium. This can dramatically decrease runtimes when running on many similar magnetic configurations as it typically happens in stellarator optimization pipelines. On the flip side, some features of the original Fortran VMEC implementation are not yet available in VMEC++, such as support for non-stellarator-symmetric configurations. This contribution presents the internal numerics of the open-source VMEC++ package publicly for the first time.
articles.abstract_zh: VMEC++ 是 Python 友好的、用 C++ 重新实现的变分矩平衡代码 (VMEC)，是用于仿星器和托卡马克的固定和自由边界理想 MHD 平衡求解器。第一个 VMEC 实现是由 Steven P. Hirshman 及其同事在 20 世纪 80 年代和 1990 年代编写的，其最新的 Fortran 版本（PARVMEC，https://github.com/ORNL-Fusion/PARVMEC）广泛用于仿星器优化系统。
articles.abstract_zh_full: VMEC++ 是 Python 友好的、用 C++ 重新实现的变分矩平衡代码 (VMEC)，是用于仿星器和托卡马克的固定和自由边界理想 MHD 平衡求解器。第一个 VMEC 实现是由 Steven P. Hirshman 及其同事在 20 世纪 80 年代和 1990 年代编写的，其最新的 Fortran 版本（PARVMEC，https://github.com/ORNL-Fusion/PARVMEC）广泛用于仿星器优化系统。我们的工作在各个关键方面改进了以前的实现：特别注意提供从安装到实际使用的惯用 Python 体验； VMEC++具有零崩溃政策；它支持经典 INDATA 格式的输入以及更友好的 JSON 文件。 VMEC++ 执行时间通常小于或等于之前的实现，并且通过利用其热重启功能可以显着缩短收敛时间：通过提供 VMEC++ 运行的输出作为后续运行的初始状态，VMEC++ 使用之前收敛的平衡进行初始化。当在许多类似的磁性配置上运行时，这可以显着减少运行时间，因为它通常发生在仿星器优化管道中。另一方面，原始 Fortran VMEC 实现的某些功能在 VMEC++ 中尚不可用，例如对非仿星器对称配置的支持。此贡献首次公开展示了开源 VMEC++ 包的内部数字。

articles.title: Memory-like effects and kinematics of trajectories in Cyclotron motion
articles.title_zh: 回旋加速器运动中的类记忆效应和轨迹运动学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.06594v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We investigate the collective dynamics of a bundle of charged particles undergoing cyclotron motion in a uniform magnetic field when subjected to a short-duration electric pulse. Using the geometric framework based on the evolution of trajectory congruences, we analyze how the pulse affects the expansion, shear, and rotation of a small family of trajectories. We show that the geometric imprint persists after the pulse has vanished, manifesting as a memory of the transient perturbation. Unlike gravitational memory effects, this does not manifest itself in focusing behaviour of the trajectories, and instead implies a restructuring of the shear component before and after the pulse. We offer direct analytic and regression based arguments for the same.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们研究了当受到短时电脉冲时，一束带电粒子在均匀磁场中进行回旋运动的集体动力学。使用基于轨迹同余演化的几何框架，我们分析了脉冲如何影响一小群轨迹的膨胀、剪切和旋转。我们表明，脉冲消失后，几何印记仍然存在，表现为瞬态扰动的记忆。与重力记忆效应不同，这并不表现在轨迹的聚焦行为上，而是意味着脉冲前后剪切分量的重组。我们为此提供直接分析和基于回归的论据。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们研究了当受到短时电脉冲时，一束带电粒子在均匀磁场中进行回旋运动的集体动力学。使用基于轨迹同余演化的几何框架，我们分析了脉冲如何影响一小群轨迹的膨胀、剪切和旋转。我们表明，脉冲消失后，几何印记仍然存在，表现为瞬态扰动的记忆。与重力记忆效应不同，这并不表现在轨迹的聚焦行为上，而是意味着脉冲前后剪切分量的重组。我们为此提供直接分析和基于回归的论据。

articles.title: Computational regimes in matrix-product-state-based quantum trajectory simulations
articles.title_zh: 基于矩阵积态的量子轨迹模拟中的计算机制
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.13779v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Efficient simulation of open quantum systems is central to modeling noisy quantum hardware and many-body dynamics. In trajectory-based tensor network methods, cost is often associated with trajectory-level quantities such as entanglement growth or bond dimension. However, the total cost of a fixed-accuracy simulation also depends on statistical sampling and on how many trajectories can run in parallel. Here we characterize computational regimes in matrix product state (MPS)-based quantum trajectory simulations by separating memory per trajectory, runtime per trajectory, and sampling effort. Two dimensionless ratios compare the bond dimensions and trajectory counts required by physically equivalent unravelings to reach the same target accuracy. When memory limits parallel execution, a smaller trajectory representation reduces the work per sample and allows more samples to run concurrently. Our scaling model predicts when this additional benefit reverses the preferred unraveling between execution limited by workers and execution limited by memory. Benchmarks across several noise channels illustrate how physical and numerical parameters change the bond dimension and sampling requirements. As an application, a pilot protocol estimates the inputs to this regime classification for a specified problem. These results show how the computational cost of an unraveling depends jointly on trajectory complexity, statistical convergence, and available hardware resources.
articles.abstract_zh: 开放量子系统的有效模拟是噪声量子硬件和多体动力学建模的核心。在基于轨迹的张量网络方法中，成本通常与轨迹级数量相关，例如纠缠增长或键维数。然而，固定精度模拟的总成本还取决于统计采样以及可以并行运行的轨迹数量。在这里，我们通过分离每个轨迹的内存、每个轨迹的运行时间和采样工作来描述基于矩阵乘积状态（MPS）的量子轨迹模拟中的计算机制。两个无量纲比率比较物理等效拆开所需的键尺寸和轨迹计数，以达到相同的目标精度。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 开放量子系统的有效模拟是噪声量子硬件和多体动力学建模的核心。在基于轨迹的张量网络方法中，成本通常与轨迹级数量相关，例如纠缠增长或键维数。然而，固定精度模拟的总成本还取决于统计采样以及可以并行运行的轨迹数量。在这里，我们通过分离每个轨迹的内存、每个轨迹的运行时间和采样工作来描述基于矩阵乘积状态（MPS）的量子轨迹模拟中的计算机制。两个无量纲比率比较物理等效拆开所需的键尺寸和轨迹计数，以达到相同的目标精度。当内存限制并行执行时，较小的轨迹表示会减少每个样本的工作量，并允许更多样本同时运行。我们的扩展模型可以预测这种额外的好处何时会逆转受工作人员限制的执行和受内存限制的执行之间的首选解体。多个噪声通道的基准说明了物理和数值参数如何改变键合尺寸和采样要求。作为一种应用，试点协议针对特定问题估计此体系分类的输入。这些结果表明，分解的计算成本如何共同取决于轨迹复杂性、统计收敛性和可用的硬件资源。

articles.title: Spin-dependent fermion potentials from mixed tensor couplings of massive spin-1 and spin-2 bosons
articles.title_zh: 来自大量自旋 1 和自旋 2 玻色子混合张量耦合的自旋相关费米子势
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.30240v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Searches for weak spin-dependent forces are commonly interpreted in terms of a basis of sixteen rotationally invariant two-fermion potentials. We derive finite-range coordinate-space potentials generated by a massive spin-1 boson with vector, axial-vector, tensor, and pseudotensor couplings to Dirac fermions. In addition to the familiar vector--vector, vector--axial-vector, and axial-vector--axial-vector interactions, we obtain the mixed vector--tensor, vector--pseudotensor, axial-vector--tensor, and axial-vector--pseudotensor potentials, together with tensor--tensor, tensor--pseudotensor, and pseudotensor--pseudotensor terms. We retain the contact terms needed in atomic-scale applications and give compact expressions that include both orderings of inequivalent fermion vertices. We then extend the analysis to a massive spin-2 mediator described by a symmetric Fierz--Pauli field. Besides the conventional coupling to the conserved fermion energy--momentum tensor, we consider a symmetric axial-tensor current. Its nonconservation for massive fermions makes the longitudinal spin-2 helicities contribute to axial-tensor--axial-tensor exchange. The leading minimal spin-2 interactions are either P,T even or P odd and T evenl. Heavy-mediator contact limits and the distinction between the M-->0 massive-spin-2 limit and a genuine massless graviton are also discussed. We map the resulting interactions onto the sixteen-potential Dobrescu--Mocioiu basis and use this mapping to translate existing experimental constraints into numerical limits on spin-1 and spin-2 coupling products in the small- and large-mediator-mass regimes, together with representative limits at finite mediator masses. The derived relations between the boson-exchange coupling constants and the coefficients of the basis potentials also allow published exclusion curves to be rescaled to arbitrary mediator masses.
articles.abstract_zh: 对弱自旋相关力的搜索通常根据十六个旋转不变的二费米子势来解释。我们推导了由大量自旋 1 玻色子生成的有限范围坐标空间势，该玻色子具有与狄拉克费米子的矢量、轴矢量、张量和赝张量耦合。除了熟悉的矢量-矢量、矢量-轴矢量和轴矢量-轴矢量相互作用之外，我们还获得了混合矢量-张量、矢量-赝张量、轴矢量-张量和轴矢量-赝张量势，以及张量-张量、张量-赝张量和赝张量-赝张量项。我们保留原子尺度应用中所需的接触项，并给出包含不等价费米子顶点的两种排序的紧凑表达式。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 对弱自旋相关力的搜索通常根据十六个旋转不变的二费米子势来解释。我们推导了由大量自旋 1 玻色子生成的有限范围坐标空间势，该玻色子具有与狄拉克费米子的矢量、轴矢量、张量和赝张量耦合。除了熟悉的矢量-矢量、矢量-轴矢量和轴矢量-轴矢量相互作用之外，我们还获得了混合矢量-张量、矢量-赝张量、轴矢量-张量和轴矢量-赝张量势，以及张量-张量、张量-赝张量和赝张量-赝张量项。我们保留原子尺度应用中所需的接触项，并给出包含不等价费米子顶点的两种排序的紧凑表达式。然后，我们将分析扩展到由对称 Fierz-Pauli 场描述的大规模自旋 2 介体。除了与守恒费米子能量动量张量的传统耦合之外，我们还考虑对称的轴向张量电流。它对大质量费米子的不守恒使得纵向自旋 2 螺旋性有助于轴向张量-轴向张量交换。主要的最小自旋 2 相互作用是 P,T 偶数或 P 奇数和 T 偶数。还讨论了重介体接触极限以及 M-->0 质量自旋 2 极限和真正的无质量引力子之间的区别。我们将产生的相互作用映射到十六个潜在的 Dobrescu-Mocioiu 基础上，并使用该映射将现有的实验约束转化为小和大介体质量状态下自旋 1 和自旋 2 耦合产物的数值限制，以及有限介体质量下的代表性限制。玻色子交换耦合常数和基势系数之间的导出关系还允许将已发布的排除曲线重新调整为任意介体质量。

articles.title: Multiparameter quantum bounds for entanglement-assisted aperture synthesis
articles.title_zh: 纠缠辅助孔径合成的多参数量子界
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.10111v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Entanglement-assisted optical interferometry promises diffraction-limited imaging over baselines where light cannot be physically combined, but its estimation-theoretic bounds exist only for a single visibility on one baseline. This work formulates the multiparameter quantum estimation problem for an M-station array. A reduction lemma shows that the multimode quantum Fisher information (QFI) equals the mean photon number times the QFI of a single delocalized photon, making the problem finite-dimensional. The local photon-number superselection rule erases all phase information from the bare state; shared entanglement restores a fraction f(r)=r/(1+r) of the QFI on a baseline supplied with r pairs, a benchmark that applies to every pair of the array. The QFI matrix and its mean Uhlmann curvature show numerically that a point source is measurement-compatible, whereas every extended-source model examined is incompatible; a semidefinite-programming evaluation shows that the Holevo bound exceeds the symmetric-logarithmic-derivative bound by up to ~24% for three stations and by 4-8% for larger arrays and for CHARA. An explicit collective receiver, a numerically optimised global linear-optical network with photon counting, attains a weighted variance within 2-9% of the Holevo bound, over an order of magnitude below an explicit pairwise receiver, and a noisy-resource threshold gives the break-even baseline (~22 km for illustrative parameters) beyond which distributed entanglement beats direct transmission. Finally, allocating a finite entanglement budget has a closed-form proportional (square-root-law) solution for a per-baseline fringe cost, whereas for the source-parameter variance under an explicit photon budget the routing of photons matters far more than the entanglement split. These results recast quantum aperture synthesis as collective multiparameter estimation, illustrated on CHARA.
articles.abstract_zh: 纠缠辅助光学干涉测量法有望在光无法物理组合的基线上进行衍射限制成像，但其估计理论界限仅存在于一条基线上的单一可见度。这项工作阐述了 M 站阵列的多参数量子估计问题。约简引理表明，多模量子费希尔信息 (QFI) 等于平均光子数乘以单个离域光子的 QFI，从而使问题成为有限维。局部光子数超选规则擦除了裸态中的所有相位信息；共享纠缠在 r 对提供的基线上恢复 QFI 的分数 f(r)=r/(1+r)，这是适用于每对阵列的基准。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 纠缠辅助光学干涉测量法有望在光无法物理组合的基线上进行衍射限制成像，但其估计理论界限仅存在于一条基线上的单一可见度。这项工作阐述了 M 站阵列的多参数量子估计问题。约简引理表明，多模量子费希尔信息 (QFI) 等于平均光子数乘以单个离域光子的 QFI，从而使问题成为有限维。局部光子数超选规则擦除了裸态中的所有相位信息；共享纠缠在 r 对提供的基线上恢复 QFI 的分数 f(r)=r/(1+r)，这是适用于每对阵列的基准。 QFI 矩阵及其平均乌尔曼曲率在数值上表明点源是测量兼容的，而所检查的每个扩展源模型都是不兼容的；半定规划评估表明，对于三个站，Holevo 界限超出对称对数导数界限高达约 24%，对于较大阵列和 CHARA，超出对称对数导数界限 4-8%。显式集体接收器是一种具有光子计数功能的数值优化全局线性光学网络，其加权方差在 Holevo 界限的 2-9% 范围内，比显式成对接收器低一个数量级，并且噪声资源阈值给出了盈亏平衡基线（说明性参数约为 22 公里），超过该基线分布式纠缠优于直接传输。最后，分配有限纠缠预算对于每基线边缘成本有一个封闭形式的比例（平方根定律）解决方案，而对于显式光子预算下的源参数方差，光子的路由比纠缠分裂更重要。这些结果将量子孔径合成重新定义为集体多参数估计，如 CHARA 所示。

articles.title: Generative discovery of chemical reaction networks
articles.title_zh: 化学反应网络的生成发现
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.38236v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Understanding chemical reactivity requires uncovering which pathways are accessible from a given set of reactants, how they compete, and how successive reactions reshape the mixture. Automated saddle-point searches can explore from reactants alone, but their computational cost rises sharply as competing pathways accumulate across successive steps. Machine-learning approaches to transition state generation typically require predefined products, yet identifying those products is a central goal of exploration. Here we introduce ReactNexus, a generative framework that generates transition-state candidates directly from reactant graphs without specifying products, predicts the species they connect, and refines pathways with a reactive machine-learned potential to guide network exploration. Its models were trained on a quantum-chemical database of 130 million structures from 1.1 million reaction records, spanning 11 elements and multiple charge and spin states. On held-out reactions, 93.6% of generated candidates refined to valid transition states at the density functional theory level, and 83.3% connected the supplied reactants to distinct products. Across decomposition, complex rearrangements, and organocatalysis, ReactNexus reveals how competing mechanisms shape product formation, uncovering pathways missed in previous studies. In a multisite nucleophilic aromatic substitution, ReactNexus identified diarylation products that explained initially unassigned LC-MS signals, with structural assignments supported by NMR after isolation. ReactNexus also predicted an additional product family not detected under the initial conditions; subsequent higher-temperature experiments provided LC-MS evidence supporting its formation. This work highlights the potential of generative models to extend mechanistic analysis to increasingly complex reaction mixtures.
articles.abstract_zh: 了解化学反应性需要揭示一组给定反应物可进入哪些途径、它们如何竞争以及连续反应如何重塑混合物。自动鞍点搜索可以仅从反应物中进行探索，但随着连续步骤中竞争路径的积累，其计算成本急剧上升。生成过渡状态的机器学习方法通常需要预定义的产品，但识别这些产品是探索的中心目标。在这里，我们介绍 ReactNexus，这是一个生成框架，可以直接从反应物图生成过渡态候选，而不指定产物，预测它们连接的物种，并利用反应性机器学习潜力来细化路径来指导网络探索。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 了解化学反应性需要揭示一组给定反应物可进入哪些途径、它们如何竞争以及连续反应如何重塑混合物。自动鞍点搜索可以仅从反应物中进行探索，但随着连续步骤中竞争路径的积累，其计算成本急剧上升。生成过渡状态的机器学习方法通常需要预定义的产品，但识别这些产品是探索的中心目标。在这里，我们介绍 ReactNexus，这是一个生成框架，可以直接从反应物图生成过渡态候选，而不指定产物，预测它们连接的物种，并利用反应性机器学习潜力来细化路径来指导网络探索。其模型在量子化学数据库上进行训练，该数据库包含来自 110 万条反应记录的 1.3 亿个结构，涵盖 11 种元素以及多种电荷和自旋态。在保留反应中，93.6% 的生成候选在密度泛函理论水平上精炼为有效的过渡态，83.3% 将提供的反应物与不同的产物连接起来。通过分解、复杂重排和有机催化，ReactNexus 揭示了竞争机制如何塑造产物形成，揭示了先前研究中遗漏的途径。在多位点亲核芳香取代中，ReactNexus 鉴定了二芳基化产物，这些产物解释了最初未分配的 LC-MS 信号，分离后的结构分配得到了 NMR 的支持。 ReactNexus 还预测了在初始条件下未检测到的其他产品系列；随后的高温实验提供了支持其形成的 LC-MS 证据。这项工作强调了生成模型将机械分析扩展到日益复杂的反应混合物的潜力。

articles.title: Chebyshev Polynomial Zonotope Abstractions for Certified Reachability of Learning-Enabled Systems
articles.title_zh: 用于学习系统认证可达性的切比雪夫多项式区域抽象
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.23246v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Nearly all current methods for computing reachable sets of nonlinear dynamics propagate them with truncated Taylor expansions plus rigorous remainders. The expansion is pointwise: once its argument is a whole set rather than a point, one polynomial must stay accurate across that set, and it reaches only as far as its disc of convergence. The limit binds hardest on the rational terms and sigmoid gates of modern controllers: smooth as these look on the real line, in the complex plane they blow up at points just off the real axis, closer as a gate sharpens, and those points cap the set width a Taylor expansion can cover, most tightly on the switching surface where the controller decides. We prove a dichotomy: no Taylor degree certifies sets wider than that cap, while a Chebyshev abstraction of equal degree, anchored to the whole set in the same polynomial-zonotope pipeline, has no cap and gains width at a geometric rate in degree. Measured walls match the formulas to between 89 and 94 percent. We give closed-form rigorous remainders, among them the first polynomial softmax transformer; existing sound treatments are linear relaxations. On closed loops, certificates survive where the Taylor ones diverge, and specifications flip from unknown to proven; on trained classifiers up to real MNIST digits, the Chebyshev frontier certifies input territory the Taylor basis surrenders. Every certified claim passed large Monte-Carlo harnesses with zero violations, and an applicability map states in advance where the basis provably cannot matter.
articles.abstract_zh: 几乎所有当前计算非线性动力学可达集的方法都通过截断的泰勒展开式加上严格的余数来传播它们。展开是逐点的：一旦它的参数是整个集合而不是一个点，一个多项式必须在该集合上保持准确，并且它只能到达其收敛盘。该限制对现代控制器的有理项和 sigmoid 门的约束最为严格：它们在实线上看起来很平滑，但在复平面中，它们在离开实轴的点处爆炸，随着门的锐化而更接近，这些点限制了泰勒展开式可以覆盖的设定宽度，最紧密地位于控制器决定的切换表面上。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 几乎所有当前计算非线性动力学可达集的方法都通过截断的泰勒展开式加上严格的余数来传播它们。展开是逐点的：一旦它的参数是整个集合而不是一个点，一个多项式必须在该集合上保持准确，并且它只能到达其收敛盘。该限制对现代控制器的有理项和 sigmoid 门的约束最为严格：它们在实线上看起来很平滑，但在复平面中，它们在离开实轴的点处爆炸，随着门的锐化而更接近，这些点限制了泰勒展开式可以覆盖的设定宽度，最紧密地位于控制器决定的切换表面上。我们证明了一个二分法：没有泰勒度证明集合比该上限更宽，而同等程度的切比雪夫抽象，锚定到同一多项式区域管道中的整个集合，没有上限并且以度数的几何比率获得宽度。测量的墙壁与公式的匹配度在 89% 到 94% 之间。我们给出了封闭形式的严格余数，其中包括第一个多项式 softmax 变换器；现有的声音处理是线性松弛。在闭环中，证书在泰勒证书出现分歧的地方仍然存在，并且规范从未知转变为已验证；在训练有素的 MNIST 数字分类器上，切比雪夫边界证明了泰勒基放弃的输入区域。每项经过认证的声明都通过了大型蒙特卡洛安全带，零违规，并且适用性地图提前说明了基础可证明并不重要。

articles.title: Toward Out-of-Distribution Generalization in Neural AC Power Flow
articles.title_zh: 神经交流功率流的分布外推广
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.23729v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Growing uncertainty in power system operations from renewables integration, extreme weather, and data center loads challenges the reliability of traditional power flow solvers at scale. Machine learning-based proxies are a potentially promising alternative, but the prohibitive cost of generating training data for large grids makes out-of-distribution generalization a key capability for deployment; currently, models trained on small grids lack that capability. In this work, we systematically evaluate how physics-informed losses, multi-grid training, and perturbation-based data augmentation improve the zero-shot transfer of three graph neural network-based power flow models from smaller systems to a larger, unseen 500-bus system. We find that (1) physics-informed losses improve transfer relative to purely supervised objectives; (2) multi-grid training on smaller systems matches the best single grid but does not close the gap to target-grid training; (3) perturbation-based augmentation on edge attributes improves transfer by up to 54.6%; and (4) random line/generator dropout does not consistently improve performance.

articles.abstract_zh_full: Growing uncertainty in power system operations from renewables integration, extreme weather, and data center loads challenges the reliability of traditional power flow solvers at scale. Machine learning-based proxies are a potentially promising alternative, but the prohibitive cost of generating training data for large grids makes out-of-distribution generalization a key capability for deployment;目前，在小型网格上训练的模型缺乏这种能力。 In this work, we systematically evaluate how physics-informed losses, multi-grid training, and perturbation-based data augmentation improve the zero-shot transfer of three graph neural network-based power flow models from smaller systems to a larger, unseen 500-bus system.我们发现（1）物理信息损失相对于纯监督目标改善了转移； (2) 较小系统上的多网格训练与最佳单个网格匹配，但并未缩小与目标网格训练的差距； (3) 基于扰动的边缘属性增强将传输提高高达 54.6%； (4) 随机线路/发电机丢失并不能始终如一地提高性能。

articles.title: A Systematic Analysis of a Small Optimal Subspace for Physics-Informed Neural Networks: n-DAS subset R^p
articles.title_zh: 物理信息神经网络的小型最优子空间的系统分析：n-DAS 子集 R^p
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.23773v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The search for a low-dimensional subspace that governs neural network training has been a persistent goal in optimization. Yet subspaces defined by Hessian eigenvalue magnitude, such as the dominant/bulk decomposition underlying Dom-SGD and Bulk-SGD, have repeatedly failed to capture where optimization takes place, and adaptive Krylov-based alternatives built on energy-fraction thresholds show promise but still struggle at lower eigenmodes. We argue this failure is structural: the directions of highest curvature are not, in general, the directions along which training moves. We introduce the dominant aligned subspace (DAS), constructed from a full eigendecomposition of the Hessian but selected by gradient alignment rather than eigenvalue magnitude, as a tool for understanding optimization dynamics and a foundation for designing methods that exploit them. To expose this structure under the hardest conditions, we use physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) as a testbed: differential operators from the parabolic, elliptic, and hyperbolic classes induce severely ill-conditioned, anisotropic loss landscapes. Across Poisson, heat, wave, and viscous Burgers benchmarks DAS-restricted training with a line search matches full-space training even where the projected Hessian remains ill-conditioned, showing empirically that convergence does not require all Hessian eigendirections but only a low-dimensional, gradient-aligned subset. We extend the analysis to Gauss-Newton within the DAS and discuss what this structure implies for future subspace-aware optimizers.
articles.abstract_zh: 寻找控制神经网络训练的低维子空间一直是优化的持久目标。然而，由 Hessian 特征值大小定义的子空间，例如 Dom-SGD 和 Bulk-SGD 背后的显性/体分解，一再未能捕获优化发生的位置，而基于能量分数阈值的自适应 Krylov 替代方案显示出希望，但在较低的本征模上仍然举步维艰。我们认为这种失败是结构性的：通常，曲率最高的方向并不是训练移动的方向。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 寻找控制神经网络训练的低维子空间一直是优化的持久目标。然而，由 Hessian 特征值大小定义的子空间，例如 Dom-SGD 和 Bulk-SGD 背后的显性/体分解，一再未能捕获优化发生的位置，而基于能量分数阈值的自适应 Krylov 替代方案显示出希望，但在较低的本征模上仍然举步维艰。我们认为这种失败是结构性的：通常，曲率最高的方向并不是训练移动的方向。我们引入了主导对齐子空间（DAS），它是由 Hessian 矩阵的完整特征分解构建的，但通过梯度对齐而不是特征值大小来选择，作为理解优化动力学的工具和设计利用它们的方法的基础。为了在最困难的条件下暴露这种结构，我们使用物理信息神经网络（PINN）作为测试平台：抛物线、椭圆和双曲类的微分算子会导致严重病态的各向异性损失景观。在泊松、热、波和粘性 Burgers 基准测试中，即使投影的 Hessian 矩阵仍然病态，DAS 限制训练与线搜索也能与全空间训练相匹配，这从经验上表明，收敛不需要所有 Hessian 特征方向，而只需要低维、梯度对齐的子集。我们将分析扩展到 DAS 中的高斯牛顿，并讨论这种结构对未来的子空间感知优化器意味着什么。

articles.title: Continuous Noisy-Loop Models
articles.title_zh: 连续噪声环路模型
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.24213v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Efficient learning and inference need not imply a compact probabilistic circuit. We quantify this distinction for continuous noisy readings of agreement between adjacent latent spins on a known square grid with d edges. With known margins and bounded Lipschitz channels, minimax squared Hellinger risk is Θ(min1,dN⁻²/³) from N independent vectors, without a reliability lower bound. A spline estimator reaches this rate in polynomial arithmetic time given a fixed positive reliability bound; an exponential-size mixture removes that requirement. At fixed positive reliability, nonnegative decomposable circuits need exp(Θ(sqrt d)) nodes for fixed total-variation error below one, even when each leaf uses at most α d coordinates, 0<α<1. Optimal Kullback--Leibler (KL) approximation error is Θ(d/maxlog d,sqrtell) in either direction with at most d^r nodes and leaf scopes ell≤α d, for fixed r>1 and 0<α<2/3. Node counts exclude leaf computation. For three fixed masks, optimal joint conditional KL has order d/log d when ell≤(log d)². Local cycle identities relate joint divergence to identifiable channel products and separate weak-channel recovery from density estimation. Factorized evidence preserves a planar zero-field Ising model: given local integrals, exact queries cost O(d³/²) arithmetic operations and one root extraction.
articles.abstract_zh: 高效的学习和推理不一定意味着紧凑的概率电路。我们量化了这种区别，以获取具有 d 边的已知方形网格上相邻潜在自旋之间一致性的连续噪声读数。在已知边际和有界 Lipschitz 通道的情况下，最小最大平方 Hellinger 风险为来自 N 个独立向量的 θ(min1,dN⁻²/³)，没有可靠性下限。给定固定的正可靠性界限，样条估计器在多项式算术时间内达到该速率；指数大小的混合物消除了这一要求。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 高效的学习和推理不一定意味着紧凑的概率电路。我们量化了这种区别，以获取具有 d 边的已知方形网格上相邻潜在自旋之间一致性的连续噪声读数。在已知边际和有界 Lipschitz 通道的情况下，最小最大平方 Hellinger 风险为来自 N 个独立向量的 θ(min1,dN⁻²/³)，没有可靠性下限。给定固定的正可靠性界限，样条估计器在多项式算术时间内达到该速率；指数大小的混合物消除了这一要求。在固定的正可靠性下，非负可分解电路需要 exp(θ(sqrt d)) 节点来将总变异误差固定在 1 以下，即使每个叶子最多使用 α d 坐标，即 01 和 0<α<2/3。节点计数不包括叶子计算。对于三个固定掩模，当 ell≤(log d)² 时，最佳联合条件 KL 的阶数为 d/log d。局部循环恒等式将联合发散与可识别的信道产品相关联，并将弱信道恢复与密度估计分开。因式分解的证据保留了平面零场 Ising 模型：给定局部积分，精确查询成本为 O(d³/²) 算术运算和一次根提取。

articles.title: Morpho-Spectral Projection Analysis (MSPA) for Plant Spectroscopy
articles.title_zh: 用于植物光谱学的形态光谱投影分析 (MSPA)
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.24599v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Plant reflectance spectroscopy across the visible, near-infrared, and shortwave infrared domain encodes foliar biochemical and anatomical traits into contiguous spectral signatures with locally differentiable structure; however, extreme inter-band collinearity and unfavorable sample-to-feature ratios challenge predictive modeling. Conventional dimensionality reduction methods routinely adopted in spectroscopy, are column-permutation invariant: they treat adjacent wavelengths as unordered tabular columns and discard the sequential differential geometry of absorption features. Here, we propose Morpho-Spectral Projection Analysis (MSPA), a supervised dimensionality reduction operator that projects contiguous spectra into a compact morpho-spectral subspace through three complementary blocks: (i) additive continuum-removed absorption depth, area, and red-edge inflection kinematics; (ii) local multi-order singular eigenmodes (0th, 1st, and 2nd derivatives) partitioned across contiguous radiative sub-windows; and (iii) global Fisher-weighted canonical subspaces regularized via trace-normalized isotropic covariance shrinkage. We validated MSPA across 8,963 spectra spanning five plant systems, coupled with six classical machine learning classifiers and four Tabular Foundation Models (TabPFN v3, TabICL v2, TabDPT v1.2, and TabFM). Despite compressing the 1,580-band spectrum by 96%, MSPA outperformed the full spectrum in 92.0% of all benchmarks and conventional reducers in 90.0% of all model-crop evaluations, raising the global mean macro-F1 from 0.7756 (full spectrum) to 0.8520, accelerating in-context inference by up to 126.5x. Designed as a self-contained spectral projection operator, the MSPA method can be directly integrated into spectroscopy workflows via the open-source code available at GitHub: https://github.com/Lucas-Osco/mspa.

articles.abstract_zh_full: 跨越可见光、近红外和短波红外域的植物反射光谱将叶的生化和解剖特征编码为具有局部可微结构的连续光谱特征；然而，极端的带间共线性和不利的样本特征比对预测建模提出了挑战。光谱学中常规采用的传统降维方法是列排列不变的：它们将相邻波长视为无序表格列，并丢弃吸收特征的顺序微分几何。在这里，我们提出了形态谱投影分析（MSPA），这是一种有监督的降维算子，通过三个互补模块将连续光谱投影到紧凑的形态谱子空间中：（i）附加连续体去除吸收深度、面积和红边拐点运动学； (ii) 跨连续辐射子窗口划分的局部多阶奇异本征模（0阶、1阶和2阶导数）； (iii) 通过迹归一化各向同性协方差收缩进行正则化的全局 Fisher 加权规范子空间。我们在跨越五个植物系统的 8,963 个光谱中验证了 MSPA，并结合六个经典机器学习分类器和四个表格基础模型（TabPFN v3、TabICL v2、TabDPT v1.2 和 TabFM）。尽管将 1,580 频段频谱压缩了 96%，但 MSPA 在 92.0% 的基准测试中优于全频谱，在 90.0% 的所有模型作物评估中优于传统减速器，将全局平均宏 F1 从 0.7756（全频谱）提高到 0.8520，将上下文推理速度提高了 126.5 倍。 MSPA 方法被设计为独立的光谱投影算子，可以通过 GitHub 上提供的开源代码直接集成到光谱工作流程中：https://github.com/Lucas-Osco/mspa。

articles.title: Synthesizing hyperspectral Data using generative Models to train spectral Unmixing Methods for low-cost Crop Residue Cover Mapping
articles.title_zh: 使用生成模型合成高光谱数据来训练低成本作物残茬覆盖测绘的光谱分离方法
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.24827v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The spectral range of the Field Imaging Nanosatellite for Crop residue Hyperspectral Mapping (FINCH), developed by the University of Toronto Aerospace Team's Space System Division, poses significant challenges for hyperspectral unmixing to determine crop residue cover fractional abundances. The severe lack of standard indices necessitates the use of complex, data-driven unmixing models. Complex unmixing models require dense, well-distributed manifolds, whereas ground-truth datasets are sparse and expensive. To better leverage the information content in existing ground-truth datasets, this study presents a framework that decouples interpolation and abundance-mapping estimation via an intermediary conditional data generator, contrasting with traditional single-model unmixing pipelines. This decoupling enables the inclusion of physical prior knowledge about spectra, which is not natively accessible to unmixing models, thereby artificially expanding the dataset to serve as a Monte Carlo approximation of the population risk. To test this hypothesis, we have proposed two generator models: a 1D Conditional U-Net with Conformer Layers (GD-Streamline) and a Dual-Path Transformer Conditional Variational AutoEncoder (TCVAE), and two unmixing models: Multi-Layered Perceptrons (MLP) and Fourier Neural Operators (FNO). The results of the study indicate a need for rigorous integration and introduction of spectral priors within the scope of the proposed decoupling framework to prevent domain and mode collapse and hallucination by the generator models; otherwise, this leads to falsely approximated data manifolds, ultimately resulting in unsatisfactory and out-of-distribution unmixing performance.
articles.abstract_zh: 由多伦多大学航空航天团队的空间系统部门开发的用于农作物残留物高光谱测绘（FINCH）的现场成像纳米卫星的光谱范围对高光谱分解以确定农作物残留物覆盖分数丰度提出了重大挑战。标准指数的严重缺乏需要使用复杂的、数据驱动的分解模型。复杂的分解模型需要密集、分布均匀的流形，而真实数据集稀疏且昂贵。为了更好地利用现有地面实况数据集中的信息内容，本研究提出了一个框架，通过中间条件数据生成器将插值和丰度映射估计解耦，与传统的单模型分解管道形成对比。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 由多伦多大学航空航天团队的空间系统部门开发的用于农作物残留物高光谱测绘（FINCH）的现场成像纳米卫星的光谱范围对高光谱分解以确定农作物残留物覆盖分数丰度提出了重大挑战。标准指数的严重缺乏需要使用复杂的、数据驱动的分解模型。复杂的分解模型需要密集、分布均匀的流形，而真实数据集稀疏且昂贵。为了更好地利用现有地面实况数据集中的信息内容，本研究提出了一个框架，通过中间条件数据生成器将插值和丰度映射估计解耦，与传统的单模型分解管道形成对比。这种解耦使得能够包含有关光谱的物理先验知识，而这些知识本身对于分解模型来说是不可访问的，从而人为地扩展数据集以充当总体风险的蒙特卡洛近似。为了测试这个假设，我们提出了两个生成器模型：具有一致性层的一维条件 U-Net (GD-Streamline) 和双路径变换器条件变分自动编码器 (TCVAE)，以及两个分解模型：多层感知器 (MLP) 和傅立叶神经算子 (FNO)。研究结果表明，需要在所提出的解耦框架范围内严格集成和引入谱先验，以防止域和模式崩溃以及生成器模型的幻觉；否则，这会导致错误地近似数据流形，最终导致解混性能不令人满意且超出分布。

articles.title: TangentPDE: Learning Local Operator Responses with Sparse Finite-Difference Supervision
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.24873v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Neural PDE operators are often optimized through state reconstruction, which largely constrains operator values at observed inputs but does not fully characterize their sensitivity to local perturbations. A more faithful approximation of operator behavior requires not only accurate state predictions, but also correct variations along local perturbation directions. We present TangentPDE, which uses finite differences to approximate directional derivatives and constructs task-relevant finite-step responses from the state outputs of a reference solver at sparse paired inputs. Its objective jointly constrains state fidelity, response-direction alignment, and response-magnitude calibration, thereby learning both operator values and their local variations. Because the response labels are constructed solely from state outputs at paired inputs, the method requires neither explicit derivative labels, linearized or adjoint PDE solves, nor full Jacobians, and remains applicable to nonlinear solvers without derivative interfaces. Building on this, we additionally propose a selectively executed adaptation mechanism to strengthen local operator representations under finite-difference supervision. Budget-matched and correspondence-perturbed controls isolate the effect of relational supervision from improvements attributable to additional state observations or increased data volume. Designed as a plug-and-play training framework, TangentPDE integrates with diverse neural-operator backbones. Across four PDE systems and 20 task-backbone settings, TangentPDE lowers the three-seed mean state error in 18 settings and the corresponding Rollout@20 error in 18, while intrinsic finite-step response gains are strongest on DiffReact and remain task- and backbone-dependent elsewhere.

articles.title: Neural Circuit Architectural Priors for Rat Locomotion
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.23364v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Animals generate behavior through continuous interactions between their neural circuits, bodies, and environment. Embodied simulations study these interactions by testing neural circuit models in biologically realistic settings. Recent efforts have simulated diverse animals, and emerging work on biologically grounded neural architectures has begun to integrate circuit connectivity and single-unit dynamics from experimental data into artificial neural networks, introducing stronger inductive biases and closer mechanistic alignment with biology. How can we develop embodied simulations that enable the study of increasingly complex bodies and neural circuits? In this work, we address the challenge through coordinated advances in the simulated body, neural architecture, and training infrastructure. We introduce Rat v2, an efficient and flexible biomechanical body for simulating rat behavior. To control this body, we develop Rat NCAP, a biologically grounded neural architecture for locomotion based on mammalian spinal circuits that incorporates cell-type-specific connectivity and a novel flexor-extensor neuromechanical interface. To optimize circuit parameters, we develop GPU-accelerated simulation and training infrastructure. The model learns to locomote at different speeds and transition between gaits without imitation learning, producing locomotion statistics, kinematics, and cell-type-specific neural activity consistent with experimental data. Analyses reveal that the neuromechanical interface substantially affects trainability and gait quality, and in silico cell-type ablations reproduce known gait phenotypes and predict gait changes under graded perturbations. Together, these findings support the view that embodied simulations at an intermediate level of abstraction can simultaneously reproduce complex behavior and yield mechanistic insights into the neural circuits that generate it.

articles.title: Accelerating Distributed Digital Ising Machines
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.23883v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Ising machines, dedicated accelerators built around the dynamics of Ising-like spin models, have emerged as a leading platform for combinatorial optimization and probabilistic sampling. The problems that motivate them require millions of spins, far beyond the on-chip capacity of any single device, so a practical Ising machine must distribute its computation across many devices. Prior work reports throughput at a single operating point, leaving the binding resource unidentified and platform crossovers measurable only by experiment; no calibrated cross-platform cost model of distributed Ising machines has been reported, nor have systematic techniques to accelerate their Markov chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) workloads. This work presents a calibrated cost model that decomposes digital Ising sweep time into compute, memory, synchronization, and inter-device communication terms, validated with 4.8% mean error across three GPU generations, FPGA and ASIC up to 1 million spins. Guided by the model, we address each term in turn and propose: (i) a data placement strategy, worth up to 4.2× speedup; (ii) multi-rate and bounded-staleness schedules that relax the barrier that Gibbs sampling imposes, cutting time-to-solution (TTS) by up to 3.16× on three benchmarks; and (iii) a phase-offset streaming dataflow that hides boundary exchange behind interior computation whenever a link satisfies a latency-transparency criterion, yielding up to 1.25×/1.74×/2.01× on an H200 pair, a ZCU106 pair, and a four-board XEM8320 2×2 mesh. The streaming dataflow is also implemented on a fabricated four-chip 28 nm ASIC sustaining 28.1 Gflips/s at 4.81 pJ/flip.

articles.title: Fill-Distance-Guided Active Learning for Causal Function Recovery under Network Interference
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.24143v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Causal inference seeks to learn how outcomes change under alternative interventions, but network interactions complicate this task. Under network interference, outcomes depend on both own treatment and neighbors' treatments, making causal effects functions of neighborhood exposure rather than single treatment contrasts. Existing methods primarily target prespecified causal contrasts or their estimation precision, leaving global response-function recovery largely unexplored. We study sequential experimentation under a limited experimental budget, with the goal of recovering the full exposure-dependent population-average response function. To this end, we propose FANCI (Fill-Distance-Guided Active Learning for Network-Interference Causal Inference). For function learning, treatment-specific Gaussian processes flexibly model nonlinear conditional response surfaces. For experimental design, we formulate global response-function recovery as a coverage problem and propose a fill-distance criterion that guides new experiments toward poorly covered regions. To account for network constraints on attainable exposure patterns, we develop full-network and target-screened strategies for selecting feasible network--assignment pairs. Theoretically, we derive uniform error bounds linking fill distance to response-function estimation and characterize the approximation loss from target screening. Simulations and an online-game experiment show that FANCI improves recovery of nonlinear exposure-dependent effects and reveals treatment patterns obscured when network interference is ignored.

articles.title: GALA: Gallery-Level Alignment for Real-Life Vision Decoding from EEG
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.24206v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Neural decoding of visual experience from electroencephalography (EEG) has achieved strong performance in intra-subject settings, but current methods fail to generalize across individuals: on the standard 200-way benchmark THINGS-EEG-2, top-1 accuracy drops from above 80% within subjects to about 32% for an unseen subject. Adapting a pre-trained encoder to new subjects and sessions typically requires labeled data, a bottleneck whose collection time severely limits practical device deployment. In a practical Brain-Computer Interface (BCI), however, the possible outcomes are known in advance and form a gallery of candidates, and the unlabeled EEG of the user accumulates as soon as the device is used. We propose a new setting, incremental transductive calibration, in which the decoder is calibrated regularly on all the unlabeled EEG received so far and on the known gallery, without any labels. This setting is closer to the conditions of a deployed BCI than the zero-shot and batch evaluations in current use. We evaluate it with a protocol in which queries arrive one at a time, with unknown and possibly unequal frequencies, and each query is decoded before it is used for calibration. In this setting, we introduce GALA : GAllery-Level Alignment, a label-free calibration method which registers the unlabeled EEG embeddings onto the gallery through shrinkage whitening, hubness correction and a Sinkhorn--Procrustes alignment with query frequencies estimated from the buffer, updated after every query. On THINGS-EEG-2, with a gallery of 200 images, it raises the top-1 accuracy on a new subject from 28% to 67% over 53 minutes of use. Across 60 evaluation settings that vary the gallery size, the query frequencies and the number of repetitions averaged per query, GALA is the most accurate label-free method in every setting, 6.6 points above the best competing method on average at the end of the stream.

articles.title: TableControl: Gesture Interaction Through Surface Vibrations
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.24218v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Integrating gesture sensing into furniture offers a way to interact with digital applications and physical devices through familiar surfaces. We present TableControl, an interactive demonstration of continuous surface-vibration-based gesture recognition with the complete processing pipeline running on a microcontroller. Using four concealed piezoelectric sensors, the system combines signal acquisition and preprocessing with neural event detection and gesture classification. The resulting labels for knock, swipe-up, and swipe-down gestures are transmitted to a host computer without streaming the underlying sensor signals. Visitors explore two example applications through hands-on interaction: an endless runner game and a physical table lamp with on/off and brightness control. A dashboard displays recognized gestures, class probabilities, and processing times.

articles.title: Optimistic Actor-Critic with Parametric Policies for Linear Markov Decision Processes
articles.abstract: arXiv:2603.28595v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Although actor-critic methods have been successful in practice, their theoretical analyses have several limitations. Specifically, existing theoretical work either sidesteps the exploration problem by making strong assumptions or analyzes impractical methods with complicated algorithmic modifications. Moreover, the actor-critic methods analyzed for linear MDPs often employ natural policy gradient and define "implicit" policies through the accumulated critic estimates, rather than learning an explicitly parameterized actor. Such policies can be computationally expensive to sample from, making the environment interactions inefficient. To that end, we focus on the finite-horizon linear MDPs and propose an optimistic actor-critic framework that uses parametric log-linear policies. In particular, we introduce a tractable logit-matching regression objective for the actor. For the critic, we use approximate Thompson sampling via Langevin Monte Carlo to obtain optimistic value estimates. We prove that, when the policy features are sufficiently expressive, the resulting algorithm achieves widetildeO(ϵ⁻⁴) and widetildeO(ϵ⁻²) sample complexity in the on-policy and off-policy settings, respectively. Our results match the state-of-the-art dependence on ϵ in prior theoretical work, while our algorithm is more aligned with practice.

articles.title: Searching the Pareto Front: Multi-Objective Retrieval for Heterogeneous Scientific Modalities
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.23639v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In cosmology, surveys span different sky regions and wavelength ranges, resulting in uneven modality coverage across observational datasets. Such heterogeneity can be addressed through either multimodal foundation models (FMs), which learn shared embedding spaces, or independently learned modality embeddings combined via late fusion. We investigate whether the latter provides an adaptive alternative to FM-based scientific retrieval. We evaluate this approach on a galaxy retrieval task spanning diverse modalities--history of star formation, spectra of light emitted, and multi-wavelength observations from two telescopes--comparing an FM baseline with separately trained embeddings fused through multi-objective optimization based on Pareto optimality. We find that the FM baseline achieves strong embedding-space proximity, but our method preserves modality-specific distance structure that allows scientists to inspect which physical signals drive similarity. Our method also achieves improved fidelity in raw-data space: across six measured properties, its nearest neighbor is 8% closer to the query on average than that retrieved by kNN in the FM embedding space (spread 0.128 vs. 0.139). These results suggest that multi-objective retrieval can surface astrophysically coherent candidates that single-objective search alone may overlook.

articles.title: Evidence-Based Credit Assignment for Search-Augmented Language Models
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.23824v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Reinforcement learning from terminal answer rewards enables search-augmented language models to interleave reasoning and retrieval without step-level annotations, yet outcome supervision assigns identical credit to every search in a trajectory regardless of whether it retrieved useful information. This limitation is especially severe when all sampled rollouts for a question fail, collapsing group-centered outcome advantages to zero even when trajectories gather markedly different evidence. We present Evidence-based Credit Assignment (ECA), which augments terminal outcome rewards with a training-only auxiliary signal measuring how retrieved documents improve the likelihood of a reference answer. Rather than scoring the full dialogue prefix, ECA queries a frozen snapshot of the current policy under an evidence-only prompt containing solely the question and the deduplicated documents observed so far, isolating the utility of retrieved passages from surface variations in generated thoughts or search queries. Within this framework, we compare two return formulations, ECA-Step (which accumulates step-clipped potential increments) and ECA-Horizon (which preserves the telescoping horizon gain in potential), paired with cross-fold group normalization, novelty gating, and search-local token assignment. Across seven Search QA benchmarks, ECA-Horizon improves strict macro exact match over an outcome-only GRPO baseline by 1.03 and 4.80 percentage points on Qwen2.5-3B- and 7B-Instruct, respectively, outperforming both RLOO and GiGPO. Zero-shot evaluation on MultiHop-RAG further demonstrates strong transfer to multi-hop inference queries.

articles.title: Cardiac MRI-informed electrocardiography enables biologically grounded cardiomyopathy detection
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.23925v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Precise myocardial phenotyping at population scale is limited by the cost and accessibility of cardiac magnetic resonance (CMR), whereas electrocardiography (ECG) is widely available but reflects electrical rather than structural and functional information. Here we develop MyoECG, a cross-modal representation learning framework that distils myocardial structural and functional knowledge from CMR into standard 12-lead ECGs, enabling imaging-informed cardiomyopathy detection and subtype classification from ECGs alone. MyoECG was pretrained on 45,241 paired ECG-CMR examinations from UK Biobank and a tertiary cardiovascular centre, then developed and validated across more than 1.8 million ECGs from seven independent datasets. Across internal and external datasets spanning prevalences of 0.2-54.7%, MyoECG outperformed five pretrained ECG foundation models, with AUROCs of 0.800-0.974 for cardiomyopathy detection. In a multi-reader study of six cardiologists, MyoECG assistance improved mean sensitivity by 0.109 (95% CI, 0.041-0.175; P = 0.009) and specificity by 0.056 (95% CI, 0.004-0.108; P = 0.040). In 41,128 UK Biobank participants, the MyoECG score showed genetic correlations with cardiomyopathy (rg = 0.409) and dilated cardiomyopathy (rg = 0.371), genome-wide associations at four loci, including regions mapped to NFIA and KCNQ1, and associations with 69 circulating proteins related to myocardial stress, cell adhesion, vascular biology and metabolism. The cardiomyopathy correlation attenuated to non-significance after adjustment for 27 measured CMR traits (rg = 0.131; P = 0.143), indicating that the score captures CMR-derived information rather than dataset-specific shortcuts. MyoECG offers a scalable route to CMR-informed cardiomyopathy assessment and a strategy for transferring knowledge from resource-intensive imaging to widely deployable physiological signals.

articles.title: Beyond Corpus-Driven Imitation: Evolving Musical Mindsets in the Agentic Orchestra via Quantum Reinforcement Learning
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.24290v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: This paper presents a framework for computer-aided music composition and performance based on quantum reinforcement learning and multi-agent interaction. We introduce the agentic orchestra, where musical agents evolve distinct mindsets through trial-and-error engagement with a musical environment, rather than through training on large datasets. The agents are implemented as parameterised quantum circuits. They evolve distinct compositional behaviours, referred to as mindsets. This enables the exploration of musical decision spaces using quantum superposition and entanglement within a hybrid quantum-classical loop. We present two complementary agent architectures: atomistic agents, which process pitch and rhythm independently, and holistic agents, which handle pitch and duration as unified note events. Mindsets are shaped through musically grounded reward functions, which can be combined and weighted to develop different mindsets across agents. The resulting system positions quantum computing agents less as autonomous composers and more as adaptive musical partners, each developing its own musical personality through interaction rather than imitation. Demonstrations show how agents generalise their learned behaviour to previously unseen material, operating in interactive and offline batch modes using MIDI-encoded music. While quantum computers are still in development, experiments conducted on IBM quantum hardware confirmed that musically meaningful learning is achievable with existing quantum computers. For composers and performers, the agentic orchestra opens new possibilities for emergent, process-oriented musical creativity, offering a scalable foundation for quantum computer-aided music composition as quantum computing technology continues to advance.

articles.title: Think Offline, Act in Real Time: Self-Improving Visual Game Agents through Code
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.24590v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Pre-trained models can read screens and reason about games, yet on an unfamiliar game, an agent still has to learn to play. We ask how an agent can self-improve on such a game from a few of its own attempts, in real-time visual games where the agent sees only the screen and the game keeps running while the agent thinks. We study two kinds of policy that can carry this improvement. In model as policy, a model selects actions during play; we adapt real-time chunking so that committed actions keep executing while the model reasons, and train a 2B controller for this interface. In code as policy, a model writes, tests, and revises a program between attempts, and the program acts during play. Across 170 GameWorld tasks, with at most eight one-minute executions per run, code as policy reaches 47.80% mean progress, against 30.90% for our trained controller, and leads in all five game categories. Improving the controller's weights on a single game, by contrast, yields only modest gains. These results favor letting a model think offline and storing what it learns in a program that acts in real time. Project repository: https://github.com/TabibitoQZP/SIGame

articles.title: Minimizing Information Age and Sensor Energy in Ocean Monitoring Networks through Hybrid Acoustic and Optical Data Harvesting by Cooperative Underwater Vehicles
articles.abstract: Ocean monitoring networks must deliver fresh measurements from battery-powered seabed sensors, yet underwater links impose a hard trade-off. Acoustic links reach kilometres but are slow and energy-hungry, whereas optical links are fast and energy-cheap but reach only metres. Autonomous underwater vehicles (AUVs) can harvest data by approaching sensors, but ocean currents perturb their motion. This paper proposes AquaFresh, a cooperative policy that decides, for every AUV and time slot, which sensor to serve and whether to use an acoustic or an optical link, minimising priority-weighted age of information (AoI) and sensor energy. AquaFresh combines Lyapunov drift-plus-penalty scores with a graph attention residual shared by all vehicles and is trained by antithetic evolution strategies on the team objective. The simulation model includes Thorp absorption, Wenz ambient noise, Rayleigh fading, co-channel acoustic interference, residual Doppler, water-type-dependent optical attenuation and a time-varying double-gyre current field. On held-out ocean realisations, AquaFresh reduced weighted AoI by 12.5% and sensor energy by 28.8% relative to a Lyapunov max-weight scheduler, and AoI by 28.0% relative to an AoI-greedy hybrid policy at equal energy. It retained the best AoI in zero-shot tests across water types, current strengths, 40 to 100 sensors and 2 to 5 vehicles, and an energy-weight sweep traced an AoI and energy front that dominates all baselines. Ablations indicate that end-to-end optimisation of the energy-aware objective drives most of the gain.

articles.title: Interface Aware Quantum Dot Atomic Silicon Arithmetic for Verified Compression and Ripple Carry Addition
articles.abstract: Quantum-dot atomic silicon provides a substrate for investigating arithmetic through the charge states of silicon dangling bonds. However, an isolated correct truth table does not establish a composable arithmetic circuit: charge-pair outputs and voltage-driven inputs use different interfaces, neighboring cells alter electrostatic conditions, and defects can produce incorrect or undecodable outputs. Direct ternary enumeration also becomes impractical as circuits grow. This study addresses these challenges with an eleven-site simultaneous full-adder cell, an explicit sensing and regeneration interface, and a complete reduced search that retains every potentially valid coupled configuration. The cell is composed into a 22-site 4:2 compressor and a 44-site four-bit ripple-carry adder. All 32 compressor and 512 adder input combinations satisfy their arithmetic identities. Across 64 compressor and 4,096 adder drive maps, independent implementations agree on the unique selected minimum, with exactly one consistent selected-state map per external input. Logical injection covers 18 and 34 single-net stuck-at faults; two tests detect every modeled fault, and three tests distinguish each faulty model from all others. Physical enumeration finds 27 of 88 omission cases and 209 of 352 displacement cases correct, while all 200 tested bias cases pass. SiQAD SimAnneal corroborates the selected configurations but exhibits a search-budget-dependent convergence gap. These results establish static arithmetic correctness and fault observability under a defined interface contract. Fabricated interfaces, metastable settling, delay, and operating energy require further investigation.

articles.title: Studies in biological interactions of apigenin by spectroscopic, quantum chemical calculations and molecular docking
articles.abstract: Apigenin (APG) is a naturally plant dietary flavonoid widely distributed in various plants and foods, including celery, parsley and chamomile. This study investigates the structural, spectroscopic, electronic and reactivity properties of the monomeric and dimeric APG using experimental and DFT methods at the B3LYP/6-311G(d,p) level. The APG dimer was stabilized by intermolecular hydrogen bonding through (O-H∙∙∙O) and (C-H∙∙∙O) interactions. Quantum theory of atoms in molecules (QTAIM) analysis revealed significant intermolecular hydrogen bonding interaction (O3-H4∙∙∙O5) in the dimer. Natural bond orbital analysis further indicated that intermolecular hydrogen bonding contributes significantly to the stabilization of the APG dimer. Vibrational and UV-Vis spectroscopy were also analyzed to assess the structural and electronic characteristics of monomer and dimer models of APG. HOMO-LUMO analysis of the APG monomer and dimer was performed to evaluate their electronic structure, reactivity and stability. The electrophilic and nucleophilic reactivity and site selectivity of molecule were revealed by molecular electrostatic potential (MESP) map. To get insights into biological properties, molecular docking of APG was performed. Overall, the results demonstrate that intermolecular hydrogen bonding plays an important role in the structural stabilization and electronic properties of the APG dimer and provides useful insights into the molecular interactions and reactivity of APG.

articles.title: Carbon Nanofiber Encapsulated High-Entropy Phosphides for Efficient Alkaline Water Splitting
articles.abstract: Transition-metal phosphides (TMPs) have attracted extensive attention as promising electrocatalysts for water splitting owing to their distinctive electronic structures, high natural abundance, low cost, and favorable electrochemical activity. Although substantial progress has been achieved in developing high-performance TMP electrocatalysts, most reported systems still suffer from hazardous, complicated synthetic routes that rely on toxic phosphorus precursors, together with insufficient intrinsic activity and poor stability. Herein, we report a green and scalable strategy to fabricate carbon-nanofiber-encapsulated high-entropy phosphides (MFeCoNiP@NCNFs, M = Cr/Mn/Mo/Cu). The synthesis employs non-toxic, renewable phytic acid as the phosphorus source, combining electrospinning with subsequent thermal treatment. The carbon-nanofiber skeleton provides continuous electron-transport pathways, confines phosphide nanoparticles to suppress agglomeration, and enables uniform incorporation of additional metal components for electronic-structure modulation. Benefiting from the high-entropy effect and Cr doping, the optimized CrFeCoNiP@NCNFs delivers outstanding bifunctional electrocatalytic activity and stability in alkaline media, exhibiting low overpotentials of 133 mV for the hydrogen evolution reaction (HER) and 309 mV for the oxygen evolution reaction (OER) at 10 mA·cm-2.

articles.title: Ground-State Preparation by Projection onto the Maximal Decoherence-Free Subspace: Operator-Algebraic Derivation and Constant-Depth Execution on 156-Qubit Processors
articles.abstract: We present a framework for preparing quantum ground states by structural projection rather than by deep-circuit Trotterized dynamical simulation. The method is grounded in an operator-algebraic construction, derived here in full, whose derivation chain runs H∂ → Aµ → Pp → Ap. We prove that the protected-subspace projector is the projector onto the maximal decoherence-free subspace of that coupling, Pp = P max DFS, and that it acts as a state-preparation map, applied in a single projective step: assuming appropriate overlap, it projects any initial state |ψ0⟩ into the prescribed ground-state subspace with an O(1) execution depth on the quantum device. We validate the framework through 58 independent executions on three IBM Heron-class superconducting quantum processors (156 qubits, r2 revision): ibm_marrakesh, ibm_kingston and ibm_fez. Twenty-one of these form the Phase 3–6 programme, utilizing up to 76 actively measured qubits and achieving highly non-uniform output distributions in which the most probable outcome exceeds its uniform-distribution probability by factors of 3.44 × 105 to 5.50 × 106 at 50,000 shots; the remaining thirty-seven test derived theorems directly against predictions computed and fixed before submission, including the projection at N = 6 to 12, where at N = 12 up to 84.0% of shots return an exact maximum cut of a frustrated graph against a uniform null of 4.88 × 10−4 . We demonstrate cross-domain applicability by deploying custom Hamiltonians encoding molecular chemistry (H2 electron correlation), integer factorization (cryptographic Ising reduction), and combinatorial optimization (MaxCut/portfolio) into the same preparation architecture, all executing at O(1) quantum circuit depth. We further extend the preparation to k-local Hamiltonians (k = 3, 4, 5) utilizing up to 153 actively measured qubits per execution, proving via conservation of the total magnetization A1 = ∑︁ x Zx that the framework generalizes to a specific structured family of k-body interactions. Finally, we address the problem encoding question by formalizing the Isometric Encoding Theorem, which provides the algebraic structure to map target problem families into the preparation (with classically-bounded construction complexity). We instantiate this construction across 6 representative encoded problem instances on live hardware. We are explicit about what this does not claim. The O(1) figure is the coherent execution depth alone, and the hardness of a target problem is confined rather than removed: to the classical synthesis of the encoding isometry in the deterministic route, and to post-selection overhead in the measurement-conditioned one. The encoding theorem bounds that classical cost only on a class 2 whose ground-state energy is computable in polynomial time, and a family whose ground-state energy is NP-hard to compute does not belong to it. These results establish that the quantum execution phase of ground-state preparation is achievable on present-day noisy intermediate-scale quantum hardware without variational optimization, Trotterization, or quantum error correction, provided the problem Hamiltonian is mapped through the decoherence-free-subspace projection framework defined herein.

articles.title: Central Atom Effects in ZnPc-Based HTMs: A DFT/TD-DFT Study for Solar Cell Applications
articles.abstract: This study aims to analyze how the central atom affects the structural, electronic, and optical properties of nine phthalocyanine derivatives (Zn-Pc, Cu-Pc, Cd-Pc, C-Pc, Si-Pc, Ge-Pc, S-Pc, Se-Pc, and Te-Pc) evaluated as potential hole-transport materials (HTMs) for perovskite solar cells.The molecules were optimized using density functional theory (DFT), while UV–Visible absorption properties were investigated using TD-DFT method. The results show that the central atom influences the bond lengths, molecular geometry, charge distribution, and electronic properties of the derivatives. The strongest calculated absorption bands were obtained Zn-Pc, Cu-Pc, and Cd-Pc, whereas Ge-Pc, S-Pc, and Se-Pc exhibited intermediate intensities. C-Pc, Si-Pc, and Te-Pc showed weak absorption in the visible region, region in the plotted spectra. The comparatively weak calculated visible absorption of C-Pc, Si-Pc, and Te-Pc warrants further investigation. Their suitability as HTMs requires assessment of hole transport, energy-level alignment at the interface, and device performance.

articles.title: Semiclassical study of muon-enhanced proton-¹¹B fusion
articles.abstract: Author(s): Hong-Yi Wang (王弘毅), Ming-Yu Chen (陈铭宇), Hao-Le Ma (马好乐), and Zhu-Fang Cui (崔著钫) Proton–boron-11 (p– 11 B) fusion only converts its reactants into three charged α particles, so that is an attractive aneutronic path to fusion energy, but the high Coulomb barrier of the 11 B nucleus (Z = 5) keeps its reactivity low. We study a new pathway that form a muonic hydrogen atom (p μ ) first, whose Bohr radius is about 200 times smaller than ordinary hydrogen, then bombard it with a 11 B nucleus. We simulate the full three-body classical motion with the classical trajectory Monte Carlo method, sampling the p μ initial state from the microcanonical ground-state ensemble. From the statistical distribution of classical turning points, we compute the Coulomb-barrier tunneling probability and obtain the cross section. The results show that the μ enhances the low-energy cross section by several orders of magnitude compared with bare nuclei. Thus, if combined with intense laser fields or high-density compression, this mechanism may enable low-energy auxiliary ignition of aneutronic p– 11 B fusion. [Phys. Rev. articles.abstract: Author(s): Ivan Krasionov, Anton D. Putintsev, Maksim Kolker, Tamsin Cookson, Sergey Alyatkin, and Pavlos G. Lagoudakis Spontaneous vortices reveal how order emerges in nonequilibrium quantum fluids. Here, the authors use single-shot interferometry to reconstruct phase and flow in a room-temperature organic polariton condensate. They find vortices predominantly at boundaries between opposing flows, with positions and circulation signs varying from shot to shot. Vortex statistics and flow spectra provide complementary probes of Kibble-Zurek and Kolmogorov-like scaling, opening a route to systematic studies of defect formation and hydrodynamics in driven-dissipative quantum fluids. articles.title: Unexpected spin effect lets electric currents switch antiferromagnets at room temperature
articles.abstract: Researchers have discovered a physical effect that expands the fundamental understanding of how electric currents interact with magnetism, revealing an unexpected way to manipulate the magnetic state of antiferromagnetic materials. A research team led by Northwestern Engineering's Pedram Khalili has discovered what it calls octupole-driven spin-transfer torque (OTT). The effect allows an electrical current to manipulate the magnetic state of a class of materials called noncollinear antiferromagnets.

articles.title: Mechanics of heterogeneous fiber networks processed by an active fluid
articles.abstract: arXiv:2605.11342v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Internally generated active stresses can drive soft materials into structures that cannot form under thermal self assembly alone. For example, a microtubule-kinesin active fluid can assemble and irreversibly restructure actin-fascin networks. Increasing the motor concentration of the active fluid results in networks with broad pore size distribution and heterogeneous bundle structure. We probe the mechanics of these actively processed fiber networks by applying local forces with optical tweezers and measuring the strain response around the probe. Displacement fields of actively-processed networks propagate over a longer range than compared to unprocessed networks. Furthermore, networks processed at higher motor concentration are stiffer on average, while also exhibiting more heterogeneous response. At large strains, both unprocessed and actively processed networks exhibit strain softening and plastic restructuring. These measurements demonstrate that tunable active fluids can alter both the structure and viscoelastic properties of materials.

articles.title: Spontaneous Electrical Inversion in Prebiotic Proteinoid Ensembles
articles.abstract: Negation is the smallest operation that turns a passive conductor of signals into a device capable of logic, because a network that can only copy and combine its inputs cannot compute every Boolean function, whereas one that can also invert them can. We asked whether a purely abiotic material, proteinoid microspheres made by thermal polycondensation of L-glutamic acid, L-phenylalanine and L-aspartic acid, expresses inverting relations between its own sites spontaneously, without any external input. Scanning electron microscopy showed spherical particles 1.4--20.8~textmu m in diameter with central craters, budding satellites and fused vesicles. Three unstimulated, independently prepared ensembles were recorded on eight differential electrode pairs at 1~Hz, for 69.97~h (recording A), 48.0~h (recording B) and 48.0~h (recording C). In all three, spike-like events coupled between sites only positively: no directed pair showed significant event-triggered suppression. Negation appeared instead at two other levels. First, each recording underwent a slow regime switch that split the electrode pairs into two complementary groups moving in opposite directions. In recording A one site fell by 124~mV and a second rose by 32~mV 2.4~h later (lagged r=-0.94), the two binarised potentials were complementary, matching the truth table of negation, in 94.3% of 401 ten-minute bins (p

articles.title: Power-Aware and Spectral-Efficiency-Aware Graph-Based Bandwidth Allocation with Alternating Power Control for Multi-UAV 6G Networks
articles.abstract: Graph-based bandwidth allocation followed by M-matrix power control is an efficient two-stage design for multi-UAV 6G networks. Its graph reformulation, however, maximizes the total allocated band-width rather than the data rate, and it allocates bandwidth with every UAV at maximum power,where interference is highest. We propose three changes. A spectral-efficiency-aware (SE-aware) allo-cation restores the data-rate objective and is solved exactly as a linear program (LP). A power-aware refinement then searches the UAV power levels, scoring every candidate by that LP while each link keeps at least the worst-link rate of the base design. Finally, an alternating bandwidth–power stage lowers transmit power at unchanged quality-of-service targets. We prove that the first stage is never worse than the base allocation, that the refinement never lowers the data rate, and that the alternating stage never increases power. Over 200 paired Monte Carlo trials per configuration with 3–10 UAVs, the proposed scheme raises the sum data rate by 21–231% and the energy efficiency by 6–95% over the base scheme under line-of-sight conditions (Holm-corrected Wilcoxon p < 0.01), and by up to 305% and 111% under mixed line-of-sight/non-line-of-sight conditions. For 3–5 UAVs it attains 87– 96% of a near-optimal joint benchmark, against 34–46% for the base scheme. The costs are a lower Jain fairness index, which a tunable rate floor partly restores, and a runtime of 0.3–2.5 s per network.

articles.title: State-insensitive optical conveyor belts on integrated nanophotonic waveguides
articles.abstract: Integrated atom-nanophotonic platforms offer a promising route towards on-chip quantum technologies by enabling strong light–matter interactions in compact geometries. Here, we propose a state-insensitive optical conveyor belt for cold cesium (Cs) atoms along an integrated nanophotonic waveguide. Using a magic compensation scheme and appropriate frequency ramping, we achieve deep phase-matched confinement in the moving frame of atoms in both their ground and excited states pertaining to their D2 transition. This conveyor effect allows for the coherence-preserving transport of atomic ensembles over micrometer-scale distances, as well as the acceleration and injection of atoms into a flat, atom guide potential, which is independent of their internal state. This work paves the way for controlled atom transport and state-insensitive manipulations in integrated nanophotonic architectures, for on-chip quantum information processing and matter wave inertial sensing.

articles.title: Decision-Level versus Feature-Level Novelty Detection for Open-Set Intrusion Detection: A Cascaded EfficientNet--GBDT and Isolation Forest Framework Evaluated on TON_IoT
articles.abstract: Closed-set classifiers on Internet of Things (IoT) and Industrial IoT (IIoT) intrusion benchmarks now reach accuracies at which aggregate accuracy no longer separates competing methods, while the capability that matters most for critical infrastructure, namely sensible behaviour on attacks never labelled during training, remains weakly addressed. This study proposes and evaluates a cascaded open-set intrusion detector on the network component of the Telemetry, Operating System and Network IoT (TON_IoT) dataset. Flow records are reduced by Principal Component Analysis (PCA) and Electromagnetic Field Optimisation (EFO), a compact EfficientNet extracts a learned embedding, a Gradient-Boosted Decision Tree (GBDT) ensemble classifies that embedding, and flows whose maximum GBDT class probability falls below 0.95 are forwarded to an Isolation Forest for novelty detection. Injection and Man-in-the-Middle (MITM) traffic are withheld from training to measure open-set behaviour. The study makes four contributions: (i) a controlled comparison of attaching the Isolation Forest to the reduced input features (decision-level) or to the learned embedding (feature-level) under identical preprocessing, data partitioning and withheld-attack protocol; (ii) evidence that replacing the softmax head with a GBDT head leaves closed-set predictions unchanged; (iii) operating points reported as alarm precision at stated attack base rates rather than detection rate alone; and (iv) measured training, storage, latency, memory and energy costs. On the eight known classes, the GBDT head attains 98.26% accuracy (macro-F1 0.9789) on 25,421 test flows, identical flow for flow to the EfficientNet softmax baseline. On withheld attacks, the classifier alone flags none as unknown, decision-level attachment identifies 81.4% and feature-level attachment 76.1%, indicating that supervised training compresses away the variation that makes unseen traffic unusual. Withheld-attack capture rises from 76.1% at a 0.65% benign false-alarm rate (54.2% alarm precision at a 1% attack base rate) to 99.8% at 13.9%, where alarm precision falls to 6.8%. The cascade costs 4.7 times the inference time of the feature extractor alone and occupies 91.4 MB. These findings show that the placement of the novelty detector, not the classification head, determines open-set capability, with direct implications for intrusion detection at petroleum-pipeline monitoring gateways.

articles.title: Disaster Robotics in the Deep Learning Era]{Disaster Robotics in the Deep Learning Era: A Systematic Review of Platforms, Autonomy, Methods, Datasets, Challenges, and Future Research Directions
articles.abstract: Disaster robotics enables responders to sense and act at a disaster site from a safe distance, converting responder risk into an equipment one. The field is increasingly shaped by deep learning and, most recently, by foundation models. However, existing surveys adopt a single perspective or platform class, predate the deep learning era or remain largely narrative. Moreover, none grades every reviewed work on a common validation maturity scale. This paper presents a systematic review of disaster robotics in the deep learning era, restricted to disaster-connected works evaluated on disaster data or in real, replicated or simulated emergency settings. The evolution of the field is traced through successive research phases, from teleoperated platforms to foundation-model interfaces and responder-grounded field autonomy. A multi-criteria taxonomy is formed, covering response tasks, robotic platforms, perception, autonomy, learning strategies, foundation model types, human-robot teaming, coordination, communication and deployment, disaster domains, and validation maturity. Each criterion is analyzed comparatively, with critical insights into the strengths and limitations of its categories under field conditions. Additionally, public datasets and benchmarks are reviewed. Current challenges are also paired with future research directions, from data acquisition and field hardening to verifiable autonomy, responder trust and evaluation. The analysis shows that systems deployed at real incidents still rely predominantly on model-based methods. It also shows that recent research leans increasingly on simulation and benchmark evaluation. Finally, foundation models have entered the field mainly as perception front ends and mission-level planners rather than as embodied policies, without yet reaching a real incident.

articles.title: Closed-loop AI enables time- and resource-efficient optimization of processing pathways without microstructural input
articles.abstract: Over the past decade, the application of artificial intelligence (AI) tools has accelerated the discovery of novel material compositions, but has done little to speed the discovery of novel material processing paths, particularly when sequential processing operations are required. Current process optimization often involves extensive efforts to characterize microstructures and properties to fully understand process-microstructure-property relationships. However, characterizing both microstructures and properties slows and limits the scalability of materials optimization. Here, we demonstrate that processing pathways can be optimized within an AI-driven closed loop without the need for intermediate microstructural characterization. By varying processing steps and parameters in a controlled manner and focusing on properties that can be quantified rapidly, our multi-objective framework simultaneously targets two competing properties: resistance to deformation (hardness) and resistance to corrosion (corrosion rate). We demonstrate this approach in ZX10, a lean, biodegradable magnesium alloy with potential applications in temporary orthopedic implants. Within three closed-loop iterations, the framework identifies processing pathways that move beyond the hardness–corrosion trade-off observed in the initial dataset, achieving high hardness and low one-day corrosion rates. Subsequent mechanical testing and extended corrosion experiments confirm that the optimized materials also exhibit increased tensile strength, enhanced ductility, and favorable corrosion performance over 14 days. Post-optimization microstructural characterization reveals that the selected materials share similar microstructural features, including ultrafine grains, comparable dislocation densities and crystallographic textures, and finely dispersed second-phase particles. These findings demonstrate that rapidly measured properties can guide the identification of favorable processing conditions without requiring microstructural information during optimization, while subsequent characterization provides insight into the underlying structure–property relationships. By delaying resource-intensive microstructural characterization until promising processing conditions are identified, this framework substantially reduces the experimental burden and offers a scalable strategy for AI-driven materials processing.

articles.title: Neural SPICE Surrogate Modeling and Sensitivity Analysis for Semiconductor MOSFETs: A Deep Learning Framework for Accelerated VLSI Simulation
articles.abstract: Modern Very Large Scale Integration (VLSI) electronic design automation (EDA) workflows rely heavily on circuit simulation engines (SPICE) to resolve large systems of non-linear differential-algebraic equations. As semiconductor dimensions scale, computing drain current characteristics iteratively via traditional numerical techniques introduces severe computational latency, particularly across extensive Monte Carlo process-variation sweeps. In this work, we propose a deep learning surrogate modeling framework to approximate device-level non-linear transport physics. The surrogate establishes a direct forward mapping F[𝑉𝑔𝑠, 𝑉ds, 𝑉𝑡ℎ, 𝜇0, 𝜆]--> Id across all operating regimes (cutoff, linear, and saturation) utilizing a high-capacity Multi-Layer Perceptron (MLP) architecture equipped with continuous Sigmoid Linear Unit (SiLU) activations. Trained on synthetically generated physical parameter profiles, the model demonstrates rapid convergence, driving means squared loss from an initial 0.122 down to 0.0078 with a coefficient of determination R² > 0.98 on unobserved test partitions. Furthermore, a normalized sensitivity analysis identifies gate bias 𝑉𝑔𝑠 and threshold voltage 𝑉𝑡ℎ as primary driving variables, fully consistent with metal-oxide-semiconductor field-effect transistor (MOSFET) electrostatics. The proposed surrogate achieves evaluation latencies under 2 milliseconds, providing a scalable path toward accelerated analog, digital, and post-silicon statistical simulations.

articles.title: Gradient-estimator design overcomes trainability barriers in neural-network-based variational optimization
articles.abstract: Neural networks provide expressive representations for scientific computing. However, even sufficiently expressive networks can suffer training failure in weak-gradient regimes, limiting their practical use in quantum many-body physics and ab initio quantum chemistry. Here we derive an unbiased direct gradient estimator and introduce the adaptive minimum-variance phase (AMVP) estimator for neural-network variational optimization. By improving the signal-to-noise ratio of weak gradients, these methods enable reliable scientific calculations where training previously failed, while substantially reducing computational cost. The framework enables compact networks to outperform larger and fine-tuned default standard-estimator models with over an order of magnitude less GPU time on correlated flux models, and ultimately exceed the density matrix renormalization group (DMRG) accuracy. It further achieves chemical accuracy in N2 bond breaking and, for the first time, in heavy-element I2 with explicit spin–orbit coupling.
