articles.title: A provenance-aware zirconia conductivity database and Arrhenius-constrained screening of doped electrolyte candidates
articles.title_zh: 来源感知的氧化锆电导率数据库和掺杂电解质候选物的阿伦尼乌斯约束筛选
articles.abstract: Zirconia solid electrolytes are key oxygen-ion conductors, but reported conductivity values depend strongly on dopant chemistry, processing history and measurement temperature. Here we curate a provenance-aware zirconia conductivity database of 1351 records and use it to compare an Arrhenius-constrained physics-informed machine-learning model (PIML) with an unconstrained deep neural network (DNN). In a reserved grouped-material confirmation split, the DNN achieves the lower pooled root-mean-square error (RMSE, in units) for withheld composition–processing groups. The Arrhenius-constrained model remains on a comparable error scale and provides bounded effective activation-energy estimates. Its clearest benefit appears in matched-material temperature extrapolation: when trained at and tested at ( ), PIML reduces RMSE from 0.4187 to 0.3609 and raises from 0.8562 to 0.8932. Bootstrap resampling of individual records and material groups quantifies uncertainty in the observed RMSE reduction. Genetic-algorithm screening at a fixed measurement temperature identifies a Sc-rich/Mg-containing zirconia region for further study. CHGNet molecular dynamics examines oxygen transport in four selected compositions. DFT calculations use one atomic configuration per composition to compare energies relative to the constituent oxides. This work provides a curated conductivity resource and a conservative screening route for doped zirconia electrolytes.
articles.abstract_zh: 氧化锆固体电解质是关键的氧离子导体，但报告的电导率值在很大程度上取决于掺杂剂化学、加工历史和测量温度。在这里，我们整理了一个包含 1351 条记录的来源感知氧化锆电导率数据库，并用它来比较阿伦尼乌斯约束的物理信息机器学习模型 (PIML) 与无约束的深度神经网络 (DNN)。在保留的分组材料确认分割中，DNN 为保留的合成处理组实现了较低的合并均方根误差（RMSE，单位）。阿伦尼乌斯约束模型保持可比较的误差范围，并提供有界的有效活化能估计。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 氧化锆固体电解质是关键的氧离子导体，但报告的电导率值在很大程度上取决于掺杂剂化学、加工历史和测量温度。在这里，我们整理了一个包含 1351 条记录的来源感知氧化锆电导率数据库，并用它来比较阿伦尼乌斯约束的物理信息机器学习模型 (PIML) 与无约束的深度神经网络 (DNN)。在保留的分组材料确认分割中，DNN 为保留的合成处理组实现了较低的合并均方根误差（RMSE，单位）。阿伦尼乌斯约束模型保持可比较的误差范围，并提供有界的有效活化能估计。其最明显的好处出现在匹配材料温度外推中：当在 ( ) 下训练和测试时，PIML 将 RMSE 从 0.4187 降低到 0.3609，并从 0.8562 提高到 0.8932。对单个记录和材料组进行 Bootstrap 重采样可量化观察到的 RMSE 降低的不确定性。在固定测量温度下的遗传算法筛选确定了富钪/含镁氧化锆区域以供进一步研究。 CHGNet 分子动力学检查四种选定成分中的氧传输。 DFT 计算使用每种成分的一种原子构型来比较相对于组成氧化物的能量。这项工作为掺杂氧化锆电解质提供了精心策划的电导率资源和保守的筛选途径。

articles.title: MagBerry: A Julia package for modeling magnon and phonon topology and transport
articles.title_zh: MagBerry：用于模拟磁振子和声子拓扑和传输的 Julia 包
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.18731v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We present MagBerry, a Julia package for studying the topology and transport of magnons, phonons, and their hybrid excitations. It combines magnetic models and linear spin-wave Hamiltonians from Sunny.jl with native modules for harmonic phonons and magnon--phonon coupling. These excitations are treated within a common bosonic Bogoliubov--de Gennes formulation. The package calculates bulk and boundary spectra, Berry curvature, and Chern numbers, and resolves the spin and phonon angular momentum carried by each mode. Transport calculations include thermal Hall, spin and orbital Nernst, and phonon angular momentum Hall responses. The package also evaluates the extended Berry curvature dipole contribution to nonlinear magnon thermal Hall transport. Relaxation-time Boltzmann theory gives heat and angular momentum currents. Examples based on published models reproduce topological magnon boundary spectra and illustrate phonon geometry and nonlinear transport. For an altermagnetic hybrid model, we extend a published study of the d-wave phonon angular momentum texture by calculating its Boltzmann transport coefficients. The resulting tensor describes how the longitudinal and transverse angular momentum currents vary with temperature and the direction of the temperature gradient.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们推出了 MagBerry，一个 Julia 包，用于研究磁振子、声子及其混合激发的拓扑和传输。它将 Sunny.jl 的磁模型和线性自旋波哈密顿量与谐波声子和磁振子-声子耦合的本机模块相结合。这些激励在常见的玻色子 Bogoliubov-de Gennes 公式中进行处理。该软件包计算体谱和边界谱、贝里曲率和陈数，并解析每种模式所携带的自旋和声子角动量。输运计算包括热霍尔、自旋和轨道能斯特以及声子角动量霍尔响应。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们推出了 MagBerry，一个 Julia 包，用于研究磁振子、声子及其混合激发的拓扑和传输。它将 Sunny.jl 的磁模型和线性自旋波哈密顿量与谐波声子和磁振子-声子耦合的本机模块相结合。这些激励在常见的玻色子 Bogoliubov-de Gennes 公式中进行处理。该软件包计算体谱和边界谱、贝里曲率和陈数，并解析每种模式所携带的自旋和声子角动量。输运计算包括热霍尔、自旋和轨道能斯特以及声子角动量霍尔响应。该软件包还评估了扩展贝里曲率偶极子对非线性磁振子热霍尔传输的贡献。弛豫时间玻尔兹曼理论给出了热流和角动量流。基于已发布模型的示例再现了拓扑磁振子边界谱并说明了声子几何和非线性传输。对于交变磁混合模型，我们通过计算玻尔兹曼输运系数来扩展已发表的 d 波声子角动量纹理研究。所得张量描述了纵向和横向角动量流如何随温度和温度梯度方向变化。

articles.title: Liquid-liquid criticality in a fluid whose two structures favor mixing
articles.title_zh: 两种结构有利于混合的流体中的液-液临界性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.18737v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The generic two-state description of liquid polyamorphism requires a non-ideality opposing mixing for liquid-liquid separation. This condition assumes that the free energy of the underlying fluid is independent of the structural order, an assumption that fails when the local structures differ in size or attraction. We derive a closed-form stability condition after density relaxation for a van der Waals closure based on the second virial coefficient of a pair potential whose internal state determines both the contact distance and the well depth. The condition recovers the familiar result for structures identical in size and attraction but can change sign within the liquid when they differ. In ten of the thirty-four parameter sets examined, a critical state preferred by the liquid requires a non-ideality favoring mixing. For one such fluid, we construct the coexistence curve, which terminates at the predicted critical point at positive pressure. Attraction and excluded volume provide distinct contributions to the density-order coupling; only the former survives on a fixed lattice with single occupancy. Removing the excluded-volume contribution restores the familiar condition in 58 of the 82 such critical states found. Thus, within this closure, liquid-liquid separation can occur with a non-ideality favoring mixing.
articles.abstract_zh: 液体多晶现象的一般二态描述需要非理想的相反混合来进行液-液分离。该条件假设底层流体的自由能与结构顺序无关，当局部结构的尺寸或吸引力不同时，该假设就会失败。我们基于内部状态决定接触距离和井深的电势对的第二维里系数，推导了范德华闭包的密度松弛后的闭合形式稳定性条件。该条件恢复了大小和吸引力相同的结构的熟悉结果，但当它们不同时，可以改变液体内的符号。在所检查的 34 个参数组中的 10 个中，液体首选的临界状态需要有利于混合的非理想状态。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 液体多晶现象的一般二态描述需要非理想的相反混合来进行液-液分离。该条件假设底层流体的自由能与结构顺序无关，当局部结构的尺寸或吸引力不同时，该假设就会失败。我们基于内部状态决定接触距离和井深的电势对的第二维里系数，推导了范德华闭包的密度松弛后的闭合形式稳定性条件。该条件恢复了大小和吸引力相同的结构的熟悉结果，但当它们不同时，可以改变液体内的符号。在所检查的 34 个参数组中的 10 个中，液体首选的临界状态需要有利于混合的非理想状态。对于一种这样的流体，我们构建了共存曲线，该曲线终止于预测的正压临界点。吸引力和排除体积对密度阶耦合有明显的贡献；只有前者在单一占用的固定格子上幸存下来。删除排除体积的贡献可以恢复所发现的 82 个此类临界状态中的 58 个的熟悉条件。因此，在该封闭件内，液-液分离可能会发生，但有利于混合的非理想性。

articles.title: Magnon binding in a quantum Hall ferromagnet with a periodic electric field
articles.title_zh: 具有周期性电场的量子霍尔铁磁体中的磁振子结合
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.18779v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: A spin wave in a filling-one quantum Hall ferromagnet is neutral but carries an electric dipole perpendicular to its momentum. A spatially periodic electrostatic potential therefore creates parallel channels for spin waves. We use this established mechanism to calculate how confinement changes the exchange binding of magnons travelling in the same direction. Narrower channels increase the overlap of their transverse wavefunctions and strengthen the effective attraction. In an isolated harmonic channel, the energy required to remove one magnon from a cluster of N is π(k_*ell)⁴N(N-1)/4 times the transverse level spacing to leading order, where k_* is the mean wave number along the channel and ell is the magnetic length. We predict the frequency and momentum dependence of the spectral line for adding a second magnon to one already present, both in an isolated channel and in a coupled array. Tunnelling in a wide array can make the binding energy exponentially small, while a strip narrower than the transverse pair size recovers one-dimensional binding at sufficiently weak attraction. We also find that a moving potential can carry a single wave packet with less spreading than free propagation when its initial group velocity matches the potential's speed.
articles.abstract_zh: 填充一量子霍尔铁磁体中的自旋波是中性的，但携带垂直于其动量的电偶极子。因此，空间周期性静电势为自旋波创建了平行通道。我们使用这种既定机制来计算限制如何改变沿同一方向行进的磁振子的交换结合。较窄的通道增加了横向波函数的重叠并增强了有效吸引力。在孤立谐波通道中，从 N 簇中移除一个磁振子所需的能量是 π(k_*ell)⁴N(N-1)/4 乘以前导阶的横向能级间距，其中 k_* 是沿通道的平均波数，ell 是磁长度。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 填充一量子霍尔铁磁体中的自旋波是中性的，但携带垂直于其动量的电偶极子。因此，空间周期性静电势为自旋波创建了平行通道。我们使用这种既定机制来计算限制如何改变沿同一方向行进的磁振子的交换结合。较窄的通道增加了横向波函数的重叠并增强了有效吸引力。在孤立谐波通道中，从 N 簇中移除一个磁振子所需的能量是 π(k_*ell)⁴N(N-1)/4 乘以前导阶的横向能级间距，其中 k_* 是沿通道的平均波数，ell 是磁长度。我们预测谱线的频率和动量依赖性，以便将第二个磁振子添加到已经存在的磁振子中，无论是在隔离通道还是在耦合阵列中。宽阵列中的隧道效应可以使结合能呈指数级减小，而比横向对尺寸更窄的条带可以在足够弱的吸引力下恢复一维结合。我们还发现，当初始群速度与势的速度相匹配时，移动势可以携带比自由传播更少的传播的单个波包。

articles.title: A Practitioner's Guide to Materials Theory and Computation in the Age of Big Data and Artificial Intelligence
articles.title_zh: 大数据和人工智能时代材料理论和计算从业者指南
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.18797v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Computational modelling has become a cornerstone of materials science, with advances in atomistic simulations, high-throughput computation, and artificial intelligence transforming how materials are understood, discovered, and designed. These developments build upon generations of theoretical innovations that have translated complex mathematical and physical principles into practical predictive tools. However, the growing diversity of computational methods presents challenges for practitioners seeking a coherent understanding of their theoretical foundations. Drawing upon the author's research experience, this monograph provides a practitioner-oriented, pedagogical overview of computational materials science, unified through the concepts of potential-energy landscapes and statistical sampling. It explores how these concepts underpin structural stability, phase behaviour, and electronic and magnetic properties, through a systematic treatment of empirical force fields, density-functional theory, many-body electronic-structure methods, statistical sampling, and property prediction. It further examines high-throughput workflows, materials databases, and the probabilistic foundations of artificial intelligence. Particular emphasis is placed on atomistic representations, graph neural networks, and generative models, highlighting the roles of symmetry, group theory, differential geometry, and stochastic processes in modern materials modelling. By connecting established physical theories with emerging data-driven approaches, this monograph offers a unified perspective on computational materials science and identifies opportunities and challenges toward physics-informed, efficient, and reliable materials discovery.
articles.abstract_zh: 计算建模已成为材料科学的基石，原子模拟、高通量计算和人工智能的进步改变了材料的理解、发现和设计方式。这些发展建立在几代理论创新的基础上，这些创新将复杂的数学和物理原理转化为实用的预测工具。然而，计算方法日益多样化给寻求对其理论基础连贯理解的从业者带来了挑战。本专着借鉴了作者的研究经验，通过势能景观和统计抽样的概念，对计算材料科学提供了面向实践者的教学概述。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 计算建模已成为材料科学的基石，原子模拟、高通量计算和人工智能的进步改变了材料的理解、发现和设计方式。这些发展建立在几代理论创新的基础上，这些创新将复杂的数学和物理原理转化为实用的预测工具。然而，计算方法日益多样化给寻求对其理论基础连贯理解的从业者带来了挑战。本专着借鉴了作者的研究经验，通过势能景观和统计抽样的概念，对计算材料科学提供了面向实践者的教学概述。它通过对经验力场、密度泛函理论、多体电子结构方法、统计采样和性能预测的系统处理，探讨了这些概念如何支撑结构稳定性、相行为以及电子和磁性能。它进一步研究了高通量工作流程、材料数据库和人工智能的概率基础。特别强调原子表示、图神经网络和生成模型，强调对称性、群论、微分几何和随机过程在现代材料建模中的作用。通过将现有的物理理论与新兴的数据驱动方法联系起来，本专着提供了计算材料科学的统一视角，并确定了基于物理的、高效且可靠的材料发现的机遇和挑战。

articles.title: Quantum Cooling by Classical Shadows
articles.title_zh: 经典阴影的量子冷却
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.18834v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Cooling to ground states of many-body Hamiltonians by imaginary-time evolution is central to quantum simulation, but its non-unitary aspect prevents direct implementation on a quantum computer. Existing routes restore it by importing structure from outside the intrinsic quantum dynamics, e.g. by parameter estimation on many copies or recursive compilation. Here, we show that a single randomized snapshot of the quantum many-body system is sufficient to steer the state along the cooling direction on average. Our algorithm, shadow chain, uses randomized measurements to collapse the state to its classical record, which fixes the next unitary update. Snapshots across steps form a trajectory that is a quantum-executable sample of an auxiliary-field path integral; fluctuations among trajectories are exponentially suppressed in system size. With the randomness supplied intrinsically by the Born measurement rule, the trajectories sample themselves rather than going through external accept-reject steps. The resulting algorithm is ansatz-free and exact upon extrapolation to the continuous limit, with the exponential cost confined only to system size rather than temperature.
articles.abstract_zh: 通过虚时间演化将多体哈密顿量冷却到基态是量子模拟的核心，但其非统一方面阻碍了在量子计算机上的直接实现。现有的路线通过从内在量子动力学外部导入结构来恢复它，例如通过许多副本或递归编译的参数估计。在这里，我们证明量子多体系统的单个随机快照足以平均沿着冷却方向引导状态。我们的算法“影子链”使用随机测量将状态折叠到其经典记录，从而修复下一个单一更新。跨步骤的快照形成一条轨迹，该轨迹是辅助场路径积分的量子可执行样本；轨迹之间的波动在系统规模上被指数抑制。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 通过虚时间演化将多体哈密顿量冷却到基态是量子模拟的核心，但其非统一方面阻碍了在量子计算机上的直接实现。现有的路线通过从内在量子动力学外部导入结构来恢复它，例如通过许多副本或递归编译的参数估计。在这里，我们证明量子多体系统的单个随机快照足以平均沿着冷却方向引导状态。我们的算法“影子链”使用随机测量将状态折叠到其经典记录，从而修复下一个单一更新。跨步骤的快照形成一条轨迹，该轨迹是辅助场路径积分的量子可执行样本；轨迹之间的波动在系统规模上被指数抑制。由于玻恩测量规则本质上提供了随机性，轨迹会自行采样，而不是经历外部接受-拒绝步骤。由此产生的算法是无 ansatz 的，并且在外推到连续极限时是精确的，指数成本仅限于系统尺寸而不是温度。

articles.title: Gapless Nature of Spin Liquid in the S=1/2 Kagome Heisenberg Antiferromagnet with Neural-Network Quantum States
articles.title_zh: 具有神经网络量子态的 S=1/2 Kagome 海森堡反铁磁体中自旋液体的无间隙性质
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.18840v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Whether the spin-1/2 kagome Heisenberg antiferromagnet hosts a gapped Z₂ or a gapless U(1) Dirac spin liquid remains a central open question in frustrated magnetism. Here, we address this question by directly computing the triplet gap with a neural-network quantum state that does not presuppose any specific spin-liquid structure. Applying a time-reversal symmetric transformer-based ansatz to clusters of up to 768 sites, we obtain state-of-the-art variational energies on two-dimensional lattices with periodic boundary conditions and estimate an energy per site of -0.43873(12) in the thermodynamic limit. Finite-size scaling of the magnetic order parameter and triplet excitation gap shows that both extrapolate to zero in the thermodynamic limit. Together, these results provide independent and direct evidence of a gapless spin-liquid ground state, consistent with the U(1) Dirac spin liquid. More broadly, they demonstrate that neural-network quantum states can resolve ground-state properties of frustrated quantum magnets that remain challenging for conventional numerical methods.
articles.abstract_zh: 自旋 1/2 戈薇海森堡反铁磁体是否具有带隙 Z2 或无带隙 U(1) 狄拉克自旋液体仍然是受阻磁学中的一个核心悬而未决的问题。在这里，我们通过使用不预设任何特定自旋液体结构的神经网络量子态直接计算三重态间隙来解决这个问题。将基于时间反转对称变压器的 ansatz 应用于多达 768 个位点的簇，我们在具有周期性边界条件的二维晶格上获得了最先进的变分能量，并估计热力学极限下每个位点的能量为 -0.43873(12)。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 自旋 1/2 戈薇海森堡反铁磁体是否具有带隙 Z2 或无带隙 U(1) 狄拉克自旋液体仍然是受阻磁学中的一个核心悬而未决的问题。在这里，我们通过使用不预设任何特定自旋液体结构的神经网络量子态直接计算三重态间隙来解决这个问题。将基于时间反转对称变压器的 ansatz 应用于多达 768 个位点的簇，我们在具有周期性边界条件的二维晶格上获得了最先进的变分能量，并估计热力学极限下每个位点的能量为 -0.43873(12)。磁序参数和三重态激发间隙的有限尺寸缩放表明，两者在热力学极限下都外推到零。总之，这些结果提供了无间隙自旋液体基态的独立且直接的证据，与 U(1) 狄拉克自旋液体一致。更广泛地说，他们证明神经网络量子态可以解决受挫量子磁体的基态特性，这对传统数值方法仍然具有挑战性。

articles.title: Coupling-Response Thermodynamic Density of States for Bosonic Working Media
articles.title_zh: 玻色工作介质的耦合响应热力学态密度
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.18873v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We introduce an operational thermodynamic density of states (TDOS), G_λ=(partial S/partialλ)T,μ, to characterize bosonic working media under microscopic spectral control. At fixed chemical potential, the response is strictly driven by the structural density of states, yielding the exact scaling law G_λ=-(d/α)S/λ for homogeneous spectra ϵ(k)=Δ+λ k^α, while coupling-dependent gaps generate edge terms only for finite boundary weight. Under a fixed-particle constraint, a secondary chemical-potential redistribution channel emerges. Exact solutions for quadratic bands and harmonic traps demonstrate that spatial dimensionality dictates whether this constrained TDOS exhibits a jump discontinuity or remains continuous across the Bose--Einstein condensation threshold. For pure scale control, the response maps exactly to the heat capacity, λ G_λ⁽N⁾=-C_N. This framework is applied to evaluate reversible work in Stirling cycles and to identify observables in magnonic platforms, contrasting global spectral edges with topological Dirac gaps in honeycomb ferromagnets.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们引入了操作热力学态密度 (TDOS)，G_λ=(partial S/partialλ)T,μ，来表征微观光谱控制下的玻色工作介质。在固定化学势下，响应严格由结构态密度驱动，对于均匀光谱 ϵ(k)=Δ+λ k^α 产生精确的标度律 G_λ=-(d/α)S/λ，而耦合相关间隙仅针对有限边界权重生成边缘项。在固定粒子约束下，出现了二次化学势重新分布通道。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们引入了操作热力学态密度 (TDOS)，G_λ=(partial S/partialλ)T,μ，来表征微观光谱控制下的玻色工作介质。在固定化学势下，响应严格由结构态密度驱动，对于均匀光谱 ϵ(k)=Δ+λ k^α 产生精确的标度律 G_λ=-(d/α)S/λ，而耦合相关间隙仅针对有限边界权重生成边缘项。在固定粒子约束下，出现了二次化学势重新分布通道。二次能带和谐波陷阱的精确解表明，空间维数决定了这种受约束的 TDOS 是表现出跳跃不连续性还是在玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚阈值上保持连续。对于纯规模控制，响应精确映射到热容，λ G_λ⁽N⁾=-C_N。该框架用于评估斯特林循环中的可逆功，并识别磁振子平台中的可观测值，将全局光谱边缘与蜂窝状铁磁体中的拓扑狄拉克间隙进行对比。

articles.title: Predictive sufficiency as an information microscope for time-resolved coherent scattering
articles.title_zh: 作为时间分辨相干散射信息显微镜的预测充分性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.18884v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: X-ray photon correlation spectroscopy (XPCS) measures dynamics through the evolution of coherent speckle patterns, most commonly summarized by intensity correlation functions. These averages describe relaxation but can conceal how speckle fluctuations evolve in time and across reciprocal space. Here we introduce an information microscope that tests whether a chosen set of XPCS observables retains the information needed to describe subsequent measured scattering dynamics. A learned representation of the present speckle sequence indicates when information remains outside the chosen description; an XPCS Alphabet then searches for experimentally accessible observables that recover it. In simulated Bragg scattering, speckle activity and anisotropy reveal signatures of correlated deformation and intermittent slip. In a controlled SAXS model, fluctuations of speckle activity provide sensitivity to the spatial extent of cooperative particle motion. In a two-dimensional glass former, retaining time-resolved speckle correlations and radial intensity recovers information lost in the average relaxation function. The fluctuations of these correlations become stronger during caging, without selecting a single dominant correlated mode. This approach uses learning to guide the physical analysis of coherent scattering, while keeping the resulting XPCS observables measurable and interpretable.
articles.abstract_zh: X 射线光子相关光谱 (XPCS) 通过相干散斑图案的演变来测量动力学，最常见的是强度相关函数。这些平均值描述了松弛，但可以掩盖散斑波动如何随时间和跨倒易空间演变。在这里，我们介绍了一种信息显微镜，用于测试一组选定的 XPCS 可观测量是否保留了描述后续测量的散射动力学所需的信息。当前散斑序列的学习表示表明信息何时仍处于所选描述之外；然后 XPCS 字母表搜索可通过实验访问的可观察量来恢复它。在模拟布拉格散射中，散斑活动和各向异性揭示了相关变形和间歇滑移的特征。
articles.abstract_zh_full: X 射线光子相关光谱 (XPCS) 通过相干散斑图案的演变来测量动力学，最常见的是强度相关函数。这些平均值描述了松弛，但可以掩盖散斑波动如何随时间和跨倒易空间演变。在这里，我们介绍了一种信息显微镜，用于测试一组选定的 XPCS 可观测量是否保留了描述后续测量的散射动力学所需的信息。当前散斑序列的学习表示表明信息何时仍处于所选描述之外；然后 XPCS 字母表搜索可通过实验访问的可观察量来恢复它。在模拟布拉格散射中，散斑活动和各向异性揭示了相关变形和间歇滑移的特征。在受控 SAXS 模型中，散斑活动的波动提供了对协作粒子运动的空间范围的敏感性。在二维玻璃成型器中，保留时间分辨散斑相关性和径向强度可以恢复平均弛豫函数中丢失的信息。在不选择单一主导相关模式的情况下，这些相关性的波动在笼养期间变得更强。这种方法利用学习来指导相干散射的物理分析，同时保持所得 XPCS 可观测值的可测量性和可解释性。

articles.title: Measurement of Magnonic Quantum Geometry
articles.title_zh: 磁量子几何测量
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.18897v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Quantum geometry plays a fundamental role in macroscopic quantum phenomena, including quantum Hall effects and flat-band superconductivity. However, since quantum geometry is encoded in wavefunctions rather than energy spectra, direct experimental characterization remains a formidable challenge. This challenge is particularly acute for quasiparticles in quantum materials, whose wavefunctions are generally inferred from effective low-energy models rather than measured directly. Here, we establish an experimental framework for characterizing the quantum geometry of magnons, a ubiquitous Bosonic quasiparticle of magnetically ordered states. We show that the inelastic neutron scattering (INS) cross-section measures geometric parameters of the spinor wavefunctions of ferromagnets. By tracking the energy- and momentum-dependent INS intensity, we extract the quantum geometric tensor without requiring detailed knowledge of microscopic spin-spin interactions. Our results establish magnons as an ideal arena for experimentally probing quantum geometry and open new avenues for exploring geometry-driven magnon transport and quantum Fisher information in magnetic materials.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子几何在宏观量子现象中发挥着重要作用，包括量子霍尔效应和平带超导。然而，由于量子几何是用波函数而不是能谱编码的，因此直接实验表征仍然是一个艰巨的挑战。对于量子材料中的准粒子来说，这一挑战尤其严峻，其波函数通常是从有效的低能模型中推断出来的，而不是直接测量的。在这里，我们建立了一个实验框架来表征磁振子的量子几何结构，磁振子是一种普遍存在的磁有序态玻色子准粒子。我们表明，非弹性中子散射（INS）横截面测量铁磁体旋量波函数的几何参数。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 量子几何在宏观量子现象中发挥着重要作用，包括量子霍尔效应和平带超导。然而，由于量子几何是用波函数而不是能谱编码的，因此直接实验表征仍然是一个艰巨的挑战。对于量子材料中的准粒子来说，这一挑战尤其严峻，其波函数通常是从有效的低能模型中推断出来的，而不是直接测量的。在这里，我们建立了一个实验框架来表征磁振子的量子几何结构，磁振子是一种普遍存在的磁有序态玻色子准粒子。我们表明，非弹性中子散射（INS）横截面测量铁磁体旋量波函数的几何参数。通过跟踪与能量和动量相关的 INS 强度，我们提取了量子几何张量，而无需详细了解微观自旋-自旋相互作用。我们的研究结果确立了磁振子作为实验探测量子几何的理想场所，并为探索磁性材料中几何驱动的磁振子输运和量子费希尔信息开辟了新途径。

articles.title: On-demand valley control in a WSe2/CrPS4 heterostructure via optically programmed magnetic order
articles.title_zh: 通过光学编程磁序对 WSe2/CrPS4 异质结构进行按需谷控制
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.18906v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The ability to optically control the valley degree of freedom in two-dimensional semiconductors is critical for scalable valleytronics. While magnetic proximity effects can lift valley degeneracy, static interfaces lack the dynamic control needed for devices. Here, we demonstrate on-demand optical switching of valley symmetry breaking in a WSe2/CrPS4 heterostructure by exploiting light-tunable magnetic order. Using polarization- and time-resolved photoluminescence, we show that excitation below the ligand-to-metal charge transfer (LMCT) gap preserves an out-of-plane Néel vector in CrPS4, generating a net out-of-plane spin at the interface and enabling spin-polarized charge transfer. This yields a robust polarization gap in the WSe2 A-exciton decay dynamics without an external magnetic field. Excitation above the LMCT gap extinguishes the polarization gap, indicating a rotation of the Néel vector to in-plane. This reversible switching provides direct evidence of spin-polarized charge transfer. Furthermore, the same optical excitation enables optical control of the decay dynamics of the low-energy excitons (XLE) by ~42%, which is potentially attributed to the modification of interfacial couplings. Our work establishes a first unique multifunctional platform where magnetic symmetry, valley polarization, and exciton relaxation are integrated and dynamically controlled by light.
articles.abstract_zh: 光学控制二维半导体谷自由度的能力对于可扩展谷电子学至关重要。虽然磁邻近效应可以消除谷简并性，但静态界面缺乏设备所需的动态控制。在这里，我们通过利用光可调磁序演示了 WSe2/CrPS4 异质结构中谷对称破缺的按需光学切换。使用偏振和时间分辨光致发光，我们表明配体到金属电荷转移 (LMCT) 间隙下方的激发在 CrPS4 中保留了面外 Néel 矢量，在界面处产生净面外自旋并实现自旋极化电荷转移。这在没有外部磁场的情况下在 WSe2 A 激子衰变动力学中产生了强大的极化间隙。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 光学控制二维半导体谷自由度的能力对于可扩展谷电子学至关重要。虽然磁邻近效应可以消除谷简并性，但静态界面缺乏设备所需的动态控制。在这里，我们通过利用光可调磁序演示了 WSe2/CrPS4 异质结构中谷对称破缺的按需光学切换。使用偏振和时间分辨光致发光，我们表明配体到金属电荷转移 (LMCT) 间隙下方的激发在 CrPS4 中保留了面外 Néel 矢量，在界面处产生净面外自旋并实现自旋极化电荷转移。这在没有外部磁场的情况下在 WSe2 A 激子衰变动力学中产生了强大的极化间隙。 LMCT 间隙上方的激励会消除偏振间隙，表明尼尔矢量向面内旋转。这种可逆转换提供了自旋极化电荷转移的直接证据。此外，相同的光学激发能够对低能激子 (XLE) 的衰变动力学进行约 42% 的光学控制，这可能归因于界面耦合的修改。我们的工作建立了第一个独特的多功能平台，其中磁对称性、谷偏振和激子弛豫被集成并由光动态控制。

articles.title: From RuP₃SiO₁₁ to Ideal Geometry: Parallel-Face Octahedra for Kitaev-Dominated Interactions
articles.title_zh: 从 RuP₃SiO₁₁ 到理想几何：Kitaev 主导相互作用的平行面八面体
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.18920v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: RuP₃SiO₁₁ has recently been identified as a Kitaev spin liquid candidate via neutron scattering. To assess its proximity to the Kitaev limit, we perform ab initio calculations of magnetic interactions, finding good agreement for the Kitaev and off-diagonal exchanges, while the Heisenberg exchange is ferromagnetic rather than the experimentally fitted antiferromagnetic one. We also identify a sizable antiferromagnetic out-of-plane exchange not captured in previous analyses. Extending the study to eight substitutional analogs in the MT₃QO₁₁ family (M = Ru, Os; T = P, As; Q= Si, Ge), we observe strong variations in magnetic interactions, highlighting the tunability of this materials class. Finally, inspired by RuP₃SiO₁₁, which exhibits a near parallel-face octahedral arrangement, we compare idealized geometries and show that the parallel-face configuration yields a Kitaev-dominated regime, suggesting a new structural route to the Kitaev limit.
articles.abstract_zh: RuP₃SiO₁₁ 最近通过中子散射被确定为基塔耶夫自旋液体候选者。为了评估其与基塔耶夫极限的接近程度，我们对磁相互作用进行了从头计算，发现基塔耶夫和非对角线交换具有良好的一致性，而海森堡交换是铁磁性的，而不是实验上拟合的反铁磁性的。我们还发现了先前分析中未捕获的相当大的反铁磁面外交换。将研究扩展到 MT₃QO₁₁ 系列中的八个替代类似物（M = Ru、Os；T = P、As；Q= Si、Ge），我们观察到磁相互作用的强烈变化，突出了此类材料的可调性。
articles.abstract_zh_full: RuP₃SiO₁₁ 最近通过中子散射被确定为基塔耶夫自旋液体候选者。为了评估其与基塔耶夫极限的接近程度，我们对磁相互作用进行了从头计算，发现基塔耶夫和非对角线交换具有良好的一致性，而海森堡交换是铁磁性的，而不是实验上拟合的反铁磁性的。我们还发现了先前分析中未捕获的相当大的反铁磁面外交换。将研究扩展到 MT₃QO₁₁ 系列中的八个替代类似物（M = Ru、Os；T = P、As；Q= Si、Ge），我们观察到磁相互作用的强烈变化，突出了此类材料的可调性。最后，受 RuP₃SiO₁₁ 的启发，RuP₃SiO₁₁ 表现出接近平行面的八面体排列，我们比较了理想化的几何形状，并表明平行面配置产生了基塔耶夫主导的体系，这提出了一条通往基塔耶夫极限的新结构路线。

articles.title: Finite-time quenches across first-, second-, and infinite-order transitions in XXZ spin chains
articles.title_zh: XXZ 自旋链中一阶、二阶和无限阶跃迁的有限时间猝灭
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.19022v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We investigate how equilibrium quantum phase transitions manifest themselves in small systems driven out of equilibrium by quantum quenches. We consider linear ramps of the anisotropy in spin-1/2 and spin-1 XXZ chains, which host transitions of first, second, and infinite (Berezinskii-Kosterlitz-Thouless, BKT) order. We consider system sizes available in current quantum simulators and investigate how the order of the transition, the symmetries, and the ramp duration affect the decomposition of the time-evolved state into the instantaneous eigenbasis. The order of the transition determines the dynamics: across the BKT transition, moderately slow ramps already keep the system close to its ground state, corresponding to an adiabatic evolution, whereas for the second-order Haldane-Néel transition a ramp roughly three times slower is required to reach the same regime. Across the first-order transition, since the dynamics conserves the magnetization of the initial state, we observe the formation of ferromagnetic domains, separated by a single domain wall for slow ramps and by multiple walls for faster ones. Interestingly, shortly after the transition, the state evolves as a coherent beating between domain-wall states, a behavior captured by the recently proposed quantum-state texture.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们研究平衡量子相变如何在因量子淬灭而失去平衡的小系统中表现出来。我们考虑自旋 1/2 和自旋 1 XXZ 链中各向异性的线性斜坡，其中包含一阶、二阶和无限（Berezinskii-Kosterlitz-Thouless，BKT）阶跃迁。我们考虑当前量子模拟器中可用的系统尺寸，并研究跃迁顺序、对称性和斜坡持续时间如何影响时间演化状态分解为瞬时本征基。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们研究平衡量子相变如何在因量子淬灭而失去平衡的小系统中表现出来。我们考虑自旋 1/2 和自旋 1 XXZ 链中各向异性的线性斜坡，其中包含一阶、二阶和无限（Berezinskii-Kosterlitz-Thouless，BKT）阶跃迁。我们考虑当前量子模拟器中可用的系统尺寸，并研究跃迁顺序、对称性和斜坡持续时间如何影响时间演化状态分解为瞬时本征基。转变的顺序决定了动力学：在 BKT 转变中，适度缓慢的斜坡已经使系统接近其基态，对应于绝热演化，而对于二阶 Haldane-Néel 转变，需要大约慢三倍的斜坡才能达到相同的状态。在一阶转变中，由于动力学保留了初始状态的磁化强度，我们观察到铁磁畴的形成，铁磁畴由单个畴壁分隔以实现缓慢的斜坡，并由多个壁分隔以实现更快的斜坡。有趣的是，转变后不久，状态演变为域壁状态之间的相干跳动，这是最近提出的量子态纹理捕获的行为。

articles.title: Flat-band driven bipolar anomalous Nernst effect towards volt-scale transverse thermoelectric conversion
articles.title_zh: 平带驱动的双极反常能斯特效应对伏特级横向热电转换的影响
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.19039v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Unipolar anomalous Nernst thermopiles are critically plagued by metallic interconnects, which induce heavy Joule dissipation and compromise the module's packing density, ultimately capping voltage generation. Here, we circumvent these limitations by establishing an intrinsic bipolar anomalous Nernst effect (BANE) paradigm, enabling seamless series integration analogous to Seebeck n-p pairs without passive metallic bridges. Focusing on flat-band topological systems, through machine learning assisted screening across multiple target properties, we identified 249 BANE materials, exhibiting near-room-temperature polarity switching. Guided by this predictive framework, we experimentally realized this phenomenon in single crystals of the Weyl ferromagnet, Co₂TiGe. Strikingly, while its intrinsic anomalous Hall conductivity (AHC) remains rigorously temperature-invariant up to the Curie temperature, the anomalous Nernst signal undergoes a sharp polarity inversion across T approx 225 K. First-principles calculations attribute this behavior to the interplay between flat bands and Weyl nodes, where thermal depopulation shifts the chemical potential across the band edge, inverting the sign of partial σₓy / partial ϵ via the Mott relation. This work opens an avenue toward compact, monolithic transverse thermopiles capable of volt-scale generation free from interfacial parasitic dissipation.
articles.abstract_zh: 单极异常能斯特热电堆受到金属互连的严重困扰，金属互连会导致大量焦耳耗散并损害模块的封装密度，最终限制电压的产生。在这里，我们通过建立固有的双极反常能斯特效应 (BANE) 范例来规避这些限制，从而实现类似于塞贝克 n-p 对的无缝串联集成，而无需无源金属桥。专注于平带拓扑系统，通过机器学习辅助筛选多个目标属性，我们鉴定了 249 种 BANE 材料，表现出接近室温的极性转换。在这个预测框架的指导下，我们通过实验在外尔铁磁体 Co2TiGe 单晶中实现了这种现象。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 单极异常能斯特热电堆受到金属互连的严重困扰，金属互连会导致大量焦耳耗散并损害模块的封装密度，最终限制电压的产生。在这里，我们通过建立固有的双极反常能斯特效应 (BANE) 范例来规避这些限制，从而实现类似于塞贝克 n-p 对的无缝串联集成，而无需无源金属桥。专注于平带拓扑系统，通过机器学习辅助筛选多个目标属性，我们鉴定了 249 种 BANE 材料，表现出接近室温的极性转换。在这个预测框架的指导下，我们通过实验在外尔铁磁体 Co2TiGe 单晶中实现了这种现象。引人注目的是，虽然其固有的反常霍尔电导率 (AHC) 在高达居里温度下保持严格的温度不变性，但反常能斯特信号在大约 225 K 的 T 上经历了急剧的极性反转。第一性原理计算将这种行为归因于平带和 Weyl 节点之间的相互作用，其中热人口减少使化学势跨越带边缘，通过莫特反转部分 σₓy / 部分 ϵ 的符号关系。这项工作为紧凑、整体式横向热电堆开辟了一条道路，该热电堆能够产生伏特级的电压，而无需界面寄生耗散。

articles.title: Emergence of Anisotropic Defect Networks in Shocked Diamond
articles.title_zh: 冲击金刚石中各向异性缺陷网络的出现
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.19045v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Predicting failure after shock loading requires understanding how the structures created during compression evolve as the material unloads. In diamond, both crystal plasticity and localized amorphization have been reported to accommodate shock-induced shear. However, it remains unresolved how the resulting defect structures organize in three dimensions during compression and how this organization influences where tensile damage localizes during release. Here we couple phase-contrast-enhanced radiography at an X-ray free-electron laser with simulations to address this question in single-crystal diamond. By combining radiographs at multiple pump-probe delays with hydrodynamic calculations, we show that linear features first become visible behind the plastic wavefront while material near the front remains highly compressed. By rotating the viewing direction about the shock axis, we find that the projected feature angles favor finite 111 sheets elongated along in-plane directions close to langle112rangle. Molecular dynamics simulations show that an interconnected network of amorphous bands and stacking faults forms during compression, preferentially on 111 variants with larger in-plane shear traction. Projections of this network qualitatively reproduce the observed loss of feature visibility with rotation. During simulated release, tension opens local cracks within these pre-existing amorphous bands. These results support a pathway in which the crystallographically organized defect network formed during compression provides preferred sites for tensile damage during release. This pathway may also operate in other strongly covalent solids.
articles.abstract_zh: 预测冲击载荷后的失效需要了解压缩过程中产生的结构如何随着材料卸载而演变。据报道，在金刚石中，晶体塑性和局部非晶化都可以适应冲击引起的剪切。然而，仍然未解决压缩过程中产生的缺陷结构如何在三个维度上组织以及该组织如何影响释放过程中拉伸损伤的局部化。在这里，我们将 X 射线自由电子激光器的相衬增强射线照相与模拟相结合，以解决单晶金刚石中的这个问题。通过将多个泵浦探针延迟处的射线照片与流体动力学计算相结合，我们发现线性特征首先在塑料波前后面变得可见，而波前附近的材料仍然高度压缩。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 预测冲击载荷后的失效需要了解压缩过程中产生的结构如何随着材料卸载而演变。据报道，在金刚石中，晶体塑性和局部非晶化都可以适应冲击引起的剪切。然而，仍然未解决压缩过程中产生的缺陷结构如何在三个维度上组织以及该组织如何影响释放过程中拉伸损伤的局部化。在这里，我们将 X 射线自由电子激光器的相衬增强射线照相与模拟相结合，以解决单晶金刚石中的这个问题。通过将多个泵浦探针延迟处的射线照片与流体动力学计算相结合，我们发现线性特征首先在塑料波前后面变得可见，而波前附近的材料仍然高度压缩。通过围绕激波轴旋转观察方向，我们发现投影特征角度有利于沿着接近 langle112rangle 的面内方向拉长的有限 111 个片。分子动力学模拟表明，压缩过程中会形成非晶带和堆垛层错的互连网络，特别是在具有较大面内剪切力的 111 种变体上。该网络的投影定性地再现了观察到的旋转时特征可见性的损失。在模拟释放过程中，张力会在这些预先存在的非晶带内打开局部裂缝。这些结果支持了一种途径，其中在压缩过程中形成的晶体学组织的缺陷网络为释放过程中的拉伸损伤提供了优选的位点。该途径也可以在其他强共价固体中起作用。

articles.title: SPARC: Evidence-guided adaptive model composition for materials discovery
articles.title_zh: SPARC：用于材料发现的证据引导自适应模型组合
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.19050v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Closed-loop experimentation requires more than selecting the next experiment. It must also determine which existing measurements and model-derived relationships are sufficiently supported to influence that decision. Here we introduce SPARC (Sparse Predictive Aggregation of Regression Components), a framework that continually revises this support as experimental evidence accumulates. Competing model families are evaluated through out-of-fold predictions, so that each model is tested on observations not used in its corresponding fit. Sparse posterior composition assigns model influence according to predictive contributions supported by the out-of-fold evidence, retaining complementary contributions from several model families. Candidate-dependent predictive dispersion and residual variability define trust, which modulates exploration alongside the predicted response. Independent diagnostics also prioritize existing measurements for prospective verification, with model-derived trust reported alongside them. Across eight published materials datasets, SPARC achieved higher R² than the corresponding literature-reported values in six, with relative gains of up to 77% without the density-functional-theory- or experiment-derived descriptors used by several published pipelines. In an automated alkaline oxygen-evolution-reaction campaign, 8 of 11 SPARC-selected experiments reached overpotentials below 300 mV, with a best value of 242 mV, compared with 18 of 125 initial experiments. Measurements prioritized for verification before repetition subsequently deviated by 76 mV on average, compared with 27 mV for matched controls. SPARC therefore turns experimental evidence into a basis for revising model influence, directing exploration and identifying measurements that warrant verification.
articles.abstract_zh: 闭环实验需要的不仅仅是选择下一个实验。它还必须确定哪些现有测量和模型派生关系得到充分支持以影响该决策。在这里，我们介绍 SPARC（回归组件的稀疏预测聚合），这是一个随着实验证据积累而不断修改这种支持的框架。竞争模型系列通过折叠预测进行评估，以便每个模型都根据其相应拟合中未使用的观察结果进行测试。稀疏后验组成根据折叠证据支持的预测贡献来分配模型影响，保留来自多个模型系列的补充贡献。依赖于候选者的预测离散度和剩余变异性定义了信任，它调节探索以及预测响应。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 闭环实验需要的不仅仅是选择下一个实验。它还必须确定哪些现有测量和模型派生关系得到充分支持以影响该决策。在这里，我们介绍 SPARC（回归组件的稀疏预测聚合），这是一个随着实验证据积累而不断修改这种支持的框架。竞争模型系列通过折叠预测进行评估，以便每个模型都根据其相应拟合中未使用的观察结果进行测试。稀疏后验组成根据折叠证据支持的预测贡献来分配模型影响，保留来自多个模型系列的补充贡献。依赖于候选者的预测离散度和剩余变异性定义了信任，它调节探索以及预测响应。独立诊断还优先考虑现有测量以进行前瞻性验证，并同时报告模型衍生的信任。在 8 个已发布的材料数据集中，SPARC 实现了比 6 个相应文献报告值更高的 R²，在没有多个已发布流程使用的密度泛函理论或实验衍生描述符的情况下，相对增益高达 77%。在自动化碱性析氧反应活动中，SPARC 选择的 11 个实验中的 8 个达到了低于 300 mV 的过电势，最佳值为 242 mV，而 125 个初始实验中只有 18 个达到了 242 mV。在重复之前优先进行验证的测量结果平均偏差 76 mV，而匹配对照的偏差为 27 mV。因此，SPARC 将实验证据转化为修正模型影响、指导探索和识别值得验证的测量的基础。

articles.title: Interplay of interfacial energetics and selective Ni segregation in the morphology of co-precipitates in low-alloy steels
articles.title_zh: 低合金钢共沉淀物形态中界面能量和选择性镍偏析的相互作用
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.19060v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Coupled precipitation and interfacial segregation in low-alloy steels change precipitate stability and morphology, which influence strengthening and embrittlement. Cu-rich precipitates (CRPs) and Mn-Ni-Si-rich precipitates (MNSPs) frequently form core-shell or appendage morphologies, but the interfacial energetics controlling this change are not well quantified. We combine a density-functional-theory-trained cluster expansion with lattice Monte Carlo simulations to evaluate the Fe/CRP, Fe/MNSP and Cu/MNSP interfaces within one Hamiltonian. The three coefficients based on excess internal energy follow gamma_Cu/MNSP < gamma_Fe/CRP <~ gamma_Fe/MNSP and give a positive work of adhesion and a negative spreading parameter, consistent with favorable Mn-Ni-Si attachment to a CRP and partial coverage. Only Ni segregates to the Fe/CRP boundary. Mn and Si segregate weakly on their own but become more enriched when Ni is present and co-segregate with Ni at the boundary. Ni forms an interfacial layer about one monolayer thick with an excess of 7.4-9.6 atoms/nm², develops B2-like local order and shows an energy reduction that increases with Ni coverage. At 1 at.% matrix Ni, a Gibbs adsorption analysis gives a Fe/CRP free-energy reduction of about 0.15 J/m². These interface coefficients and segregation trends connect segregation, interface energy and co-precipitation and support compositional optimization in low-alloy steels.
articles.abstract_zh: 低合金钢中的耦合析出和界面偏析会改变析出物稳定性和形态，从而影响强化和脆化。富铜沉淀物（CRP）和富锰镍硅沉淀物（MNSP）经常形成核壳或附属物形态，但控制这种变化的界面能量学尚未得到很好的量化。我们将密度泛函理论训练的簇展开与晶格蒙特卡罗模拟相结合，以评估一个哈密顿量内的 Fe/CRP、Fe/MNSP 和 Cu/MNSP 界面。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 低合金钢中的耦合析出和界面偏析会改变析出物稳定性和形态，从而影响强化和脆化。富铜沉淀物（CRP）和富锰镍硅沉淀物（MNSP）经常形成核壳或附属物形态，但控制这种变化的界面能量学尚未得到很好的量化。我们将密度泛函理论训练的簇展开与晶格蒙特卡罗模拟相结合，以评估一个哈密顿量内的 Fe/CRP、Fe/MNSP 和 Cu/MNSP 界面。基于过剩内能的三个系数遵循 gamma_Cu/MNSP < gamma_Fe/CRP <~ gamma_Fe/MNSP 并给出正的粘附功和负的铺展参数，与有利的 Mn-Ni-Si 对 CRP 的附着和部分覆盖一致。只有 Ni 偏析到 Fe/CRP 边界。 Mn 和 Si 本身偏析较弱，但当 Ni 存在时变得更加富集，并在边界处与 Ni 共偏析。 Ni 形成约一个单层厚的界面层，其含量超过 7.4-9.6 个原子/nm²，形成类似 B2 的局部有序性，并显示出随着 Ni 覆盖范围的增加而增加的能量降低。在 1 at.% 基质 Ni 下，吉布斯吸附分析表明 Fe/CRP 自由能降低约 0.15 J/m²。这些界面系数和偏析趋势将偏析、界面能和共沉淀联系起来，并支持低合金钢的成分优化。

articles.title: Spontaneous Chiral Superradiance of a Spin-1 Condensate in a Ring Cavity
articles.title_zh: 环腔中 Spin-1 凝聚体的自发手性超辐射
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.19139v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We investigate superradiant phase transitions in a spin-1 Bose-Einstein condensate coupled to a ring cavity, where two symmetry-related Raman processes couple the atomic spin states to counterpropagating cavity modes. Above the superradiant threshold, we find that the symmetry between the two Raman channels is spontaneously broken, giving rise to a chiral superradiant (CSR) phase. Despite the exchange symmetry of the Hamiltonian, the CSR state spontaneously selects one of the two propagation directions, with one cavity mode becoming macroscopically occupied while its counterpropagating partner remains dark. Spin-dependent collisions further reshape the superradiant phase diagram by selectively shifting the boundaries between the chiral and symmetric superradiant phases, a feature intrinsic to the multicomponent spin-1 manifold. For sufficiently negative spin-dependent interactions, the interaction-induced modification of the atomic level structure gives rise to a reversed plane-wave phase characterized by an inverted internal-state occupation. These results identify spontaneous selection between symmetry-related superradiant channels as a mechanism for generating chirality in many-body cavity QED and demonstrate how spin-dependent collisions control the resulting superradiant phase structure.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们研究了与环形腔耦合的自旋 1 玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚体中的超辐射相变，其中两个与对称相关的拉曼过程将原子自旋状态与反向传播腔模式耦合。在超辐射阈值之上，我们发现两个拉曼通道之间的对称性自发破缺，产生手性超辐射（CSR）相。尽管哈密顿量具有交换对称性，但 CSR 状态会自发选择两个传播方向之一，其中一个腔模被宏观占据，而其反向传播伙伴保持黑暗。自旋相关碰撞通过选择性地移动手性和对称超辐射相之间的边界（多组分 spin-1 流形的固有特征）进一步重塑超辐射相图。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们研究了与环形腔耦合的自旋 1 玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚体中的超辐射相变，其中两个与对称相关的拉曼过程将原子自旋状态与反向传播腔模式耦合。在超辐射阈值之上，我们发现两个拉曼通道之间的对称性自发破缺，产生手性超辐射（CSR）相。尽管哈密顿量具有交换对称性，但 CSR 状态会自发选择两个传播方向之一，其中一个腔模被宏观占据，而其反向传播伙伴保持黑暗。自旋相关碰撞通过选择性地移动手性和对称超辐射相之间的边界（多组分 spin-1 流形的固有特征）进一步重塑超辐射相图。对于足够负的自旋相关相互作用，相互作用引起的原子能级结构的改变会产生以反转内态占据为特征的反转平面波相位。这些结果确定了对称相关超辐射通道之间的自发选择作为多体腔 QED 中产生手性的机制，并证明了自旋相关碰撞如何控制由此产生的超辐射相结构。

articles.title: Chiral-phonon-mediated spin current injection into an Ising superconductor
articles.title_zh: 手性声子介导的自旋电流注入伊辛超导体
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.19180v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We theoretically propose chiral-phonon-mediated spin current injection into an Ising superconductor in a chiral-insulator/Ising-superconductor heterostructure, where nonequilibrium phonons driven by a temperature gradient transfer their angular momentum to electron spins via interfacial phonon-spin conversion. Using the nonequilibrium Green's function formalism, we derive an expression for the injected spin current and show that it depends on the difference between the contributions from the two phonon branches with opposite circular polarizations. We further investigate the temperature dependence of the injected spin current density at different in-plane magnetic field strengths. In the superconducting state, the spin current density increases with temperature or in-plane magnetic field strength. In addition to the kink at the superconducting transition, a second kink appears below the transition temperature. The position of this kink is consistent with the onset of phonon-induced two-quasiparticle excitations as the superconducting gap decreases with increasing temperature. We further investigate the magnetic-field dependence of the kink temperature in a temperature--magnetic-field phase diagram.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们理论上提出手性声子介导的自旋电流注入手性绝缘体/伊辛超导体异质结构中的伊辛超导体，其中由温度梯度驱动的非平衡声子通过界面声子自旋转换将其角动量转移到电子自旋。使用非平衡格林函数形式，我们推导了注入自旋电流的表达式，并表明它取决于具有相反圆极化的两个声子分支的贡献之间的差异。我们进一步研究了不同面内磁场强度下注入自旋电流密度的温度依赖性。在超导状态下，自旋电流密度随着温度或面内磁场强度的增加而增加。除了超导转变处的扭结之外，在转变温度以下还出现第二个扭结。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们理论上提出手性声子介导的自旋电流注入手性绝缘体/伊辛超导体异质结构中的伊辛超导体，其中由温度梯度驱动的非平衡声子通过界面声子自旋转换将其角动量转移到电子自旋。使用非平衡格林函数形式，我们推导了注入自旋电流的表达式，并表明它取决于具有相反圆极化的两个声子分支的贡献之间的差异。我们进一步研究了不同面内磁场强度下注入自旋电流密度的温度依赖性。在超导状态下，自旋电流密度随着温度或面内磁场强度的增加而增加。除了超导转变处的扭结之外，在转变温度以下还出现第二个扭结。当超导间隙随着温度升高而减小时，该扭结的位置与声子引起的两个准粒子激发的开始一致。我们进一步研究了温度-磁场相图中扭结温度的磁场依赖性。

articles.title: Inelastic confinement-induced resonances in multiwell potentials
articles.title_zh: 多孔势中非弹性约束引起的共振
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.19300v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Recently, resonance features associated with multiwell effects have been reported in a fascinating experiment conducted with an ultracold-atom quantum simulator [Y. K. Lee, H. Lin, and W. Ketterle, Phys. Rev. Lett. 131, 213001 (2023)]. The results were explained as a consequence of superexchange, which determines the spin dynamics in a singly-occupied Mott insulator, by allowing for the virtual population of two particles on the same site. In this work, a complementary interpretation of the resonance features is provided based on inelastic confinement-induced resonances, manifested as avoided crossings in the two-particle spectrum, showing excellent agreement with the experimental results. The comparison of the results of the single- and double-well descriptions of the optical trapping potential confirms the multiwell origin of the experimental features. However, the double-well model is already shown to be sufficient for providing an explanation of the apparent symmetry violation that occurs within single-well models. Furthermore, certain limitations of the harmonic approximation are discussed.
articles.abstract_zh: 最近，在使用超冷原子量子模拟器 [Y. K. Lee、H. Lin 和 W. Ketterle，物理学家。莱特牧师。 131, 213001 (2023)]。结果被解释为超级交换的结果，超级交换通过允许同一位置上两个粒子的虚拟群体来决定单占据莫特绝缘体中的自旋动力学。在这项工作中，基于非弹性约束引起的共振提供了对共振特征的补充解释，表现为避免了两粒子谱的交叉，与实验结果表现出极好的一致性。光捕获势的单井和双井描述结果的比较证实了实验特征的多井起源。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 最近，在使用超冷原子量子模拟器 [Y. K. Lee、H. Lin 和 W. Ketterle，物理学家。莱特牧师。 131, 213001 (2023)]。结果被解释为超级交换的结果，超级交换通过允许同一位置上两个粒子的虚拟群体来决定单占据莫特绝缘体中的自旋动力学。在这项工作中，基于非弹性约束引起的共振提供了对共振特征的补充解释，表现为避免了两粒子谱的交叉，与实验结果表现出极好的一致性。光捕获势的单井和双井描述结果的比较证实了实验特征的多井起源。然而，双井模型已被证明足以解释单井模型中发生的明显对称性破坏。此外，还讨论了谐波近似的某些局限性。

articles.title: Knitting the Ising Transition: Statistical Physics as a Tool for Stochastic Knit Design
articles.title_zh: 编织伊辛跃迁：统计物理学作为随机编织设计的工具
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.19317v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Textile designs are typically based on biperiodic, deterministic patterns. However, hand and machine manufacturing are not restricted to periodic patterns. Instead, the entanglement topology can be chosen for each base unit cell of the textile. Non-deterministic processes, such as stochastic realisations of physical systems, can then serve as design tools for creating original patterns. In this Proceedings, we present a proof of concept for stochastic design by generating knitted fabrics from Ising model spin patterns. We leverage the binary analogy between knit/purl stitches and up/down spins to produce fabrics that directly represent spin realisations at different temperatures. Ising patterns then play the role of topological instructions to arrange the entanglements in the fabric. This proof of concept paves the way for novel stochastic designs of fabrics whose properties are directly controlled by the statistical characteristics of an underlying physical process.
articles.abstract_zh: 纺织品设计通常基于双周期、确定性模式。然而，手工和机器制造并不局限于周期性图案。相反，可以为纺织品的每个基本单元选择缠结拓扑。非确定性过程（例如物理系统的随机实现）可以用作创建原始模式的设计工具。在本论文中，我们通过从伊辛模型纺纱图案生成针织面料，提出了随机设计的概念证明。我们利用针织/反捻针迹和向上/向下旋转之间的二元类比来生产直接代表不同温度下旋转实现的织物。然后，伊辛图案发挥拓扑指令的作用来排列织物中的缠结。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 纺织品设计通常基于双周期、确定性模式。然而，手工和机器制造并不局限于周期性图案。相反，可以为纺织品的每个基本单元选择缠结拓扑。非确定性过程（例如物理系统的随机实现）可以用作创建原始模式的设计工具。在本论文中，我们通过从伊辛模型纺纱图案生成针织面料，提出了随机设计的概念证明。我们利用针织/反捻针迹和向上/向下旋转之间的二元类比来生产直接代表不同温度下旋转实现的织物。然后，伊辛图案发挥拓扑指令的作用来排列织物中的缠结。这一概念验证为织物的新颖随机设计铺平了道路，其特性直接由基础物理过程的统计特征控制。

articles.title: When the Boundary Changes the Bulk: Topological Edge Modes in Dynamical Quantum Phase Transitions
articles.title_zh: 当边界改变体积时：动态量子相变中的拓扑边缘模式
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.19328v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: For dynamical quantum phase transitions (DQPTs) in open chains it has been noted that the boundary can change the bulk: in time windows bounded by DQPTs, exponentially localized edge modes of the Loschmidt matrix produce a finite change in the intensive return rate. These modes have been attributed to topological properties of the initial and final Hamiltonians. Here we show that it is not the topology of the Hamiltonians but rather that of the non-Hermitian Loschmidt matrix which protects these edge modes. In particular, we show that topological edge modes can exist in class A, where both Hamiltonians are topologically trivial. For classes A, BDI, and AIII we show that these modes are protected by Z indices of a Toeplitz operator and that K-splitting theorems provide a precise bulk-boundary correspondence. In class D, they are protected instead by a Z₂ index that records whether the quench has flipped the fermion parity at the edge. The bulk invariant for class D can be formulated either as a ratio of the Loschmidt amplitudes for periodic and anti-periodic boundary conditions or as a winding number that counts phase vortices in momentum and time. We discuss examples and provide numerical data for all four topological classes.
articles.abstract_zh: 对于开链中的动态量子相变 (DQPT)，人们注意到边界可以改变体积：在 DQPT 限制的时间窗口中，Loschmidt 矩阵的指数局域边缘模式会产生密集返回率的有限变化。这些模式归因于初始和最终哈密顿量的拓扑性质。在这里，我们证明保护这些边缘模式的不是哈密顿量的拓扑，而是非厄米洛施密特矩阵的拓扑。特别是，我们证明了拓扑边缘模式可以存在于 A 类中，其中两个哈密顿量都是拓扑平凡的。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 对于开链中的动态量子相变 (DQPT)，人们注意到边界可以改变体积：在 DQPT 限制的时间窗口中，Loschmidt 矩阵的指数局域边缘模式会产生密集返回率的有限变化。这些模式归因于初始和最终哈密顿量的拓扑性质。在这里，我们证明保护这些边缘模式的不是哈密顿量的拓扑，而是非厄米洛施密特矩阵的拓扑。特别是，我们证明了拓扑边缘模式可以存在于 A 类中，其中两个哈密顿量都是拓扑平凡的。对于 A、BDI 和 AIII 类，我们证明这些模式受到 Toeplitz 算子的 Z 索引的保护，并且 K 分裂定理提供了精确的体边界对应。在 D 类中，它们受到 Z2 索引的保护，该索引记录淬灭是否翻转了边缘的费米子宇称。 D 类的体积不变量可以表示为周期性和反周期边界条件的洛施密特振幅之比，也可以表示为计算动量和时间中的相位涡旋的绕数。我们讨论示例并提供所有四个拓扑类别的数值数据。

articles.title: Tunable topological droplets on supercoiled DNA under tension
articles.title_zh: 张力下超螺旋 DNA 上的可调拓扑液滴
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.19342v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: DNA--protein co-condensation is an important regulatory mechanism for gene expression and repair. For straight DNA under constant stretching forces, co-condensation is ``all-or-nothing'': above a critical force, condensates are prevented from nucleating, while below it the entire molecule collapses into a droplet. Here we show by coarse-grained simulations and analytic theory that DNA supercoiling mechanically differentiates the condensation substrate: DNA plectonemes constitute force-insulated pockets on which condensates can nucleate even above the critical force. The size of the resulting droplets is tunable through the applied force and linking number. Surface tension drives the coarsening of multiple plectoneme-associated condensates into a single topological droplet. Magnetic tweezers experiments with spermine reproduce both the force-dependent collapse and the supercoiling-dependent condensation.
articles.abstract_zh: DNA-蛋白质共缩合是基因表达和修复的重要调节机制。对于在恒定拉伸力下的直 DNA，共缩合是“全有或全无”：在临界力之上，缩合物被阻止成核，而在临界力之下，整个分子塌缩成液滴。在这里，我们通过粗粒度模拟和分析理论表明，DNA 超螺旋在机械上区分了凝聚底物：DNA plectoneme 构成了力绝缘的口袋，即使在临界力以上，凝聚物也可以在其上成核。产生的液滴的大小可通过施加的力和连接数来调节。表面张力驱动多个与浆体相关的冷凝物粗化成单个拓扑液滴。
articles.abstract_zh_full: DNA-蛋白质共缩合是基因表达和修复的重要调节机制。对于在恒定拉伸力下的直 DNA，共缩合是“全有或全无”：在临界力之上，缩合物被阻止成核，而在临界力之下，整个分子塌缩成液滴。在这里，我们通过粗粒度模拟和分析理论表明，DNA 超螺旋在机械上区分了凝聚底物：DNA plectoneme 构成了力绝缘的口袋，即使在临界力以上，凝聚物也可以在其上成核。产生的液滴的大小可通过施加的力和连接数来调节。表面张力驱动多个与浆体相关的冷凝物粗化成单个拓扑液滴。用精胺进行的磁镊实验再现了力依赖性塌缩和超螺旋依赖性凝结。

articles.title: Exploring Energy Landscapes for Functional Materials: Ga vacancies in β-Ga₂O₃
articles.title_zh: 探索功能材料的能源格局：β-Ga2O₃ 中的 Ga 空位
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.19365v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Energy landscape exploration requires extensive energy and force evaluations, making efficient access to interatomic potentials an important practical challenge. We present a persistent socket interface that connects the landscape exploration tools in the GMIN, OPTIM, and PATHSAMPLE programs to potentials available through the Atomic Simulation Environment (ASE). The persistent design keeps both the calculator and socket connection active throughout the search, avoiding repeated initialisation. We apply this framework to understand and predict the properties of Ga vacancies in β-Ga₂O₃ using two NequIP-based potentials, and construct kinetic transition networks describing complex vacancy configurations and migration pathways. Temperature-dependent analysis of the dominant paths reveals how the most probable migration sequence can change, with the mechanism governed by global properties of the network, rather than simply the highest energy barrier. Visualisation, mean first-passage times, and heat capacities enable us to connect the organisation of the landscape to relaxation time scales and thermodynamic observables. The interface extends energy landscape methods to ASE-compatible atomistic models, providing a general framework for combining global optimisation, transition state searches, kinetic network analysis, and thermodynamic characterisation with recent developments in machine-learned interatomic potentials.
articles.abstract_zh: 能源景观探索需要广泛的能量和力评估，这使得有效获取原子间势成为重要的实际挑战。我们提出了一个持久套接字接口，它将 GMIN、OPTIM 和 PATHSAMPLE 程序中的景观探索工具连接到通过原子模拟环境 (ASE) 提供的可用潜力。持久性设计使计算器和套接字连接在整个搜索过程中保持活动状态，避免重复初始化。我们应用这个框架来使用两个基于 NequIP 的势来理解和预测 β-Ga2O₃ 中 Ga 空位的性质，并构建描述复杂空位配置和迁移路径的动力学过渡网络。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 能源景观探索需要广泛的能量和力评估，这使得有效获取原子间势成为重要的实际挑战。我们提出了一个持久套接字接口，它将 GMIN、OPTIM 和 PATHSAMPLE 程序中的景观探索工具连接到通过原子模拟环境 (ASE) 提供的可用潜力。持久性设计使计算器和套接字连接在整个搜索过程中保持活动状态，避免重复初始化。我们应用这个框架来使用两个基于 NequIP 的势来理解和预测 β-Ga2O₃ 中 Ga 空位的性质，并构建描述复杂空位配置和迁移路径的动力学过渡网络。对主要路径的温度相关分析揭示了最可能的迁移序列如何变化，其机制由网络的全局属性控制，而不仅仅是最高能垒。可视化、平均首次通过时间和热容使我们能够将景观的组织与弛豫时间尺度和热力学可观测值联系起来。该接口将能量景观方法扩展到与 ASE 兼容的原子模型，提供了一个将全局优化、过渡态搜索、动力学网络分析和热力学表征与机器学习原子间势的最新发展相结合的通用框架。

articles.title: Universal Analytical Description of Magnetoexcitons in Two-Dimensional Semiconducting Materials
articles.title_zh: 二维半导体材料中磁激子的通用分析描述
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.19415v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Matching the Coulomb and logarithmic limits of the Rytova--Keldysh model gives a universal zero-field spectrum for monolayer exciton s states, Eₙsimeq-Ry^*/[n-1/2+fₙ(ξ)]², where ξ is the screening parameter. Analytical radii determine diamagnetic coefficients and the magnetic crossover scale. Zero-field deviations peak near 1% across the full screening range 0≤ξ≤100. For the sampled hBN-encapsulated monolayers, magnetoexciton energies agree with numerical spectra to sub-meV rms up to 100T and capture the measured orbital shifts. Shared parameters link optical and magneto-optical spectra.
articles.abstract_zh: 匹配 Rytova--Keldysh 模型的库仑和对数极限给出了单层激子态的通用零场谱，Eₙsimeq-Ry^*/[n-1/2+fₙ(Ψ)]²，其中 Υ 是筛选参数。解析半径确定抗磁系数和磁交叉尺度。在整个筛选范围 0≤ψ≤100 内，零场偏差峰值接近 1%。对于采样的六方氮化硼封装的单层材料，磁激子能量与高达 100T 的亚 meV rms 数值谱一致，并捕获了测量的轨道位移。共享参数将光学光谱和磁光光谱联系起来。
