articles.abstract: Author(s): Natalie Kuhn, Marc Schütte, Joachim Emming, Felix Hellenkamp, Leo Dreyer, Frank Volmer, Kenji Watanabe, Takashi Taniguchi, Lutz Waldecker, Christoph Stampfer, and Bernd Beschoten Magnetic proximity effects offer a powerful route to tailor the electronic properties of two-dimensional materials by coupling them to 2D magnets. So far, these effects have been understood to be governed primarily by the interfacial magnetization. In this work, the authors go beyond this picture by demonstrating that magnetic order deeper within a multilayer CrI₃ magnet can also influence an adjacent WSe₂ semiconductor. While the neutral exciton valley splitting in WSe₂ tracks the interfacial CrI₃ magnetization, the optical response of positively charged trions is additionally sensitive to the magnetic alignment of more distant CrI₃ layers. These findings open new perspectives for engineering spin and valley properties in van der Waals heterostructures. [Phys. Rev. Materials 10, 114004] Published Mon Nov 16, 2026

articles.abstract: Author(s): Rajesh Swami, Papul Sahu, Sonali S Pradhan, V. Kanchana, and Z. Hossain Tb 2 Zn 17 crystallizes in the rhombohedral Th 2 Zn 17 -type structure (space group R 3 ¯ m ), a structure type known to accommodate atomic disorder. Here, the authors highlight the role of disorder-induced scattering in magnetotransport measurements, which exhibit signatures of weak antilocalization. This compound shows multiple first-order field-induced metamagnetic transitions, strong magnetic anisotropy, crystal electric field effects, and possible spin canting within its antiferromagnetic state. First-principles calculations predict multiple electron and hole Fermi pockets, along with mirror-symmetry-protected nodal rings, suggesting Tb 2 Zn 17 as a promising rare-earth-based magnetic topological semimetal. articles.abstract: Author(s): Sicheng Zhou, Ruihuan Duan, Jie Pang, Xiaoxiong Liu, Sunchao Huang, Yubin Gong, Xinyi Zheng, Lei Xu, Lihong Hu, Siyuan Zhou, Zheng Liu, Youguo Shi, Bingbing Tong, Peiling Li, Zhaozheng Lyu, Zhiwei Dou, Jie Shen, Xiunian Jing, Fanming Qu, Yanqun Guo, Guangtong Liu, and Li Lu Here, the authors identify a Fermi surface driven mechanism for positive linear magnetoresistance in the kagome ferrimagnet TbMn 6 Sn 6 . Measurements on multiple nanoflake devices reveal pronounced linear magnetoresistance, with substantial device-to-device variations in both its slope and the quadratic-to-linear crossover field. Combining magnetotransport experiments with first-principles-based semiclassical calculations, the authors demonstrate how the relaxation time and small shifts in chemical potential govern these variations. These findings provide insight into the microscopic origin of linear magnetoresistance and, in particular, its emergence at relatively low crossover fields. [Phys. Rev. B 114, L291106] Published Mon Nov 16, 2026

articles.title: Evolution of the saddle point in antimony telluride homologous superlattices
articles.title_zh: 碲化锑同系超晶格鞍点的演化
articles.abstract: Author(s): Yi-Hsin Shen, Shane Smolenski, Ming Wen, Yimo Hou, Nishkarsh Agarwal, Eoghan Downey, Jakob Hammond-Renfro, Katharine Moncrieffe, Chun Lin, Makoto Hashimoto, Donghui Lu, Robert Hovden, Kai Sun, Dominika Zgid, Emanuel Gull, Pierre Ferdinand P. Poudeu, Na Hyun Jo, and Rachel S. Goldman Engineering the density of states near the Fermi level is a central strategy for accessing correlated quantum matter, with broad implications for emerging electronic and quantum technologies. One particularly powerful route involves saddle points in the electronic band structure, which give rise to van Hove singularities (VHSs) with divergent density of states. To date, approaches for bringing the Fermi level into alignment with a VHS have relied mainly upon gating, chemical doping, or heterostructure engineering. Here, the authors demonstrate an alternative pathway - combining topological insulators (antimony telluride) with topological semimetals (antimonene) in the form of antimony telluride homologous superlattices. Using scanning tunneling spectroscopy (STS) and angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy (ARPES), in conjunction with scGW calculations, they provide evidence for a saddle point and associated van Hove singularity near the M-point. They identify the key role of Sb and Te pz orbital hybridization in generating the saddle point and shifting it toward the Fermi level as the number of antimonene layers increases. These findings establish a pathway for tuning van Hove singularities through atomic-layer engineering, offering new opportunities for realizing correlated quantum phases. [Phys. Rev. Hamilton Silicon hole dots can host dense arrays of spin qubits and provide rapid electric control via the strong spin-orbit interaction. The impact on hole-spin properties due to changes in the electrical environment, such as hole dot number, is not well understood. This study utilizes spin leakage current to probe the spin-orbit and g -tensor orientation in a silicon double dot when the dot hole number is varied. articles.title: Asymmetric mode hybridization in Floquet cavity magnonics
articles.title_zh: Floquet 腔磁振子学中的不对称模式杂交
articles.abstract: Author(s): Amin Pishehvar, Jayakrishnan M. P. Nair, Zixin Yan, Yu Jiang, Benedetta Flebus, and Xufeng Zhang Controllable mode hybridization is a versatile means to engineer interactions between distinct degrees of freedom of spin waves, but previous demonstrations have been limited to symmetric cases. This study use phase-coherent, dual-tone Floquet driving to break the symmetry of magnon-photon hybridization, creating interference between multiple pathways with relative strengths controlled by the drive phase. This interference produces unequal Autler-Townes splittings for the two interacting modes, enabling continuously tunable asymmetric hybridization, and thus providing a programmable approach to engineering such interactions in driven and hybrid systems. [Phys. Rev. Applied 26, L051003] Published Mon Nov 16, 2026

articles.title: A hierarchical adaptive Fourier-feature physics-informed neural network for radio-frequency capacitively coupled plasma discharges
articles.title_zh: 用于射频电容耦合等离子体放电的分层自适应傅里叶特征物理通知神经网络
articles.abstract: Physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) are difficult to train for radio-frequency capacitively coupled plasma fluid-Poisson systems because missing initial conditions, steep sheath gradients, and strongly imbalanced residuals can lead to unstable or nonunique reconstructions. We propose a Hierarchical Adaptive Fourier-feature PINN (HA-FPINN) for such coupled plasma models. The method combines Fourier feature mapping to improve the representation of small-scale sheath structures, sparse physical anchors to provide interior constraints, and a two-level adaptive weighting scheme to balance the PDE, boundary, and anchor losses as well as individual equation residuals. The framework is tested on an 8-equation helium discharge model and a 23-equation electronegative model. In the helium case, HA-FPINN reconstructs the space-time evolution of the main physical variables with anchors and converges for all tested network architectures, with convergence times of – s. In the case, HA-FPINN achieves stable reconstruction with anchors, whereas the non-adaptive FPINN and standard PINN fail to converge under the same setting. The best performance in both systems is obtained at the tested Fourier frequency parameter . Noise-injection tests show that HA-FPINN maintains the lowest reconstruction error in the helium case and preserves the main space-time structures in the case at anchor noise levels of up to . These results show that HA-FPINN provides a robust PINN formulation for strongly coupled plasma fluid models with missing initial conditions.
articles.abstract_zh: 物理信息神经网络 (PINN) 很难针对射频电容耦合等离子体流体泊松系统进行训练，因为缺少初始条件、陡峭的鞘层梯度和强烈不平衡的残差可能会导致不稳定或非唯一的重建。我们为此类耦合等离子体模型提出了分层自适应傅里叶特征 PINN (HA-FPINN)。该方法结合了傅里叶特征映射来改进小尺度鞘结构的表示，稀疏物理锚提供内部约束，以及两级自适应加权方案来平衡偏微分方程、边界和锚损失以及单个方程残差。该框架在 8 方程氦放电模型和 23 方程负电模型上进行了测试。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 物理信息神经网络 (PINN) 很难针对射频电容耦合等离子体流体泊松系统进行训练，因为缺少初始条件、陡峭的鞘层梯度和强烈不平衡的残差可能会导致不稳定或非唯一的重建。我们为此类耦合等离子体模型提出了分层自适应傅里叶特征 PINN (HA-FPINN)。该方法结合了傅里叶特征映射来改进小尺度鞘结构的表示，稀疏物理锚提供内部约束，以及两级自适应加权方案来平衡偏微分方程、边界和锚损失以及单个方程残差。该框架在 8 方程氦放电模型和 23 方程负电模型上进行了测试。在氦气情况下，HA-FPINN 用锚点重构了主要物理变量的时空演化，并为所有测试的网络架构收敛，收敛时间为 – s。在这种情况下，HA-FPINN 实现了锚点的稳定重建，而非自适应 FPINN 和标准 PINN 在相同设置下无法收敛。两个系统的最佳性能都是在测试的傅里叶频率参数下获得的。噪声注入测试表明，HA-FPINN 在氦气情况下保持了最低的重建误差，并在锚噪声水平高达 的情况下保留了主要时空结构。这些结果表明，HA-FPINN 为缺少初始条件的强耦合等离子体流体模型提供了稳健的 PINN 公式。

articles.title: Topology-based fast neutron background suppression and sterile-neutrino sensitivity in a segmented reactor overlineνₑ detector
articles.title_zh: 分段反应堆上线νₑ探测器中基于拓扑的快中子背景抑制和惰性中微子灵敏度
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.17348v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Reactor electron antineutrinos are commonly detected through the inverse beta decay interaction, with a prompt positron followed by delayed neutron capture. In shallow or above-ground segmented organic scintillator detectors, correlated fast neutrons are a dominant background because proton recoils can mimic the prompt IBD signal. We study topology-based machine learning using the Indian Scintillator Matrix for Reactor Anti-Neutrinos detector as a case study. A multilayer perceptron is trained on reconstructed topological observables from detailed Geant4 simulations. The mathrmF₁ score and bootstrap resampling on an independent validation sample yield a fixed threshold of PIBD>0.40. Applied without further optimization to an independent testing sample, the MLP retains (83.4± 0.7)% of IBD events and rejects (77.3± 0.7)% of fast neutron events. In a controlled spectral benchmark using an independent AmBe fast neutron spectrum, the selection reduces the net candidate-spectrum deformation by 84%. The energy dependent signal acceptance and residual fast neutron component are subsequently incorporated into a binned likelihood, which recovers the injected IBD signal strength as mathrmhatα=0.993⁺⁰.⁰⁵³₋₀.₀₄₈, with an empirical goodness-of-fit probability of 0.434. The expected sterile-neutrino sensitivity for the ISMRAN detector is evaluated at baselines of 13 m and 18 m, with two years of exposure at each baseline. For the nominal pre-MLP S/B=1:2 benchmark and the background model, retaining the classifier score in a joint (mathrmEₚᵣₒₘₚₜ× PIBD) likelihood improves the 95% C.L. sensitivity to sin²2θ₁₄ by a logarithmically averaged 7.9% over 0.1≤Δ m₄₁²≤1~eV² relative to an energy-only likelihood with the same fast neutron contamination.
articles.abstract_zh: 反应堆电子反中微子通常通过逆β衰变相互作用来检测，先是瞬发正电子，然后是延迟中子俘获。在浅层或地上分段有机闪烁体探测器中，相关快中子是主要背景，因为质子反冲可以模拟瞬发 IBD 信号。我们使用用于反应堆反中微子探测器的印度闪烁体矩阵作为案例研究来研究基于拓扑的机器学习。多层感知器根据详细的 Geant4 模拟重建的拓扑可观测量进行训练。 mathrmF₁ 分数和独立验证样本上的 bootstrap 重采样产生 PIBD>0.40 的固定阈值。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 反应堆电子反中微子通常通过逆β衰变相互作用来检测，先是瞬发正电子，然后是延迟中子俘获。在浅层或地上分段有机闪烁体探测器中，相关快中子是主要背景，因为质子反冲可以模拟瞬发 IBD 信号。我们使用用于反应堆反中微子探测器的印度闪烁体矩阵作为案例研究来研究基于拓扑的机器学习。多层感知器根据详细的 Geant4 模拟重建的拓扑可观测量进行训练。 mathrmF₁ 分数和独立验证样本上的 bootstrap 重采样产生 PIBD>0.40 的固定阈值。在不进一步优化独立测试样本的情况下，MLP 保留 (83.4± 0.7)% 的 IBD 事件并拒绝 (77.3± 0.7)% 的快中子事件。在使用独立 AmBe 快中子能谱的受控能谱基准中，该选择将净候选能谱变形减少了 84%。随后将能量相关信号接受度和残余快中子分量合并到分箱似然中，将注入的 IBD 信号强度恢复为 mathrmhatα=0.993⁺⁰.⁰53₋₀.₀₈，经验拟合优度概率为 0.434。 ISMRAN 探测器的预期无菌中微子灵敏度在 13 m 和 18 m 基线处进行评估，每个基线暴露两年。对于标称 pre-MLP S/B=1:2 基准和背景模型，在联合 (mathrmEₚᵣₒₘₚₜ× PIBD) 似然中保留分类器分数可提高 95% C.L.相对于相同快中子污染的纯能量似然，在 0.1≤Δ m₄₁²≤1~eV² 范围内，对 sin²2θ₁₄ 的敏感性对数平均提高 7.9%。

articles.title: High-Transmission Cryogenic Fiber-Optic U-Bench Filter for Ultra-Low-Background Single-Photon Detection in Superconducting Devices
articles.title_zh: 用于超导器件中超低本底单光子检测的高传输低温光纤 U 型台滤波器
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.17349v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We report on our progress in implementing a cryogenic fiber-optic U-bench hosting an ultra-narrow bandpass filter, designed to mitigate the dominant fiber-coupled 300 K black-body background observed for superconducting single-photon detectors. While U-benches can be routinely aligned at room temperature to achieve minor optical losses, cooling them down results in substantial misalignment due to thermal contraction of their components. To mitigate the resulting losses, we have integrated cryo-compatible piezo stepper motors to the U-bench, enabling its in situ realignment while cold. In particular, this allows us to shift the temperature dependent transmission window of the used filter by rotating it with respect to the beam axis. First results show that our U-bench filter reaches a transmission coefficient of 38% (4.2 dB loss) at 40 K temperature. We project that the U-bench filter can reduce the black-body background down to 10⁻⁸ Hz and 10⁻³ Hz ranges for 1064 nm and 1550 nm wavelengths, respectively. With the expected background rates and the herein reported transmission coefficient, applying the U-bench filter in series with a transition edge sensor shows great potential in increasing the sensitivity of dedicated rare-event searches. We project that the noise-equivalent power for 1550 nm wavelength could be reduced down to 10⁻²⁰ W Hz⁻¹/² range if intrinsic background sources can be sufficiently mitigated.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们报告了在实施配备超窄带通滤波器的低温光纤 U 型工作台方面取得的进展，该工作台旨在减轻超导单光子探测器观察到的主要光纤耦合 300 K 黑体背景。虽然 U 型工作台可以在室温下进行常规对准，以实现较小的光学损耗，但将其冷却会导致由于其组件的热收缩而导致严重的未对准。为了减轻由此产生的损失，我们将兼容低温的压电步进电机集成到 U 形工作台上，使其能够在冷时进行原位重新对准。特别是，这使我们能够通过相对于光束轴旋转所使用的滤波器来改变其与温度相关的传输窗口。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们报告了在实施配备超窄带通滤波器的低温光纤 U 型工作台方面取得的进展，该工作台旨在减轻超导单光子探测器观察到的主要光纤耦合 300 K 黑体背景。虽然 U 型工作台可以在室温下进行常规对准，以实现较小的光学损耗，但将其冷却会导致由于其组件的热收缩而导致严重的未对准。为了减轻由此产生的损失，我们将兼容低温的压电步进电机集成到 U 形工作台上，使其能够在冷时进行原位重新对准。特别是，这使我们能够通过相对于光束轴旋转所使用的滤波器来改变其与温度相关的传输窗口。第一个结果表明，我们的 U 台滤波器在 40 K 温度下的传输系数达到 38%（4.2 dB 损耗）。我们预计 U 形台滤波器可以将 1064 nm 和 1550 nm 波长的黑体背景分别降低至 10⁻⁸ Hz 和 10⁻3 Hz 范围。凭借预期的背景率和本文报告的传输系数，将 U 台滤波器与过渡边缘传感器串联应用在提高专用稀有事件搜索的灵敏度方面显示出巨大的潜力。我们预计，如果可以充分减轻固有背景源，1550 nm 波长的噪声等效功率可以降低至 10⁻²⁰ W Hz⁻1/² 范围。

articles.title: Hybrid Quantum-Classical Sequence Models for Sample-Efficient Energy Regression in Simulated Calorimeter Showers
articles.title_zh: 模拟量热仪喷淋中样本有效能量回归的混合量子经典序列模型
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.17354v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Energy reconstruction from electromagnetic calorimeter data underpins particle identification, event reconstruction and precision measurements in high-energy physics. Machine learning already performs well on this task, yet two questions remain open: how much the choice of data representation matters, and whether hybrid quantum-classical models add value in practice. We compare classical and quantum-enhanced models for incident positron energy reconstruction on the CaloGAN dataset, a public benchmark of 100,000 simulated electromagnetic shower events spanning 1 to 100 GeV. Eight architectures, namely SVR, ANN, CNN and LSTM together with their quantum counterparts, are trained on three calorimeter representations: engineered physical features, calorimeter images, and longitudinal shower sequences. Models that follow the longitudinal development of the shower reach the highest accuracy, which points to the value of physically informed representations. The hybrid QLSTM gives the lowest reconstruction error, with an RMSE of 0.294 GeV. Under matched-data conditions with only 1,500 training events, the QLSTM improves on the classical LSTM by 52.7% and also surpasses an LSTM trained on the full set. These observations indicate that longitudinal representations are central to calorimeter energy reconstruction and give preliminary evidence that hybrid quantum-classical sequence models can be more sample-efficient for regression in high-energy physics.
articles.abstract_zh: 电磁量热仪数据的能量重建支撑着高能物理中的粒子识别、事件重建和精确测量。机器学习在这项任务上已经表现良好，但有两个问题仍然悬而未决：数据表示的选择有多重要，以及混合量子经典模型是否在实践中增加价值。我们在 CaloGAN 数据集上比较了入射正电子能量重建的经典模型和量子增强模型，CaloGAN 数据集是跨越 1 到 100 GeV 的 100,000 个模拟电磁簇射事件的公共基准。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 电磁量热仪数据的能量重建支撑着高能物理中的粒子识别、事件重建和精确测量。机器学习在这项任务上已经表现良好，但有两个问题仍然悬而未决：数据表示的选择有多重要，以及混合量子经典模型是否在实践中增加价值。我们在 CaloGAN 数据集上比较了入射正电子能量重建的经典模型和量子增强模型，CaloGAN 数据集是跨越 1 到 100 GeV 的 100,000 个模拟电磁簇射事件的公共基准。八种架构，即 SVR、ANN、CNN 和 LSTM 及其量子对应物，在三种量热计表示上进行训练：工程物理特征、量热计图像和纵向簇射序列。遵循流星雨纵向发展的模型达到了最高的精度，这表明了物理信息表示的价值。混合 QLSTM 的重建误差最低，RMSE 为 0.294 GeV。在仅 1,500 个训练事件的匹配数据条件下，QLSTM 比经典 LSTM 提高了 52.7%，也超过了在全套数据上训练的 LSTM。这些观察结果表明，纵向表示是热量计能量重建的核心，并提供了初步证据，表明混合量子经典序列模型对于高能物理回归来说可以更具样本效率。

articles.title: Design and Experimental Evaluation of a Low-Cost Immersion Cooling System
articles.title_zh: 低成本浸入式冷却系统的设计和实验评估
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.17361v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: This paper presents a low-cost, open-source, single-phase immersion cooling testbed for studying liquid cooling of data center hardware. A 500 W titanium heater, standing in for server load, is submerged in a glass tank of mineral oil, a dielectric fluid. The heated oil is circulated by a magnetic drive pump through an air-cooled radiator. An ESP32 microcontroller logs three DS18B20 temperature sensors (heater surface, bulk fluid and ambient) and switches the pump, fan and heater through a relay module. The complete system costs INR 35,318 (about USD 380), built entirely from components available in India. At quasi-steady state under the full 500 W load, the heater surface reached 118.3 degC while the bulk oil stayed at 29.3 degC, only 8.0 degC above ambient. Thermal-resistance analysis shows that the heater-to-oil interface, limited by natural convection, accounts for about 92% of the total resistance (178.0 vs 16.0 mdegC/W). The external loop therefore has spare capacity. CAD files, firmware and data are openly available, so the setup can be reproduced and used to compare dielectric fluids, loads and flow arrangements.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种低成本、开源、单相浸没式冷却测试台，用于研究数据中心硬件的液体冷却。代表服务器负载的 500 W 钛加热器浸入装有矿物油（一种介电流体）的玻璃罐中。加热的油由磁力驱动泵通过风冷散热器循环。 ESP32 微控制器记录三个 DS18B20 温度传感器（加热器表面、散装液体和环境温度），并通过继电器模块切换泵、风扇和加热器。整个系统的成本为 35,318 印度卢比（约合 380 美元），完全采用印度供应的组件构建。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 本文提出了一种低成本、开源、单相浸没式冷却测试台，用于研究数据中心硬件的液体冷却。代表服务器负载的 500 W 钛加热器浸入装有矿物油（一种介电流体）的玻璃罐中。加热的油由磁力驱动泵通过风冷散热器循环。 ESP32 微控制器记录三个 DS18B20 温度传感器（加热器表面、散装液体和环境温度），并通过继电器模块切换泵、风扇和加热器。整个系统的成本为 35,318 印度卢比（约合 380 美元），完全采用印度供应的组件构建。在 500 W 满负载下的准稳态下，加热器表面达到 118.3 摄氏度，而散装油保持在 29.3 摄氏度，仅比环境温度高 8.0 摄氏度。热阻分析表明，受自然对流限制的加热器与油的界面约占总电阻的 92%（178.0 vs 16.0 mdegC/W）。因此，外部环路有闲置容量。 CAD 文件、固件和数据都是公开可用的，因此可以复制该设置并用于比较介电流体、负载和流动布置。

articles.title: MID: a muon detector for the ALICE 3 upgrade project
articles.title_zh: MID：用于 ALICE 3 升级项目的 μ 子探测器
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.17363v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The success of the ALICE programme has allowed to study the hottest state of matter created in the laboratory: the strongly-interacting quark-gluon plasma (sQGP). However, some fundamental questions on the sQGP and other aspects of the strong interaction will remain open even after LHC Run 4. To address this, the ALICE collaboration has proposed a major upgrade of its detector, known as ALICE 3. Among the subdetectors considered for this upgrade is the muon identification detector (MID), whose aim is to contribute to the study of charmonium and exotic-hadron production in heavy-ion collisions. While the baseline design consists of plastic-scintillator-based chambers placed around a cylindrical magnetic iron absorber, different detector technologies are under evaluation for the MID, including multi-wire proportional chambers. This proceeding presents the results of two MID prototypes based on FNAL-NICADD scintillator bars, Kuraray fibers and Hamamatsu SiPMs, characterized in test beams at the CERN Proton Synchrotron with 3 GeV/c muon- and pion-enriched beams. The muon efficiency as well as the hadron suppression obtained using machine learning techniques will be discussed.
articles.abstract_zh: ALICE 计划的成功使我们能够研究实验室中创造的最热物质状态：强相互作用夸克-胶子等离子体 (sQGP)。然而，即使在 LHC Run 4 之后，有关 sQGP 和强相互作用其他方面的一些基本问题仍然存在。为了解决这个问题，ALICE 合作组织提出了对其探测器的重大升级，称为 ALICE 3。此次升级考虑的子探测器之一是 μ 子识别探测器 (MID)，其目的是为研究重离子碰撞中粲素和奇异强子的产生做出贡献。
articles.abstract_zh_full: ALICE 计划的成功使我们能够研究实验室中创造的最热物质状态：强相互作用夸克-胶子等离子体 (sQGP)。然而，即使在 LHC Run 4 之后，有关 sQGP 和强相互作用其他方面的一些基本问题仍然存在。为了解决这个问题，ALICE 合作组织提出了对其探测器的重大升级，称为 ALICE 3。此次升级考虑的子探测器之一是 μ 子识别探测器 (MID)，其目的是为研究重离子碰撞中粲素和奇异强子的产生做出贡献。虽然基线设计由放置在圆柱形磁性铁吸收器周围的基于塑料闪烁体的室组成，但 MID 正在评估不同的探测器技术，包括多线比例室。本论文介绍了基于 FNAL-NICADD 闪烁体棒、Kuraray 光纤和 Hamamatsu SiPM 的两个 MID 原型的结果，其特征是在 CERN 质子同步加速器的测试光束中使用 3 GeV/c muon 和 pion 富集光束。将讨论使用机器学习技术获得的μ子效率以及强子抑制。

articles.title: Axis-selective AC magnetic-field imaging in the tens-of-megahertz regime using RF-dressed continuous-wave scanning NV magnetometry
articles.title_zh: 使用射频连续波扫描 NV 磁力测量在数十兆赫范围内进行轴选择性交流磁场成像
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.17366v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Spatially resolved magnetic-field imaging reveals material properties and local currents in microelectronic devices. Conventional pulsed scanning nitrogen-vacancy (NV) magnetometry (SNVM) faces increasingly stringent microwave (MW) pulse-control requirements for detecting radio-frequency (RF) magnetic fields at frequencies ranging from tens to hundreds of megahertz. To address this challenge, we implement an RF-dressed continuous-wave (CW) sensing scheme for SNVM and demonstrate AC magnetic-field imaging at 33.5 MHz. The method exploits electron-spin double resonance in the NV spin-1 three-level system: the target RF magnetic field coherently couples two spin eigenstates, forming RF-dressed states whose splittings are detected in continuous-wave electron-spin double resonance (CW-ESDR) spectra under continuous laser, MW, and RF excitation. This approach avoids short, high-power MW pulses and synchronization between the RF field and a pulsed sensing sequence. Using an NV-ensemble diamond probe integrated with an atomic force microscope (AFM), we image the Oersted field of an RF-driven L-shaped microcircuit. Successively selecting three crystallographic NV axes by static bias-field control yields maps of RF magnetic-field projection magnitudes, with distinct distributions qualitatively reproduced by Biot-Savart calculations. Transverse bias-field control also tunes the RF-coupled spin-state transition frequency from 14.4 to 89.3 MHz, as characterized by spectroscopy and Hamiltonian analysis, with RF-dressed resonances directly observed in CW-ESDR spectra at 89.3 MHz. Together with previous RF magnetic-field detection up to 632 MHz using the same RF-dressed CW sensing principle in a confocal NV setup, these results support extending AC magnetic-field imaging with SNVM toward the hundreds-of-megahertz regime and, with additional phase information, vector magnetic-field reconstruction.
articles.abstract_zh: 空间分辨磁场成像揭示了微电子器件中的材料特性和局部电流。传统的脉冲扫描氮空位 (NV) 磁力测定 (SNVM) 面临着日益严格的微波 (MW) 脉冲控制要求，用于检测频率范围为数十到数百兆赫的射频 (RF) 磁场。为了应对这一挑战，我们为 SNVM 实施了 RF 连续波 (CW) 传感方案，并演示了 33.5 MHz 的交流磁场成像。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 空间分辨磁场成像揭示了微电子器件中的材料特性和局部电流。传统的脉冲扫描氮空位 (NV) 磁力测定 (SNVM) 面临着日益严格的微波 (MW) 脉冲控制要求，用于检测频率范围为数十到数百兆赫的射频 (RF) 磁场。为了应对这一挑战，我们为 SNVM 实施了 RF 连续波 (CW) 传感方案，并演示了 33.5 MHz 的交流磁场成像。该方法利用了 NV spin-1 三能级系统中的电子自旋双共振：目标 RF 磁场相干耦合两个自旋本征态，形成 RF 修饰态，其分裂可在连续激光、MW 和 RF 激励下的连续波电子自旋双共振 (CW-ESDR) 光谱中检测到。这种方法避免了短的高功率微波脉冲以及射频场和脉冲传感序列之间的同步。使用与原子力显微镜 (AFM) 集成的 NV 系综金刚石探针，我们对射频驱动的 L 形微电路的奥斯特场进行成像。通过静态偏置场控制连续选择三个晶体 NV 轴，生成 RF 磁场投影幅度图，并通过 Biot-Savart 计算定性再现不同的分布。横向偏置场控制还将 RF 耦合自旋态跃迁频率从 14.4 MHz 调整到 89.3 MHz，如光谱学和哈密顿分析所表征，在 89.3 MHz 的 CW-ESDR 光谱中直接观察到 RF 修饰谐振。与之前在共焦 NV 设置中使用相同的 RF 连续波传感原理进行的高达 632 MHz 的 RF 磁场检测相结合，这些结果支持使用 SNVM 将交流磁场成像扩展到数百兆赫范围，并通过附加相位信息进行矢量磁场重建。

articles.title: Turbulence at the Correlation Scale as the Driver of Magnetic Reconnection: In Situ Observations and Kinetic Simulations
articles.title_zh: 相关尺度的湍流作为磁重联的驱动因素：原位观测和动力学模拟
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.17450v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study the statistical properties of magnetic reconnection using high-resolution in situ observations from the Magnetospheric Multiscale (MMS) Mission in the terrestrial magnetosheath and kinetic particle-in-cell (PIC) simulations. For the first time, using in situ observations, we find that the statistics of upstream reconnecting fields in a macroscopic turbulent plasma system are closely linked with the amplitude of turbulence at the correlation scales. These results are further confirmed with fully kinetic plasma turbulence simulations. Consequently, the average magnetic reconnection rates and associated heating rates, determined through the upstream fields, could become orders of magnitude higher than those predicted using the turbulence amplitude at the dissipation scale. We then use a simplified model of the heating of reconnection exhausts to estimate the ratio of this reconnection heating rate to the overall energy cascade rate due to turbulence. Estimates from the PIC simulations and the MMS observations yield a ratio on the order of 1/5, indicating that direct reconnection heating is playing a substantial role in dissipating the turbulent fluctuations.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们利用地面磁层多尺度（MMS）任务的高分辨率原位观测和细胞内动力学粒子（PIC）模拟来研究磁重联的统计特性。我们首次利用原位观测发现宏观湍流等离子体系统中上游重连场的统计数据与相关尺度上的湍流振幅密切相关。 These results are further confirmed with fully kinetic plasma turbulence simulations.因此，通过上游场确定的平均磁重联率和相关加热率可能比使用耗散规模的湍流幅度预测的值高出几个数量级。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们利用地面磁层多尺度（MMS）任务的高分辨率原位观测和细胞内动力学粒子（PIC）模拟来研究磁重联的统计特性。我们首次利用原位观测发现宏观湍流等离子体系统中上游重连场的统计数据与相关尺度上的湍流振幅密切相关。 These results are further confirmed with fully kinetic plasma turbulence simulations.因此，通过上游场确定的平均磁重联率和相关加热率可能比使用耗散规模的湍流幅度预测的值高出几个数量级。然后，我们使用重新连接排气加热的简化模型来估计该重新连接加热速率与由于湍流引起的总体能量级联速率的比率。 PIC 模拟和 MMS 观测的估计得出的比率约为 1/5，表明直接重联加热在耗散湍流波动中发挥着重要作用。

articles.title: Horizontal component of the ion drag force in a plasma sheath
articles.title_zh: 等离子体鞘中离子曳力的水平分量
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.17601v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The ion drag force is responsible for the underlying physics behind many important phenomena in complex (dusty) plasma, such as void formation, particle alignment in an ion flow, shadow-like attraction between the particles, dust clouds rotation in the presence of a magnetic field etc. In this paper, we investigate the ion drag force acting on particles levitating near the sheath edge of a capacitively coupled discharge in xenon. In particular, we calculate the radial (horizontal) component of the ion drag force directed parallel to the lower electrode above which the particles levitate. The calculation is based on the actual information about the ion flow, which is directly obtained using Laser Induced Fluorescence. The calculated horizontal component is comparable in magnitude to the vertical one, which pushes the particles toward the electrode surface, and is higher than previously expected. This unexpected finding must be taken into account in future research. The very possibility of the measurements we report opens the door for detailed studies of dusty plasma phenomena governed by ions and their flows.
articles.abstract_zh: 离子曳力是复杂（尘埃）等离子体中许多重要现象背后的基本物理原理，例如空隙形成、离子流中的粒子排列、粒子之间的阴影般的吸引力、磁场存在下的尘埃云旋转等。在本文中，我们研究了作用在氙气中电容耦合放电的鞘边缘附近悬浮的粒子上的离子曳力。特别是，我们计算平行于粒子悬浮在其上方的下电极的离子曳力的径向（水平）分量。该计算基于有关离子流的实际信息，该信息是使用激光诱导荧光直接获得的。计算出的水平分量在大小上与垂直分量相当，垂直分量将颗粒推向电极表面，并且高于之前的预期。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 离子曳力是复杂（尘埃）等离子体中许多重要现象背后的基本物理原理，例如空隙形成、离子流中的粒子排列、粒子之间的阴影般的吸引力、磁场存在下的尘埃云旋转等。在本文中，我们研究了作用在氙气中电容耦合放电的鞘边缘附近悬浮的粒子上的离子曳力。特别是，我们计算平行于粒子悬浮在其上方的下电极的离子曳力的径向（水平）分量。该计算基于有关离子流的实际信息，该信息是使用激光诱导荧光直接获得的。计算出的水平分量在大小上与垂直分量相当，垂直分量将颗粒推向电极表面，并且高于之前的预期。在未来的研究中必须考虑到这一意外发现。我们报告的测量的可能性为详细研究由离子及其流动控制的尘埃等离子体现象打开了大门。

articles.title: Global saddle selection and exact absolute-instability boundaries for convection in porous media with throughflow
articles.title_zh: 通流多孔介质中对流的全局鞍点选择和精确的绝对不稳定边界
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.17614v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In the Darcy-Prats problem, horizontal throughflow leaves the temporal onset of convection unchanged but raises the heating required for a localized disturbance to grow at a fixed point. The saddle equations give five candidates, but only the saddles reached by deformation of the Fourier contour contribute to the growth. For Ra>π², Pe>0 we prove that the same off-axis pair contributes throughout the domain: no Stokes transition can change its contribution. Its growth gives a unique analytic absolute threshold, first reached by the lowest vertical mode. Rescaling transfers the selection to Forchheimer drag, transverse rolls of a power-law fluid, anisotropic permeability, an open upper boundary and a vertical magnetic field. A shift of the same growth function accounts for interphase heat exchange in a model of metallic foam. At prescribed throughflow the threshold increases strictly with either resistance coefficient. In particular, a vertical magnetic field raises the absolute threshold at fixed Péclet number. Tabulated thresholds check the reduction. Algebraic elimination gives the boundary polynomial, and frequency recovery selects its physical branch. At the Darcy level the selected saddles trace an arc of the elliptic curve 11a3, a degeneration of a genus-two family at nonzero shifted levels. Series inversion on this arc gives an integer weak-throughflow series and an all-order strong-throughflow expansion. Rational certificates establish the exact convergence radii of both series on the selected sheets.
articles.abstract_zh: 在达西-普拉茨问题中，水平通流使对流的时间起始保持不变，但增加了局部扰动在固定点增长所需的热量。鞍座方程给出了五个候选方程，但只有通过傅里叶轮廓变形达到的鞍座才对增长做出贡献。对于 Ra>π²，Pe>0，我们证明相同的离轴对在整个域中做出贡献：没有斯托克斯跃迁可以改变其贡献。它的增长给出了一个独特的分析绝对阈值，首先由最低垂直模式达到。重新缩放将选择转移到 Forchheimer 阻力、幂律流体的横向滚动、各向异性磁导率、开放上边界和垂直磁场。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在达西-普拉茨问题中，水平通流使对流的时间起始保持不变，但增加了局部扰动在固定点增长所需的热量。鞍座方程给出了五个候选方程，但只有通过傅里叶轮廓变形达到的鞍座才对增长做出贡献。对于 Ra>π²，Pe>0，我们证明相同的离轴对在整个域中做出贡献：没有斯托克斯跃迁可以改变其贡献。它的增长给出了一个独特的分析绝对阈值，首先由最低垂直模式达到。重新缩放将选择转移到 Forchheimer 阻力、幂律流体的横向滚动、各向异性磁导率、开放上边界和垂直磁场。相同增长函数的转变解释了金属泡沫模型中的相间热交换。在规定的流量下，阈值严格随任一阻力系数增加。特别是，垂直磁场提高了固定佩克莱数处的绝对阈值。列表阈值检查减少情况。代数消去给出边界多项式，频率恢复选择其物理分支。在达西能级，所选鞍点沿着椭圆曲线 11a3 的弧线，即非零位移能级下属二族的退化。该弧上的级数反演给出了整数弱通流级数和全阶强通流展开。有理证明在选定的板材上建立了两个系列的精确收敛半径。

articles.title: Learning and Generating Time Trajectories of Multidimensional Stochastic Processes
articles.title_zh: 学习和生成多维随机过程的时间轨迹
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.17711v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We present a multidimensional statistics-informed neural network (SINN) framework for learning and generating trajectories of multicomponent stochastic processes. SINN is built upon a deterministic recurrent neural network that takes streams of white-noise sequences as input and generates ensembles of stochastic trajectories whose statistical properties match those of the underlying stochastic dynamics. While SINN has been demonstrated for various one-dimensional non-Markovian processes, extending it to multidimensional processes is essential for real-world applications. Here, we present key developments toward this goal. First, because direct estimation of multivariate probability density functions (PDFs) becomes computationally challenging with increasing dimension, we represent joint-distribution information using collections of one-dimensional PDFs constructed from linear combinations of the process components. Second, to accommodate the larger set of statistical objectives required to characterize multidimensional processes, we adopt a self-adaptive loss-balancing strategy that dynamically weights the components of the total loss function. Third, we introduce a reference-normalized validation framework that interprets statistical discrepancies relative to the finite-sample variability between independent target ensembles. We also investigate the role of the input white-noise dimension in SINN performance. We evaluate the proposed approach using a Langevin benchmark based on two coupled Duffing oscillators and further demonstrate its applicability to the Langevin dynamics of the Fermi-Pasta-Ulam chain and kinetic Monte Carlo simulations of a lattice Lotka-Volterra model. Our results demonstrate that the multidimensional SINN framework provides a practical approach for modeling multidimensional stochastic dynamics.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们提出了一个多维统计信息神经网络（SINN）框架，用于学习和生成多分量随机过程的轨迹。 SINN 建立在确定性循环神经网络的基础上，该网络将白噪声序列流作为输入，并生成随机轨迹的集合，其统计特性与基础随机动力学的统计特性相匹配。虽然 SINN 已被证明适用于各种一维非马尔可夫过程，但将其扩展到多维过程对于实际应用至关重要。在这里，我们介绍实现这一目标的关键进展。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们提出了一个多维统计信息神经网络（SINN）框架，用于学习和生成多分量随机过程的轨迹。 SINN 建立在确定性循环神经网络的基础上，该网络将白噪声序列流作为输入，并生成随机轨迹的集合，其统计特性与基础随机动力学的统计特性相匹配。虽然 SINN 已被证明适用于各种一维非马尔可夫过程，但将其扩展到多维过程对于实际应用至关重要。在这里，我们介绍实现这一目标的关键进展。首先，由于随着维数的增加，多元概率密度函数 (PDF) 的直接估计在计算上变得具有挑战性，因此我们使用由过程组件的线性组合构造的一维 PDF 的集合来表示联合分布信息。其次，为了适应表征多维过程所需的更大的统计目标，我们采用了自适应损失平衡策略，该策略动态地对总损失函数的各个组成部分进行加权。第三，我们引入了一个参考归一化验证框架，该框架解释相对于独立目标集合之间的有限样本变异性的统计差异。我们还研究了输入白噪声维度在 SINN 性能中的作用。我们使用基于两个耦合 Duffing 振荡器的 Langevin 基准来评估所提出的方法，并进一步证明其对 Fermi-Pasta-Ulam 链的 Langevin 动力学和格子 Lotka-Volterra 模型的动力学蒙特卡洛模拟的适用性。我们的结果表明，多维 SINN 框架为多维随机动力学建模提供了一种实用的方法。

articles.title: Tracing Uncertainties of Extreme El Niño Prediction to Mesoscale Ocean Currents
articles.title_zh: 追踪极端厄尔尼诺现象对中尺度洋流预测的不确定性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.17854v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The predictability of the El Niño-Southern Oscillation (ENSO) has historically been linked to large-scale errors in models' initial conditions such as heat content and surface wind stress. Here we demonstrate that these slowly evolving errors may ultimately originate from mesoscale errors in initial oceanic states that are common in current models and ocean observation systems. This hidden source of ENSO forecast uncertainty, in terms of mesoscale ocean-current errors, is convincingly exposed by the conditional nonlinear optimal perturbation (CNOP) method applied to a differentiable ocean AI model. The CNOP-identified most influential current errors are strongly event-dependent. For the 1997/98 El Niño, the initial current errors in the eastern Pacific results in the largest forecast error through locally suppressing original subsurface warming. For the 2015/16 event, the dominate error originates from the western Pacific, which reorganizes upper ocean temperature structure and affects the eastern Pacific through the equatorial waveguide. Further analysis reveals that these current errors perturb mesoscale eddy count and eddy kinetic energy triggering large-scale temperature errors that hinder El Niño development. The timing of the maximum growth rate of the obtained CNOP error is well aligned with the spring predictability barrier of ENSO, and the error structures are reflected in simulated analysis errors caused by unresolved mesoscale currents. These findings extend the potential source of ENSO predictability beyond large-scale thermal signals, reveal for the first time an uncharted route of ENSO forecast failure, and provide an important physical basis for targeted ocean observations and data assimilation in the future.
articles.abstract_zh: 厄尔尼诺-南方涛动（ENSO）的可预测性历来与模型初始条件（例如热含量和表面风应力）的大规模误差有关。在这里，我们证明这些缓慢演变的误差最终可能源于当前模型和海洋观测系统中常见的初始海洋状态的中尺度误差。应用于可微分海洋人工智能模型的条件非线性最优扰动 (CNOP) 方法令人信服地揭示了 ENSO 预报不确定性的隐藏来源（中尺度洋流误差）。 CNOP 确定的最具影响力的当前错误与事件密切相关。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 厄尔尼诺-南方涛动（ENSO）的可预测性历来与模型初始条件（例如热含量和表面风应力）的大规模误差有关。在这里，我们证明这些缓慢演变的误差最终可能源于当前模型和海洋观测系统中常见的初始海洋状态的中尺度误差。应用于可微分海洋人工智能模型的条件非线性最优扰动 (CNOP) 方法令人信服地揭示了 ENSO 预报不确定性的隐藏来源（中尺度洋流误差）。 CNOP 确定的最具影响力的当前错误与事件密切相关。对于1997/98年厄尔尼诺现象，东太平洋的初始海流误差通过局部抑制原始地下变暖而导致最大的预报误差。对于2015/16事件，主要误差来自西太平洋，它重组了上层海洋温度结构，并通过赤道波导影响东太平洋。进一步分析表明，这些电流误差扰乱了中尺度涡流计数和涡流动能，引发了大规模的温度误差，阻碍了厄尔尼诺现象的发展。所获得的 CNOP 误差最大增长率的时间与 ENSO 的弹簧可预测性障碍非常一致，并且误差结构反映在由未解析的中尺度电流引起的模拟分析误差中。这些发现将ENSO可预测性的潜在来源扩展到大规模热信号之外，首次揭示了ENSO预报失败的未知途径，并为未来有针对性的海洋观测和资料同化提供了重要的物理基础。

articles.title: Antihelical Edge States in Photonic Metacrystals
articles.title_zh: 光子超晶体中的反螺旋边缘态
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.17877v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Antihelical edge states represent a gapless form of boundary transport in which modes with opposite spin counterpropagate along a given boundary, while modes sharing the same spin propagate in the same direction on opposite boundaries. Here we show that such states arise naturally within a modified Kane-Mele framework realized in an electromagnetic-dual photonic metacrystal with staggered bianisotropy. Reversing the spin-dependent next-nearest-neighbor coupling on one sublattice reorganizes the bulk spectrum into a spin-polarized Dirac semimetal characterized by spin-dependent energy shifts of the Dirac cones rather than a bulk gap. This bulk reorganization generates tilted edge-mode dispersions in zigzag ribbons and gives rise to antihelical edge transport coexisting with bulk states. Full-wave simulations confirm the corresponding bulk and edge behaviors. Extending the analysis to finite geometries, simulations further reveal discrete corner-localized modes. A realistic design based on split-ring metaatoms is proposed to realize the required staggered bianisotropy and spin-dependent energy shifts of the Dirac cones. Furthermore, we show that the tensorial freedom of the bianisotropic constitutive relations enables continuous manipulation of the electromagnetic pseudospin basis while preserving the antihelical boundary transport. These results provide a practical route for engineering unconventional gapless boundary transport in photonic Dirac systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 反螺旋边缘态代表边界输运的无间隙形式，其中具有相反自旋的模式沿着给定边界反向传播，而共享相同自旋的模式在相反边界上以相同方向传播。在这里，我们表明，这种状态在具有交错双各向异性的电磁双光子超晶体中实现的改进的 Kane-Mele 框架内自然出现。反转一个亚晶格上的自旋相关的次近邻耦合将体光谱重新组织成自旋极化的狄拉克半金属，其特征是狄拉克锥体的自旋相关的能量变化而不是体能隙。这种块体重组在锯齿形带中产生倾斜边缘模式色散，并引起与块体状态共存的反螺旋边缘输运。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 反螺旋边缘态代表边界输运的无间隙形式，其中具有相反自旋的模式沿着给定边界反向传播，而共享相同自旋的模式在相反边界上以相同方向传播。在这里，我们表明，这种状态在具有交错双各向异性的电磁双光子超晶体中实现的改进的 Kane-Mele 框架内自然出现。反转一个亚晶格上的自旋相关的次近邻耦合将体光谱重新组织成自旋极化的狄拉克半金属，其特征是狄拉克锥体的自旋相关的能量变化而不是体能隙。这种块体重组在锯齿形带中产生倾斜边缘模式色散，并引起与块体状态共存的反螺旋边缘输运。全波模拟证实了相应的体和边缘行为。将分析扩展到有限几何形状，模拟进一步揭示了离散角局部模式。提出了一种基于裂环元原子的现实设计，以实现狄拉克锥所需的交错双各向异性和自旋相关的能量转移。此外，我们表明，双各向异性本构关系的张量自由度使得能够连续操纵电磁赝自旋基础，同时保留反螺旋边界输运。这些结果为光子狄拉克系统中的非常规无间隙边界传输工程提供了一条实用途径。

articles.title: A Necessary and Sufficient Condition for Complete TE/TM Separability in Fully Anisotropic Waveguides
articles.title_zh: 全各向异性波导中TE/TM完全分离的充要条件
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.17888v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: A necessary and sufficient condition is established for complete transverse-electric/transverse-magnetic (TE/TM) separability in waveguides homogeneously filled with a fully anisotropic and lossless medium. The permittivity and permeability tensors are Hermitian positive-definite and may contain nonzero transverse--longitudinal coupling terms. Complete TE/TM separation occurs if and only if the transverse permeability block is proportional to the transpose of the transverse permittivity block and the corresponding transverse--longitudinal coupling vectors satisfy the same proportionality relation after complex conjugation. The longitudinal constitutive entries remain independent apart from positive definiteness. The condition is derived directly from the source-free Maxwell equations, and independent analyses of the TE and TM modes lead to the same material relation. Since no boundary condition enters the derivation, the criterion is independent of the boundary type. Full-vector waveguide mode analyses using our in-house programs for perfect-electric-conductor and Bloch-periodic waveguides, with material tensors satisfying and violating the condition, agree with the theoretical results.
articles.abstract_zh: 建立了均匀填充完全各向异性和无损介质的波导中完全横向电/横向磁（TE/TM）可分离性的充分必要条件。介电常数和磁导率张量是埃尔米特正定的，并且可以包含非零横向-纵向耦合项。当且仅当横向磁导率块与横向介电常数块的转置成正比并且相应的横向-纵向耦合矢量在复共轭后满足相同的比例关系时，才会发生完全的 TE/TM 分离。除了正定性之外，纵向本构条目保持独立。该条件直接从无源麦克斯韦方程导出，并且对 TE 和 TM 模式的独立分析得出相同的材料关系。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 建立了均匀填充完全各向异性和无损介质的波导中完全横向电/横向磁（TE/TM）可分离性的充分必要条件。介电常数和磁导率张量是埃尔米特正定的，并且可以包含非零横向-纵向耦合项。当且仅当横向磁导率块与横向介电常数块的转置成正比并且相应的横向-纵向耦合矢量在复共轭后满足相同的比例关系时，才会发生完全的 TE/TM 分离。除了正定性之外，纵向本构条目保持独立。该条件直接从无源麦克斯韦方程导出，并且对 TE 和 TM 模式的独立分析得出相同的材料关系。由于没有边界条件进入推导，因此准则与边界类型无关。使用我们的完美电导体和布洛赫周期波导的内部程序进行的全矢量波导模式分析，在材料张量满足和违反条件的情况下，与理论结果一致。

articles.title: Flow structure, heat transport, and dissipation in vertical-field magnetoconvection at similar Reynolds numbers
articles.title_zh: 相似雷诺数下垂直场磁对流中的流动结构、热传输和耗散
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.17979v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We employ direct numerical simulations to investigate the effect of a vertical magnetic field on the flow structures, heat transport, and dissipation rates in Rayleigh--Bénard convection of a low-Prandtl-number fluid (Pr = 0.025) at an approximately fixed Reynolds number (Re approx 880), maintained by adjusting the Rayleigh number to compensate for the Lorentz force. As the Hartmann number increases, the flow becomes more anisotropic, which strengthens the positive convective heat fluxes relative to the negative ones and thereby raises the Nusselt number, accompanied by a thinning of the thermal boundary layers. The total viscous and thermal dissipation rates are dominated by the boundary layers, whereas the total magnetic dissipation rate is dominated by the bulk. With increasing Hartmann number, the boundary-layer fraction of the viscous and magnetic dissipation rates increases, whereas that of the thermal dissipation computed from the temperature fluctuations decreases, owing to the suppression of temperature fluctuations near the boundary layers. The dissipation rates deviate from log-normality and are well described by stretched exponential distributions, whose tails become more extended with increasing Hartmann number.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们采用直接数值模拟来研究垂直磁场对低普朗特数流体 (Pr = 0.025) 的瑞利-贝纳德对流中的流动结构、热传输和耗散率的影响，雷诺数近似固定（Re 约为 880），通过调整瑞利数来补偿洛伦兹力来维持。随着哈特曼数的增加，流动变得更加各向异性，这增强了相对于负对流热通量的正对流热通量，从而提高了努塞尔数，同时热边界层变薄。总粘性和热耗散率由边界层决定，而总磁耗散率由体积决定。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们采用直接数值模拟来研究垂直磁场对低普朗特数流体 (Pr = 0.025) 的瑞利-贝纳德对流中的流动结构、热传输和耗散率的影响，雷诺数近似固定（Re 约为 880），通过调整瑞利数来补偿洛伦兹力来维持。随着哈特曼数的增加，流动变得更加各向异性，这增强了相对于负对流热通量的正对流热通量，从而提高了努塞尔数，同时热边界层变薄。总粘性和热耗散率由边界层决定，而总磁耗散率由体积决定。随着哈特曼数的增加，粘性和磁耗散率的边界层部分增加，而由于边界层附近的温度波动受到抑制，由温度波动计算的热耗散部分减少。耗散率偏离对数正态性，并且可以通过拉伸指数分布很好地描述，其尾部随着哈特曼数的增加而变得更加延长。

articles.title: Optical Representation Neural Networks Enabled by Weakly Supervised Learning
articles.title_zh: 弱监督学习支持的光学表示神经网络
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.18045v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Diffractive optical neural networks (ONNs) show remarkable promise in high-speed and energy-efficient optical computing. However, most existing ONNs are optimized to reproduce predefined output intensity distributions, with the desired optical responses explicitly specified before training. Here, we introduce optical representation neural networks (ORNNs) enabled by coarse-grained weak supervision. Using handwritten Devanagari, Arabic, and English characters as three semantic groups, a modified contrastive objective encourages samples from the same script to cluster into similar optical representations. Remarkably, ORNNs improve the classification accuracy by approximately 9% over conventional supervised ONNs, while requiring only around 18% of the training steps to reach a stable test accuracy of 84.5%. These features can be selectively interpreted using corresponding semantic decoders. Building on this concept, we further realized semantic optical encryption with electronic neural network (ENN) decryption using experimentally acquired representations from a single-layer diffractive network fabricated by two-photon polymerization lithography (TPL). Here, we combine information from different scripts into a mixed optical ciphertext that is then first optically classified before being decrypted with a matched ENN. This work broadens the training paradigm of ONNs by coupling upstream optical representation learning with downstream task-specific decoding, opening new avenues for optical information processing.
articles.abstract_zh: 衍射光学神经网络 (ONN) 在高速、节能的光学计算领域展现出非凡的前景。然而，大多数现有的 ONN 都经过优化，可重现预定义的输出强度分布，并在训练前明确指定所需的光学响应。在这里，我们介绍了通过粗粒度弱监督实现的光学表示神经网络（ORNN）。使用手写天城文、阿拉伯文和英文字符作为三个语义组，修改后的对比目标鼓励来自同一脚本的样本聚集成相似的光学表示。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 衍射光学神经网络 (ONN) 在高速、节能的光学计算领域展现出非凡的前景。然而，大多数现有的 ONN 都经过优化，可重现预定义的输出强度分布，并在训练前明确指定所需的光学响应。在这里，我们介绍了通过粗粒度弱监督实现的光学表示神经网络（ORNN）。使用手写天城文、阿拉伯文和英文字符作为三个语义组，修改后的对比目标鼓励来自同一脚本的样本聚集成相似的光学表示。值得注意的是，与传统的监督 ONN 相比，ORNN 的分类精度提高了约 9%，同时仅需要约 18% 的训练步骤即可达到 84.5% 的稳定测试精度。这些特征可以使用相应的语义解码器选择性地解释。在此概念的基础上，我们利用通过双光子聚合光刻（TPL）制造的单层衍射网络实验获得的表示，进一步实现了通过电子神经网络（ENN）解密的语义光学加密。在这里，我们将来自不同脚本的信息组合成混合光学密文，然后首先对其进行光学分类，然后使用匹配的 ENN 进行解密。这项工作通过将上游光学表示学习与下游特定任务解码相结合，拓宽了 ONN 的训练范式，为光学信息处理开辟了新途径。

articles.title: Finite-Larmor-radius vortex interaction from δf to full-f gyrofluid dynamics
articles.title_zh: 从δf到全f回旋流体动力学的有限拉莫半径涡流相互作用
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.18093v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study finite-size electrostatic gyrofluid vortex pairs in a two-dimensional isothermal model, focusing on finite-Larmor-radius effects and the transition from local perturbative to finite-amplitude full-distribution dynamics. An effective response kernel based on Padé ion gyroaveraging regularizes the short-range Euler interaction on the Larmor-radius scale while preserving its logarithmic far field, yielding a finite- core prediction for the orbital frequency. Local-model scans show that increasing the ion temperature relative to the electron temperature enhances gyrospinning and filamentation and drives a separation-dependent transition from merger to long-lived co-rotation. Long-wavelength simulations reproduce the predicted finite-Larmor- radius-induced dip in orbital angular frequency, corresponding to a pronounced slowdown of the vortex-pair rotation. For the full-distribution regime, we introduce a quasi-neutrality-consistent initialization that reconstructs the ion gyrocenter density from prescribed electron density and electrostatic potential. It recovers the local limit at small amplitude, whereas finite-amplitude simulations reveal additional mean-density polarization vorticity, delayed or arrested merger, and a loss of density- vorticity sign symmetry already in the cold-ion full-f system. An independent sign scan of density and vorticity then shows how this nonlinear NOB asymmetry combines with the local warm-ion FLR symmetry breaking identified in earlier δf vortex studies; for warm ions, Padé-based arbitrary-wavelength NOB and NOB+LWL polarization additionally produce distinct morphologies and trajectories. These results demonstrate that nonlinear density-dependent polarization and FLR physics form separate but coupled mechanisms that can qualitatively alter elementary vortex interactions in two-dimensional gyrofluid dynamics.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们研究二维等温模型中的有限尺寸静电陀螺流体涡流对，重点关注有限拉莫尔半径效应以及从局部微扰到有限幅度全分布动力学的转变。基于帕德离子陀螺平均的有效响应核在拉莫尔半径尺度上正则化短程欧拉相互作用，同时保留其对数远场，从而产生轨道频率的有限核心预测。局部模型扫描表明，增加相对于电子温度的离子温度会增强陀螺旋转和丝状化，并驱动从合并到长寿命共同旋转的分离依赖性转变。长波长模拟再现了预测的有限拉莫尔半径引起的轨道角频率下降，对应于涡旋对旋转的明显减慢。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们研究二维等温模型中的有限尺寸静电陀螺流体涡流对，重点关注有限拉莫尔半径效应以及从局部微扰到有限幅度全分布动力学的转变。基于帕德离子陀螺平均的有效响应核在拉莫尔半径尺度上正则化短程欧拉相互作用，同时保留其对数远场，从而产生轨道频率的有限核心预测。局部模型扫描表明，增加相对于电子温度的离子温度会增强陀螺旋转和丝状化，并驱动从合并到长寿命共同旋转的分离依赖性转变。长波长模拟再现了预测的有限拉莫尔半径引起的轨道角频率下降，对应于涡旋对旋转的明显减慢。对于全分布体系，我们引入了准中性一致的初始化，该初始化根据规定的电子密度和静电势重建离子回转中心密度。它在小振幅下恢复了局部极限，而有限振幅模拟揭示了冷离子全f系统中已经存在的额外平均密度极化涡度、延迟或阻止合并以及密度涡度符号对称性的损失。然后，密度和涡度的独立符号扫描显示了这种非线性 NOB 不对称性如何与早期 δf 涡旋研究中发现的局部热离子 FLR 对称性破缺相结合；对于暖离子，基于 Padé 的任意波长 NOB 和 NOB+LWL 偏振还产生不同的形态和轨迹。这些结果表明，非线性密度相关偏振和 FLR 物理形成独立但耦合的机制，可以定性地改变二维陀螺流体动力学中的基本涡旋相互作用。

articles.title: CGTransformer: A Topology-Aware Autoregressive Framework for Crystal Generation and Inverse Design
articles.title_zh: CGTransformer：用于晶体生成和逆设计的拓扑感知自回归框架
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.18303v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Autoregressive language models offer a unified route to crystal generation and inverse design, but their performance depends on how periodic structures are serialized. Symmetry equivalent and closely related crystals can receive different atomic orders under coordinate-based serialization, introducing variability unrelated to their structural connectivity. Here, we present CGTransformer (Crystal Graph Transformer), an autoregressive generative framework that addresses this challenge via a graph-embedded sorting strategy. Using quotientgraph topology and barycentric embeddings, Element Symmetry Graph (ESG) converts periodic crystal networks into topology-guided one-dimensional sequences that retain key local and symmetry-related structural information. CGTransformer achieves high generation validity and the highest single shot crystal structure prediction (CSP) match rate among the compared MP-20 baselines (63.24%), while same backbone comparisons show improved structure recovery over coordinate-based ordering. Furthermore, we demonstrate property-conditioned inverse design for wide-bandgap semiconductors, where ESG achieves a much higher stable, unique and novel (S.U.N.) rate and stronger target-property alignment than the coordinate-based baseline. These results establish topology-guided sequence construction as an effective route to improving crystal generation and property-directed design at fixed model capacity.
articles.abstract_zh: 自回归语言模型提供了晶体生成和逆向设计的统一途径，但其性能取决于周期性结构的序列化方式。对称等效且密切相关的晶体可以在基于坐标的序列化下接收不同的原子顺序，从而引入与其结构连接性无关的可变性。在这里，我们提出了 CGTransformer（Crystal Graph Transformer），这是一种自回归生成框架，它通过图嵌入排序策略来解决这一挑战。使用商图拓扑和重心嵌入，元素对称图 (ESG) 将周期性晶体网络转换为拓扑引导的一维序列，保留关键的局部和对称相关的结构信息。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 自回归语言模型提供了晶体生成和逆向设计的统一途径，但其性能取决于周期性结构的序列化方式。对称等效且密切相关的晶体可以在基于坐标的序列化下接收不同的原子顺序，从而引入与其结构连接性无关的可变性。在这里，我们提出了 CGTransformer（Crystal Graph Transformer），这是一种自回归生成框架，它通过图嵌入排序策略来解决这一挑战。使用商图拓扑和重心嵌入，元素对称图 (ESG) 将周期性晶体网络转换为拓扑引导的一维序列，保留关键的局部和对称相关的结构信息。 CGTransformer 在比较的 MP-20 基线中实现了高生成有效性和最高的单次晶体结构预测 (CSP) 匹配率 (63.24%)，而相同的主干比较表明，与基于坐标的排序相比，结构恢复得到了改善。此外，我们还演示了宽带隙半导体的属性条件逆向设计，其中 ESG 实现了比基于坐标的基线更高的稳定、独特和新颖 (S.U.N.) 率以及更强的目标属性对齐。这些结果将拓扑引导的序列构建确立为在固定模型容量下改进晶体生成和属性导向设计的有效途径。

articles.title: AI for Parameter Selection in Sample-based Quantum Diagonalization
articles.title_zh: 基于样本的量子对角化中参数选择的人工智能
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.18307v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Sample-based Quantum Diagonalization (SQD) methods provide a way to compute molecular ground-state energies, but their accuracy and runtime depend sensitively on configuration choices such as the subspace dimension, propagation timestep, and the allocation of a fixed sampling budget across circuits, for which no formal selection method exists. In this work, we explore whether oracle models can predict the quantum runtime and approximation error from the Hamiltonian and the candidate configuration. Using synthetic Hamiltonians with controllable spectral properties, we show that machine-learned models can map a Hamiltonian directly to the best-ranked configuration within a predefined grid for the SKQD algorithm, validated against classical Krylov propagation, achieving strong rank correlations between true and predicted error and runtime, Spearman ρ = 0.969 and ρ = 0.905, respectively. Extending the approach to 50 molecular Hamiltonians (20-50 qubits), with reference ground-state energies from classical calculations, we train regressors that predict the simulation error and runtime for a given molecule--configuration pair ahead of execution, and classifiers to distinguish, from 600 SqDRIFT quantum-hardware runs, whether a configuration achieves a ground-state energy within chemical accuracy (1.6×10⁻³ Ha approx 1 kcal/mol). For the molecular Hamiltonians, the models additionally provide an a priori feasibility and resource estimate, predicting whether a molecule can reach chemical accuracy on current hardware and at what runtime, thus correctly classifying held-out molecules at the molecule level, achieving balanced accuracy 61.8% in-distribution and 100% for five larger held-out molecules.
articles.abstract_zh: 基于样本的量子对角化（SQD）方法提供了一种计算分子基态能量的方法，但其准确性和运行时间敏感地取决于配置选择，例如子空间维度、传播时间步长以及跨电路的固定采样预算分配，而对于这些配置选择不存在正式的选择方法。在这项工作中，我们探索预言模型是否可以根据哈密顿量和候选配置预测量子运行时间和近似误差。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 基于样本的量子对角化（SQD）方法提供了一种计算分子基态能量的方法，但其准确性和运行时间敏感地取决于配置选择，例如子空间维度、传播时间步长以及跨电路的固定采样预算分配，而对于这些配置选择不存在正式的选择方法。在这项工作中，我们探索预言模型是否可以根据哈密顿量和候选配置预测量子运行时间和近似误差。使用具有可控谱特性的合成哈密顿量，我们表明机器学习模型可以将哈密顿量直接映射到 SKQD 算法预定义网格内的最佳排名配置，并针对经典 Krylov 传播进行验证，实现真实误差和预测误差与运行时间之间的强排名相关性，分别为 Spearman ρ = 0.969 和 ρ = 0.905。将方法扩展到 50 个分子哈密顿量（20-50 个量子位），利用经典计算中的参考基态能量，我们训练回归器，在执行之前预测给定分子配置对的模拟误差和运行时间，并训练分类器，以从 600 SqDRIFT 量子硬件运行中区分配置是否在化学精度内实现基态能量（1.6×10⁻³ Ha 约 1）千卡/摩尔）。对于分子哈密顿量，该模型还提供了先验可行性和资源估计，预测分子是否可以在当前硬件上以及运行时达到化学精度，从而在分子水平上正确分类保留分子，实现分布内 61.8% 的平衡精度和五个较大保留分子 100% 的平衡精度。

articles.title: A Multiscale Analysis of an Interplanetary Shock from IMAP, SOLAR-1, and the L1 Constellation to Earth
articles.title_zh: 来自IMAP、SOLAR-1和L1星座的行星际激波对地球的多尺度分析
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.18314v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Collisionless shocks are primary sites of particle acceleration throughout the Universe. Transient, mesoscale structures forming around these shocks influence their energy conversion efficiency, yet remain poorly observed at interplanetary (IP) shocks: spacecraft sample the shock transition briefly, and single-point measurements cannot disentangle temporal evolution from spatial structure. Here, we examine a fast, CME-driven IP shock of 2026 January 19, observed by IMAP, SOLAR-1, Wind, ACE, DSCOVR, and Aditya-L1 at L1 and by ARTEMIS and MMS near Earth, to determine its spatial and temporal structure. At MHD scales, a pre-existing solar wind flux tube is overtaken by the shock as it crosses the L1 fleet. This inflates the apparent magnetic compression ratio far beyond the ideal strong-shock limit of 4, showing that upstream and downstream intervals can sample different plasma and bias single-spacecraft estimates. At kinetic scales, IMAP and SOLAR-1, separated by only sim7 R_E (sim340 ion inertial lengths), sample the same foreshock yet record localized structures that differ measurably; these are the first candidate signatures of large-scale foreshock transients at an IP shock. Further upstream, shocklets appear hundreds of R_E ahead of the shock, consistent with steepening of ambient solar wind waves. Near Earth, the shock-to-flux-tube arrival lag increases to approximately six minutes, corresponding to a nominal sheath extension of sim50 R_E, indicating sheath expansion over sim200 R_E of propagation. Together, these results show that the IP shock, its foreshock, and its sheath evolve across multiple scales from L1 to Earth, underscoring the need for multipoint measurements to resolve the underlying processes.
articles.abstract_zh: 无碰撞激波是整个宇宙中粒子加速的主要场所。在这些激波周围形成的瞬态介观结构会影响它们的能量转换效率，但在行星际（IP）激波中仍然很少被观察到：航天器对激波转变进行短暂采样，单点测量无法将时间演化与空间结构分开。在这里，我们研究了 2026 年 1 月 19 日由 CME 驱动的快速 IP 冲击，由 L1 的 IMAP、SOLAR-1、Wind、ACE、DSCOVR 和 Aditya-L1 以及地球附近的 ARTEMIS 和 MMS 观测到，以确定其空间和时间结构。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 无碰撞激波是整个宇宙中粒子加速的主要场所。在这些激波周围形成的瞬态介观结构会影响它们的能量转换效率，但在行星际（IP）激波中仍然很少被观察到：航天器对激波转变进行短暂采样，单点测量无法将时间演化与空间结构分开。在这里，我们研究了 2026 年 1 月 19 日由 CME 驱动的快速 IP 冲击，由 L1 的 IMAP、SOLAR-1、Wind、ACE、DSCOVR 和 Aditya-L1 以及地球附近的 ARTEMIS 和 MMS 观测到，以确定其空间和时间结构。在 MHD 尺度上，预先存在的太阳风通量管在穿过 L1 舰队时会被激波超越。这使表观磁压缩比远远超出了理想的强震极限 4，表明上游和下游间隔可以采样不同的等离子体和偏置单航天器估计值。在动力学尺度上，IMAP 和 SOLAR-1 仅相隔 sim7 R_E（sim340 离子惯性长度），对相同的前震进行采样，但记录了明显不同的局部结构；这些是 IP 冲击时大规模前震瞬变的第一个候选特征。再往上游，冲击波出现在冲击波之前数百个 R_E，这与周围太阳风波的陡峭化一致。在地球附近，激波到磁通管的到达延迟增加到大约六分钟，对应于 sim50 R_E 的标称鞘层延伸，表明鞘层扩展超过了 sim200 R_E 的传播。总之，这些结果表明，IP 冲击、其前震及其鞘层在从 L1 到地球的多个尺度上演化，强调需要多点测量来解决潜在的过程。

articles.title: Bond Anharmonicity in a Caged Molecule Probed by Vibronic Core Spectroscopy
articles.title_zh: 通过电子振动核心光谱探测笼状分子中的键非和谐性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.18331v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: X-ray absorption spectroscopy and resonant inelastic X-ray scattering at the nitrogen K-edge show that the NequivN bond in N₂@C₆₀ is substantially more anharmonic than in free N₂, with the ground-state (X¹Σ_g⁺) anharmonic constant hbarωₑ xₑ a factor of two larger (3.8±0.3~meV versus sim 1.8~meV) despite an essentially unchanged harmonic frequency. The same enhancement is found across all three vibronic potentials accessible to the experiment---the electronic ground state, the core-excited intermediate state, and the spectator-decay final state---pointing to a common origin rather than an effect specific to one electronic configuration. High-level coupled-cluster calculations of the N₂@C₆₀ potential energy surface, however, find no significant change in anharmonicity upon encapsulation, ruling out a simple static distortion of the NequivN bonding potential by the fullerene cage. We propose instead that the dramatic increase in hbarωₑ xₑ above the gas-phase value -- which, taken literally, would imply an unphysical halving of the N₂ dissociation energy - reflects the breakdown of the single-molecule Morse description, as previously invoked to explain anomalous anharmonicities in N₂ clusters, and supported by the observation of shifts in the fullerene host's Raman modes.
articles.abstract_zh: X射线吸收光谱和氮K边的共振非弹性X射线散射表明，N2@C60中的NequivN键比自由N2中的非简声性大得多，尽管谐波频率基本不变，但基态(X1Σ_g⁺)非简常数hbarωₑxₑ大两倍(3.8±0.3~meV与sim 1.8~meV)。在实验可访问的所有三个电子振动势（电子基态、核心激发中间态和观察者衰变最终态）中发现了相同的增强，这指向共同的起源，而不是特定于一种电子配置的效应。
articles.abstract_zh_full: X射线吸收光谱和氮K边的共振非弹性X射线散射表明，N2@C60中的NequivN键比自由N2中的非简声性大得多，尽管谐波频率基本不变，但基态(X1Σ_g⁺)非简常数hbarωₑxₑ大两倍(3.8±0.3~meV与sim 1.8~meV)。在实验可访问的所有三个电子振动势（电子基态、核心激发中间态和观察者衰变最终态）中发现了相同的增强，这指向共同的起源，而不是特定于一种电子配置的效应。然而，对 N2@C60 势能面的高级耦合簇计算发现，封装后的非谐性没有显着变化，从而排除了富勒烯笼对 NequivN 键合势的简单静态扭曲。相反，我们提出 hbarωₑ xₑ 高于气相值的急剧增加——从字面上看，这意味着 N 2 解离能非物理性地减半——反映了单分子莫尔斯描述的崩溃，正如之前用来解释 N 2 簇中的异常非谐性的那样，并得到了对富勒烯主体拉曼模式变化的观察的支持。

articles.title: Radiation in relativistic plasmas via particle simulations
articles.title_zh: 通过粒子模拟相对论等离子体中的辐射
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.18332v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We investigate radiation in relativistic electron-proton isotropic plasmas using molecular dynamics, with velocity-dependent inertia, retarded interactions, and quantum-corrected pair potentials. Radiation spectra from the Liénard-Wiechert fields agree with analytical models. Successive scattering events suppress bremsstrahlung even at weak coupling, while jitter radiation becomes comparable at higher coupling for all resolved frequencies. This first-principles framework will help develop radiation models for suppression and field effects that are inaccessible in typical particle-in-cell methods.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们利用分子动力学研究相对论电子-质子各向同性等离子体中的辐射，具有速度相关的惯性、延迟的相互作用和量子校正的电对势。 Liénard-Wiechert 场的辐射光谱与分析模型一致。即使在弱耦合下，连续的散射事件也会抑制轫致辐射，而对于所有解析频率，抖动辐射在较高耦合下变得相当。这一第一性原理框架将有助于开发典型的细胞内粒子方法无法实现的抑制和场效应的辐射模型。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们利用分子动力学研究相对论电子-质子各向同性等离子体中的辐射，具有速度相关的惯性、延迟的相互作用和量子校正的电对势。 Liénard-Wiechert 场的辐射光谱与分析模型一致。即使在弱耦合下，连续的散射事件也会抑制轫致辐射，而对于所有解析频率，抖动辐射在较高耦合下变得相当。这一第一性原理框架将有助于开发典型的细胞内粒子方法无法实现的抑制和场效应的辐射模型。

articles.title: Enhanced Hyperspectral Nano-FTIR Imaging by Neural-Network-Based Processing of Multiple Signal Harmonics
articles.title_zh: 通过基于神经网络的多信号谐波处理增强超光谱纳米FTIR成像
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.18387v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Nano-FTIR spectroscopy combines infrared spectroscopy with nanometer-scale spatial resolution and enables hyperspectral nanoimaging. However, quantitative measurements typically rely on higher-harmonic near-field signals, which are largely background-free but suffer from low signal-to-noise ratio (SNR). Lower harmonics provide substantially higher SNR but contain significant background contributions that distort the near-field response and hinder quantitative analysis. Here, we introduce a cross-harmonic neural network (CHNN) that exploits the complementary information encoded in multiple harmonic channels to denoise third-harmonic hyperspectral data. Trained directly on experimental nano-FTIR datasets, the CHNN uses first- and second-harmonic spectra to improve the SNR of the third-harmonic response. Applied to a PMMA/PS polymer blend, it substantially reduces noise while preserving spectral features and nanoscale spatial contrast. Compared with conventional single-harmonic denoising using an autoencoder, the CHNN achieves superior noise suppression. These results demonstrate the potential of lower-harmonic signals for improving hyperspectral nano-FTIR imaging without increasing acquisition time.
articles.abstract_zh: 纳米 FTIR 光谱将红外光谱与纳米级空间分辨率相结合，实现高光谱纳米成像。然而，定量测量通常依赖于高次谐波近场信号，这些信号基本上没有背景，但信噪比 (SNR) 较低。较低的谐波可提供更高的信噪比，但包含显着的背景影响，会扭曲近场响应并阻碍定量分析。在这里，我们引入了一种交叉谐波神经网络（CHNN），它利用多个谐波通道中编码的互补信息来对三次谐波高光谱数据进行去噪。 CHNN 直接在实验纳米 FTIR 数据集上进行训练，使用一次和二次谐波光谱来提高三次谐波响应的 SNR。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 纳米 FTIR 光谱将红外光谱与纳米级空间分辨率相结合，实现高光谱纳米成像。然而，定量测量通常依赖于高次谐波近场信号，这些信号基本上没有背景，但信噪比 (SNR) 较低。较低的谐波可提供更高的信噪比，但包含显着的背景影响，会扭曲近场响应并阻碍定量分析。在这里，我们引入了一种交叉谐波神经网络（CHNN），它利用多个谐波通道中编码的互补信息来对三次谐波高光谱数据进行去噪。 CHNN 直接在实验纳米 FTIR 数据集上进行训练，使用一次和二次谐波光谱来提高三次谐波响应的 SNR。应用于 PMMA/PS 聚合物混合物时，它可以显着降低噪声，同时保留光谱特征和纳米级空间对比度。与使用自动编码器的传统单谐波去噪相比，CHNN 实现了优异的噪声抑制。这些结果证明了低谐波信号在不增加采集时间的情况下改善高光谱纳米 FTIR 成像的潜力。

articles.title: Generation of low-frequency flows by shear Alfvén waves in magnetohydrodynamics
articles.title_zh: 磁流体动力学中阿尔文剪切波产生低频流
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.18423v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Coherently forced, weak reduced-magnetohydrodynamic turbulence is studied in a uniform plasma to investigate the long-term nonlinear interactions of shear Alfvén waves. The 'pump waves' are chosen to model toroidal Alfvén eigenmodes, excited by suprathermal particles in magnetic fusion devices. Modes with zero frequency and no variation along the magnetic field are generated nonlinearly; these produce analogues of zonal flows and currents in a gradient-free system. This indicates that quasistationary flows can be generated by shear Alfvén waves in systems simpler than those previously considered, which relied on compressibility, finite-Larmor-radius effects, or complex geometry. The saturated amplitudes of the modes are found analytically and numerically as a function of pump-wave amplitude. This facilitates estimates of the critical amplitude above which toroidal Alfvén eigenmodes can generate sufficiently strong zonal flows to suppress microturbulence in the core of magnetic fusion devices. This threshold corresponds to magnetic fluctuations whose amplitude, relative to the background field, is comparable to ρₛₜₐᵣ ᵢ, the ion Larmor radius normalised to the minor radius of the device.
articles.abstract_zh: 研究均匀等离子体中的相干受力弱磁流体动力湍流，以研究剪切阿尔文波的长期非线性相互作用。选择“泵浦波”来模拟环形阿尔文本征模，由磁聚变装置中的超热粒子激发。非线性产生零频率且沿磁场无变化的模式；这些产生了无梯度系统中的纬向流动和电流的类似物。这表明，在比之前考虑的系统更简单的系统中，准静止流可以通过剪切阿尔芬波产生，这些系统依赖于可压缩性、有限拉莫尔半径效应或复杂的几何形状。模式的饱和振幅是通过分析和数值方法找到的，作为泵浦波振幅的函数。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 研究均匀等离子体中的相干受力弱磁流体动力湍流，以研究剪切阿尔文波的长期非线性相互作用。选择“泵浦波”来模拟环形阿尔文本征模，由磁聚变装置中的超热粒子激发。非线性产生零频率且沿磁场无变化的模式；这些产生了无梯度系统中的纬向流动和电流的类似物。这表明，在比之前考虑的系统更简单的系统中，准静止流可以通过剪切阿尔芬波产生，这些系统依赖于可压缩性、有限拉莫尔半径效应或复杂的几何形状。模式的饱和振幅是通过分析和数值方法找到的，作为泵浦波振幅的函数。这有助于估计临界振幅，高于该临界振幅，环形阿尔芬本征模可以产生足够强的纬向流，以抑制磁聚变装置核心中的微湍流。该阈值对应于磁波动，其幅度相对于背景场可与 ρₛₜₐᵣ ᵢ（标准化为设备小半径的离子拉莫尔半径）相当。

articles.title: Blind in-memory arithmetic with confined skyrmions: doubling and successor functions on a skyrmion byte
articles.title_zh: 具有受限斯格明子的盲内存算术：斯格明子字节上的加倍和后继函数
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.18492v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We present a skyrmionic-based computation platform, able to perform fully in-memory computing by collectively manipulating the skyrmions that serve as bits of the binary memory. The computation protocols are implemented through driving currents and adequately located anisotropy defects that modify the dynamics of the skyrmions along a magnetic track. Simulations demonstrating the feasibility of such an in-memory computing system are shown for several basic and simple mathematical operations with natural numbers, such as doubling and adding one (the successor function). We also discuss how further optimization of the geometry, barrier profiles, current amplitudes, and timing parameters could improve both the robustness and the overall practical feasibility of the system.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们提出了一种基于斯格明子的计算平台，该平台能够通过集体操纵用作二进制存储器比特的斯格明子来执行完全的内存内计算。计算协议通过驱动电流和位于适当位置的各向异性缺陷来实现，这些缺陷会改变斯格明子沿磁道运动的动力学行为。针对几种使用自然数的简单基本数学运算（例如加倍和加一（后继函数）），我们展示了证明此类内存中计算系统可行性的模拟。我们还讨论了如何通过进一步优化几何形状、势垒轮廓、电流幅度和时序参数来提高系统的鲁棒性和整体实用可行性。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们提出了一种基于斯格明子的计算平台，该平台能够通过集体操纵用作二进制存储器比特的斯格明子来执行完全的内存内计算。计算协议通过驱动电流和位于适当位置的各向异性缺陷来实现，这些缺陷会改变斯格明子沿磁道运动的动力学行为。针对几种使用自然数的简单基本数学运算（例如加倍和加一（后继函数）），我们展示了证明此类内存中计算系统可行性的模拟。我们还讨论了如何通过进一步优化几何形状、势垒轮廓、电流幅度和时序参数来提高系统的鲁棒性和整体实用可行性。

articles.title: A Surrogate Boundary Condition for Improved Accuracy and Performance of Local Modeling in Radiation Transport Simulations
articles.title_zh: 用于提高辐射输运模拟中局部建模的准确性和性能的替代边界条件
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.18535v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Monte Carlo neutronics analysis of tokamak designs is computationally expensive due to the complex CAD geometries required to accurately model them. Design iteration of port plugs using global transport in the full model is impractical because of the computational cost. To circumvent this, local modeling methods are used. In the local modeling method, a boundary condition is assumed on the port plug, such that particles that leave the port plug do not require transport in the surrounding global model. For this purpose, vacuum and reflective boundaries are assumed, both of which provide poor approximation of the true transport physics in the global model. To improve on current techniques, a surrogate model is presented that provides a physics-informed boundary condition for the component. A neural network is trained to reproduce the boundary condition on the component that represents the behavior of particles returning from the surrounding geometry. Monte Carlo transport is only necessary within the component, and approximate physics from the surrounding region are retained. This approach allows the design in the component to be iterated without requiring full model transport and joining of the component mesh to the global mesh in each iteration. In this work, the surrogate model is evaluated against vacuum and reflective boundaries-- outperforming both in accuracy, with surrogate predictions of the flux in the port plug differing less than 12% from the global transport solution in any given energy bin. The surrogate boundary condition is also demonstrated to be more performant than global transport for the simplified benchmark geometry.
articles.abstract_zh: 托卡马克设计的蒙特卡罗中子学分析的计算成本很高，因为精确建模需要复杂的 CAD 几何形状。由于计算成本的原因，在完整模型中使用全局传输来设计端口插头的迭代是不切实际的。为了避免这种情况，使用局部建模方法。在局部建模方法中，在端口塞上假设边界条件，使得离开端口塞的粒子不需要在周围的全局模型中传输。为此，假设了真空和反射边界，这两者都不能很好地近似全局模型中的真实传输物理。为了改进现有技术，提出了一种替代模型，为组件提供基于物理的边界条件。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 托卡马克设计的蒙特卡罗中子学分析的计算成本很高，因为精确建模需要复杂的 CAD 几何形状。由于计算成本的原因，在完整模型中使用全局传输来设计端口插头的迭代是不切实际的。为了避免这种情况，使用局部建模方法。在局部建模方法中，在端口塞上假设边界条件，使得离开端口塞的粒子不需要在周围的全局模型中传输。为此，假设了真空和反射边界，这两者都不能很好地近似全局模型中的真实传输物理。为了改进现有技术，提出了一种替代模型，为组件提供基于物理的边界条件。训练神经网络来重现组件上的边界条件，该边界条件代表从周围几何体返回的粒子的行为。仅在组件内需要蒙特卡罗传输，并且保留周围区域的近似物理场。这种方法允许迭代组件中的设计，而无需在每次迭代中进行完整的模型传输和组件网格与全局网格的连接。在这项工作中，替代模型针对真空和反射边界进行了评估，其准确性优于两者，端口插头中通量的替代预测与任何给定能量箱中的全局传输解决方案的差异小于 12%。对于简化的基准几何形状，替代边界条件也被证明比全局传输更高效。

articles.title: Foundation Tensor Networks Generalize Across Quantum Lattice Systems
articles.title_zh: 基础张量网络在量子晶格系统中推广
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.17655v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Neural quantum states and tensor networks have emerged as leading techniques for simulating quantum many-body systems. However, disordered systems remain extremely challenging in both frameworks as they require computation of the ground state for every realization of the disorder. Recently, neural quantum states have been used to construct foundation models that generate the ground state directly from the Hamiltonian. Still, they are hindered by the need to perform extensive sampling to estimate observables. To address these difficulties, we introduce the foundation tensor network (FTN), which uses a neural network to generate the tensor network representation of the ground-state wavefunction from the Hamiltonian. To accelerate training, we develop a technique, called textttGridBP, based on iterated one-dimensional belief propagation that reduces the cost of computing the energy expectation value to just two tensor contractions. We use FTNs to calculate the critical parameters of the glass transition in the quantum Edwards-Anderson model via finite-size scaling analysis. To facilitate rapid averaging, we use a moment-generating function to evaluate the order parameter, lowering the cost to a single tensor contraction. We obtain high-fidelity estimates for the critical parameters by averaging over 500,000 disorder realizations.
articles.abstract_zh: 神经量子态和张量网络已成为模拟量子多体系统的领先技术。然而，无序系统在这两个框架中仍然极具挑战性，因为它们需要为无序的每次实现计算基态。最近，神经量子态已被用来构建直接从哈密顿量生成基态的基础模型。尽管如此，他们仍然受到需要进行大量采样来估计可观测值的阻碍。为了解决这些困难，我们引入了基础张量网络（FTN），它使用神经网络从哈密顿量生成基态波函数的张量网络表示。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 神经量子态和张量网络已成为模拟量子多体系统的领先技术。然而，无序系统在这两个框架中仍然极具挑战性，因为它们需要为无序的每次实现计算基态。最近，神经量子态已被用来构建直接从哈密顿量生成基态的基础模型。尽管如此，他们仍然受到需要进行大量采样来估计可观测值的阻碍。为了解决这些困难，我们引入了基础张量网络（FTN），它使用神经网络从哈密顿量生成基态波函数的张量网络表示。为了加速训练，我们开发了一种名为 textttGridBP 的技术，该技术基于迭代一维置信传播，可将计算能量期望值的成本降低到仅两次张量收缩。我们使用 FTN 通过有限尺寸尺度分析来计算量子 Edwards-Anderson 模型中玻璃化转变的关键参数。为了促进快速平均，我们使用矩生成函数来评估阶参数，从而降低单个张量收缩的成本。我们通过对超过 500,000 个无序实现进行平均，获得了关键参数的高保真度估计。

articles.title: An AI-enabled high-resolution chlorophyll-a forecasting model that outperforms the operational global biogeochemical system
articles.title_zh: 一种基于人工智能的高分辨率叶绿素a预测模型，其性能优于现有的全球生物地球化学系统
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.17704v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Surface chlorophyll-a concentration is a key indicator of marine phytoplankton variability, and short-term forecasts of its distribution provide advance information for marine ecosystem monitoring and management. However, interactions between physical transport and biological processes complicate chlorophyll-a forecasting, and simulating these coupled processes with conventional numerical models imposes substantial computational demands. Here we introduce ChlCast, an AI model that generates daily forecasts of surface chlorophyll-a concentration over a 10-day horizon at approximately 4-km resolution between 60^circS and 60^circN. ChlCast combines factorized spatiotemporal convolutions with a multiscale architecture to learn from historical chlorophyll-a fields and climatological information. Compared with the operational 0.25^circ Copernicus global ocean biogeochemical forecasting system, ChlCast reduces mean absolute error and root mean square error by 70.74% and 47.63%, respectively, against satellite-derived Level-4 chlorophyll-a fields, and by 35.03% and 13.07% against independent BGC-Argo in situ observations. Coastal case studies further show that the 4-km forecasts retain coastal gradients and localized concentration maxima that are weakened by coarse-grid averaging. These results demonstrate the potential of observation-driven deep learning for high-resolution forecasting of surface chlorophyll-a variability at the near-global scale.
articles.abstract_zh: 表层叶绿素a浓度是海洋浮游植物变异性的关键指标，对其分布的短期预测为海洋生态系统的监测和管理提供了预先信息。然而，物理输送与生物过程之间的相互作用使叶绿素a的预测变得复杂，使用传统数值模型模拟这些耦合过程需要巨大的计算量。本文将介绍 ChlCast，这是一种人工智能模型，可在 60°S 至 60°N 之间以约 4 公里的分辨率生成 10 天的表面叶绿素 a 浓度每日预测。ChlCast 将分解的时空卷积与多尺度架构相结合，从历史叶绿素-a 场和气候学信息中学习。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 表层叶绿素a浓度是海洋浮游植物变异性的关键指标，对其分布的短期预测为海洋生态系统的监测和管理提供了预先信息。然而，物理输送与生物过程之间的相互作用使叶绿素a的预测变得复杂，使用传统数值模型模拟这些耦合过程需要巨大的计算量。本文将介绍 ChlCast，这是一种人工智能模型，可在 60°S 至 60°N 之间以约 4 公里的分辨率生成 10 天的表面叶绿素 a 浓度每日预测。ChlCast 将分解的时空卷积与多尺度架构相结合，从历史叶绿素-a 场和气候学信息中学习。与运行中的0.25^circ哥白尼全球海洋生物地球化学预测系统相比，ChlCast与卫星衍生的4级叶绿素a场相比，平均绝对误差和均方根误差分别降低了70.74%和47.63%，与独立的BGC-Argo原位观测相比，分别降低了35.03%和13.07%。沿海案例研究进一步表明，4公里分辨率的预测保留了沿海梯度和局部浓度峰值，而这些梯度和峰值在粗网格平均中被削弱。这些结果表明，基于观测的深度学习在近全球尺度上对地表叶绿素a变异性进行高分辨率预测具有潜力。

articles.title: A Concise Introduction to Quantum Electromagnetics
articles.title_zh: 量子电磁学简明入门
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.17988v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: This book introduces quantum electromagnetics to readers trained in classical electromagnetics, without assuming a systematic background in quantum mechanics. The central question is when classical descriptions suffice, and when the quantum states of matter or the field must be retained explicitly. Starting from familiar electromagnetic modes and material response, the discussion develops atomic dynamics, field quantization, and the interaction of quantized fields with quantum matter. Particular attention is given to how mode profiles, Green functions, and scattering matrices obtained from classical electromagnetic calculations enter quantum models. Atomic coherence, photon statistics, spontaneous emission, and cavity coupling are developed through derivations that identify the physical assumptions and limits of each description. Examples drawn from atomic clocks, Rydberg-atom receivers, and single-photon devices connect these concepts to excitation, propagation, and measurement in practical systems. Loss and noise are included in relating internal dynamics to measured signals and correlations. The final discussion examines how sensitivity and claims of quantum advantage depend on bandwidth, measurement resources, and the classical reference used for comparison. The aim is to help readers choose an appropriate model, carry out the calculation, and understand what its predictions mean for an electromagnetic measurement.
articles.abstract_zh: 本书面向受过经典电磁学训练的读者，向他们介绍量子电磁学，并不假定读者具备量子力学的系统性背景知识。核心问题是，何时经典描述就足够了，何时必须明确保留物质或场的量子态。从熟悉的电磁模式和材料响应出发，讨论了原子动力学、场量子化以及量子化场与量子物质的相互作用。特别关注的是，如何将从经典电磁计算中获得的模态分布、格林函数和散射矩阵引入量子模型。原子相干性、光子统计、自发辐射和腔耦合是通过推导来阐述的，这些推导确定了每种描述的物理假设和局限性。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 本书面向受过经典电磁学训练的读者，向他们介绍量子电磁学，并不假定读者具备量子力学的系统性背景知识。核心问题是，何时经典描述就足够了，何时必须明确保留物质或场的量子态。从熟悉的电磁模式和材料响应出发，讨论了原子动力学、场量子化以及量子化场与量子物质的相互作用。特别关注的是，如何将从经典电磁计算中获得的模态分布、格林函数和散射矩阵引入量子模型。原子相干性、光子统计、自发辐射和腔耦合是通过推导来阐述的，这些推导确定了每种描述的物理假设和局限性。来自原子钟、里德伯原子接收器和单光子器件的实例将这些概念与实际系统中的激发、传播和测量联系起来。在将内部动力学与所测量的信号和相关性联系起来时，损失和噪声也被考虑在内。最后的讨论探讨了灵敏度和量子优势的声称如何取决于带宽、测量资源以及用于比较的经典参考。其目的是帮助读者选择合适的模型，进行计算，并了解其预测对电磁测量的意义。

articles.title: A Machine-learning-aided Workflow for Sampling Small Polaron Dynamics in Energy Materials
articles.title_zh: 一种用于对能源材料中的小极化子动力学进行采样的机器学习辅助工作流程
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.18041v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: One of the defining characteristics of most energy materials, used as e.g.~battery electrodes, photovoltaics, or photocatalysts, is their ability conduct charges such as electrons and holes. The exact mechanism of this conductivity depends on the material, but is often dominated by the existence of mobile small polarons, i.e.~electrons or holes strongly localised through the polarisation of their environment. Computationally, small polarons can be treated with reasonably accuracy through the use of self-interaction corrected or hybrid density functional theory (DFT) together with local geometry optimisation. Similar approaches can be employed to determine the energy barriers to movement of the polarons through hopping. Unfortunately, realistic energy materials tend have very large numbers of symmetry inequivalent polaronic configurations and correspondingly large numbers of hopping barriers, making them hard to tackle explicitly. In this work we therefore extend the computational reach of DFT calculations with machine-learned (ML) surrogate models, which then feed into a kinetic model to quantitatively estimate the conductivity of a battery anode material (Li₄Ti₅O₁₂ or LTO) at realistic, defected conditions. We calculate the conductivity at room temperature to be 6.7 × 10⁻³ S/cm which lies well in the experimental range. To this end, we only needed a total of 154 polaron barrier calculations, out of 3649 symmetry inequivalent ones, achieving an over 20-fold increase of computational efficiency. Overall, our work demonstrates how DFT-trained ML surrogates can be used to quantitatively and efficiently sample the dynamics of small polarons in energy materials.
articles.abstract_zh: 大多数能量材料（例如用作电池电极、光伏材料或光催化剂）的一个显著特征是其能够传导电荷，如电子和空穴。这种导电性的确切机制取决于材料，但通常由移动小极化子的存在主导，即通过其环境的极化而强烈局域化的电子或空穴。在计算方面，可以通过使用自相互作用校正或混合密度泛函理论（DFT）以及局部几何优化，以合理的精度处理小极化子。可以采用类似的方法来确定小极化子通过跃迁运动的能垒。遗憾的是，现实的能源材料往往具有非常大量的对称性不等价的极化子构型，以及相应的大量跃迁势垒，因此难以明确处理。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 大多数能量材料（例如用作电池电极、光伏材料或光催化剂）的一个显著特征是其能够传导电荷，如电子和空穴。这种导电性的确切机制取决于材料，但通常由移动小极化子的存在主导，即通过其环境的极化而强烈局域化的电子或空穴。在计算方面，可以通过使用自相互作用校正或混合密度泛函理论（DFT）以及局部几何优化，以合理的精度处理小极化子。可以采用类似的方法来确定小极化子通过跃迁运动的能垒。遗憾的是，现实的能源材料往往具有非常大量的对称性不等价的极化子构型，以及相应的大量跃迁势垒，因此难以明确处理。因此，在本研究中，我们使用机器学习（ML）代理模型扩展了DFT计算的计算范围，然后将其输入动力学模型，以定量估算电池阳极材料（Li₄Ti₅O₁₂或LTO）在真实缺陷条件下的导电率。我们计算出的室温导电率为6.7 × 10⁻³ S/cm，完全在实验范围内。为此，在3649个对称性不等价的极化子势垒计算中，我们仅需要总共154个，从而使计算效率提高了20多倍。总体而言，我们的工作展示了如何使用经过DFT训练的ML代理模型来定量和高效地采样能量材料中小极化子的动力学。

articles.title: Quantum phase estimation on a Rydberg quantum simulator
articles.title_zh: 里德伯量子模拟器上的量子相位估算
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.18122v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Determining the energy spectrum of a many-body quantum system is a central goal of quantum physics. Ground-state energies underpin materials science and quantum chemistry, whereas excited states govern dynamical phenomena such as quantum thermalization. Quantum simulators have greatly shaped our understanding of many-body systems, for example, by enabling access to microscopic mechanisms and nonlocal order parameters. However, experiments still struggle to access the full range of many-body spectral features and are typically limited to measuring energy gaps and excitations by spectroscopic means. Here, we address this challenge by demonstrating quantum phase estimation on an analog Rydberg quantum simulator. We reconstruct the complex-valued return amplitude, or Loschmidt echo, of an initial probe state. From its Fourier transform, we measure absolute ground-state energies and energy gaps in systems of up to 19 atoms in one and two spatial dimensions. Varying the initial probe state, we select distinct spectral windows within which we compute the longitudinal and transverse magnetization, and observe their competition across the many-body spectrum. Our results thereby demonstrate phase-sensitive many-body spectroscopy on an analog quantum simulator without auxiliary qubits or controlled evolution.
articles.abstract_zh: 确定多体量子系统的能谱是量子物理学的核心目标。基态能量是材料科学和量子化学的基础，而激发态则主导着量子热化等动力学现象。量子模拟器极大地影响了我们对多体系统的理解，例如，通过使我们能够了解微观机制和非局域序参量。然而，实验仍然难以获得全方位的多体谱特征，通常仅限于通过光谱手段测量能隙和激发。在这里，我们通过在模拟里德伯量子模拟器上演示量子相位估算来应对这一挑战。我们重构了初始探测态的复值返回振幅，即洛施密特回波。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 确定多体量子系统的能谱是量子物理学的核心目标。基态能量是材料科学和量子化学的基础，而激发态则主导着量子热化等动力学现象。量子模拟器极大地影响了我们对多体系统的理解，例如，通过使我们能够了解微观机制和非局域序参量。然而，实验仍然难以获得全方位的多体谱特征，通常仅限于通过光谱手段测量能隙和激发。在这里，我们通过在模拟里德伯量子模拟器上演示量子相位估算来应对这一挑战。我们重构了初始探测态的复值返回振幅，即洛施密特回波。通过其傅里叶变换，我们测量了一维和二维空间中多达19个原子的系统的绝对基态能量和能隙。通过改变初始探测态，我们选择了不同的谱窗，在这些谱窗内计算纵向和横向磁化强度，并观察它们在多体谱中的竞争。因此，我们的结果展示了在没有辅助量子比特或受控演化的模拟量子模拟器上进行的相位敏感多体光谱学。

articles.title: Certificate-Based Verification of Pulsed Field Ablation Models
articles.title_zh: 基于证书的脉冲场消融模型验证
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.18148v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Computational models of pulsed field ablation predict the lesion as the tissue where the electric field exceeds a lethal threshold. Their numerical error is rarely bounded, and automated pipelines increasingly run them without an expert checking each result. To verify each run, we separate the question "was the stated model solved correctly?" from the solver that answers it. An untrusted solver returns with its answer a certificate, consisting of a potential with the correct electrode and ground values and an exactly charge-conserving current. A small independent checker verifies the certificate against a written specification of the physics. Using the Prager-Synge hypercircle theorem evaluated in ball arithmetic, it turns the certificate into guaranteed two-sided bounds on the impedance and on the root-mean-square field of every tile of a lesion map, also over a range of blood/tissue conductivity ratios. A vectorized version of the checker takes about a tenth of the solve time. For a focal electrode in contact, the tile-resolved depth at 1000 V and 700 V/cm is proven to lie in 3.50-3.75 mm for every ratio from 1.7 to 3.75. For a bipolar catheter, certified depths overlap published in-vivo depths. Where they differ from a published reference model, the certificates prove that the difference is not numerical error in our computation.
