articles.title: Geometric diabatization via learned parallel transport of electronic states
articles.abstract: We present a machine-learning framework for diabatization based on the parallel transport of electronic states. Starting from a differential-geometric description of the Born–Oppenheimer approximation, we learn the generator of a continuous unitary transformation between adiabatic and quasi-diabatic electronic states. The generator is represented by a neural network and integrated along nuclear paths using a neural ordinary differential equation. Sparse non-adiabatic coupling data are used to train the local transport, while the more densely available adiabatic energies are included through an energy-weighted regularization term. This avoids fitting the adiabatic potential energy surfaces directly and preserves both orthonormality and the adiabatic energy spectrum by construction. The method is demonstrated for an analytically solvable two-state model with a conical intersection, the ionic–neutral avoided crossing in LiF, and a two-dimensional cut through the conical intersection of NO 2 . The examples show the construction of quasi-diabatic representations under explicitly specified geometric path conventions.
articles.journal: The Journal of Chemical Physics Current Issue

articles.title: From spectra to performance: Multimodal machine learning for organic optoelectronic materials discovery
articles.abstract: The discovery and rational optimization of optoelectronic materials increasingly rely on heterogeneous characterization data encoding structure, morphology, electronic states, and device properties. Conventional spectral interpretation remains expert-dependent and often treats each modality in isolation, limiting information extraction. Machine learning has improved information extraction from individual spectroscopic modalities, yet single modality approaches often suffer from incomplete structural and physical representations. Multimodal machine learning enables integration of diverse spectroscopic signals into unified representations. In this review, we summarize recent advances in multimodal spectral learning and heterogeneous data fusion for spectra–structure–property relationships in optoelectronic materials. We discuss how the synergistic combination of infrared, Raman, nuclear magnetic resonance, and mass spectrometry improves functional-group recognition, substructure inference, and spectrum-based molecular structure elucidation and raw-spectrum learning for molecular elucidation. We further elaborate on how the fusion of optical spectra, morphology, processing parameters, and molecular representations facilitates quantitative property prediction and materials discovery. Key challenges include simulation-experiment domain gaps, limited multimodal datasets, missing modalities, and insufficient model interpretability. Overall, multimodal spectral learning is emerging as a promising approach for transforming characterization from a descriptive tool into a predictive framework for rational materials design.
articles.journal: The Journal of Chemical Physics Current Issue

articles.title: Photoelectron and MATI spectra of pyridine from the beyond Born–Oppenheimer constructed diabatic Hamiltonian matrices
articles.abstract: The mechanism of the radiationless processes involved in photoelectron (PE) and mass-analyzed threshold ionization (MATI) spectra of pyridine is investigated by considering nonadiabatic interactions among the low-lying electronic states ( 2 A 1 , 2 A 2 , and 2 B 1 ). This phenomenon demands an accurate electron and nuclear coupling employing beyond Born–Oppenheimer (BBO) treatment and, thereafter, quantum dynamics to generate the experimental spectra. In the present work, we construct multi-state multi-mode diabatic Hamiltonian using ab initio calculated adiabatic potential energy surfaces and nonadiabatic coupling terms for the first three electronic states involving twelve (12) nonadiabatically active normal modes. The theoretically calculated spectra generally reproduces the experimental envelopes of the 2 A 1 , mixed 2 A 1 + 2 A 2 , and 2 B 1 ionization bands, yielding good agreement with the measured relative vibrational energies throughout the experimental energy domain (9.0–11.3 eV). The multi-mode multi-state quantum-dynamics calculation using time-dependent discrete variable representation (TDDVR) methodology provides a consistent assignment for numerous vibronic transitions, where the closely spaced spectral features originate from substantial mixing of vibrational contributions. The overall agreement obtained for both the PE and MATI spectra demonstrates that TDDVR dynamics on the BBO-based diabatic Hamiltonian provides a robust first-principles framework for simulating and interpreting vibronic spectra of pyridine exhibiting strong nonadiabatic interactions.
articles.journal: The Journal of Chemical Physics Current Issue

articles.title: Effective density of states of a dissipative and confined cyclotron motion
articles.abstract: We determine the effective thermodynamic density of states associated with the reduced partition function of a charged two-dimensional harmonic oscillator in a uniform magnetic field and linearly coupled to an Ohmic heat bath regularized by a Drude cutoff. The reduced partition function is factorized exactly in terms of the complex decay rates of the two magnetic chiral sectors and gamma functions. A weak-coupling expansion nonperturbatively in a magnetic field resolves the bath-induced ground-state shift into the two chiral Fock–Darwin modes. Its inverse Laplace transform contains an isolated contribution at the reduced ground-state energy defined by the partition-function ratio and a continuum that starts immediately above it. The low-energy continuum is fixed by the Ohmic bath, while the high-energy density grows linearly as required by the two-dimensional classical limit. We derive the residue representation for generic nondegenerate magnetic-field poles and show why the zero-field limit requires separate treatment when chiral pole pairs coalesce. High-precision inverse-Laplace calculations are combined with the analytic residue expansion to obtain numerically stable continuum densities from threshold to high energy. Dissipation progressively suppresses the oscillatory spectral structure, whereas the magnetic field reorganizes the resonance positions and weights and invalidates a literal extension of the usual zero-field all-real-pole overdamped classification. The zero-field calculation is independently validated against the damped-oscillator density of states of Hanke and Zwerger. We also emphasize that the resulting quantity is an effective thermodynamic density of states defined by the reduced partition function rather than the local spectral function of the open subsystem.
articles.journal: The Journal of Chemical Physics Current Issue

articles.title: Unraveling electron-transfer mediated decay through quantum wavepacket dynamics
articles.abstract: Electron-transfer mediated decay (ETMD) turns a single ionization event into a double-ionization outcome: an electron is transferred to a nearby cation, and the energy released in this neutralization step ejects a second low-energy electron. In this work, we give a fully quantum nuclear-dynamical account of ETMD in the weakly bound triatomic He + K 2 cluster, a minimal representation of K 2 sitting at the surface of a helium nanodroplet, the environment in which this decay channel has been experimentally observed. Starting from ab initio potential energy surfaces and geometry-dependent ETMD decay widths for the states involved, we propagate nuclear wave packets with the multiconfigurational time-dependent Hartree method and obtain state-resolved ETMD probabilities together with the kinetic energy spectra of the emitted secondary electrons. The calculations show that a mismatch in surface topology between the decaying He + K 2 state and the final HeK22+ state drives substantial nuclear motion during the electronic relaxation, and that this motion strongly shapes both the overall decay rate and the emitted-electron spectrum.
articles.journal: The Journal of Chemical Physics Current Issue

articles.title: Classical-to-DFT multi-fidelity approach for developing machine learning potentials of aqueous systems
articles.abstract: Machine learning interatomic potentials (MLIPs) offer near– ab initio accuracy at a fraction of the cost of conventional electronic structure calculations, but their reliability depends critically on the quality and diversity of training data. Here, we present a classical-to-density functional theory (DFT) multi-fidelity workflow for efficient dataset generation, in which long classical molecular dynamics trajectories are supplemented with selectively DFT-optimized configurations to train neural network potentials. We demonstrate this approach on four systems: bulk water, water at the air–water interface, CaSO 4 in bulk water, and CaSO 4 at the interface. In all cases, the trained models faithfully reproduce reference DFT properties, validating the workflow across both simple and chemically complex environments. We further probe the extrapolation capabilities of the models, showing that bulk-trained networks can generalize to different temperatures, pressures, and interfacial geometries when datasets include targeted augmented configurations. This multi-fidelity strategy thus enables accurate and transferable MLIPs for complex solvated and interfacial systems, bridging the gap between computational efficiency and first-principles accuracy.
articles.journal: The Journal of Chemical Physics Current Issue

articles.title: 3D Interconnected Hierarchically Porous Cellulose/Chitosan Composite Aerogels for Efficient Enzyme Immobilization and Enhanced Phytochemical Biotransformation
articles.abstract: Enzymes possess high catalytic efficiency and remarkable selectivity. Consequently, they have garnered increasing attention as sustainable biocatalysts for green biomanufacturing. However, limited operational stability, poor reusability, and difficult recovery during catalytic processes remain major barriers to their practical applications. As a result, enzyme immobilization has surfaced as a robust approach for enhancing enzyme stability and enabling repeated reuse. Developing suitable immobilization carriers capable of providing favorable catalytic microenvironments remains a critical challenge. Porous biobased carriers offer promising platforms for enzyme immobilization since their high specific surface area and interconnected porous architecture. Herein, a microcrystalline cellulose/chitosan composite aerogel (MCC/CS-GA) was fabricated through glutaraldehyde crosslinking and freeze-drying as a robust biomass-derived support for β-glucosidase (β-Glu) immobilization. The MCC/CS-GA-bound β-Glu had better pH tolerance and thermal stability than the free enzyme. And it kept good catalytic activity in harsh conditions. Furthermore, after being stored at 4 ℃ for 15 days, The anchored enzyme kept over 75% activity from the start, which indicates an improvement in storage stability.The MCC/CS-GA-immobilized β-Glu also enabled facile catalyst recovery and preserved 70.43% of its original activity after six cycles, indicating excellent operational durability. Furthermore, the biotransformation of Jujuboside A into Jujuboside B, which possesses a lower molecular weight and enhanced blood‑brain barrier permeability relative to its precursor, achieved an efficiency of 78.4%, representing an approximately 8‑fold enhancement compared with the native plant extract. Therefore, the MCC/CS-GA immobilization system facilitated efficient phytochemical biotransformation and may exhibit broader potential for biotransforming diverse phytoglycosides into bioactive aglycones. Furthermore, the porous cellulose-based carrier provides a versatile platform for enzyme immobilization toward sustainable biocatalytic applications.

articles.title: Size-consistency-corrected multireference configuration interaction in COLUMBUS provides highly accurate molecular excitation energies
articles.abstract: Accurate reference data for electronically excited states are essential for assessing multireference electronic-structure methods. We benchmark state-averaged complete-active-space self-consistent field (SA-CASSCF), exchange-scaled CASSCF (XS-CASSCF), fully uncontracted multireference configuration interaction with single and double excitations (MR-CISD), and four a posteriori size-consistency corrections against the theoretical best estimates of QUESTDB. The dataset comprises 263 valence excitations across 41 small and medium-sized molecules, including singlet and triplet nπ*, ππ*, and doubly excited states. All SA-CASSCF and MR-CISD calculations were performed with the COLUMBUS program system using molecule-specific active spaces and the aug-cc-pVDZ basis set. For the 233 safe transitions, SA-CASSCF and MR-CISD yield mean absolute errors of 0.58 and 0.32 eV, respectively, with predominantly positive biases. The Davidson–Silver/Siegbahn (+DV3) and Pople (+P) corrections reduce the mean absolute errors to 0.10 and 0.11 eV and the root-mean-square errors to 0.13 eV. They also provide a more balanced description across spin multiplicities and excitation characters. XS-CASSCF, evaluated with two distinct parameterizations, improves singlet ππ* states, particularly those with pronounced ionic character, but degrades nπ* states and does not improve the overall statistics relative to SA-CASSCF. For 36 selected unsafe or doubly excited transitions, MR-CISD+DV3 and MR-CISD+P retain mean absolute errors of 0.16 eV. Their agreement with extrapolated full configuration interaction-based reference values and discrepancies from several complete-active-space third-order perturbation theory- and partially contracted- n -electron valence state second-order perturbation theory-based estimates identify states whose current best estimates merit independent re-examination. Overall, size-consistency-corrected MR-CISD provides highly accurate and broadly balanced valence excitation energies.
articles.journal: The Journal of Chemical Physics Current Issue

articles.title: Chirality-sensitive mobility and dissipation of Brownian motion on a helical landscape
articles.abstract: We study the Brownian dynamics and linear response of a particle with inertia moving in a two-dimensional helical landscape imprinted on a cylindrical surface. In the harmonic well approximation, the deterministic motion separates into free propagation along the screw direction and harmonic motion in the transverse screw-normal direction. We show that for isotropic damping, this simplification survives in the Langevin description, whereas anisotropic damping along the axial and angular directions couples the stochastic dynamics and destroys separability. The resulting anisotropic model is formulated as a linear Ornstein–Uhlenbeck process in phase space with a zero mode associated with diffusion along the screw coordinate, so that the full phase-space dynamics does not relax to a stationary distribution in an infinite system. To treat transport in this setting, we construct the stationary dynamics in the stable subspace obtained after projecting out the zero mode. This leads to a linear response theory for this system and yields closed analytical expressions for stationary time-correlation functions and the dynamical mobility tensor in both the time and frequency domains. The off-diagonal elements of the mobility tensor describe the cross-response between axial forcing and angular motion and between applied torque and axial transport. Consistent with time reversal symmetry, these cross mobilities are equal and provide a direct dynamical signature of the helical geometry. In addition, a simultaneous application of driving in both the axial and angular directions reveals asymmetry in energy dissipation rate due to the helical landscape.
articles.journal: The Journal of Chemical Physics Current Issue

articles.title: Aggregation and impurity effects on the photophysics of ultralong organic phosphorescence in carbazole derivatives
articles.abstract: Ultralong organic phosphorescence in carbazole derivatives involves interconnected photophysical processes. Although experimental studies have proposed various possible mechanisms, the connections among excited state electronic structure, impurity induced changes in excited states, excitation energy migration, and emission processes still need to be elucidated from a state-resolved perspective. Here, we study the corresponding photophysical processes in pristine DPhCzT- and DPhBdT-doped crystals using electronic structure calculations, fragment particle–hole density diabatization, vibronic spectral simulations, and rate calculations. In pristine aggregates, weak intermolecular excitonic coupling is insufficient to significantly stabilize triplet energy. The fluorescence and phosphorescence arise mainly from localized excited states. After introducing DPhBdT impurities, the energy level distribution and character of the low energy excited states change markedly. A low energy charge transfer (CT) state and an impurity localized triplet state form at the host–guest interface, corresponding to fluorescence and phosphorescence emission, respectively. In finite aggregates, charge separated states lie at substantially higher energies and are not identified as the dominant low energy photophysical pathway. Significantly, the CT state suppresses the decay channel competing with intersystem crossing (ISC) and increases the total ISC rate, thereby promoting triplet state population.
articles.journal: The Journal of Chemical Physics Current Issue

articles.title: Selective multilevel force fields for excited-state spectroscopy: A provenance-aware multi-provider workflow
articles.abstract: Accurate electronic-structure methods for excited-state energies are increasingly accessible, but their application to geometries and vibrational properties is often limited because analytic energy derivatives are not available in most cases. Building on accuracy ladders established for ground-state structures and energetics, we extend the same hierarchical strategy to predominantly single-reference excited states, where analytic energy derivatives are often unavailable. The hierarchy combines a hybrid density-functional baseline (L0), a double-hybrid intermediate level (L1), equation-of-motion (EOM) coupled-cluster singles and doubles (L2), and a final L3 refinement by coupled-cluster singles, doubles, and approximate triples (CC3). An accurate composite scheme is obtained by combining L3 structures with L2 basis-set and core–valence increments, whereas harmonic force fields are obtained from L3 curvatures along L0 normal modes. Numerical derivatives are evaluated in parallel in symmetry-adapted, nonredundant internal coordinates; optimizations retain totally symmetric directions, and force fields retain symmetry-allowed blocks. Complete small-molecule force fields show that L3 curvatures along L0 normal modes reproduce the full L3 harmonic frequencies within 4 cm −1 . HNO and HCF demonstrate that the complete-basis-set correction is state specific, whereas core–valence bond-length corrections can be transferred from the ground state. Across this demonstrative set, the resulting economical composite reduces the EOM/TZ baseline deviations from the CC3/TZ reference by more than 40% for all geometrical parameters; where the full CC3/TZ results are available, the economical composite outperforms both EOM/TZ alone and the ground-state-transfer construction used in prior strategies. A one-dimensional variational treatment describes the H 2 CO inversion; acrolein and tetrazine extend the construction to larger molecules, while the carbonyl subspace of uracil illustrates reduced-dimensionality L3 treatment.
articles.journal: The Journal of Chemical Physics Current Issue

articles.title: Probing ion pairing within the electric double layer via the interfacial water response in nonlinear vibrational spectroscopy
articles.abstract: The additive picture for ion-induced non-linear spectroscopic signatures at an aqueous interface is revisited here, taking the example of KCl at the interface with a charge-neutral hydrophobic self-assembled monolayer/water interface. Density functional theory-based molecular dynamics simulations are combined with theoretical sum-frequency generation spectroscopy in order to examine the non-linear signatures of ion-pairing in the Binding Interfacial Layer (BIL, the innermost layer of water in direct contact with the surface). Because the surface carries no intrinsic charge, spectral changes that arise from the neat to the electrolytic aqueous interface are solely due to ion adsorption/exclusion and solvation-shell asymmetry in the BIL. We find distinct ion-pair signatures that point to a role for ion–ion correlations in shaping the electric double layer structure at the molecular scale, going beyond an additive picture of independent ion solvation-shell contributions to the spectra.
articles.journal: The Journal of Chemical Physics Current Issue

articles.title: Laser spectroscopic detection of the semiconductor growth intermediates GaCH 3 and InCH 3 in the gas phase
articles.abstract: We report the detection of the monomethyl gallium [GaCH 3 ] and monomethyl indium [InCH 3 ] molecules in the gas phase by laser induced emission spectroscopy. The transient species were “synthesized” by a pulsed electric discharge through the vapor of the corresponding trimethylmetal compounds diluted in high pressure argon. The MCH 3 molecules were identified by the observed ground state vibrational frequencies of the hydrogenated and deuterated molecules compared with previous matrix isolation values and our ab initio predictions. Theory establishes that the spectra in the visible near 540 (GaCH 3 ) and 625 nm (InCH 3 ) are due to unusual T 1 –S 0 transitions in these symmetric top free radicals.
articles.journal: The Journal of Chemical Physics Current Issue

articles.title: Interatomic correlations in the multiphonon dynamic structure factor of crystals
articles.abstract: Time-dependent atom-pair correlations provide a direct connection between microscopic vibrational dynamics and momentum- and energy-resolved scattering spectra. In crystalline materials, however, practical multiphonon calculations commonly retain interatomic correlations at one phonon while reducing higher orders to atomic self-correlations. We formulate a deterministic correlation-function method that evaluates coherent inelastic scattering at specified phonon order and in the all-order harmonic sum. Expanding the Gaussian atom-pair intermediate scattering function generates finite orders, whereas retaining its exponential gives the all-order result, avoiding explicit enumeration of n -phonon mode tuples. We apply the method to powder-averaged graphite and diamond at 300 and 1200 K in a fixed-lattice harmonic model and isolate the signed distinct contribution by subtracting the same-atom self-term from the full atom-pair spectrum. The distinct multiphonon signal is substantially larger in graphite than in diamond and develops pronounced positive and negative structures whose net integral is strongly reduced by cancellation. Two-phonon scattering is dominant, but structured third- and fourth-order contributions remain; a smaller fifth-and-higher-order residual is clearest for graphite at 1200 K. Pair-distance analysis at 1200 K finds comparable near-neighbor-group weights relative to self-scattering, but a larger contribution from more distant pairs in graphite. Larger normalized displacement correlations, particularly for interlayer out-of-plane motion, provide a dynamical context for this contrast. Explicit higher orders and finer phonon meshes preserve the material contrast and order hierarchy while revealing residual amplitude sensitivity. These results provide a material- and observable-specific assessment of the self-approximation within the harmonic model.
articles.journal: The Journal of Chemical Physics Current Issue

articles.title: Poincaré sphere representation of spin-driven polarization encoding in two-dimensional perovskite light sources
articles.abstract: Nonlinear optical light sources enable the generation of photons with polarization states that are intrinsically determined by underlying material dynamics, rather than imposed through external modulation. Here, we investigate how four-wave-mixing signal fields emitted by a representative two-dimensional perovskite system can be leveraged for polarization-encoded quantum communication. The experimentally reconstructed signal field is represented by Stokes-vector trajectories on the Poincaré sphere to establish a predictive framework that connects the optical response to practical figures of merit for spin-driven semiconductor light sources. Applied to a model quantum communication scheme in the weak coherent-state regime, this representation quantifies the resolution of the polarization states generated at two pump–probe delays, thereby enabling estimation of the number of detected photons per decoded bit. In addition, a microscopic model connects the signal-field ellipticity to spin relaxation within the exciton fine structure, revealing that interference between resonantly enhanced optical transitions governs the accessible polarization states. The analysis suggests that modest stabilization of the lowest-energy biexciton could substantially improve polarization-encoding performance, offering a route toward materials optimization. More broadly, these results motivate closer integration of nonlinear spectroscopy, semiconductor materials, and quantum information science in the development of novel light sources for quantum communication.
articles.journal: The Journal of Chemical Physics Current Issue

articles.title: Infrared and microwave spectroscopy of (CO) 2 –water trimers and observation of a new symmetric isomer
articles.abstract: (CO) 2 –water trimers are studied by theoretical calculations and by high-resolution spectroscopy in the microwave and mid-infrared regions. Calculations yield a symmetric global minimum structure (“Isomer 1”) with hydrogen bonds to CO monomers at each end of the water molecule, and a nearly isoenergetic stable form (“Isomer 2”) with a cyclic structure and a single hydrogen bond. Microwave spectra of Isomer 2 were observed previously for (CO) 2 –H 2 O and (CO) 2 –HDO, and here (CO) 2 –D 2 O is studied and the (CO) 2 –HDO results are extended. Infrared spectra are observed here for both isomers of (CO) 2 –D 2 O in the D 2 O ν 3 fundamental region (≈2780 cm −1 ), for (CO) 2 –HDO Isomer 1 in the O–D stretch region (≈2710 cm −1 ), and for (CO) 2 –H 2 O Isomer 2 in the ν 2 bend region (≈1600 cm −1 ). The Isomer 1 infrared bands represent the first spectroscopic identification of this form; there is an unusually large change in the A rotational constant between the ground and excited states, but the spectrum is not sensitive to the magnitude of A , which remains uncertain. The microwave spectrum of Isomer 1 remains to be discovered.
articles.journal: The Journal of Chemical Physics Current Issue

articles.title: Stress Analysis and Optimization of Ball Grid Array Solder Joints in 2.5D Packaging under Random Vibration Loading
articles.abstract: A finite element model of the ball grid array (BGA) solder joints in a 2.5D package was established, and random vibration stress analysis was performed. A strain measurement platform was then built to verify the simulation accuracy. The upper and lower BGA solder joint heights and the interposer thickness were selected as influencing factors, and an orthogonal array of 16 trials was designed using the Taguchi method. The maximum random vibration stresses of the upper and lower BGA solder joints were obtained for these 16 parameter combinations through finite element simulation, and range analysis and analysis of variance (ANOVA) were conducted. A grey relational dual-objective optimization method was used to optimize the solder joint stresses, yielding the optimal parameter combination, which was verified by simulation. The results show that the factors influencing the maximum stress of the upper BGA solder joints are ranked as upper BGA solder joint > lower BGA solder joint height > interposer thickness, whereas for the lower BGA solder joints the ranking is interposer thickness > lower BGA solder joint height > upper BGA solder joint height. The optimal combination is an upper BGA solder joint height of 0.24 mm, a lower BGA solder joint height of 0.38 mm, and an interposer thickness of 0.1 mm. These findings help reduce cumulative vibration fatigue damage in BGA solder joints and improve the vibration reliability of 2.5D packaging structures.

articles.title: Unstable plasma heats itself with waves it generates, experiments reveal
articles.title_zh: 实验表明，不稳定的等离子体通过产生的波加热自身
articles.abstract: Fusion power is expected to be a sustainable energy source that emits no carbon dioxide during electricity generation. To achieve this, research is underway worldwide to confine high-temperature plasma using magnetic fields. To initiate a fusion reaction, high-energy particles or waves must be injected from outside to heat the plasma to extremely high temperatures.

articles.title: Fabrication of Waterborne Polyurethane Flexible Strain Sensors Based on KH560-MXene/MWCNTs Synergistic Effects and the Application in Motion Posture Monitoring
articles.title_zh: 基于KH560-MXene/MWCNTs协同效应的水性聚氨酯柔性应变传感器的制备及其在运动姿态监测中的应用
articles.abstract: Flexible sensors serve as the core component of wearable electronics and intelligent health monitoring devices, possessing enormous application potential in the fields of human physiological signal acquisition and motion behavior detection. Nevertheless, flexible sensing materials generally suffer from poor environmental stability, weak anti-interference capability of sensing signals, and inevitable degradation of sensing performance during long-term cyclic operation, which severely restrict their large-scale practical applications. To address these issues, waterborne polyurethane (WPU) is adopted as the flexible matrix, modified MXene nanosheets with KH560 and multi-walled carbon nanotubes (MWCNTs) were introduced as hybrid conductive fillers. An integrated high-performance flexible strain sensor is fabricated via a solution blending and casting strategy. Through hydrogen bonding and electrostatic adsorption effects, a 1D-2D interconnected conductive network is constructed, where MXene acts as the primary conductive unit and MWCNTs function as interconnection bridging segments. This flexible sensor based on the composite system exhibits superior comprehensive performances, including a high gauge factor of 2.81, a broad strain detection range of 0-2800%, rapid response and recovery times of 150 ms and 120 ms, as well as excellent cycling stability over 3000 cycles. Density functional theory (DFT) calculations elucidate the interfacial mechanism of the MXene/MWCNTs heterojunction, verifying that the sensing mechanism originates from the synergistic effect of band structure evolution and conductive network reconstruction. Furthermore, the sensor enables real-time monitoring of electromyographic signals during human movements, demonstrating great application potential in intelligent wearable electronics.
articles.abstract_zh: 柔性传感器作为可穿戴电子产品和智能健康监测设备的核心部件，在人体生理信号采集和运动行为检测等领域具有巨大的应用潜力。然而，柔性传感材料普遍存在环境稳定性差、传感信号抗干扰能力弱、长期循环运行不可避免地导致传感性能下降等问题，严重制约了其大规模实际应用。为了解决这些问题，采用水性聚氨酯（WPU）作为柔性基质，引入带有KH560的改性MXene纳米片和多壁碳纳米管（MWCNT）作为混合导电填料。通过溶液混合和铸造策略制造集成的高性能柔性应变传感器。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 柔性传感器作为可穿戴电子产品和智能健康监测设备的核心部件，在人体生理信号采集和运动行为检测等领域具有巨大的应用潜力。然而，柔性传感材料普遍存在环境稳定性差、传感信号抗干扰能力弱、长期循环运行不可避免地导致传感性能下降等问题，严重制约了其大规模实际应用。为了解决这些问题，采用水性聚氨酯（WPU）作为柔性基质，引入带有KH560的改性MXene纳米片和多壁碳纳米管（MWCNT）作为混合导电填料。通过溶液混合和铸造策略制造集成的高性能柔性应变传感器。通过氢键和静电吸附效应，构建了 1D-2D 互连导电网络，其中 MXene 作为主要导电单元，MWCNT 作为互连桥接段。这种基于复合系统的柔性传感器表现出优越的综合性能，包括2.81的高应变系数、0-2800%的宽应变检测范围、150 ms和120 ms的快速响应和恢复时间，以及超过3000次循环的优异循环稳定性。密度泛函理论（DFT）计算阐明了MXene/MWCNTs异质结的界面机制，验证了传感机制源于能带结构演化和导电网络重构的协同效应。此外，该传感器还能够实时监测人体运动过程中的肌电信号，在智能可穿戴电子产品中展现出巨大的应用潜力。

articles.title: Biological and comparative genomic characterization of Staphylococcus aureus phage SJP49-2 and its effects on biofilm biomass
articles.title_zh: 金黄色葡萄球菌噬菌体 SJP49-2 的生物学和比较基因组特征及其对生物膜生物量的影响
articles.abstract: Background Biofilms complicate control of Staphylococcus aureus in food-related environments, and susceptibility to phages varies among strains. This study characterized phage SJP49-2 using morphology, lysis coverage across 92 laboratory-maintained strains, environmental stability, culture propagation, planktonic growth, biofilm biomass and a beef surface model. Host and phage genomes were analyzed, and SJP49-2 was compared with 19 reference phage genomes. Phenotypic assays were conducted as single experiments with technical replication and descriptive analysis.Results SJP49-2 showed lysis against 64 of 92 strains (69.57%). At the highest tested doses, crystal violet signals during biofilm formation and after treatment of established biofilms were 79.36% and 94.80% lower than their controls, respectively. In beef, the inoculation scheme at a multiplicity of infection of 1000 had an 8 h bacterial count 2.08 log₁₀ units below the control and a rise from its own baseline 0.45 log₁₀ units smaller than the control; starting counts differed with the inoculation schemes. Sequencing generated 2,461,307 raw and 2,377,351 filtered read pairs. The 44,239 bp assembly contained no ambiguous bases, had a GC content of 35.38% and contained 69 GeneMarkS-predicted coding sequences with 93.13% nonoverlapping genomic coverage. Genomic annotations supported temperate potential; general protein-product discrepancies qualified the interpretation of negative database screens. The existing 20-genome comparison contained 383 gene clusters, including 11 strict core clusters.Conclusions SJP49-2 exhibited antibacterial and biofilm-biomass-reducing phenotypes under the tested conditions. The beef observations were consistent with growth limitation within the tested inoculation schemes. Its genomic features and candidate antibacterial proteins provide a basis for further investigation of phage–host interactions and food-related biocontrol.
articles.abstract_zh: 背景生物膜使食品相关环境中金黄色葡萄球菌的控制变得复杂，并且不同菌株对噬菌体的敏感性不同。本研究利用形态学、92 个实验室维护菌株的裂解覆盖率、环境稳定性、培养物繁殖、浮游生长、生物膜生物量和牛肉表面模型来表征噬菌体 SJP49-2。对宿主和噬菌体基因组进行了分析，并将 SJP49-2 与 19 个参考噬菌体基因组进行了比较。表型测定作为单一实验进行，并进行了技术复制和描述性分析。结果 SJP49-2 显示对 92 个菌株中的 64 个菌株进行裂解 (69.57%)。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 背景生物膜使食品相关环境中金黄色葡萄球菌的控制变得复杂，并且不同菌株对噬菌体的敏感性不同。本研究利用形态学、92 个实验室维护菌株的裂解覆盖率、环境稳定性、培养物繁殖、浮游生长、生物膜生物量和牛肉表面模型来表征噬菌体 SJP49-2。对宿主和噬菌体基因组进行了分析，并将 SJP49-2 与 19 个参考噬菌体基因组进行了比较。表型测定作为单一实验进行，并进行了技术复制和描述性分析。结果 SJP49-2 显示对 92 个菌株中的 64 个菌株进行裂解 (69.57%)。在最高测试剂量下，生物膜形成期间和已建立的生物膜处理后的结晶紫信号分别比对照低 79.36% 和 94.80%。在牛肉中，感染复数为 1000 的接种方案的 8 小时细菌计数比对照低 2.08 log10 单位，并且从其自身基线的上升比对照小 0.45 log10 单位；起始计数因接种方案而异。测序生成 2,461,307 个原始读段对和 2,377,351 个过滤读段对。 44,239 bp 的组装体不含歧义碱基，GC 含量为 35.38%，包含 69 个 GeneMarkS 预测的编码序列，非重叠基因组覆盖率为 93.13%。基因组注释支持温带潜力；一般蛋白质-产品差异限定了阴性数据库筛选的解释。现有20个基因组比较包含383个基因簇，其中11个严格核心簇。结论SJP49-2在测试条件下表现出抗菌和生物膜生物量减少表型。牛肉观察结果与测试接种方案内的生长限制一致。其基因组特征和候选抗菌蛋白为进一步研究噬菌体-宿主相互作用和食品相关生物防治提供了基础。

articles.title: Agroforestry enhances soil quality and carbon storage with carbon-credit potential across contrasting land-use systems in the Western Ghats
articles.title_zh: 农林业通过西高止山脉对比土地利用系统的碳信用潜力提高土壤质量和碳储存
articles.abstract: Agroforestry systems can improve soil quality and carbon storage while generating additional economic value through carbon financing. This study evaluated forest, coffee agroforestry (Coffee AF), rubber agroforestry (Rubber AF), mango agroforestry (Mango AF), and sole-cropping systems for soil quality, soil organic carbon (SOC) storage, biomass carbon accumulation, and indicative carbon-finance potential in the Western Ghats of Karnataka, India. SOC was assessed throughout the soil profile to capture both surface and subsurface carbon pools. Soil quality index (SQI) was higher under Coffee AF (0.655), Rubber AF (0.617), and Mango AF (0.550) than sole cropping (0.499) at 0–30 cm. Surface SOC stocks ranged from 16.6 to 88.3 Mg C ha⁻¹, with Coffee AF showing greater surface SOC storage, whereas Rubber AF recorded the highest deep-soil carbon storage. Relative to sole cropping, annual soil-C accumulation potential was 8.1, 3.8 and 0.76 t CO₂e ha⁻¹ yr⁻¹ at 0–30 cm and 4.41, 5.17 and 4.12 t CO₂e ha⁻¹ yr⁻¹ at 30–100 cm for Coffee AF, Rubber AF and Mango AF, respectively. Biomass carbon reached 68.9, 28.8 and 22.5 t C ha⁻¹ in Rubber AF, Coffee AF and Mango AF, with annual woody biomass removal potentials of 11.8, 4.6 and 3.7 t CO₂e ha⁻¹ yr⁻¹, respectively. Indicative gross carbon-finance value was highest for Rubber AF (USD 415.5 ha⁻¹ yr⁻¹), followed by Coffee AF (USD 338.3) and Mango AF (USD 167.3). Overall, agroforestry provides combined soil, carbon-storage and economic benefits, with Rubber AF particularly promising for deep-soil carbon storage and carbon-finance potential.
articles.abstract_zh: 农林业系统可以改善土壤质量和碳储存，同时通过碳融资产生额外的经济价值。本研究评估了印度卡纳塔克邦西高止山脉的森林、咖啡农林业 (Coffee AF)、橡胶农林业 (Rubber AF)、芒果农林业 (Mango AF) 和单一种植系统的土壤质量、土壤有机碳 (SOC) 储存、生物量碳积累和指示性碳融资潜力。对整个土壤剖面的 SOC 进行评估，以捕获地表和地下碳库。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 农林业系统可以改善土壤质量和碳储存，同时通过碳融资产生额外的经济价值。本研究评估了印度卡纳塔克邦西高止山脉的森林、咖啡农林业 (Coffee AF)、橡胶农林业 (Rubber AF)、芒果农林业 (Mango AF) 和单一种植系统的土壤质量、土壤有机碳 (SOC) 储存、生物量碳积累和指示性碳融资潜力。对整个土壤剖面的 SOC 进行评估，以捕获地表和地下碳库。在 0-30 厘米处，咖啡 AF (0.655)、橡胶 AF (0.617) 和芒果 AF (0.550) 的土壤质量指数 (SQI) 高于单作 (0.499)。表面 SOC 储量范围为 16.6 至 88.3 Mg C ha⁻1，其中咖啡 AF 显示出更大的表面 SOC 存储量，而橡胶 AF 记录了最高的深层土壤碳存储量。相对于单作，咖啡 AF、橡胶 AF 和芒果 AF 在 0-30 cm 处的土壤年碳积累潜力分别为 8.1、3.8 和 0.76 t CO2e ha⁻1 年，在 30-100 cm 处分别为 4.41、5.17 和 4.12 t CO2e ha⁻1 年。橡胶AF、咖啡AF和芒果AF的生物质碳达到68.9、28.8和22.5吨C ha⁻1，年木本生物量去除潜力分别为11.8、4.6和3.7吨CO2e ha⁻1年。橡胶 AF 的指示性碳融资总额最高（每公顷每年 415.5 美元），其次是咖啡 AF（338.3 美元）和芒果 AF（167.3 美元）。总体而言，农林业提供了土壤、碳储存和经济效益的综合效益，而橡胶AF在深层土壤碳储存和碳融资潜力方面尤其有前景。

articles.title: Agulhas Current Variability and Ocean Heat Transport Implications for Regional Climate Variability and Extreme Ocean Conditions
articles.title_zh: 厄加勒斯海流变化和海洋热传输对区域气候变化和极端海洋条件的影响
articles.abstract: The Agulhas Current is one of the strongest western boundary currents of the global ocean and plays a fundamental role in the exchange of heat and salt between the Indian and Atlantic Oceans through the Agulhas leakage system. Variability in the current influences regional circulation, inter-basin exchange, and potentially the Atlantic Meridional Overturning Circulation (AMOC). Despite its climatic importance, the relative roles of atmospheric forcing, large-scale climate variability, and intrinsic ocean dynamics in controlling Agulhas Current transport remain incompletely understood. This study investigates the mean structure, transport variability, heat transport characteristics, and forcing mechanisms of the Agulhas Current using an Eulerian framework based on ocean reanalysis and atmospheric datasets. The mean circulation is characterized by a narrow, surface-intensified western boundary current extending to depths of approximately 800–1000 m, followed by a pronounced retroflection south of Africa. Volume transport estimates reveal a persistent southward flow with a mean transport of approximately 63 Sv and substantial variability (standard deviation ≈ 21 Sv), indicating a highly dynamic current system. Spectral and time-series analyses show that variability is dominated by interannual and longer-timescale fluctuations, with only weak seasonal modulation and no significant long-term trend. Comparison with the Niño-3.4 and Dipole Mode Index (DMI) indicates episodic correspondence with ENSO and Indian Ocean Dipole variability, but no robust or consistent relationship. Heat transport diagnostics demonstrate that the Agulhas Current is a major pathway for poleward heat redistribution in the southwestern Indian Ocean. Meridional heat transport is strongly concentrated within the upper ocean and closely follows the velocity structure of the current, indicating that variations in current strength directly modulate thermal energy transport. Analysis of wind stress curl reveals only a weak relationship with transport variability (r ≈ 0.11), with no significant lagged response or coherent spatial structure, suggesting that local atmospheric forcing plays a minor role in controlling transport fluctuations. Composite analyses of extreme transport states show that variability is primarily associated with changes in current intensity rather than shifts in position. High-transport periods are characterized by a strengthened and coherent current core, whereas low-transport periods exhibit weakened and fragmented flow structures. These results indicate that Agulhas Current variability is governed predominantly by intrinsic ocean dynamics, mesoscale instability, and large-scale circulation adjustments rather than direct local wind forcing.
articles.abstract_zh: 厄加勒斯洋流是全球海洋最强的西边界洋流之一，通过厄加勒斯渗漏系统在印度洋和大西洋之间的热量和盐交换中发挥着基础作用。洋流的变化会影响区域环流、流域间交换，并可能影响大西洋经向翻转环流 (AMOC)。尽管其对气候具有重要意义，但大气强迫、大规模气候变率和内在海洋动力学在控制厄加勒斯洋流输送方面的相对作用仍不完全清楚。本研究使用基于海洋再分析和大气数据集的欧拉框架，研究了厄加勒斯洋流的平均结构、输运变化、热输运特征和强迫机制。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 厄加勒斯洋流是全球海洋最强的西边界洋流之一，通过厄加勒斯渗漏系统在印度洋和大西洋之间的热量和盐交换中发挥着基础作用。洋流的变化会影响区域环流、流域间交换，并可能影响大西洋经向翻转环流 (AMOC)。尽管其对气候具有重要意义，但大气强迫、大规模气候变率和内在海洋动力学在控制厄加勒斯洋流输送方面的相对作用仍不完全清楚。本研究使用基于海洋再分析和大气数据集的欧拉框架，研究了厄加勒斯洋流的平均结构、输运变化、热输运特征和强迫机制。平均环流的特点是狭窄、表面强化的西边界流延伸至约 800-1000 米的深度，随后在非洲南部出现明显的逆反射。体积输运估计揭示了持续向南的流动，平均输运约为 63 Sv 和显着的变化（标准差 ≈ 21 Sv），表明存在高度动态的水流系统。光谱和时间序列分析表明，变异性以年际和较长时间尺度的波动为主，只有微弱的季节性调制，没有显着的长期趋势。与 Niño-3.4 和偶极模态指数 (DMI) 的比较表明，与 ENSO 和印度洋偶极子变率存在偶发性对应关系，但没有稳健或一致的关系。热传输诊断表明，厄加勒斯洋流是西南印度洋向极地热量重新分配的主要通道。经向热传输强烈集中在上层海洋内，并密切遵循洋流的速度结构，表明洋流强度的变化直接调节热能传输。风应力旋度分析表明，与输运变化的关系较弱（r ≈ 0.11），没有显着的滞后响应或相干的空间结构，表明局部大气强迫在控制输运波动中起着次要作用。极端输运状态的综合分析表明，变异性主要与电流强度的变化有关，而不是与位置的变化有关。高输运周期的特点是增强和相干的电流核心，而低输运周期则表现出减弱和分散的流动结构。这些结果表明，厄加勒斯洋流的变化主要受内在海洋动力学、中尺度不稳定性和大规模环流调整的影响，而不是直接的局部风力强迫。

articles.title: Impact of in vitro exposure to 5G-modulated 3.5 GHz fields on human forebrain organoids
articles.title_zh: 体外暴露于 5G 调制 3.5 GHz 场对人类前脑类器官的影响
articles.abstract: The development of 5G mobile technology exposes populations to electromagnetic fields at 3.5 GHz, raising concerns about their effects on human brain development. Most studies on the cerebral effects of radiofrequencies have used rodents, despite major differences between human and rodent corticogenesis, including progenitor subtypes and maturation timing. Here, 40-day-old human forebrain organoids, with actively proliferating apical and basal neural progenitors, were exposed to 5G-modulated 3.5 GHz radiofrequencies at an average specific absorption rate (SAR) of 1.5 W/kg. Effects on neural and glial development were assessed at 7 and 13 weeks using immunocytochemistry and RNA sequencing. Exposed and control organoids showed comparable size and morphology. Progenitor subtype identity and number, proliferation, and apoptotic death rates were similar at both stages. No significant differences were observed in the proportions of cortical neurons, oligodendrocytes, or astrocytes. Transcriptomic analysis confirmed neuronal maturation from 7 to 13 weeks but revealed no significant change in gene expression following exposure. These findings suggest that, under the in vitro conditions tested, 5G-modulated 3.5 GHz radiofrequencies have no major effect on human forebrain organoid development.
articles.abstract_zh: 5G 移动技术的发展使人们暴露在 3.5 GHz 的电磁场中，引发了人们对其对人类大脑发育影响的担忧。大多数关于射频对大脑影响的研究都使用啮齿类动物，尽管人类和啮齿类动物的皮质生成之间存在重大差异，包括祖细胞亚型和成熟时间。在这里，40 天大的人类前脑类器官（具有活跃增殖的顶端和基底神经祖细胞）暴露于 5G 调制的 3.5 GHz 射频，平均比吸收率 (SAR) 为 1.5 W/kg。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 5G 移动技术的发展使人们暴露在 3.5 GHz 的电磁场中，引发了人们对其对人类大脑发育影响的担忧。大多数关于射频对大脑影响的研究都使用啮齿类动物，尽管人类和啮齿类动物的皮质生成之间存在重大差异，包括祖细胞亚型和成熟时间。在这里，40 天大的人类前脑类器官（具有活跃增殖的顶端和基底神经祖细胞）暴露于 5G 调制的 3.5 GHz 射频，平均比吸收率 (SAR) 为 1.5 W/kg。在第 7 周和第 13 周时，使用免疫细胞化学和 RNA 测序评估了对神经和神经胶质发育的影响。暴露的和对照的类器官显示出相当的大小和形态。两个阶段的祖细胞亚型身份和数量、增殖和凋亡死亡率相似。皮质神经元、少突胶质细胞或星形胶质细胞的比例没有观察到显着差异。转录组分析证实神经元在 7 至 13 周内成熟，但暴露后基因表达没有显着变化。这些发现表明，在体外测试条件下，5G 调制的 3.5 GHz 射频对人类前脑类器官的发育没有重大影响。

articles.title: Enhanced Ionic Conductivity in Polyvinyl Alcohol-Based Gel Polymer Electrolytes with Titanium dioxide Nanofillers
articles.title_zh: 使用二氧化钛纳米填料增强聚乙烯醇基凝胶聚合物电解质的离子电导率
articles.abstract: The development for advanced polymer electrolytes with high ionic conductivity is crucial for replacing traditional liquid electrolytes in energy conversion systems that often suffer from leakage. Gel polymer electrolytes (GPEs) offer a safer and more stable alternative, yet their performance is restricted by the high crystallinity of polymer. In this study, a polyvinyl alcohol (PVA)-based electrolyte system was developed comprising potassium iodide (KI) in ethylene carbonate (EC) and propylene carbonate (PC), and dimethyl sulfoxide (DMSO) solvent. Titanium dioxide (TiO₂) nanofillers at varying concentrations were introduced to analyze their effect on electrolyte properties. Structural and electrochemical characterizations were carried out using X-ray diffraction (XRD), Fourier-transform infrared spectroscopy (FTIR), and electrochemical impedance spectroscopy (EIS). XRD analysis revealed a significant reduction in crystallinity with TiO₂ incorporation, whereas FTIR demonstrated strong interactions between polymer, salt, and filler. Ionic conductivity increased significantly with nanofiller addition, reaching a maximum of 10.4 mS cm⁻1 at 4 wt.% TiO2. These findings highlight the beneficial effect of nanofillers in high-conductivity GPEs, offering the promising potential for developing a safe and efficient gel electrolyte in electrochemical systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 开发具有高离子电导率的先进聚合物电解质对于取代经常发生泄漏的能量转换系统中的传统液体电解质至关重要。凝胶聚合物电解质（GPE）提供了一种更安全、更稳定的替代品，但其性能受到聚合物高结晶度的限制。在这项研究中，开发了一种基于聚乙烯醇（PVA）的电解质体系，包含碳酸亚乙酯（EC）和碳酸亚丙酯（PC）中的碘化钾（KI）以及二甲基亚砜（DMSO）溶剂。引入不同浓度的二氧化钛 (TiO2) 纳米填料来分析它们对电解质性能的影响。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 开发具有高离子电导率的先进聚合物电解质对于取代经常发生泄漏的能量转换系统中的传统液体电解质至关重要。凝胶聚合物电解质（GPE）提供了一种更安全、更稳定的替代品，但其性能受到聚合物高结晶度的限制。在这项研究中，开发了一种基于聚乙烯醇（PVA）的电解质体系，包含碳酸亚乙酯（EC）和碳酸亚丙酯（PC）中的碘化钾（KI）以及二甲基亚砜（DMSO）溶剂。引入不同浓度的二氧化钛 (TiO2) 纳米填料来分析它们对电解质性能的影响。使用 X 射线衍射 (XRD)、傅里叶变换红外光谱 (FTIR) 和电化学阻抗谱 (EIS) 进行结构和电化学表征。 XRD 分析显示，TiO2 的掺入使结晶度显着降低，而 FTIR 则表明聚合物、盐和填料之间存在很强的相互作用。添加纳米填料后离子电导率显着增加，在 4 wt.% TiO2 时达到最大值 10.4 mS cm-1。这些发现强调了纳米填料在高电导率 GPE 中的有益作用，为在电化学系统中开发安全高效的凝胶电解质提供了广阔的前景。

articles.title: Improvement of dielectric and structural characteristics of Nanofiller (Ba0.92Sr0.08 )TiO3 Ceramics combined with epoxy as composites for dielectric purposes
articles.title_zh: 纳米填料 (Ba0.92Sr0.08 )TiO3 陶瓷与环氧树脂相结合作为介电用途复合材料的介电和结构特性的改善
articles.abstract: Polymer Nano composites were created by reinforcing epoxy with barium titanate (B0.92 S0.08) TiO3, boasting high dielectric strength. These composites showcased significant alterations in their dielectric capabilities, influenced by time, temperature, and concentration. The research delved into epoxy resin composites, exploring how the ratio of BST nanoparticles affected the dielectric strength concerning the epoxy aspect ratio. Epoxy was combined with nano filler titanate (B0.92 S0.08) TiO3 Ceramics at various BST to epoxy ratios of 0%, 2.5%, 5%, 7%, and 100%, with the mixture left to cure in an oven at temperatures of 40°C, 50°C, 60°C, and 80°C for durations ranging from 10 to 50 minutes. The temperature was consistently set at 50°C, while curing times varied from 10 to 50 minutes. The study also delved into the mechanical bonding mechanisms between BST and epoxy polymer. Techniques such as Scanning Electron Microscopy (SEM) and Transmission Electron Microscopy (TEM) were employed to study delaminated layers, inspect fracture surfaces, and assess structural features and dielectric strength. Discussions revolved around the impacts of concentration, particle size, and BST filler on the dielectric properties of BST/polymer composites. Artificial Neural Networks, known as ANNs, mimic the intricate workings of the human brain to delve into the realms of ceramic/polymer composites' dielectric constants and the crafting of BST/polymer composites. Delving deeper, the enhancement of dielectric constants in BST/polymer composites is succinctly outlined. A novel theoretical model focusing on dielectric constants, drawn from our prior research endeavors, is presented. Furthermore, the impacts of various factors on the dielectric constants of these composites are explored, aiding in the forecast of their dielectric constants. This discussion holds significant theoretical and research implications for future endeavors.
articles.abstract_zh: 聚合物纳米复合材料是通过用钛酸钡 (B0.92 S0.08) TiO3 增强环氧树脂而制成的，具有高介电强度。这些复合材料的介电能力受时间、温度和浓度的影响而发生显着变化。该研究深入研究了环氧树脂复合材料，探讨了 BST 纳米粒子的比例如何影响环氧树脂长径比的介电强度。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 聚合物纳米复合材料是通过用钛酸钡 (B0.92 S0.08) TiO3 增强环氧树脂而制成的，具有高介电强度。这些复合材料的介电能力受时间、温度和浓度的影响而发生显着变化。该研究深入研究了环氧树脂复合材料，探讨了 BST 纳米粒子的比例如何影响环氧树脂长径比的介电强度。将环氧树脂与纳米填料钛酸酯 (B0.92 S0.08) TiO3 陶瓷以 0%、2.5%、5%、7% 和 100% 的各种 BST 与环氧树脂比例混合，并将混合物在温度为 40°C、50°C、60°C 和 80°C 的烘箱中固化，持续时间为 10 至 50 分钟。温度始终设定在 50°C，而固化时间从 10 到 50 分钟不等。该研究还深入研究了 BST 和环氧聚合物之间的机械粘合机制。采用扫描电子显微镜 (SEM) 和透射电子显微镜 (TEM) 等技术来研究分层、检查断裂表面并评估结构特征和介电强度。讨论围绕浓度、粒径和 BST 填料对 BST/聚合物复合材料介电性能的影响展开。人工神经网络（称为 ANN）模仿人脑的复杂工作原理，深入研究陶瓷/聚合物复合材料的介电常数和 BST/聚合物复合材料的制作领域。深入研究后，简明扼要地概述了 BST/聚合物复合材料介电常数的增强。提出了一种基于介电常数的新颖理论模型，该模型源自我们之前的研究成果。此外，还探讨了各种因素对这些复合材料介电常数的影响，有助于预测其介电常数。这一讨论对未来的努力具有重要的理论和研究意义。

articles.title: PEC-backed absorber for multiband applications ranging from 8 GHz to 40 GHz
articles.title_zh: 适用于 8 GHz 至 40 GHz 多频段应用的 PEC 支持吸收器
articles.abstract: In this paper, a compact multi-ring metasurface is proposed for multi-notch transmission over a wide frequency range of 8–40 GHz. The structure consists of concentric split-ring resonators with different radii and auxiliary coupling rings, where the resonant response is controlled by the effective inductance, capacitance, and electromagnetic coupling between the resonating elements. The design is developed through a nine-stage evolution, and an equivalent coupled-RLC model is used to explain the origin of the observed resonances. The structure also exhibits similar responses under TE and TM polarizations, indicating polarization-insensitive behavior. Further, the effects of stacking, relative displacement, air-gap separation, and rotation between metasurface layers are investigated, demonstrating additional control over the resonant transmission characteristics.
articles.abstract_zh: 在本文中，提出了一种紧凑的多环超表面，用于在 8-40 GHz 的宽频率范围内进行多凹口传输。该结构由不同半径的同心开环谐振器和辅助耦合环组成，其中谐振响应由谐振元件之间的有效电感、电容和电磁耦合控制。该设计经过九阶段的演变，并使用等效耦合 RLC 模型来解释观察到的共振的起源。该结构在 TE 和 TM 偏振下也表现出类似的响应，表明对偏振不敏感的行为。此外，还研究了超表面层之间的堆叠、相对位移、气隙分离和旋转的影响，证明了对谐振传输特性的额外控制。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在本文中，提出了一种紧凑的多环超表面，用于在 8-40 GHz 的宽频率范围内进行多凹口传输。该结构由不同半径的同心开环谐振器和辅助耦合环组成，其中谐振响应由谐振元件之间的有效电感、电容和电磁耦合控制。该设计经过九阶段的演变，并使用等效耦合 RLC 模型来解释观察到的共振的起源。该结构在 TE 和 TM 偏振下也表现出类似的响应，表明对偏振不敏感的行为。此外，还研究了超表面层之间的堆叠、相对位移、气隙分离和旋转的影响，证明了对谐振传输特性的额外控制。

articles.title: Electrospun Cellulose Acetate Mats Mimic Nature for Oil–Water Sorption and Separation
articles.title_zh: 静电纺丝醋酸纤维素垫模仿自然的油水吸附和分离
articles.abstract: Oil contamination presents persistent environmental challenges, motivating the development of effective sorbents from alternative and sustainable materials. This study investigates electrospun cellulose acetate (CA) mats for oil sorption, examining the effects of polymer composition, precursor concentration, and electrospinning throughput. Pure CA and CA/polyvinylpyrrolidone (PVP) composite mats were fabricated and evaluated using gravimetric measurements and ultraviolet–visible (UV–Vis) analysis. Pure CA exhibited substantially greater oil sorption than the CA/PVP composite, while increasing CA concentration from 10.0% to 15.0% produced the greatest improvement in oil uptake. The 15.0% CA formulation achieved an average gravimetric oil-sorption capacity approximately three times that reported for conventional polypropylene sorbents. Standard and high-throughput electrospinning of 10.0% CA yielded comparable performance, supporting the scalability of the fabrication process. Inspired by the Salvinia effect, in which specialized aquatic fern surfaces combine water repellency with air retention, these CA mats integrate high apparent water repellency and oil uptake within a single material produced through a single-step process. This approach demonstrates the potential of electrospun CA as a scalable biomimetic sorbent for oil–water separation, translating complementary biological functions into a practical fibrous architecture.
articles.abstract_zh: 石油污染带来了持续的环境挑战，促使人们利用替代和可持续材料开发有效的吸附剂。本研究研究了静电纺丝醋酸纤维素 (CA) 垫的吸油性能，检查了聚合物成分、前体浓度和静电纺丝吞吐量的影响。使用重量测量和紫外可见 (UV-Vis) 分析来制造和评估纯 CA 和 CA/聚乙烯吡咯烷酮 (PVP) 复合垫。纯 CA 比 CA/PVP 复合材料表现出更大的吸油量，而将 CA 浓度从 10.0% 增加到 15.0% 可以最大程度地提高吸油量。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 石油污染带来了持续的环境挑战，促使人们利用替代和可持续材料开发有效的吸附剂。本研究研究了静电纺丝醋酸纤维素 (CA) 垫的吸油性能，检查了聚合物成分、前体浓度和静电纺丝吞吐量的影响。使用重量测量和紫外可见 (UV-Vis) 分析来制造和评估纯 CA 和 CA/聚乙烯吡咯烷酮 (PVP) 复合垫。纯 CA 比 CA/PVP 复合材料表现出更大的吸油量，而将 CA 浓度从 10.0% 增加到 15.0% 可以最大程度地提高吸油量。 15.0% CA 配方的平均重量油吸附能力约为传统聚丙烯吸附剂的三倍。 10.0% CA 的标准和高通量静电纺丝产生了可比的性能，支持了制造工艺的可扩展性。受萨尔维尼亚效应（Salvinia 效应）的启发，特殊的水生蕨类植物表面将防水性与气密性结合在一起，这些 CA 垫将高表观防水性和吸油性集成到通过一步工艺生产的单一材料中。这种方法展示了电纺CA作为可扩展的仿生吸附剂用于油水分离的潜力，将互补的生物功能转化为实用的纤维结构。

articles.title: DPI-score: a deep learning-based metric for assessing protein-protein interfaces in cryoEM derived assemblies

articles.abstract: Nature Communications, Published online: 14 November 2026; doi:10.1038/s41467-026-79090-8 The study introduces deep learning-based protein-protein interfaces’ quality score- DPI-score, that uses only structural coordinates, without engineered interface features. It provides complementary validation and detects errors at interfaces.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究引入了基于深度学习的蛋白质-蛋白质界面的质量评分——DPI-score，该评分仅使用结构坐标，没有工程化的界面特征。它提供补充验证并检测接口处的错误。

articles.title: Chirality-locked low-dimensional bound states in the continuum lasers
articles.title_zh: 连续谱激光器中手性锁定的低维束缚态
