articles.title: Seismic Resilience Quantification of Steel Storage Tanks: Integrating Fragility, Recovery Time, and Mitigation Strategies
articles.title_zh: 钢制储罐的抗震能力量化：综合脆弱性、恢复时间和缓解策略
articles.abstract: While traditional seismic assessments of storage tanks focus primarily on structural failure probabilities, a comprehensive evaluation of resilience must also account for post-earthquake functionality loss and recovery time. This study proposes a quantitative framework to assess the seismic resilience of a (:32,000:m³) steel storage tank. Using the results of detailed nonlinear finite element analyses and Incremental Dynamic Analysis (IDA), seismic fragility curves were developed for four damage states (Slight, Moderate, Extensive, and Complete). A resilience loss function was formulated by integrating the discrete probability of damage, the immediate loss of functionality, and the expected recovery time for each damage state. A Resilience Index (RI) was then calculated to compare the effectiveness of four different scenarios: the as-built unanchored tank, an anchored tank, a base-isolated tank, and an anchored tank operating at a reduced fill level ((:50%)). The results indicate that the as-built unanchored configuration has a moderate resilience index (RI = (:0.62)). The implementation of base isolation provided the most significant enhancement in resilience (RI = (:0.86), classified as "Excellent"), closely followed by the combination of anchorage and reduced fill level (RI = (:0.82)). The resilience loss increased drastically from 15 functionality-days for slight damage to (:18,000) functionality-days for complete failure. The proposed framework provides a practical, risk-informed tool for facility managers to prioritize retrofit investments and enhance the post-earthquake continuity of critical energy infrastructure.
articles.abstract_zh: 虽然传统的储罐地震评估主要关注结构失效概率，但对弹性的综合评估还必须考虑震后功能损失和恢复时间。本研究提出了一个评估 (:32,000:m³) 钢储罐抗震能力的定量框架。利用详细的非线性有限元分析和增量动力分析 (IDA) 的结果，开发了四种损伤状态（轻微、中度、广泛和完全）的地震易损性曲线。通过整合离散的损坏概率、立即功能损失以及每个损坏状态的预期恢复时间，制定了弹性损失函数。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 虽然传统的储罐地震评估主要关注结构失效概率，但对弹性的综合评估还必须考虑震后功能损失和恢复时间。本研究提出了一个评估 (:32,000:m³) 钢储罐抗震能力的定量框架。利用详细的非线性有限元分析和增量动力分析 (IDA) 的结果，开发了四种损伤状态（轻微、中度、广泛和完全）的地震易损性曲线。通过整合离散的损坏概率、立即功能损失以及每个损坏状态的预期恢复时间，制定了弹性损失函数。然后计算弹性指数 (RI)，以比较四种不同情况的有效性：已建成的非锚定储罐、锚定储罐、基础隔离储罐以及在降低填充水平 ((:50%)) 下运行的锚定储罐。结果表明，竣工的非锚固结构具有中等的弹性指数（RI =（：0.62））。基础隔离的实施提供了最显着的弹性增强（RI =（：0.86），分类为“优秀”），紧随其后的是锚固和降低填充水平的组合（RI =（：0.82））。弹性损失从轻微损坏的 15 个功能日急剧增加到完全故障的 (18,000) 个功能日。拟议的框架为设施管理者提供了一个实用的、风险提示的工具，可以优先考虑改造投资并增强关键能源基础设施的震后连续性。

articles.title: Regional Ocean Conditions Shape Mesoscale Eddy Thermal Responses to ENSO Diversity in the Subtropical Southeastern Indian Ocean
articles.title_zh: 区域海洋条件影响副热带东南印度洋ENSO多样性的中尺度涡热响应
articles.abstract: Satellite altimetry, Argo profiles, and ocean reanalysis are used to examine mesoscale eddy thermal responses to eastern-Pacific (EP) and central-Pacific (CP) ENSO in the subtropical southeastern Indian Ocean. Anticyclonic temperature anomalies relative to climatology broadly follow regional background changes. During EP-El Niño, eastern subsurface cooling and central shallow warming coincide with weaker eastern but strong central warm-core anomalies. Leeuwin Current variations suggest that changes in poleward warm-water transport contribute to the eastern temperature response. Cyclonic eddies retain subsurface cold cores under all four ENSO conditions, with pronounced upper-ocean warming producing a warm-over-cold structure during CP-La Niña. Subtracting matched contemporaneous out-of-eddy temperatures preserves these cores and their greater depth in the central sector. The ENSO–shear relationship is stronger for meridional than zonal shear in the eastern Leeuwin Current–Leeuwin Undercurrent system, whereas zonal shear in the central South Indian Countercurrent–South Equatorial Current system is associated with both ENSO indices. These shear changes may affect eddy development through baroclinic instability. Approximately 15–17% of eastern-origin eddies propagate into the central sector and may retain thermal properties acquired upstream. Regional background temperature thus helps explain anticyclonic thermal contrasts, while circulation adjustments and westward propagation may also contribute to subsurface thermal variability.
articles.abstract_zh: 卫星测高、Argo 剖面和海洋再分析用于研究印度洋东南部副热带东太平洋 (EP) 和中太平洋 (CP) ENSO 的中尺度涡流热响应。与气候学相关的反气旋温度异常大致遵循区域背景变化。东部型厄尔尼诺期间，东部次表层变冷和中部浅层变暖与东部较弱但中部较强的暖核异常同时发生。卢纹海流的变化表明，极地暖水输送的变化有助于东部的温度响应。在所有四种 ENSO 条件下，气旋涡流都保留了地下冷核心，在中部拉尼娜期间，上层海洋明显变暖，产生暖冷结构。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 卫星测高、Argo 剖面和海洋再分析用于研究印度洋东南部副热带东太平洋 (EP) 和中太平洋 (CP) ENSO 的中尺度涡流热响应。与气候学相关的反气旋温度异常大致遵循区域背景变化。东部型厄尔尼诺期间，东部次表层变冷和中部浅层变暖与东部较弱但中部较强的暖核异常同时发生。卢纹海流的变化表明，极地暖水输送的变化有助于东部的温度响应。在所有四种 ENSO 条件下，气旋涡流都保留了地下冷核心，在中部拉尼娜期间，上层海洋明显变暖，产生暖冷结构。减去匹配的同期涡流外温度可以保留这些核心及其在中心区域的更大深度。在东部卢文海流-卢文潜流系统中，经向切变的 ENSO-切变关系比纬向切变更强，而南印度逆流-南赤道海流系统中部的纬向切变与这两个 ENSO 指数都有关联。这些剪切变化可能会通过斜压不稳定性影响涡流的发展。大约 15-17% 的东部涡流传播到中心区域，并可能保留上游获得的热特性。因此，区域背景温度有助于解释反气旋热对比，而环流调整和向西传播也可能有助于地下热变率。

articles.title: Layer-Dependent Degradation of Surface-Coated PMMA: Interplay Between Fabrication Method, Simulated Toothbrushing on Surface Roughness and Color Stability
articles.title_zh: 表面涂层 PMMA 的层依赖性降解：制造方法、模拟牙刷对表面粗糙度和颜色稳定性之间的相互作用
articles.abstract: Background Surface coatings are used to improve the surface and optical properties of provisional restorations, but how the number of coating layers affects their durability across PMMA fabrication methods remains unclear. This in vitro study evaluated the effects of coating-layer number and fabrication method on surface roughness, coating thickness, and color change after simulated toothbrushing.Methods Eighty-one PMMA specimens (10 × 10 × 3 mm) were fabricated by milling, 3D printing, or auto-polymerization and coated with one, two, or three layers of Optiglaze Color (n = 9 per subgroup). Surface roughness (Ra), incremental layer thickness, and color (CIELab) were evaluated before and after 10,000 toothbrushing cycles, and coating cross-sections were examined by scanning electron microscopy (SEM). Data were analyzed using ANOVA (α = 0.05).Results Baseline Ra was highest in auto-polymerized (2.50 ± 0.74 µm), intermediate in 3D-printed (1.36 ± 0.35 µm), and lowest in milled (0.70 ± 0.33 µm) specimens. SEM showed that cumulative coating thickness increased from approximately 100 to 200 µm with additional layers. Coating application reduced Ra in all groups except the one-layer milled group. After brushing, Ra increased significantly in most groups, most markedly in the one- and two-layer milled groups, whereas the three-layer coating maintained the lowest Ra values. Thickness of the C Plus and Clear HV layers decreased significantly in the milled and auto-polymerized groups but not in the 3D-printed group. ΔE* remained ≤ 3.3 except in the three-layer 3D-printed and auto-polymerized groups, and coating-layer number, but not fabrication method, significantly affected ΔE*.Conclusions Within the limitations of this in vitro study, multilayer coatings were associated with lower Ra after toothbrushing than the single-layer coating, although Ra still increased significantly in several multilayer groups. Thickness loss varied according to the fabrication method and layer, and the three-layer coating exceeded the acceptable color threshold in two methods. The benefit of additional layers should be weighed against both surface durability and color stability.
articles.abstract_zh: 背景 表面涂层用于改善临时修复体的表面和光学性能，但涂层的数量如何影响其在 PMMA 制造方法中的耐用性仍不清楚。这项体外研究评估了涂层层数和制造方法对模拟刷牙后表面粗糙度、涂层厚度和颜色变化的影响。方法通过铣削、3D 打印或自动聚合制造 81 个 PMMA 样本 (10 × 10 × 3 mm)，并涂有一层、两层或三层 Optiglaze Color（每组 n = 9）。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 背景 表面涂层用于改善临时修复体的表面和光学性能，但涂层的数量如何影响其在 PMMA 制造方法中的耐用性仍不清楚。这项体外研究评估了涂层层数和制造方法对模拟刷牙后表面粗糙度、涂层厚度和颜色变化的影响。方法通过铣削、3D 打印或自动聚合制造 81 个 PMMA 样本 (10 × 10 × 3 mm)，并涂有一层、两层或三层 Optiglaze Color（每组 n = 9）。在 10,000 次刷牙循环之前和之后评估表面粗糙度 (Ra)、增量层厚度和颜色 (CIELab)，并通过扫描电子显微镜 (SEM) 检查涂层横截面。使用方差分析 (α = 0.05) 分析数据。结果 基线 Ra 在自动聚合样本中最高 (2.50 ± 0.74 µm)，在 3D 打印样本中居中 (1.36 ± 0.35 µm)，在研磨样本中最低 (0.70 ± 0.33 µm)。 SEM 显示，随着层数的增加，累积涂层厚度从大约 100 µm 增加到 200 µm。除一层研磨组外，所有组中的涂层应用均降低了 Ra。刷牙后，大多数组的 Ra 显着增加，其中一层和两层研磨组的 Ra 显着增加，而三层涂层保持最低的 Ra 值。在研磨组和自聚合组中，C Plus 和 Clear HV 层的厚度显着降低，但在 3D 打印组中则没有。除三层 3D 打印组和自聚合组外，ΔE* 保持≤≤3.3，并且涂层层数（而不是制造方法）显着影响 ΔE*。 结论 在本体外研究的限制内，多层涂层与刷牙后的 Ra 低于单层涂层相关，尽管在几个多层组中 Ra 仍然显着增加。厚度损失根据制造方法和层的不同而变化，并且三层涂层在两种方法中超出了可接受的颜色阈值。应权衡附加层的好处与表面耐久性和颜色稳定性。

articles.title: Decoupling of the dynamic and subsurface thermal expressions of the climatological semiannual Rossby wave in the Bay of Bengal
articles.title_zh: 孟加拉湾气候半年罗斯贝波的动力和地下热表达的解耦
articles.abstract: The climatological semiannual Rossby wave of the Bay of Bengal is usually described from altimetric sea level anomaly (SLA) alone, on the assumption that sea level and subsurface temperature are interchangeable. We test this with 22 years (2004–2025) of altimetry and Argo data, using a plane-wave projection, a layer-wise steric decomposition and normal-mode solutions. Coherent westward propagation is confined to 7–11°N, 81–90°E, where direction purity exceeds 0.65. Only the subsurface thermal expression recovers a single freely propagating first-mode wave: the 160 m temperature, the 20°C isotherm depth and the 100–300 m steric height all give a wavelength near 18°, a speed of 12.6–12.9 cm s⁻¹ and 0.97–0.98 of the variance explained by one plane wave. SLA is compressed to 11.8° and 8.3 cm s⁻¹ and drifts in phase by up to 1.1 month, because part of the semiannual steric height is quasi-standing in the upper 100 m; removing that layer restores a 19.7° wave. The apparent amplitude decoupling is a normalization artifact: scaled with the observed thermocline displacement, the westward 160 m temperature component matches heaving to within 9%. Confining mode 1 to a 3° band reproduces the observed speed, whereas the two-dimensional mode is twice as fast, so the along-path speed variation in altimetry reflects interference rather than changing stratification. The winter–spring crest reaches the western boundary in February–April, deepening the thermocline by 10 m, while the summer–autumn event is cancelled by the annual cycle. A single altimetric view can misrepresent a baroclinic wave in a freshwater-influenced basin.
articles.abstract_zh: 孟加拉湾的气候半年罗斯贝波通常仅通过高度海平面异常（SLA）来描述，假设海平面和地下温度可以互换。我们使用平面波投影、分层空间分解和正态模式解决方案，用 22 年（2004-2025 年）的测高和 Argo 数据对此进行了测试。相干向西传播仅限于 7–11°N、81–90°E，方向纯度超过 0.65。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 孟加拉湾的气候半年罗斯贝波通常仅通过高度海平面异常（SLA）来描述，假设海平面和地下温度可以互换。我们使用平面波投影、分层空间分解和正态模式解决方案，用 22 年（2004-2025 年）的测高和 Argo 数据对此进行了测试。相干向西传播仅限于 7–11°N、81–90°E，方向纯度超过 0.65。只有地下热表达式才能恢复单个自由传播的第一模波：160 m 温度、20°C 等温线深度和 100–300 m 空间高度都给出了接近 18° 的波长、12.6–12.9 cm s⁻1 的速度和由一个平面波解释的方差 0.97–0.98。 SLA 被压缩至 11.8° 和 8.3 cm s⁻1，相位漂移长达 1.1 个月，因为半年立体高度的一部分准站立在上部 100 m 内；移除该层可恢复 19.7° 的波。表观振幅解耦是一种归一化伪影：与观测到的温跃层位移成比例，向西 160 m 的温度分量与起伏的匹配度在 9% 以内。将模式 1 限制在 3° 范围内可再现观测到的速度，而二维模式的速度是其两倍，因此测高中的沿路径速度变化反映的是干扰，而不是改变分层。冬春波峰在 2 月至 4 月到达西部边界，使温跃层加深 10 m，而夏秋事件则因年循环而取消。单一的高度测量视图可能会歪曲受淡水影响的盆地中的斜压波。

articles.title: Time-varying mesh stiffness for fast force estimation on cracked and healthy double helical gears
articles.title_zh: 时变啮合刚度，可快速估计有裂纹和健康的双斜齿轮的力
articles.abstract: Time-Varying-Mesh-Stiffness (TVMS) in the context of gearing has traditionally been studied from a theoretical standpoint. This work strives to summarize in a concise manner notable literature pertaining to TVMS and proposes a methodology to extend its utility to the computation of time-dependent forces on gear flanks. This is done by calculating the share of individual tooth stiffnesses to the total mesh stiffness at any given instant of time, and relating this fraction to the instantaneous distribution of forces amongst the teeth in the mesh, under the assumption of parallel spring configuration. In this paper, the effects of the introduction of a crack in the tooth root is also investigated. Gearbox vibrations and premature tooth failure are often accompanied by time‑varying internal loading that occurs during the mesh‑in and mesh‑out phases of gear‑tooth contact. Direct finite‑element analysis of these forces is computationally prohibitive, motivating the development of an analytical framework based on time‑varying mesh stiffness (TVMS). This work presents a comprehensive TVMS model for double‑helical gear pairs that accommodates both healthy and surface‑cracked teeth. Leveraging a slice‑wise decomposition of the gear tooth—where each infinitesimal spur‑slice contributes a series of bending, shear, axial, fillet, and Hertzian compliances—the model yields closed‑form expressions for the stiffness of individual slices and aggregates them to obtain the total mesh stiffness as a function of roll angle. An explicit algorithm guides the workflow from geometry definition through force computation, including the treatment of crack geometry (straight‑line and parabolic limiting lines) and its influence on cross‑sectional area and moment of inertia. The results demonstrate that the TVMS framework provides a rapid, physics‑based alternative to full FEM analyses for evaluating gear‑tooth forces, assessing the impact of defects, and supporting dynamic‑response studies of high‑speed helical and double‑helical gear trains. Future work will focus on experimental validation and extension to multiple or more complex cracks.
articles.abstract_zh: 传统上从理论角度研究齿轮装置中的时变网格刚度 (TVMS)。这项工作力求以简洁的方式总结与 TVMS 相关的著名文献，并提出一种方法，将其实用性扩展到计算齿轮齿面上随时间变化的力。这是通过计算在任何给定时刻单个齿刚度占总啮合刚度的份额，并将该分数与在平行弹簧配置的假设下啮合中齿之间的力的瞬时分布相关联来完成的。在本文中，还研究了在齿根中引入裂纹的影响。齿轮箱振动和过早的齿失效通常伴随着轮齿接触的啮合和啮合阶段发生的时变内部负载。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 传统上从理论角度研究齿轮装置中的时变网格刚度 (TVMS)。这项工作力求以简洁的方式总结与 TVMS 相关的著名文献，并提出一种方法，将其实用性扩展到计算齿轮齿面上随时间变化的力。这是通过计算在任何给定时刻单个齿刚度占总啮合刚度的份额，并将该分数与在平行弹簧配置的假设下啮合中齿之间的力的瞬时分布相关联来完成的。在本文中，还研究了在齿根中引入裂纹的影响。齿轮箱振动和过早的齿失效通常伴随着轮齿接触的啮合和啮合阶段发生的时变内部负载。对这些力进行直接有限元分析在计算上是令人望而却步的，这促使了基于时变网格刚度 (TVMS) 的分析框架的开发。这项工作提出了一个全面的双螺旋齿轮副 TVMS 模型，可以容纳健康的牙齿和表面裂纹的牙齿。利用齿轮齿的切片分解（其中每个无穷小的正切片贡献一系列弯曲、剪切、轴向、圆角和赫兹柔量），该模型生成各个切片刚度的闭合形式表达式，并将它们聚合以获得作为滚动角函数的总网格刚度。显式算法指导从几何定义到力计算的工作流程，包括裂纹几何形状（直线和抛物线限制线）的处理及其对横截面积和惯性矩的影响。结果表明，TVMS 框架提供了一种快速、基于物理的替代完整 FEM 分析的方法，用于评估轮齿力、评估缺陷的影响以及支持高速螺旋和双螺旋齿轮系的动态响应研究。未来的工作将侧重于实验验证和扩展到多个或更复杂的裂缝。

articles.title: Dynamic Stabilization of Biped Robots on Compound Terrains via Upper- Body Compensated Hybrid Switching ZMP Control
articles.title_zh: 通过上半身补偿混合开关 ZMP 控制实现复合地形上双足机器人的动态稳定
articles.abstract: This paper presents a simulation-based study on dynamic stability control of a planar biped robot walking over compound terrains consisting of flat surfaces, inclined planes, and stair steps. The locomotion problem is modeled as a hybrid switching system, in which discrete transitions between single-support and double-support phases are coordinated through a phase-dependent switching control strategy. For each phase, smooth and continuous joint trajectories are generated using cubic spline interpolation. Dynamic balance is assessed and regulated through a Switching Zero- Moment Point (ZMP)-based criterion, where the admissible stability region is updated according to the active support phase and its corresponding support polygon. A key contribution of this work is the integration of upper-body mass compensation into the switching ZMP framework. By explicitly incorporating the torso contribution into the dynamic model and adjusting upper-body motion across gait transitions, corrective moments are generated to keep the ZMP within the admissible region under varying terrain conditions. Simulation results show that the proposed hybrid switching controller improves trajectory tracking, enhances ZMP regulation, and preserves stable locomotion across compound and uneven walking surfaces. .
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种基于仿真的研究，研究平面双足机器人在由平坦表面、斜面和楼梯台阶组成的复合地形上行走的动态稳定性控制。运动问题被建模为混合切换系统，其中单支撑和双支撑阶段之间的离散转换通过阶段相关的切换控制策略进行协调。对于每个阶段，使用三次样条插值生成平滑且连续的关节轨迹。动态平衡通过基于切换零力矩点 (ZMP) 的标准进行评估和调节，其中允许的稳定性区域根据活动支撑相位及其相应的支撑多边形进行更新。这项工作的一个关键贡献是将上身质量补偿集成到切换 ZMP 框架中。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 本文提出了一种基于仿真的研究，研究平面双足机器人在由平坦表面、斜面和楼梯台阶组成的复合地形上行走的动态稳定性控制。运动问题被建模为混合切换系统，其中单支撑和双支撑阶段之间的离散转换通过阶段相关的切换控制策略进行协调。对于每个阶段，使用三次样条插值生成平滑且连续的关节轨迹。动态平衡通过基于切换零力矩点 (ZMP) 的标准进行评估和调节，其中允许的稳定性区域根据活动支撑相位及其相应的支撑多边形进行更新。这项工作的一个关键贡献是将上身质量补偿集成到切换 ZMP 框架中。通过明确地将躯干贡献纳入动态模型并调整步态转换过程中的上半身运动，生成校正力矩以在不同地形条件下将 ZMP 保持在允许区域内。仿真结果表明，所提出的混合开关控制器改善了轨迹跟踪，增强了 ZMP 调节，并在复合和不平坦的行走表面上保持稳定的运动。 。

articles.title: Spatially Resolved Quantification of the Molecular Functionalization Process using Marker Molecules for Device Applications
articles.title_zh: 使用用于设备应用的标记分子对分子功能化过程进行空间分辨量化
articles.abstract: Quantifying molecular functionalization efficiency helps predict key properties such as stability, solubility, surface reactivity and morphology, and the electrical or optical performance of devices. In device engineering, functionalization success is usually judged only at final electrical, electrochemical or optical testing. Earlier indications can come from surface-sensitive techniques such as XPS and AFM, or from contact angle measurements, which while well-established cannot provide calibrated chemical quantification with high spatial resolution. Direct, fast and robust quantification immediately after modification with high spatial resolution is therefore desirable, particularly in multi-step fabrication where functionalization is critical to device function, as in molecular sensors. Here we demonstrate a simple, robust method that requires no sample preparation, using conventional energy-dispersive X-ray (EDX) spectroscopy in a scanning electron microscope (SEM). Sulphur-containing silanes bound to silanol groups on silicon oxide function as EDX markers. By combining this with a detailed treatment of electron beam–substrate interaction at varying incident energies, we obtain calibrated, quantitative data on the functionalization. We also examine the limits of EDX quantification and apply it to map functionalization heterogeneity across the substrate, with numerical estimates of the mapping spatial resolution.
articles.abstract_zh: 量化分子功能化效率有助于预测关键特性，例如稳定性、溶解度、表面反应性和形态，以及器件的电学或光学性能。在设备工程中，功能化是否成功通常仅在最终的电气、电化学或光学测试中进行判断。早期的迹象可以来自表面敏感技术，如 XPS 和 AFM，或来自接触角测量，虽然这些技术已成熟，但无法提供具有高空间分辨率的校准化学定量。因此，在高空间分辨率修饰后立即进行直接、快速和稳健的定量是可取的，特别是在功能化对器件功能至关重要的多步骤制造中，如在分子传感器中。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 量化分子功能化效率有助于预测关键特性，例如稳定性、溶解度、表面反应性和形态，以及器件的电学或光学性能。在设备工程中，功能化是否成功通常仅在最终的电气、电化学或光学测试中进行判断。早期的迹象可以来自表面敏感技术，如 XPS 和 AFM，或来自接触角测量，虽然这些技术已成熟，但无法提供具有高空间分辨率的校准化学定量。因此，在高空间分辨率修饰后立即进行直接、快速和稳健的定量是可取的，特别是在功能化对器件功能至关重要的多步骤制造中，如在分子传感器中。在这里，我们展示了一种简单、稳健的方法，无需样品制备，在扫描电子显微镜 (SEM) 中使用传统的能量色散 X 射线 (EDX) 光谱。与氧化硅上的硅烷醇基团结合的含硫硅烷充当 EDX 标记物。通过将其与不同入射能量下电子束-基底相互作用的详细处理相结合，我们获得了有关功能化的校准定量数据。我们还研究了 EDX 定量的局限性，并将其应用于绘制整个基底的功能化异质性，并对绘制空间分辨率进行数值估计。

articles.title: Correlating structural and chemical transitions in the oxidation of Th-doped UO2
articles.title_zh: 掺钍 UO2 氧化过程中结构和化学转变的关联
articles.abstract: The oxidative phase transition of UOtextsubscript2 occurs via formation of several intermediate phases, leading to significant structural and chemical changes in the material. This can increase fuel solubility, complicating the long-term storage of spent nuclear fuel. The incorporation of thorium into UOtextsubscript2 and the effect on oxidation is of particular interest, as thorium exists primarily as Th(IV) making it resistant to the formation of higher oxide phases. Here, we investigate the influence of Th content on oxidation behaviour in epitaxial thin films. Complementary in situ synchrotron experiments were conducted to probe the crystallographic and chemical-state changes throughout oxidation, allowing correlation of the changing oxide structure to the evolving uranium valency. Overall results demonstrate that oxidation is fully inhibited with 13% Th. These results provide new insight into the coupled structural and chemical transformations in homogeneous U-Th solid solutions, supporting the use of mixed actinide oxides as a spent-fuel storage solution.
articles.abstract_zh: UOtextsubscript2 的氧化相变通过形成几个中间相而发生，导致材料发生显着的结构和化学变化。这会增加燃料的溶解度，使乏核燃料的长期储存变得复杂。钍掺入 UOtextsubscript2 及其对氧化的影响特别令人感兴趣，因为钍主要以 Th(IV) 形式存在，使其能够抵抗高级氧化物相的形成。在这里，我们研究了 Th 含量对外延薄膜氧化行为的影响。进行了补充原位同步加速器实验，以探测整个氧化过程中的晶体学和化学态变化，从而将变化的氧化物结构与不断变化的铀价相关联。
articles.abstract_zh_full: UOtextsubscript2 的氧化相变通过形成几个中间相而发生，导致材料发生显着的结构和化学变化。这会增加燃料的溶解度，使乏核燃料的长期储存变得复杂。钍掺入 UOtextsubscript2 及其对氧化的影响特别令人感兴趣，因为钍主要以 Th(IV) 形式存在，使其能够抵抗高级氧化物相的形成。在这里，我们研究了 Th 含量对外延薄膜氧化行为的影响。进行了补充原位同步加速器实验，以探测整个氧化过程中的晶体学和化学态变化，从而将变化的氧化物结构与不断变化的铀价相关联。总体结果表明，13% Th 可以完全抑制氧化。这些结果为均质 U-Th 固溶体中的耦合结构和化学转变提供了新的见解，支持使用混合锕系氧化物作为乏燃料存储解决方案。

articles.title: Phytoecdysteroid-containing medium component from Spinacia oleracea L. improves muscle cell differentiation for cultured meat production
articles.title_zh: 来自菠菜的含有植物蜕皮类固醇的培养基成分可改善肌肉细胞分化，用于培养肉生产
articles.abstract: Cultured meat production remains constrained by the cost, variability, and animal origin of serum supplements. This study evaluated phytoecdysteroid-containing Spinacia oleracea L. extracts as partial replacements for fetal bovine serum (FBS) and horse serum (HS) in muscle cell culture. Extracts were prepared from freeze-dried or fresh spinach using methanol or ethanol and characterized for 20-hydroxyecdysone (20-HE), free amino acids, and fatty acids. In C2C12 myoblasts, freeze-dried extracts containing 0.05 µM 20-HE supported proliferation in medium containing 5% FBS at levels comparable to or greater than those obtained with 10% FBS. In bovine myosatellite cells, freeze-dried methanol extract containing 0.5 µM 20-HE with 10% FBS produced proliferation comparable to the 20% FBS control. Selected spinach-derived treatments also maintained myogenic differentiation under reduced-HS conditions. These findings support an approximately 50% reduction in animal-derived serum under the best-performing conditions tested, rather than complete replacement. Responses were concentration-dependent and differed between C2C12 and bovine myosatellite cells, indicating cell-model-specific requirements for serum reduction.
articles.abstract_zh: 培养肉生产仍然受到血清补充剂的成本、变异性和动物来源的限制。本研究评估了含有植物蜕皮激素的菠菜提取物作为肌肉细胞培养中胎牛血清 (FBS) 和马血清 (HS) 的部分替代品。使用甲醇或乙醇从冻干或新鲜菠菜中制备提取物，并对其 20-羟基蜕皮酮 (20-HE)、游离氨基酸和脂肪酸进行表征。在 C2C12 成肌细胞中，含有 0.05 µM 20-HE 的冻干提取物支持含有 5% FBS 的培养基中的增殖，其水平与用 10% FBS 获得的水平相当或更高。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 培养肉生产仍然受到血清补充剂的成本、变异性和动物来源的限制。本研究评估了含有植物蜕皮激素的菠菜提取物作为肌肉细胞培养中胎牛血清 (FBS) 和马血清 (HS) 的部分替代品。使用甲醇或乙醇从冻干或新鲜菠菜中制备提取物，并对其 20-羟基蜕皮酮 (20-HE)、游离氨基酸和脂肪酸进行表征。在 C2C12 成肌细胞中，含有 0.05 µM 20-HE 的冻干提取物支持含有 5% FBS 的培养基中的增殖，其水平与用 10% FBS 获得的水平相当或更高。在牛肌卫星细胞中，含有 0.5 µM 20-HE 和 10% FBS 的冻干甲醇提取物产生的增殖与 20% FBS 对照相当。选定的菠菜衍生处理在低 HS 条件下也能维持生肌分化。这些发现支持在测试的最佳表现条件下，动物源性血清减少了约 50%，而不是完全替代。反应具有浓度依赖性，并且 C2C12 和牛肌卫星细胞之间存在差异，表明细胞模型对血清减少的特定要求。

articles.title: Spin-Coating-Speed-Dependent Structural and Optical Properties of Open-Air-Processed MAPbI 3 Thin Films with Bandgap-Constrained SCAPS-1D Sensitivity Analysis
articles.title_zh: 通过带隙约束 SCAPS-1D 灵敏度分析露天加工的 MAPbI 3 薄膜的旋涂速度依赖性结构和光学特性
articles.abstract: Spin coating offers an accessible route for depositing metal-halide perovskite absorbers, but interactions among rotational speed, solvent removal and crystallization complicate ambient process optimization. This study examined the effects of spin-coating speed (2000–5000 rpm) on the structural and optical properties of open-air-processed methylammonium lead iodide (MAPbI₃) films and used measured optical bandgaps to constrain SCAPS-1D simulations. Films were deposited from a 1.25 M precursor using ethyl acetate antisolvent treatment and annealed at 110°C for 10 min under controlled conditions of 24.4°C and 41.5% relative humidity. X-ray diffraction confirmed tetragonal MAPbI₃ with preferential (110) orientation and no detectable PbI₂ reflection. The structural response was non-monotonic. At 3000 rpm, the film exhibited the narrowest (110) peak (FWHM: 0.352°), largest Scherrer coherent-domain size (22.73 nm), lowest estimated microstrain (1.257 × 10⁻²) and lowest crystallographic dislocation-density parameter (1.936 × 10⁻³ nm⁻²). Thus, 3000 rpm produced the most favourable XRD-derived crystalline characteristics within the investigated range, although these metrics do not establish reduced electronic trap density, suppressed recombination or superior photovoltaic performance. Optical bandgaps ranged from 1.59–1.60 eV. In an otherwise fixed FTO/TiO₂/MAPbI₃/Spiro-OMeTAD/carbon model, the corresponding simulated efficiencies were 16.67% and 16.47%, respectively. Coordinated parameter optimization yielded a projected efficiency of 25.38%, with (:Vₒc) of 1.25 V, (:Jₛc) of 24.24 mA cm⁻² and fill factor of 83.61%. These results establish a process-specific structure–optical-property relationship, while the simulated outputs remain model-dependent projections requiring experimental device validation. The approach also illustrates how experimental measurements can inform device-level sensitivity analysis without overstating causal relationships.
articles.abstract_zh: 旋涂为沉积金属卤化物钙钛矿吸收剂提供了一种可行的途径，但旋转速度、溶剂去除和结晶之间的相互作用使环境工艺优化变得复杂。本研究研究了旋涂速度 (2000–5000 rpm) 对露天加工的甲基碘化铅铵 (MAPbI₃) 薄膜的结构和光学特性的影响，并使用测量的光学带隙来约束 SCAPS-1D 模拟。使用乙酸乙酯反溶剂处理从 1.25 M 前体沉积薄膜，并在 24.4°C 和 41.5% 相对湿度的受控条件下于 110°C 退火 10 分钟。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 旋涂为沉积金属卤化物钙钛矿吸收剂提供了一种可行的途径，但旋转速度、溶剂去除和结晶之间的相互作用使环境工艺优化变得复杂。本研究研究了旋涂速度 (2000–5000 rpm) 对露天加工的甲基碘化铅铵 (MAPbI₃) 薄膜的结构和光学特性的影响，并使用测量的光学带隙来约束 SCAPS-1D 模拟。使用乙酸乙酯反溶剂处理从 1.25 M 前体沉积薄膜，并在 24.4°C 和 41.5% 相对湿度的受控条件下于 110°C 退火 10 分钟。 X 射线衍射证实四方 MAPbI3 具有优先 (110) 取向，并且没有可检测到的 PbI2 反射。结构响应是非单调的。在 3000 rpm 时，薄膜表现出最窄的 (110) 峰（FWHM：0.352°）、最大的谢乐相干域尺寸（22.73 nm）、最低的估计微应变（1.257 × 10²）和最低的晶体位错密度参数（1.936 × 10³ nm²）。因此，3000 rpm 在研究范围内产生了最有利的 XRD 衍生晶体特性，尽管这些指标并未建立降低的电子陷阱密度、抑制的复合或优异的光伏性能。光学带隙范围为 1.59–1.60 eV。在固定的 FTO/TiO2/MAPbI3/Spiro-OMeTAD/carbon 模型中，相应的模拟效率分别为 16.67% 和 16.47%。协调参数优化的预计效率为 25.38%，(:Vₒc) 为 1.25 V，(:Jₛc) 为 24.24 mA cm⁻²，填充因子为 83.61%。这些结果建立了特定于工艺的结构-光学-性能关系，而模拟输出仍然是依赖于模型的预测，需要实验设备验证。该方法还说明了实验测量如何在不夸大因果关系的情况下为设备级灵敏度分析提供信息。

articles.title: Enhancing solar conversion efficiency of CdTe-based absorber solar cells via SCAPS-1D simulation
articles.title_zh: 通过 SCAPS-1D 模拟提高 CdTe 基吸收太阳能电池的太阳能转换效率
articles.abstract: The growing global energy demand and the need for new sources have driven significant advancements in energy storage technologies, which are essential for improving energy sustainability and efficiency. Cadmium telluride (CdTe) is one of the most efficient and cost-effective thin-film solar cell materials with an ideal band gap between 1.44 eV and 1.5 eV. CdTe is a long-standing material in the fabrication of solar cells for its ideal band gap and high optical absorption coefficient. This is a promising material due to its efficient devices and cost ratio because of its large flexibility in the manufacturing process. Due to its properties, CdTe has been regarded as a material for producing high-efficiency solar cells. In the ideal band gap range, which is suitable for the solar cell spectrum and maximum absorption (more than 90%) of incoming photons at a thickness of 2 µm. CdTe is the absorber; the cadmium sulphide (CdS) film and the back contact are the typical layers that make up the conventional structure of a superstrate CdTe solar cell. An absorber layer with Nickel oxide (NiO) as the window layer was investigated in order to enhance the Photovoltaic (PV) system’s device features as well as parameters. To assess the effectiveness of the thin-film solar cell architectures, can be modelled utilising computer simulations. The efficiency of CdTe Photovoltaic (PV) cells was found to be 27.7% by simulation in SCAPS-1D simulation software.
articles.abstract_zh: 全球不断增长的能源需求和对新能源的需求推动了储能技术的重大进步，这对于提高能源可持续性和效率至关重要。碲化镉 (CdTe) 是最高效、最具成本效益的薄膜太阳能电池材料之一，其理想带隙在 1.44 eV 至 1.5 eV 之间。 CdTe 因其理想的带隙和高光学吸收系数而成为太阳能电池制造中长期使用的材料。这是一种很有前途的材料，因为它具有高效的设备和成本比，并且在制造过程中具有很大的灵活性。由于其特性，CdTe 被认为是生产高效太阳能电池的材料。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 全球不断增长的能源需求和对新能源的需求推动了储能技术的重大进步，这对于提高能源可持续性和效率至关重要。碲化镉 (CdTe) 是最高效、最具成本效益的薄膜太阳能电池材料之一，其理想带隙在 1.44 eV 至 1.5 eV 之间。 CdTe 因其理想的带隙和高光学吸收系数而成为太阳能电池制造中长期使用的材料。这是一种很有前途的材料，因为它具有高效的设备和成本比，并且在制造过程中具有很大的灵活性。由于其特性，CdTe 被认为是生产高效太阳能电池的材料。在理想带隙范围内，适合太阳能电池光谱和厚度为 2 µm 时入射光子的最大吸收（超过 90%）。 CdTe为吸收体；硫化镉 (CdS) 薄膜和背接触层是构成上层 CdTe 太阳能电池传统结构的典型层。研究了以氧化镍 (NiO) 作为窗口层的吸收层，以增强光伏 (PV) 系统的器件特性和参数。为了评估薄膜太阳能电池架构的有效性，可以利用计算机模拟进行建模。通过SCAPS-1D仿真软件的仿真发现CdTe光伏（PV）电池的效率为27.7%。

articles.title: Multiscale Thermal Transport in AlPO-18 for Heat-Transformation Applications
articles.title_zh: 用于热转换应用的 AlPO-18 中的多尺度热传输
articles.abstract: A multiscale analysis of framework dynamics, negative thermal expansion, and heat transport is presented for AlPO-18, with explicit distinction between crystallographic cell conventions and transport operators. The calcined conventional C2/c cell contains Al₂₄P₂₄O₉₆, 144 atoms, and has a volume of 3241.81 Å³, whereas the corresponding 72-atom primitive cell has a volume of 1620.90 Å³. The calculated elastic tensor is positive definite, with stiffness eigenvalues ranging from 13.9 to 222 GPa. The Reuss bulk, shear, and Young moduli are 73.56, 19.34, and 53.35 GPa, respectively. Variable-temperature diffraction reveals a volume contraction of 0.91% between 105 and 455 K. The volumetric thermal-expansion coefficient remains negative throughout this interval, changing from − 30.75 × 10⁻⁶ K⁻¹ at 105 K to − 22.41 × 10⁻⁶ K⁻¹ at 455 K, with a value of − 26.18 × 10⁻⁶ K⁻¹ at 298 K. No thermal-expansion crossover is observed. Analysis of the local T···T distances and the eight-membered-ring span shows that the contraction is governed primarily by transverse Al–O–P hinging and cooperative tetrahedral rotations rather than uniform bond shortening. A 216-branch harmonic spectrum, Raman comparison, charge-density redistribution, and heat-capacity-weighted mode analysis associate this structural flexibility with low-frequency collective framework vibrations. The transport analysis distinguishes three physically different conductivity baselines: 1.150 W m⁻¹ K⁻¹ for the periodic Wigner total, 0.773 W m⁻¹ K⁻¹ for the reservoir Monte Carlo population target, and 0.370 W m⁻¹ K⁻¹ for the boundary-limited platelet response. These values correspond to different operators, geometries, and channel definitions and therefore do not represent competing estimates of a single bulk conductivity. A gray two-stream benchmark gives a statistical convergence slope of − 0.53 and approaches the diffusive limit within 2% for L/Λ ≥ 98. Boundary calculations and AlPO-18/PVOH coating transients further demonstrate how thickness, surface specularity, and coupled heat and mass transfer modify the intrinsic framework response. The study establishes a quantitatively consistent connection between cell normalization, macroscopic contraction, framework vibrations, transport channels, and application-scale thermal behaviour in AlPO-18.
articles.abstract_zh: 对 AlPO-18 的框架动力学、负热膨胀和热传输进行了多尺度分析，并明确区分了晶体单元约定和传输算子。煅烧后的传统C2/c电池含有Al24P24O96、144个原子，体积为3241.81 Å3，而相应的72原子原始电池的体积为1620.90 Å3。计算出的弹性张量是正定的，刚度特征值范围为 13.9 至 222 GPa。罗伊斯体积模量、剪切模量和杨氏模量分别为 73.56、19.34 和 53.35 GPa。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 对 AlPO-18 的框架动力学、负热膨胀和热传输进行了多尺度分析，并明确区分了晶体单元约定和传输算子。煅烧后的传统C2/c电池含有Al24P24O96、144个原子，体积为3241.81 Å3，而相应的72原子原始电池的体积为1620.90 Å3。计算出的弹性张量是正定的，刚度特征值范围为 13.9 至 222 GPa。罗伊斯体积模量、剪切模量和杨氏模量分别为 73.56、19.34 和 53.35 GPa。变温衍射显示，在 105 至 455 K 之间，体积收缩了 0.91%。在此期间，体积热膨胀系数保持为负值，从 105 K 时的 − 30.75 × 10⁻⁶ K⁻1 变化到 455 K 时的 − 22.41 × 10⁻⁶ K⁻1，其值为- 26.18 × 10-6 K-1 (298 K)。未观察到热膨胀交叉。对局部 T·T 距离和八元环跨度的分析表明，收缩主要由横向 Al-O-P 铰接和协作四面体旋转决定，而不是均匀的键缩短。 216 分支谐波谱、拉曼比较、电荷密度重新分布和热容加权模式分析将这种结构灵活性与低频集体框架振动联系起来。输运分析区分了三个物理上不同的电导率基线：周期性维格纳总电导率基线为 1.150 W m-1 K-1，储库蒙特卡罗群体目标为 0.773 W m-1 K-1，边界限制血小板响应为 0.370 W m-1 K-1。这些值对应于不同的操作员、几何形状和通道定义，因此并不代表单个体电导率的竞争估计。灰色双流基准给出了 - 0.53 的统计收敛斜率，并且在 L/Λ ≥ 98 的情况下接近 2% 以内的扩散极限。边界计算和 AlPO-18/PVOH 涂层瞬态进一步证明了厚度、表面镜面度和耦合热质传递如何改变内在框架响应。该研究在 AlPO-18 中的细胞标准化、宏观收缩、框架振动、传输通道和应用规模热行为之间建立了定量一致的联系。

articles.title: Quantitative Mapping of Hidden Structural Relaxation and Heterogeneity in Sputtered IGZO Thin Films Using 4D-STEM RDF Analysis
articles.title_zh: 使用 4D-STEM RDF 分析定量绘制溅射 IGZO 薄膜中隐藏的结构弛豫和异质性
articles.abstract: Amorphous indium–gallium–zinc oxide (a-IGZO) is a widely used channel material for thin-film transistors (TFTs), where post-deposition annealing is used to optimize their device performance. However, conventional characterization techniques, such as X-ray diffraction (XRD) and high-resolution transmission electron microscopy (HRTEM), have limited sensitivity to detect the subtle and nanoscale structural evolution, including local atomic rearrangements and nanocrystal nucleation, that precedes macroscopic crystallization and may affect charge transport. To overcome this, we combined four-dimensional scanning transmission electron microscopy (4D-STEM) with spatially resolved radial distribution function (RDF) analysis to map the structural evolution of a-IGZO films as a function of annealing temperature. Although XRD and HRTEM revealed no discernible crystallization up to 500°C, our RDF analysis detected a shift toward shorter distances and a broadening of the metal–oxygen bond distance distribution with increasing annealing temperature, indicating non-uniform local structural relaxation. This nanoscale densification and rearrangement may explain the non-monotonic temperature dependence of the sheet resistance, which decreases up to an annealing temperature of 400°C and increases at higher temperatures. Our 4D-STEM RDF analysis resolves structural dynamics preceding crystallization that remain beyond the detection limits of conventional characterization techniques, thereby providing a new metric to guide process optimization in amorphous oxide semiconductors.
articles.abstract_zh: 非晶氧化铟镓锌 (a-IGZO) 是一种广泛用于薄膜晶体管 (TFT) 的沟道材料，采用沉积后退火来优化其器件性能。然而，传统的表征技术，如 X 射线衍射 (XRD) 和高分辨率透射电子显微镜 (HRTEM)，对于检测细微的纳米级结构演化（包括局部原子重排和纳米晶体成核）的灵敏度有限，这些演化先于宏观结晶并可能影响电荷传输。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 非晶氧化铟镓锌 (a-IGZO) 是一种广泛用于薄膜晶体管 (TFT) 的沟道材料，采用沉积后退火来优化其器件性能。然而，传统的表征技术，如 X 射线衍射 (XRD) 和高分辨率透射电子显微镜 (HRTEM)，对于检测细微的纳米级结构演化（包括局部原子重排和纳米晶体成核）的灵敏度有限，这些演化先于宏观结晶并可能影响电荷传输。为了克服这个问题，我们将四维扫描透射电子显微镜 (4D-STEM) 与空间分辨径向分布函数 (RDF) 分析相结合，以绘制 a-IGZO 薄膜的结构演变随退火温度的变化。尽管 XRD 和 HRTEM 显示在高达 500°C 的温度下没有明显的结晶，但我们的 RDF 分析检测到随着退火温度的升高，金属-氧键距分布向更短的距离转变，并且变宽，表明局部结构松弛不均匀。这种纳米级致密化和重排可以解释方块电阻的非单调温度依赖性，当退火温度达到 400°C 时，方块电阻会降低，并在更高的温度下增加。我们的 4D-STEM RDF 分析解决了结晶之前的结构动力学问题，该结构动力学仍然超出了传统表征技术的检测极限，从而提供了一个新的指标来指导非晶氧化物半导体的工艺优化。

articles.title: Differential Deformation and Retrogressive Evolution of the Linbang Landslide with Multiple Slip Surfaces under Reservoir Water-Level Fluctuations
articles.title_zh: 水库水位升降下林浜多滑面滑坡的差异变形与回归演化
articles.abstract: Fluctuations in reservoir water level are a major cause of the reactivation of ancient landslides along reservoir banks, yet for deposits controlled by weak intercalated zones, the differences in deformation response among individual sliding masses and the traction between them remain poorly understood. Taking the Linbang ancient landslide deposit in the Houziyan Reservoir of the Dadu River as a case study, this paper integrates SBAS-InSAR deformation identification, field monitoring, a large-scale physical model test and coupled seepage-stress numerical simulation to investigate the differential deformation of the sliding masses and the mechanism of traction-driven evolution under reservoir water level fluctuations. The results show that: (i) before impoundment, deformation was concentrated at the front edge and expanded towards the middle and rear parts after impoundment; the maximum cumulative displacement in the field reached 4674.94 mm, and accelerated deformation occurred mainly during the drawdown period from December to May, allowing the landslide to be divided into a strongly deformed front zone, a traction zone in the middle and a passively dragged zone at the rear. (ii) The physical model reproduced the initial impoundment and five subsequent water level cycles; seven cracks developed, and the maximum surface change obtained by 3D laser scanning increased from 2.75 cm in the first cycle to 3.68 cm in the fifth, with deformation propagating successively from J3 to J2 and J1, indicating retrogressive extension from the front towards the rear. (iii) Initial impoundment softened and settled the submerged sliding masses, weakening their support for the upper masses; during drawdown, internal drainage lagged behind the falling reservoir level, generating an outward seepage force superimposed on the downslope component, with pore pressure peaks lagging behind water level peaks; the strongly weathered phyllite-dominated mass, with high water retention and relatively slow drainage, is an important control on the stepwise deformation during drawdown. (iv) Numerical simulation further indicates that during water level rise the inward seepage force and external hydrostatic pressure provide a stabilizing contribution, whereas larger drawdown rates or higher rainfall intensities increase the reduction in stability. The deformation of the Linbang landslide is governed by traction between sliding masses, showing the staged characteristics of acceleration during initial impoundment, stepwise movement during drawdown and deceleration during the subsequent rise.

articles.abstract_zh_full: 水库水位波动是库岸古滑坡重新活动的主要原因，但对于受软弱夹层控制的沉积物，单个滑动体之间变形响应的差异以及它们之间的牵引力仍然知之甚少。以大渡河猴子岩水库林榜古滑坡堆积体为例，集SBAS-InSAR变形识别、现场监测、大型物理模型试验和渗流应力耦合数值模拟于一体，研究水库水位波动下滑体的差异变形及牵引演化机制。结果表明：(i)蓄水前变形集中在前缘，蓄水后向中后部扩展；现场最大累计位移达4674.94毫米，加速变形主要发生在12月至5月的水位下降期间，使滑坡分为前部强烈变形区、中部牵引区和后部被动拖曳区。 (ii) 物理模型再现了初始蓄水和随后的五个水位周期；出现7条裂纹，3D激光扫描得到的最大表面变化从第一周期的2.75 cm增加到第五周期的3.68 cm，变形依次从J3传播到J2和J1，表明从前向后退行延伸。 (iii) 最初的蓄水软化并沉降了水下滑动体，削弱了它们对上部体块的支撑；水位下降过程中，内部排水滞后于库位下降，产生叠加在下坡分量上的向外渗流力，孔隙压力峰值滞后于水位峰值；以强风化千枚岩为主的岩体，具有较高的保水性和相对较慢的排水速度，是水位下降过程中逐步变形的重要控制因素。 (iv) 数值模拟进一步表明，在水位上升期间，向内渗流力和外部静水压力提供了稳定性贡献，而较大的水位下降率或较高的降雨强度则增加了稳定性的降低。林浜滑坡的变形受滑动体之间的牵引力控制，呈现出蓄水初期加速、下降阶段逐步移动、上升阶段减速的阶段性特征。

articles.title: In-situ experiments and numerical simulation of ground vibration isolation using concrete row-pile barriers
articles.title_zh: 混凝土排桩屏障地面隔振现场试验与数值模拟
articles.abstract: In recent years, ground vibration induced by train operation and other rail-transit activities has become increasingly prominent, creating a growing need for effective vibration isolation measures. This study combines in-situ experiments with finite element simulations to systematically investigate the ground vibration isolation performance of concrete row-pile barriers. Firstly, in-situ experiments were conducted under no-barrier, single-row, and double-row configurations to examine the effects of the number of pile rows and vibration direction on isolation performance. A finite element model was then established and validated against the experimental results. Based on the validated model, parametric analyses were performed to investigate the effects of pile length, pile diameter, pile spacing, number of pile rows, barrier location, and source position. Further dimensionless analysis was conducted by normalizing the pile geometric parameters and source-to-barrier distance with the characteristic Rayleigh wavelength of the site. The results show that the isolation performance of row-pile barriers exhibits pronounced spatial non-uniformity. For single-row barriers, pile length and spacing are the dominant parameters, with effective ranges of approximately 12–16 m and 1–2 m, respectively. For multiple-row barriers, increasing the number of rows improves vibration attenuation but produces diminishing marginal benefits. Local vibration amplification is also observed behind double-row barriers in the near-field oblique region. Finally, the findings provide a scientific basis and engineering reference for the design of concrete row-pile barriers for ground vibration isolation.
articles.abstract_zh: 近年来，列车运行和其他轨道交通活动引起的地面振动日益突出，对有效隔振措施的需求日益增长。本研究将现场实验与有限元模拟相结合，系统研究混凝土排桩屏障的地面隔振性能。首先，在无障碍、单排和双排三种构型下进行了现场试验，考察桩排数和振动方向对隔震性能的影响。然后建立了有限元模型并根据实验结果进行了验证。基于验证的模型，进行参数分析，研究桩长、桩径、桩距、桩排数、障碍物位置和源位置的影响。通过使用该地点的特征瑞利波长对桩几何参数和源到屏障距离进行归一化，进行了进一步的无量纲分析。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 近年来，列车运行和其他轨道交通活动引起的地面振动日益突出，对有效隔振措施的需求日益增长。本研究将现场实验与有限元模拟相结合，系统研究混凝土排桩屏障的地面隔振性能。首先，在无障碍、单排和双排三种构型下进行了现场试验，考察桩排数和振动方向对隔震性能的影响。然后建立了有限元模型并根据实验结果进行了验证。基于验证的模型，进行参数分析，研究桩长、桩径、桩距、桩排数、障碍物位置和源位置的影响。通过使用该地点的特征瑞利波长对桩几何参数和源到屏障距离进行归一化，进行了进一步的无量纲分析。结果表明，排桩屏障的隔震性能表现出明显的空间不均匀性。对于单排护栏，桩长和间距是主要参数，有效范围分别约为 12-16 m 和 1-2 m。对于多排屏障，增加排数可以改善振动衰减，但会产生边际效益递减。在近场倾斜区域的双排势垒后面也观察到局部振动放大。最后，研究结果为地面隔振混凝土排桩屏障的设计提供科学依据和工程参考。

articles.title: Characterization of unsteady dynamics and loss mechanisms in supersonic turbine trailing-edge flows
articles.title_zh: 超音速涡轮后缘流动的非定常动力学特征和损失机制
articles.abstract: This study investigates trailing-edge flow physics in a linear supersonic turbine cascade using wall-resolved large-eddy simulations. Three inlet Mach numbers (((Mᵢₙfₜy=1.85)), ((2.00)), and ((2.15))) are considered at a fixed Reynolds number of ((Re=395,000)) to assess the influence of shock-boundary-layer interactions (SBLIs) on the trailing-edge dynamics. Variations in Mach number shift the SBLIs downstream, causing the suction-side interaction to merge with the trailing-edge recirculation region for ((Mᵢₙfₜy=1.85)) and ((2.15)). Cases with an SBLI located near the trailing edge also exhibit amplified pressure fluctuations within the shock–trailing-edge interaction region. Spectral analysis shows that the trailing-edge shocks are dominated by low- and mid-frequency unsteadiness, with increasing Mach number shifting the dominant content toward lower frequencies. Calculation of mass flux over the bubble surface reveals a strongly asymmetric exchange across the trailing-edge separation region, with larger mass-flux magnitudes along the suction-side interface. Temporal correlations indicate that bubble expansions and contractions precede the trailing-edge shock-system response, which is highly synchronized when a large shock-induced separation bubble forms near the trailing edge. Along the wake, increasing Mach number enhances the pressure and density asymmetry between the blade surfaces, which deflects the flow toward the lower-density stream on the suction side. Spectral proper orthogonal decomposition identifies Kelvin-Helmholtz-type coherent structures at higher frequencies along the wake, with similar modal topologies for all cases. Finally, entropy-generation analysis shows that viscous dissipation dominates the aerodynamic losses, primarily within the suction-side boundary layer, whereas the wake contributes only a minor fraction.
articles.abstract_zh: 本研究使用壁分辨大涡模拟研究线性超音速涡轮叶栅中的后缘流动物理场。在固定雷诺数 ((Re=395,000)) 下考虑三个入口马赫数 (((Mᵢₙfₜy=1.85))、((2.00)) 和 ((2.15)))，以评估激波边界层相互作用 (SBLI) 对后缘动力学的影响。马赫数的变化使 SBLI 向下游移动，导致吸力侧相互作用与后缘再循环区域合并 ((Mᵢₙfₜy=1.85)) 和 ((2.15))。 SBLI 位于后缘附近的情况也在激波-后缘相互作用区域内表现出放大的压力波动。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 本研究使用壁分辨大涡模拟研究线性超音速涡轮叶栅中的后缘流动物理场。在固定雷诺数 ((Re=395,000)) 下考虑三个入口马赫数 (((Mᵢₙfₜy=1.85))、((2.00)) 和 ((2.15)))，以评估激波边界层相互作用 (SBLI) 对后缘动力学的影响。马赫数的变化使 SBLI 向下游移动，导致吸力侧相互作用与后缘再循环区域合并 ((Mᵢₙfₜy=1.85)) 和 ((2.15))。 SBLI 位于后缘附近的情况也在激波-后缘相互作用区域内表现出放大的压力波动。谱分析表明，后缘激波以低频和中频不定常为主，随着马赫数的增加，主导内容向低频方向移动。气泡表面质量通量的计算揭示了后缘分离区域的强烈不对称交换，沿吸力侧界面具有更大的质量通量值。时间相关性表明气泡膨胀和收缩先于后缘激波系统响应，当在后缘附近形成大的激波引起的分离气泡时，后缘激波系统响应是高度同步的。沿着尾流，马赫数的增加会增强叶片表面之间的压力和密度不对称性，从而使气流偏向吸力侧的较低密度流。谱本征正交分解可识别沿尾流的较高频率下的开尔文-亥姆霍兹型相干结构，所有情况都具有相似的模态拓扑。最后，熵产生分析表明，粘性耗散在空气动力学损失中占主导地位，主要是在吸力侧边界层内，而尾流仅贡献一小部分。

articles.title: Effectiveness of raw eucalypt pole pre-supply operations in reducing surface and end checking in electricity distribution poles in Uganda
articles.title_zh: 原桉树杆预供应操作在减少乌干达配电杆表面和端部检查方面的有效性
articles.abstract: Premature failure of utility poles is a significant problem in Uganda, leading to substantial financial losses, operational disruption and safety risks. Among several factors that cause premature failure, it is critical to note that, frequent development of drying defects such as surface checksand end splits compromise the mechanical strength and durability of the poles. This study sought to contribute to the durability of treated poles by evaluating the effectiveness of three different pre-seasoning interventions, pre-felling girdling, bark girdling post-felling, and foliage retention post-felling in reducing surface and end checks in Eucalyptus grandis x camaldulensis. A sample of 100 poles was divided into four groups – the control and three treatment groups “Treatment 1 – pre-felling girdling, Treatment 2 – bark girdling post-felling, and Treatment 3 – foliage retention post-felling”. Over a period of five months, regular measurements of moisture content, check length, width, and depth were taken. The treatments were effective in reducing the number of checks compared to the control group. Specifically, Treatment 3 (foliage retention after felling) was the most effective in reducing check depth, with a mean of 60.60 mm compared to 74.83 mm for the control. Overall, the control group exhibited the highest values for check number, depth and width across all groups.  Based on these findings, it is recommended that pole suppliers in Uganda adopt these practices to improve the durability of their products. Further research is necessary to explore the combined effects of these treatments and to determine the effective duration for girdling.
articles.abstract_zh: 电线杆过早失效是乌干达的一个严重问题，会导致重大财务损失、运营中断和安全风险。在导致过早失效的几个因素中，值得注意的是，频繁出现的干燥缺陷（例如表面裂纹和端部裂口）会损害电线杆的机械强度和耐用性。本研究试图通过评估三种不同的预干燥干预措施（采伐前环剥、采伐后树皮环剥以及采伐后保留树叶）在减少巨桉 x 赤桉表面和末端检查方面的有效性，来提高经过处理的杆的耐用性。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 电线杆过早失效是乌干达的一个严重问题，会导致重大财务损失、运营中断和安全风险。在导致过早失效的几个因素中，值得注意的是，频繁出现的干燥缺陷（例如表面裂纹和端部裂口）会损害电线杆的机械强度和耐用性。本研究试图通过评估三种不同的预干燥干预措施（采伐前环剥、采伐后树皮环剥以及采伐后保留树叶）在减少巨桉 x 赤桉表面和末端检查方面的有效性，来提高经过处理的杆的耐用性。将 100 根杆子样本分为四组 - 对照组和三个处理组“处理 1 - 砍伐前环剥，处理 2 - 砍伐后树皮环剥，处理 3 - 砍伐后保留叶子”。在五个月的时间内，定期测量水分含量、支票长度、宽度和深度。与对照组相比，这些治疗有效减少了检查次数。具体而言，处理 3（砍伐后保留叶子）在减少检查深度方面最有效，平均为 60.60 毫米，而对照组为 74.83 毫米。总体而言，对照组在所有组中显示出最高的检查数量、深度和宽度值。  根据这些发现，建议乌干达的电线杆供应商采用这些做法来提高其产品的耐用性。需要进一步的研究来探索这些处理的综合效果并确定环剥的有效持续时间。

articles.title: Quantum Cointegration: Common Trends and Ordered Correlations
articles.title_zh: 量子协整：共同趋势和有序相关性
articles.abstract: A contrast can remove a common stochastic trend and still leave part of the residual unidentified. For a self-adjoint quantum process, the same cancellation produces a short-memory residual, but the symmetric covariance of that residual does not fix the time-ordered products. In the model (Zₜ⁽σ⁾=Qₜ+σ Pₜ₋₁), both signs have symmetric spectrum (f(θ)=1) and ordered spectrum (S_σ(θ)=1-σsinθ). A real linear contrast of one fresh copy has a law independent of (σ). The imaginary part of the ordered Weyl witness (w(eⁱuZₜeⁱvZₜ₋₁)) changes sign with (σ). A finite-dimensional simulation of an idealized differential sensor reproduces the common-trend cancellation, the equality of the real-contrast laws, and the sign of the ordered witness. The simulation is not a hardware measurement, and it does not establish a gain in sensor precision. The statements apply to the processes, initial conditions, and instruments named with them. Full assumptions, proofs, counterexamples, and numerical qualifications are included in the appendices to make the operator and recorded-data claims separately auditable.
articles.abstract_zh: 对比可以消除常见的随机趋势，但仍然留下部分残差无法识别。对于自伴量子过程，相同的消除会产生短记忆残差，但该残差的对称协方差不会修复时间排序的乘积。在模型（Zₜ⁽σ⁾=Qₜ+σ Pₜ₋₁）中，两个符号都具有对称谱（f(θ)=1）和有序谱（S_σ(θ)=1-σsinθ）。一个新副本的真实线性对比度具有独立于 (σ) 的定律。有序 Weyl 见证 (w(eⁱuZₜeⁱvZₜ₋₁)) 的虚部随 (σ) 改变符号。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 对比可以消除常见的随机趋势，但仍然留下部分残差无法识别。对于自伴量子过程，相同的消除会产生短记忆残差，但该残差的对称协方差不会修复时间排序的乘积。在模型（Zₜ⁽σ⁾=Qₜ+σ Pₜ₋₁）中，两个符号都具有对称谱（f(θ)=1）和有序谱（S_σ(θ)=1-σsinθ）。一个新副本的真实线性对比度具有独立于 (σ) 的定律。有序 Weyl 见证 (w(eⁱuZₜeⁱvZₜ₋₁)) 的虚部随 (σ) 改变符号。理想化差分传感器的有限维模拟再现了共同趋势抵消、真实对比定律的等式以及有序见证的符号。模拟不是硬件测量，并且不会提高传感器精度。这些陈述适用于以它们命名的过程、初始条件和仪器。附录中包含完整的假设、证明、反例和数值限定，以使算子和记录数据声明可以单独审核。

articles.title: Geometry-Aware Depth Anomaly Detection and Adaptive Decision Modeling for Automated Robotic Quality Sorting
articles.title_zh: 用于自动机器人质量分拣的几何感知深度异常检测和自适应决策建模
articles.abstract: Industrial 3D anomaly detection remains challenging when defective surface structures must be distinguished from normal geometric variations across different industrial components. This study presents a geometry-aware anomaly detection framework that integrates local surface characteristics with global object-shape descriptors for industrial defect identification and localization. The proposed framework is evaluated using the MVTec 3D-AD benchmark, comprising 4,147 industrial 3D scans across ten object categories. Local geometric characteristics, including surface normals, curvature, depth variation, and neighborhood consistency, are combined with global descriptors, including convexity, solidity, and void ratio, to construct a complementary geometric representation. The experimental evaluation examines conventional geometric thresholding, an unsupervised 3D anomaly detection baseline, and the proposed local–global feature-fusion approach. Image-level anomaly detection and pixel-level defect localization are assessed using AUROC, average precision, Intersection over Union, and Dice similarity. Feature-ablation analysis investigates the respective contributions of local and global geometric representations. Furthermore, anomaly severity and prediction uncertainty are incorporated into a three-action quality-inspection strategy comprising acceptance, rejection, and additional inspection. The sorting component is evaluated through a cost-sensitive simulation that considers false acceptance, false rejection, and additional-inspection requirements. The study connects geometric anomaly detection with uncertainty-aware quality control decision modeling and investigates the contribution of complementary geometric information to automated industrial inspection. Physical robotic deployment and validation under actual manufacturing conditions remain outside the scope of this experimental evaluation.
articles.abstract_zh: 当必须将有缺陷的表面结构与不同工业组件的正常几何变化区分开来时，工业 3D 异常检测仍然具有挑战性。本研究提出了一种几何感知异常检测框架，该框架将局部表面特征与全局对象形状描述符相结合，用于工业缺陷识别和定位。所提出的框架使用 MVTec 3D-AD 基准进行评估，其中包括 10 个对象类别的 4,147 个工业 3D 扫描。局部几何特征（包括表面法线、曲率、深度变化和邻域一致性）与全局描述符（包括凸度、坚固性和空隙率）相结合，以构建互补的几何表示。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 当必须将有缺陷的表面结构与不同工业组件的正常几何变化区分开来时，工业 3D 异常检测仍然具有挑战性。本研究提出了一种几何感知异常检测框架，该框架将局部表面特征与全局对象形状描述符相结合，用于工业缺陷识别和定位。所提出的框架使用 MVTec 3D-AD 基准进行评估，其中包括 10 个对象类别的 4,147 个工业 3D 扫描。局部几何特征（包括表面法线、曲率、深度变化和邻域一致性）与全局描述符（包括凸度、坚固性和空隙率）相结合，以构建互补的几何表示。实验评估检查了传统的几何阈值、无监督的 3D 异常检测基线以及提出的局部-全局特征融合方法。使用 AUROC、平均精度、并集交集和 Dice 相似度来评估图像级异常检测和像素级缺陷定位。特征消融分析研究局部和全局几何表示的各自贡献。此外，异常严重性和预测不确定性被纳入三动作质量检查策略中，包括接受、拒绝和附加检查。分拣组件通过成本敏感的模拟进行评估，该模拟考虑了错误接受、错误拒绝和附加检查要求。该研究将几何异常检测与不确定性感知质量控制决策模型联系起来，并研究互补几何信息对自动化工业检测的贡献。实际制造条件下的物理机器人部署和验证仍然不属于本实验评估的范围。

articles.title: Cheese Type and Pre-Drying Morphology Critically Determine the Flavor Profile, Oxidative Stability, and Storage Performance of Freeze-Dried Cheese Powders
articles.title_zh: 奶酪类型和预干燥形态关键决定冻干奶酪粉的风味特征、氧化稳定性和储存性能
articles.abstract: Freeze-dried cheese powders provide concentrated flavor and extended shelf life, but their quality may depend on cheese type and sample morphology before drying. This study evaluated the effects of cheese type (Cheddar, Mozzarella, and enzyme-modified cheese (EMC)), pre-drying morphology (shreds, slices, and cubes), and storage/ripening time (0, 30, and 60 days) on the physicochemical properties, volatile profile, fatty acid composition, and oxidative stability of freeze-dried cheese powders. Proximate composition, water activity, free fatty acids, peroxide value, total oxidation value, and thiobarbituric acid-reactive substances were determined, while volatile compounds and fatty acids were analyzed by gas chromatography-mass spectrometry. Cheese type, morphology, and storage/ripening time significantly affected most attributes (p < 0.05). All powders had high total solids (96.01–97.88%) and low water activity (0.21–0.25). Cheddar developed the most complex volatile profile, whereas EMC showed accelerated flavor development, the highest free fatty acid content (0.26–0.46%), and the highest total oxidation values (5.1–7.5). Mozzarella retained a milder volatile profile and greater oxidative stability. Cubes generally retained higher concentrations of volatile compounds, whereas shreds favored moisture removal and showed greater lipolysis and oxidation. These findings demonstrate that cheese type and pre-drying morphology can be optimized to balance flavor development, oxidative stability, and storage performance.
articles.abstract_zh: 冻干奶酪粉提供浓缩的风味和延长的保质期，但其质量可能取决于干燥前的奶酪类型和样品形态。本研究评估了奶酪类型（切达奶酪、马苏里拉奶酪和酶改性奶酪 (EMC)）、预干燥形态（碎片、切片和立方体）和储存/成熟时间（0、30 和 60 天）对冻干奶酪粉的理化特性、挥发性成分、脂肪酸组成和氧化稳定性的影响。测定了近似成分、水分活度、游离脂肪酸、过氧化值、总氧化值和硫代巴比妥酸反应物质，并通过气相色谱-质谱法分析了挥发性化合物和脂肪酸。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 冻干奶酪粉提供浓缩的风味和延长的保质期，但其质量可能取决于干燥前的奶酪类型和样品形态。本研究评估了奶酪类型（切达奶酪、马苏里拉奶酪和酶改性奶酪 (EMC)）、预干燥形态（碎片、切片和立方体）和储存/成熟时间（0、30 和 60 天）对冻干奶酪粉的理化特性、挥发性成分、脂肪酸组成和氧化稳定性的影响。测定了近似成分、水分活度、游离脂肪酸、过氧化值、总氧化值和硫代巴比妥酸反应物质，并通过气相色谱-质谱法分析了挥发性化合物和脂肪酸。奶酪类型、形态和储存/成熟时间显着影响大多数属性（p < 0.05）。所有粉末都具有较高的总固体含量（96.01–97.88%）和较低的水分活度（0.21–0.25）。切达干酪具有最复杂的挥发性特征，而 EMC 则表现出加速的风味发展、最高的游离脂肪酸含量（0.26-0.46%）和最高的总氧化值（5.1-7.5）。马苏里拉奶酪保留了较温和的挥发性和较高的氧化稳定性。立方体通常保留较高浓度的挥发性化合物，而碎片有利于去除水分并显示出更大的脂肪分解和氧化作用。这些发现表明，可以优化奶酪类型和预干燥形态，以平衡风味发展、氧化稳定性和储存性能。

articles.title: Explainable Physics-Guided Machine Learning for Modeling and Prediction of Facies-Supported Unconfined Compressive Strength: Implication for CO 2 Storage
articles.title_zh: 用于相支撑无侧限抗压强度建模和预测的可解释物理引导机器学习：对 CO 2 封存的影响
articles.abstract: The geomechanical stability of CO₂ storage reservoirs, particularly the Unconfined Compressive Strength (UCS) of caprocks and reservoir formations, is critical for ensuring long-term containment security. Traditional UCS estimation methods, laboratory testing and empirical correlations, are often cost-prohibitive, time-intensive, or insufficiently accurate for heterogeneous subsurface systems. This study introduces a novel Explainable Physics-Guided Machine Learning (PGML) framework that, for the first time, combines facies-specific empirical equations with five advanced machine learning algorithms, AdaBoost, Gradient Boosting (GBT), Random Forest (RF), CatBoost, and Radial Basis Function Neural Network (RBFNN), in a discrepancy learning mode. Rather than predicting UCS directly, the models learn the residual between empirical predictions and laboratory-measured values using conventional well logs (porosity, density, gamma ray, resistivity, slowness, and ultrasonic velocity) from 45 core samples across seven wells in the Zubair Oil Field, Iraq. This physics-anchored approach preserves physical interpretability while capturing complex data-driven patterns. Results demonstrate substantial improvements across all algorithms: PGML increased the coefficient of determination (R²) from 0.10–0.84 (conventional ML) to 0.82–0.98, with the AdaBoost-PGML model achieving the highest accuracy (R² = 0.975, RMSE = 5.9 MPa), a 72% reduction in prediction error compared to conventional AdaBoost (R² = 0.68, RMSE = 21 MPa). SHapley Additive exPlanations (SHAP) analysis reveals that depth, porosity, bulk density, and gamma ray are the primary controls on the empirical-model discrepancy, indicating that compaction trends, pore structure, and clay content, absent from simple velocity-based equations, critically influence UCS. Applied to CO₂ storage assessment in the Zubair Field, the framework identifies a thick sandstone reservoir (φ = 16.9%, k = 428 mD) with high-integrity caprock (UCS = 156 MPa) as highly suitable for secure sequestration, while flagging a deeper interval where moderate caprock strength (UCS < 100 MPa) poses leakage risks. This hybrid PGML-XAI approach provides a robust, interpretable, and practically implementable tool for geomechanical characterization, directly supporting risk-informed decision-making in carbon storage projects.
articles.abstract_zh: 二氧化碳封存储层的地质力学稳定性，特别是盖层和储层地层的无侧限抗压强度 (UCS)，对于确保长期封存安全至关重要。传统的 UCS 估计方法、实验室测试和经验相关性通常成本高昂、耗时，或者对于异构地下系统不够准确。本研究引入了一种新颖的可解释物理引导机器学习（PGML）框架，该框架首次以差异学习模式将特定相的经验方程与五种先进的机器学习算法（AdaBoost、梯度提升（GBT）、随机森林（RF）、CatBoost 和径向基函数神经网络（RBFNN））相结合。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 二氧化碳封存储层的地质力学稳定性，特别是盖层和储层地层的无侧限抗压强度 (UCS)，对于确保长期封存安全至关重要。传统的 UCS 估计方法、实验室测试和经验相关性通常成本高昂、耗时，或者对于异构地下系统不够准确。本研究引入了一种新颖的可解释物理引导机器学习（PGML）框架，该框架首次以差异学习模式将特定相的经验方程与五种先进的机器学习算法（AdaBoost、梯度提升（GBT）、随机森林（RF）、CatBoost 和径向基函数神经网络（RBFNN））相结合。这些模型不是直接预测 UCS，而是使用传统测井曲线（孔隙度、密度、伽马射线、电阻率、慢度和超声波速度）从伊拉克 Zubair 油田 7 口井的 45 个岩心样本中学习经验预测和实验室测量值之间的残差。这种基于物理的方法保留了物理可解释性，同时捕获复杂的数据驱动模式。结果表明，所有算法都有显着改进：PGML 将决定系数 (R²) 从 0.10–0.84（传统 ML）提高到 0.82–0.98，其中 AdaBoost-PGML 模型实现了最高精度（R² = 0.975，RMSE = 5.9 MPa），与传统 AdaBoost（R² = 0.68， RMSE = 21 MPa）。 SHapley 加法解释 (SHAP) 分析表明，深度、孔隙度、体积密度和伽马射线是经验模型差异的主要控制因素，这表明压实趋势、孔隙结构和粘土含量（在简单的基于速度的方程中不存在）对 UCS 具有严重影响。该框架应用于 Zubair 油田的二氧化碳封存评估，确定厚砂岩储层（φ = 16.9%，k = 428 mD）和高完整性盖层（UCS = 156 MPa）非常适合安全封存，同时标记了较深的层段，其中中等盖层强度（UCS < 100 MPa）存在泄漏风险。这种混合 PGML-XAI 方法为地质力学表征提供了强大的、可解释的且实际可实施的工具，直接支持碳封存项目中的风险知情决策。

articles.title: Compositionally Graded Additive Manufacturing: A Method for Alloy Development and Tribocorrosion Evaluation
articles.title_zh: 成分分级增材制造：合金开发和摩擦腐蚀评估的方法
articles.abstract: Additive manufacturing (AM) enables the fabrication of materials with tailored compositional and microstructural gradients, offering unique opportunities for studying complex degradation phenomena such as tribocorrosion. In this work, a thin-walled stainless steel build with a continuous compositional gradient from super-austenitic AL6XN to austenitic 316L was produced using a dual-hopper powder feed system. Energy-dispersive spectroscopy (EDS) confirmed the compositional gradient and corresponding decrease in pitting resistance equivalent number (PREN), while electron backscatter diffraction (EBSD) revealed a microstructural gradient characteristic of thin-walled AM builds, evolving from fine elongated grains near the baseplate to coarser columnar grains at the top. Potentiostatic tribocorrosion testing in 0.6 M NaCl under anodic applied potentials demonstrated that wear rate increased with build height, inversely following the PREN gradient. Microhardness measurements confirmed the additional contribution of microstructural evolution on the local wear resistance which also impacts tribocorrosion performance. Current transients showed higher dissolution activity in 316L-rich regions and lower currents in AL6XN-rich regions, consistent with SEM observations of increased corrosion products in the 316L-regions. These results highlight that tribocorrosion performance is driven by the combined effects of wear resistance and corrosion resistance. More importantly, they demonstrate the utility of AM-graded samples as an efficient platform for screening alloys enabling novel alloy development and as a means for probing the coupled effects of wear and corrosion in tribocorrosion studies.
articles.abstract_zh: 增材制造 (AM) 能够制造具有定制成分和微观结构梯度的材料，为研究摩擦腐蚀等复杂降解现象提供了独特的机会。在这项工作中，使用双料斗送粉系统生产了具有从超级奥氏体 AL6XN 到奥氏体 316L 连续成分梯度的薄壁不锈钢结构。能量色散光谱 (EDS) 证实了成分梯度和相应的抗点蚀当量数 (PREN) 下降，而电子背散射衍射 (EBSD) 揭示了薄壁增材制造结构的微观结构梯度特征，从靠近基板的细长晶粒演变为顶部较粗的柱状晶粒。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 增材制造 (AM) 能够制造具有定制成分和微观结构梯度的材料，为研究摩擦腐蚀等复杂降解现象提供了独特的机会。在这项工作中，使用双料斗送粉系统生产了具有从超级奥氏体 AL6XN 到奥氏体 316L 连续成分梯度的薄壁不锈钢结构。能量色散光谱 (EDS) 证实了成分梯度和相应的抗点蚀当量数 (PREN) 下降，而电子背散射衍射 (EBSD) 揭示了薄壁增材制造结构的微观结构梯度特征，从靠近基板的细长晶粒演变为顶部较粗的柱状晶粒。在阳极施加电位下在 0.6 M 氯化钠中进行的恒电位摩擦腐蚀测试表明，磨损率随着构建高度的增加而增加，与 PREN 梯度成反比。显微硬度测量证实了微观结构演变对局部耐磨性的额外贡献，这也影响摩擦腐蚀性能。电流瞬变显示富含 316L 的区域具有较高的溶解活性，而富含 AL6XN 的区域则具有较低的电流，这与 SEM 观察到的 316L 区域腐蚀产物增加一致。这些结果表明，摩擦腐蚀性能是由耐磨性和耐腐蚀性的综合作用驱动的。更重要的是，他们展示了 AM 分级样品作为筛选合金的有效平台的实用性，从而实现新型合金的开发，以及作为探测摩擦腐蚀研究中磨损和腐蚀耦合效应的手段。

articles.title: Physics-Constrained Deep Sequential Learning for Continuous Pore Pressure and Fracture Gradient Prediction in Heterogeneous Carbonate Reservoirs Using Conventional Wireline Logs
articles.title_zh: 使用传统有线测井进行非均质碳酸盐岩储层连续孔隙压力和裂缝梯度预测的物理约束深度序列学习
articles.abstract: Accurate assessment of predrilling and post-drill of formation pore pressure (Pp) and fracture gradient (FG) is quite important for defining a safe mud-weight window and avoiding kicks. Also, it is crucial for mitigating lost circulation and improving casing shoe depths. In Middle Eastern reservoirs, specifically heterogeneous carbonate reservoirs, traditional empirical correlations such as Eaton's sonic and resistivity equations as well as Bowers' velocity-stress relations and Matthews-Kelly fracture models often fail. Failure is attributed to carbonate rock stiffness, diagenetic cementation and secondary porosity beside chemical compaction decouple acoustic velocity from vertical effective stress (σ'v). Moreover, particular dipole sonic logs (Δts), borehole image logs and laboratory rock-mechanics core measurements are not often acquired across entire development wells because of extreme cost and operational hazards. However, using conventional wireline logs and as follow; Gamma Ray (GR); Bulk Density (ρb); Neutron Porosity (ϕN); Deep Resistivity (Rt); Caliper (CALI), and Compressional Sonic transit time (Δtc) is to overcome these limitations. This study suggests a novel work of Physics-Constrained Bidirectional Gated Recurrent Unit with Temporal Depth Attention (PC-BiGRU-Attn) framework. When well-log profiles are formulated as bidirectional stratigraphic depth sequences (L = 31, samples = 1.94 m aperture) instead of isolated depth points, the sequential network captures vertical compaction transitions beside caprock sealing effects and lithofacies boundaries across carbonate subunits. Both, Terzaghi's effective stress principle and geomechanical boundary constraints (Phyd ≤ Pp < Pf ≤ σv) are embedded directly into a hybrid physics-informed loss function to eradicate physically excluded pressure spikes in uncalibrated intervals. Field validation across three anonymized wells (WELL X1, WELL X2, and WELL X3, comprising 60,186 depth measurements spanning 1,247.12–3,392.62 m) demonstrates that the proposed PC-BiGRU-Attn architecture outperforms standalone empirical methods (Eaton, Bowers, and Matthews–Kelly), Multilayer Perceptrons (MLP), Gradient Boosted Trees (GBR), 1D Convolutional Neural Networks (1D-CNN), and standard Bidirectional Long Short-Term Memory (Bi-LSTM) networks. On the unseen blind test well (WELL X2, N = 8,946), PC-BiGRU-Attn achieves a coefficient of determination (R²) of 0.9876 (RMSE = 60.14 psi, MAPE = 1.30%) for pore pressure and R² = 0.9961 (RMSE = 32.39 psi, or FG RMSE = 0.0047 psi/ft, MAPE = 0.46%) for fracture pressure, reducing blind-well pore and fracture pressure RMSE by 37.2% and 49.6%, respectively, relative to point-wise ANN models while maintaining a 0.00% physical violation rate.
articles.abstract_zh: 准确评估钻前和钻后地层孔隙压力 (Pp) 和裂缝梯度 (FG) 对于确定安全泥浆重量窗口和避免井涌非常重要。此外，它对于减少循环漏失和提高套管鞋深度也至关重要。在中东油藏中，特别是非均质碳酸盐岩油藏中，传统的经验相关性（例如 Eaton 的声波和电阻率方程以及 Bowers 的速度-应力关系和 Matthews-Kelly 裂缝模型）经常失效。除了化学压实将声速与垂直有效应力（σ'v）解耦之外，破坏还归因于碳酸盐岩的刚度、成岩胶结和次生孔隙度。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 准确评估钻前和钻后地层孔隙压力 (Pp) 和裂缝梯度 (FG) 对于确定安全泥浆重量窗口和避免井涌非常重要。此外，它对于减少循环漏失和提高套管鞋深度也至关重要。在中东油藏中，特别是非均质碳酸盐岩油藏中，传统的经验相关性（例如 Eaton 的声波和电阻率方程以及 Bowers 的速度-应力关系和 Matthews-Kelly 裂缝模型）经常失效。除了化学压实将声速与垂直有效应力（σ'v）解耦之外，破坏还归因于碳酸盐岩的刚度、成岩胶结和次生孔隙度。此外，由于极端的成本和操作风险，通常不会在整个开发井中获取特定的偶极子声波测井（Δts）、钻孔图像测井和实验室岩石力学岩心测量。然而，使用传统的电缆测井如下；伽马射线（GR）；堆积密度（ρb）；中子孔隙度 (ψN)；深电阻率（Rt）；卡尺 (CALI) 和压缩声波渡越时间 (Δtc) 就是为了克服这些限制。这项研究提出了具有时间深度注意力的物理约束双向门控循环单元（PC-BiGRU-Attn）框架的新颖工作。当测井剖面被制定为双向地层深度序列（L = 31，样本 = 1.94 m孔径）而不是孤立的深度点时，序列网络捕获除了盖层密封效应和跨碳酸盐亚基的岩相边界之外的垂直压实转变。 Terzaghi 的有效应力原理和地质力学边界约束 (Phyd ≤ Pp < Pf ≤ σv) 都直接嵌入到混合物理信息损失函数中，以消除未校准间隔中物理排除的压力峰值。对三个匿名井（WELL X1、WELL X2 和 WELL X3，包括跨越 1,247.12–3,392.62 m 的 60,186 个深度测量）的现场验证表明，所提出的 PC-BiGRU-Attn 架构优于独立的经验方法（Eaton、Bowers 和 Matthews–Kelly）、多层感知器 (MLP)、梯度提升树(GBR)、一维卷积神经网络 (1D-CNN) 和标准双向长短期记忆 (Bi-LSTM) 网络。在看不见的盲测试井 (WELL X2, N = 8,946) 上，PC-BiGRU-Attn 的孔隙压力决定系数 (R²) 为 0.9876 (RMSE = 60.14 psi，MAPE = 1.30%)，R² = 0.9961对于破裂压力（RMSE = 32.39 psi，或 FG RMSE = 0.0047 psi/ft，MAPE = 0.46%），相对于逐点 ANN 模型，盲井孔隙和破裂压力 RMSE 分别降低 37.2% 和 49.6%，同时保持 0.00% 的物理违规率。

articles.title: Two-Stage Spectral Decoupling for High-Precision Digital Twin: A Multi-Frequency Residual Compensation Framework
articles.title_zh: 高精度数字孪生的两级频谱解耦：多频率残余补偿框架
articles.abstract: High-fidelity digital twin modeling hinges on accurately compensating the multi-frequency dynamic deviation between physical entities and mechanism-based models, in which low-frequency components (e.g., aging trends, thermal deformation) coexist with high-frequency disturbances (e.g., transient vibration, electromagnetic interference). Existing methods typically fit the deviation as a single residual, causing high-frequency transient features to be overwhelmed by dominant low-frequency signals. This paper proposes a two-stage spectral decoupling framework: a base time-series model first captures the low-frequency trend, and a dedicated Wavelet-Enhanced Residual Transformer (WERT) then refines the high-frequency residual. WERT embeds the discrete wavelet transform (DWT) into the Transformer forward pass to explicitly decouple multi-scale time-frequency features, employs parallel prediction heads to handle statistical heterogeneity across output dimensions, and exploits the unique data advantage that DT systems can acquire mechanism-model predictions in real time. On two six-degree-of-freedom robotic arm platforms (JAKA Zu 12 and UR3), the proposed method reduces the fused-prediction mean absolute error (MAE) by 28.1% and 31.2%. Under a 0.1 mm tolerance band, the in-tolerance rate improves by 46%. Band-wise error energy analysis confirms that error reduction concentrates in the low- and mid-frequency bands where the base model underfits. Ablation studies show that the two-stage spectral decoupling paradigm is the dominant factor of accuracy gain, that mean absolute error (MAE) loss aligns closely with the Laplacian statistics of residual signals, and that using only high-frequency wavelet components retains near-lossless accuracy with 86% fewer parameters. This work provides an efficient and robust deviation-compensation paradigm for high-fidelity DTs of complex industrial systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 高保真数字孪生建模取决于精确补偿物理实体和基于机制的模型之间的多频率动态偏差，其中低频分量（例如老化趋势、热变形）与高频干扰（例如瞬态振动、电磁干扰）共存。现有方法通常将偏差拟合为单个残差，导致高频瞬态特征被占主导地位的低频信号淹没。本文提出了一个两阶段频谱解耦框架：基础时间序列模型首先捕获低频趋势，然后使用专用的小波增强残差变换器（WERT）细化高频残差。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 高保真数字孪生建模取决于精确补偿物理实体和基于机制的模型之间的多频率动态偏差，其中低频分量（例如老化趋势、热变形）与高频干扰（例如瞬态振动、电磁干扰）共存。现有方法通常将偏差拟合为单个残差，导致高频瞬态特征被占主导地位的低频信号淹没。本文提出了一个两阶段频谱解耦框架：基础时间序列模型首先捕获低频趋势，然后使用专用的小波增强残差变换器（WERT）细化高频残差。 WERT将离散小波变换（DWT）嵌入到Transformer前向传递中，以显式解耦多尺度时频特征，采用并行预测头来处理跨输出维度的统计异质性，并利用DT系统可以实时获取机制模型预测的独特数据优势。在两个六自由度机械臂平台（JAKA Zu 12 和 UR3）上，该方法将融合预测平均绝对误差（MAE）降低了 28.1% 和 31.2%。在 0.1 毫米公差范围内，不公差率提高了 46%。逐带误差能量分析证实，误差减少集中在基本模型拟合不足的低频段和中频段。消融研究表明，两级谱解耦范式是精度增益的主导因素，平均绝对误差 (MAE) 损失与残余信号的拉普拉斯统计密切相关，并且仅使用高频小波分量即可保持近乎无损的精度，参数减少 86%。这项工作为复杂工业系统的高保真 DT 提供了一种高效、鲁棒的偏差补偿范例。

articles.title: Feature Engineering Is the Bottleneck: An Explainability Study of ML-Based Security-Relevant Method Detection
articles.title_zh: 特征工程是瓶颈：基于 ML 的安全相关方法检测的可解释性研究
articles.abstract: Static Application Security Testing tools trace untrusted data flows using curated lists of Security-Relevant Methods (SRMs), namely sources, sinks and sanitizers. Machine learning approaches for SRM detection (ML4SRM) report strong cross-validation results yet perform far worse on unseen code, and prior work has not asked why. To assess this disparity we develop WEAVE, a tool combining automated model selection, repeated cross-validation and explainable Artificial intelligence (XAI) using SHapley Additive exPlanations (SHAP) for WEKA/MEKA pipelines. Using WEAVE and SRM-Dataset, our consolidated collection of 10,180 Java SRMs, we conduct an explanation study of three ML4SRM approaches, namely, Dev-Assist, SSCM, and SWAN. Global and local explanations show that the models rely on identifier tokens and parameter signatures, barely on the method body, so they learn dependencies among surface features specific to the training data. On unseen code the models read those same features differently, with 43 of 59 feature group and model combinations shifting significantly, by up to 62 percentage points, and 14 pointing the opposite way for most methods. Nothing inside the models changes. An attribution is a per-instance quantity averaged over the methods explained, not a weight stored in the model, so one fixed decision function can be read two ways. AutoML, included as a control, raises F1 yet broadens feature use in only four of the seven models, while aggregate metrics hide the instability, with micro-F1 at 0.99 where minority-class F1 is 0.15. Feature engineering, not model selection, is therefore the bottleneck for SRM detection. Progress depends on features that survive renaming, obfuscation stress tests, and per-class metrics alongside aggregate scores.
articles.abstract_zh: 静态应用程序安全测试工具使用安全相关方法 (SRM) 的精选列表（即源、接收器和清理器）来跟踪不受信任的数据流。用于 SRM 检测 (ML4SRM) 的机器学习方法报告了强大的交叉验证结果，但在未见过的代码上表现却差得多，并且之前的工作并未询问原因。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 静态应用程序安全测试工具使用安全相关方法 (SRM) 的精选列表（即源、接收器和清理器）来跟踪不受信任的数据流。用于 SRM 检测 (ML4SRM) 的机器学习方法报告了强大的交叉验证结果，但在未见过的代码上表现却差得多，并且之前的工作并未询问原因。为了评估这种差异，我们开发了 WEAVE，这是一种结合了自动模型选择、重复交叉验证和可解释人工智能 (XAI) 的工具，使用 SHapley Additive exPlanations (SHAP) 进行 WEKA/MEKA 管道。使用 WEAVE 和 SRM-Dataset（我们的 10,180 个 Java SRM 的综合集合），我们对三种 ML4SRM 方法（即 Dev-Assist、SSCM 和 SWAN）进行了解释研究。全局和局部解释表明，模型依赖于标识符标记和参数签名，几乎不依赖于方法主体，因此它们学习特定于训练数据的表面特征之间的依赖关系。在看不见的代码上，模型以不同的方式读取这些相同的特征，59 个特征组和模型组合中有 43 个显着变化，变化幅度高达 62 个百分点，而对于大多数方法来说，有 14 个指向相反的方向。模型内部没有任何变化。归因是对所解释的方法进行平均的每个实例数量，而不是模型中存储的权重，因此可以通过两种方式读取一个固定决策函数。 AutoML 作为对照，提高了 F1，但仅在七个模型中的四个模型中扩大了功能使用，而聚合指标掩盖了不稳定性，微型 F1 为 0.99，少数类 F1 为 0.15。因此，特征工程（而不是模型选择）是 SRM 检测的瓶颈。进展取决于能否经受住重命名、混淆压力测试、每类指标以及总分的影响。

articles.title: Dielectric and electrical properties of sol-gel γ-Fe2O3 nanoparticles: polaron hopping and a thermal crossover of the transport regime
articles.title_zh: 溶胶-凝胶 γ-Fe2O3 纳米粒子的介电和电学性质：极化子跳跃和传输机制的热交叉
articles.abstract: γ-Fe2O3 nanoparticles prepared by the sol-gel method (supercritical drying in ethanol) were characterized by XRD, TEM/HRTEM and Raman spectroscopy, which indicate a single-phase cubic spinel structure (maghemite-like) made of quasi-spherical, essentially single-crystalline nanoparticles (crystallite size of about 9–12 nm from XRD; mean TEM diameter of about 7 nm). Their electrical and dielectric properties were studied by impedance spectroscopy between 300 and 600 K. Below ≈ 420 K the ac conductivity is dispersive and follows Jonscher’s power law, with a frequency exponent s that varies non-monotonically with temperature (minimum near 340 K); above ≈ 440 K it is frequency independent. The thermally activated conductivity, the low activation energies at low temperature (100– 300 meV from the ac data; 315 meV from the impedance fits) and the behavior of s(T) are consistent with charge transport by hopping of small polarons between Fe 2+ and Fe 3+ ions, with a probable crossover from correlated-barrier-hopping/overlapping-large-polaron to non-overlapping small-polaron tunneling; Mott’s variable-range hopping is ruled out. The Fe 2+ carriers are attributed to the reducing synthesis medium and to the oxygen-deficient surface of the ~7 nm particles, and the hopping barrier to the reorganization energy of the Fe 2+ /Fe 3+ electron transfer. The activation energy increases to 0.73 eV above 440 K and the conductivity rises about sevenfold between 420 and 440 K, whereas an Arrhenius extrapolation predicts only ≈ 2.5; we tentatively interpret this step as the thermally activated release of additional Fe 2+ carriers (loss of surface hydroxyl groups and oxygen) combined with the activation of the inter-particle contacts of the aerogel network, which carry the long-range current.
articles.abstract_zh: 通过溶胶-凝胶法（乙醇中超临界干燥）制备的 γ-Fe2O3 纳米颗粒通过 XRD、TEM/HRTEM 和拉曼光谱进行表征，结果表明单相立方尖晶石结构（磁赤铁矿状）由准球形、基本上单晶的纳米颗粒组成（从 XRD 来看，晶粒尺寸约为 9-12 nm；平均 TEM 直径约为 7 nm）。通过 300 至 600 K 之间的阻抗谱研究了它们的电气和介电特性。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 通过溶胶-凝胶法（乙醇中超临界干燥）制备的 γ-Fe2O3 纳米颗粒通过 XRD、TEM/HRTEM 和拉曼光谱进行表征，结果表明单相立方尖晶石结构（磁赤铁矿状）由准球形、基本上单晶的纳米颗粒组成（从 XRD 来看，晶粒尺寸约为 9-12 nm；平均 TEM 直径约为 7 nm）。通过 300 至 600 K 之间的阻抗谱研究了它们的电气和介电特性。在 420 K 以下，交流电导率是色散的，并且遵循 Jonscher 幂律，频率指数 s 随温度非单调变化（最小接近 340 K）；高于 ≈ 440 K 时，它与频率无关。热激活电导率、低温下的低激活能（交流数据为 100–300 meV；阻抗拟合为 315 meV）和 s(T) 的行为与 Fe 2+ 和 Fe 3+ 离子之间小极化子跳跃的电荷传输一致，可能存在从相关势垒跳跃/重叠大极化子隧道到非重叠小极化子隧道的交叉；莫特的可变范围跳跃被排除。 Fe 2+ 载流子归因于还原合成介质和〜7 nm颗粒的缺氧表面，以及Fe 2+ /Fe 3+ 电子转移重组能的跳跃势垒。在 440 K 以上，活化能增加至 0.73 eV，电导率在 420 至 440 K 之间增加约七倍，而阿伦尼乌斯外推法预测仅为 ≈ 2.5；我们暂时将此步骤解释为额外 Fe 2+ 载体的热激活释放（表面羟基和氧的损失）与气凝胶网络颗粒间接触的激活相结合，该网络携带长程电流。

articles.title: Silane-Functionalized MgO Nanoflake-Reinforced PLA–Curcumin Nanocomposite Films for Active Grape Packaging
articles.title_zh: 用于活性葡萄包装的硅烷官能化 MgO 纳米片增强 PLA-姜黄素纳米复合薄膜
articles.abstract: Hydrothermally synthesized magnesium oxide (MgO) nanoflakes (NFs) were developed as functional nanofillers for biodegradable active food packaging. X-ray diffraction confirmed a face-centered cubic crystal structure with an average crystallite size of 21.5 nm, while transmission electron microscopy revealed a flake-like morphology with particle sizes of 90–110 nm. The MgO NFs exhibited concentration-dependent antibacterial activity against Staphylococcus aureus and Escherichia coli, with greater susceptibility observed for E. coli. Toxicity assessment using Artemia salina nauplii and RAW 264.7 macrophage cells demonstrated excellent biocompatibility without significant cytotoxicity up to 50 µg mL⁻¹. Surface-functionalized MgO, modified with 3-(glycidyloxypropyl)trimethoxysilane, was incorporated into polylactic acid/curcumin (PLA-CRU) films at 1–3% via solvent casting. FTIR, XRD, and SEM analyses confirmed improved interfacial compatibility, enhanced crystallinity, and uniform nanoparticle dispersion within the polymer matrix. The PLA-CRU-3% F-MgO film exhibited complete inhibition of both bacterial strains and the highest antioxidant activity. During grape storage, the nanocomposite films reduced weight loss, maintained pH and titratable acidity, preserved antioxidant capacity, and effectively delayed fruit deterioration. Overall, the PLA-CRU-3% F-MgO nanocomposite demonstrates strong potential as a biodegradable active packaging material for extending the shelf life and microbiological safety of fresh fruits.
articles.abstract_zh: 水热合成氧化镁（MgO）纳米片（NF）被开发为可生物降解活性食品包装的功能性纳米填料。 X 射线衍射证实了平均晶粒尺寸为 21.5 nm 的面心立方晶体结构，而透射电子显微镜显示出颗粒尺寸为 90-110 nm 的片状形态。 MgO NFs 对金黄色葡萄球菌和大肠杆菌表现出浓度依赖性抗菌活性，并且对大肠杆菌具有更高的敏感性。使用卤虫无节幼体和 RAW 264.7 巨噬细胞进行的毒性评估显示出优异的生物相容性，在高达 50 µg mL⁻1 的情况下没有显着的细胞毒性。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 水热合成氧化镁（MgO）纳米片（NF）被开发为可生物降解活性食品包装的功能性纳米填料。 X 射线衍射证实了平均晶粒尺寸为 21.5 nm 的面心立方晶体结构，而透射电子显微镜显示出颗粒尺寸为 90-110 nm 的片状形态。 MgO NFs 对金黄色葡萄球菌和大肠杆菌表现出浓度依赖性抗菌活性，并且对大肠杆菌具有更高的敏感性。使用卤虫无节幼体和 RAW 264.7 巨噬细胞进行的毒性评估显示出优异的生物相容性，在高达 50 µg mL⁻1 的情况下没有显着的细胞毒性。用 3-(缩水甘油氧基丙基)三甲氧基硅烷改性的表面功能化 MgO，通过溶剂浇铸以 1-3% 的浓度掺入聚乳酸/姜黄素 (PLA-CRU) 薄膜中。 FTIR、XRD 和 SEM 分析证实了界面相容性的改善、结晶度的增强以及纳米粒子在聚合物基质内的均匀分散。 PLA-CRU-3%F-MgO薄膜对两种菌株均表现出完全抑制作用，并具有最高的抗氧化活性。在葡萄贮藏过程中，纳米复合薄膜减少了失重，保持了pH值和可滴定酸度，保留了抗氧化能力，有效延缓了果实变质。总体而言，PLA-CRU-3% F-MgO 纳米复合材料显示出作为可生物降解活性包装材料的巨大潜力，可延长新鲜水果的保质期和微生物安全性。

articles.title: Effect of Agarose Content on the Thermal, Rheological, and Electrochemical Properties of Proline: Glycerol-based Eutectogels
articles.title_zh: 琼脂糖含量对脯氨酸热学、流变学和电化学性质的影响：甘油基共凝胶
articles.abstract: Deep eutectic solvent (DES)-based eutectogels combine the physicochemical characteristics of DESs with the structural properties of polymeric networks. In the present study, a proline DES with a 1:3 molar ratio was incorporated into agarose to prepare eutectogels with different agarose contents. Two formulations were investigated using 50 g and 100 g of agarose per 100 g of DES, respectively. The prepared eutectogels were characterized by thermogravimetric analysis (TGA), rheological measurements, cyclic voltammetry (CV), and electrochemical impedance spectroscopy (EIS) to investigate their thermal, viscoelastic, flow, and electrochemical behaviour. TGA showed initial mass loss associated with volatile/moisture components followed by major thermal degradation at higher temperatures. Rheological measurements showed that the storage modulus (G′) remained higher than the loss modulus (G″) for both formulations, indicating predominantly elastic and gel-like behaviour. The higher agarose-content formulation exhibited greater G′ and viscosity, while both eutectogels showed shear-thinning behaviour. CV measurements demonstrated measurable electrochemical responses, with the 50% eutectogel showing a higher current at +1 V (3.7 μA) than the 100% eutectogel (0.93 μA). EIS measurements provided complementary information on the resistive and interfacial behaviour of the eutectogels. Overall, the results demonstrate that variation in agarose content can influence the thermal, rheological, and electrochemical behaviour of proline eutectogels, providing a basis for further optimization of DES–biopolymer systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 基于低共熔溶剂 (DES) 的共熔凝胶将 DES 的物理化学特性与聚合物网络的结构特性相结合。本研究将脯氨酸DES以1:3的摩尔比掺入琼脂糖中，制备了不同琼脂糖含量的共熔凝胶。对两种制剂进行了研究，每 100 g DES 分别使用 50 g 和 100 g 琼脂糖。通过热重分析（TGA）、流变测量、循环伏安法（CV）和电化学阻抗谱（EIS）对制备的共熔凝胶进行表征，以研究其热、粘弹性、流动和电化学行为。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 基于低共熔溶剂 (DES) 的共熔凝胶将 DES 的物理化学特性与聚合物网络的结构特性相结合。本研究将脯氨酸DES以1:3的摩尔比掺入琼脂糖中，制备了不同琼脂糖含量的共熔凝胶。对两种制剂进行了研究，每 100 g DES 分别使用 50 g 和 100 g 琼脂糖。通过热重分析（TGA）、流变测量、循环伏安法（CV）和电化学阻抗谱（EIS）对制备的共熔凝胶进行表征，以研究其热、粘弹性、流动和电化学行为。 TGA 显示与挥发性/水分成分相关的初始质量损失，随后在较高温度下发生主要热降解。流变测量表明，两种配方的储能模量 (G') 仍然高于损耗模量 (G'')，表明主要是弹性和凝胶状行为。琼脂糖含量较高的制剂表现出较高的 G' 和粘度，而两种共熔凝胶均表现出剪切稀化行为。 CV 测量显示可测量的电化学响应，50% 共析凝胶在 +1 V 时显示出比 100% 共析凝胶 (0.93 μA) 更高的电流 (3.7 μA)。 EIS 测量提供了共熔凝胶电阻和界面行为的补充信息。总的来说，结果表明琼脂糖含量的变化可以影响脯氨酸共熔凝胶的热、流变和电化学行为，为进一步优化 DES-生物聚合物系统提供了基础。

articles.title: Little-Parks Oscillations and Parity Effects in Mesoscopic Superconducting Rings
articles.title_zh: 介观超导环中的小帕克斯振荡和宇称效应
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.14597v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We analytically investigate the Little-Parks (LP) effect, the periodic oscillation of the superconducting transition temperature T_c driven by an applied magnetic flux Φ, from the weak-coupling Bardeen-Cooper-Schrieffer (BCS) limit to the intermediate-coupling regime in a mesoscopic, quasi-one-dimensional ring. Utilizing a Ginzburg-Landau (GL) expansion with twisted boundary conditions, we correctly incorporate both the discrete finite-size topological parity interference and the continuous center-of-mass (CM) kinetic energy shift induced by the supercurrent. We derive a closed-form expression for T_c(Φ) valid within the GL framework across variable interaction strengths. We demonstrate that the LP response comprises two distinct physical contributions: a discrete topological parity effect governed by the correlation length ratio ξ/R, and a continuous kinetic energy term scaling as 1/R². As the coupling increases and the spatial correlation length of the pairs contracts (ξ ll R), the constituent pairs become geometrically blind to the global boundary constraint, leading to an exponential suppression of the discrete parity modulation. However, the requirement that the condensate acquires a flux-dependent macroscopic CM momentum persists. This ensures that the critical temperature T_c maintains an algebraic LP modulation driven predominantly by the macroscopic kinetic energy of the supercurrent. We bound our theoretical approach by discussing the breakdown of mean-field GL validity before phase fluctuations dominate near the strong-coupling limit.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们分析研究了 Little-Parks (LP) 效应，即由外加磁通量 Φ 驱动的超导转变温度 T_c 的周期性振荡，从弱耦合 Bardeen-Cooper-Schrieffer (BCS) 极限到介观准一维环中的中间耦合状态。利用具有扭曲边界条件的金茨堡-朗道（GL）展开，我们正确地结合了离散有限尺寸拓扑宇称干涉和超流引起的连续质心（CM）动能移动。我们推导出 T_c(Φ) 的封闭式表达式，该表达式在 GL 框架内跨可变交互强度有效。
