articles.title: Evaluation of bioplastic films made from seaweeds and its polymers
articles.title_zh: 由海藻及其聚合物制成的生物塑料薄膜的评估
articles.abstract: Seaweeds grow and produce a significant amount of biomass per unit area, providing specialized phytochemicals for the manufacturing of bioplastics, which may otherwise less affordable. In this study, the brown seaweed Sargassum denticulatum and the red Corallina officinalis were used to prepare bioplastic films from both whole algal powder and their extracted polymers using two methods: conventional and ultrasound-assisted extraction. Ultrasound proved to be more effective for extracting polymers, as evidenced by the yield of alginate, which was higher than that of carrageenan in both methods. The functional compositions of the films were evaluated using Fourier-Transform Infrared (FTIR) spectroscopy. Additionally, key properties such as solubility, moisture absorption resistance, elongation at break, tensile strength, and degradability were assessed. The resulting bioplastic films exhibited varying physical and mechanical properties, making each suitable for distinct applications based on its characteristics. Notably, the whole-algae films demonstrated higher solubility, superior mechanical properties, and faster degradation compared to the polymer-based films. Therefore, bioplastic films made from seaweeds and their extracted polysaccharides hold great potential as viable alternatives to synthetic plastics, contributing to the reduction of environmental pollution caused by petroleum-derived materials.
articles.abstract_zh: 海藻生长并产生大量单位面积生物质，为生物塑料的制造提供特殊的植物化学物质，否则生物塑料的成本可能更高。在本研究中，使用褐藻锯齿海带和红藻石枝藻，采用两种方法（常规提取法和超声辅助提取法）从全藻粉及其提取的聚合物中制备生物塑料薄膜。事实证明，超声波在提取聚合物方面更有效，这体现在两种方法中藻酸盐的产率均高于卡拉胶。使用傅里叶变换红外（FTIR）光谱法评估了薄膜的功能成分。此外，还评估了溶解性、吸湿性、断裂伸长率、拉伸强度和降解性等关键性能。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 海藻生长并产生大量单位面积生物质，为生物塑料的制造提供特殊的植物化学物质，否则生物塑料的成本可能更高。在本研究中，使用褐藻锯齿海带和红藻石枝藻，采用两种方法（常规提取法和超声辅助提取法）从全藻粉及其提取的聚合物中制备生物塑料薄膜。事实证明，超声波在提取聚合物方面更有效，这体现在两种方法中藻酸盐的产率均高于卡拉胶。使用傅里叶变换红外（FTIR）光谱法评估了薄膜的功能成分。此外，还评估了溶解性、吸湿性、断裂伸长率、拉伸强度和降解性等关键性能。所得生物塑料薄膜表现出不同的物理和机械性能，因此每种薄膜都因其特性而适用于不同的应用。值得注意的是，与聚合物基薄膜相比，全藻薄膜表现出更高的溶解度、更优异的机械性能和更快的降解速度。因此，由海藻及其提取的多糖制成的生物塑料薄膜作为合成塑料的可行替代品具有巨大潜力，有助于减少石油衍生材料造成的环境污染。

articles.title: Optimization of a radio-frequency inductively coupled plasma thruster
articles.abstract: Radio-Frequency (RF) Inductively Coupled Plasma (ICP) thrusters are an emerging electrothermal propulsion technology that creates a high-density plasma to heat propellant which is then accelerated through a converging-diverging nozzle. Using a multi-physics model accounting for plasma production, plasma-coil electromagnetic coupling, heat transfer, and impedance matching, this work investigates optimization of a complete RF ICP propulsion system for small satellite missions by varying important design and operating parameters including thruster size, propellant type, mass flow rate, and RF frequency. Aside from thruster performance, an important optimization metric is minimization of the total propulsion system mass, and for a representative small satellite mission power and total impulse of 100 W and 1 kNs respectively, xenon is found to be an attractive propellant because of its low ionization threshold, high atomic mass, and high storage density. This not only reduces propulsion system inert mass, but also yields a thrust-to-power ratio almost ten times higher than other electric propulsion technologies such as gridded ion or Hall thrusters.

articles.title: Sovereign-Mohawk: Machine-Checked Hierarchical Byzantine Resilience and Probabilistic Composition for Federated Learning
articles.abstract: Federated learning (FL) at scale requires aggregating model updates across multi-tier topologies while tolerating adversarial participants. A common assumption in hierarchical FL is that if every local aggregation tier enforces an honest-majority guard, the composition inherits global Byzantine resilience. In this paper, we present Sovereign-Mohawk, an FL architecture and Lean 4 formal development that refutes and repairs this assumption. First, we present a machine-checked negative result: a concrete counterexample in Lean 4 showing that naive deterministic composition of per-tier Multi-Krum guards fails, allowing a 60% global Byzantine leaf fraction to pass local filters under concentrated placement. Second, we formalize a probabilistic repair proving that under explicit (:i.i.d.) Bernoulli committee sampling, the probability of any tier exceeding its Byzantine filtering threshold is strictly bounded by a Chernoff bound over rationals, verified for (:T=200) committees and (:c=50,000) leaves per committee via native_decide ((:Pfₐᵢₗle:200×:2⁻¹⁰⁰⁰)). Third, we couple these formal artifacts with a deployable Go runtime featuring Rényi differential privacy, flat Groth16/BN254 zero-knowledge verifiability, and post-quantum key exchange (X25519-ML-KEM-768). Finally, we evaluate the system across multi-node Kind (Kubernetes-in-Docker) clusters on single hosts (up to 500 pods), CI swarm matrices (500–1,500 nodes), and a 1,000-node simulator target under safe (10% Byzantine) and edge (35% Byzantine) adversarial regimes, demonstrating microsecond aggregation overhead (30.63 (:μ:)s) and minimal accuracy impact (1.8% gap vs. clean baseline). Every formal claim is bound to implementation code via a publicly audited traceability matrix enforced in continuous integration. Federated Learning, Byzantine Fault Tolerance, Formal Verification, Lean 4, Hierarchical Aggregation, Differential Privacy, Zero-Knowledge Proofs.

articles.title: Photoacoustic imaging of human brain function through intact adult skulls
articles.abstract: Blood-oxygen-level-dependent (BOLD) functional magnetic resonance imaging (fMRI) has revolutionized noninvasive imaging of human brain function, but it indirectly senses deoxyhemoglobin through water-proton relaxation and relies on bulky, costly, noisy, enclosed, superconducting-magnet scanners. In contrast, photoacoustic computed tomography (PACT) directly probes hemoglobin absorption using a more compact, lower-cost, quieter, open, magnet-free system. However, functional PACT of the adult human brain has so far been demonstrated only after surgical skull removal, because the skull strongly attenuates optical and acoustic signals. Here, we demonstrate non-invasive transcranial functional PACT (T-fPACT) through the intact adult skull. A densely packed, high-channel-count (3,072-element) hemispherical ultrasonic array provides near-2π-steradian simultaneous acquisition, enabling high sensitivity and single-shot three-dimensional imaging at 20 Hz that eliminates motion blurring. Participant-specific stabilization further enables measurement of small task-evoked hemodynamic responses over the entire task duration. In healthy adults, T-fPACT localized responses to expected sensorimotor regions, distinguished task-specific motor representations, and yielded consistent localizations across repeated task runs and visits. Comparison with high-field (7 T) fMRI showed spatially corresponding functional regions, while dual-wavelength imaging revealed distinct hemoglobin-weighted responses. These findings overcome the long-standing skull barrier in human brain PACT and establish non-invasive, rapid volumetric photoacoustic imaging of brain function.

articles.title: Iron modified coal gangue for light assisted attenuation of aqueous hexavalent chromium
articles.abstract: Coal gangue is a potential mineral precursor for water-treatment materials, but the effect of iron modification on aqueous hexavalent chromium [Cr(VI)] attenuation requires evaluation. This study compares a calcined and acid-washed gangue-derived material (SA) with its iron-modified counterpart (SAF) under white light-emitting diode irradiation. SAF was prepared by treatment with an iron nitrate precursor in N,N-dimethylformamide at 200 °C for 15 h, followed by centrifugation, drying, and calcination in air at 600 °C for 6 h. Powder X-ray diffraction showed similar dominant mineral reflections for SA and SAF, while surface spectroscopy and elemental mapping detected iron in SAF. Relative to SA, SAF exhibited a higher transient photocurrent and a smaller electrochemical impedance arc under the measurement conditions. The concentration profiles indicate faster aqueous Cr(VI) attenuation by SAF at pH 7 than by SA, with a steeper decline for acidified SAF at pH 3. Quantitative rate comparisons require validated sampling and concentration measurements. These observations do not independently establish complete chromium removal, a specific iron oxide phase, or a zeolite heterojunction. A possible contribution from light-driven electron transfer is discussed alongside adsorption and iron-mediated reactions. The findings identify an iron-modified gangue-derived material for further investigation, with chromium mass balance, iron leaching, independent replication, and authentic wastewater testing required to establish environmental applicability.

articles.title: Lightweight MXene–B₄C–Polyimide Nanocomposite for Simultaneous Cosmic Radiation and Electromagnetic Interference Shielding in Aerospace Avionics
articles.abstract: At cruise altitudes, atmospheric proton radiation and electromagnetic interference (EMI) jointly threaten the reliability of flight-critical avionics. Conventional protection strategies typically address these hazards separately through aluminum- or lead-based radiation barriers and conductive copper-mesh EMI shields, increasing enclosure mass, volume, and integration complexity. To address this limitation, we present a lightweight dual-function MXene (Ti₃C₂Tₓ)–B₄C–polyimide nanocomposite that combines proton attenuation and EMI shielding within a single conformal material system. The framework integrates SRIM/TRIM-guided compositional design, controlled nanocomposite fabrication, proton-beam testing, broadband EMI characterization, and aerospace-relevant environmental validation. SRIM/TRIM simulations show that a boron-rich composition of 31 at% achieves complete stopping of 50 MeV protons at approximately 36 mm bulk thickness, with electronic stopping dominating energy loss and negligible backscattering. Surface-functionalized B₄C nanoparticles (~ 45 nm) and exfoliated MXene nanosheets are incorporated through solution casting and vacuum-assisted filtration. At 20 wt% B₄C and 15 wt% MXene, the 36 mm composite achieves 100% proton attenuation, approximately fivefold higher than an aerospace-grade aluminum reference, and 54.7 dB EMI shielding across the X-band (8.2–12.4 GHz). Electrical conductivity reaches 2.1 × 10⁴ S/m, flexibility is retained to a 2 mm bend radius, and areal mass is reduced by ~ 81% relative to a 2.0 mm aluminum reference. Selected RTCA DO-160G-aligned tests confirm performance retention after 500 thermal cycles and 1,000 h humidity exposure. MCNP6.2 simulations further project an eightfold reduction in processor radiation dose. Overall, the optimized composition balances proton attenuation, EMI shielding, flexibility, and mass efficiency within aerospace-relevant thickness constraints, supporting lightweight multifunctional protection for aerospace electronics.

articles.title: Joint Directional K-Shell and Feature-Guided Ranking in Complex Networks
articles.abstract: Identifying influential nodes in directed complex networks is an important problem in network science. Although K-shell decomposition can efficiently identify network cores containing highly influential nodes, its low resolution and core-like group problems limit its effectiveness for key-node identification in directed networks. Many methods address these issues by integrating K-shell with additional features for node ranking, but they do not focus on improving shell ranking. In this paper, we propose a ranking method named Shell-based Structural-Propagation Influence (SSPI) from a different perspective. First, a new directed K-shell representation, termed KSOutIn, is introduced to consider both incoming and outgoing edges. The two components of KSOutIn are then analyzed to determine their ability to provide a reliable shell ranking. Since they are insufficient when used alone or through a weighted linear combination, structural and topological features are extracted and evaluated using Linear Regression, Random Forest, and Gradient Boosting Machine models across 16 real-world and synthetic directed complex networks. PFI and SHAP are then used to identify the most important features. Finally, one of the most important features is combined with the K-shell information to construct SSPI for node ranking. Evaluation on various real-world directed networks shows that SSPI achieves the highest overall accuracy with low imprecision and time complexity.

articles.title: Partially decoupling cell size and density as tailorable design parameters in mSLA-printed gyroid cores for sustainable sandwich panels
articles.abstract: Lightweight sandwich cores can be tailored to the load case, yet design rules linking lattice architecture to core and panel performance are lacking for vat photopolymerisation. Sheet-network gyroid lattices were printed by masked stereolithography (mSLA) from a partially biobased PLA-based resin across a full factorial of unit cell size (5–20 mm) and nominal density (5–20%). The printable window, density, wall thickness and compressive properties were characterised. Selected cores were integrated into sandwich panels with basalt fibre facesheets in a partially biobased epoxy matrix and tested in flexure. Printability was bounded by wall separation below ≈ 130 µm and by resin entrapment in 5 mm cells at high density. Cell size controlled wall thickness (132–271 µm at 5% density), whilst apparent density was independent of cell size at low density (p ≥ 0.14), so the two act as partially decoupled design levers. Compressive strength followed bending-dominated Gibson–Ashby scaling (n ≈ 1.5 in the defect-free range and ≈ 2 across the full window). A cell-size effect on strength was robust at 20% density on raw and ρ²-normalised bases, and emerging at 15%. It is attributed to coupled wall thickness and cell count rather than the architecture itself. Panel flexural rankings matched core rankings. The 20 mm/20% core yielded the stiffest panels whilst the 5 mm/10% core gave the most strain-tolerant, benignly failing panels. These results establish mSLA gyroid lattices as tailorable sandwich cores, provide indicative design rules for core selection, and show that partially biobased constituents can form structurally efficient sandwich panels.

articles.title: Tight drill-stem tests as in-situ matrix permeability tests: how much of the gas in a fractured quartzite can be produced? Attahaddy Field, Sirte Basin, Libya
articles.abstract: In tight fractured gas reservoirs most of the gas is stored in the matrix, but the matrix permeability that controls whether this gas reaches the fractures is often below what routine core analysis can measure. In the Cambro-Ordovician Gargaf quartzite of the Attahaddy Field, Sirte Basin, Libya, 37 of 44 core plugs read zero permeability (below about 0.05 mD), so whether the gas in place can be produced has been unknown. We show that drill-stem tests (DSTs) that flowed little or nothing, usually dismissed as failures, help to answer this, because they test the rock between conductive fractures in situ. Pressure–time records of nine DSTs in seven wells (1987–1997) were recovered from scanned well files by optical character recognition and transcription, and analysed with gas pseudo-pressure and Bourdet derivatives. Gas tests flowing 5.5–11.7 MMcf/d give interval-average permeabilities of 0.26–4.5 mD (two of them lower bounds), and a weak test at least 0.11 mD, after an early derivative hump caused by wellbore storage and positive skin. The tight Gargaf test FF12 DST-2, which produced no fluid to surface, gives a lower bound of 1.6–2.6 µD; together with the core detection limit this brackets the permeability of the rock between flowing fractures at about 2–50 µD. A low-permeability test (FF21 DST-2, 5.5 µD) proves to overlap the productive zone of an earlier test in the same well, showing that low DST permeability can also reflect damage. A real-gas diffusion model of matrix blocks bounded by fractures, with block sizes from the conductive-fracture spacing inferred from 60 Gargaf DSTs (mean 383 ft; 218 ft and 559 ft in areas of bright and dim top-reservoir seismic amplitude), shows that even at the 2-µD lower bound about 90% of the matrix gas drains to the fractures within 30 years; the drained fraction would fall to 80% only below about 0.6 µD and to 50% below about 0.07 µD. With gas initially in place of 5.3 Tcf (P10–P90 3.7–7.4), 4.0 Tcf (2.8–5.7) is technically drainable to a 1,000 psia abandonment pressure for the bracketed permeability. Mapped with the 3D seismic, the main difference between bright and dim areas lies in reaching the fractures: an open interval needs about 500 ft to have a 90% chance of meeting a flowing fracture where the top reflection is bright, and about 1,300 ft where it is dim. Recovery in this field is therefore limited by how much of the fracture network is connected to wells, and by water entering through the fractures, rather than by the tightness of the matrix.

articles.title: Superconducting vortices provide experimental evidence that clogging is a phase transition
articles.abstract: Clogging is a phenomenon in which moving particles get stuck, slowing or blocking the flow, but how this transition occurs has remained experimentally unproven. Researchers from Science Tokyo studied superconducting vortices to demonstrate that clogging is a nonequilibrium phase transition. Using a two-step measurement protocol, they distinguished clogging from conventional pinning and revealed that both transitions share a critical point, offering new insights into predicting and controlling clogging across diverse systems.

articles.title: Substantial Reduction of Hole Injection Barrier at the Au/Rubrene Organic Semiconductor Interface Using PFBT Self-Assembled Monolayers
articles.abstract: Surface functionalization using self-assembled monolayers (SAMs) is an effective and widely adopted strategy for optimizing the charge injection and interfacial energetics in organic electronic devices. In particular, 2,3,4,5,6-pentafluorothiophenol (PFBT) SAMs are widely employed to augment the work function of noble metal electrodes, such as Au, and favorably template organic semiconductor molecular packing. However, comprehensive in situ spectroscopic investigations detailing the thickness-dependent energy-level alignment across the PFBT-modified Au/organic semiconductor interface remain scarce. This study investigates the interfacial electronic structures of 5,6,11,12-tetraphenylnaphthacene (rubrene) deposited on air-exposed Au (Air-Au), ultraviolet-ozone-treated Au (UVO-Au), and UVO-Au-functionalized PFBT (UVO-Au/PFBT) using in situ X-ray and ultraviolet photoelectron spectroscopy (XPS and UPS). High-resolution XPS reveals that UV–O3 pre-activation forms an ultrathin gold oxide (AuOx) layer, thereby dramatically enhancing the chemisorption kinetics and packing density of the PFBT SAM. While UV–O3 treatment alone increases the work function of Au from 4.78 to 5.06 eV, subsequent PFBT chemisorption further elevates it to 5.33 eV via a pronounced permanent dipole moment directed toward the substrate. Consequently, the hole injection barrier at the Au/rubrene interface is progressively reduced from 0.65 eV for Air-Au to 0.40 eV for UVO-Au and ultimately down to 0.27 eV for UVO-Au/PFBT. This dramatic reduction reaches the thermodynamic Fermi-level pinning regime, providing direct spectroscopic evidence for establishing near-Ohmic contacts. These findings offer fundamental insights into contact-resistance minimization and interface design for high-performance organic optoelectronic devices.

articles.title: Effects of Cr-Coatings on Hydride Reorientation in Zircaloy-4 Claddings
articles.abstract: The effect of reoriented hydrides in chromium coated Zircaloy-4 alloys using cold spray and physical vapor deposition methods was compared to uncoated Zircaloy-4, a reference light water reactor cladding material. The reorientation studies were carried out in an internal pressurization assembly inside of a furnace under conditions resembling pellet cladding mechanical interactions. The morphology of the reoriented hydrides of the bare coating was consistent with reorientation tests that can be found in literature. At elevated strains above 0.3% hoops strain, the chromium coated tubes formed small cracks in the hard chromium layer which led to localized stress concentrations that ultimately caused the precipitation of radially oriented hydrides at crack tips. Through high-resolution neutron radiography, spatially-resolved hydrogen concentration was characterized in the cladding. Large gradients the hydrogen concentration were observed in chromium coated cladding compared to the relatively homogenous distribution of the bare cladding. Furthermore, through ring compression testing, the resulting mechanical response to of bare versus chromium coated cladding with radial hydrides was demonstrated. Specifically, localized radial hydrides at coating cracks caused multiple shallow locations of cladding cracking where the bare material cracked more catastrophically due to the higher connectivity of radial and circumferential hydrides.

articles.title: Receiver Sensitivity Limits, Forward Error Correction, and Adaptive Beam Divergence for Space Laser Links: When Does Adapting the Beam Pay Off?
articles.abstract: Space laser terminals for low-Earth-orbit (LEO) to geostationary (GEO) data relay must close optical links at received powers near -55 dBm while platform pointing jitters by several microradians. We first evaluate four 1550 nm receiver architectures—PIN, avalanche photodiode (APD), optically pre-amplified on-off keying (OOK), and pre-amplified differential phase-shift keying (DPSK)—referenced directly to the fundamental quantum limit and standard Forward Error Correction (FEC) bounds. An uncoded pre-amplified DPSK receiver satisfies -55 dBm at a bit error rate (BER) of 10⁻⁶ only up to ~600 Mb/s. At 10 Gb/s, -55 dBm delivers only 2.5 photons/bit, falling below the 13.1 photons/bit quantum limit; thus, a flat -55 dBm specification is physically infeasible above 1.9 Gb/s uncoded and above 3.5 Gb/s even with soft-decision LDPC coding. We then investigate transmit beam divergence optimization under Rayleigh-distributed pointing jitter. For a fixed data rate, we prove analytically that the outage-optimal divergence is invariant to pointing jitter standard deviation, occurring uniquely when peak received power equals e times the receiver sensitivity (P_pk = e * S, a 4.34 dB margin). Conversely, for rate-adaptive links, optimal divergence scales linearly with jitter. In trans-atmospheric downlinks, Gamma-Gamma scintillation reintroduces jitter dependence to fixed-rate links. A 60 s time-domain dynamic simulation of a LEO-GEO relay terminal utilizing a four-state liquid-lens divergence controller yields a 95% throughput gain during disturbance episodes over the optimal fixed beam, demonstrating that dynamic beam adaptation is justified for rate-adaptive terminals and atmospheric paths, but unnecessary for fixed-rate inter-satellite links.

articles.title: Partial recovery of meter-scale surface weather
articles.abstract: Near-surface weather varies over tens to hundreds of meters, yet remains unresolved in analyses and forecasts. We test whether this variation can be inferred without resolving atmospheric dynamics. Combining sparse weather stations, high-resolution Earth observation, and coarse atmospheric dynamics, we infer temperature, dewpoint, and wind at 30-m resolution across the contiguous United States. Against measurements held out in space and time, estimates reduce error by 11-28% relative to the strongest baseline. Within held-out 0.25° grid cells, we recover more spatial variance than baselines, explaining nearly half of temperature variability in the median cell. The method captures time-varying differences between locations and produces coherent patterns associated with topography and land cover. Beyond weather, our findings illustrate how sparse observations of a dynamical system can be combined with dense observations of persistent environmental structure to recover otherwise unresolved spatial variability.

articles.title: Can You Price AI Usage? A Documentation Audit of Credit-Based AI Products
articles.abstract: Many AI products sell a named credit that users spend as they run actions. Whether a buyer can judge cost depends on what the public documentation shows: how credits map to actions, what a credit costs, and how spending is attributed afterward. This study audits first-party documentation for 22 AI prod-ucts and asks three questions. Before a run, can a buyer work out the credit cost of a named action? Can the buyer turn those credits into dollars on the same pages? After use, do the pages show where the credits went? The main finding is that documentation is stronger at stating a credit number than at supporting a decision. 17 of 22 products publish an exact credit amount for at least one action. Of these, 7 also state a dollar rate for that action, and 5 of those also have a known or buyer-set quantity, so only 5 reach a computable dollar quote for one event (6 if a rate derived from a same-page plan price counts). On coded pages the usual gap is the dollar rate: 9 products have a known quantity but state none there. A dated read of other same-domain pages (Section 2) raises the products with a dollar rate or a plan price with a credit allowance from 11 to 19 of 22; the added figures are plan prices, not event quotes. Spend after use is less gran-ular still: only 5 of 25 surface records describe an amount per action, job, query or session, and most show totals or a balance only. A credit can carry different prices by route, so a figure needs its route. Providers could close common gaps by stating the dollar value of a credit beside each credit amount, publishing an action-level rate table, and showing credits per action in the usage record. These are implications, not measured effects. The results describe public documentation for a frame of 76 candidates, not product behavior, billing accuracy or market prevalence.

articles.title: Efficient Nonlinear Normal Mode Analysis of Wing–Control Surface Structures with Free-Play Nonlinearity Using a CMS–HCF Framework
articles.abstract: Structural nonlinearities in aircraft control surfaces can significantly influence their dynamic characteristics and aeroelastic behavior. While low-order lumped-parameter models with two or three degrees of freedom have been extensively studied, analyzing nonlinear normal modes (NNMs) of wing–control surface systems using high-dimensional finite element (FE) models remains computationally challenging. Although conventional numerical continuation frameworks (NCFs) have been developed for analyzing NNMs of nonlinear structures, their computational cost increases substantially as the number of degrees of freedom grows. To overcome this limitation, this study presents an efficient computational framework that integrates the Craig–Bampton component mode synthesis (CMS) method with a hybrid continuation framework (HCF) for computing the NNMs of a wing–control surface structure with both structural flexibility and free-play nonlinearity. The HCF is extended and integrated with CMS, and the resulting CMS–HCF framework is then applied to analyze the NNMs of a FE model of an aircraft wing with a control surface. The results show that the frequency–energy curves obtained using the proposed framework exhibit excellent agreement with those computed using the conventional NCF, while achieving computational speedups of approximately 16–36 times. Comparisons with full-order FE simulations further demonstrate that the reduced-order model captures the dominant nonlinear modal characteristics. Furthermore, the analysis of internal resonances reveals modal coupling between the first and second NNM families in the presence of free-play nonlinearity. The effects of both the free-play angle and central stiffness on the NNMs are also investigated using the proposed framework. Reducing the free-play angle shifts nonlinear modal interactions toward lower energy levels, whereas reducing the central stiffness alters the modal-frequency relationship and consequently the order of internal resonance.

articles.title: Clean Energy Trade in an Age of Environmental Policy Divergence: A Three-Dimensional Panel Approach
articles.abstract: Trade in clean energy goods has grown rapidly while governments pursue different environmental policies, and it remains unclear how divergence in policy stringency between trading partners is related to bilateral trade. This paper examines that relationship and the persistence of bilateral clean energy trade. Divergence may raise trading costs or signal technological advantage. Standard system estimators remove only the pair effect. The paper therefore proposes a system generalised method of moments estimator for dynamic three-dimensional bilateral panels, in which each observation is indexed by an exporter, an importer and a year. The proposed estimator also removes exporter-time and importer-time heterogeneity by cross-sectionally demeaning the dependent variable, the regressors and the instruments within each period and combines this transformation with collapsed instruments and two-step efficient weighting. Monte Carlo experiments show that the proposed estimator keeps a small bias and accurate test size when exporter-time and importer-time effects are persistent, a setting in which standard system estimators are inconsistent. An application to bilateral clean energy trade among major economies shows that the correction matters for some parameters and not for others. Persistence changes little relative to the standard estimator while the association between the absolute difference in environmental policy stringency and trade is much smaller. A signed difference is absorbed by exporter-time and importer-time effects so only the absolute difference is identified and its association differs in sign across estimators. The heterogeneity that a two-dimensional estimator leaves in the error term therefore distorts the policy coefficient more than the estimated dynamics.

articles.title: Hydrothermally synthesised n-n heterostructured ZnO-SnO 2 composites: A novel solution for formaldehyde detection
articles.abstract: This work presents the hydrothermally synthesised and detailed investigation on pure ZnO, SnO2 and n-n heterostructured ZnO-SnO2 composite materials for the detection of formaldehyde under ambient conditions. The sensor material was structurally and morphologically characterized by X-ray diffraction technique, Raman spectroscopy, transmission electron microscopy (TEM) and scanning electron microscopy (SEM). Chemical properties of the prepared materials were studied using energy-dispersive X-ray spectroscopy and X-ray photo electron spectroscopy. Gas sensing studies were performed with liquid distribution technique towards various volatile organic compounds such as acetone, benzene, ethanol, methanol and formaldehyde under ambient conditions. Among these gases formaldehyde has shown good response towards n-n heterostructured ZnO-SnO2 composite material with a response and recovery times of 36s and 24 s under ambient conditions.

articles.title: A High-Resolution Voxel-Based Algorithm for Solid Rocket Motor Grain Perimeter Calculation and Decoupled Burnback Simulation
articles.abstract: Accurate tracking of evolving propellant grain perimeters is critical for internal ballistics modeling of solid rocket motors (SRM). Conventional implicit methods, such as the Level Set and Minimum Distance Function approaches, incur substantial computational overheads, whereas coarse discrete rasterization techniques suffer from spurious morphological erosion. This study presents a computationally efficient 2.5D voxel-based algorithm that integrates sub-pixel contour tracing via first-order linear interpolation to resolve geometric regression at a spatial resolution of 0.05 mm. By decoupling the spatial burn back analysis from the thermodynamic loop and assuming a uniform web regression rate, the framework rapidly generates idealized burn surface area versus web distance profiles. Implemented with Just-In-Time (JIT) parallelization on a standard workstation (Intel Core i5-12450H, 16 GB RAM), the algorithm achieves an O(N2)spatial complexity, processing a 16-million-pixel domain in approximately 0.3361 s. Geometric validation against commercial CAD measurements yielded a mean absolute error (MAE) of 0.204 mm, with relative errors as low as 0.006% for highly symmetric configurations (e.g., Model-1). Code-to-code verification against the Open Motor solver demonstrated a 0.97%relative variance in the average chamber pressure and 0.08% in the total delivered impulse. Cross-validation against experimental AFRPL BATES motor data indicated a 3.6% deviation in peak pressure and 6.1% in specific impulse, consistent with the model's deliberate exclusion of longitudinal erosive burning and multi-segment coupling effects. The framework is explicitly scoped for preliminary SRM design iterations, where the axial pressure gradients are negligible (L/D < 10). It does not resolve transient phenomena such as ignition over-pressurization or crossflow-induced erosive burning. The proposed methodology provides a validated, hardware-accessible tool for rapid geometric analysis prior to high-fidelity coupled simulation.

articles.title: A 26-year satellite record of vegetation phenology and productivity proxy across Europe
articles.abstract: Satellite land surface phenology describes seasonal vegetation development across landscapes. We present MR-VPP 5.0, a 26-year record (2000–2025) of vegetation phenology and seasonal productivity proxy across Europe, available through Copernicus Land Monitoring Service (CLMS). The dataset is derived from MODIS Collection 6.1 NBAR reflectance, contains 13 annual vegetation phenology and productivity (VPP) metrics for up to two growing seasons per year, Plant Phenology Index (PPI) seasonal trajectories at 5-day interval, and quality information, on a 500 m ETRS89-LAEA grid. VPP metrics describe the timing and magnitude of green-up, seasonal maximum and senescence, season length, rates of change, and integrated PPI. Quality-weighted daily PPI observations were processed with TIMESAT Version 4.2 to reconstruct seasonal curves and identify growing seasons. Technical checks examine processing artefacts, output quality and the consistency of the 2025 annual-update strategy against full-archive processing, and temporal correspondence with documented disturbances. The record supports regional and continental studies of vegetation seasonality, ecosystem productivity, and responses to climate variability and disturbance.

articles.title: Morphological and Spatial Characteristics of Indian Pangolin (Manis crassicaudata) Burrows in the Protected Semi-Arid Landscape of Saurashtra, Gujarat, India
articles.abstract: The Indian Pangolin (Manis crassicaudata) is classified as endangered and is an important ecosystem engineer of the ecosystem where it exists; however, there are very few quantitative baseline studies that evaluate its burrow characteristics and habitat selection. This longitudinal study spanned 2024–2026 and included two different types of natural protected areas located in Saurashtra, Gujarat, India: the basaltic Barda Wildlife Sanctuary and alluvial Mitiyala Wildlife Sanctuary. Using Average Nearest Neighbour analysis, we identified evidence of significant clustering for both feeding burrows (Z = -13.76; P < 0.001 in Barda; Z = -9.72; p < 0.001 in Mitiyala) and resting burrows (Z = -3.99; p < 0.001 in Barda; Z = -3.39; p < 0.001 in Mitiyala). Using the proximity of commute distances, we calculated an average foraging commute of 331.03 ± 360.59 m in Mitiyala, suggesting that the pangolin spatially separates locations used for feeding versus resting, likely to reduce the risk of predation. An optimised multi-model ensemble framework (GLM, GAM, RF, MaxEnt) was implemented using 10 environmental covariates to address landscape selection dynamics. The suitability gradient was binarised at an optimised threshold cutoff of 0.431 using Youden’s J criterion. Validating the models showed excellent predictive accuracy (TSS > 0.75, p < 0.01; AUC > 0.90, p < 0.01), identifying land surface temperature and soil texture as the primary determinants of burrow selection. The finding provides fine-scale environmental constraints affecting subterranean ecology and can serve as transferable baseline data for preserving patch-refugia within ecological fragmentation of semi-arid landscapes.

articles.title: MechFoundry: An agentic loop that poses and performs engineering analyses and optimization of real-world objects
articles.abstract: AI agents can automate software engineering because a compiler or a test suite checks that the code does what the user or the agent intended. In engineering analysis, however, the steps that precede the computation have few easily verifiable checks: modeling a design or an object, deciding how it is used, where supports and loads are applied, and what material each part is made of. A human expert therefore makes these decisions, carries out the steps, and judges the result, one object at a time. We present MechFoundry, an agentic loop coupled with bespoke software that automates structural analyses of real-world objects without a human in the loop. From an object's lexical description, it generates a shape, poses a loading case relevant to how the object is used, assigns a material to each part, solves the nonlinear structural response, and improves the design against the loads it carries. A differentiable GPU solver built on an adaptive octree that need not conform to the surface enables the transition from shape generation to simulation and optimization. Across 50 everyday and engineering objects, the agent posed and solved a loading case in 6.5 minutes and for US1.3 per object on average. Without a test suite to check against, we had language-model reviewers grade each session, as a first indication of where the agent's engineering judgment holds and where it fails.

articles.title: Experimental study of flame characteristics of methane diffusion combustion with metal fiber burner under O₂/CO₂ oxy-fuel
articles.abstract: O₂/CO₂ oxy-fuel combustion can produce CO₂-rich flue gas and suppress nitrogen-oxide formation, but the high heat capacity, infrared activity, and chemical participation of CO₂ can simultaneously alter flame stabilization and CO burnout. Methane free diffusion flames and flames formed around a vertical cylindrical metal fiber burner were therefore examined in an O₂/CO₂ coflow under identical operating boundaries. The total coflow rate was fixed at 20 L/min, the oxygen mole fraction was varied from 21% to 35%, and the methane flow rate was 5–20 L/min. Visible and infrared imaging, fixed-height thermocouple measurements, radiative heat-flux measurements, and dry-basis CO/NOx analysis were combined to establish a structure-thermal-radiation-emission relationship. The metal fiber burner redistributed methane through its porous sidewall and formed a coupled near-wall surface-combustion region and upper thermal plume. At high load, the 13–29 cm region approached approximately 800°C. Radiative heat flux was controlled mainly by methane flow rate, increasing from about 35–50 W/m² at 5 L/min to 240–300 W/m² at 20 L/min. Oxygen enrichment promoted CO post-oxidation: for the metal fiber burner, CO decreased from approximately 315 to 240 ppm at 5 L/min and from 165 to 45 ppm at 10 L/min. At 15–20 L/min, CO fell to roughly 7–31 ppm. NOx remained approximately 1.5–4.8 ppm across most conditions. The results identify low-load CO burnout, rather than NOx, as the principal operating constraint for CO₂-diluted metal fiber combustion and provide quantitative guidance for low-NOx, carbon-capture-compatible burner design.

articles.title: Large-Eddy Simulation of Momentum Balance, Internal Boundary Layer Development, and Turbulent Flow Adjustment Across a Canopy-to-Clearing Transition
articles.abstract: Abrupt canopy-to-clearing transitions generate internal boundary layers and non-equilibrium turbulence that govern surface momentum exchange. Large-eddy simulations of a canonical wind-tunnel canopy-to-clearing case use a localized dynamic kinetic-energy sub-grid model with vertically distributed canopy drag. Inside the canopy, simulated mean velocity and friction velocity agree closely with particle image velocimetry and hot-wire anemometry (RMSE ((0.141)) for ((overlineu/Uₕ)) and ((0.043)) for ((overlineu/U₀)); Table 3). Above the crest, the continuous porous medium over-predicts Reynolds shear stress (RMSE ((0.395,u_*²))) and streamwise variance, consistent with homogenized stem-wake effects. At sub-canopy height, advection, pressure gradients and Reynolds-stress divergences peak within five canopy heights of the edge and keep turbulent stresses elevated to ((x/h approx 20)). Including the sub-grid stress divergence lowers the momentum residual to ((|Rₓ| < 0.03)) beyond ((x/h approx 10)); closer to the edge, dispersive stresses from unresolved wakes dominate. Downstream, the internal boundary layer thickens (((δIBL propto x⁰.⁷²⁻⁻⁰.⁷⁸))) and the shear length scale grows from ((0.30,m)) to ((sim 8.6,m)), with an apparent plateau near ((x/h approx 50)). Under a C2-light disclosure, this far-wake leveling represents a physical trend observed under the present grid resolution that warrants future confirmation by mesh-independent adaptive studies. The results provide a rigorous neutral hydrodynamic baseline for vegetative roughness transitions and surface drag formulations.

articles.title: Ozone concentration, not concentration-time dose, governs inactivation of dried human coronavirus on surfaces
articles.abstract: Gaseous ozone reaches surfaces that liquid disinfectants and ultraviolet light cannot. Decontamination cycles are commonly specified by the concentration-time product CT, on the assumption that equal products give equal outcomes. We tested that assumption for human coronavirus 229E dried on polystyrene, using ozone generated from ambient air by a packed-electrode volumetric dielectric barrier discharge reactor. At the standard viral load, doubling the contact time raised the dose to 24,000 ppm·min and gave 2.8 log10, whereas raising the concentration from 200 to 250 ppm reached only 15,000 ppm·min yet gave 3.0 log10. With a fivefold larger inoculum the separation widened: 24,000 ppm·min at 200 ppm achieved 1.4 log10, while 15,000 ppm·min at 250 ppm achieved 2.3 log10. At both loads the larger integrated dose, delivered at the lower concentration, produced the smaller reduction. Exponents derived from the standard-load conditions are 1.2 for concentration and 0.3 for contact time, so concentration is roughly fourfold more influential. We attribute this to ozone diffusing into a dried organic film that consumes it. Across published surface studies the required CT spans more than three orders of magnitude. A cycle specified by CT alone can therefore under-decontaminate a surface while nominally meeting its dose target.

articles.title: Antibiotic-induced gut dysbiosis triggers systemic metabolic reprogramming via depletion of microbiota-derived tryptophan metabolites in broilers
articles.abstract: Background The poultry industry has widely used antibiotics at growth-promoting doses, a practice that has accelerated antimicrobial resistance. However, the effects of prolonged low-dose antibiotic exposure on chicken gut microbiota and systemic metabolism remain inadequately understood. Results Broilers received a broad-spectrum antibiotic cocktail in drinking water, and 16S rRNA sequencing, serum metabolomics, and phenotypic measurements were integrated to investigate antibiotic impacts on the gut microbiota and mechanisms of metabolic regulation. Antibiotic treatment significantly altered the cecal microbial community, marked by reductions in Lactobacillus and butyrate-producing genera and increases in Escherichia-Shigella and Enterococcus(P<0.05). Functional gene prediction indicated downregulation of carbohydrate and amino acid metabolism pathways alongside upregulation of ABC transporters and quorum sensing systems. Consistent with this functional shift, tryptophan-derived indole metabolites were the most depleted class of circulating metabolites: 5-hydroxyindoxyl sulfate, quinoline 1-oxide and 2,8-quinolinediol were each reduced by 45–53%. Their depletion was accompanied by broad host metabolic remodeling, including significant increases in branched-chain amino acid catabolites , a coordinated reduction of six phospholipid species (FDR < 0.05) with lysophosphatidylcholines declining most consistently, elevated markers of oxidative stress and of antioxidant defense. Trends toward increased fatty acid oxidation and impaired TCA cycle flux were also observed. These metabolic alterations were accompanied by reduced intestinal length and lower immune organ indices. Conclusions Long-term exposure to a broad-spectrum antibiotic cocktail induces gut dysbiosis and depletes microbiota-derived tryptophan–indole metabolites, which is accompanied by systemic metabolic remodeling and impaired intestinal and organ development in broilers. These findings identify microbial tryptophan metabolism as a candidate target for mitigating antibiotic-induced metabolic impairment.

articles.title: Giant nonlinearity of the kinetic inductance in a superconducting hybrid strip
articles.abstract: Author(s): D. Yu. Vodolazov, Yu. P. Korneeva, M. A. Dryazgov, S. S. Ustavschikov, N. V. Porokhov, N. N. Osipov, I. Yu. Pashenkin, A. A. Korneev, and M. A. Tarkhov Kinetic inductance stores energy in the kinetic motion of charge carriers, and is crucial to the operation of modern superconducting devices, particularly those used in quantum information processing. In this study, a method to substantially boost the nonlinearity of a superconductor’s kinetic inductance—by as much as two orders of magnitude—is demonstrated in a bilayer of niobium nitride and aluminum. Potential applications include superconducting magnetometers, parametric amplifiers, calorimeters, and current sensors. [Phys. Rev. Applied 26, 054036] Published Thu Nov 12, 2026

articles.title: Accurate excitation energy prediction of BODIPY dyes through stacking-ensemble Δ-learning
articles.abstract: Accurate prediction of excitation energies is critical for the rational design of boron-dipyrromethene (BODIPY) dyes, but conventional time-dependent density functional theory (TD-DFT) often suffers from pronounced functional-dependent errors for this class of chromophores. To improve TD-DFT predictions toward DLPNO-STEOM-CCSD level accuracy at a much lower computational cost, we developed a stacking ensemble Δ-learning framework that combines computationally affordable ωB97X-D3 calculations with DLPNO-STEOM-CCSD reference data to achieve accurate and transferable predictions of vertical S 1 excitation energies for BODIPY derivatives. Using a dataset of 866 BODIPY derivatives containing up to 42 atoms, we first benchmarked 21 exchange–correlation functionals against DLPNO-STEOM-CCSD. ωB97X-D3 was used as a representative TD-DFT baseline for demonstrating the Δ-learning workflow. Among the 13 regression models, the stacking ensemble model achieved the best overall performance on the test set according to various metrics. This model generalized well to a size-extrapolation set of 134 BODIPY derivatives containing 43 atoms. It was further validated on an external experimental benchmark set of 15 larger BODIPYs previously reported in the literature and demonstrated transferability to nine structurally distinct near-infrared aza-BODIPYs. These results demonstrate that the proposed stacking ensemble Δ-learning framework provides an accurate, efficient, and transferable approximation to DLPNO-STEOM-CCSD level excitation energies, enabling large-scale screening and rational design of BODIPY chromophores at substantially reduced computational cost.

articles.title: QEpy: Quantum ESPRESSO in python
articles.abstract: QEpy is a Python electronic-structure software package based on Quantum ESPRESSO (QE). QEpy accomplishes two goals. First, it simplifies running and prototyping calculations with QE. Second, it targets nonstandard workflows where the electronic-structure engine is used in ways for which it was not originally designed. For example, QEpy can instruct QE to run with custom potentials in the Hamiltonian, including external, exchange-correlation, and local pseudopotentials. QEpy also exposes, at any point during an electronic-structure calculation, including between self-consistent-field cycles, quantities that would normally be accessible only through post-processing, such as the electron density and wavefunctions. QEpy’s API to the Atomic Simulation Environment gives direct access to ASE-based workflows and tools. These capabilities make QEpy a flexible platform for implementing custom workflows, interfacing QE with other simulation tools, and prototyping new electronic-structure methods. This work is written in a hybrid paper/tutorial style. Several example notebooks are presented, together with references to publications in which QEpy has already been employed. Our goal is for QEpy to serve as a versatile platform for research, teaching, and innovation in electronic-structure theory and method development.

articles.title: Toward chemically accurate quantum simulations on quantum hardware: A quantum-HPC hybrid approach
articles.abstract: We report one of the most comprehensive experimental demonstrations to date of quantum-computing-based molecular simulation on IQM’s Sirius 24-qubit superconducting quantum processor, using up to 16 operational qubits. We employ Sample-based Quantum Diagonalization (SQD) with the Local Unitary Cluster Jastrow (LUCJ) Ansatz to compute ground-state energies of benchmark molecular systems, including H 2 , LiH, BeH 2 , H 2 O, and NH 3 . We further introduce the linear-CNOT unitary coupled-cluster singles and doubles Ansatz within the SQD framework, reducing the classical pre-computation overhead at the cost of increased quantum circuit depth and demonstrate its effectiveness by accurately recovering the ground-state energies of H 2 , LiH, and BeH 2 . A comparative analysis of the two Ansätze is presented, highlighting their respective merits, demerits, and practical use cases in near-term quantum simulations. In addition, we perform one-dimensional potential energy surface (1D-PES) scans for H 2 and HeH + using STO-3G and 6-31G basis sets and for LiH and BeH 2 using STO-3G. We also report the first experimental generation of a full two-dimensional potential energy surface (2D-PES) map, consisting of a 32 × 32 grid in bond length and bond angle, for the water molecule in the STO-3G basis on IQM quantum hardware. Beyond small-molecule benchmarks, we integrate Density Matrix Embedding Theory (DMET) with SQD(LUCJ) to obtain chemically accurate 4-electron-in-4-orbital active-space energies for eight ligand-like molecules, as well as for the pharmacologically relevant amantadine molecular system, representing the first of such experimental demonstrations. Across all studies, the majority of quantum-computed energies agree with reference full configuration interaction results and with DMET-complete active space CI energies for embedded systems, to within chemical accuracy for the chosen basis sets. These results demonstrate the robustness of quantum sampling-based classical diagonalization approaches while highlighting the promise of hybrid embedding strategies combined with near-term Ansätze for advancing quantum chemistry toward classically intractable molecular systems and establishing their practicality on current quantum hardware.

articles.title: Markov state model for the forced unfolding of a small peptide
articles.abstract: The mechanical unfolding of molecular complexes or biomolecules can routinely be studied using methods of single molecule force spectroscopy. In particular, the application of a force ramp with a constant pulling velocity in conjunction with stochastic modeling can be used to obtain valuable information regarding the relevant kinetics and the energy landscape. The computational counterpart of this type of experiment, using molecular dynamics simulations with atomistic resolution, allows us to gain insights into the molecular rearrangements underlying the unfolding process. However, due to the large difference in time scales, often coarse graining procedures are applied in the simulations. Most of the utilized techniques do not allow us to follow the atomistic details of the relevant conformational transitions due to the structural simplifications used to speed up the simulations. Here, we apply an earlier developed dynamic coarse graining technique based on Markov state modeling to a model peptidic system that does not unfold in a simple two-state manner. Using the donor–acceptor distances of the helical hydrogen bonds as collective variables and performing a dimension reduction allows us to construct a Markov model of the unfolding process that correctly represents the microscopic behavior of the system for not too fast pulling velocities. The chosen example shows that the method can be used to mimic the mechanical unfolding process of systems for which the end-to-end distance does not provide a sufficient order parameter and that do not unfold in a simple cooperative manner.

articles.title: Energy performance assessment of functionally graded metal foams using a finite element approach
articles.title_zh: 使用有限元方法对功能级金属泡沫进行能源性能评估
articles.abstract: Open-cell metal foams hold significant potential as functionally graded porous media for heat transfer applications such as solar thermal collectors; however, manufacturing constraints often limit the use of idealized, smoothly graded materials. While multiple uniform-layer foams present a pragmatic alternative, their thermohydraulic performance across moderate-to-high porosities remains under-researched. This study evaluates the energy performance of fluid flow through a parallel channel embedded with step-gradient metal foams. The Finite Element Method (FEM) was utilized to solve the normalized mass, momentum, and energy conservation equations under the Local Thermal Non-Equilibrium (LTNE) condition, examining constant, double, triple, and linear configurations at average porosities (overlineφ) of 0.7, 0.8, and 0.9. Fluid dynamically redistributes to maintain a uniform longitudinal pressure decrease, yielding steep velocity gradients near boundaries and layer interfaces. An analysis of the non-equilibrium parameter (Δ NE) justifies the LTNE approach, demonstrating that thermal equilibrium is compromised near heated walls and porosity-variation interfaces. Thermally, deliberate foam stacking steepens near-wall temperature gradients and reduces the plate-to-fluid temperature difference. Notably, equal-thickness triple-layer configurations (model T2) exhibited an increase in the Performance Evaluation Criterion (PEC) of approximately 10--11% compared to the constant-porosity case at overlineφ = 0.8 and 0.9. These results suggest that strategically stacked discrete-porosity open-cell metal foams provide a highly practical approach for optimizing energy performance in convective heat exchange devices.

articles.title: Cosmic Rays Propagation in Plasmas with Ionization Effects in Astrophysical Settings
articles.title_zh: 在天体物理环境中具有电离效应的等离子体中的宇宙射线传播
articles.abstract: Cosmic rays are a significant non-thermal component of astrophysical plasmas and can substantially affect, how magnetized media behave and exchange energy, and become ionized. Cosmic rays exchange momentum and energy with thermal plasma through self-generated Alfvén waves, while in partially ionized regions. They also experience ionization losses and are affected by ion-neutral damping. In this work, a theoretical four-fluid model is presented in which thermal plasma, cosmic rays, and forward and backward-propagating self-excited Alfvén waves are treated as distinct but massless coupled fluids. The role of ionization is incorporated through closure terms in the cosmic-ray and thermal energy equations and through effects of ionization. The numerical results show that increasing the ionization parameter significantly enhances the plasma velocity and thermal pressure, whereas the cosmic-ray pressure decreases noticeably, the forward and backward Alfvén wave pressures exhibit only minor variations. It regulates the efficiency of wave-mediated coupling between cosmic rays and the thermal plasma by modifying the ionization fraction of the background medium. The analysis indicates that the ionization controls whether cosmic rays remain coupled to the plasma through Alfvénic turbulence or decouple and propagate with fewer constraints. This framework provides a transparent basis for understanding cosmic-ray transport, and plasma heating in weakly and moderately ionized astrophysical systems such as the interstellar medium, molecular cloud envelopes, and cosmic-ray driven outflows.
articles.abstract_zh: 宇宙射线是天体物理等离子体的重要非热成分，可以大大影响磁化介质的行为和交换能量，并变得电离。宇宙射线通过自生Alfvén波与热等离子体交换动量和能量，同时在部分电离区域。它们还会经历电离损失，并受到离子中性阻尼的影响。在这项工作中，提出了一种理论四流体模型，其中热等离子体、宇宙射线以及向前和向后传播的自激Alfvén波被视为不同但无质量的耦合流体。电离的作用是通过宇宙射线和热能方程中的闭包项以及通过电离的影响来实现的。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 宇宙射线是天体物理等离子体的重要非热成分，可以大大影响磁化介质的行为和交换能量，并变得电离。宇宙射线通过自生Alfvén波与热等离子体交换动量和能量，同时在部分电离区域。它们还会经历电离损失，并受到离子中性阻尼的影响。在这项工作中，提出了一种理论四流体模型，其中热等离子体、宇宙射线以及向前和向后传播的自激Alfvén波被视为不同但无质量的耦合流体。电离的作用是通过宇宙射线和热能方程中的闭包项以及通过电离的影响来实现的。数值结果表明，增加电离参数可显著增强等离子体速度和热压，而宇宙射线压力明显降低，正向和反向Alfvén波压力仅表现出微小变化。它通过修改背景介质的电离分数来调节宇宙射线和热等离子体之间的波介导耦合效率。分析表明，电离控制宇宙射线是通过Alfvénic湍流保持耦合到等离子体，还是在较少的约束下解耦和传播。该框架为理解宇宙射线传输以及弱电离和中电离天体物理系统（如星际介质、分子云包络和宇宙射线驱动的流出）中的等离子体加热提供了透明的基础。

articles.title: A Comprehensive Threat Model and Risk Assessment Framework for Quantum-Secure Communication in the Metaverse
articles.title_zh: 元宇宙中量子安全通信的综合威胁模型和风险评估框架
articles.abstract: The rapid growth of the Metaverse creates major challenges in secure communication because of its decentralized and data-intensive nature. Traditional cryptographic methods are vulnerable to quantum computing attacks. This research paper developed a unified framework for quantum-secure communication in the Metaverse. It integrated quantum key distribution (QKD), post-quantum cryptography (PQC), STRIDE-based threat modelling, and attack tree analysis. A quantitative risk model based on probability and impact is developed and validated using simulations with 10,000 to 100,000 users. The results show that the risk has come down by 52.2%, the threat detection rate is 95%, and the attack success rate is less than 10%. The system demonstrates linear scalability with controlled latency and acceptable computational overhead (10–16%). Statistical analysis indicates that the risk distribution is stable and the variance is lower. Compared to existing methods, the developed framework provides enhanced security, scalability, and adaptability, particularly in handling increased user loads and dynamic network conditions. It is critical to preserving performance and reliability in high-demand scenarios, especially when ensuring that secure communication remains effective under varying user loads and network conditions. The research work offers a practical solution for secure communication in quantum-enabled Metaverse environments. Additionally, it addresses challenges such as data integrity, user privacy, and real-time interaction in these complex digital spaces.
articles.abstract_zh: 由于其分散和数据密集型的性质，元宇宙的快速发展给安全通信带来了重大挑战。传统的加密方法容易受到量子计算攻击。本研究论文开发了元宇宙中量子安全通信的统一框架。它集成了量子密钥分发（ QKD ）、后量子密码学（ PQC ）、基于STRIDE的威胁建模和攻击树分析。使用具有10,000至100,000个用户的模拟来开发和验证基于概率和影响的定量风险模型。结果表明，风险下降了52.2% ，威胁检测率为95% ，攻击成功率小于10%。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 由于其分散和数据密集型的性质，元宇宙的快速发展给安全通信带来了重大挑战。传统的加密方法容易受到量子计算攻击。本研究论文开发了元宇宙中量子安全通信的统一框架。它集成了量子密钥分发（ QKD ）、后量子密码学（ PQC ）、基于STRIDE的威胁建模和攻击树分析。使用具有10,000至100,000个用户的模拟来开发和验证基于概率和影响的定量风险模型。结果表明，风险下降了52.2% ，威胁检测率为95% ，攻击成功率小于10%。该系统具有线性可扩展性，具有可控的延迟和可接受的计算开销（ 10–16% ）。统计分析表明，风险分布稳定，方差较小。与现有方法相比，开发的框架提供了增强的安全性、可扩展性和适应性，特别是在处理增加的用户负载和动态网络条件方面。在高需求场景中保持性能和可靠性至关重要，特别是在确保安全通信在不同用户负载和网络条件下保持有效的情况下。这项研究工作为量子元宇宙环境中的安全通信提供了实用的解决方案。此外，它还解决了这些复杂数字空间中的数据完整性、用户隐私和实时交互等挑战。

articles.title: LGE-FIng: Learned Glyph Embedding for Image-Conditioned Candidate Reranking in Post-OCR Correction of Chinese Historical Books
articles.title_zh: LGE-FIng ：中国历史书籍OCR后校正中图像条件候选排名的学习字形嵌入
articles.abstract: Post-OCR correction of Chinese historical books is bounded by substitution errors, yet the glyph cues that would resolve them are used poorly: hand-crafted descriptors break down across the domain gap between woodblock printing and modern typefaces, and they are keyed to the recognized character rather than to the observed glyph image. LGE-FIng learns a glyph embedding under an ArcFace objective with cross-domain alignment, so that a woodblock glyph block and a multi-font rendered prototype of the same character share one class center. At each position the embedding is queried by the real image block, and its nearest neighbors feed image-conditioned candidates into the corrector's search lattice. On a 60-page book-disjoint test set, the image-queried channel beats an identical channel keyed to the recognition character's rendering by + 1.13 to + 1.54 percentage points (pp) under four independent weight-mapping calibrations, all agreeing in sign and magnitude. The gain survives a scale-free rank calibration that equalizes the two channels' weight ladders, which rules out a cosine-scale artifact. A layout-aware fusion of both channels reaches + 3.66 pp over the bare recognizer (PP-OCRv5) and + 3.73 pp with a real-corpus hybrid gallery. A mechanistic probe traces the effect to rank one: the image channel ranks the ground truth first in 19.4% of substitution positions, while the static channel cannot do so by construction. The method trains cheaply, stays OCR-agnostic, and integrates into an existing corrector as an additional candidate source.
articles.abstract_zh: 中国历史书籍的OCR后更正受到替换错误的限制，但解决它们的字形提示使用不当：手工制作的描述符在木版印刷和现代字体之间的域间隙中分解，并且它们与公认的字符而不是观察到的字形图像相关联。LGE-FIng通过跨域对齐在ArcFace目标下学习字形嵌入，以便木块字形块和同一字符的多字体渲染原型共享一个类中心。在每个位置，嵌入由真实图像块查询，并且其最近的邻居将图像条件的候选者馈送到校正器的搜索格中。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 中国历史书籍的OCR后更正受到替换错误的限制，但解决它们的字形提示使用不当：手工制作的描述符在木版印刷和现代字体之间的域间隙中分解，并且它们与公认的字符而不是观察到的字形图像相关联。LGE-FIng通过跨域对齐在ArcFace目标下学习字形嵌入，以便木块字形块和同一字符的多字体渲染原型共享一个类中心。在每个位置，嵌入由真实图像块查询，并且其最近的邻居将图像条件的候选者馈送到校正器的搜索格中。在60页的书本分离测试集上，图像查询通道在四个独立的权重映射校准下击败与识别字符渲染键相同的通道+ 1.13至+ 1.54个百分点（ pp ） ，所有通道在符号和幅度上都一致。增益在无标度等级校准中幸存下来，该校准均衡了两个通道的权重阶梯，这排除了余弦标度伪影。两个通道的布局感知融合在裸机识别器（ PP-OCRv5 ）上达到+ 3.66 pp ，并通过真实语料库混合画廊达到+ 3.73 pp。机械探针将效果追溯到排名一：图像通道在19.4%的替换位置中将地面真值排在第一位，而静态通道不能通过构造来做到这一点。该方法训练成本低廉，与OCR无关，并集成到现有校正器中作为额外的候选源。

articles.title: Machine Learning-Enhanced Air Quality Management via QFIELD and QGIS: Mapping and Bio-cover Materials at Ojota Landfill
articles.title_zh: 通过QFIELD和QGIS进行机器学习增强的空气质量管理： Ojota垃圾填埋场的测绘和生物覆盖材料
articles.abstract: Landfill emissions represent a major environmental challenge in rapidly urbanizing cities within developing countries. Methane, particulate matter, and odor-generating compounds released from poorly managed landfill sites contribute to air pollution and pose risks to surrounding communities. This study evaluates the effectiveness of a laboratory-simulated bio-cover system formulated using landfill topsoil, compost, rice husk and earthworm castings in a 6:2:1:1 mix ratio for mitigating microbial and gaseous emissions at the Ojota landfill in Lagos, Nigeria. Spatially informed field measurements are conducted at six sampling points established at 15m intervals across the landfill, coordinates recorded and mapped via QFIELD and QGIS to provide accurate spatial representation of emission gradients across the study area. Air quality parameters including particulate matter (PM2.5 and PM10), sulfur dioxide (SO₂), and carbon monoxide (CO) are monitored to establish baseline environmental conditions. To extend this point-based assessment, six machine learning approaches — Random Forest, Gradient Boosting (XGBoost/LightGBM), Support Vector Machine, K-Nearest Neighbours, Gaussian Process Regression/Regression Kriging, and an Artificial Neural Network — are applied to the geo-referenced air quality dataset to classify AQI status by pollutant driver and to generate a continuous, uncertainty-aware pollutant risk surface across the landfill footprint. Microbial indicators including total bacterial count (TBC), total coliform count (TCC), and fecal coliform (FC) are determined, while physicochemical characterization involves pH measurements and Fourier transform infrared spectroscopy (FTIR) over soil samples collected. Results show significant reductions in microbial indicators following bio-cover application, improved biological regulation within the cover material, pH values remain within near-neutral conditions favorable for microbial oxidation processes. FTIR spectra further reveal functional groups associated with organic matter stabilization and biodegradation. The novelty of this study lies in integrating geospatial air quality mapping and machine learning-based prediction with microbiological and FTIR-based biochemical characterization to evaluate a locally formulated bio-cover system under tropical landfill conditions, providing a sustainable and cost-effective strategy for improving landfill air quality management.
articles.abstract_zh: 垃圾填埋场排放是发展中国家快速城市化城市面临的主要环境挑战。从管理不善的垃圾填埋场释放的甲烷、颗粒物和产生气味的化合物会导致空气污染，并对周围社区构成风险。本研究评估了实验室模拟生物覆盖系统的有效性，该系统使用6: 2: 1: 1混合比的垃圾填埋表土、堆肥、稻壳和蚯蚓粪便配制，以减轻尼日利亚拉各斯Ojota垃圾填埋场的微生物和气体排放。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 垃圾填埋场排放是发展中国家快速城市化城市面临的主要环境挑战。从管理不善的垃圾填埋场释放的甲烷、颗粒物和产生气味的化合物会导致空气污染，并对周围社区构成风险。本研究评估了实验室模拟生物覆盖系统的有效性，该系统使用6: 2: 1: 1混合比的垃圾填埋表土、堆肥、稻壳和蚯蚓粪便配制，以减轻尼日利亚拉各斯Ojota垃圾填埋场的微生物和气体排放。在整个垃圾填埋场以15米的间隔建立的六个采样点进行空间信息实地测量，通过QFIELD和QGIS记录和绘制坐标，以提供整个研究区域排放梯度的准确空间表示。监测空气质量参数，包括颗粒物（ PM2.5和PM10 ）、二氧化硫（ SO ₂ ）和一氧化碳（ CO ） ，以确定基线环境条件。为了扩展这种基于点的评估，将六种机器学习方法（随机森林、梯度增强（ XGBoost/LightGBM ）、支持向量机、K-最近邻、高斯过程回归/回归克里格和人工神经网络）应用于地理参考空气质量数据集，以按污染物驱动因素对AQI状态进行分类，并在填埋场足迹中生成连续的、具有不确定性的污染物风险面。测定微生物指标，包括总细菌计数（ TBC ）、总大肠菌群计数（ TCC ）和粪便大肠菌群（ FC ） ，而物理化学表征涉及对采集的土壤样品的pH测量和傅里叶变换红外光谱（ FTIR ）。结果显示，生物覆盖施用后微生物指标显著降低，覆盖材料内的生物调节得到改善， pH值保持在有利于微生物氧化过程的近中性条件下。傅里叶变换红外光谱进一步揭示了与有机物稳定和生物降解相关的官能团。本研究的新颖之处在于将地理空间空气质量测绘和基于机器学习的预测与微生物和基于FTIR的生物化学表征相结合，以评估热带垃圾填埋条件下本地配制的生物覆盖系统，为改善垃圾填埋空气质量管理提供可持续且具有成本效益的策略。

articles.title: Annotate this: A comparative benchmark of MS/MS annotation algorithms across reference compounds and complex samples
articles.title_zh: 注释：参考化合物和复杂样品的MS/MS注释算法的比较基准
articles.abstract: Introduction Metabolite annotation from LC-MS/MS data remains a bottleneck in untargeted metabolomics. A growing number of computational tools employing diverse strategies, from spectral library matching and in silico fragmentation to machine learning and de novo structure generation, have been developed. However, the diversity of tools makes it difficult to determine which approaches provide reliable annotations. Direct comparisons under consistent, realistic conditions are needed to guide tool selection and improve annotation confidence.  Objectives We benchmarked five popular annotation tools: MS2Query, SIRIUS, MSNovelist, MetFrag and ChemDistiller, under default parameters and without prior sample knowledge.  Methods Tools were evaluated on two datasets: 357 in-house acquired MS/MS spectra from reference compounds with unambiguous ground truth, and 194 expert-annotated spectra from NIST SRM 1950 plasma. Performance was assessed across formula and structure accuracy, coverage, precision, Tanimoto similarity to ground truth, and score reliability. Results MS2Query and SIRIUS emerged as top performers with complementary profiles: MS2Query achieved the highest annotation coverage (100% on reference compounds) while SIRIUS yielded the highest conditional accuracy (78%). MSNovelist performed comparably to SIRIUS. MetFrag performance was database-dependent, with PubChem yielding near-complete annotation failure and KEGG enabling moderate precision. ChemDistiller excelled at formula annotation but underperformed structurally.  Conclusion No single tool dominates across all metrics. Tool selection should be guided by balance between coverage and precision, with score-based filtering and multi-tool consensus strategies recommended to improve annotation confidence.
articles.abstract_zh: 引言基于LC-MS/MS数据的代谢物注释仍然是非靶向代谢组学中的一个瓶颈。人们已经开发出越来越多的计算工具，这些工具采用各种策略，包括质谱库匹配和计算机模拟碎片化，以及机器学习和从头结构生成。然而，工具的多样性使得难以确定哪些方法能够提供可靠的注释。需要在一致、现实的条件下进行直接比较，以指导工具选择并提高注释置信度。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 引言基于LC-MS/MS数据的代谢物注释仍然是非靶向代谢组学中的一个瓶颈。人们已经开发出越来越多的计算工具，这些工具采用各种策略，包括质谱库匹配和计算机模拟碎片化，以及机器学习和从头结构生成。然而，工具的多样性使得难以确定哪些方法能够提供可靠的注释。需要在一致、现实的条件下进行直接比较，以指导工具选择并提高注释置信度。目标 我们在默认参数下，在不具备样本先验知识的情况下，对五种常用注释工具进行了基准测试：MS2Query、SIRIUS、MSNovelist、MetFrag和ChemDistiller。方法 在两个数据集上对工具进行了评估：357个具有明确真实值的内部采集的参考化合物MS/MS谱图，以及194个来自NIST SRM 1950血浆的专家注释谱图。对分子式和结构准确性、覆盖率、精密度、与真实值的Tanimoto相似性以及评分可靠性等方面的性能进行了评估。结果 MS2Query和SIRIUS表现出色，具有互补的特征： MS2Query实现了最高的注释覆盖率（对照化合物为100%），而SIRIUS实现了最高的条件准确率（78%）。MSNovelist的性能与SIRIUS相当。MetFrag的性能取决于数据库，PubChem几乎完全无法进行注释，而KEGG则实现了中等精度。ChemDistiller在分子式标注方面表现出色，但在结构方面表现不佳。结论：没有哪一种工具在所有指标上都占据主导地位。工具的选择应以覆盖面和精度的平衡为指导，建议采用基于分数的筛选和多工具一致性策略，以提高标注的置信度。

articles.title: Fuzzy Logic and Machine Learning Approaches for Modeling Monthly Rainfall from Meteorological Variables in Sulaymaniyah, Kurdistan Region of Iraq
articles.title_zh: 基于气象变量的苏莱曼尼亚（伊拉克库尔德斯坦地区）月降雨量建模的模糊逻辑和机器学习方法
articles.abstract: Monthly rainfall information is essential for water management and rainfed agriculture in semi-arid Kurdistan Region of Iraq. This study developed a Mamdani fuzzy inference system (FIS-RH-T-E) in MATLAB that estimates monthly rainfall in Sulaymaniyah from relative humidity (RH), temperature, and evaporation, using 140 expert rules and data from Bakrajo station (2010–2024, n = 180). The FIS was compared with multiple linear regressions (MLR), random forest, gradient boosting, support vector regression, a multilayer perceptron and monthly climatology, evaluated by leave-one-year-out cross-validation and a 2020–2024 hold-out, including one-month-ahead prediction. Climatology alone achieved a Nash-Sutcliffe efficiency (NSE) of 0.45. The FIS reached a coefficient of determination (R2) of 0.63 and NSE = 0.63 (Kling-Gupta efficiency 0.71), second only to MLR (R2 = 0.67, NSE = 0.66) and ahead of support vector regression, gradient boosting and random forest (NSE 0.61–0.62); differences among these five models were not significant, whereas all clearly outperformed climatology and multilayer perceptron (NSE = 0.44). Scored on their training data, the machine-learning models reached NSE up to 0.84, which overstates their accuracy. RH dominated both FIS response surfaces and data-driven analyses (anomaly correlation with rainfall 0.63, against − 0.21 for temperature and evaporation). All models underestimated the wettest months; the FIS never exceeded 221 mm, whereas observed rainfall reached 316 mm. No model predicted rainfall one month ahead better than climatology. An expert-defined FIS therefore provides transparent estimates as accurate as machine learning for filling gaps in rainfall records, whereas forecasting requires large-scale predictors.
articles.abstract_zh: 月降雨量信息对于伊拉克半干旱库尔德斯坦地区的用水管理和雨养农业至关重要。本研究在MATLAB中开发了一个Mamdani模糊推理系统（FIS-RH-T-E），该系统使用140条专家规则和巴克拉乔气象站的数据（2010–2024年，n = 180），根据相对湿度（RH）、温度和蒸发量估算苏莱曼尼亚的月降雨量。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 月降雨量信息对于伊拉克半干旱库尔德斯坦地区的用水管理和雨养农业至关重要。本研究在MATLAB中开发了一个Mamdani模糊推理系统（FIS-RH-T-E），该系统使用140条专家规则和巴克拉乔气象站的数据（2010–2024年，n = 180），根据相对湿度（RH）、温度和蒸发量估算苏莱曼尼亚的月降雨量。将 FIS 与多元线性回归 (MLR)、随机森林、梯度提升、支持向量回归、多层感知机和月度气候学进行了比较，并通过留一法交叉验证和 2020–2024 年的留出法进行了评估，其中包括一个月提前预测。仅气候学就实现了 0.45 的纳什-萨特克利夫效率 (NSE)。FIS的决定系数（R2）和NSE = 0.63（Kling-Gupta效率为0.71），仅次于MLR（R2 = 0.67，NSE = 0.66），优于支持向量回归、梯度提升和随机森林（NSE为0.61–0.62）；这五种模型之间的差异并不显著，但所有模型都明显优于气候学和多层感知器（NSE = 0.44）。根据其训练数据得分，机器学习模型的NSE最高可达0.84，这夸大了它们的准确性。RH在FIS响应面和数据驱动分析中均占主导地位（与降雨量的异常相关性为0.63，而与温度和蒸发量的异常相关性为-0.21）。所有模型都低估了最潮湿的月份；FIS从未超过221毫米，而观测到的降雨量达到了316毫米。没有一个模型的提前一个月降雨量预测优于气候学。因此，由专家定义的FIS提供了与机器学习一样准确的透明估算，用于填补降雨记录中的空白，而预测则需要大规模的预测因子。

articles.title: Benchmarking a Hardware-Efficient Variational Quantum Eigensolver for Ground-State Energies and Potential Energy Curves of Nine Small Molecules against Exact Active-Space and Full Configuration Interaction References
articles.title_zh: 针对九种小分子的基态能量和势能曲线，将硬件高效变分量子本征求解器与精确有活动空间和全组态相互作用参考值进行基准比较
articles.abstract: The variational quantum eigensolver (VQE) is the leading near-term quantum algorithm for molecular ground states, but its accuracy is often reported with inconsistent reference values and metrics. We present a reproducible benchmark of a hardware-efficient VQE ansatz (RY–RZ rotations with linear CNOT entanglement) for H2, HeH+, LiH, BeH2, H2O, NH3, CH4, CO2 and N2 in the STO-3G basis. Hamiltonians were generated with PySCF and Qiskit Nature, encoded with the parity mapping and two-qubit reduction on 2, 4 or 6 qubits, and minimised with SLSQP and analytic gradients in noiseless statevector simulations, with a penalty term enforcing the correct electron number. Energies are compared with exact active-space (CASCI) and all-electron full configuration interaction (FCI) references in the same basis, at experimental geometries and along potential energy curves (144 geometries in total). For the two- and four-qubit systems, VQE reproduces the exact energies, potential energy curves, bond lengths and harmonic frequencies to numerical precision. For the six-qubit systems the equilibrium errors are 0.3–7.5 mEh and reach 51.1 mEh along the curves, so chemical accuracy (1.6 mEh) is reached only for H2O and CH4; increasing the depth to reps = 4–6 (20–30 CNOTs) restores chemical accuracy at equilibrium, and UCCSD reaches chemical accuracy for all nine molecules but requires 476 instead of 15 CNOT gates. Active-space truncation errors (1–139 mEh) exceed the VQE errors, and deviations of STO-3G bond lengths from experiment (up to 0.14 Å) are basis-set effects shared by FCI. The results show why VQE errors should be reported in absolute terms against exact references for the same Hamiltonian, and they provide a baseline for evaluating noise-aware and symmetry-preserving ansätze.
articles.abstract_zh: 变分量子特征值求解器（VQE）是用于分子基态的主要近期量子算法，但其准确性在报告时通常使用不一致的参考值和指标。我们提出了一个硬件高效VQE ansatz（具有线性CNOT纠缠的RY–RZ旋转）在STO-3G基组中针对H2、HeH+、LiH、BeH2、H2O、NH3、CH4、CO2和N2的可重现基准。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 变分量子特征值求解器（VQE）是用于分子基态的主要近期量子算法，但其准确性在报告时通常使用不一致的参考值和指标。我们提出了一个硬件高效VQE ansatz（具有线性CNOT纠缠的RY–RZ旋转）在STO-3G基组中针对H2、HeH+、LiH、BeH2、H2O、NH3、CH4、CO2和N2的可重现基准。哈密顿量使用PySCF和Qiskit Nature生成，使用奇偶映射和2、4或6个量子比特上的双量子比特约简进行编码，并在无噪声态矢量模拟中使用SLSQP和解析梯度进行最小化，同时使用惩罚项来强制执行正确的电子数。在相同的基组中，在实验几何构型下以及沿势能曲线（总共144个几何构型），将能量与精确的活性空间（CASCI）和全电子全组态相互作用（FCI）参考值进行比较。对于二量子比特和四量子比特系统，VQE以数值精度再现了精确的能量、势能曲线、键长和谐振频率。对于六量子比特系统，平衡误差为0.3–7.5 mEh，沿曲线达到51.1 mEh，因此仅对于H2O和CH4达到化学精度（1.6 mEh）；将深度增加到reps = 4–6（20–30个CNOT）可恢复平衡时的化学精度，并且UCCSD对于所有九种分子都达到化学精度，但需要476个CNOT门，而不是15个。有活性的空间截断误差（1–139 mEh）超过了VQE误差，STO-3G键长与实验值的偏差（高达0.14 Å）是FCI共有的基组效应。结果表明，为什么应以绝对值形式报告VQE误差，并将其与同一哈密顿量的精确参考值进行比较，这些结果为评估噪声感知和对称性保持的波函数试探提供了基准。

articles.title: Bridging Graph and Pairwise Learning for Gene Regulatory Network Inference from scRNA-seq Data
articles.title_zh: 用于从scRNA-seq数据中推断基因调控网络的桥接图和成对学习
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.13801v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Motivation: Gene regulatory networks (GRNs) capture the underlying interactions through which transcription factors (TFs) regulate genes. Based on gene expression data, existing GRN inference approaches generally fall into two categories: graph-based methods, which model the GRN as a whole graph, and pairwise-based methods, which decompose the GRN into individual TF-target gene pairs for modeling. However, each approach exhibits limitations that are precisely the strengths of its counterpart. Graph-based methods tend to overfit due to their reliance on a single training graph, whereas pairwise-based methods benefit from abundant TF-target training pairs. In contrast, pairwise-based methods overlook the global topological structure, which is essential for comprehensively capturing regulatory mechanisms. Results: To address these limitations, we propose scGPL, an end-to-end unified framework that jointly models global regulatory topology and local interactions. scGPL extracts macro-level features from the global regulatory graph and introduces a dynamic, importance-guided subgraph sampling mechanism to capture fine-grained local dependencies. By fusing global representations with subgraph-enhanced local features, our framework bridges the gap between the two paradigms, incorporating essential whole-graph topological dependencies while retaining the data abundance advantage of pairwise methods. Extensive experiments on seven benchmark datasets demonstrate that scGPL consistently achieves state-of-the-art performance, with up to 13.7% improvement over the strongest baseline, validating the effectiveness of our integrative design. Availability and implementation: The source code is maintained on GitHub (https://github.com/talent-hang/scGPL), and the datasets and versioned releases are archived at https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21608485 for reproducibility.
articles.abstract_zh: 动机：基因调控网络 (GRN) 捕捉转录因子 (TF) 通过其调控基因的潜在相互作用。基于基因表达数据，现有的GRN推断方法通常分为两类：基于图的方法，将GRN建模为整个图；以及基于成对的方法，将GRN分解为单个TF-靶基因对进行建模。然而，每种方法都存在局限性，而这些局限性恰恰是另一种方法的优势。基于图的方法由于依赖于单个训练图，因此往往会出现过拟合，而基于成对的方法则受益于丰富的TF-靶标训练对。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 动机：基因调控网络 (GRN) 捕捉转录因子 (TF) 通过其调控基因的潜在相互作用。基于基因表达数据，现有的GRN推断方法通常分为两类：基于图的方法，将GRN建模为整个图；以及基于成对的方法，将GRN分解为单个TF-靶基因对进行建模。然而，每种方法都存在局限性，而这些局限性恰恰是另一种方法的优势。基于图的方法由于依赖于单个训练图，因此往往会出现过拟合，而基于成对的方法则受益于丰富的TF-靶标训练对。相比之下，基于成对的方法忽视了全局拓扑结构，而这对于全面捕捉调控机制至关重要。结果：为了解决这些局限性，我们提出了scGPL，这是一个端到端的统一框架，可联合建模全局调控拓扑和局部相互作用。scGPL从全局调控图中提取宏观特征，并引入了一种动态的、以重要性为导向的子图采样机制，以捕捉精细的局部依赖关系。通过将全局表示与子图增强的局部特征相结合，我们的框架弥合了两种范式之间的鸿沟，既融入了至关重要的全图拓扑依赖性，又保留了成对方法的数据丰富性优势。对七个基准数据集进行的广泛实验表明，scGPL始终能实现最先进的性能，与最强的基线相比，性能提升高达13.7%，这验证了我们集成设计的有效性。可用性和实现：源代码在 GitHub (https://github.com/talent-hang/scGPL) 上维护，数据集和版本化发布存档在 https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21608485 ，以供重现。

articles.title: Wafer-scale MoS2 and HZO-based Ferroelectric Field Effect Transistors with 4.4 V Memory Window for Back-End Compatible Multibit Memory
articles.title_zh: 具有 4.4 V 存储窗口的晶圆级 MoS2 和基于 HZO 的铁电场效应晶体管，用于后端兼容的多比特存储器
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.12968v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Ferroelectric field-effect transistors (FeFETs) with low-power operation and non-volatile data retention enabled by stable ferroelectric polarization switching, have emerged as promising alternatives to conventional floating-gate transistors for next-generation low-power memory applications. A FeFET with two-dimensional (2D) channel provides the opportunity for better electrostatic gate control and scalability beyond silicon. In this work, we report wafer scale 2D semiconductor-based FeFETs with Hf0.5Zr0.5O2 (HZO) gate stack showing unusual p-type charge transport and stable multibit memory properties.
