FeFETs based on 2-3 monolayer Molybdenum disulfide (MoS2) channel and a 20 nm HZO back gate oxide layer exhibit a large hysteresis with a memory window spanning 4.4 V under a operating voltage range of +3.8 to -3.8 V, and an ION/IOFF ratio of 10⁵. We demonstrate that the polarization charge-induced modification of Schottky barrier width strongly affects the hole transport and memory properties of MoS2-HZO FeFETs. We further demonstrate several advantages and unique features of the FeFETs such as nondestructive data readout, non-volatile data retention under zero gate bias, low operation voltage, high write endurance and ultra-fast switching speed. These 1T memory cells can simplify the dense 3D integrated array architecture and offer additional practical functionalities, such as fast programming and erasing of large data arrays that are absent for many conventional memories. The demonstrated MoS2 and HZO-based FeFET shows great potential for on-chip complementary metal-oxide semiconductor (CMOS)-back-end-of-line (BEOL) compatible circuits for multifunctional devices, especially for 3D monolithically integrated architectures for AI workload.
articles.abstract_zh: 铁电场效应晶体管（FeFET）具有低功耗工作特性，并通过稳定的铁电极化翻转实现非易失性数据保持。FeFET已成为传统浮栅晶体管的有希望的替代品，可用于下一代低功耗存储器应用。具有二维 (2D) 通道的 FeFET 为实现更好的静电栅极控制和超越硅的可扩展性提供了机会。在本文中，我们报告了具有 Hf0.5Zr0.5O2 (HZO) 栅极堆叠的晶圆级二维半导体基 FeFET，其表现出异常的 p 型电荷输运和稳定的多比特存储特性。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 铁电场效应晶体管（FeFET）具有低功耗工作特性，并通过稳定的铁电极化翻转实现非易失性数据保持。FeFET已成为传统浮栅晶体管的有希望的替代品，可用于下一代低功耗存储器应用。具有二维 (2D) 通道的 FeFET 为实现更好的静电栅极控制和超越硅的可扩展性提供了机会。在本文中，我们报告了具有 Hf0.5Zr0.5O2 (HZO) 栅极堆叠的晶圆级二维半导体基 FeFET，其表现出异常的 p 型电荷输运和稳定的多比特存储特性。基于 2-3 层单层二硫化钼 (MoS2) 沟道和 20 nm HZO 背栅氧化层的 FeFET 在 +3.8 至 -3.8 V 的工作电压范围内表现出较大的滞后性，存储窗口跨度为 4.4 V，ION/IOFF 比率为 10⁵。我们证明，极化电荷诱导的肖特基势垒宽度变化强烈影响 MoS2-HZO FeFET 的空穴输运和存储特性。我们进一步展示了 FeFET 的若干优点和独特特性，例如无损数据读出、零栅极偏压下的非易失性数据保持、低工作电压、高写入耐久性和超快开关速度。这些 1T 存储单元可以简化高密度 3D 集成阵列架构，并提供额外的实用功能，例如快速编程和擦除大型数据阵列，而许多传统存储器不具备这些功能。所展示的基于 MoS2 和 HZO 的 FeFET 在多功能器件的片上互补金属氧化物半导体 (CMOS) 后端工艺 (BEOL) 兼容电路方面展现出巨大潜力，尤其适用于用于 AI 工作负载的 3D 单片集成架构。

articles.title: Point defects and primary radiation damage in Co-free Fe-Ni-Cr-Mn high-entropy alloys from molecular dynamics
articles.title_zh: 基于分子动力学的无钴Fe-Ni-Cr-Mn高熵合金的点缺陷和一次辐照损伤
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.13038v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Co-free Fe-Ni-Cr-Mn high-entropy alloys (HEAs) are candidates for nuclear structural applications. We used molecular dynamics with the EAM-21 potential, stiffened at short range, to study five HEAs that have been irradiated experimentally: Fe37Ni34Cr16Mn13 (ES1), Fe35Ni35Cr15Mn15 (P35), Fe46Ni22Cr15Mn17 (Y3), Fe27Ni28Cr18Mn27 (Kumar) and Fe30Ni30Cr10Mn30 (C30). They were compared with pure Ni, Fe60Ni40, the Fe70Ni10Cr20 model alloy of 316L, and Fe50Ni34Cr16, which is ES1 with Mn replaced by Fe. We calculated stacking fault energies, threshold displacement energies, point-defect formation and migration energies, and 1015 displacement cascades from 5 to 40 keV at 300 and 823 K. The stacking fault energy follows the Ni content: 19-44 mJ/m² in the alloys and 113 mJ/m² in Ni. Compared with the Mn-free alloys, the HEAs have lower threshold displacement energies (48-56 against 64-74 eV) and lower dumbbell formation energies, and Mn is the element most transported by interstitials. All the concentrated alloys leave about the same number of Frenkel pairs, 56-72 at 40 keV, half the number in Ni. At 40 keV, 54-58% of the interstitials are in clusters in the HEAs, against 67-71% in Fe60Ni40, Fe70Ni10Cr20 and Fe50Ni34Cr16 and 82% in Ni. At the same cluster size, clusters of 4-12 interstitials are faulted about half as often in the HEAs, and this does not follow the stacking fault energy. The surviving interstitials are enriched in Mn in the HEAs and in Ni in the Mn-free alloys, and depleted in Cr. The results support direct loop formation in cascades in Fe60Ni40 and Fe70Ni10Cr20 and less of it in ES1.
articles.abstract_zh: 无钴 Fe-Ni-Cr-Mn 高熵合金 (HEA) 是核结构应用的候选材料。我们使用具有短程硬化 EAM-21 势的分子动力学研究了经过实验辐照的五种 HEA：Fe37Ni34Cr16Mn13 (ES1)、Fe35Ni35Cr15Mn15 (P35)、Fe46Ni22Cr15Mn17 (Y3)、Fe27Ni28Cr18Mn27 (Kumar) 和 Fe30Ni30Cr10Mn30 （C30）。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 无钴 Fe-Ni-Cr-Mn 高熵合金 (HEA) 是核结构应用的候选材料。我们使用具有短程硬化 EAM-21 势的分子动力学研究了经过实验辐照的五种 HEA：Fe37Ni34Cr16Mn13 (ES1)、Fe35Ni35Cr15Mn15 (P35)、Fe46Ni22Cr15Mn17 (Y3)、Fe27Ni28Cr18Mn27 (Kumar) 和 Fe30Ni30Cr10Mn30 （C30）。将它们与纯Ni、Fe60Ni40、316L的Fe70Ni10Cr20模型合金以及Fe50Ni34Cr16（即用Fe代替Mn的ES1）进行了比较。我们计算了堆垛层错能、阈值位移能、点缺陷形成和迁移能，以及 300 和 823 K 下 5 至 40 keV 的 1015 个位移级联。堆垛层错能与 Ni 含量相关：合金中为 19-44 mJ/m²，Ni 中为 113 mJ/m²。与无锰合金相比，HEA 具有较低的阈位移能（48-56 对 64-74 eV）和较低的哑铃形成能，并且锰是间隙原子传输最多的元素。所有浓缩合金留下的弗兰克尔对数量大致相同，在 40 keV 时为 56-72 个，是镍中数量的一半。在 40 keV 时，HEA 中 54-58% 的间隙原子聚集在簇中，而 Fe60Ni40、Fe70Ni10Cr20 和 Fe50Ni34Cr16 中为 67-71%，Ni 中为 82%。在簇大小相同的情况下，4-12 个间隙原子簇在 HEA 中发生故障的频率大约是 HEA 的一半，并且这与堆垛层错能量无关。幸存的间隙原子在 HEA 中富集 Mn，在无锰合金中富集 Ni，并贫化 Cr。结果支持 Fe60Ni40 和 Fe70Ni10Cr20 级联中直接形成环路，而 ES1 中则支持较少的环路形成。

articles.title: Chiral Superconductivity Indifferent to Parent Topology in the Square-Lattice Hofstadter-Hubbard Model
articles.title_zh: 方晶格 Hofstadter-Hubbard 模型中的手性超导性与母体拓扑无关
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.13091v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study a π-flux square-lattice t-t' Hofstadter-Hubbard model proposed to be realizable in twisted moiré bilayers. By tuning U and t' at half filling, ground-state density-matrix renormalization group simulations (DMRG) and a parton analysis identify an integer quantum Hall (IQH) phase, a chiral spin liquid (CSL), and an antiferromagnet (AFM) in the phase diagram, while charge and spin fluctuations from finite-temperature determinant quantum Monte Carlo (DQMC) suggest a closing charge gap but an open spin gap at the IQH-CSL boundary, consistent with the topological criticality expected there. This model therefore produces a phase diagram hosting weakly correlated band topology (IQH), intrinsic topological order (CSL), and conventional symmetry breaking (AFM) side by side. Upon doping any of these three parent phases, a single chiral topological superconductor with spin Chern number Cₛ=-2 occupies nearly the entire phase diagram. DMRG, DQMC, and weak-coupling perturbation theory agree on its pairing symmetry. This shows that doping the topological band of our model robustly induces the same paired state throughout the phase diagram regardless of the character of the underlying correlated half-filled state and its magnetic fluctuations, whether an IQH, a spin liquid or a weakly fluctuating AFM.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们研究了一种 π 通量方格 t-t' Hofstadter-Hubbard 模型，该模型建议可在扭曲莫尔双层中实现。通过在半填充时调整 U 和 t'，基态密度矩阵重整化群模拟 (DMRG) 和部分子分析识别出相图中的整数量子霍尔 (IQH) 相、手性自旋液体 (CSL) 和反铁磁体 (AFM)，而有限温度行列式量子蒙特卡罗 (DQMC) 的电荷和自旋波动表明电荷能隙闭合，但 IQH-CSL 边界处的自旋能隙开放，与拓扑一致预计那里会有临界点。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们研究了一种 π 通量方格 t-t' Hofstadter-Hubbard 模型，该模型建议可在扭曲莫尔双层中实现。通过在半填充时调整 U 和 t'，基态密度矩阵重整化群模拟 (DMRG) 和部分子分析识别出相图中的整数量子霍尔 (IQH) 相、手性自旋液体 (CSL) 和反铁磁体 (AFM)，而有限温度行列式量子蒙特卡罗 (DQMC) 的电荷和自旋波动表明电荷能隙闭合，但 IQH-CSL 边界处的自旋能隙开放，与拓扑一致预计那里会有临界点。因此，该模型会生成一个相图，其中并排包含弱相关能带拓扑 (IQH)、本征拓扑序 (CSL) 和传统对称破缺 (AFM)。在掺杂这三个母相中的任何一个后，自旋陈数 Cₛ=-2 的单个手性拓扑超导体几乎占据了整个相图。 DMRG、DQMC 和弱耦合微扰理论都同意其配对对称性。这表明，无论底层相关半填充态的特征及其磁波动如何，无论是 IQH、自旋液体还是弱波动 AFM，掺杂我们模型的拓扑带都会在整个相图中稳健地诱导相同的配对态。

articles.title: Quantum Control Geometry as a Metric of Chaos
articles.title_zh: 作为混沌度量的量子控制几何
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.13101v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Quantum-chaotic systems share the same coarse-grained features characteristic of random matrices, such as Wigner-Dyson level-spacing statistics, yet can exhibit strikingly different eigenstate structure and many-body dynamics, including relaxation, transport, scrambling, and entanglement growth. This raises the fundamental question of whether these finer-grained features probe genuinely distinct aspects of quantum chaos or, instead, reflect different manifestations of a common underlying structure---and whether such structure provides a meaningful basis for regarding one many-body quantum system as "more chaotic" than another. Here, we address this question by introducing a quantum geometric framework that quantifies the susceptibility of many-body eigenstates to physically allowed deformations of the Hamiltonian, as constrained by spatial locality, symmetries, and conservation laws. The resulting geometric susceptibility is quantitative, providing a metric of chaos beyond traditional binary diagnostics; intrinsic, as it depends on the manifold of allowed Hamiltonian deformations rather than on the way the system is probed; and unifying, as it directly connects eigenstate structure with dynamics. For canonical models of quantum chaos, we find that minimal geometric susceptibility, maximal eigenstate randomness, broad spectral response of local operators, and the suppression of nonhydrodynamic slow structure coalesce in the same region of Hamiltonian control space. This suggests that these seemingly distinct signatures of chaos are different manifestations of a common underlying geometric structure. Our framework provides a route toward understanding the limits of relaxation and scrambling under physical constraints; in applications, it offers a means to engineer strongly chaotic regimes in programmable quantum systems with restricted controls.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子混沌系统具有与随机矩阵相同的粗粒度特征，例如维格纳-戴森能级间距统计，但可以表现出截然不同的本征态结构和多体动力学，包括弛豫、传输、扰乱和纠缠增长。这就提出了一个基本问题：这些更细粒度的特征是否真正探测了量子混沌的不同方面，或者相反，反映了共同底层结构的不同表现——以及这种结构是否为将一个多体量子系统视为比另一个多体量子系统“更混乱”提供了有意义的基础。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 量子混沌系统具有与随机矩阵相同的粗粒度特征，例如维格纳-戴森能级间距统计，但可以表现出截然不同的本征态结构和多体动力学，包括弛豫、传输、扰乱和纠缠增长。这就提出了一个基本问题：这些更细粒度的特征是否真正探测了量子混沌的不同方面，或者相反，反映了共同底层结构的不同表现——以及这种结构是否为将一个多体量子系统视为比另一个多体量子系统“更混乱”提供了有意义的基础。在这里，我们通过引入一个量子几何框架来解决这个问题，该框架量化了多体本征态对物理允许的哈密顿量变形的敏感性，受到空间局域性、对称性和守恒定律的约束。由此产生的几何敏感性是定量的，提供了超越传统二元诊断的混沌度量；内在的，因为它取决于允许的哈密顿变形的流形，而不是探测系统的方式；并且统一，因为它直接将本征态结构与动力学联系起来。对于量子混沌的规范模型，我们发现最小几何磁化率、最大本征态随机性、局部算子的宽谱响应以及非流体动力学慢结构的抑制在哈密顿控制空间的同一区域中合并。这表明这些看似不同的混沌特征是共同的基础几何结构的不同表现。我们的框架提供了一条了解物理约束下放松和加扰的极限的途径；在应用中，它提供了一种在控制受限的可编程量子系统中设计强混沌状态的方法。

articles.title: Mimicking the zero-field Josephson diode effect with remanent magnetization and self-field
articles.title_zh: 通过剩磁和自场模拟零场约瑟夫森二极管效应
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.13157v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: A Josephson junction whose critical current is larger in one direction than in the other is a diode. With a magnetized barrier, a junction can be a diode at zero applied field, and this is commonly attributed to an intrinsic Josephson diode effect, in which the magnetic barrier breaks time-reversal symmetry. Here we show that the same signatures arise from two ordinary ingredients: the magnetic field of the bias current in the electrodes and the remanent magnetization of the barrier. In cross-type Nb/Pd₈₉Ni₁₁/Nb junctions, the self-field displaces the interference patterns of the two current polarities in opposite directions. An in-plane remanent magnetization translates the pattern and brings the resulting asymmetry to zero field, where the junction mimics a nonvolatile diode with an asymmetry of 10 to 12% and a polarity set by the magnetization direction. Reversing the current or the field cannot distinguish this mimic from an intrinsic effect, but the wiring can: moving the current lead to the other arm of the electrode across the field reverses the self-field diode, in applied field and at zero field alike, whereas an intrinsic diode would be unchanged. This gives a simple dc test for Josephson diodes in the current-perpendicular-to-plane geometry.
articles.abstract_zh: 一个方向的临界电流大于另一个方向的临界电流的约瑟夫森结是二极管。有了磁化势垒，结可以是零外加磁场下的二极管，这通常归因于固有的约瑟夫森二极管效应，其中磁势垒打破了时间反转对称性。在这里，我们表明相同的特征来自两个普通成分：电极中偏置电流的磁场和势垒的剩磁。在交叉型Nb/Pd89Ni11/Nb结中，自场使两个电流极性的干涉图案沿相反方向移动。面内剩磁会平移该图案，并将由此产生的不对称性降至零场，其中结模拟非易失性二极管，其不对称性为 10% 至 12%，极性由磁化方向设定。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 一个方向的临界电流大于另一个方向的临界电流的约瑟夫森结是二极管。有了磁化势垒，结可以是零外加磁场下的二极管，这通常归因于固有的约瑟夫森二极管效应，其中磁势垒打破了时间反转对称性。在这里，我们表明相同的特征来自两个普通成分：电极中偏置电流的磁场和势垒的剩磁。在交叉型Nb/Pd89Ni11/Nb结中，自场使两个电流极性的干涉图案沿相反方向移动。面内剩磁会平移该图案，并将由此产生的不对称性降至零场，其中结模拟非易失性二极管，其不对称性为 10% 至 12%，极性由磁化方向设定。反转电流或场无法将这种模拟与固有效应区分开来，但接线可以：将电流引线移动到场上电极的另一臂，会反转自场二极管，在施加场和零场下都是如此，而本征二极管将保持不变。这为电流垂直于平面几何形状的约瑟夫森二极管提供了简单的直流测试。

articles.title: Study of the frustrated SU(3) Heisenberg chain with SU(3)-symmetric matrix product states
articles.title_zh: 具有SU(3)对称矩阵积态的受抑SU(3)海森堡链研究
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.13166v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study the SU(3) Heisenberg chain with nearest- and next-nearest-neighbor antiferromagnetic exchange J₁ and J₂. Field theory predicts that the trimerized valence-bond solid of this chain has a finite extent in α=J₂/J₁, followed by a gapless SU(3)₁ phase, but earlier numerical estimates of the upper boundary range from αapprox2.1 (exact diagonalization) to αapprox3.8 (iDMRG). We use the variational uniform matrix product state (VUMPS) algorithm with the full non-Abelian SU(3) symmetry imposed on the virtual bonds, reaching bond dimensions up to Dapprox8000, and locate the phase boundaries by finite-entanglement scaling. Resolving the transfer-matrix spectrum and the entanglement spectrum by SU(3) irreducible representation, we find that the trimerized phase extends to αc₂gtrsim3.5 and end below αapprox5, excluding a boundary near αapprox2. At larger α our numerical analysis of the effective central charge is consistent with the predicted massless flow from SU(3)₂ to SU(3)₁.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们研究具有最近邻和次近邻反铁磁交换 J₁ 和 J2 的 SU(3) 海森堡链。场论预测，该链的三聚化价键固体在 α=J2/J1 中具有有限范围，随后是无间隙 SU(3)1 相，但早期数值估计的上边界范围从 αapprox2.1（精确对角化）到 αapprox3.8 (iDMRG)。我们使用变分均匀矩阵积态 (VUMPS) 算法，对虚拟键施加完全非阿贝尔 SU(3) 对称性，键维尺寸高达 Dapprox8000，并通过有限纠缠缩放来定位相边界。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们研究具有最近邻和次近邻反铁磁交换 J₁ 和 J2 的 SU(3) 海森堡链。场论预测，该链的三聚化价键固体在 α=J2/J1 中具有有限范围，随后是无间隙 SU(3)1 相，但早期数值估计的上边界范围从 αapprox2.1（精确对角化）到 αapprox3.8 (iDMRG)。我们使用变分均匀矩阵积态 (VUMPS) 算法，对虚拟键施加完全非阿贝尔 SU(3) 对称性，键维尺寸高达 Dapprox8000，并通过有限纠缠缩放来定位相边界。通过 SU(3) 不可约表示解析转移矩阵谱和纠缠谱，我们发现三聚相延伸到 αc2gtrsim3.5 并结束于 αapprox5 以下，不包括 αapprox2 附近的边界。在较大的 α 下，我们对有效中心电荷的数值分析与预测的从 SU(3)2 到 SU(3)1 的无质量流一致。

articles.title: Hybridization-brightened interlayer excitons in multilayer WSe2 controlled by sliding ferroelectricity
articles.title_zh: 滑动铁电控制多层 WSe2 中的杂化增亮层间激子
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.13264v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Interlayer excitons (IXs) combine spatially separated electron and hole wavefunctions with electrically tunable dipole moments, but their reduced wavefunction overlap generally limits optical emission, particularly for high-energy states. Here we report a bright, spectrally narrow high-energy interlayer exciton (h-IX) near 2.23 eV in few-layer WSe2 and investigate how its optical activity evolves with layer number and sliding-ferroelectric polarization. In pristine 2H-WSe2, we observe thickness-dependent brightening of high-energy exciton emission. GW-BSE calculations reveal mixed intralayer and interlayer configurations with enhanced optical weight, suggesting that multilayer hybridization contributes to the observed brightening. In parallel-stacked 3L/3L WSe2 containing a sliding-ferroelectric interface, the h-IX exhibits polarization-dependent energies and Stark responses that distinguish Pup and Pdown domains. Electric-field-driven domain-wall motion produces hysteretic transfer of spectral weight between the two h-IX branches, enabling optical tracking of ferroelectric switching. These results establish multilayer hybridization as a route to optically active high-energy interlayer excitons and sliding ferroelectricity as a complementary degree of freedom for controlling their energy, dipole and emission.
articles.abstract_zh: 层间激子（IX）将空间分离的电子和空穴波函数与电可调偶极矩结合在一起，但它们减少的波函数重叠通常会限制光发射，特别是对于高能态。在这里，我们报告了少层 WSe2 中接近 2.23 eV 的明亮、光谱窄的高能层间激子 (h-IX)，并研究了其光学活性如何随层数和滑动铁电极化而演变。在原始的 2H-WSe2 中，我们观察到高能激子发射的厚度依赖性增亮。 GW-BSE 计算揭示了混合的层内和层间结构，具有增强的光学重量，表明多层杂化有助于观察到的增亮。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 层间激子（IX）将空间分离的电子和空穴波函数与电可调偶极矩结合在一起，但它们减少的波函数重叠通常会限制光发射，特别是对于高能态。在这里，我们报告了少层 WSe2 中接近 2.23 eV 的明亮、光谱窄的高能层间激子 (h-IX)，并研究了其光学活性如何随层数和滑动铁电极化而演变。在原始的 2H-WSe2 中，我们观察到高能激子发射的厚度依赖性增亮。 GW-BSE 计算揭示了混合的层内和层间结构，具有增强的光学重量，表明多层杂化有助于观察到的增亮。在包含滑动铁电界面的平行堆叠 3L/3L WSe2 中，h-IX 表现出偏振相关能量和区分 Pup 和 Pdown 域的 Stark 响应。电场驱动的畴壁运动在两个 h-IX 分支之间产生光谱权重的滞后转移，从而实现铁电开关的光学跟踪。这些结果将多层杂化确立为光学活性高能层间激子的途径，并将滑动铁电性作为控制其能量、偶极子和发射的补充自由度。

articles.title: Optically modulated field-dependent electrical response in a non-collinear antiferromagnet/ferromagnet heterostructure
articles.title_zh: 非共线反铁磁体/铁磁体异质结构中的光调制场相关电响应
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.13351v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The interplay among optical, electrical, and magnetic stimuli offers opportunities to control the functional response of spintronic heterostructures. Here, we investigate the field-dependent electrical response of MgO/IrMn₃/Py/Au under radio-frequency (RF) excitation, white-light illumination, and direct-current (DC) bias. Under a 20 MHz RF signal with a nominal power of 2 W, the measured voltage in the dark remains at several tens of nanovolts. Upon illumination with approximately 1 W of white light, a pronounced field-dependent feature emerges around 315--320 Oe, reaching 0.9--1.0 μV. The illumination-associated differential voltage is approximately 0.95 μV. A DC current of 1 mA produces a response of approximately 1 μV, while the simultaneous application of RF, DC, and optical excitation increases the voltage to approximately 1.8 μV. Magnetic characterization reveals exchange bias with a blocking temperature near 380 K, while electrical resistance measurements show a pronounced dependence on magnetic-field orientation, consistent with the anisotropic response of the heterostructure. These results demonstrate that the field-dependent electrical response can be modulated through combined optical and electrical excitation, involving magneto-optical interactions and spin-dependent transport phenomena, potentially including spin Hall-related contributions and the magnetic spin Hall effect. This work provides insights into coupled optical, electrical, and magnetic-field effects in heterostructures based on non-collinear antiferromagnets and ferromagnetic layers.
articles.abstract_zh: 光、电和磁刺激之间的相互作用为控制自旋电子异质结构的功能响应提供了机会。在这里，我们研究了 MgO/IrMn₃/Py/Au 在射频 (RF) 激励、白光照明和直流 (DC) 偏置下的场相关电响应。在标称功率为2W的20MHz射频信号下，黑暗中测量的电压保持在几十纳伏。在大约 1 W 的白光照射下，在 315--320 Oe 左右出现明显的场相关特征，达到 0.9--1.0 μV。与照明相关的差分电压约为 0.95 μV。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 光、电和磁刺激之间的相互作用为控制自旋电子异质结构的功能响应提供了机会。在这里，我们研究了 MgO/IrMn₃/Py/Au 在射频 (RF) 激励、白光照明和直流 (DC) 偏置下的场相关电响应。在标称功率为2W的20MHz射频信号下，黑暗中测量的电压保持在几十纳伏。在大约 1 W 的白光照射下，在 315--320 Oe 左右出现明显的场相关特征，达到 0.9--1.0 μV。与照明相关的差分电压约为 0.95 μV。 1 mA 的直流电流产生大约 1 μV 的响应，而同时施加 RF、DC 和光激励则将电压增加到大约 1.8 μV。磁特性揭示了截止温度接近 380 K 时的交换偏差，而电阻测量显示出对磁场方向的明显依赖性，与异质结构的各向异性响应一致。这些结果表明，场相关的电响应可以通过光和电的组合激发进行调制，涉及磁光相互作用和自旋相关的输运现象，可能包括自旋霍尔相关的贡献和磁自旋霍尔效应。这项工作提供了对基于非共线反铁磁体和铁磁层的异质结构中耦合光、电和磁场效应的见解。

articles.title: A Perspective on Topological Charge Density Wave Materials
articles.title_zh: 拓扑电荷密度波材料的展望
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.13360v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Charge density waves are among the earliest known ordered states in quantum materials, yet they have re-emerged at the center of modern discussions of topology, symmetry breaking, and collective dynamics. In several material classes, charge-density-wave order reshapes electronic bands, boundary states, defect structures, and electromagnetic responses in ways that invite a topological interpretation. Real-space imaging has shown that incommensurate order can form networks of phase defects rather than uniform modulations. Boundary-resolved spectroscopy has revealed in-gap modes whose existence and spatial structure track the charge-density-wave order, although such observations remain confined to a single material family. In Weyl materials, density-wave gaps have been linked to axion-like magnetoelectric response, placing the charge-density-wave phase within a dynamical-field description of the effective action. In kagome metals, charge order is intertwined with Berry curvature, unconventional symmetry breaking, and superconductivity. These developments have led to the term "topological charge density wave," but the phrase describes several physically distinct phenomena. We distinguish three meanings: (i) topology of the order parameter and its defects, (ii) topology of the charge-density-wave-reconstructed electronic structure and its boundary modes, and (iii) axion-like electromagnetic response generated by density-wave order. The experimental and theoretical support for these three meanings differs substantially. This Perspective traces the development of these ideas, clarifies the evidence behind each class, identifies unresolved questions and points of debate, and outlines experimental criteria for establishing topology in charge-density-wave states.
articles.abstract_zh: 电荷密度波是量子材料中最早已知的有序态之一，但它们已重新出现在现代拓扑、对称破缺和集体动力学讨论的中心。在几种材料类别中，电荷密度波序以引发拓扑解释的方式重塑电子能带、边界态、缺陷结构和电磁响应。真实空间成像表明，不相称的阶数可以形成相位缺陷网络，而不是均匀调制。边界分辨光谱揭示了间隙内模式，其存在和空间结构跟踪电荷密度波顺序，尽管此类观察仍然局限于单一材料族。在韦尔材料中，密度波间隙与类轴子磁电响应相关，将电荷密度波相位置于有效作用的动态场描述中。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 电荷密度波是量子材料中最早已知的有序态之一，但它们已重新出现在现代拓扑、对称破缺和集体动力学讨论的中心。在几种材料类别中，电荷密度波序以引发拓扑解释的方式重塑电子能带、边界态、缺陷结构和电磁响应。真实空间成像表明，不相称的阶数可以形成相位缺陷网络，而不是均匀调制。边界分辨光谱揭示了间隙内模式，其存在和空间结构跟踪电荷密度波顺序，尽管此类观察仍然局限于单一材料族。在韦尔材料中，密度波间隙与类轴子磁电响应相关，将电荷密度波相位置于有效作用的动态场描述中。在戈薇金属中，电荷顺序与贝里曲率、非常规对称性破缺和超导性交织在一起。这些发展催生了“拓扑电荷密度波”这一术语，但该短语描述了几种物理上不同的现象。我们区分了三个含义：（i）有序参数的拓扑及其缺陷，（ii）电荷密度波重构电子结构的拓扑及其边界模式，以及（iii）由密度波有序产生的轴子电磁响应。这三种含义的实验和理论支持存在很大差异。本视角追溯了这些想法的发展，澄清了每个类别背后的证据，确定了未解决的问题和争论点，并概述了在电荷密度波态中建立拓扑的实验标准。

articles.title: Geometry-Selective Higher-order topological insulators induced by dₓy altermagnet
articles.title_zh: dₓy 交变磁体诱导的几何选择性高阶拓扑绝缘体
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.13438v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We show that proximity to a dₓy-wave altermagnet provides an effective route to engineering boundary-geometry-dependent higher-order topological phases. The boundary geometry plays a crucial role in determining the topological properties: axis-aligned edge states remain gapless, whereas diagonal edges acquire effective masses with alternating signs, giving rise to four corner modes localized at the mass domain walls. By projecting onto the edge-state subspace, we derive the effective edge Hamiltonians for different boundary geometries. Furthermore, π-flux defects introduced under periodic boundary conditions yield zero-energy bound states localized at the flux cores, providing complementary evidence for nontrivial topology without physical boundaries. The interplay between the Zeeman field and the altermagnetic order drives a topological transition through the closing and reopening of the edge gap, while the bulk gap remains open. These findings highlight the crucial role of boundary geometry in higher-order topology and establish proximity-induced dₓy-wave altermagnetism as a route to engineering higher-order topological phases.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们证明，接近 dₓy 波交变磁体为设计边界几何相关的高阶拓扑相提供了一条有效的途径。边界几何形状在确定拓扑特性中起着至关重要的作用：轴对齐的边缘状态保持无间隙，而对角边缘获得具有交替符号的有效质量，从而产生位于质量域壁处的四个角模式。通过投影到边缘状态子空间，我们得出不同边界几何形状的有效边缘哈密顿量。此外，在周期性边界条件下引入的 π 磁通缺陷会产生位于磁通核心处的零能量束缚态，为没有物理边界的非平凡拓扑提供了补充证据。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们证明，接近 dₓy 波交变磁体为设计边界几何相关的高阶拓扑相提供了一条有效的途径。边界几何形状在确定拓扑特性中起着至关重要的作用：轴对齐的边缘状态保持无间隙，而对角边缘获得具有交替符号的有效质量，从而产生位于质量域壁处的四个角模式。通过投影到边缘状态子空间，我们得出不同边界几何形状的有效边缘哈密顿量。此外，在周期性边界条件下引入的 π 磁通缺陷会产生位于磁通核心处的零能量束缚态，为没有物理边界的非平凡拓扑提供了补充证据。塞曼场和交变磁序之间的相互作用通过边缘间隙的关闭和重新打开驱动拓扑转变，而体间隙保持打开。这些发现强调了边界几何在高阶拓扑中的关键作用，并建立了邻近感应 dₓy 波交变磁性作为设计高阶拓扑相的途径。

articles.title: Facilitated Relaxation Overrides Energetic Pathways in a Multiphase Square-Kagome Artificial Spin Ice
articles.title_zh: 多相方戈薇人工旋转冰中的促进放松超越能量通路
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.13500v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Relaxation in interacting many-body systems is typically assumed to follow energy minimization, yet local dynamical rules can determine which microscopic pathways are accessible. In facilitated relaxation, these pathways are enabled or blocked by neighboring configurations. However, isolating such rules in natural materials is difficult because energetics, disorder and dynamics are usually entangled. Here we realize a geometrically tunable square-kagome artificial spin ice-a lithographic nanomagnet array-that provides a clean, designable platform for facilitated relaxation. The array hosts two tunable nearest-neighbor interactions and supports multiple low-energy phases: spin crystal, spin liquid and spin foam. In the spin-foam phase, abundant facilitator configurations allow relaxation to follow Boltzmann statistics. In the spin-crystal phase, by contrast, domain-wall excitations are trapped in non-Boltzmann distributions, although energetically preferred relaxation channels exist. The ordered crystal background lacks the facilitators needed to connect topologically distinct domain-wall classes. These classes are therefore kinetically isolated, as observed in both experiment and Monte Carlo simulation. Our results show that transition-network topology can override energetic relaxation, establishing artificial spin ice as a programmable platform for constrained dynamics and nonergodic relaxation.
articles.abstract_zh: 通常假设相互作用的多体系统中的松弛遵循能量最小化，但局部动力学规则可以确定哪些微观路径是可访问的。在促进放松中，这些路径被邻近的配置启用或阻断。然而，在天然材料中分离出这些规则很困难，因为能量学、无序性和动力学通常是相互纠缠的。在这里，我们实现了一种几何可调的方形戈薇人造旋转冰——一种光刻纳米磁体阵列——它提供了一个干净、可设计的平台，以促进放松。该阵列具有两种可调的最近邻相互作用，并支持多种低能相：自旋晶体、自旋液体和自旋泡沫。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 通常假设相互作用的多体系统中的松弛遵循能量最小化，但局部动力学规则可以确定哪些微观路径是可访问的。在促进放松中，这些路径被邻近的配置启用或阻断。然而，在天然材料中分离出这些规则很困难，因为能量学、无序性和动力学通常是相互纠缠的。在这里，我们实现了一种几何可调的方形戈薇人造旋转冰——一种光刻纳米磁体阵列——它提供了一个干净、可设计的平台，以促进放松。该阵列具有两种可调的最近邻相互作用，并支持多种低能相：自旋晶体、自旋液体和自旋泡沫。在旋转泡沫阶段，丰富的促进剂配置允许松弛遵循玻尔兹曼统计。相比之下，在自旋晶体相中，尽管存在能量优选的弛豫通道，但畴壁激发被捕获在非玻尔兹曼分布中。有序的晶体背景缺乏连接拓扑上不同的畴壁类别所需的促进剂。因此，正如在实验和蒙特卡罗模拟中观察到的那样，这些类别在动力学上是孤立的。我们的结果表明，过渡网络拓扑可以超越能量弛豫，将人造自旋冰建立为约束动力学和非遍历弛豫的可编程平台。

articles.title: Magnetization-free quantum anomalous Hall effect in altermagnetic weak topological insulators
articles.title_zh: 交磁弱拓扑绝缘体中的无磁化量子反常霍尔效应
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.13508v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The quantum anomalous Hall (QAH) effect is usually realized through ferromagnetism or magnetic dop ing, which limits material choices and often results in low mobility, disorder sensitivity, and low operating temperatures. Here, we propose a mechanism to achieve the QAH phase without net magnetization, using altermagnetic exchange on a weak topological insulator (WTI). The altermagnetic order selectively gaps the Dirac cone at the Z point, while hybridization between the top and bottom surfaces of the WTI thin film opens a trivial gap at the point, generating a Chern number C = 1 phase with a single chiral edge channel. We verify the topological transition through both a minimal thin-film model and a slab geometry, and compute the associated Hall response. As altermagnets and layered WTIs already exist experimentally, this mechanism offers a promising and experimentally accessible route to realizing QAH phases without magnetic doping or global magnetization. The results indicate that altermagnetic surface engineering may provide a clean and controllable pathway for realizing dissipationless edge transport in layered quantum materials.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子反常霍尔（QAH）效应通常通过铁磁性或磁性掺杂来实现，这限制了材料的选择，并且常常导致低迁移率、无序敏感性和低工作温度。在这里，我们提出了一种在弱拓扑绝缘体（WTI）上使用交变磁交换来实现无净磁化的 QAH 相的机制。交变磁序选择性地在 Z 点处使狄拉克锥产生间隙，而 WTI 薄膜的顶面和底面之间的杂化在该点处打开了一个微不足道的间隙，从而生成具有单个手性边缘通道的陈数 C = 1 相。我们通过最小薄膜模型和平板几何形状验证拓扑转变，并计算相关的霍尔响应。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 量子反常霍尔（QAH）效应通常通过铁磁性或磁性掺杂来实现，这限制了材料的选择，并且常常导致低迁移率、无序敏感性和低工作温度。在这里，我们提出了一种在弱拓扑绝缘体（WTI）上使用交变磁交换来实现无净磁化的 QAH 相的机制。交变磁序选择性地在 Z 点处使狄拉克锥产生间隙，而 WTI 薄膜的顶面和底面之间的杂化在该点处打开了一个微不足道的间隙，从而生成具有单个手性边缘通道的陈数 C = 1 相。我们通过最小薄膜模型和平板几何形状验证拓扑转变，并计算相关的霍尔响应。由于交替磁体和层状 WTI 已经在实验中存在，因此该机制提供了一种有前景且可通过实验实现的途径，无需磁掺杂或全局磁化即可实现 QAH 相。结果表明，交变磁表面工程可以为实现层状量子材料中的无耗散边缘传输提供干净且可控的途径。

articles.title: Field-induced magnetic quantum phase transitions in a bilayer triangular lattice antiferromagnet K₂Co₂(HPO₃)₂(C₂O₄)(H₂O)₂
articles.title_zh: 双层三角晶格反铁磁体 K2Co2(HPO3)2(C2O4)(H2O)2 中场致磁量子相变
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.13532v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We present a ³¹P nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR) study on the spin-1/2 bilayer triangular-lattice antiferromagnet K₂Co₂(HPO₃)₂(C₂O₄)(H₂O)₂. Measurements were performed at temperatures down to 0.06 K and magnetic fields up to 26 T. In the field range of 0.5 T to 4 T, the low-temperature spin-lattice relaxation rate 1/T₁ exhibits a peak, signaling the onset of a magnetically ordered state. Within this ordered phase, 1/T₁ shows gapless behavior, suggesting a spin supersolid phase. This ordering is suppressed around 4 T. Between 6 T and 18 T, clear splittings of the NMR spectra are observed, indicating the emergence of a second ordered magnetic phase. The field derivative of the low-temperature Knight shift Kᵣₘ ₙ reveals changes in slope at approximately 10 T, 15.5 T, and 18 T. The first two features correspond to bulk magnetizations of 1/3 and 2/3 of the fully saturated moment, respectively, while the last one marks a quantum phase transition from the second ordered phase to the fully polarized state. These results establish the studied compound as a platform for investigating field-induced quantum phase transitions and emergent phases in frustrated bilayer triangular-lattice antiferromagnets.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们对自旋 1/2 双层三角晶格反铁磁体 K2Co2(HPO3)2(C2O4)(H2O)2 进行了 31P 核磁共振 (NMR) 研究。测量在低至 0.06 K 的温度和高达 26 T 的磁场下进行。在 0.5 T 至 4 T 的磁场范围内，低温自旋晶格弛豫率 1/T₁ 出现峰值，表明磁有序状态的开始。在这个有序相中，1/T₁ 显示出无间隙行为，表明存在自旋超固体相。这种有序性在 4 T 附近受到抑制。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们对自旋 1/2 双层三角晶格反铁磁体 K2Co2(HPO3)2(C2O4)(H2O)2 进行了 31P 核磁共振 (NMR) 研究。测量在低至 0.06 K 的温度和高达 26 T 的磁场下进行。在 0.5 T 至 4 T 的磁场范围内，低温自旋晶格弛豫率 1/T₁ 出现峰值，表明磁有序状态的开始。在这个有序相中，1/T₁ 显示出无间隙行为，表明存在自旋超固体相。这种有序性在 4 T 附近受到抑制。在 6 T 和 18 T 之间，观察到 NMR 光谱的明显分裂，表明出现了第二有序磁性相。低温奈特位移 Kᵣₘ ₙ 的场导数揭示了大约 10 T、15.5 T 和 18 T 处的斜率变化。前两个特征分别对应于完全饱和矩的 1/3 和 2/3 的体磁化强度，而最后一个特征则标志着从第二有序相到完全极化状态的量子相变。这些结果将所研究的化合物确立为研究受挫双层三角晶格反铁磁体中场致量子相变和涌现相的平台。

articles.title: Hidden interfacial magnetism in RuO₂ heterostructures revealed by a superconducting spin switch
articles.title_zh: 超导自旋开关揭示了 RuO2 异质结构中隐藏的界面磁性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.13579v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: RuO₂, once the flagship altermagnetic candidate, is now believed to be nonmagnetic in the bulk, yet weak, static and spatially inhomogeneous magnetism emerges at its surfaces and interfaces. Where this magnetism resides, what stabilises it, and whether it is connected to these states remain open questions. Here we address these questions at the Nb/RuO₂ interface using a superconducting spin switch. A GdN/Nb/RuO₂ trilayer allows interfacial exchange-field alignment to tune the superconducting transition temperature of Nb, probing interfacial magnetism inaccessible to conventional magnetometry. The switch reveals a hidden magnetic subsystem, which we attribute to a thin RuOₓ redox layer formed as Nb scavenges oxygen from RuO₂. This layer behaves as a weak and magnetically hard ferromagnet with vacancy-induced anisotropy. Furthermore, supercurrent amplifies the switching efficiency, making the probe sensitivity tunable in situ. Superconducting spin switches thus emerge as a quantitative low-temperature probe of hidden magnetism at buried interfaces.
articles.abstract_zh: RuO2，曾经是旗舰的变磁候选者，现在被认为在整体上是非磁性的，但在其表面和界面处出现了微弱的、静态的和空间不均匀的磁性。这种磁性存在于何处，是什么稳定了它，以及它是否与这些状态有关仍然是悬而未决的问题。在这里，我们使用超导自旋开关在 Nb/RuO2 界面上解决这些问题。 GdN/Nb/RuO2 三层允许界面交换场排列来调节 Nb 的超导转变温度，从而探测传统磁力测量无法达到的界面磁性。
articles.abstract_zh_full: RuO2，曾经是旗舰的变磁候选者，现在被认为在整体上是非磁性的，但在其表面和界面处出现了微弱的、静态的和空间不均匀的磁性。这种磁性存在于何处，是什么稳定了它，以及它是否与这些状态有关仍然是悬而未决的问题。在这里，我们使用超导自旋开关在 Nb/RuO2 界面上解决这些问题。 GdN/Nb/RuO2 三层允许界面交换场排列来调节 Nb 的超导转变温度，从而探测传统磁力测量无法达到的界面磁性。该开关揭示了一个隐藏的磁性子系统，我们将其归因于铌从 RuO2 中清除氧气时形成的薄 RuOₓ 氧化还原层。该层表现为弱磁硬铁磁体，具有空位引起的各向异性。此外，超电流放大了开关效率，使探头灵敏度可原位可调。因此，超导自旋开关成为埋藏界面隐藏磁性的定量低温探针。

articles.title: Topological flat bands from nonlinear periodic motion
articles.title_zh: 非线性周期运动的拓扑平带
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.13591v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We use the Lax formulation of classical integrable systems to characterize the topology of nonlinear periodic orbits. For a Hamiltonian system with one degree of freedom, we express the chiral-symmetric Lax operator along a periodic orbit in a frequency basis. Energy conservation makes both bands of the resulting tight-binding model exactly flat. The harmonic oscillator corresponds to a fully dimerized topological Su-Schrieffer-Heeger model, while nonlinearity generates long-range hopping through higher harmonics. In the symmetric double well, the winding number changes as intrawell periodic orbits give way to an orbit spanning both wells, and the zero-energy edge mode of the semi-infinite chain disappears. We derive the edge-mode profile and show that its localization length diverges logarithmically as the separatrix is approached. At the separatrix, the period and the hopping decay length diverge while the band gap remains finite; this singular limit of the periodic motion allows the winding number of the infinite frequency chain to change. Canonical quantization of the Lax operator also connects the chiral winding numbers to supersymmetric quantum mechanics: for a bound system on the real line with simple turning points, their sum over all periodic orbits at a common positive energy equals the Witten index. We also apply the construction to periodic nonlinear waves through traveling-wave reductions. The finite-period winding number becomes undefined in their solitary-wave limits.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们使用经典可积系统的 Lax 公式来表征非线性周期轨道的拓扑。对于一个自由度的哈密顿系统，我们以频率为基础表达沿周期轨道的手性对称 Lax 算子。能量守恒使得所得紧束缚模型的两个能带都完全平坦。谐振子对应于完全二聚化的拓扑 Su-Schrieffer-Heeger 模型，而非线性则通过高次谐波产生长程跳变。在对称双阱中，随着阱内周期轨道让位于跨越两个阱的轨道，缠绕数发生变化，并且半无限链的零能量边缘模式消失。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们使用经典可积系统的 Lax 公式来表征非线性周期轨道的拓扑。对于一个自由度的哈密顿系统，我们以频率为基础表达沿周期轨道的手性对称 Lax 算子。能量守恒使得所得紧束缚模型的两个能带都完全平坦。谐振子对应于完全二聚化的拓扑 Su-Schrieffer-Heeger 模型，而非线性则通过高次谐波产生长程跳变。在对称双阱中，随着阱内周期轨道让位于跨越两个阱的轨道，缠绕数发生变化，并且半无限链的零能量边缘模式消失。我们推导了边缘模式轮廓，并表明当接近分界线时，其定位长度呈对数发散。在分界线处，周期和跳变衰减长度发散，而带隙保持有限；周期性运动的奇异极限允许无限频率链的缠绕数发生变化。 Lax算子的规范量子化还将手性缠绕数与超对称量子力学联系起来：对于实线上具有简单转折点的束缚系统，它们在共同正能量下的所有周期轨道上的总和等于维滕指数。我们还通过行波衰减将该结构应用于周期性非线性波。有限周期绕组数在其孤波极限中变得不确定。

articles.title: How anion composition governs structural frameworks and Li-ion transport in oxychloride solid-state electrolytes
articles.title_zh: 阴离子组成如何控制氯氧化物固态电解质中的结构框架和锂离子传输
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.13611v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Mixed-anion lithium oxychlorides exhibit high Li conductivity, but the relationship between oxygen content, structural framework, and Li-ion transport remains unclear. Here, crystal structure prediction and molecular dynamics simulations with machine-learning interatomic potentials are used to examine Li_yMOₓCl₆₋₂ₓ (M = Nb and Ta [Group 5] and M = Ti, Zr, and Hf [Group 4]). Increasing oxygen content changes isolated chloride-rich polyhedra into one-dimensional chains and subsequently more highly connected two- and three-dimensional frameworks. In the Group 5 series, fast Li diffusion occurs over x approx 0.67--1.5, where the Li sites form a three-dimensional percolating network. Potential of mean force maps and nudged elastic band calculations reveal that fast Li-ion transport requires a low-dimensional framework supporting long-range migration through undercoordinated Li sites with low barriers, together with similar energies across Li sites. Finally, we perform fine-grid compositional search, which identifies LiNbO₀.₆₇Cl₄.₆₇, LiTaO₀.₇₅Cl₄.₅, LiNbO₁.₅Cl₃, and LiTaO₁.₅Cl₃ as stable candidates with predicted room-temperature self-diffusivities of up to sim 10⁻⁶,cm²/s. These findings establish how oxygen content controls framework and Li-ion transport, guiding the design of lithium oxyhalide electrolytes.
articles.abstract_zh: 混合阴离子氯氧化锂表现出高锂电导率，但氧含量、结构框架和锂离子传输之间的关系仍不清楚。在这里，使用机器学习原子间势的晶体结构预测和分子动力学模拟来检查 Li_yMOₓCl₆₋₂ₓ（M = Nb 和 Ta [第 5 族]，M = Ti、Zr 和 Hf [第 4 族]）。增加氧含量将孤立的富含氯化物的多面体转变为一维链，随后转变为更加高度连接的二维和三维框架。在第 5 族系列中，快速 Li 扩散发生在 x 约 0.67--1.5 范围内，其中 Li 位点形成三维渗透网络。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 混合阴离子氯氧化锂表现出高锂电导率，但氧含量、结构框架和锂离子传输之间的关系仍不清楚。在这里，使用机器学习原子间势的晶体结构预测和分子动力学模拟来检查 Li_yMOₓCl₆₋₂ₓ（M = Nb 和 Ta [第 5 族]，M = Ti、Zr 和 Hf [第 4 族]）。增加氧含量将孤立的富含氯化物的多面体转变为一维链，随后转变为更加高度连接的二维和三维框架。在第 5 族系列中，快速 Li 扩散发生在 x 约 0.67--1.5 范围内，其中 Li 位点形成三维渗透网络。平均力图和微推弹性带计算的潜力表明，快速锂离子传输需要一个低维框架，支持通过低势垒的欠配位锂位点进行长距离迁移，以及跨锂位点的类似能量。最后，我们进行细网格成分搜索，将 LiNbO₀.₆₇Cl₄.₆₇、LiTaO₀.₇₅Cl₄.₅、LiNbO₁.₅Cl₃ 和 LiTaO₁.₅Cl₃ 识别为稳定候选者，预测室温自扩散率高达 sim 10⁻⁶，cm²/秒。这些发现确定了氧含量如何控制框架和锂离子传输，指导卤氧化锂电解质的设计。

articles.title: Emergent Quantized Zak Phases without Dimerization in a Multicomponent Fermionic Extended Hubbard Model
articles.title_zh: 多组分费米子扩展哈伯德模型中无二聚化的涌现量子化 Zak 相
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.13695v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Quantized Zak phases are commonly associated with dimerized systems, such as the noninteracting Su--Schrieffer--Heeger (SSH) model. In interacting systems, however, interactions can induce effective dimerization of particle clusters even in the absence of explicit dimerization in the underlying lattice. In this work, we study a one-dimensional multicomponent fermionic extended Hubbard model under a resonance condition between the on-site and nearest-neighbor interactions. We find that quantized Zak phases emerge for odd fermion numbers ngeqslant 3, protected by the inversion symmetry of the effective Hamiltonian. Furthermore, in the presence of a tilted field, fermion clusters exhibit Bloch oscillations, during which their Zak phases can be extracted from the evolution of a Gaussian wave packet over one Bloch period. Our results reveal an interaction-induced mechanism for realizing quantized Zak phases in multicomponent fermionic systems without explicit lattice dimerization.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子化 Zak 相通常与二聚系统相关，例如非相互作用的 Su--Schrieffer--Heeger (SSH) 模型。然而，在相互作用的系统中，即使在底层晶格中不存在显式二聚化的情况下，相互作用也可以诱导粒子簇的有效二聚化。在这项工作中，我们研究了现场相互作用和最近邻相互作用之间共振条件下的一维多分量费米子扩展哈伯德模型。我们发现奇数费米子数 ngeqslant 3 出现量化的 Zak 相位，受到有效哈密顿量的反演对称性的保护。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 量子化 Zak 相通常与二聚系统相关，例如非相互作用的 Su--Schrieffer--Heeger (SSH) 模型。然而，在相互作用的系统中，即使在底层晶格中不存在显式二聚化的情况下，相互作用也可以诱导粒子簇的有效二聚化。在这项工作中，我们研究了现场相互作用和最近邻相互作用之间共振条件下的一维多分量费米子扩展哈伯德模型。我们发现奇数费米子数 ngeqslant 3 出现量化的 Zak 相位，受到有效哈密顿量的反演对称性的保护。此外，在存在倾斜场的情况下，费米子簇表现出布洛赫振荡，在此期间，可以从一个布洛赫周期内高斯波包的演化中提取它们的 Zak 相位。我们的结果揭示了一种相互作用诱导机制，可在多组分费米子系统中实现量子化 Zak 相，而无需显式晶格二聚化。

articles.title: An infrared divacancy color center in bulk hexagonal diamond for quantum communication
articles.title_zh: 用于量子通信的大块六方金刚石中的红外双空位色心
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.13736v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Intrinsic color centers are investigated in bulk hexagonal diamond as potential emitters for fiber-based quantum communication. Hybrid density functional theory and constrained-occupation delta SCF calculations identify five carbon-vacancy and divacancy configurations with stable optical excited states. A comparison of their radiative and nonradiative properties within a three-point configuration-coordinate model identifies the positively charged axial divacancy, VVa1+, as the most promising candidate. It exhibits the highest calculated zero-phonon-line (ZPL) emission rate of 43.9 MHz and ZPL quantum efficiency of 11.8% among the five candidates. Its weak structural relaxation yields a Huang-Rhys factor of 0.395, while a multimode photoluminescence calculation gives a Debye-Waller factor of 69.37%, indicating a dominant zero-phonon contribution. The predicted ZPL at 0.603 eV (2057.3 nm) also has the smallest photon-energy separation from the 1310 and 1550 nm telecom targets among the candidates. These results identify VVa1+ as a promising intrinsic color center for fiber-based quantum communication, with quantum frequency upconversion offering a route from its strong infrared ZPL to the telecom O and C bands.
articles.abstract_zh: 研究了块状六角金刚石中的本征色心作为基于光纤的量子通信的潜在发射器。混合密度泛函理论和约束占据 Delta SCF 计算确定了五种具有稳定光学激发态的碳空位和双空位构型。在三点构型坐标模型中比较它们的辐射和非辐射特性，确定带正电的轴向双空位 VVa1+ 是最有希望的候选者。在五种候选产品中，它表现出最高的计算零声子线 (ZPL) 发射率（43.9 MHz）和 11.8% 的 ZPL 量子效率。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 研究了块状六角金刚石中的本征色心作为基于光纤的量子通信的潜在发射器。混合密度泛函理论和约束占据 Delta SCF 计算确定了五种具有稳定光学激发态的碳空位和双空位构型。在三点构型坐标模型中比较它们的辐射和非辐射特性，确定带正电的轴向双空位 VVa1+ 是最有希望的候选者。在五种候选产品中，它表现出最高的计算零声子线 (ZPL) 发射率（43.9 MHz）和 11.8% 的 ZPL 量子效率。其弱结构弛豫产生 0.395 的 Huang-Rhys 因子，而多模光致发光计算得出的 Debye-Waller 因子为 69.37%，表明零声子贡献占主导地位。预测的 ZPL 为 0.603 eV（2057.3 nm），在候选目标中，与 1310 和 1550 nm 电信目标的光子能量分离也是最小的。这些结果表明，VVa1+ 是基于光纤的量子通信的一个有前途的固有色心，量子频率上转换提供了从其强红外 ZPL 到电信 O 和 C 波段的路线。

articles.title: Electronic Origin of Contrasting Li and Na Clustering on Graphene
articles.title_zh: 石墨烯上锂和钠对比团簇的电子起源
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.13798v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The electrochemical performance of anode materials is often defined by the ability of metal ions (e.g., Li and Na) to be effectively stored within the host material over a specific range of chemical potentials. This is particularly true for adsorbed Li and Na atoms on carbon surfaces (e.g., graphite or pore surfaces in hard carbon), where the interplay between ionic and metallic bonding often takes place - while metal atoms act as ionic species, in a finite concentration limit, they tend to form metallic bonding when they approach each other. What makes the case special is that, despite similar chemical identities, Li and Na atoms exhibit distinct tendencies for cluster formation; for example, the formation of Li metallic clusters on a graphene surface is only thermodynamically favorable after reaching a finite metal-ion concentration. Motivated by this, herein, we use first-principles calculations on graphene to examine the electronic origin of Li and Na clustering. Specifically, we demonstrate that the separated adsorbed atoms donate electrons to graphene, shifting the Fermi level to higher energies; however, the formation of metal clusters can result in the formation of lower-energy orbitals that are specifically associated with metal-metal bonding, thus lowering the Fermi level (and hence total energies). Importantly, while the process is somewhat similar for Na and Li atoms, the energy levels of the newly formed metallic states govern the difference in metallic cluster formation between Li and Na.
articles.abstract_zh: 阳极材料的电化学性能通常由金属离子（例如Li和Na）在特定化学势范围内有效储存在主体材料内的能力来定义。对于碳表面（例如石墨或硬碳中的孔隙表面）上吸附的锂和钠原子来说尤其如此，其中离子键和金属键之间经常发生相互作用 - 虽然金属原子充当离子物种，但在有限的浓度限制下，它们在彼此接近时往往会形成金属键。该案例的特殊之处在于，尽管化学特性相似，Li 和 Na 原子却表现出不同的簇形成倾向。例如，只有在达到有限的金属离子浓度后，石墨烯表面上锂金属簇的形成才在热力学上有利。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 阳极材料的电化学性能通常由金属离子（例如Li和Na）在特定化学势范围内有效储存在主体材料内的能力来定义。对于碳表面（例如石墨或硬碳中的孔隙表面）上吸附的锂和钠原子来说尤其如此，其中离子键和金属键之间经常发生相互作用 - 虽然金属原子充当离子物种，但在有限的浓度限制下，它们在彼此接近时往往会形成金属键。该案例的特殊之处在于，尽管化学特性相似，Li 和 Na 原子却表现出不同的簇形成倾向。例如，只有在达到有限的金属离子浓度后，石墨烯表面上锂金属簇的形成才在热力学上有利。受此启发，我们在本文中使用石墨烯的第一性原理计算来研究Li和Na聚集的电子起源。具体来说，我们证明了分离的吸附原子向石墨烯提供电子，将费米能级转移到更高的能量；然而，金属簇的形成可能导致形成与金属-金属键合相关的低能轨道，从而降低费米能级（从而降低总能量）。重要的是，虽然钠和锂原子的过程有些相似，但新形成的金属态的能级决定了锂和钠之间金属簇形成的差异。

articles.title: Structural and electronic properties of (Hf,Zr)O₂ phases from first principles
articles.title_zh: 根据第一原理得出 (Hf,Zr)O2 相的结构和电子特性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.13817v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: (Hf,Zr)O₂ material system is promising for ferroelectric devices, owing to their compatibility with the existing electronics manufacturing processes. Technology computer-aided design (TCAD) simulations can be used for the device design and optimization, but the predictive power of TCAD device simulations depends on the quality of the material parameters. These are still surprisingly poorly understood, also for the metastable ferroelectric phase, largely owing to the difficulties in synthesizing phase-pure samples. Here, we carry out high-quality first-principles calculations to extract reliable lattice parameters, dielectric constants, and band gaps for six of the most common phases of HfO₂, Hf₀.₅Zr₀.₅O₂, and ZrO₂. We compare results from GGA, meta-GGA, and hybrid functionals to shed light on the sensitivity of the results on the level of theory and to connect the results to earlier literature. In the case of band structures, we also consider GW corrections as well as the effects of temperature-induced band gap renormalization and excitonic effects. Finally, we use these results in TCAD simulations for (Hf,Zr)O₂ FeCAP to demonstrate the effect that non-ferroelectric interlayers could have on the hysteresis curves and band diagrams.
articles.abstract_zh: (Hf,Zr)O2 材料系统由于与现有电子制造工艺兼容，因此在铁电器件方面具有广阔的前景。技术计算机辅助设计（TCAD）模拟可用于器件设计和优化，但TCAD器件模拟的预测能力取决于材料参数的质量。令人惊讶的是，人们对亚稳态铁电相的了解仍然知之甚少，这主要是由于合成纯相样品的困难。在这里，我们进行高质量的第一性原理计算，以提取 HfO2、Hf₀.₅Zr₀.₅O2 和 ZrO2 六种最常见相的可靠晶格参数、介电常数和带隙。
articles.abstract_zh_full: (Hf,Zr)O2 材料系统由于与现有电子制造工艺兼容，因此在铁电器件方面具有广阔的前景。技术计算机辅助设计（TCAD）模拟可用于器件设计和优化，但TCAD器件模拟的预测能力取决于材料参数的质量。令人惊讶的是，人们对亚稳态铁电相的了解仍然知之甚少，这主要是由于合成纯相样品的困难。在这里，我们进行高质量的第一性原理计算，以提取 HfO2、Hf₀.₅Zr₀.₅O2 和 ZrO2 六种最常见相的可靠晶格参数、介电常数和带隙。我们比较了 GGA、元 GGA 和混合泛函的结果，以阐明结果在理论层面的敏感性，并将结果与早期文献联系起来。在能带结构的情况下，我们还考虑引力场修正以及温度引起的带隙重正化和激子效应的影响。最后，我们在 (Hf,Zr)O2 FeCAP 的 TCAD 模拟中使用这些结果来证明非铁电中间层对磁滞曲线和能带图的影响。

articles.title: Hierarchical Topological Protection and Subsymmetry-Driven Edge-State Switching
articles.title_zh: 分层拓扑保护和亚对称驱动的边缘状态切换
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.13839v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We reveal a hierarchy of topological protection in which multiple symmetries and their reduced forms provide distinct mechanisms for protecting topological edge states. In Hermitian Hamiltonians obtained by doubling chiral non-Hermitian systems, a structural and an inherited chiral symmetry provide complementary channels of topological protection. By selectively breaking either symmetry, we demonstrate their distinct roles in protecting edge zero modes, establishing different levels of protection under symmetry reduction. Remarkably, even when both full chiral symmetries are broken, fixed subsymmetry constraints allow the protected zero-mode configurations to switch between opposite edges and change in number across the topological phase boundaries of the symmetry-unbroken system. Our results establish a hierarchical framework for topological protection, revealing a route to controlling edge-state configurations via reduced symmetry constraints.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们揭示了拓扑保护的层次结构，其中多重对称性及其简化形式为保护拓扑边缘状态提供了独特的机制。在通过加倍手性非厄米系统获得的厄米哈密顿量中，结构对称性和继承的手性对称性提供了拓扑保护的互补通道。通过选择性地破坏任一对称性，我们展示了它们在保护边缘零模式、在对称性降低下建立不同级别的保护方面的独特作用。值得注意的是，即使当两个完全手性对称性都被破坏时，固定的亚对称约束也允许受保护的零模式配置在相对边缘之间切换，并在对称性未破坏系统的拓扑相边界上改变数量。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们揭示了拓扑保护的层次结构，其中多重对称性及其简化形式为保护拓扑边缘状态提供了独特的机制。在通过加倍手性非厄米系统获得的厄米哈密顿量中，结构对称性和继承的手性对称性提供了拓扑保护的互补通道。通过选择性地破坏任一对称性，我们展示了它们在保护边缘零模式、在对称性降低下建立不同级别的保护方面的独特作用。值得注意的是，即使当两个完全手性对称性都被破坏时，固定的亚对称约束也允许受保护的零模式配置在相对边缘之间切换，并在对称性未破坏系统的拓扑相边界上改变数量。我们的结果建立了拓扑保护的分层框架，揭示了通过减少对称约束来控制边缘状态配置的途径。

articles.title: Orchestr.AI: A Unified Workflow for Training and Benchmarking of Machine-Learned Interatomic Potentials
articles.title_zh: Orchestr.AI：用于机器学习原子间势的训练和基准测试的统一工作流程
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.13898v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Machine-learning force fields enable atomistic simulations at near-reference accuracy and substantially reduced computational cost, but their development remains fragmented across software frameworks with incompatible data formats, configuration schemes, dependencies, and execution procedures. Orchestr.AI addresses this limitation through a unified workflow that coordinates different MLIP software frameworks, referred to as engines, for data preparation, model training, fine-tuning, evaluation, and deployment. A common YAML interface defines each experiment, while engine-specific environment profiles preserve compatible software stacks and avoid dependency conflicts. The platform currently supports five MLIP model architectures, namely SchNet, PaiNN, NequIP, Allegro, and MACE, through their corresponding software implementations, providing automated configuration mapping and standardized dataset handling across these frameworks. Benchmarks on the rMD17 and 3BPA datasets show that Orchestr.AI reproduces the expected performance trends while enabling controlled cross-engine comparisons. Repeated executions with fixed configurations and engine profiles produce highly consistent results, demonstrating practical workflow reproducibility. Beyond training, Orchestr.AI provides modular architectural interfaces that connect trained models to ASE-based simulations, batch inference, epistemic uncertainty estimation, calibration, and active-learning workflows. The platform therefore provides a reproducible and extensible infrastructure for developing, comparing, and deploying machine-learning interatomic potentials, which we validate here through cross-engine accuracy and repeatability benchmarks.
articles.abstract_zh: 机器学习力场能够以接近参考的精度进行原子模拟，并大大降低了计算成本，但它们的开发仍然分散在软件框架中，数据格式、配置方案、依赖性和执行过程不兼容。 Orchestr.AI 通过统一的工作流程解决了这一限制，该工作流程协调不同的 MLIP 软件框架（称为引擎），用于数据准备、模型训练、微调、评估和部署。通用的 YAML 接口定义每个实验，而特定于引擎的环境配置文件保留兼容的软件堆栈并避免依赖冲突。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 机器学习力场能够以接近参考的精度进行原子模拟，并大大降低了计算成本，但它们的开发仍然分散在软件框架中，数据格式、配置方案、依赖性和执行过程不兼容。 Orchestr.AI 通过统一的工作流程解决了这一限制，该工作流程协调不同的 MLIP 软件框架（称为引擎），用于数据准备、模型训练、微调、评估和部署。通用的 YAML 接口定义每个实验，而特定于引擎的环境配置文件保留兼容的软件堆栈并避免依赖冲突。该平台目前通过相应的软件实现支持五种MLIP模型架构，即SchNet、PaiNN、NequIP、Allegro和MACE，提供跨这些框架的自动化配置映射和标准化数据集处理。 rMD17 和 3BPA 数据集的基准测试表明，Orchestr.AI 再现了预期的性能趋势，同时实现了受控的跨引擎比较。使用固定配置和发动机配置文件重复执行可产生高度一致的结果，展示了实际工作流程的可重复性。除了训练之外，Orchestr.AI 还提供模块化架构接口，将训练后的模型连接到基于 ASE 的模拟、批量推理、认知不确定性估计、校准和主动学习工作流程。因此，该平台提供了一个可重复和可扩展的基础设施，用于开发、比较和部署机器学习原子间势，我们在这里通过跨引擎准确性和可重复性基准对其进行验证。

articles.title: Chiral magnon Kerr interaction from linear and nonlinear Meissner screening in ferromagnet--superconductor bilayers
articles.title_zh: 铁磁体-超导双层中线性和非线性迈斯纳筛选的手性磁振子克尔相互作用
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.13937v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Magnon Kerr interaction showing a dependence of magnon dispersion frequency on its population is a useful functionality for nonlinear and quantum magnonics; its strength and sign depend on magnetic anisotropy, bias, and mode geometry. We here propose to use a superconducting gate to tune the Kerr interaction of magnons in ferromagnetic insulators. Even when the superconductor responds linearly, the frequency shift induced by its reflected dipolar field depends on the longitudinal magnetization. The decrease of this magnetization with increasing precession amplitude therefore produces a Kerr contribution. We go beyond this linear Meissner-screening regime by showing that at finite excitation amplitude, the significant Meissner screening currents reduce the superfluid stiffness, thus enhancing the effective magnetic-field penetration and rendering the Meissner backaction amplitude dependent. This superflow-induced pair breaking adds a second Kerr contribution, controlled by the interfacial superflow relative to the nonlinear screening scale. For yttrium iron garnet gated by dirty niobium, we predict a significant renormalization of the Kerr effect by superconductors, with the resulting Kerr contribution strongly chiral in the Damon--Eshbach configuration. By showing that the linear and nonlinear Meissner screening to the Kerr interaction can be distinguished by varying temperature, our work establishes a route to directional control of magnon nonlinear interactions.
articles.abstract_zh: 磁振子克尔相互作用显示磁振子色散频率与其布居数的相关性，对于非线性和量子磁振子学来说是一个有用的功能；其强度和符号取决于磁各向异性、偏置和模式几何形状。我们在这里建议使用超导门来调节铁磁绝缘体中磁振子的克尔相互作用。即使超导体线性响应，其反射偶极场引起的频移也取决于纵向磁化强度。因此，随着进动幅度的增加，磁化强度会降低，从而产生克尔贡献。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 磁振子克尔相互作用显示磁振子色散频率与其布居数的相关性，对于非线性和量子磁振子学来说是一个有用的功能；其强度和符号取决于磁各向异性、偏置和模式几何形状。我们在这里建议使用超导门来调节铁磁绝缘体中磁振子的克尔相互作用。即使超导体线性响应，其反射偶极场引起的频移也取决于纵向磁化强度。因此，随着进动幅度的增加，磁化强度会降低，从而产生克尔贡献。我们超越了这种线性迈斯纳屏蔽机制，表明在有限的激励幅度下，显着的迈斯纳屏蔽电流降低了超流体刚度，从而增强了有效磁场穿透并使迈斯纳反作用幅度依赖。这种超流引起的对断裂增加了第二个克尔贡献，该贡献由相对于非线性筛选尺度的界面超流控制。对于由脏铌门控的钇铁石榴石，我们预测超导体对克尔效应的显着重整化，由此产生的克尔贡献在达蒙-埃什巴赫配置中具有强手性。通过证明克尔相互作用的线性和非线性迈斯纳筛选可以通过改变温度来区分，我们的工作建立了磁振子非线性相互作用的定向控制途径。

articles.title: Analytic Two-Radius Model for the Zero-Shear and High-Frequency Viscosity of Colloidal Suspensions
articles.title_zh: 胶体悬浮液零剪切和高频粘度的解析双半径模型
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.13982v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Nearly hard-sphere colloids are stabilized by short-range repulsions that set their effective size and equilibrium microstructure. Their hydrodynamic interactions, in contrast, are set by the no-slip surface. Since these two do not necessarily coincide, there are potentially two effective radii that control their dynamics in different ways. Yet it is commonplace to model and analyze such suspensions with a single effective radius, which merges these different physics. Two-radius models, in which a hard, solvent-permeable shell surrounds a no-slip core, have been proposed to improve the description of these suspensions. Their rheology is known exactly at pair level, but at higher concentrations their zero-shear viscosity has been obtained only with semi-empirical expressions, which do not recover the exact pair result. Here, we close this gap with a theory for the zero-shear and high-frequency viscosity of these two-radius models. By keeping pairs out of near contact, the shell lowers the high-frequency viscosity, as our Stokesian dynamics simulations confirm, and shifts the zero-shear viscosity from hydrodynamic toward thermodynamic stress. We apply our theory to experiments on charge- and sterically stabilized colloids from the literature and find that it accurately describes the measured viscosities. We discuss the benefits of fitting data to a two-radius model compared to a single-radius one. To facilitate this fitting in future work, closed-form expressions are provided that cover the full range of shell thicknesses and volume fractions.
articles.abstract_zh: 近乎硬球的胶体通过短程排斥来稳定，从而设定其有效尺寸和平衡微观结构。相反，它们的流体动力相互作用是由防滑表面决定的。由于这两者不一定重合，因此可能有两个有效半径以不同的方式控制它们的动态。然而，用单一有效半径对这种悬架进行建模和分析是很常见的，它融合了这些不同的物理原理。人们提出了双半径模型，其中硬的、溶剂可渗透的壳包围着防滑核，以改进对这些悬浮液的描述。它们的流变学在对水平上是准确已知的，但在较高浓度下，它们的零剪切粘度只能通过半经验表达式获得，这不能恢复精确的对结果。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 近乎硬球的胶体通过短程排斥来稳定，从而设定其有效尺寸和平衡微观结构。相反，它们的流体动力相互作用是由防滑表面决定的。由于这两者不一定重合，因此可能有两个有效半径以不同的方式控制它们的动态。然而，用单一有效半径对这种悬架进行建模和分析是很常见的，它融合了这些不同的物理原理。人们提出了双半径模型，其中硬的、溶剂可渗透的壳包围着防滑核，以改进对这些悬浮液的描述。它们的流变学在对水平上是准确已知的，但在较高浓度下，它们的零剪切粘度只能通过半经验表达式获得，这不能恢复精确的对结果。在这里，我们用这些双半径模型的零剪切和高频粘度理论来缩小这一差距。正如我们的斯托克斯动力学模拟所证实的那样，通过保持对不接近接触，壳降低了高频粘度，并将零剪切粘度从流体力学应力转变为热力学应力。我们将我们的理论应用于文献中电荷和空间稳定胶体的实验，发现它准确地描述了测量的粘度。我们讨论与单半径模型相比，将数据拟合到两半径模型的好处。为了便于在未来的工作中进行这种拟合，提供了涵盖所有壳厚度和体积分数的封闭式表达式。

articles.title: Evidence of anomalous Hall crystals in moiré rhombohedral graphene
articles.title_zh: 莫尔菱形石墨烯中异常霍尔晶体的证据
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.14067v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: An anomalous Hall crystal (AHC) is a quantum state of matter, in which spontaneous electron crystallization leads to a quantized Hall effect without a magnetic field. The state can emerge in materials with strong Coulomb interaction and large Berry curvatures, such as few-layer rhombohedral graphene. Although the idea of AHCs has been invoked to explain some of the observed Chern insulators in moiré rhombohedral graphene (mRG), direct experimental evidence of AHCs has been missing so far. Here, we report experimental evidence of AHCs in hole-doped mRG through combined electrical transport and noise measurements. We identify a series of distinct Chern insulators spanning a broad and continuous range of doping densities incommensurate with the underlying moiré lattice; the states exhibit current-induced broadband noise and memory effects as well as pronounced gate hysteresis. Systematic magnetic field, temperature and gate dependence studies further support the emergence of a spontaneously charge-ordered state that acts as a parental state for the observed Chern insulators. The absence of Chern insulators at nearby integer fillings also distinguishes the observed state from the reported reentrant or extended quantum (anomalous) Hall states. Altogether, our results establish experimental evidence of AHCs in mRG and open the door for further exploration of the collective dynamics in this new state of matter.
articles.abstract_zh: 反常霍尔晶体（AHC）是一种物质的量子态，其中自发电子结晶会在没有磁场的情况下产生量子化霍尔效应。这种状态可以出现在具有强库仑相互作用和大贝里曲率的材料中，例如少层菱面体石墨烯。尽管 AHC 的概念已被用来解释莫尔菱形石墨烯 (mRG) 中观察到的一些陈绝缘体，但迄今为止，AHC 的直接实验证据一直缺失。在这里，我们通过结合电传输和噪声测量报告了空穴掺杂 mRG 中 AHC 的实验证据。我们确定了一系列不同的陈绝缘体，其掺杂密度范围广泛且连续，与底层的莫尔晶格不相称；
articles.abstract_zh_full: 反常霍尔晶体（AHC）是一种物质的量子态，其中自发电子结晶会在没有磁场的情况下产生量子化霍尔效应。这种状态可以出现在具有强库仑相互作用和大贝里曲率的材料中，例如少层菱面体石墨烯。尽管 AHC 的概念已被用来解释莫尔菱形石墨烯 (mRG) 中观察到的一些陈绝缘体，但迄今为止，AHC 的直接实验证据一直缺失。在这里，我们通过结合电传输和噪声测量报告了空穴掺杂 mRG 中 AHC 的实验证据。我们确定了一系列不同的陈绝缘体，其掺杂密度范围广泛且连续，与底层的莫尔晶格不相称；这些状态表现出电流引起的宽带噪声和记忆效应以及明显的栅极磁滞。系统磁场、温度和栅极依赖性研究进一步支持自发电荷有序态的出现，该态充当观察到的陈绝缘体的母态。附近整数填充处不存在陈绝缘体也将观察到的状态与报告的重入或扩展量子（反常）霍尔状态区分开来。总而言之，我们的结果建立了 mRG 中 AHC 的实验证据，并为进一步探索这种新物质状态的集体动力学打开了大门。

articles.title: Local electronic structure of the Co2+ ions in the disordered perovskite phase of Ba3CoNb2O9: a temperature-dependent X-ray absorption and magnetic circular dichroism study
articles.title_zh: Ba3CoNb2O9 无序钙钛矿相中 Co2+ 离子的局域电子结构：温度依赖性 X 射线吸收和磁圆二色性研究
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.14072v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We performed temperature-dependent X-ray absorption spectroscopy (XAS) and X-ray magnetic circular dichroism (XMCD) measurements on the disordered phase of Ba₃CoNb₂O₉ to determine the local electronic structure of the Co²⁺ ions. We employed the line-fitting inverse partial fluorescence yield (iPFY) method to obtain reliable spectra from this insulating material. From the comparison between the experimental spectra and full multiplet cluster calculations we were able to constrain the local crystal-field environment and assess the spin-orbit-entangled nature of the Co²⁺ ground state. In this chemically disordered system, the Co²⁺ ions retain on average an effectively cubic crystal-field environment that supports a J_eff = 1/2 ground state. These results further establish that Ba₃CoNb₂O₉ is a promising platform for investigating the effect of disorder on J_eff = 1/2 magnetism.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们对 Ba₃CoNb2O₉ 的无序相进行了温度依赖性 X 射线吸收光谱 (XAS) 和 X 射线磁圆二色性 (XMCD) 测量，以确定 Co2+ 离子的局域电子结构。我们采用线拟合逆部分荧光产率（iPFY）方法从这种绝缘材料中获得可靠的光谱。通过比较实验光谱和完整的多重态簇计算，我们能够限制局部晶体场环境并评估 Co²⁺ 基态的自旋轨道纠缠性质。在这个化学无序系统中，Co²⁺ 离子平均保留有效的立方晶体场环境，支持 J_eff = 1/2 基态。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们对 Ba₃CoNb2O₉ 的无序相进行了温度依赖性 X 射线吸收光谱 (XAS) 和 X 射线磁圆二色性 (XMCD) 测量，以确定 Co2+ 离子的局域电子结构。我们采用线拟合逆部分荧光产率（iPFY）方法从这种绝缘材料中获得可靠的光谱。通过比较实验光谱和完整的多重态簇计算，我们能够限制局部晶体场环境并评估 Co²⁺ 基态的自旋轨道纠缠性质。在这个化学无序系统中，Co²⁺ 离子平均保留有效的立方晶体场环境，支持 J_eff = 1/2 基态。这些结果进一步证实 Ba₃CoNb2O₉ 是研究无序对 J_eff = 1/2 磁性影响的有前途的平台。

articles.title: Particle-hole asymmetry and a fluctuating pair-density-wave state in a lightly doped Mott insulator on the square lattice
articles.title_zh: 方晶格上轻掺杂莫特绝缘体中的粒子孔不对称性和波动对密度波态
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.14101v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Whether a lightly doped Mott insulator on the square lattice supports robust d-wave superconductivity remains a central question in strongly correlated physics and in the microscopic theory of cuprate superconductivity. Experiments and numerical studies reveal a pronounced particle-hole asymmetry, pointing to a delicate competition among d-wave superconductivity, pair-density wave (PDW), stripe, charge-density wave (CDW), and antiferromagnetic correlations. Here we combine large-scale DMRG and finite-size PEPS to study the square-lattice t-J model at low doping, δ ≤ 0.1, while tuning the next-nearest-neighbor hopping t' from the electron-like (t'>0) to the hole-like (t'<0) regime. The electron-like side supports robust, nearly uniform d-wave pairing, whereas decreasing t' induces a period-two plaquette modulation and ultimately produces, on the hole-like side, a charge-dominated state with a strongly suppressed static pairing amplitude. DMRG calculations on open strips and squares, together with PEPS calculations on open squares up to 16×16 sites, support this evolution. On squares with C₄-symmetric Hamiltonians, both methods find that the pair correlations of the hole-like state select the plaquette momenta (π,0) and (0,π) and decay within a few lattice spacings, while the dominant charge-density modulation forms a bidirectional checkerboard whose period extrapolates to about 4a₀, close to that observed in lightly doped Bi-2201. These observations establish a fluctuating plaquette PDW in the lightly doped hole-like regime, in which local pairs carry finite momentum but lack phase coherence. Our results firmly establish particle-hole asymmetry as a central organizing principle for competing pairing tendencies in the lightly doped t-J model.
articles.abstract_zh: 方形晶格上的轻掺杂莫特绝缘体是否支持鲁棒的 d 波超导仍然是强相关物理学和铜酸盐超导微观理论的中心问题。实验和数值研究揭示了明显的粒子空穴不对称性，表明 d 波超导性、对密度波 (PDW)、条纹、电荷密度波 (CDW) 和反铁磁相关性之间存在微妙的竞争。在这里，我们结合大规模 DMRG 和有限尺寸 PEPS 来研究低掺杂（δ ≤ 0.1）下的方晶格 t-J 模型，同时将近邻跳跃 t' 从类电子（t'>0）调整为类空穴（t'<0）状态。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 方形晶格上的轻掺杂莫特绝缘体是否支持鲁棒的 d 波超导仍然是强相关物理学和铜酸盐超导微观理论的中心问题。实验和数值研究揭示了明显的粒子空穴不对称性，表明 d 波超导性、对密度波 (PDW)、条纹、电荷密度波 (CDW) 和反铁磁相关性之间存在微妙的竞争。在这里，我们结合大规模 DMRG 和有限尺寸 PEPS 来研究低掺杂（δ ≤ 0.1）下的方晶格 t-J 模型，同时将近邻跳跃 t' 从类电子（t'>0）调整为类空穴（t'<0）状态。类电子侧支持稳健、几乎均匀的 d 波配对，而减少 t' 会引发二周期斑块调制，并最终在类空穴侧产生电荷主导状态，并强烈抑制静态配对幅度。对开放条带和正方形的 DMRG 计算，以及对最多 16×16 站点的开放正方形的 PEPS 计算，支持了这种演变。在具有 C₄ 对称哈密顿量的正方形上，两种方法都发现，类空穴态的配对相关性选择了斑块动量 (π,0) 和 (0,π)，并在几个晶格间距内衰减，而主要的电荷密度调制形成了一个双向棋盘，其周期外推至约 4a₀，接近于轻掺杂 Bi-2201 中观察到的情况。这些观察结果在轻掺杂类空穴区域中建立了波动的斑块 PDW，其中局部对携带有限的动量但缺乏相位相干性。我们的结果牢固地确立了粒子-空穴不对称性作为轻掺杂 t-J 模型中竞争配对趋势的中心组织原则。

articles.title: Spin-glass order in a field requires magnetic-field chaos in XY gauge glasses for d≤ 4
articles.title_zh: 场中的自旋玻璃序要求 XY 规玻璃中的磁场混沌，d≤ 4
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.14109v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The XY gauge-glass model is believed to exhibit a spin-glass phase in dimensions d≥ 3. In this paper, we prove that, in dimensions d≤ 4 and at any finite temperature, a magnetic field applied in a fixed direction, with amplitudes that fluctuate from site to site according to the Rayleigh distribution, must either induce magnetic-field chaos in the spin-glass phase or destroy spin-glass order altogether, whenever a spin-glass phase exists at zero field. In particular, if a spin-glass phase persists under such a field, as predicted by the replica-symmetry-breaking (RSB) picture, it must exhibit magnetic-field chaos. This conclusion follows from our proof that, for any fixed nonzero field strength, the disorder average of the squared overlap between equilibrium spin configurations at zero field and those at nonzero field vanishes in the thermodynamic limit. By gauge transformations, the overlap statistics are identical to the magnetization statistics of an XY gauge glass with correlated bond disorder in a Gaussian random field. Our proof combines this exact identity with quantitative estimates on the suppression of ferromagnetic order by random fields in continuous-spin systems, due to Dario, Harel, and Peled [Commun. Math. Phys. 405, 212 (2024)] and building on the work of Imry and Ma [Phys. Rev. Lett. 35, 1399 (1975)] and of Aizenman and Wehr [Phys. Rev. Lett. 62, 2503 (1989); Commun. Math. Phys. 130, 489 (1990)]. We extend these estimates to bond-dependent interactions. Although our result provides a rare rigorous constraint on the nature of spin-glass phases in finite-dimensional systems, it does not determine whether spin-glass order survives in a field, and therefore does not distinguish between the droplet and RSB pictures. The case of a strictly uniform field remains open.
articles.abstract_zh: XY 规矩玻璃模型被认为表现出尺寸为 d≥ 3 的自旋玻璃相。在本文中，我们证明，在尺寸 d≤ 4 和任何有限温度下，只要在零场存在自旋玻璃相，在固定方向上施加磁场，其幅度根据瑞利分布从一个位置到另一个位置波动，必须在自旋玻璃相中引起磁场混沌或完全破坏自旋玻璃顺序。特别是，如果自旋玻璃相在这样的场下持续存在，正如复制对称破缺（RSB）图所预测的那样，它一定会表现出磁场混沌。
articles.abstract_zh_full: XY 规矩玻璃模型被认为表现出尺寸为 d≥ 3 的自旋玻璃相。在本文中，我们证明，在尺寸 d≤ 4 和任何有限温度下，只要在零场存在自旋玻璃相，在固定方向上施加磁场，其幅度根据瑞利分布从一个位置到另一个位置波动，必须在自旋玻璃相中引起磁场混沌或完全破坏自旋玻璃顺序。特别是，如果自旋玻璃相在这样的场下持续存在，正如复制对称破缺（RSB）图所预测的那样，它一定会表现出磁场混沌。这个结论来自我们的证明，即对于任何固定的非零场强，零场和非零场的平衡自旋构型之间的平方重叠的无序平均值在热力学极限中消失。通过规范变换，重叠统计量与高斯随机场中具有相关键无序的 XY 规范玻璃的磁化强度统计量相同。我们的证明将这种精确的同一性与连续自旋系统中随机场对铁磁有序的抑制的定量估计结合起来，这归功于 Dario、Harel 和 Peled [Commun.数学。物理。 405, 212 (2024)] 并以 Imry 和 Ma 的工作为基础 [Phys. 405, 212 (2024)]莱特牧师。 35, 1399 (1975)] 以及 Aizenman 和 Wehr [Phys.莱特牧师。 62、2503（1989）；交流。数学。物理。 130, 489 (1990)]。我们将这些估计扩展到依赖键的相互作用。尽管我们的结果对有限维系统中自旋玻璃相的性质提供了罕见的严格约束，但它并不能确定自旋玻璃序是否在场中存在，因此不能区分液滴和RSB图片。严格统一场的情况仍然悬而未决。

articles.title: End-state-assisted tunneling at a topological insulator STM tip
articles.title_zh: 拓扑绝缘体 STM 尖端的终态辅助隧道效应
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.14155v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Recent spin-sensitive scanning tunneling experiments with topological-insulator tips motivate a microscopic understanding of how tip geometry controls current delivery. We show that topological end states mediate resonant tunneling through the gap opened by interedge hybridization in a quantum spin Hall tip. An asymmetric termination gives oppositely spin-polarized helical paths unequal effective lengths and resonance widths. Within an independent-path description, their transmitted-current imbalance vanishes at a matched resonance and becomes finite away from it. Coupling these directional channels to a d-wave altermagnet yields a spin-dependent interference contrast. Hybridized end states along a stepped termination provide multiple tunneling resonances. Our results establish end-state-mediated tunneling as a transport mechanism for STM with strongly confined topological tips.
articles.abstract_zh: 最近使用拓扑绝缘体尖端进行的自旋敏感扫描隧道实验激发了人们对尖端几何形状如何控制电流传输的微观理解。我们表明，拓扑端态通过量子自旋霍尔尖端中边缘杂化所打开的间隙介导共振隧道效应。不对称终端给出相反的自旋极化螺旋路径不相等的有效长度和共振宽度。在独立路径描述中，它们的传输电流不平衡在匹配谐振处消失，并在远离匹配谐振时变得有限。将这些定向通道耦合到 d 波交流磁体会产生自旋相关的干涉对比。沿着阶梯终端的混合端态提供了多个隧道共振。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 最近使用拓扑绝缘体尖端进行的自旋敏感扫描隧道实验激发了人们对尖端几何形状如何控制电流传输的微观理解。我们表明，拓扑端态通过量子自旋霍尔尖端中边缘杂化所打开的间隙介导共振隧道效应。不对称终端给出相反的自旋极化螺旋路径不相等的有效长度和共振宽度。在独立路径描述中，它们的传输电流不平衡在匹配谐振处消失，并在远离匹配谐振时变得有限。将这些定向通道耦合到 d 波交流磁体会产生自旋相关的干涉对比。沿着阶梯终端的混合端态提供了多个隧道共振。我们的结果将最终状态介导的隧道效应确立为具有强限制拓扑尖端的 STM 的传输机制。

articles.title: Thermodynamic signatures of a nearby quantum critical endpoint in UTe₂ under intense magnetic field
articles.title_zh: 强磁场下 UTe2 中附近量子临界端点的热力学特征
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.14185v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Several unconventional superconducting phases have been discovered in the vicinity of metamagnetism in the heavy-fermion paramagnet UTe₂ under magnetic field. To describe the mechanism of magnetic-field-induced superconductivity, a challenge is to characterize the quantum critical magnetic properties at the metamagnetic transition. In this work, we investigate the thermodynamic properties of UTe₂ under magnetic fields up to 60~T applied in the crystallographic b-c plane. Magnetization and magnetostriction experiments have been performed under magnetic fields tilted by an angle θlesssim42^circ from b toward c. They support that a quantum critical endpoint at the field angle θQCEPsimeq(70±10)^circ and magnetic field μ₀HQCEPsimeq(75±10)~T terminates the metamagnetic transition line. A pseudo-gap in the magnetic susceptibility is related with the metamagnetic transition observed in magnetic fields for θ<θQCEP. The possible relation between the quantum critical endpoint and the development of magnetic-field-induced superconductivity is discussed.
articles.abstract_zh: 在磁场下的重费米子顺磁体 UTe2 的超磁性附近发现了几个非常规超导相。为了描述磁场诱发超导的机制，一个挑战是表征变磁转变时的量子临界磁特性。在这项工作中，我们研究了在晶体 b-c 平面施加高达 60~T 的磁场下 UTe₂ 的热力学性质。磁化和磁致伸缩实验是在从 b 向 c 倾斜角度 θlesssim42^circ 的磁场下进行的。他们支持场角 θQCEPsimeq(70±10)^circ 和磁场 μ₀HQCEPsimeq(75±10)~T 处的量子临界端点终止变磁转变线。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在磁场下的重费米子顺磁体 UTe2 的超磁性附近发现了几个非常规超导相。为了描述磁场诱发超导的机制，一个挑战是表征变磁转变时的量子临界磁特性。在这项工作中，我们研究了在晶体 b-c 平面施加高达 60~T 的磁场下 UTe₂ 的热力学性质。磁化和磁致伸缩实验是在从 b 向 c 倾斜角度 θlesssim42^circ 的磁场下进行的。他们支持场角 θQCEPsimeq(70±10)^circ 和磁场 μ₀HQCEPsimeq(75±10)~T 处的量子临界端点终止变磁转变线。磁化率中的赝带隙与在 θ<θQCEP 的磁场中观察到的变磁转变有关。讨论了量子临界端点与磁场诱发超导发展之间可能的关系。

articles.title: The Multiscale Principle in phase transition: Geometric structure, thermodynamic entropy, and dynamical instability
articles.title_zh: 相变中的多尺度原理：几何结构、热力学熵和动力学不稳定性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.14230v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Scaling and multi-scaling are two guiding principles for understanding nature or even commerce and industrial outcome. In the realm of critical phenomena, scaling laws describe the behavior of physical quantities near a continuous phase transition. This is a complex phenomena where systems exhibit critical fluctuations and long-range correlations, challenging classical formulations such as the fluctuation-dissipation theorem (FDT). In particular, near critical points, the divergence of the correlation length and the emergence of fractal geometry in spin clusters suggest the need for alternative frameworks. In this work, we explore the connection between critical exponents, fractal dimensions, and the thermodynamic formalism known as the Principium Luxuriae. By linking the thermodynamic fractal dimension D to the correlation length and entropy variations, we reinterpret energy dissipation in terms of multiscale processes. This approach allows us to reproduce effective scaling tendencies associated with the critical behavior of the 2d Ising model and provides new insight into how systems redistribute energy macroscopically during phase transitions. Furthermore, we demonstrate that the decrease in D near the critical temperature marks a transition toward macroscopic coherence, where the system begins to dissipate energy across its entire scale. This unified behavior, however, induces a heightened sensitivity to perturbations, where local fluctuations are transmitted globally through the fractal network. This mechanism establishes a direct bridge between geometric structure, thermodynamic entropy, and the onset of dynamical instability (chaos) as the system approaches criticality.
articles.abstract_zh: 尺度化和多尺度化是理解自然甚至商业和工业成果的两个指导原则。在临界现象领域，标度定律描述了连续相变附近物理量的行为。这是一种复杂的现象，系统表现出临界波动和长程相关性，对波动耗散定理 (FDT) 等经典公式提出了挑战。特别是，在临界点附近，相关长度的发散以及自旋簇中分形几何的出现表明需要替代框架。在这项工作中，我们探索了临界指数、分形维数和被称为“奢华原理”的热力学形式之间的联系。通过将热力学分形维数 D 与相关长度和熵变化联系起来，我们重新解释了多尺度过程的能量耗散。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 尺度化和多尺度化是理解自然甚至商业和工业成果的两个指导原则。在临界现象领域，标度定律描述了连续相变附近物理量的行为。这是一种复杂的现象，系统表现出临界波动和长程相关性，对波动耗散定理 (FDT) 等经典公式提出了挑战。特别是，在临界点附近，相关长度的发散以及自旋簇中分形几何的出现表明需要替代框架。在这项工作中，我们探索了临界指数、分形维数和被称为“奢华原理”的热力学形式之间的联系。通过将热力学分形维数 D 与相关长度和熵变化联系起来，我们重新解释了多尺度过程的能量耗散。这种方法使我们能够重现与 2d Ising 模型的关键行为相关的有效缩放趋势，并为系统在相变期间如何宏观地重新分配能量提供新的见解。此外，我们证明，接近临界温度时 D 的降低标志着向宏观相干性的转变，系统开始在整个尺度上耗散能量。然而，这种统一的行为导致了对扰动的高度敏感，其中局部波动通过分形网络在全球范围内传播。当系统接近临界时，这种机制在几何结构、热力学熵和动力学不稳定（混沌）的发生之间建立了直接的桥梁。

articles.title: Nonreciprocal Josephson Dynamics of a PT-Symmetric Atomtronic SQUID
articles.title_zh: PT 对称原子电子 SQUID 的非互易约瑟夫森动力学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.14291v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We investigate non-Hermitian Josephson dynamics in an atomtronic quantum interference device (AQUID), formed by a ring Bose Einstein condensate with balanced atomic gain and loss regions and two moving optical barriers. The balanced gain and loss profile establishes a parity time symmetric potential while breaking spatial inversion symmetry, providing the essential ingredients for nonreciprocal Josephson transport. The dynamics are monitored nondestructively through the phase quadrature spectrum of an optomechanical cavity driven by Laguerre Gaussian beams coupled to the condensate. We demonstrate that increasing the local gain and loss strength softens the parity time symmetric collective mode towards an exceptional point, as verified by Bogoliubov de Gennes analysis. The associated coherent population exchange produces an additional characteristic splitting in the cavity output spectrum. For linearly translating barriers, non-Hermiticity provides an additional control parameter for tuning the critical current. When the barriers undergo simultaneous translation and rotation, the rotation induced phase modifies the interference between counter propagating currents, offering further control over the nonreciprocal response. Under periodic barrier modulation, we find more pronounced Shapiro steps in the current voltage characteristics due to the intrinsic parity time symmetric collective mode. Finally, we propose an alternative Hermitian realization using a tilted optical lattice, providing an experimentally accessible route to engineering biased transport and population transfer. Our results establish parity time symmetric atomtronic SQUIDs as a versatile platform for controlling nonreciprocal Josephson transport and collective excitations in driven quantum fluids.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们研究了原子电子量子干涉装置（AQUID）中的非厄米约瑟夫森动力学，该装置由具有平衡原子增益和损失区域以及两个移动光学屏障的环形玻色爱因斯坦凝聚体形成。平衡的增益和损耗曲线建立了宇称时间对称势，同时打破了空间反演对称性，为非互易约瑟夫森输运提供了必要的成分。通过与凝聚体耦合的拉盖尔高斯光束驱动的光机械腔的相位正交谱，对动力学进行非破坏性监测。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们研究了原子电子量子干涉装置（AQUID）中的非厄米约瑟夫森动力学，该装置由具有平衡原子增益和损失区域以及两个移动光学屏障的环形玻色爱因斯坦凝聚体形成。平衡的增益和损耗曲线建立了宇称时间对称势，同时打破了空间反演对称性，为非互易约瑟夫森输运提供了必要的成分。通过与凝聚体耦合的拉盖尔高斯光束驱动的光机械腔的相位正交谱，对动力学进行非破坏性监测。我们证明，增加局部增益和损耗强度可以将宇称时间对称集体模式软化到一个特殊点，这一点已由 Bogoliubov de Gennes 分析验证。相关的相干布居交换在腔输出光谱中产生额外的特征分裂。对于线性平移势垒，非厄米性提供了用于调整临界电流的附加控制参数。当障碍物同时平移和旋转时，旋转引起的相位会改变反向传播电流之间的干扰，从而进一步控制不可逆响应。在周期性势垒调制下，由于固有奇偶校验时间对称集体模式，我们发现电流电压特性中存在更明显的夏皮罗阶跃。最后，我们提出了一种使用倾斜光学晶格的替代厄米特实现，为工程偏向运输和人口转移提供了一条实验可行的途径。我们的结果将宇称时间对称原子电子 SQUID 建立为一个通用平台，用于控制驱动量子流体中的非互易约瑟夫森输运和集体激发。

articles.title: Good Practices for Measuring the Interfacial Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya Interaction by Brillouin Light Scattering and Magneto-Optical Kerr Effect
articles.title_zh: 通过布里渊光散射和磁光克尔效应测量界面 Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya 相互作用的良好实践
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.14405v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The interfacial Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya interaction (iDMI) is a key ingredient for stabilizing chiral magnetic states, such as skyrmions and chiral domain walls, which are key building blocks for next-generation spintronic technologies. Despite its importance, the quantitative determination of the iDMI constant, D, is often plagued by significant discrepancies. This paper establishes a set of good practices for measuring iDMI using two primary techniques: Brillouin Light Scattering (BLS) and the Magneto-Optical Kerr Effect (MOKE). Through the analysis of Co/Pt-based heterostructures, this work provides a comprehensive roadmap for measurement procedures, data evaluation, and uncertainty analysis. Our analysis highlights the crucial role of magnetic parameters used to extract the iDMI constant and propagation of their uncertainties, and the measurement model for enhancing measurement reliability. The proposed methodology provides a practical framework for improving the consistency and reproducibility of iDMI measurements across different laboratories and experimental techniques.
articles.abstract_zh: Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya 界面相互作用 (iDMI) 是稳定手性磁态的关键成分，例如斯格明子和手性畴壁，它们是下一代自旋电子技术的关键构建模块。尽管 iDMI 常数 D 很重要，但其定量测定常常受到显着差异的困扰。本文建立了一套使用两种主要技术测量 iDMI 的良好实践：布里渊光散射 (BLS) 和磁光克尔效应 (MOKE)。通过对 Co/Pt 基异质结构的分析，这项工作为测量程序、数据评估和不确定性分析提供了全面的路线图。
articles.abstract_zh_full: Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya 界面相互作用 (iDMI) 是稳定手性磁态的关键成分，例如斯格明子和手性畴壁，它们是下一代自旋电子技术的关键构建模块。尽管 iDMI 常数 D 很重要，但其定量测定常常受到显着差异的困扰。本文建立了一套使用两种主要技术测量 iDMI 的良好实践：布里渊光散射 (BLS) 和磁光克尔效应 (MOKE)。通过对 Co/Pt 基异质结构的分析，这项工作为测量程序、数据评估和不确定性分析提供了全面的路线图。我们的分析强调了用于提取 iDMI 常数及其不确定性传播的磁参数的关键作用，以及用于增强测量可靠性的测量模型。所提出的方法为提高不同实验室和实验技术的 iDMI 测量的一致性和可重复性提供了一个实用的框架。

articles.title: Dimensional Crossover and Correlated Spin Dynamics in the Chain-Like van der Waals Antiferromagnet AgCrP₂S₆
articles.title_zh: 链状范德华反铁磁体 AgCrP2S₆ 中的维度交叉和相关自旋动力学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.14444v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We report a comprehensive investigation of the magnetic properties and spin dynamics of the chain-like van der Waals antiferromagnet AgCrP₂S₆ using magnetization, magnetic susceptibility, and ³¹P nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR). The magnetic susceptibility exhibits a broad maximum near 250 K, characteristic of strong short-range antiferromagnetic correlations in a low-dimensional system. A classical Fisher-chain analysis gives an effective intrachain exchange scale J/k_Bapprox 140 K, while a quantum S=3/2 nearest-neighbor-chain calculation yields J/k_Bapprox 114 K. A constrained AF-FM zig-zag-chain calculation is also compatible with the susceptibility, supporting a dominant quasi one dimensional antiferromagnetic exchange scale of order 100 K. ³¹P NMR measurements provide microscopic insight into both static and dynamic spin correlations. The K-χ relation displays two distinct linear regimes separated near T^astapprox 250 K, with different slopes indicating a change in the effective transferred hyperfine couplings. Below TN, the relaxation follows 1/T₁propto T⁵, consistent with magnon-mediated relaxation in the ordered state. The temperature dependence of the internal hyperfine field yields a critical exponent βapprox 0.36, consistent with three-dimensional universality. Together, these results establish AgCrP₂S₆ as a quasi-one-dimensional S=3/2 antiferromagnet embedded in a layered van der Waals host, in which local probes directly resolve the crossover from correlated intrachain spin dynamics to anisotropic three-dimensional magnetic order. More broadly, AgCrP₂S₆ provides a useful van der Waals platform for studying dimensional crossover, correlated spin dynamics, and hyperfine-coupling evolution in low-dimensional antiferromagnets.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们报告了使用磁化强度、磁化率和 31P 核磁共振 (NMR) 对链状范德华反铁磁体 AgCrP2S6 的磁性和自旋动力学进行的全面研究。磁化率在 250 K 附近表现出较宽的最大值，这是低维系统中强短程反铁磁相关性的特征。经典的 Fisher 链分析给出有效的链内交换尺度 J/k_Bapprox 140 K，而量子 S=3/2 最近邻链计算产生 J/k_Bapprox 114 K。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们报告了使用磁化强度、磁化率和 31P 核磁共振 (NMR) 对链状范德华反铁磁体 AgCrP2S6 的磁性和自旋动力学进行的全面研究。磁化率在 250 K 附近表现出较宽的最大值，这是低维系统中强短程反铁磁相关性的特征。经典的 Fisher 链分析给出有效的链内交换尺度 J/k_Bapprox 140 K，而量子 S=3/2 最近邻链计算产生 J/k_Bapprox 114 K。约束 AF-FM zig-zag 链计算也与磁化率兼容，支持 100 K 量级的主要准一维反铁磁交换尺度。 31P NMR 测量提供对静态和动态自旋相关性的微观洞察。 K-χ 关系显示在 T^ast 约 250 K 附近分离的两个不同的线性区域，不同的斜率表明有效转移超精细耦合的变化。在 TN 以下，弛豫遵循 1/T₁propto T5，与有序状态下磁振子介导的弛豫一致。内部超精细场的温度依赖性产生了大约 0.36 的临界指数 β，与三维普适性一致。总之，这些结果将 AgCrP2S₆ 确定为嵌入层状范德华主体中的准一维 S=3/2 反铁磁体，其中局部探针直接解决从相关链内自旋动力学到各向异性三维磁序的交叉。更广泛地说，AgCrP2S₆ 为研究低维反铁磁体中的维度交叉、相关自旋动力学和超精细耦合演化提供了一个有用的范德华平台。

articles.title: Mutual Linearity in Nonlinear Population Dynamics
articles.title_zh: 非线性总体动力学中的互线性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.14501v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Mutual Linearity in Nonlinear Population DynamicsMutual linearity, the persistence of affine relations among stationary observables under arbitrarily strong changes of one transition rate, is known for Markov jump processes and chemical reaction networks. We show that generalized Lotka--Volterra dynamics form a new class of mutually linear systems, even though species can go extinct and attractors can be chaotic. Any change to one species' equation acts on the others as one effective press and keeps all abundances affinely related: piecewise across extinctions, and as time averages on chaotic attractors.
articles.abstract_zh: 非线性总体动力学中的互线性互线性，即在一种跃迁速率的任意强烈变化下，固定可观测量之间仿射关系的持续性，以马尔可夫跳跃过程和化学反应网络而闻名。我们证明了广义的 Lotka-Volterra 动力学形成了一类新的互线性系统，尽管物种可能灭绝并且吸引子可能是混乱的。一个物种方程的任何变化都会作为一种有效的压力作用于其他物种，并使所有丰度保持密切相关：在灭绝过程中分段，以及混沌吸引子的时间平均值。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 非线性总体动力学中的互线性互线性，即在一种跃迁速率的任意强烈变化下，固定可观测量之间仿射关系的持续性，以马尔可夫跳跃过程和化学反应网络而闻名。我们证明了广义的 Lotka-Volterra 动力学形成了一类新的互线性系统，尽管物种可能灭绝并且吸引子可能是混乱的。一个物种方程的任何变化都会作为一种有效的压力作用于其他物种，并使所有丰度保持密切相关：在灭绝过程中分段，以及混沌吸引子的时间平均值。

articles.title: Leveraging Large Language Models to Predict Atomic Oxygen Erosion of Polymers in Low Earth Orbit
articles.title_zh: 利用大型语言模型预测近地轨道聚合物的原子氧侵蚀
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.12910v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Low Earth orbit (LEO), home to most active satellites, is projected to undergo a debris-fragmentation cascade known as Kessler Syndrome. In light of this eventuality, it is imperative to maximize the operational lifetime of LEO satellites. Instrumental to this goal is the development of next-generation polymeric materials with improved resistance to atomic oxygen (AO) erosion. Because genuine LEO exposure experiments are prohibitively expensive and LEO conditions are difficult to reproduce in the laboratory, data-driven approaches offer a promising alternative for accelerating materials discovery. Here, we develop a fine-tuned large language model (LLM) based on OpenAI's GPT-4o to predict the AO erosion yield (E_y) of polymers using a curated dataset of 201 measurements compiled from multiple NASA LEO exposure missions.
