articles.title: Understanding the impact of BiVO 4 surface facet and termination on infrared spectroscopy and oxygen evolution reaction
articles.abstract: The infrared (IR) spectra of BiVO 4 surfaces are sensitive to local atomic structure and can potentially provide insight into surface heterogeneity observed in recent spatially resolved nano-Fourier-transform infrared (nano-FTIR) spectroscopy measurements. However, no clear relationship has been established yet between IR spectral features and the surface atomic structures in BiVO 4 . Here, we used first-principles calculations to investigate the IR signatures of four low-index BiVO 4 surface orientations with stoichiometric and Bi-rich terminations. We found that the most distinctive spectral feature is the symmetric stretching mode of VO43− units, which is present only on stoichiometric surfaces and exhibits facet-dependent frequency shifts and intensity variations. Analysis of the vibrational modes showed that these changes originate from differences in the magnitude and orientation of surface-induced V–O bond distortions relative to the surface normal direction. Comparison with experimental nano-FTIR spectra shows a consistent trend in the change of the symmetric stretching peak intensity across different surface facets, while discrepancies in the relative intensity ratio between asymmetric and symmetric stretching modes suggest additional contributions from experimental factors, including probe depth and tip orientation. Oxygen evolution reaction calculations further confirm the strong influence of surface orientation and termination on catalytic activity. These results establish a direct link between surface atomic structure, IR signatures, and catalytic behavior in BiVO 4 , providing a framework for interpreting nanoscale IR spectroscopy measurements of heterogeneous photocatalyst surfaces.
articles.journal: The Journal of Chemical Physics Current Issue

articles.title: Determination of fundamental properties of nitrogen from first principles. III. Temperature and frequency dependence of the molecular polarizability and magnetic susceptibility
articles.abstract: This work is the third part of the series of papers that focus on the theoretical determination of the properties of nitrogen that are relevant in metrology. Here, we present first-principles calculations of the temperature and frequency dependence of the molecular polarizability and magnetic susceptibility of the nitrogen molecule (N 2 ). The purely electronic contributions to the static polarizability, Cauchy coefficients (up to sixth order), and isotropic magnetic susceptibility are computed over a range of internuclear distances using a robust composite scheme combining several electronic structure methods. The temperature dependence, evaluated from 50 to 2000 K, is determined using two independent methods: rovibrational averaging and path integral Monte Carlo. The polarizabilities obtained from theory agree with the recent high-precision thermometry measurements, wherever the latter are available, but are significantly less accurate. However, the main usefulness of the theoretical data revolves around combining it with the available experimental results to generate semi-empirical estimates of various quantities that have never been measured thus far. As an example, we determine highly accurate semi-empirical estimates of the static polarizability at key reference temperatures, α 0 ( T ) = 11.735 962 a.u. at T = 303 K and α 0 ( T ) = 11.735 585 a.u. at T = 273.16 K. Furthermore, we report theoretical values for the magnetic susceptibility, highlighting the importance of the paramagnetic contribution, and address a significant discrepancy with the experimental data for this quantity.
articles.journal: The Journal of Chemical Physics Current Issue

articles.title: Hydrogen-bond donor–acceptor imbalance in low-frequency terahertz water spectra
articles.abstract: The low-frequency dielectric response of liquid water is commonly described by a dominant Debye relaxation together with additional faster contributions whose microscopic origin remains debated. Here, we show that the dielectric function of water between 0.14 and 1.21 THz can be represented by a collective Debye relaxation plus a Drude–Smith term constrained to the zero-dc-conductivity limit. The Drude–Smith spectral weight increases upon heating pure liquid water from 20 to 50 °C and decreases upon isotopic substitution (D 2 O at 20 °C vs H 2 O at 20 °C). Among several microscopic measures of electronic polarization and its fluctuations extracted from molecular-dynamics simulations, including path-integral simulations with nuclear quantum effects, the population of water molecules with unequal numbers of donated and accepted hydrogen bonds best tracks the trends of the Drude–Smith spectral weight, changing with the same sign and comparable magnitude. Because such donor–acceptor imbalance is the local condition for net intermolecular charge transfer, it points to fluctuating molecular charges, a degree of freedom that fixed-charge representations lack by construction. Consistently, ab-initio-based dielectric spectra show that the ∼0.1–1 THz response cannot be solely described within a fixed-charge representation. These results support a plausible interpretation of parts of the excess low-frequency THz response of water as electronic-polarization fluctuations associated with transient donor–acceptor imbalance within the aqueous hydrogen-bond network.
articles.journal: The Journal of Chemical Physics Current Issue

articles.title: Approximating committor functions: Objective functions and enhanced sampling
articles.abstract: Many molecular dynamics simulations aim to study transitions between two states (from reactant to product states). In this context, the committor function (which gives, for a given molecular configuration, the probability of reaching the product state before the reactant state) is a pivotal quantity, in particular because it is the optimal importance function for rare-event simulation methods, such as importance sampling or splitting techniques. These methods are used to sample the reactive path ensemble and estimate, for example, the transition rate. However, learning such a function is generally a challenging task due to the high dimensionality of the configuration space. In this work, after reviewing existing methodologies to construct approximate committor functions, we propose a new loss function based on the application of Itō’s formula to learn the committor function with a minimization procedure on the parameters of a neural network. After comparing this novel approach to existing procedures on the Müller–Brown potential, we introduce a coupling strategy with the Adaptive Multilevel Splitting method to better approximate the committor function by improving the sampling of the reactive trajectories. This methodology, in which the committor function is iteratively learned, initially requires only knowledge of the reactant and product states.
articles.journal: The Journal of Chemical Physics Current Issue

articles.title: Modeling the inner electric double layer using short-range machine learning potentials: A critical assessment
articles.abstract: Atomistic simulations of electrochemical interfaces typically require large system sizes and long simulation times to obtain reliable thermodynamic properties. In this context, machine learning interatomic potentials (MLIPs) allow for computationally efficient sampling compared to density functional theory-based molecular dynamics simulations. Although conventional short-range MLIPs are recognized as inadequate for modeling the (potentially nanometer-wide) diffuse layer, they may still be capable of describing the inner electric double layer that is relevant for electrochemical reactions. Here, we evaluate the performance of common (short-ranged) MLIP architectures [the deep potential DP, the (graph) atomic cluster expansion-based models GRACE and MACE, and the pre-trained eSEN-OC25] for charged Au/electrolyte interfaces. In the evaluation, we focus on the effect of message passing and on the potentially adverse effect of data interference when training for a broad range of surface charges. Our results suggest that both local and message-passing models are able to reliably learn the interfacial structure when training on a single charge state. However, when trained on datasets that span multiple charge states, the MLIPs tested yield inconsistent predictions of interfacial water orientation and ion distributions. This behavior can be traced to the MLIPs being “blind” to the actual surface charge. Message-passing models show somewhat greater robustness to mixed-charge training data, likely due to their larger receptive field, but are still prone to artifacts and errors in the description of the interfacial structure. Overall, our results provide practical guidance on the expected accuracy and cross-charge-state transferability of short-ranged MLIPs for the description of the inner layer of electrode/electrolyte interfaces that will be relevant to their use in computational electrocatalysis.

articles.title: Determination of fundamental properties of nitrogen from first principles. I. Atomic polarizabilities and long-range dispersion coefficients
articles.abstract: This work is the first in a series of papers in which we perform theoretical calculations of various fundamental properties of nitrogen relevant for gas thermometry experiments. In this part, we focus on the properties of the nitrogen atom, namely, dynamic polarizabilities and dispersion coefficients that describe interaction between two nitrogen atoms at large internuclear separations. These quantities are calculated using a composite scheme based on coupled cluster and full configuration interaction methods and large Gaussian basis sets optimized specifically for the purposes of this work. The dispersion coefficients, C n with n = 6, 8, 10, are obtained using Casimir–Polder formulas by numerical integration over dipole, quadrupole, and octupole polarizabilities for imaginary frequencies represented analytically by Padé approximants. Special attention is paid to careful error control and uncertainty estimation of the calculated quantities.
articles.journal: The Journal of Chemical Physics Current Issue

articles.title: Pressure-retarded DNA translocations of nanopores reveal nanoscale stagnant fluid layers
articles.abstract: Although nanopore sequencing and sensing have undergone years of commercial development, accurately interpreting current signals, translating them into molecular length, position, and sequence, depends on knowing the translocation speed, which still lacks a physical model capable of predicting it from first principles. Existing models introduce adjustable parameters that can be tuned to match translocation data under a single experimental condition, but none has been tested against an independent constraint capable of distinguishing genuine nanoscale surface physics from curve-fitting. Here, we resolve this ambiguity using pressure-driven counterflow as such an independent test by measuring how the event-charge-deficit distribution of DNA translocations responds to a controlled counterpressure. Our model combining a sub-nanometer stagnant fluid layer ( δ ≈ 0.18 nm, consistent across all lengths tested) with coil drag scaled by the radius of gyration reproduces the measured pressure dependence; models omitting either effect require unphysical parameter values and break down as pressure increases. These results establish the stagnant layer as a physically real departure from continuum hydrodynamics rather than a fitting artifact, and yield an analytical expression for the pressure-dependent translocation velocity that offers a route toward more accurate velocity models for nanopore sequencing and sensing.
articles.journal: The Journal of Chemical Physics Current Issue

articles.title: Interfacial Strengthening and Stress Mitigation in GH4169/Ti60 Diffusion-Bonded Joints Driven by Cu Interlayer Thickness Design
articles.abstract: Heterogeneous joining of GH4169 Ni-based superalloy and Ti60 titanium alloy combines their advantages, but brittle Ti-Ni phases and stress concentration lower joint strength. Here, pure Cu interlayers were used for diffusion bonding GH4169/Ti60 joints. The Cu foil thickness was varied to study microstructural evolution and reveal strengthening and fracture mechanisms. Direct TLP bonding produces a joint comprising diffusion layer I (GH4169 side), central brazing seam II, and diffusion layer III (Ti60 side), with typical microstructure GH4169/Crss+(Ni,Cr,Fe)ss/TiNi/Ti2Ni/α-Ti/Ti60; brittle TiNi compounds degrade performance. With Cu foil, the typical microstructure becomes Ti(Ni,Cu)/TiCu+TiAl/β-Ti+Ti3Sn/α-Ti+Ti2Cu/α-Ti/Ti60. Increasing Cu thickness coarsens zone II grains and reduces the high-angle grain boundary fraction from 92.5% to 46.1%. At 0.03mm Cu, the maximum KAM values in zones I, II, and III are 4.88°, 4.99°, and 4.97°, respectively, indicating relatively uniform stress. The (Ni,Cu)ss/Ti3Sn/Ti–Cu layered structure in zone II greatly relieves residual stress and gives a maximum joint strength of 190MPa. Fracture morphology and path indicate brittle fracture; cracks initiate between the (Cu,Ni)ss and TiCu phases and form small secondary cracks.

articles.title: Determination of fundamental properties of nitrogen from first principles. II. Potential energy curve and spectroscopic properties of N 2
articles.abstract: This work is the second part of the series devoted to first-principles determination of the fundamental properties of nitrogen. In this part, we calculate the potential energy curve for the electronic ground state of N 2 . The potential is divided into three components: short-, medium-, and long-range, and a different computational protocol is applied to each component, based on a composite coupled cluster approach, genuine multireference methods, and asymptotic expansion of the interaction energy. A particular focus is on the short-range part, as the accuracy of this component is critical from the point of view of metrological applications, including the temperature dependence of many properties of nitrogen gas. The uncertainties of the theoretical data, originating both from basis set incompleteness and applied theoretical method, are rigorously analyzed and provided at 2 σ level, i.e., expanded ( k = 2) uncertainties. The developed potential energy curve is used to calculate the spectroscopic parameters of the N 2 ground state, and the results are compared with the available theoretical and experimental data.

articles.title: The fastest levitated spinning magnet ever made might help physicists search for dark matter
articles.title_zh: 有史以来最快的悬浮旋转磁铁可能有助于物理学家寻找暗物质
articles.abstract: Tiny levitated magnets are able to avoid contact friction, making them useful for detecting extremely weak forces and magnetic fields and acting as ultralow-noise quantum sensors and precision measurement tools. Combining levitation with extreme cold further reduces unwanted motion that can make faint signals hard to detect.

articles.title: Physicochemical properties and ecological and human-health risk assessment of soil-like material excavated from a stabilised municipal solid waste landfill on the Xizang Plateau
articles.title_zh: 西藏高原稳定化城市生活垃圾填埋场出土类土材料的理化性质及生态与人类健康风险评估
articles.abstract: Landfill mining is promoted to reclaim land and recover resources from legacy waste, but re-use of its fine, humus-rich fraction, soil-like material (SLM), is constrained by scarce information on its properties and risks at high altitudes. We characterised SLM excavated at 0–5 m depths from the stabilised Lhasa municipal solid waste landfill (Xizang, 3,670 m a.s.l.) and assessed heavy metal contamination, ecological risk and human-health risk using contamination factors, geoaccumulation indices, Hakanson's potential ecological risk index and the USEPA exposure model, with 20,000 Monte Carlo iterations. SLM accounted for 61.2 ± 4.6% of the excavated waste and was slightly alkaline (pH 7.76–8.11), strongly humified and nutrient-rich (SOM 47.5–96.6 g kg⁻¹; available K 978–2,541 mg kg⁻¹; humic-acid/fulvic-acid ratio 5.0). Mean metal concentrations met the Chinese agricultural screening values (GB 15618 − 2018), but Cr, Cd and Hg were enriched 2.2–3.3-fold over the local background, giving a potential ecological risk index of 215.8 (moderate hazard) dominated by Hg (60.5%) and Cd (30.2%). Non-carcinogenic risk exceeded the USEPA threshold only for children (HI = 1.55; Cr 70%, As 22%); Monte Carlo gave an 85% probability that the child HI exceeds unity, whereas total carcinogenic risk (2.1 × 10⁻⁵ for adults; 3.1 × 10⁻⁵ for children) remained acceptable in over 99.5% of simulations. SLM is therefore unsuitable for direct agricultural or residential use but suitable for non-food biomass, landscaping substrates and landfill cover after blending and monitoring of Hg, Cd and Cr speciation.
articles.abstract_zh: 垃圾填埋场采矿旨在开垦土地并从遗留废物中回收资源，但其富含腐殖质的细小部分的类土材料（SLM）的再利用受到有关其在高海拔地区的特性和风险的信息稀缺的限制。我们对稳定的拉萨城市固体废物填埋场（西藏，海拔 3,670 m）挖掘的 SLM 进行了特征分析，并使用污染因子、地累积指数、Hakanson 潜在生态风险指数和 USEPA 暴露模型（20,000 次蒙特卡罗迭代）评估了重金属污染、生态风险和人类健康风险。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 垃圾填埋场采矿旨在开垦土地并从遗留废物中回收资源，但其富含腐殖质的细小部分的类土材料（SLM）的再利用受到有关其在高海拔地区的特性和风险的信息稀缺的限制。我们对稳定的拉萨城市固体废物填埋场（西藏，海拔 3,670 m）挖掘的 SLM 进行了特征分析，并使用污染因子、地累积指数、Hakanson 潜在生态风险指数和 USEPA 暴露模型（20,000 次蒙特卡罗迭代）评估了重金属污染、生态风险和人类健康风险。 SLM占出土废物的61.2±4.6%，呈弱碱性（pH 7.76-8.11）、强腐殖化且营养丰富（SOM 47.5-96.6 g kg-1；有效钾 978-2,541 mg kg-1；腐殖酸/黄腐酸比 5.0）。平均金属浓度符合中国农业筛查值（GB 15618 − 2018），但Cr、Cd和Hg较当地背景富集2.2-3.3倍，潜在生态风险指数为215.8（中度危害），以Hg（60.5%）和Cd（30.2%）为主。仅针对儿童的非致癌风险超过 USEPA 阈值（HI = 1.55；Cr 70%，As 22%）；蒙特卡洛给出的儿童 HI 超过统一的概率为 85%，而总致癌风险（成人为 2.1 × 10⁻⁵；儿童为 3.1 × 10⁻⁵）在超过 99.5% 的模拟中仍然可以接受。因此，SLM 不适合直接农业或住宅用途，但在混合和监测汞、镉和铬形态后，适用于非粮食生物质、景观美化基质和垃圾填埋场覆盖。

articles.title: Optimization of the Ultrasound-Assisted Extraction of Anthocyanins from Acerola (Malpighia emarginata) Using Response Surface Methodology
articles.title_zh: 使用响应面法优化超声辅助提取金虎尾花青素
articles.abstract: The extraction of anthocyanins from acerola (Malpighia emarginata) has potential for obtaining bioactive compounds, and ultrasound-assisted extraction (UAE) is an alternative to conventional methods. In this study, the kinetics and the influence of operating variables on the total anthocyanin content (TAC) obtained by UAE were investigated. Extraction was performed in an ultrasonic bath at 40 kHz, using an extraction solvent of 95% ethanol and 1.5 mol L− 1 HCl at an 85:15 (v/v) ratio. Extraction kinetics were evaluated using Fick’s Law, the Power Law, and the Peleg model, while the experimental conditions were optimized through statistical analysis of a Box-Behnken design. TAC was determined by the single pH method at 535 nm. Among the kinetic models, the Peleg model showed a satisfactory fit to the experimental data, with R2 > 0.99 and RMSE = 0.1975, indicating the relevance of diffusion in the mass transfer process. In the experimental design, TAC ranged from 9.32 to 25.46 mg/100 g. ANOVA indicated a significant effect of the linear term of the solid/liquid ratio (p = 0.0012) and of the quadratic terms of temperature (p = 0.0065) and time (p = 0.0151). The quadratic regression model showed R² = 0.9403 and a non-significant lack of fit (p = 0.2633). The maximum response predicted by the model was 27.45 mg/100 g, associated with a temperature of 38.8°C, a time of 7.87 min, and a solid/liquid ratio of 0.02 g/mL. The results revealed that combining kinetic modeling and optimization is a suitable approach for understanding the ultrasound-assisted extraction of anthocyanins from acerola.
articles.abstract_zh: 从针叶樱桃（Malpighia emarginata）中提取花青素具有获得生物活性化合物的潜力，而超声辅助提取（UAE）是传统方法的替代方法。在这项研究中，研究了阿联酋获得的总花青素含量（TAC）的动力学和操作变量的影响。在 40 kHz 超声波浴中进行提取，提取溶剂为 95% 乙醇和 1.5 mol·L− 1 HCl，比例为 85:15 (v/v)。使用菲克定律、幂律和 Peleg 模型评估萃取动力学，同时通过 Box-Behnken 设计的统计分析优化实验条件。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 从针叶樱桃（Malpighia emarginata）中提取花青素具有获得生物活性化合物的潜力，而超声辅助提取（UAE）是传统方法的替代方法。在这项研究中，研究了阿联酋获得的总花青素含量（TAC）的动力学和操作变量的影响。在 40 kHz 超声波浴中进行提取，提取溶剂为 95% 乙醇和 1.5 mol·L− 1 HCl，比例为 85:15 (v/v)。使用菲克定律、幂律和 Peleg 模型评估萃取动力学，同时通过 Box-Behnken 设计的统计分析优化实验条件。 TAC 通过单一 pH 法在 535 nm 处测定。动力学模型中，Peleg模型与实验数据吻合良好，R2 > 0.99，RMSE = 0.1975，表明传质过程中扩散的相关性。在实验设计中，TAC 范围为 9.32 至 25.46 mg/100 g。方差分析表明固/液比的线性项 (p = 0.0012) 以及温度的二次项 (p = 0.0065) 和时间 (p = 0.0151) 具有显着影响。二次回归模型显示 R² = 0.9403，不显着失拟合 (p = 0.2633)。模型预测的最大响应为 27.45 mg/100 g，与温度 38.8°C、时间 7.87 分钟和固/液比 0.02 g/mL 相关。结果表明，结合动力学建模和优化是了解超声辅助提取针叶樱桃花青素的合适方法。

articles.title: Negative Extrapolation for Targeted Motif Suppression in Molecular Generators
articles.title_zh: 分子发生器中靶向基序抑制的负外推
articles.abstract: Broadly trained molecular generators can cover diverse chemical space, but may also produce motifs that are undesirable in a given discovery context, e.g., reactive motifs. Adapting a pretrained generator to suppress such chemistry is therefore an important practical problem. However, most model steering methods enrich desirable compounds or optimize a predefined reward, whereas selectively suppressing an undesirable region of chemical space without compromising the quality and diversity of the remaining distribution remains challenging. Here, we adapt negative extrapolation (NE), a parameter-space editing strategy in which a generator is fine-tuned on molecules containing unwanted structural motifs and the resulting weight update is reversed, to suppress these motifs directly within the generator. We evaluated NE using two custom string-based autoregressive generators, a public pretrained recurrent prior, and a three-dimensional flow-matching generator, with unedited generation and conventional fine-tuning on molecules without the unwanted motifs as principal comparators. Across the string-based generators, NE reduced the occurrence of four structural motif classes (reactive, metal-binding, charged, and assay-interference motifs) more strongly than conventional fine-tuning. We further extended NE through selective parameter editing and combinations of learned update directions, enabling generative validity to be preserved across different model architectures. In the three-dimensional flow-matching generator, corrected NE reduced the fraction of valid molecules containing any of the unwanted motifs from 31.1% to 2.2% and increased the fixed-budget yield of unique, motif-free molecules that were valid molecular graphs and passed three-dimensional chemical and geometric consistency checks from 60.0% to 80.8%. Together, these results support NE as a simple approach for selectively editing molecular generators across architectures and across string-based and three-dimensional representations, while preserving molecular diversity and without requiring a reward-optimization loop. Scientific Contribution: We apply the parameter-arithmetic principle of reversing a learned update to an important problem in molecular generation: selectively suppressing a defined unwanted region of chemical space while preserving the quality and diversity of the remaining distribution. Across string-based and three-dimensional generators, we further investigate how parameter arithmetic can be adapted through selective parameter editing and combinations of independently learned update directions to retain model validity when full-model extrapolation is disruptive.
articles.abstract_zh: 经过广泛训练的分子发生器可以覆盖不同的化学空间，但也可能产生在给定的发现背景下不需要的基序，例如反应基序。因此，采用预先训练的生成器来抑制这种化学反应是一个重要的实际问题。然而，大多数模型引导方法丰富了所需的化合物或优化了预定义的奖励，而选择性地抑制化学空间中不需要的区域而不影响剩余分布的质量和多样性仍然具有挑战性。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 经过广泛训练的分子发生器可以覆盖不同的化学空间，但也可能产生在给定的发现背景下不需要的基序，例如反应基序。因此，采用预先训练的生成器来抑制这种化学反应是一个重要的实际问题。然而，大多数模型引导方法丰富了所需的化合物或优化了预定义的奖励，而选择性地抑制化学空间中不需要的区域而不影响剩余分布的质量和多样性仍然具有挑战性。在这里，我们采用负外推法（NE），这是一种参数空间编辑策略，其中生成器对包含不需要的结构基序的分子进行微调，并且所产生的权重更新被反转，以直接在生成器内抑制这些基序。我们使用两个定制的基于字符串的自回归生成器、一个公共预训练的循环先验生成器和一个三维流匹配生成器来评估 NE，其中未经编辑的生成和对分子的常规微调，没有不需要的基序作为主要比较器。在基于字符串的生成器中，NE 比传统的微调更有效地减少了四种结构基序类别（反应基序、金属结合基序、带电基序和测定干扰基序）的出现。我们通过选择性参数编辑和学习更新方向的组合进一步扩展了 NE，从而能够在不同的模型架构中保留生成有效性。在三维流程匹配生成器中，校正后的 NE 将包含任何不需要的基序的有效分子的比例从 31.1% 减少到 2.2%，并将作为有效分子图并通过三维化学和几何一致性检查的独特、无基序分子的固定预算产量从 60.0% 增加到 80.8%。总之，这些结果支持 NE 作为一种简单的方法，用于跨架构、跨基于字符串和三维表示选择性编辑分子生成器，同时保留分子多样性，并且不需要奖励优化循环。科学贡献：我们将参数算术原理应用于分子生成中的一个重要问题，即逆转学习更新：选择性抑制化学空间中定义的不需要的区域，同时保留剩余分布的质量和多样性。在基于字符串和三维的生成器中，我们进一步研究了如何通过选择性参数编辑和独立学习的更新方向的组合来调整参数算术，以在全模型外推被破坏时保持模型的有效性。

articles.title: Current selects the helicity of a chiral phonon
articles.title_zh: Current 选择手性声子的螺旋度
articles.abstract: The emergence of spin-polarized electrons from nonmagnetic chiral molecules and crystals is called Chirality-induced spin selectivity (CISS). A chiral phonon of definite wavevector q can strongly enhance it, but near equilibrium the two helicities +q and −q are equally populated: they are time-reversal partners and their contributions cancel. We show that in a biased chiral conductor the current causes the phonon of one helicity to damp less than the other. The damping asymmetry is odd in the current, odd under q → −q, invariant under a mirror that reverses the structural handedness, and equal, mode for mode, to the current-induced nonconservative Berry force on the phonon coordinate. Closing the phonon kinetics with a rate equation turns the asymmetry into a net lattice helicity: at any finite bias one helicity is preferentially populated, with no threshold, growing linearly with the current as V → 0; above a threshold that helicity becomes a self-sustained coherent travelling wave. We demonstrate this effect in elemental tellurium, treated as an open quantum system (electronic Hamiltonian, phonon bath, and electron–phonon coupling) within a quasi-ab initio framework. The electronic Hamiltonian is supplied by a vertex-corrected quasipar-ticle self-consistent GW (QSGˆWQSGˆ QSGˆW) potential with spin–orbit coupling; nuclear displacements are modeled with a machine-learned interatomic potential, which yields chiral phonon modes at finite ±q z on the Γ–A line. The perturbation to the electronic Hamiltonian from a nuclear displacement is approximated by a frozen-phonon deformation potential. In tellurium the damping asymmetry grows linearly with the current, the resulting lattice helicity persists from low temperature to room temperature, and the coherent regime appears below about 20 K at 0.2 V and 40 K at 0.4 V. No optical pump is needed: a bias alone drives the current and selects the phonon helicity; reversing the current reverses the selection.
articles.abstract_zh: 非磁性手性分子和晶体中出现自旋极化电子称为手性诱导自旋选择性（CISS）。确定波矢 q 的手性声子可以强烈增强它，但在接近平衡时，两个螺旋 +q 和 -q 的分布是相等的：它们是时间反转伙伴，并且它们的贡献相互抵消。我们证明，在偏置的手性导体中，电流导致一种螺旋性的声子阻尼小于另一种螺旋性的声子。阻尼不对称性在电流中是奇数，在 q → −q 下是奇数，在反转结构旋向性的镜子下不变，并且模式与模式相等，与声子坐标上电流感应的非保守贝里力相同。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 非磁性手性分子和晶体中出现自旋极化电子称为手性诱导自旋选择性（CISS）。确定波矢 q 的手性声子可以强烈增强它，但在接近平衡时，两个螺旋 +q 和 -q 的分布是相等的：它们是时间反转伙伴，并且它们的贡献相互抵消。我们证明，在偏置的手性导体中，电流导致一种螺旋性的声子阻尼小于另一种螺旋性的声子。阻尼不对称性在电流中是奇数，在 q → −q 下是奇数，在反转结构旋向性的镜子下不变，并且模式与模式相等，与声子坐标上电流感应的非保守贝里力相同。用速率方程封闭声子动力学将不对称性转化为净晶格螺旋度：在任何有限偏置下，优先填充一个螺旋度，没有阈值，随着 V → 0 随电流线性增长；超过一个阈值，螺旋性就成为自持的相干行波。我们在元素碲中证明了这种效应，将其视为准从头计算框架内的开放量子系统（电子哈密顿量、声子浴和电子声子耦合）。电子哈密顿量由具有自旋轨道耦合的顶点校正准粒子自洽 GW (QSG^WQSG^QSG^W) 势提供；核位移是用机器学习的原子间势来建模的，它在 Γ-A 线上产生有限 ±q z 的手性声子模式。核位移对电子哈密顿量的扰动通过冻结声子变形势来近似。在碲中，阻尼不对称性随电流线性增长，由此产生的晶格螺旋度从低温到室温持续存在，并且相干范围出现在 0.2 V 时约 20 K 和 0.4 V 时约 40 K 以下。不需要光泵：仅靠偏置驱动电流并选择声子螺旋度；反转电流会反转选择。

articles.title: FT-NIR Spectroscopy and Explainable Machine Learning for Eggshell Based Classification of Organic and Conventional Market Eggs
articles.title_zh: FT-NIR 光谱和可解释的机器学习用于基于蛋壳的有机和传统市场鸡蛋分类
articles.abstract: The premium pricing of organic eggs creates incentives for product misrepresentation and motivates the development of rapid, non-destructive screening tools to differentiate labeled organic and conventional eggs. Fourier transform near-infrared (FT-NIR) spectroscopy coupled with machine learning was evaluated for classifying retail eggs marketed as organic versus conventional. A total of 147 eggs were measured and spectra were analyzed using partial least squares–discriminant analysis (PLS-DA), along with gradient-boosted tree models (XGBoost and LightGBM). The dataset was partitioned into training (70%) and testing (30%) sets. Among the evaluated models, PLS-DA achieved the best test performance with an overall accuracy of 91.0%. To improve interpretability, SHapley Additive exPlanations (SHAP) were used to identify wavelengths that most strongly contributed to model predictions. Influential regions included bands near ~1400 nm, consistent with O-H absorptions commonly associated with moisture-related spectral features, and regions near ~2300 nm, which are often associated with crystalline calcium-carbonate-related absorptions in the near-infrared and may reflect variation in mineral-associated spectral response of eggshell. These results indicate that FT-NIR spectroscopy combined with machine learning can differentiate retail eggs labeled as organic versus conventional under the conditions of this study, supporting further development of rapid screening approaches for market classification and quality assurance applications.
articles.abstract_zh: 有机鸡蛋的溢价刺激了产品虚假陈述，并推动了快速、无损筛选工具的开发，以区分贴有标签的有机鸡蛋和传统鸡蛋。傅里叶变换近红外 (FT-NIR) 光谱与机器学习相结合，对销售的零售鸡蛋进行有机鸡蛋和传统鸡蛋的分类进行了评估。总共测量了 147 个鸡蛋，并使用偏最小二乘判别分析 (PLS-DA) 以及梯度增强树模型（XGBoost 和 LightGBM）对光谱进行了分析。数据集分为训练集 (70%) 和测试集 (30%)。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 有机鸡蛋的溢价刺激了产品虚假陈述，并推动了快速、无损筛选工具的开发，以区分贴有标签的有机鸡蛋和传统鸡蛋。傅里叶变换近红外 (FT-NIR) 光谱与机器学习相结合，对销售的零售鸡蛋进行有机鸡蛋和传统鸡蛋的分类进行了评估。总共测量了 147 个鸡蛋，并使用偏最小二乘判别分析 (PLS-DA) 以及梯度增强树模型（XGBoost 和 LightGBM）对光谱进行了分析。数据集分为训练集 (70%) 和测试集 (30%)。在评估的模型中，PLS-DA 取得了最好的测试性能，总体准确率为 91.0%。为了提高可解释性，使用 SHapley Additive exPlanations (SHAP) 来识别对模型预测贡献最大的波长。影响区域包括约 1400 nm 附近的波段，与通常与水分相关的光谱特征相关的 O-H 吸收一致，以及约 2300 nm 附近的区域，这些区域通常与近红外中结晶碳酸钙相关的吸收有关，可能反映蛋壳矿物相关光谱响应的变化。这些结果表明，在本研究的条件下，FT-NIR 光谱与机器学习相结合可以区分标记为有机的零售鸡蛋与传统的零售鸡蛋，从而支持进一步开发用于市场分类和质量保证应用的快速筛选方法。

articles.title: Delocalisation, not decentralisation: a small fraction of non-local ledger links shifts construction supply networks into a mean-field coordination transition
articles.title_zh: 去本地化，而不是去中心化：一小部分非本地账本链接将建筑供应网络转变为平均场协调过渡
articles.abstract: Distributed-ledger technologies are expected to improve coordination in construction supply networks, yet realised benefits are uneven. We model ledger-mediated verification as a collective coordination problem on networks and examine how network structure affects the transition from hub-mediated to peer-mediated verification. Using a statistical-mechanics model with a single normalised control parameter and no empirically fitted parameters, we simulate spatially embedded and non-spatial verification networks with cluster Monte Carlo methods. The numerical approach is first validated against established benchmark results. The model exhibits a continuous coordination transition, but its behaviour depends strongly on network topology. Purely local verification networks display non-mean-field behaviour and require a higher critical threshold than non-spatial networks. Rewiring only 5% of links to distant counterparties shifts the system close to mean-field behaviour and substantially lowers the threshold, with little further change at higher rewiring levels. The results suggest that the key structural effect of a distributed ledger is not simply decentralisation, but delocalisation: enabling verification across otherwise local boundaries. Even a small proportion of long-range verification links can therefore alter collective coordination dynamics and reduce the connectivity required for system-wide change.
articles.abstract_zh: 分布式账本技术有望改善建筑供应网络的协调，但实现的效益并不均衡。我们将账本介导的验证建模为网络上的集体协调问题，并研究网络结构如何影响从集线器介导的验证到对等介导的验证的转变。使用具有单个归一化控制参数且没有经验拟合参数的统计力学模型，我们使用集群蒙特卡罗方法模拟空间嵌入和非空间验证网络。首先根据既定的基准结果验证数值方法。该模型表现出连续的协调过渡，但其行为强烈依赖于网络拓扑。纯本地验证网络显示非平均场行为，并且需要比非空间网络更高的临界阈值。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 分布式账本技术有望改善建筑供应网络的协调，但实现的效益并不均衡。我们将账本介导的验证建模为网络上的集体协调问题，并研究网络结构如何影响从集线器介导的验证到对等介导的验证的转变。使用具有单个归一化控制参数且没有经验拟合参数的统计力学模型，我们使用集群蒙特卡罗方法模拟空间嵌入和非空间验证网络。首先根据既定的基准结果验证数值方法。该模型表现出连续的协调过渡，但其行为强烈依赖于网络拓扑。纯本地验证网络显示非平均场行为，并且需要比非空间网络更高的临界阈值。仅重新连接 5% 的与远程交易对手的链路即可使系统接近平均场行为，并大大降低阈值，在更高的重新连接级别上几乎没有进一步的变化。结果表明，分布式账本的关键结构效应不仅仅是去中心化，而是非本地化：能够跨越本地边界进行验证。因此，即使是一小部分远程验证链路也可以改变集体协调动态，并减少全系统变化所需的连接性。

articles.title: Synthesis of Magnetic Nanocatalyst CaO/CoFe3O4 for Biodiesel Production using Pongamia pinnata oil Seed
articles.title_zh: 利用水黄皮油籽合成用于生物柴油生产的磁性纳米催化剂 CaO/CoFe3O4
articles.abstract: Biodiesel has emerged as prominent alternative source for commercial fuels. Pongamia pinnata (P. pinnata) has been recognised as the potential source for biodiesel, prepared from its seeds. The present study is to develop a novel heterogenous magnetic nano catalyst CaO/CoFe3O4 for the preparation of biodiesel from P. pinnata through transesterification reaction and improve the catalyst reusability. Magnetic core Fe3O4 and CoFe3O4 were prepared by co-precipitation method. Crab shell was calcinated at 600°C for 4 h for the preparation of calcium oxide (CaO). CaO/CoFe3O4 was synthesized by doping of CaO and CoFe3O4. Characterization of the synthesised catalyst was done using Fourier Transform Infrared Spectroscopy, Scanning Electron Microscopy, X-ray Diffraction and Particle Size Analyzer to analyses the functional group, morphology, crystalline structure and particle size respectively. The optimized parameter for biodiesel production by transesterification are 12:1 molar ratio of methanol to oil, 2.5wt% catalyst concentration, 120 min reaction time, 65°C reaction temperature and 500 rpm stirring rate to give a maximum of 98.56 wt% yield. The reusability study conferred that the biodiesel yield of above 92 wt% were obtained when regenerating and reusing the catalyst up to six cycles, further the yield drops below 65 wt% at ninth cycle of catalyst reusability. After transesterification, the fuel properties were analyzed using ASTM D6751 standard and it was found within prescribe limit.

articles.abstract_zh_full: 生物柴油已成为商业燃料的重要替代来源。水黄皮 (P. pinnata) 已被认为是从其种子中制备生物柴油的潜在来源。本研究旨在开发一种新型多相磁性纳米催化剂CaO/CoFe3O4，用于通过酯交换反应从P. pinnata制备生物柴油，并提高催化剂的重复使用性。采用共沉淀法制备了磁芯Fe3O4和CoFe3O4。将蟹壳在 600°C 下煅烧 4 h，制备氧化钙 (CaO)。通过CaO和CoFe3O4的掺杂合成了CaO/CoFe3O4。使用傅里叶变换红外光谱、扫描电子显微镜、X射线衍射和粒度分析仪对合成的催化剂进行表征，分别分析官能团、形貌、晶体结构和粒度。酯交换法生产生物柴油的优化参数为甲醇与油摩尔比12:1、催化剂浓度2.5wt%、反应时间120 min、反应温度65℃和搅拌速率500 rpm，最高收率98.56 wt%。可重复使用性研究表明，当催化剂再生和重复使用最多六个周期时，生物柴油收率超过 92 wt%，进一步在催化剂可重复使用的第九个循环时，收率降至 65 wt% 以下。酯交换反应后，使用 ASTM D6751 标准对燃料性能进行分析，发现其性能在规定限度内。

articles.title: Design and Numerical Analysis of a Highly Nonlinear Dual-Core Photonic Crystal Fiber with Ultra-Low Confinement Loss at 1.55 µm Wavelength
articles.title_zh: 1.55 µm 波长下具有超低限制损耗的高度非线性双芯光子晶体光纤的设计和数值分析
articles.abstract: In this paper, we propose and rigorously analyse a novel dual-core photonic crystal fibre (DC-PCF) design based on silica-air micro-structure. The fibre geometry is designed to reach a compromise between high optical nonlinearities and very low confinement loss at the standard telecommunication wavelength of (:λ:=1.55μ:m). Using the Full-Vector Finite Element Method (Full-Vector FEM) combined with circular Perfectly Matched Layers (PML), the fundamental propagation parameters—including modal field distributions, effective refractive index (:(nₑff₎), effective mode area ( (:Aₑff)), nonlinear coefficient ((:γ:)), supermode coupling characteristics, and confinement loss—are investigated. Numerical convergence tests confirm that for the optimized ratio (:raisebox1exd!left/:!raisebox-1exvarLambda:right.) = 0.76, the proposed DC-PCF yields a high nonlinear coefficient of 60 (:W⁻¹Km⁻¹,) atight effective mode area of 2.34(:μ:m²), and an ultra-low confinement loss of 0.001(:raisebox1exdB!left/:!raisebox-1exKmright.) at 1.55(:μ:m). A comprehensive quantitative comparison with existing literature demonstrates the distinct numerical performance and potential suitability of this fiber for optical signal processing and future optical communication networks.
articles.abstract_zh: 在本文中，我们提出并严格分析了一种基于二氧化硅-空气微结构的新型双芯光子晶体光纤（DC-PCF）设计。光纤几何形状的设计旨在在标准电信波长 (:λ:=1.55μ:m) 下实现高光学非线性和极低限制损耗之间的折衷。采用全矢量有限元法（Full-Vector FEM）结合圆形完美匹配层（PML），研究了基本传播参数，包括模场分布、有效折射率（:(nₑff₎）、有效模面积（（:Aₑff））、非线性系数（（:γ:)）、超模耦合特性和限制损耗。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在本文中，我们提出并严格分析了一种基于二氧化硅-空气微结构的新型双芯光子晶体光纤（DC-PCF）设计。光纤几何形状的设计旨在在标准电信波长 (:λ:=1.55μ:m) 下实现高光学非线性和极低限制损耗之间的折衷。采用全矢量有限元法（Full-Vector FEM）结合圆形完美匹配层（PML），研究了基本传播参数，包括模场分布、有效折射率（:(nₑff₎）、有效模面积（（:Aₑff））、非线性系数（（:γ:)）、超模耦合特性和限制损耗。数值收敛测试证实，对于优化的比率(:raisebox1exd!left/:!raisebox-1exvarLambda:right.) = 0.76，所提出的 DC-PCF 产生 60 (:W⁻1Km⁻1) 的高非线性系数和 2.34(:μ:m²) 的紧有效模式面积，以及 0.001 的超低限制损耗(:raisebox1exdB!left/:!raisebox-1exKmright。)与现有文献的全面定量比较表明了该光纤在光信号处理和未来光通信网络中的独特数值性能和潜在适用性。

articles.title: Exploration of the northern stratospheric polar vortex extremes via archetype analysis and tropospheric imprint
articles.title_zh: 通过原型分析和对流层印记探索北部平流层极涡极值
articles.abstract: The winter stratospheric polar vortex is known to go through morphological change yielding various extreme states of its dynamic and thermodynamic state variables. These extreme states, including sudden stratospheric warming, generally have longer timescale compared to the chaotic limit of weather predictability, and may have significant impact on tropospheric variability. This offers the opportunity to boosting the predictability in the subseasonal-to-seasonal timescales especially regarding extreme events. Here extreme states of polar vortex are identified using archetypal analysis; a powerful unsupervised machine learning method. Polar vortex archetypes represent corners of the data convex hull and yield various extreme states including strong, split and displaced vortices. These states are shown to yield tropospheric and surface climate delayed response through teleconnections including North Atlantic Oscillation and Arctic Oscillation with lag of more than four to five weeks offering potential for predictability in the subseasonal-to-seasonal window.
articles.abstract_zh: 众所周知，冬季平流层极地涡旋会经历形态变化，产生其动力和热力学状态变量的各种极端状态。这些极端状态，包括平流层突然变暖，与天气预报的混乱极限相比，通常具有更长的时间尺度，并且可能对对流层变率产生重大影响。这提供了提高次季节到季节时间尺度的可预测性的机会，特别是在极端事件方面。这里使用原型分析来识别极地涡旋的极端状态；一种强大的无监督机器学习方法。极地涡旋原型代表数据凸包的角点，并产生各种极端状态，包括强涡旋、分裂涡旋和位移涡旋。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 众所周知，冬季平流层极地涡旋会经历形态变化，产生其动力和热力学状态变量的各种极端状态。这些极端状态，包括平流层突然变暖，与天气预报的混乱极限相比，通常具有更长的时间尺度，并且可能对对流层变率产生重大影响。这提供了提高次季节到季节时间尺度的可预测性的机会，特别是在极端事件方面。这里使用原型分析来识别极地涡旋的极端状态；一种强大的无监督机器学习方法。极地涡旋原型代表数据凸包的角点，并产生各种极端状态，包括强涡旋、分裂涡旋和位移涡旋。这些状态显示出通过遥相关产生对流层和地表气候延迟响应，包括北大西洋涛动和北极涛动，滞后超过四到五周，为次季节到季节窗口的预测提供了潜力。

articles.title: The Uruana de Minas geomagnetic anomaly remains aligned with mapped geological structures across four decades
articles.title_zh: 乌鲁阿纳-德米纳斯地磁异常在过去的四十年里一直与地图上的地质结构保持一致
articles.abstract: A persistent crustal boundary may preserve its geometry across magnetic surveys that do not reproduce amplitude. We characterize the partial magnetic-gradient envelope at Uruana de Minas, Brazil, using archives from 1971–1972, 2008 and 2011. The 2011 raw-field gradient reversal supplies the geographic anchor. Historical and 2008 reconstructions recover opposed directional-derivative walls in a fixed 7–9 km annulus, with midpoints near Uruana. A historical bilinear model predicts withheld flight lines with a pooled error of 3.34 nT, compared with 5.00 nT for a plane. Magnetic and independently mapped geological orientation domains reconstruct one another with a worst held-out error of 2.287°, ranking first among 28 supported centers. The 1971-to-2008 eigenframe rotates by only 3.328° despite curvature-spectrum change. Raw-to-corrected 2008 Hessian differences are predominantly isotropic at 6–12 km support, separating processing effects from axis orientation. All six outer curvature roots lie within 0.702 km of the frozen 2011 front, the best placement among 65 parallel translations. Upward continuation preserves the central saddle in 100/100 realizations to 12 km, while the external root migrates and disappears near 4 km at standard support. A recovered scalar–triaxial file preserves the geographic contrast on reciprocal traverses. The surveys recover a structurally registered partial envelope and separate persistent geometry from processing-sensitive curvature. Historical line-offset sensitivity and external angular analogues delimit the result. Geographic vector closure and source mechanism remain unresolved.
articles.abstract_zh: 持久的地壳边界可以在不再现振幅的磁力测量中保留其几何形状。我们利用 1971-1972 年、2008 年和 2011 年的档案描述了巴西乌鲁阿纳德米纳斯的部分磁梯度包络线的特征。2011 年的原始场梯度反转提供了地理锚点。历史和 2008 年的重建在固定的 7-9 公里环带中恢复了相对的方向导数墙，中点靠近乌鲁阿纳。历史双线性模型预测保留航线的汇总误差为 3.34 nT，而飞机的汇总误差为 5.00 nT。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 持久的地壳边界可以在不再现振幅的磁力测量中保留其几何形状。我们利用 1971-1972 年、2008 年和 2011 年的档案描述了巴西乌鲁阿纳德米纳斯的部分磁梯度包络线的特征。2011 年的原始场梯度反转提供了地理锚点。历史和 2008 年的重建在固定的 7-9 公里环带中恢复了相对的方向导数墙，中点靠近乌鲁阿纳。历史双线性模型预测保留航线的汇总误差为 3.34 nT，而飞机的汇总误差为 5.00 nT。磁性和独立绘制的地质方向域相互重建，最差保留误差为 2.287°，在 28 个支持中心中排名第一。尽管曲率谱发生了变化，1971 年至 2008 年的特征帧仅旋转了 3.328°。原始到校正的 2008 Hessian 差异在 6-12 km 支持处主要是各向同性的，将处理效果与轴方向分开。所有六个外曲率根均位于 2011 年冰冻锋面 0.702 公里范围内，这是 65 个平行平移中的最佳位置。向上延续以 100/100 实现将中央鞍保留到 12 公里，而外部根在标准支撑处迁移并消失近 4 公里。恢复的标量三轴文件保留了相互遍历的地理对比度。这些调查恢复了结构注册的部分包络线，并将持久几何形状与处理敏感的曲率分开。历史线偏移灵敏度和外部角度类似物界定了结果。地理媒介闭合和源头机制仍未解决。

articles.abstract: Nature Chemistry, Published online: 10 November 2026; doi:10.1038/s41557-026-02304-5 Chiral helical superstructures provide a platform to control photon polarization and electron spin, yet they are challenging to construct using inorganic materials. Now, homochiral triple helices that exhibit pronounced circularly polarized luminescence have been assembled from gold by tailoring the steric and stereochemical properties of supporting chiral cyclic ligands.

articles.title: Interpretable machine learning of formation energies and band gaps in hybrid perovskites through SHAP analysis and SISSO modelling
articles.title_zh: 通过 SHAP 分析和 SISSO 建模对混合钙钛矿中的形成能和带隙进行可解释的机器学习
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.09944v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Accurate and interpretable property prediction is essential for exploring hybrid organic-inorganic perovskites. Here, we combine machine-learning screening with SHAP analysis and SISSO descriptor discovery. Using 4,456 compounds, optimized XGBoost models achieved test-set R² values of 0.99 for formation energy and 0.93 for band gap and were applied to over 180,000 candidates. Comparison across approximately 17,000 common compounds revealed broadly overlapping distributions from XGBoost and CGCNN but substantially lower predictions from UPET, suggesting potential limitations in its transferability to hybrid organic-inorganic perovskites. SHAP analysis and correlation-based pruning retained eight primary features for each property, from which SISSO derived expressions comprising four nonlinear descriptors. These expressions couple molecular and inorganic properties for formation energy and emphasize relative atomic sizes and B-site characteristics for band gap. This framework supports efficient candidate prioritization and interpretable analysis of learned structures-property relationships in hybrid perovskites.
articles.abstract_zh: 准确且可解释的性质预测对于探索有机-无机杂化钙钛矿至关重要。在这里，我们将机器学习筛选与 SHAP 分析和 SISSO 描述符发现相结合。使用 4,456 种化合物，优化的 XGBoost 模型在测试集上实现了形成能 R² 值为 0.99，带隙 R² 值为 0.93，并应用于超过 180,000 个候选化合物。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 准确且可解释的性质预测对于探索有机-无机杂化钙钛矿至关重要。在这里，我们将机器学习筛选与 SHAP 分析和 SISSO 描述符发现相结合。使用 4,456 种化合物，优化的 XGBoost 模型在测试集上实现了形成能 R² 值为 0.99，带隙 R² 值为 0.93，并应用于超过 180,000 个候选化合物。对大约 17,000 种常见化合物的比较揭示了 XGBoost 和 CGCNN 的分布广泛重叠，但 UPET 的预测大大降低，这表明其向混合有机-无机钙钛矿的可转移性存在潜在限制。 SHAP 分析和基于相关性的修剪保留了每个属性的八个主要特征，SISSO 从中导出了包含四个非线性描述符的表达式。这些表达式结合了形成能的分子和无机特性，并强调了带隙的相对原子尺寸和 B 位特征。该框架支持有效的候选优先级排序和对混合钙钛矿中学习的结构-性质关系的可解释分析。

articles.title: Interception Focusing of Colloid Transport in Granular Porous Media
articles.title_zh: 粒状多孔介质中胶体传输的拦截聚焦
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.09947v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Colloid transport and retention in environmental granular porous media underlie groundwater resource protection from, and remediation using, biological and non-biological nano- and micro-particles (colloids). During transport, colloids periodically intercept grain surfaces and translate along them at separation distances across several tens of nm corresponding to the secondary minimum between the opposing forces of longer-range of van der Waals (VDW) attraction and shorter-range electric double layer (EDL) repulsion. Relatively weak diffusive translation of colloids supports their continued translation in secondary minimum association until they are expelled to bulk fluid at rear flow stagnation zones on grain leeward sides. We herein show that this dynamic focuses colloids into a network of fluid streamlines (incomplete mixing lamellae) that enhances their subsequent likelihood of interception with downgradient grains, i.e., increases the so-called collector efficiency (typically denoted by Greek letter eta). Interception focusing of colloids in granular porous media explains well-observed outcomes of colloid transport under environmental conditions, including nonmonotonic nonexponential profiles of retained colloids and the non-Markovian nature of extended tailing of low colloid concentrations following initial elution. Interception focusing is a fundamental process that distinguishes colloids from solutes and renders inapplicable to colloids the assumption that is often invoked for solutes of complete pore scale mixing in granular porous media.
articles.abstract_zh: 环境粒状多孔介质中的胶体传输和保留是地下水资源保护和利用生物和非生物纳米和微米颗粒（胶体）进行修复的基础。在运输过程中，胶体周期性地拦截颗粒表面，并以数十纳米的间隔距离沿颗粒平移，该距离对应于长程范德华 (VDW) 吸引力和短程双电层 (EDL) 排斥力之间的相反力之间的次要最小值。胶体相对较弱的扩散平移支持它们在次要最小缔合中的持续平移，直到它们被排出到颗粒背风侧的后流停滞区处的大量流体中。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 环境粒状多孔介质中的胶体传输和保留是地下水资源保护和利用生物和非生物纳米和微米颗粒（胶体）进行修复的基础。在运输过程中，胶体周期性地拦截颗粒表面，并以数十纳米的间隔距离沿颗粒平移，该距离对应于长程范德华 (VDW) 吸引力和短程双电层 (EDL) 排斥力之间的相反力之间的次要最小值。胶体相对较弱的扩散平移支持它们在次要最小缔合中的持续平移，直到它们被排出到颗粒背风侧的后流停滞区处的大量流体中。我们在此表明，这种动态将胶体集中到流体流线网络（不完全混合片层）中，从而增强了它们随后被降梯度颗粒拦截的可能性，即增加了所谓的收集器效率（通常用希腊字母 eta 表示）。粒状多孔介质中胶体的截获聚焦解释了在环境条件下观察到的胶体传输结果，包括保留胶体的非单调非指数分布以及初始洗脱后低胶体浓度延长拖尾的非马尔可夫性质。截获聚焦是区分胶体和溶质的基本过程，并且使颗粒状多孔介质中完全孔隙尺度混合的溶质经常引用的假设不适用于胶体。

articles.title: Topology and Information in Regularized Transport on Graphs
articles.title_zh: 图正则传输中的拓扑和信息
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.09968v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study how two geometries of mass on a finite graph interact: the information geometry of the generalized entropy F_q used for regularized transport, and the arithmetic of divisors governed by the Riemann--Roch theorem of Baker and Norine and by the Jacobian. Because the correction term of F_q is affine, F_q-regularization at strength γ is Tsallis regularization at temperature γ/q. Over the reals, chip-firing connects all configurations of equal degree, so the Jacobian enters transport only through integrality. We introduce the transport defect, the worst-case cost of steering d chips towards a target by chip-firing, and prove 1/dleδTV(D)le(d-r(D))/d=(g-1-r(K-D))/dlemin(1,g/d) whenever gge1; vertex multiplicities give a lower bound and an equality criterion. A regularized topological gap Γq,γ(D,E) tends to the chip-move defect as γ→0, lies in an explicit window, has a high-temperature slope given by Tsallis coupling entropies, and admits a positive regime if and only if gge1. Dual potentials certify exactly the convex relaxation of a linear system; the remainder is an integrality gap. Zeros in optimal plans occur only for q>1, by a mechanism different from the sign change of Γ. Exact computations on 1784 divisor classes find the rank bound (d-r(D))/d attained in 1769 of them, an observed frequency. Experiments on honeycomb and Erdős--Rényi networks with 10² to 10⁵ nodes test the statements on regularized plans, not Γ; over 10³le nle10⁵ their transport costs are consistent with growth like n¹/² and log n, respectively.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们研究有限图上的两种质量几何如何相互作用：用于正则化传输的广义熵 F_q 的信息几何，以及由 Baker 和 Norine 的黎曼-罗赫定理以及雅可比行列式控制的除数算术。由于 F_q 的校正项是仿射的，因此强度 γ 处的 F_q 正则化是温度 γ/q 处的 Tsallis 正则化。在实数上，芯片发射连接所有同等程度的配置，因此雅可比行列式仅通过完整性进入传输。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们研究有限图上的两种质量几何如何相互作用：用于正则化传输的广义熵 F_q 的信息几何，以及由 Baker 和 Norine 的黎曼-罗赫定理以及雅可比行列式控制的除数算术。由于 F_q 的校正项是仿射的，因此强度 γ 处的 F_q 正则化是温度 γ/q 处的 Tsallis 正则化。在实数上，芯片发射连接所有同等程度的配置，因此雅可比行列式仅通过完整性进入传输。我们引入了传输缺陷，即通过芯片发射将 d 芯片导向目标的最坏情况成本，并证明 1/dleδTV(D)le(d-r(D))/d=(g-1-r(K-D))/dlemin(1,g/d) 每当 gge1;顶点重数给出了下界和相等标准。当 γ→0 时，正则化拓扑间隙 Гq,γ(D,E) 趋向于芯片移动缺陷，位于显式窗口中，具有由 Tsallis 耦合熵给出的高温斜率，并且当且仅当 gge1 时才允许正状态。对偶势准确地证明了线性系统的凸松弛；其余部分是完整性差距。最优计划中的零仅在 q>1 时出现，其机制与 Γ 的符号变化不同。对 1784 个除数类的精确计算找到了其中 1769 个除数类所达到的等级界限 (d-r(D))/d，即观察到的频率。具有 10² 到 10⁵ 节点的蜂窝网络和 Erdős-Rényi 网络的实验测试了正则化计划的陈述，而不是 Γ；超过 10³le nle10⁵ 时，它们的运输成本分别与 n1/² 和 log n 等增长一致。

articles.title: Enhancement of the magnetorheological effect using discontinuous shear thickening with a mixture of magnetic and non magnetic particles
articles.title_zh: 使用磁性和非磁性颗粒的混合物进行不连续剪切增稠增强磁流变效应
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.09970v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The phenomenon of discontinuous shear thickening (DST) is observed in suspensions of solid particles with a very high-volume fraction. Using a suspension of magnetic particles at high-volume fraction we have, for the first time, demonstrated experimentally the presence of a frictional network of particles by a simultaneous measurement of the electrical resistance of the suspension and of the rheological curve. An obstacle for the applications of MRS remains the sedimentation and aggregation linked to the high density of the iron microparticles. We have recently found that a small fraction of ferromagnetic particles within a concentrated suspension of calcium carbonate particles is not only sufficient to trigger the transition by application of a magnetic field but also optimum for the amplitude of the jump in viscosity observed in DST. We shall explain this result from stress transmission between the magnetic particles and nonmagnetic ones, both inserted in the percolated network of particles. We will also highlight the role of the polyelectrolyte adsorbed on the surface of the particles in the DST transition through the balance between the repulsive entropic force between two layers of polymer adsorbed on different particles and the magnetic attraction force.
articles.abstract_zh: 在具有非常高体积分数的固体颗粒悬浮液中观察到不连续剪切增稠（DST）现象。使用高体积分数的磁性颗粒悬浮液，我们通过同时测量悬浮液的电阻和流变曲线，首次通过实验证明了颗粒摩擦网络的存在。 MRS 应用的一个障碍仍然是与高密度铁微粒相关的沉积和聚集。我们最近发现，碳酸钙颗粒浓缩悬浮液中的一小部分铁磁颗粒不仅足以通过施加磁场来触发转变，而且对于 DST 中观察到的粘度跳跃幅度来说也是最佳的。我们将通过磁性颗粒和非磁性颗粒之间的应力传递来解释这一结果，两者都插入颗粒的渗透网络中。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在具有非常高体积分数的固体颗粒悬浮液中观察到不连续剪切增稠（DST）现象。使用高体积分数的磁性颗粒悬浮液，我们通过同时测量悬浮液的电阻和流变曲线，首次通过实验证明了颗粒摩擦网络的存在。 MRS 应用的一个障碍仍然是与高密度铁微粒相关的沉积和聚集。我们最近发现，碳酸钙颗粒浓缩悬浮液中的一小部分铁磁颗粒不仅足以通过施加磁场来触发转变，而且对于 DST 中观察到的粘度跳跃幅度来说也是最佳的。我们将通过磁性颗粒和非磁性颗粒之间的应力传递来解释这一结果，两者都插入颗粒的渗透网络中。我们还将通过吸附在不同颗粒上的两层聚合物之间的排斥熵力与磁吸引力之间的平衡来强调吸附在颗粒表面的聚电解质在 DST 转变中的作用。

articles.title: A transversely isotropic constitutive model for semisoft elasticity in main-chain liquid crystal elastomers
articles.title_zh: 主链液晶弹性体半软弹性横观各向同性本构模型
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.10060v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Monodomain main-chain liquid crystal elastomers exhibit pronounced stiffness anisotropy and broad semisoft plateaus following finite onset strains. At fixed chain anisotropy, the neo-classical model predicts equal principal Young's moduli, while its transversely isotropic extension with a constant semisoft modulus constrains the relation between reorientation onset and subsequent stress growth. We develop a finite-strain, isothermal elastic model combining transversely isotropic network elasticity with a deformation-dependent quadratic semisoft penalty. Within a weak-fluctuation approximation, a reduced statistical closure based on assumed linear contraction of effective local anisotropy fluctuations at fixed mean anisotropy yields an exponential transition from an initial to a residual semisoft modulus. The network energy preserves ideal soft modes, and the formulation recovers the de Gennes strain-director coupling in the infinitesimal limit. Analytical relations for perpendicular tension show that the rotating-stage stress depends on both the current semisoft modulus and its derivative with respect to the first deformation invariant. This permits a finite onset followed by a substantially flatter rotating response than in the constant-modulus limit. Oblique tension couples director rotation, shear and lateral contraction. Comparisons with orientation-dependent measurements using a common parameter set capture the principal stiffness contrast and broad perpendicular plateau, with discrepancies remaining in oblique stresses and intermediate-angle initial moduli.
articles.abstract_zh: 单畴主链液晶弹性体在有限起始应变后表现出明显的刚度各向异性和宽阔的半软平台。在固定链各向异性下，新古典模型预测相等的主杨氏模量，而其具有恒定半软模量的横向各向同性延伸限制了重新取向开始与随后的应力增长之间的关系。我们开发了一种有限应变等温弹性模型，将横向各向同性网络弹性与变形相关的二次半软罚分相结合。在弱波动近似内，基于固定平均各向异性下有效局部各向异性波动的假设线性收缩的减少的统计闭包产生从初始到残余半软模量的指数转变。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 单畴主链液晶弹性体在有限起始应变后表现出明显的刚度各向异性和宽阔的半软平台。在固定链各向异性下，新古典模型预测相等的主杨氏模量，而其具有恒定半软模量的横向各向同性延伸限制了重新取向开始与随后的应力增长之间的关系。我们开发了一种有限应变等温弹性模型，将横向各向同性网络弹性与变形相关的二次半软罚分相结合。在弱波动近似内，基于固定平均各向异性下有效局部各向异性波动的假设线性收缩的减少的统计闭包产生从初始到残余半软模量的指数转变。网络能量保留了理想的软模式，并且该公式在无穷小极限内恢复了 de Gennes 应变-导向器耦合。垂直张力的解析关系表明，旋转台应力取决于当前的半软模量及其相对于第一变形不变量的导数。这允许有限的起始，随后是比恒定模量极限更平坦的旋转响应。斜拉力耦合导向旋转、剪切和横向收缩。使用通用参数集与方向相关测量进行比较，捕获主刚度对比和宽阔的垂直平台，但倾斜应力和中间角初始模量仍存在差异。

articles.title: Roadmap on Nanoscale Superconductivity for Quantum Technologies
articles.title_zh: 量子技术纳米级超导路线图
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.10076v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In 2025, the Year of Quantum Science and Technology, we celebrate a century of quantum mechanics, witnessing a surge in activities that illuminate its inherent strangeness and drive technological innovation. Superconductivity, discovered 114 years ago, stands as a prime example, offering direct and compelling evidence of macroscopic quantum phenomena. Beyond its ability to conduct immense currents without loss, superconductivity reveals the quantum realm operating on a scale we can directly observe and manipulate. The macroscopic quantum coherence, where an ensemble of particles is described by a single wave function, leads to remarkable consequences: dissipation-less current and flux quantization - the basic properties exploited in superconducting quantum circuit fabrication. This Roadmap has been inspired by intensive discussions and collaborations emerging from the European COST Action CA21144 (SuperQuMap - Superconducting Nanodevices and Quantum Materials for Coherent Manipulation). The roadmap outlines the network's concrete activities, driving advancements in superconductor-based quantum technologies and charting future directions. Spanning fundamental research to practical applications, the roadmap incorporates insights from industry partners developing quantum computation. It begins by exploring quantum materials, highlighting how topology and electronic correlations could catalyze a quantum leap in technology. We then delve into manipulating the superconducting phase, leveraging advancements in magnetism, 3D fabrication, and tunable correlations. Further, we showcase the advanced microscopy techniques - such as angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy and scanning probes - used to visualize quantum behavior. Finally, and crucially, we detail the quantum devices developed within the network, and their transformative impact on modern quantum computing approaches.
articles.abstract_zh: 2025 年是量子科学技术年，我们庆祝量子力学百年，见证了一系列活动的激增，这些活动阐明了其固有的奇异性并推动了技术创新。 114 年前发现的超导性就是一个典型的例子，为宏观量子现象提供了直接且令人信服的证据。除了能够无损耗地传导巨大电流之外，超导性还揭示了我们可以直接观察和操纵的量子领域。宏观量子相干性（其中粒子集合由单个波函数描述）会产生显着的后果：无耗散电流和通量量子化 - 超导量子电路制造中利用的基本特性。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 2025 年是量子科学技术年，我们庆祝量子力学百年，见证了一系列活动的激增，这些活动阐明了其固有的奇异性并推动了技术创新。 114 年前发现的超导性就是一个典型的例子，为宏观量子现象提供了直接且令人信服的证据。除了能够无损耗地传导巨大电流之外，超导性还揭示了我们可以直接观察和操纵的量子领域。宏观量子相干性（其中粒子集合由单个波函数描述）会产生显着的后果：无耗散电流和通量量子化 - 超导量子电路制造中利用的基本特性。该路线图的灵感来自于欧洲成本行动 CA21144（SuperQuMap - 用于相干操纵的超导纳米器件和量子材料）中出现的深入讨论和合作。该路线图概述了该网络的具体活动，推动基于超导体的量子技术的进步并规划未来方向。该路线图涵盖基础研究到实际应用，融合了开发量子计算的行业合作伙伴的见解。它首先探索量子材料，强调拓扑和电子关联如何催化技术的量子飞跃。然后，我们利用磁性、3D 制造和可调相关性方面的进步，深入研究操纵超导相。此外，我们还展示了用于可视化量子行为的先进显微镜技术，例如角度分辨光电子能谱和扫描探针。最后，也是至关重要的，我们详细介绍了网络内开发的量子设备，以及它们对现代量子计算方法的变革性影响。

articles.title: Pelletization Pressure Engineering of the Superconducting Properties of Fluorine-Doped PrFeAsO
articles.title_zh: 掺氟PrFeAsO超导性能的造粒压力工程
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.10083v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We investigate the influence of the pelletization pressure on the structural, microstructural, and superconducting properties of fluorine-doped PrFeAsO0.7F0.3 (Pr1111). Precursor powders are pressed into pellets at pressures ranging from 174 to 1131 MPa, after which the applied pressure is released and all samples undergo an identical two-step conventional synthesis process at ambient pressure (CSP-AP). All samples predominantly exhibit the tetragonal P4/nmm structure, and the lattice parameter a and unit-cell volume V decrease with increasing pelletization pressure up to an intermediate-pressure range (~900 MPa) before increasing at higher pressures. The actual fluorine-content derived from energy-dispersive X-ray spectroscopy (EDX) also increase with pelletization pressure, while Raman spectra show only modest variations in the characteristic vibrational modes associated with Fe and As. The superconducting response exhibits a non-monotonic dependence on the pelletization pressure. Among the investigated samples, the sample pelletized at 870 MPa exhibits the most favorable overall superconducting properties, with a superconducting onset temperature of 44.2 K, ~5 K higher than that of the lowest-pressure sample. It also displays a narrower superconducting transition, the highest relative sample density, a favorable effective magnetic critical current density at high fields, and a relatively large effective thermally activated flux-flow activation energy. At higher pelletization pressures, the superconducting response deteriorates, coinciding with increases in the lattice parameters, increased secondary-phase contributions, and reduced relative density. These findings establish the pelletization pressure as a relevant processing parameter for modifying the structural, microstructural and superconducting properties of Pr1111 during CSP-AP.
