These results provide a quantitative reference for interpreting NMR experiments in DNL materials and for identifying genuine correlation effects beyond DOS-induced contributions.
articles.abstract_zh: 核磁共振研究中的 Korringa 因子 K(α) 是金属中电子相关效应的广泛使用的度量，通常使用非相关值 K(α) = 1 进行解释。然而，在狄拉克费米子系统中，非相关参考值取决于电子态密度 (DOS)，并且与常规金属的电子态密度不同。在这里，我们使用基于 DOS 的方法从理论上研究了具有有限节点线色散的狄拉克节点线 (DNL) 系统中的非相关 Korringa 因子 K^*(α)。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 核磁共振研究中的 Korringa 因子 K(α) 是金属中电子相关效应的广泛使用的度量，通常使用非相关值 K(α) = 1 进行解释。然而，在狄拉克费米子系统中，非相关参考值取决于电子态密度 (DOS)，并且与常规金属的电子态密度不同。在这里，我们使用基于 DOS 的方法从理论上研究了具有有限节点线色散的狄拉克节点线 (DNL) 系统中的非相关 Korringa 因子 K^*(α)。我们证明 K^*(α) 表现出内在的温度依赖性，从高温下的狄拉克费米子值 1.71 不断演变到低温下的金属值 1。研究发现，交叉温度与节点线色散宽度成正比，节点线色散宽度被确定为控制 DNL 系统中不相关 Korringa 因子的特征能量尺度。我们进一步证明朗道量子化产生奇异的 DOS 结构，该结构强烈增强 K^*(α)，即使在没有电子相关性的情况下也会产生明显的峰值。此外，K^*(α) 表现出由层内和层间贡献引起的两种不同类型的磁振荡。后者源于属于费米能级正负量子数朗道子带的奇点的重叠，代表了 DNL 有限能量色散的独特结果。这些结果为解释 DNL 材料中的 NMR 实验以及识别 DOS 引起的贡献之外的真正相关效应提供了定量参考。

articles.title: Continuum Dirac Theory and Nonlinear Extensions of a Chain of Alternating non-linear springs: an SSH version of the Fermi-Pasta-Ulam-Tsingou model
articles.title_zh: 连续统狄拉克理论和交替非线性弹簧链的非线性扩展：Fermi-Pasta-Ulam-Tsingou 模型的 SSH 版本
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.04049v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: A mechanical version of the SSH model, made of equal masses joined by two alternating non-linear springs is studied in the continuum limit. Such a non-linear dimerized mechanical chain generates a nonlinear, dispersive, two-field hyperbolic system of Boussinesq type of differential equations, describing coupled acoustic and gapped optical fields. The corresponding Lagrangian density is found, revealing that the acoustic and optical degrees of freedom are coupled through a structure that is formally analogous to a synthetic spin-orbit coupling, where the spatial motion is locked to the internal sublattice degree of freedom. An emergent non-Abelian Berry connection term also appears. Some particular solitary-wave solutions are found using variational theory, as the effective optical field obeys an undamped and unforced cubic-quintic Duffing equation. Near the Brillouin-zone edge, the system becomes a nonlinear Dirac field theory of the Soler type, providing a direct mechanical realization of interacting relativistic solitons. By factoring out fast spatial oscillations, an effective Jackiw-Rebbi Hamiltonian is obtained, with topological zero modes at domain walls. These modes are akin to the electronic flat bands in moire graphene systems associated with superconductivity and charge fractionalization. Finally, we discuss the mechanical rigidity transition and its effects on the fields as the system evolves toward the fully dimerized limit, in which the zero modes are floppy modes.
articles.abstract_zh: 在连续介质极限下研究了 SSH 模型的机械版本，该模型由两个交替的非线性弹簧连接的相等质量组成。这种非线性二聚机械链生成布辛涅斯克型微分方程的非线性、色散、双场双曲系统，描述耦合的声场和间隙光场。找到了相应的拉格朗日密度，揭示了声学和光学自由度是通过一种形式上类似于合成自旋轨道耦合的结构耦合的，其中空间运动被锁定到内部亚晶格自由度。还出现了一个新兴的非阿贝尔贝里连接项。使用变分理论找到了一些特定的孤立波解，因为有效光场服从无阻尼且无受迫的三次五次杜芬方程。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在连续介质极限下研究了 SSH 模型的机械版本，该模型由两个交替的非线性弹簧连接的相等质量组成。这种非线性二聚机械链生成布辛涅斯克型微分方程的非线性、色散、双场双曲系统，描述耦合的声场和间隙光场。找到了相应的拉格朗日密度，揭示了声学和光学自由度是通过一种形式上类似于合成自旋轨道耦合的结构耦合的，其中空间运动被锁定到内部亚晶格自由度。还出现了一个新兴的非阿贝尔贝里连接项。使用变分理论找到了一些特定的孤立波解，因为有效光场服从无阻尼且无受迫的三次五次杜芬方程。在布里渊区边缘附近，系统变成索勒型非线性狄拉克场论，提供相互作用的相对论孤子的直接机械实现。通过分解快速空间振荡，获得有效的 Jackiw-Rebbi 哈密顿量，在畴壁处具有拓扑零模式。这些模式类似于莫尔石墨烯系统中与超导性和电荷分级相关的电子平带。最后，我们讨论了当系统向完全二聚极限演化时，机械刚性转变及其对场的影响，其中零模式是软盘模式。

articles.title: Resolving magnetic order and dynamics with polarized neutron scattering: a practical guide to longitudinal polarization analysis
articles.title_zh: 用极化中子散射解析磁序和动力学：纵向极化分析实用指南
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.04050v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Neutron scattering provides microscopic information on magnetic order and spin dynamics. Most experiments, however, use unpolarized neutrons and do not fully exploit the information carried by the neutron spin. Longitudinal polarization analysis (LPA), established in the pioneering work of Moon, Riste, and Koehler at Oak Ridge National Laboratory in the late 1960s, separates magnetic and nonmagnetic scattering contributions through their different effects on the neutron spin. In this review, we illustrate how LPA can distinguish weak magnetic scattering from nonmagnetic contributions, constrain small moment components, and resolve the spin-space anisotropy of magnetic excitations. We introduce the formalism connecting measured polarization channels to magnetic quantities and discuss scattering geometry, crystallographic projections, and corrections for finite polarization. Our aim is to provide a practical guide for neutron scatterers using LPA to determine magnetic structures and characterize spin excitations in quantum materials. We conclude with opportunities in altermagnets, unconventional superconductors, and kagome magnets.
articles.abstract_zh: 中子散射提供有关磁序和自旋动力学的微观信息。然而，大多数实验使用非极化中子，并没有充分利用中子自旋携带的信息。纵向极化分析 (LPA) 是由 Moon、Riste 和 Koehler 于 20 世纪 60 年代末在橡树岭国家实验室的开创性工作中建立的，通过磁性和非磁性散射对中子自旋的不同影响来区分它们。在这篇综述中，我们阐述了 LPA 如何区分弱磁散射和非磁贡献，约束小矩分量，并解决磁激励的自旋空间各向异性。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 中子散射提供有关磁序和自旋动力学的微观信息。然而，大多数实验使用非极化中子，并没有充分利用中子自旋携带的信息。纵向极化分析 (LPA) 是由 Moon、Riste 和 Koehler 于 20 世纪 60 年代末在橡树岭国家实验室的开创性工作中建立的，通过磁性和非磁性散射对中子自旋的不同影响来区分它们。在这篇综述中，我们阐述了 LPA 如何区分弱磁散射和非磁贡献，约束小矩分量，并解决磁激励的自旋空间各向异性。我们介绍了将测量的偏振通道与磁量连接起来的形式，并讨论了散射几何、晶体学投影和有限偏振的校正。我们的目标是为中子散射体使用 LPA 确定磁性结构和表征量子材料中的自旋激发提供实用指南。我们最后总结了交流磁体、非常规超导体和戈薇磁体方面的机遇。

articles.title: Non-equilibrium orientational dynamics of pinned topological defects in two-dimensional nematic liquid crystals
articles.title_zh: 二维向列液晶中钉扎拓扑缺陷的非平衡取向动力学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.04071v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The long-wavelength dynamics of two-dimensional (2D) nematic liquid crystals (LCs) is dominated by the motion of topological defects, which behave like interacting particles endowed with both topological charge and orientation. In experimentally relevant regimes, the translational dynamics of the defect positions can be accurately described by effective nematoelastic particle-particle interaction forces. By contrast, analogous quasistatic torque descriptions for the orientational dynamics typically fail due to a breakdown of time-scale separation, severely hindering the inverse design of texture response dynamics in nematic LCs. To overcome this obstruction, we introduce a linear phase-diffusion formulation that accurately predicts the orientational relaxation dynamics of pinned topological defects in the nonlinear 2D Landau-de Gennes theory. The broad practical potential of this approach is demonstrated by showing how it enables the inverse design of transient nematic patterns as well as the inference of hidden defect configurations from sparse measurements.
articles.abstract_zh: 二维 (2D) 向列液晶 (LC) 的长波长动力学由拓扑缺陷的运动主导，其行为就像具有拓扑电荷和取向的相互作用粒子。在实验相关的情况下，缺陷位置的平移动力学可以通过有效的线弹性粒子-粒子相互作用力来准确描述。相比之下，取向动力学的类似准静态扭矩描述通常会由于时间尺度分离的破坏而失败，严重阻碍了向列液晶中纹理响应动力学的逆向设计。为了克服这一障碍，我们引入了一种线性相扩散公式，该公式可以准确预测非线性 2D Landau-de Gennes 理论中固定拓扑缺陷的取向弛豫动力学。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 二维 (2D) 向列液晶 (LC) 的长波长动力学由拓扑缺陷的运动主导，其行为就像具有拓扑电荷和取向的相互作用粒子。在实验相关的情况下，缺陷位置的平移动力学可以通过有效的线弹性粒子-粒子相互作用力来准确描述。相比之下，取向动力学的类似准静态扭矩描述通常会由于时间尺度分离的破坏而失败，严重阻碍了向列液晶中纹理响应动力学的逆向设计。为了克服这一障碍，我们引入了一种线性相扩散公式，该公式可以准确预测非线性 2D Landau-de Gennes 理论中固定拓扑缺陷的取向弛豫动力学。该方法的广泛实际潜力通过展示它如何实现瞬态向列图案的逆设计以及从稀疏测量推断隐藏缺陷配置来证明。

articles.title: Multi-Fidelity Machine Learning for Predicting Startup Stress Growth and Strain Hardening in Wormlike Micellar Solutions
articles.title_zh: 用于预测蠕虫胶束解决方案中的启动应力增长和应变硬化的多保真机器学习
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.04115v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Wormlike micellar solutions exhibit formulation-dependent nonlinear startup responses, including stress overshoot, undershoot, and strain hardening, making prediction across compositions and shear rates challenging. We developed a multi-fidelity machine-learning framework to predict stress-growth curves in cetylpyridinium chloride (CPyCl)-based wormlike micelles from sparse experimental measurements. The framework combines a low-fidelity analytical model describing the overall startup response with high-fidelity experimental data capturing formulation-specific nonlinear features. This approach addresses the limited and uneven coverage of salt chemistry, concentration, and shear rate without relying solely on data-intensive neural-network training. The trained model predicts complete stress-growth responses at untested shear rates and enables extraction of strain-hardening characteristics from interpolated curves. By augmenting sparse rheological measurements, the framework provides a basis for exploring relationships among formulation variables, linear viscoelastic properties, and nonlinear startup behavior, while supporting more efficient characterization of wormlike micellar solutions.
articles.abstract_zh: 蠕虫状胶束溶液表现出依赖于配方的非线性启动响应，包括应力过冲、下冲和应变硬化，使得对成分和剪切速率的预测具有挑战性。我们开发了一种多保真度机器学习框架，可以通过稀疏的实验测量来预测基于氯化十六烷基吡啶 (CPyCl) 的蠕虫状胶束的应力增长曲线。该框架结合了描述整体启动响应的低保真分析模型和捕获配方特定非线性特征的高保真实验数据。该方法解决了盐化学、浓度和剪切速率的有限且不均匀的覆盖范围，而无需仅依赖数据密集型神经网络训练。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 蠕虫状胶束溶液表现出依赖于配方的非线性启动响应，包括应力过冲、下冲和应变硬化，使得对成分和剪切速率的预测具有挑战性。我们开发了一种多保真度机器学习框架，可以通过稀疏的实验测量来预测基于氯化十六烷基吡啶 (CPyCl) 的蠕虫状胶束的应力增长曲线。该框架结合了描述整体启动响应的低保真分析模型和捕获配方特定非线性特征的高保真实验数据。该方法解决了盐化学、浓度和剪切速率的有限且不均匀的覆盖范围，而无需仅依赖数据密集型神经网络训练。经过训练的模型可以预测未经测试的剪切速率下的完整应力增长响应，并能够从插值曲线中提取应变硬化特征。通过增强稀疏流变测量，该框架为探索配方变量、线性粘弹性特性和非线性启动行为之间的关系提供了基础，同时支持更有效地表征蠕虫状胶束溶液。

articles.title: Altermagnetism-induced Fulde-Ferrell-Larkin-Ovchinnikov superfluids and momentum-selective pairing channels in optical lattices
articles.title_zh: 交变磁力诱导的 Fulde-Ferrell-Larkin-Ovchinnikov 超流体和光学晶格中的动量选择性配对通道
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.04214v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study the superfluid phases of a two-dimensional degenerate Fermi gas in an optical lattice subject to a dₓy-wave altermagnetic term that couples to the in-plane spin component. The single-particle Hamiltonian generates anisotropic Fermi surfaces for the two pseudo-spin species while maintaining zero net polarization. Using the Bogoliubov-de Gennes approach, we show that this anisotropy favors Cooper pairing at a finite center-of-mass momentum, producing a competition between Bardeen-Cooper-Schrieffer (BCS) and Fulde-Ferrell-Larkin-Ovchinnikov (FFLO) pairing and leading to FFLO superfluids. We further examine the effect of a Zeeman-induced spin polarization and find that triplet and singlet pairing channels coexist and compete, resulting in a momentum-selective pairing pattern. Remarkably, this triplet pairing emerges exclusively in the FFLO phase and is entirely absent in the BCS phase. The model is readily realizable in ultracold atoms with current experimental techniques, providing a feasible route for quantum emulation and for studying unconventional superfluid phases.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们研究了光学晶格中二维简并费米气体的超流体相，该气体受到与面内自旋分量耦合的 dₓy 波交磁项的影响。单粒子哈密顿量为两个赝自旋物种生成各向异性费米表面，同时保持零净极化。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们研究了光学晶格中二维简并费米气体的超流体相，该气体受到与面内自旋分量耦合的 dₓy 波交磁项的影响。单粒子哈密顿量为两个赝自旋物种生成各向异性费米表面，同时保持零净极化。使用 Bogoliubov-de Gennes 方法，我们表明这种各向异性有利于有限质心动量下的 Cooper 配对，从而产生 Bardeen-Cooper-Schrieffer (BCS) 和 Fulde-Ferrell-Larkin-Ovchinnikov (FFLO) 配对之间的竞争，并导致 FFLO 超流体。我们进一步研究了塞曼诱导的自旋极化的影响，发现三重态和单重态配对通道共存并竞争，从而产生动量选择性配对模式。值得注意的是，这种三联体配对仅出现在 FFLO 阶段，而在 BCS 阶段完全不存在。该模型可以利用当前的实验技术在超冷原子中轻松实现，为量子仿真和非常规超流体相的研究提供了可行的途径。

articles.title: Thermally enhanced magnon-phonon resonance in van der Waals antiferromagnet FePS3
articles.title_zh: 范德华反铁磁体 FePS3 中的热增强磁振子共振
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.04229v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Strong coupling between collective excitations provides a route to controlling quantum states of matter, yet its evolution under thermal fluctuations remains poorly understood. In the van der Waals antiferromagnet FePS3, strong magnon-phonon coupling is established at low temperatures. At the same time, recent terahertz experiments revealed the counterintuitive stabilization of a long-lived metastable magnetic state with an exceedingly long lifetime of 5 msec at the antiferromagnetic transition, not at the base temperature. This was attributed to a strongly coupled spin-lattice scenario, challenging the conventional wisdom that increased magnetic and thermal fluctuations near TN should be detrimental to the coherent control of a metastable phase. Thus it requires an independent examination for correct understanding. Using high-field Raman spectroscopy, we systematically investigate the temperature evolution of magnon-phonon coupling in FePS3. We observe a pronounced avoided crossing between magnon and phonon modes across a wide range of temperatures and find that the coupling strength remains remarkably robust with increasing temperatures. The zero-field magnon-phonon detuning decreases progressively with warming, driving the system toward resonance and thereby enhancing their hybridization near the transition temperature. This anomalous thermal evolution provides the crucial key to understanding the unusual terahertz-driven states recently reported in FePS3. More broadly, our results highlight van der Waals magnets as a promising platform for strong coupling among collective excitations and for controlling magnetic states through light-matter interactions.
articles.abstract_zh: 集体激发之间的强耦合提供了控制物质量子态的途径，但其在热波动下的演化仍然知之甚少。在范德华反铁磁体 FePS3 中，在低温下建立了强磁振子耦合。与此同时，最近的太赫兹实验揭示了一种反直觉的长期亚稳态磁态稳定性，其在反铁磁转变时而不是在基础温度下具有 5 毫秒的超长寿命。这是由于强耦合的自旋晶格场景，挑战了传统观点，即 TN 附近增加的磁和热波动应该不利于亚稳态相的相干控制。因此，需要进行独立检查才能正确理解。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 集体激发之间的强耦合提供了控制物质量子态的途径，但其在热波动下的演化仍然知之甚少。在范德华反铁磁体 FePS3 中，在低温下建立了强磁振子耦合。与此同时，最近的太赫兹实验揭示了一种反直觉的长期亚稳态磁态稳定性，其在反铁磁转变时而不是在基础温度下具有 5 毫秒的超长寿命。这是由于强耦合的自旋晶格场景，挑战了传统观点，即 TN 附近增加的磁和热波动应该不利于亚稳态相的相干控制。因此，需要进行独立检查才能正确理解。利用高场拉曼光谱，我们系统地研究了 FePS3 中磁振子-声子耦合的温度演化。我们观察到在很宽的温度范围内明显避免了磁振子模式和声子模式之间的交叉，并发现随着温度的升高，耦合强度仍然非常强大。零场磁振子-声子失谐随着变暖而逐渐减小，驱动系统共振，从而增强它们在转变温度附近的杂化。这种反常的热演化为理解最近在 FePS3 中报道的不寻常的太赫兹驱动状态提供了关键的关键。更广泛地说，我们的结果强调了范德华磁体作为集体激发之间强耦合以及通过光-物质相互作用控制磁态的有前途的平台。

articles.title: Anomalous Hall Response and Real-Space Current Correlations in Rhombohedral Graphene
articles.title_zh: 菱面体石墨烯中的反常霍尔响应和实空间电流相关性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.04312v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We investigate the anomalous Hall effect (AHE) and magnetization observed in rhombohedral graphene through real-space calculations which lead to new insights. Our calculations reveal no equilibrium loop currents of the type associated with the Haldane model of a quantum anomalous Hall insulator. Instead, the AHE arises in this instance from interference between electronic paths forming oriented closed Wilson loops of current operators in the presence of valley polarization. We show some examples of these Wilson loops. Using the fact that the added-carrier charge density resides dominantly in the top and bottom layers, we develop a real-space expansion of the surface Hamiltonian that reproduces the Hall response of the full model with good accuracy. We also predict that a smooth local potential induces equilibrium circulating currents whose strength depends on both Berry curvature and the orbital moments of states at the Fermi surface.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们通过实空间计算研究了菱面体石墨烯中观察到的反常霍尔效应（AHE）和磁化强度，从而得出新的见解。我们的计算表明，不存在与量子反常霍尔绝缘体霍尔丹模型相关的类型的平衡环路电流。相反，在这种情况下，AHE 是由于在存在谷极化的情况下形成电流算子的定向闭合威尔逊环的电子路径之间的干扰而产生的。我们展示了这些威尔逊环的一些示例。利用添加载流子电荷密度主要存在于顶层和底层的事实，我们开发了表面哈密顿量的实空间扩展，可以高精度地再现整个模型的霍尔响应。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们通过实空间计算研究了菱面体石墨烯中观察到的反常霍尔效应（AHE）和磁化强度，从而得出新的见解。我们的计算表明，不存在与量子反常霍尔绝缘体霍尔丹模型相关的类型的平衡环路电流。相反，在这种情况下，AHE 是由于在存在谷极化的情况下形成电流算子的定向闭合威尔逊环的电子路径之间的干扰而产生的。我们展示了这些威尔逊环的一些示例。利用添加载流子电荷密度主要存在于顶层和底层的事实，我们开发了表面哈密顿量的实空间扩展，可以高精度地再现整个模型的霍尔响应。我们还预测，平滑的局部势能引起平衡环流，其强度取决于贝里曲率和费米表面状态的轨道矩。

articles.title: LaQX: A JAX Toolkit for Neural Quantum State Simulations of Lattice Quantum Many-Body Models
articles.title_zh: LaQX：用于晶格量子多体模型神经量子态模拟的 JAX 工具包
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.04333v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Neural quantum states provide accurate variational representations for interacting lattice fermions and spins. Turning a new ansatz into a reproducible calculation, however, requires coordinated implementations of the Hamiltonian, sampling, optimization, observables, and accelerator parallelism. We present LaQX (Lattice Quantum simulation based on jaX), an open-source neural quantum state library based on JAX that organizes these components through common functional interfaces. Beyond ground-state variational Monte Carlo, LaQX supports excited-state calculations, Green's Function Monte Carlo refinement, adiabatic evolution, and real-time evolution with time-dependent variational Monte Carlo. It consolidates methods developed in recent high-accuracy neural quantum state studies of the Hubbard model and frustrated magnets, and the package has been used to investigate the triangular-lattice Hofstadter-Hubbard model. We document these capabilities with reproducible calculations for Hubbard, J₁-J₂ Heisenberg, altermagnetic Hubbard, and interacting Hofstadter models. Function-oriented modules separate the scientific components and limit the source context needed for extensions by human developers and large language models. Source code, documentation, and executable examples are available at https://github.com/bytedance/laqx.
articles.abstract_zh: 神经量子态为相互作用的晶格费米子和自旋提供了准确的变分表示。然而，将新的 ansatz 转变为可重复的计算，需要哈密顿量、采样、优化、可观测值和加速器并行性的协调实现。我们提出了 LaQX（基于 jaX 的晶格量子模拟），这是一个基于 JAX 的开源神经量子状态库，它通过通用功能接口组织这些组件。除了基态变分蒙特卡罗之外，LaQX 还支持激发态计算、格林函数蒙特卡罗细化、绝热演化以及依赖时间的变分蒙特卡罗的实时演化。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 神经量子态为相互作用的晶格费米子和自旋提供了准确的变分表示。然而，将新的 ansatz 转变为可重复的计算，需要哈密顿量、采样、优化、可观测值和加速器并行性的协调实现。我们提出了 LaQX（基于 jaX 的晶格量子模拟），这是一个基于 JAX 的开源神经量子状态库，它通过通用功能接口组织这些组件。除了基态变分蒙特卡罗之外，LaQX 还支持激发态计算、格林函数蒙特卡罗细化、绝热演化以及依赖时间的变分蒙特卡罗的实时演化。它整合了最近在哈伯德模型和受抑磁体的高精度神经量子态研究中开发的方法，并且该软件包已用于研究三角晶格 Hofstadter-Hubbard 模型。我们通过哈伯德、J₁-J2 海森堡、交流哈伯德和相互作用的霍夫施塔特模型的可重复计算来记录这些功能。面向功能的模块将科学组件分开，并限制人类开发人员和大型语言模型扩展所需的源上下文。源代码、文档和可执行示例可在 https://github.com/bytedance/laqx 上获取。

articles.title: TT-SCHA for Thermodynamics of Binary Alloys
articles.title_zh: 二元合金热力学的 TT-SCHA
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.04402v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The free energy of a crystal is an integral over the positions of all its atoms, in 3N dimensions. We evaluate it without random sampling for the ordered alloys B2 NiAl and gamma-TiAl with embedded-atom potentials, using a self-consistent harmonic approximation (SCHA) corrected to third order in temperature, calculated via thermal averages of tensor-train (TT) integrals built from one atom and its neighbors, which we call TT-SCHA. The result is for an infinite crystal without sampling error; its numerical error is set by the starting pivots of the interpolation (up to 9 MPa in the pressure, reduced by averaging three runs; SM Table S26). Against the molecular dynamics of 65,536 atoms (Frenkel-Ladd free energy at 600 K, integrated energy above), TT-SCHA free energy agrees to 0.13 meV per atom at 600-1000 K, using 420-500 times fewer core-seconds for one run. At zero pressure, results agree with published calculations that use the same embedded-atom potential: the published elastic constants of gamma-TiAl (to 1 GPa, by a static lattice calculation) and its thermal expansion from Monte Carlo sampling (to 0.012 percentage points).
articles.abstract_zh: 晶体的自由能是 3N 维中所有原子位置的积分。我们对具有嵌入原子势的有序合金 B2 NiAl 和 gamma-TiAl 进行了评估，无需随机采样，而是使用温度校正为三阶的自洽谐波近似 (SCHA)，通过由一个原子及其邻居构建的张量序列 (TT) 积分的热平均值计算，我们将其称为 TT-SCHA。结果是无限晶体，没有采样误差；其数值误差由插值的起始枢轴设置（压力高达 9 MPa，通过平均三次运行而减少；SM 表 S26）。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 晶体的自由能是 3N 维中所有原子位置的积分。我们对具有嵌入原子势的有序合金 B2 NiAl 和 gamma-TiAl 进行了评估，无需随机采样，而是使用温度校正为三阶的自洽谐波近似 (SCHA)，通过由一个原子及其邻居构建的张量序列 (TT) 积分的热平均值计算，我们将其称为 TT-SCHA。结果是无限晶体，没有采样误差；其数值误差由插值的起始枢轴设置（压力高达 9 MPa，通过平均三次运行而减少；SM 表 S26）。与 65,536 个原子的分子动力学（600 K 下的 Frenkel-Ladd 自由能，上面的积分能量）相比，TT-SCHA 自由能在 600-1000 K 下同意每个原子 0.13 meV，一次运行的核心秒数减少了 420-500 倍。在零压力下，结果与已发表的使用相同嵌入原子势的计算结果一致：已发表的 γ-TiAl 弹性常数（通过静态晶格计算达到 1 GPa）及其蒙特卡罗采样的热膨胀（达到 0.012 个百分点）。

articles.title: Strain-Glass Dynamics in the Superionic Conductor Na₃PS₄
articles.title_zh: 超离子导体 Na₃PS₄ 中的应变玻璃动力学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.04547v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Ionic conduction in solid-state electrolytes is conventionally described by mobile cations migrating through a static host lattice. Yet the fastest conductors are often the most disordered, and how disorder enhances transport remains unresolved at the mesoscale, inaccessible to ensemble-averaged probes. We use Bragg X-ray photon correlation spectroscopy to measure nanoscale structural dynamics of a single ball-milled Na₃PS₄ particle. We find that the cubic phase behaves as a strain glass: a frustrated configuration of three degenerate tetragonal variants with short-range order. Its domain-wall motion is stress-driven, crossing over irreversibly to thermally activated dynamics on annealing as residual milling stress is depleted. Rearrangements follow scale-free avalanche statistics, matching ferroelastic martensites but without external driving. The tetragonal polymorph shows none of these features and relaxes fifty times more slowly. These dynamics occur on timescales comparable to estimated ionic diffusion across the particle, indicating the host structure cannot be assumed static on transport-relevant timescales.
articles.abstract_zh: 固态电解质中的离子传导通常通过移动阳离子迁移穿过静态主晶格来描述。然而，最快的导体往往是最无序的，而无序如何增强传输在介观尺度上仍然悬而未决，集合平均探针无法访问。我们使用布拉格 X 射线光子相关光谱来测量单个球磨 Na₃PS₄ 颗粒的纳米级结构动力学。我们发现立方相的行为类似于应变玻璃：具有短程有序的三个简并四方变体的受挫构型。其畴壁运动是应力驱动的，随着残余铣削应力的耗尽，退火时不可逆地转变为热激活动力学。重排遵循无标度雪崩统计，匹配铁弹马氏体但没有外部驱动。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 固态电解质中的离子传导通常通过移动阳离子迁移穿过静态主晶格来描述。然而，最快的导体往往是最无序的，而无序如何增强传输在介观尺度上仍然悬而未决，集合平均探针无法访问。我们使用布拉格 X 射线光子相关光谱来测量单个球磨 Na₃PS₄ 颗粒的纳米级结构动力学。我们发现立方相的行为类似于应变玻璃：具有短程有序的三个简并四方变体的受挫构型。其畴壁运动是应力驱动的，随着残余铣削应力的耗尽，退火时不可逆地转变为热激活动力学。重排遵循无标度雪崩统计，匹配铁弹马氏体但没有外部驱动。四方多晶型物没有表现出这些特征，并且松弛速度慢五十倍。这些动力学发生的时间尺度与估计的粒子内离子扩散相当，表明主体结构在与传输相关的时间尺度上不能假设是静态的。

articles.title: Interfacial Hole Accumulation Enables Selective Free-Surface Formation in Ge-on-Si
articles.title_zh: 界面孔累积可实现硅基硅中的选择性自由表面形成
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.04589v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Electrochemically formed two-dimensional free surfaces (2DFS) decouple Ge epilayers from the misfit-dislocation network at the Ge/Si interface, but the origin of their selectivity has remained unclear. We combine finite-volume current-distribution modelling, including charge-transfer kinetics, with a one-dimensional Poisson analysis of the p-Ge/p+-Si heterojunction. With realistic conductivities, an ohmic description would drive 77% of the anodic current through Ge, whereas hole-limited charge transfer reduces this fraction to 0.07%, independently of the electrolyte conductivity. The valence-band offset accumulates holes on the Ge side up to ~1019 cm--3 within a self-limited nanometric layer, which localizes dissolution at the interface. The model yields design rules for the doping contrast (NSi/NGe ___ 60) and the mesa width (___ 3.6λ, with λ approx 1.7 μm).
articles.abstract_zh: 电化学形成的二维自由表面（2DFS）将Ge外延层与Ge/Si界面的失配位错网络解耦，但其选择性的起源仍不清楚。我们将有限体积电流分布建模（包括电荷转移动力学）与 p-Ge/p+-Si 异质结的一维泊松分析相结合。对于实际电导率，欧姆描述将驱动 77% 的阳极电流通过 Ge，而空穴限制电荷转移将该比例降低至 0.07%，与电解质电导率无关。价带偏移在自限纳米层内在 Ge 侧累积高达约 1019 cm--3 的空穴，从而使界面处的溶解局部化。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 电化学形成的二维自由表面（2DFS）将Ge外延层与Ge/Si界面的失配位错网络解耦，但其选择性的起源仍不清楚。我们将有限体积电流分布建模（包括电荷转移动力学）与 p-Ge/p+-Si 异质结的一维泊松分析相结合。对于实际电导率，欧姆描述将驱动 77% 的阳极电流通过 Ge，而空穴限制电荷转移将该比例降低至 0.07%，与电解质电导率无关。价带偏移在自限纳米层内在 Ge 侧累积高达约 1019 cm--3 的空穴，从而使界面处的溶解局部化。该模型给出了掺杂对比度 (NSi/NGe ___ 60) 和台面宽度 (___ 3.6λ，其中 λ 约为 1.7 μm) 的设计规则。

articles.title: Spin-Density-Driven Hybrid Spin Splitting in Collinear Compensated Magnets
articles.title_zh: 共线补偿磁体中自旋密度驱动的混合自旋分裂
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.04617v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Nonrelativistic spin splitting in collinear compensated magnets is constrained by spin-group symmetry, with distinct alternating and Zeeman-type splitting typically associated with altermagnets and fully compensated ferrimagnets, respectively. From a spin-density perspective, we propose a class of hybrid compensated magnets in which alternating-like and Zeeman-type spin splitting coexist within a single collinear compensated state. Using a minimal two-sector model, we demonstrate that this coexistence arises from competition between directional sublattice dispersion and the sector-dependent energy biases arising from the same structural inequivalence. First-principles calculations provide a proof of concept in a crossed bilayer of unequal-width Janus graphene nanoribbons, where the structurally inequivalent ribbons retain approximately symmetry-related spin-density distributions. The valence and conduction sectors support direction-selective spin transport and energy-selective spin-polarized states, respectively. These results connect the spatial organization of spin density with the electronic response to structural inequivalence, providing a design principle for hybrid spin splitting in compensated magnets.
articles.abstract_zh: 共线补偿磁体中的非相对论自旋分裂受到自旋群对称性的约束，具有明显的交替和塞曼型分裂通常分别与交替磁体和完全补偿的亚铁磁体相关。从自旋密度的角度来看，我们提出了一类混合补偿磁体，其中交替型和塞曼型自旋分裂在单个共线补偿态中共存。使用最小的两扇区模型，我们证明这种共存是由于定向亚晶格色散与相同结构不等价性引起的扇区相关能量偏差之间的竞争而产生的。第一性原理计算提供了不等宽度Janus石墨烯纳米带交叉双层的概念证明，其中结构不等价的带保留了近似对称相关的自旋密度分布。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 共线补偿磁体中的非相对论自旋分裂受到自旋群对称性的约束，具有明显的交替和塞曼型分裂通常分别与交替磁体和完全补偿的亚铁磁体相关。从自旋密度的角度来看，我们提出了一类混合补偿磁体，其中交替型和塞曼型自旋分裂在单个共线补偿态中共存。使用最小的两扇区模型，我们证明这种共存是由于定向亚晶格色散与相同结构不等价性引起的扇区相关能量偏差之间的竞争而产生的。第一性原理计算提供了不等宽度Janus石墨烯纳米带交叉双层的概念证明，其中结构不等价的带保留了近似对称相关的自旋密度分布。价态和传导区分别支持方向选择性自旋输运和能量选择性自旋极化态。这些结果将自旋密度的空间组织与结构不等价的电子响应联系起来，为补偿磁体中的混合自旋分裂提供了设计原理。

articles.title: Hydrogen-induced modification of the local charge density in MnSb₂Te₄
articles.title_zh: 氢诱导改变 MnSb2Te₄ 中的局部电荷密度
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.04649v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We investigate the effects of ionic hydrogen (H⁺) intake on the occupied and unoccupied states of MnSb₂Te₄, a van der Waals magnetic material. Using angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy (ARPES) and time-resolved ARPES, combined with resonant and core level photoemission, we reveal that hydrogen binds near specific lattice sites, locally redistributing charge density and reshaping the valence band spectral weight. While the band gap and picosecond carrier dynamics show only minor changes upon hydrogenation, the conduction band exhibits a striking stoichiometry-dependent response. These findings indicate that hydrogen interacts strongly with the intrinsic defects in the lattice, acting as a selective dopant in MnSb₂Te₄. Our work provides a spectroscopic basis for using hydrogen as a tool for the control of the electronic and magnetic properties in layered 2D materials.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们研究了离子氢 (H⁺) 摄入量对范德华磁性材料 MnSb2Te₄ 的占据和未占据状态的影响。利用角分辨光电子能谱 (ARPES) 和时间分辨 ARPES，结合共振和核心能级光电子发射，我们揭示了氢在特定晶格位点附近结合，局部重新分布电荷密度并重塑价带光谱权重。虽然带隙和皮秒载流子动力学在氢化时仅显示出微小的变化，但导带表现出惊人的化学计量依赖性响应。这些发现表明氢与晶格中的固有缺陷强烈相互作用，充当 MnSb2Te4 中的选择性掺杂剂。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们研究了离子氢 (H⁺) 摄入量对范德华磁性材料 MnSb2Te₄ 的占据和未占据状态的影响。利用角分辨光电子能谱 (ARPES) 和时间分辨 ARPES，结合共振和核心能级光电子发射，我们揭示了氢在特定晶格位点附近结合，局部重新分布电荷密度并重塑价带光谱权重。虽然带隙和皮秒载流子动力学在氢化时仅显示出微小的变化，但导带表现出惊人的化学计量依赖性响应。这些发现表明氢与晶格中的固有缺陷强烈相互作用，充当 MnSb2Te4 中的选择性掺杂剂。我们的工作为使用氢作为控制层状二维材料的电子和磁性的工具提供了光谱基础。

articles.title: Statistically Robust Characterization of Polaron and Bipolaron Intrinsic Traps in Amorphous Silica Reveals the Role of Network Flexibility in Electron Localisation
articles.title_zh: 无定形二氧化硅中极化子和双极化子本征陷阱的统计稳健表征揭示了网络灵活性在电子定位中的作用
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.04652v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Intrinsic electron localization in amorphous silica (a-SiO2) contributes to charge trapping and defect generation in silica-based electronic materials - a phenomenon that degrades logic-device performance but can be exploited for memory applications. However, the structural distribution of one- and two-electron traps remains incompletely characterized, largely because the disordered covalent network of a-SiO2 spans a vast configurational space. To address this, we perform statistical sampling to select a representative 200-model subset of defect-free bulk a-SiO2 structures from a structurally converged parent set of 2512 models, generated via classical melt-quench molecular dynamics simulations. We then characterize the intrinsic one- and two-electron traps in this subset using HSE06 density functional theory calculations. Analysis of neutral precursor sites shows that trapping propensity is not determined by a universal O-Si-O angle or Si-O bond length; it is controlled by the accessibility of the relaxed trap geometry, requiring both local strain and medium-range network flexibility. Single electrons predominantly form edge-centred polarons on distorted SiO4 tetrahedra, with occupied states 3.1-4.3 eV below the conduction band minimum. Injection of a second electron drives stronger lattice relaxation, most commonly Si-O bond elongation leading to rupture, thereby forming threefold-coordinated-Si (Si3) bipolarons and, in some cases, Si-Si-bonded bipolaron configurations. The calculated bipolaron energy ranges are consistent with optical absorption features at 3.7, 4.7, and 6.4 eV associated with intrinsic electron localization.
articles.abstract_zh: 无定形二氧化硅 (a-SiO2) 中的本征电子局域化会导致二氧化硅基电子材料中的电荷俘获和缺陷产生，这种现象会降低逻辑器件的性能，但可用于存储器应用。然而，一电子和二电子陷阱的结构分布仍未完全表征，这主要是因为a-SiO2的无序共价网络跨越了巨大的构型空间。为了解决这个问题，我们进行统计采样，从通过经典熔体淬火分子动力学模拟生成的 2512 个模型的结构收敛父集中选择具有代表性的 200 个无缺陷块状 a-SiO2 结构的模型子集。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 无定形二氧化硅 (a-SiO2) 中的本征电子局域化会导致二氧化硅基电子材料中的电荷俘获和缺陷产生，这种现象会降低逻辑器件的性能，但可用于存储器应用。然而，一电子和二电子陷阱的结构分布仍未完全表征，这主要是因为a-SiO2的无序共价网络跨越了巨大的构型空间。为了解决这个问题，我们进行统计采样，从通过经典熔体淬火分子动力学模拟生成的 2512 个模型的结构收敛父集中选择具有代表性的 200 个无缺陷块状 a-SiO2 结构的模型子集。然后，我们使用 HSE06 密度泛函理论计算来表征该子集中固有的一电子陷阱和二电子陷阱。对中性前体位点的分析表明，捕获倾向并非由通用的 O-Si-O 角度或 Si-O 键长决定；它由松弛陷阱几何结构的可访问性控制，需要局部应变和中程网络灵活性。单电子主要在扭曲的 SiO4 四面体上形成边缘中心极化子，占据态比导带最小值低 3.1-4.3 eV。第二个电子的注入会驱动更强的晶格弛豫，最常见的是 Si-O 键伸长导致断裂，从而形成三重配位的 Si (Si3) 双极化子，在某些情况下形成 Si-Si 键合的双极化子构型。计算出的双极化子能量范围与与本征电子局域化相关的 3.7、4.7 和 6.4 eV 处的光学吸收特征一致。

articles.title: Thermodynamic Evidence for Multiple Field-Induced Phases in an Anisotropic Kagome Antiferromagnet
articles.title_zh: 各向异性 Kagome 反铁磁体中多个场感应相的热力学证据
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.04675v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Kagome antiferromagnets are predicted to host exotic field-induced phases, yet experimental identification of their thermodynamic signatures remains challenging. Here we combine specific heat (C) and ultrasound measurements up to 36 T and down to 0.5 K to map the H-T phase diagram of the anisotropic kagome magnet Y₃Cu₉(OH)₁₉Cl₈. We show that the suppression of long-range antiferromagnetic order with field at sim 15 T approximately coincides with the onset of the unconventional 1/6 (or 1/9) magnetization plateau previously observed in this system. The attenuation (and sound velocity) then intriguingly increases down to 0.5 K just at μ₀H = 15 T, and C/T becomes temperature independent. Moreover, our measurements are consistent with the opening of a spin gap Δ₀simeq3.5± 0.3 K within the plateau and reveal a further compressible (ungapped) phase beyond the plateau phase, unveiling a rich sequence of field-induced phases in this quantum magnet.
articles.abstract_zh: Kagome 反铁磁体预计会具有奇异的场诱导相，但对其热力学特征的实验识别仍然具有挑战性。在这里，我们将比热 (C) 和高达 36 T 和低至 0.5 K 的超声波测量结合起来，绘制各向异性 Kagome 磁体 Y₃Cu₉(OH)₁₉Cl₈ 的 H-T 相图。我们表明，在 sim 15 T 处场对长程反铁磁有序的抑制大约与先前在该系统中观察到的非常规 1/6（或 1/9）磁化平台的开始一致。
articles.abstract_zh_full: Kagome 反铁磁体预计会具有奇异的场诱导相，但对其热力学特征的实验识别仍然具有挑战性。在这里，我们将比热 (C) 和高达 36 T 和低至 0.5 K 的超声波测量结合起来，绘制各向异性 Kagome 磁体 Y₃Cu₉(OH)₁₉Cl₈ 的 H-T 相图。我们表明，在 sim 15 T 处场对长程反铁磁有序的抑制大约与先前在该系统中观察到的非常规 1/6（或 1/9）磁化平台的开始一致。然后，衰减（和声速）在 μ₀H = 15 T 时有趣地增加至 0.5 K，并且 C/T 变得与温度无关。此外，我们的测量结果与平台内自旋间隙 Δ₀simeq3.5± 0.3 K 的打开一致，并揭示了平台相之外的进一步可压缩（无间隙）相，揭示了该量子磁体中丰富的场感应相序列。

articles.title: Small-data physics-informed ML model for magnetic exchange based on chemical composition and structure
articles.title_zh: 基于化学成分和结构的磁交换小数据物理信息机器学习模型
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.04681v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In this paper we propose an ensemble model based on a swarm of dense neural networks, able to predict Heisenberg exchange interactions within less than 1% error. The model uses the inputs of the ab-initio Schrödinger equation, i.e. the compound structure and chemical composition. In this first work, we trained the model on a few compounds of the hexagonal manganite family and were able to infer, with similar accuracy, the J values for other compounds of the same family at randomly chosen geometries, thus showing that we accurately learned the effect of the chemical composition and structure on effective magnetic integrals J.
articles.abstract_zh: 在本文中，我们提出了一种基于密集神经网络群的集成模型，能够以小于 1% 的误差预测海森堡交换相互作用。该模型使用从头算薛定谔方程的输入，即化合物结构和化学成分。在第一项工作中，我们对六方锰酸盐家族的几种化合物训练了模型，并能够以类似的精度推断出随机选择几何形状的同一家族其他化合物的 J 值，从而表明我们准确地了解了化学成分和结构对有效磁积分 J 的影响。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在本文中，我们提出了一种基于密集神经网络群的集成模型，能够以小于 1% 的误差预测海森堡交换相互作用。该模型使用从头算薛定谔方程的输入，即化合物结构和化学成分。在第一项工作中，我们对六方锰酸盐家族的几种化合物训练了模型，并能够以类似的精度推断出随机选择几何形状的同一家族其他化合物的 J 值，从而表明我们准确地了解了化学成分和结构对有效磁积分 J 的影响。

articles.title: Critical amplitudes of the Baxter-Wu model from MCPA and Wolff simulations: free-exponent and fixed-exponent fits
articles.title_zh: MCPA 和 Wolff 模拟中的 Baxter-Wu 模型的临界振幅：自由指数和固定指数拟合
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.04733v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The two-dimensional Baxter-Wu model belongs to the universality class of the four-state Potts model. Exact expressions are available for its energy, specific heat, magnetization, and polarization amplitudes. We use these results as a benchmark for evaluating two simulation algorithms and two approaches to extracting critical amplitudes. Microcanonical population annealing (MCPA) and the sublattice-freezing Wolff algorithm yield highly consistent estimates for the energy and order parameters when applied to lattices of comparable size. According to the exact Joyce series, the local effective exponent does not stabilize at a constant value but instead undergoes a monotonic drift. This behaviour stems from corrections to scaling, which can be expressed as a series in the cube root of the reduced temperature. As a result, these corrections decay relatively slowly, with the leading term being of relative order |t|²/³. When performing a fit with a free exponent on an automatically identified plateau, this drift gets incorporated into the estimated exponent, introducing a substantial bias in the derived amplitudes. In contrast, a fit that fixes the exponent to its exact value and explicitly accounts for the analytic correction series delivers a close match to the known exact amplitudes. Using this refined fitting approach, we obtain estimates for the susceptibility amplitudes and the universal amplitude ratios. These values are in good agreement with predictions from form-factor calculations. Additionally, we numerically determine the leading correction coefficient for the polarization.
articles.abstract_zh: 二维Baxter-Wu模型属于四态Potts模型的普适类。其能量、比热、磁化强度和极化幅度都有精确的表达式。我们使用这些结果作为评估两种仿真算法和两种提取临界幅度的方法的基准。当应用于大小相当的晶格时，微正则布居退火 (MCPA) 和亚晶格冻结 Wolff 算法可以对能量和有序参数产生高度一致的估计。根据精确的乔伊斯级数，局部有效指数不会稳定在恒定值，而是经历单调漂移。这种行为源于对标度的修正，可以表示为降低温度的立方根的级数。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 二维Baxter-Wu模型属于四态Potts模型的普适类。其能量、比热、磁化强度和极化幅度都有精确的表达式。我们使用这些结果作为评估两种仿真算法和两种提取临界幅度的方法的基准。当应用于大小相当的晶格时，微正则布居退火 (MCPA) 和亚晶格冻结 Wolff 算法可以对能量和有序参数产生高度一致的估计。根据精确的乔伊斯级数，局部有效指数不会稳定在恒定值，而是经历单调漂移。这种行为源于对标度的修正，可以表示为降低温度的立方根的级数。因此，这些修正的衰减速度相对较慢，主导项的相对阶数为 |t|²/³。当在自动识别的平台上使用自由指数进行拟合时，这种漂移会被纳入估计的指数中，从而在导出的幅度中引入很大的偏差。相反，将指数固定为其精确值并明确考虑解析校正级数的拟合可提供与已知精确幅度的紧密匹配。使用这种精细的拟合方法，我们获得了磁化率幅度和通用幅度比的估计值。这些值与形状因数计算的预测非常一致。此外，我们还以数值方式确定了偏振的主要校正系数。

articles.title: Controlling nitrogen incorporation in (Eu,Ba,Ca)TiO₃-derived perovskite-type oxynitrides through Fermi Level Engineering
articles.title_zh: 通过费米能级工程控制 (Eu,Ba,Ca)TiO₃ 衍生的钙钛矿型氮氧化物中的氮掺入
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.04745v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Defect states directly influence not only functional properties, but also oxynitride formation during ammonolysis. Along with structural stability and charge balance, these defects can cause non-uniform nitrogen incorporation. To address this, the recently proposed Fermi Level Engineering concept provides a powerful alternative of rationalising oxynitride synthesis. By using the electron chemical potential, i.e., the Fermi level, as a unique descriptor, this approach can predict, understand, and manipulate defect formation enthalpies and charge transition levels, subsequently allowing to incorporate defect-property correlations to the concept. This work combines theoretical modelling and experimental characterisation of barium titanium oxynitrides to explain an intrinsic, self-limiting nitridation process. Progressive nitrogen incorporation causes a Fermi level downward shift, leaving further nitrogen substitution on oxygen sites energetically unfavourable, up to 0.03 N per unit formula. We demonstrate that A-site cation substitution in Eu₁₋ₓBaₓTiO₃- and Eu₁₋ₓCaₓTiO₃-derived oxynitrides can be applied to control compensation of the additional negative charge from N³⁻ and keep the Fermi level high. The Eu²⁺/³⁺ redox couple enables substitution of oxygen by nitrogen through pinning of the Fermi level at the europium charge transition level, at sim 2.9 eV above the VBM. This allows for higher nitrogen uptake of up to 0.65 per formula unit (taken from hot gas extraction) through a more controlled process. Further incorporation is then limited by an intra-Ti(O,N)₆ octahedra distortion due to internal bond-angle variance. These findings demonstrate that Fermi Level Engineering provides a pathway to predict and overcome intrinsic synthetic and thermodynamic limitations in oxynitride synthesis.
articles.abstract_zh: 缺陷状态不仅直接影响功能特性，还直接影响氨解过程中氮氧化物的形成。除了结构稳定性和电荷平衡之外，这些缺陷还会导致氮掺入不均匀。为了解决这个问题，最近提出的费米能级工程概念提供了合理化氮氧化物合成的强大替代方案。通过使用电子化学势（即费米能级）作为独特的描述符，该方法可以预测、理解和操纵缺陷形成焓和电荷跃迁水平，随后允许将缺陷性质相关性纳入概念中。这项工作结合了钡钛氮氧化物的理论建模和实验表征，以解释固有的自限氮化过程。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 缺陷状态不仅直接影响功能特性，还直接影响氨解过程中氮氧化物的形成。除了结构稳定性和电荷平衡之外，这些缺陷还会导致氮掺入不均匀。为了解决这个问题，最近提出的费米能级工程概念提供了合理化氮氧化物合成的强大替代方案。通过使用电子化学势（即费米能级）作为独特的描述符，该方法可以预测、理解和操纵缺陷形成焓和电荷跃迁水平，随后允许将缺陷性质相关性纳入概念中。这项工作结合了钡钛氮氧化物的理论建模和实验表征，以解释固有的自限氮化过程。逐渐的氮掺入导致费米能级向下移动，从而使氧位点上的进一步氮取代在能量上不利，每单位公式高达 0.03 N。我们证明，Eu₁₋ₓBaₓTiO₃-和Eu₋ₓCaₓTiO₃衍生的氮氧化物中的A位阳离子取代可用于控制来自N3-的额外负电荷的补偿并保持高费米能级。 Eu2⁺/3⁺氧化还原对通过将费米能级固定在铕电荷跃迁能级（高于 VBM sim 2.9 eV），能够用氮取代氧。这使得通过更受控的过程，每个配方单元的氮吸收量高达 0.65（从热气提取中获取）。由于内部键角变化，进一步的掺入受到 Ti(O,N)6 八面体内畸变的限制。这些发现表明，费米能级工程提供了一种预测和克服氮氧化物合成中内在合成和热力学限制的途径。

articles.title: Nonreciprocal charge transport in quantum materials: From superconductors to magnetic systems
articles.title_zh: 量子材料中的不可逆电荷传输：从超导体到磁系统
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.04821v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Nonreciprocal charge transport, where current flows preferentially in one direction, has become a key topic across quantum materials. This review covers some recent progress in bulk crystals, artificial heterostructures, van der Waals systems, high-temperature superconductors, and magnetic materials. The review discusses both intrinsic origins, such as band-structure effects, and extrinsic ones, including vortex motion, device geometry, and heating artifacts. A central focus is the superconducting diode effect due to its application potential, which shows different critical currents for opposite directions. The review also examines how symmetry breaking, spin-orbit coupling, and magnetic order contribute to the observed responses. However, there remain challenges when many exciting findings lack a unified picture, and the field continues to debate the relative importance of various mechanisms. The review highlights key open questions and suggests future directions, including better experimental standards and device integration. This review aims to give a balanced view of what is known, what is uncertain, and where the field might go next.
articles.abstract_zh: 不可逆电荷传输（电流优先沿一个方向流动）已成为量子材料的一个关键主题。这篇综述涵盖了块状晶体、人工异质结构、范德华系统、高温超导体和磁性材料方面的一些最新进展。该评论讨论了内在起源（例如能带结构效应）和外在起源（包括涡流运动、器件几何形状和加热伪影）。中心焦点是超导二极管效应，因为它具有应用潜力，在相反方向上显示出不同的临界电流。该综述还研究了对称性破缺、自旋轨道耦合和磁序如何影响观察到的响应。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 不可逆电荷传输（电流优先沿一个方向流动）已成为量子材料的一个关键主题。这篇综述涵盖了块状晶体、人工异质结构、范德华系统、高温超导体和磁性材料方面的一些最新进展。该评论讨论了内在起源（例如能带结构效应）和外在起源（包括涡流运动、器件几何形状和加热伪影）。中心焦点是超导二极管效应，因为它具有应用潜力，在相反方向上显示出不同的临界电流。该综述还研究了对称性破缺、自旋轨道耦合和磁序如何影响观察到的响应。然而，当许多令人兴奋的发现缺乏统一的认识时，仍然存在挑战，并且该领域仍在争论各种机制的相对重要性。该评论强调了关键的悬而未决的问题，并提出了未来的方向，包括更好的实验标准和设备集成。本次审查旨在对已知的内容、不确定的内容以及该领域下一步的发展方向给出一个平衡的看法。

articles.title: Hidden Triakontadipole Order in the Triangular-Lattice Magnet CeMgAl₁₁O₁₉
articles.title_zh: 三角晶格磁体 CeMgAl₁₁O₁₉ 中隐藏的 Triakontadipole 顺序
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.04845v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The absence of magnetic Bragg peaks and a broad excitation continuum are commonly recognized experimental features of a quantum spin liquid. The Ce-based triangular-lattice hexaaluminate CeMgAl₁₁O₁₉ exhibits both signatures, yet its effective model and ground state remain under debate. Experiments have variously suggested a quantum spin liquid, proximate umbrella point, and disorder-suppressed magnetic order. Here we trace these contradictions to an overlooked multipolar degree of freedom: the transverse pseudospin of the |±5/2rangle Kramers doublet is a rank-5 triakontadipole rather than an ordinary dipole. Analyzing the magnetization, neutron spectra, and thermodynamics on equal footing, we establish a dipole-triakontadipole XXZ model with Jₚₑᵣₚ simeq 0.65 K and J_c simeq -0.13 K. The resulting planar triakontadipolar superfluid order is hidden from dipolar probes, explaining the absence of a magnetic Bragg peak in neutron scattering. The zero-field excitations separate into a low-energy triakontadipole wave and a broad higher-energy continuum. We further propose nuclear spin-lattice relaxation and spin-current experiments to probe the gapless excitations of this hidden triakontadipole superfluid. Our findings thus open a new avenue for high-rank multipolar physics in rare-earth triangular-lattice magnets.
articles.abstract_zh: 不存在磁性布拉格峰和宽的激发连续体是量子自旋液体普遍公认的实验特征。 Ce基三角晶格六铝酸盐CeMgAl₁₁O₁₉表现出这两个特征，但其有效模型和基态仍存在争议。实验从不同角度提出了量子自旋液体、近似伞点和无序抑制磁序。在这里，我们将这些矛盾追溯到一个被忽视的多极自由度：|±5/2rangle Kramers 双峰的横向赝自旋是 5 级三触偶极子，而不是普通偶极子。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 不存在磁性布拉格峰和宽的激发连续体是量子自旋液体普遍公认的实验特征。 Ce基三角晶格六铝酸盐CeMgAl₁₁O₁₉表现出这两个特征，但其有效模型和基态仍存在争议。实验从不同角度提出了量子自旋液体、近似伞点和无序抑制磁序。在这里，我们将这些矛盾追溯到一个被忽视的多极自由度：|±5/2rangle Kramers 双峰的横向赝自旋是 5 级三触偶极子，而不是普通偶极子。在平等的基础上分析磁化强度、中子能谱和热力学，我们建立了一个偶极-triakontadipole XXZ模型，其中Jₚₑᵣₚ simeq 0.65 K和J_c simeq -0.13 K。由此产生的平面triakontadipole超流体序对偶极探针来说是隐藏的，这解释了中子散射中不存在磁布拉格峰的原因。零场激发分为低能三触偶极波和宽阔的高能连续谱。我们进一步提出核自旋晶格弛豫和自旋电流实验来探测这种隐藏的三康他偶极超流体的无间隙激发。因此，我们的发现为稀土三角晶格磁体的高阶多极物理开辟了一条新途径。

articles.title: Single-anchor Delta-learning with the cluster Gutzwiller approximation: predicting phase boundaries of strongly correlated bosons in optical lattices
articles.title_zh: 使用簇 Gutzwiller 近似的单锚 Delta 学习：预测光学晶格中强相关玻色子的相边界
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.04936v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The cluster Gutzwiller method is widely used to study strongly correlated bosonic systems in optical lattices because it explicitly treats quantum fluctuations within a cluster. However, its computational cost grows exponentially with the cluster size, making large-cluster phase diagrams computationally expensive. To reduce this cost, we recently introduced Delta-learning into cluster Gutzwiller calculations and proposed multipoint regression Delta-learning (MPR-Delta), which learns the difference between small- and large-cluster results from four high-cost critical points of the target cluster and thereby predicts the complete target phase boundary. For sufficiently large target clusters, however, even computing one critical point on the phase boundary is already expensive, so obtaining four such points remains highly costly. A natural question then arises: can the complete target phase boundary be predicted with fewer high-cost critical points of the target cluster? To address this question, we propose single-anchor Delta-learning (SA-Delta), which requires only a single high-cost critical point of the target cluster to reconstruct the complete target phase boundary, thereby greatly reducing the computational cost. We test this framework on several classes of Bose-Hubbard models and find that, in the cases considered, it achieves lower reconstruction errors with fewer high-cost points than MPR-Delta. The combination of SA-Delta with the cluster Gutzwiller approximation thus provides an efficient framework for studying phase transitions of strongly correlated bosonic systems in complex optical lattices, and may be extended to more complex quantum many-body systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 簇 Gutzwiller 方法广泛用于研究光学晶格中的强相关玻色子系统，因为它明确地处理簇内的量子涨落。然而，其计算成本随着簇大小呈指数增长，使得大簇相图的计算成本昂贵。为了降低这一成本，我们最近将 Delta 学习引入集群 Gutzwiller 计算中，并提出了多点回归 Delta 学习（MPR-Delta），它从目标集群的四个高成本关键点学习小集群和大集群结果之间的差异，从而预测完整的目标相边界。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 簇 Gutzwiller 方法广泛用于研究光学晶格中的强相关玻色子系统，因为它明确地处理簇内的量子涨落。然而，其计算成本随着簇大小呈指数增长，使得大簇相图的计算成本昂贵。为了降低这一成本，我们最近将 Delta 学习引入集群 Gutzwiller 计算中，并提出了多点回归 Delta 学习（MPR-Delta），它从目标集群的四个高成本关键点学习小集群和大集群结果之间的差异，从而预测完整的目标相边界。然而，对于足够大的目标簇，即使计算相边界上的一个临界点也已经很昂贵，因此获得四个这样的点仍然非常昂贵。那么一个自然的问题就出现了：能否用较少的目标簇高成本临界点来预测完整的目标相边界？为了解决这个问题，我们提出了单锚Delta学习（SA-Delta），它只需要目标簇的单个高成本临界点即可重建完整的目标相边界，从而大大降低了计算成本。我们在几类 Bose-Hubbard 模型上测试了该框架，发现在所考虑的情况下，与 MPR-Delta 相比，它以更少的高成本点实现了更低的重建误差。因此，SA-Delta 与簇 Gutzwiller 近似的结合为研究复杂光学晶格中强相关玻色子系统的相变提供了一个有效的框架，并且可以扩展到更复杂的量子多体系统。

articles.title: Field-free transverse response in altermagnet and topological insulator heterojunctions
articles.title_zh: 交流磁体和拓扑绝缘体异质结中的无场横向响应
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.04937v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We theoretically investigate the transport properties of a topological insulator (TI) connected to two-dimensional altermagnetic (AM) leads in the absence of an external magnetic field. Exploiting the intrinsic time-reversal symmetry breaking of altermagnets, we report the emergence of a field-free transverse differential conductivity in the resulting AM-TI-AM heterostructure. Our analysis reveals that this transverse response is highly sensitive to the orientation of the Néel vector: a finite transverse conductivity manifests when the Néel vector possesses an out-of-plane component, whereas it strictly vanishes for in-plane orientations (θ = π/2) under symmetric chemical potentials (μₜ = μ_b) due to the restoration of symmetry between the k_y and -k_y momentum channels. Conversely, when asymmetric chemical potentials are applied (μₜ ≠ μ_b), this symmetry is broken, yielding a finite transverse response even for an in-plane Néel vector. Furthermore, we demonstrate that while the longitudinal differential conductivity exhibits Fabry-Pérot-type oscillations as a function of the TI's chemical potential, the transverse conductivity displays a distinct antisymmetric dependence. Notably, the oscillatory behavior of the longitudinal conductivity persists even at finite temperatures. Spatially, the transverse current contribution decays exponentially with position inside the TI region. We also find that both the longitudinal and transverse differential conductivity exhibit periodic oscillations with the junction parameter χₜ=χ_b. These findings provide a fundamental understanding of field-free transverse responses in spin-momentum locked boundary states, highlighting the potential of AM-TI heterojunctions for next-generation spintronic applications.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们从理论上研究了在没有外部磁场的情况下连接到二维交流磁 (AM) 引线的拓扑绝缘体 (TI) 的输运特性。利用交流磁体固有的时间反转对称性破缺，我们报告了在所得的 AM-TI-AM 异质结构中出现了无场横向微分电导率。我们的分析表明，这种横向响应对尼尔矢量的方向高度敏感：当尼尔矢量具有面外分量时，会出现有限的横向电导率，而在对称化学势（μₜ = μ_b）下，由于 k_y 和 -k_y 动量通道之间对称性的恢复，横向电导率在对称化学势（μₜ = μ_b）下严格消失。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们从理论上研究了在没有外部磁场的情况下连接到二维交流磁 (AM) 引线的拓扑绝缘体 (TI) 的输运特性。利用交流磁体固有的时间反转对称性破缺，我们报告了在所得的 AM-TI-AM 异质结构中出现了无场横向微分电导率。我们的分析表明，这种横向响应对尼尔矢量的方向高度敏感：当尼尔矢量具有面外分量时，会出现有限的横向电导率，而在对称化学势（μₜ = μ_b）下，由于 k_y 和 -k_y 动量通道之间对称性的恢复，横向电导率在对称化学势（μₜ = μ_b）下严格消失。相反，当应用不对称化学势（μₜ ≠ μ_b）时，这种对称性就会被打破，即使对于面内尼尔矢量也会产生有限的横向响应。此外，我们证明，虽然纵向微分电导率表现出法布里-珀罗型振荡作为 TI 化学势的函数，但横向电导率却表现出明显的反对称依赖性。值得注意的是，即使在有限的温度下，纵向电导率的振荡行为仍然持续。在空间上，横向电流贡献随着 TI 区域内的位置呈指数衰减。我们还发现纵向和横向微分电导率均表现出周期性振荡，结参数 χₜ=χ_b。这些发现提供了对自旋动量锁定边界态中无场横向响应的基本理解，凸显了 AM-TI 异质结在下一代自旋电子应用中的潜力。

articles.title: Current control of spin-wave transport in YIG via the smallVO₂ insulator-to-metal transition
articles.title_zh: 通过小 VO2 绝缘体到金属转变对 YIG 中自旋波输运的电流控制
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.04951v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Electrically reconfigurable spin-wave transport is central to realizing energy-efficient magnonic information technologies, yet existing current-driven approaches require current densities that undermine the fundamental dissipation advantage of spin-wave-based signal processing. Here, we demonstrate low-power electrical control of spin-wave propagation in a hybrid magnonic device comprising a low-damping yttrium iron garnet (YIG) film coupled to an adjacent vanadium dioxide (smallVO₂) stripe. Passing a small current through smallVO₂ triggers its insulator-to-metal transition (IMT), producing a sharp, reversible resistivity reduction exceeding three orders of magnitude. This abrupt phase transition locally modifies the spin-wave dispersion in YIG, reducing the group velocity and suppressing transmission by up to 40 dB near the ferromagnetic resonance frequency. Pulsed current excitation enables reconfiguration of spin-wave transport on a 10 ms timescale. Temperature-dependent measurements, corroborated by thermal modeling, decouple the respective contributions of current-induced heating of YIG and the IMT in smallVO₂, establishing the latter as the dominant control mechanism. Our results demonstrate that electrically induced phase transitions in correlated oxides constitute an energy-efficient strategy for dynamic spin-wave manipulation, providing a scalable route toward reconfigurable magnonic devices.
articles.abstract_zh: 电可重构自旋波传输是实现节能磁波信息技术的核心，但现有的电流驱动方法所需的电流密度破坏了基于自旋波的信号处理的基本耗散优势。在这里，我们演示了混合磁振器件中自旋波传播的低功率电控制，该器件包括与相邻二氧化钒（小VO 2）条带耦合的低阻尼钇铁石榴石（YIG）薄膜。让小电流通过小VO2会触发其绝缘体到金属的转变（IMT），从而产生超过三个数量级的急剧、可逆的电阻率降低。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 电可重构自旋波传输是实现节能磁波信息技术的核心，但现有的电流驱动方法所需的电流密度破坏了基于自旋波的信号处理的基本耗散优势。在这里，我们演示了混合磁振器件中自旋波传播的低功率电控制，该器件包括与相邻二氧化钒（小VO 2）条带耦合的低阻尼钇铁石榴石（YIG）薄膜。让小电流通过小VO2会触发其绝缘体到金属的转变（IMT），从而产生超过三个数量级的急剧、可逆的电阻率降低。这种突然的相变局部改变了 YIG 中的自旋波色散，降低了群速度，并在铁磁共振频率附近抑制了高达 40 dB 的传输。脉冲电流激励能够在 10 ms 时间尺度上重新配置自旋波传输。通过热模型证实的与温度相关的测量，解耦了小VO2中YIG和IMT电流感应加热的各自贡献，将后者确立为主要控制机制。我们的结果表明，相关氧化物中的电诱导相变构成了动态自旋波操纵的节能策略，为可重构磁振子器件提供了一条可扩展的途径。

articles.title: Ta-based S-I-S junctions for integrated superconducting Electronics
articles.title_zh: 用于集成超导电子器件的 Ta 基 S-I-S 结
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.04982v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In this work, we have presented S-I-S Josephson junctions with rmα-Ta electrodes and a rm TaOₓ barrier. We grew base and top α-Ta electrodes using seed layer engineering, showing both Nb and rm TaNₓ are viable seed layer choices, and particularly emphasize that at room temperature a re-seed layer is required to nucleate rmα-Ta for the top electrode. However, we note that the choice of seed layer can have subtle implications on the electrical tunneling behavior of the junctions. We used room-temperature probing of variable junction areas, combined with Ambegaokar-Baratoff physics, to characterize the wafer scale critical current densities. For 0.4 μm² junctions, we found junction spreads as low as 2.0% across the 20 x 20 mm chip relevant for device performance. The entire process was carried out using standard industry foundry processing using 150 mm wafer tooling, which is an important step towards proving that Ta-based junctions can be implemented at scale. We have successfully fabricated and tested junctions with rmα-Ta electrodes and a rm TaOₓ insulating tunnel barrier, demonstrating that this is a material platform which merits further investigation and studies for potential application in classical and quantum superconducting technologies.
articles.abstract_zh: 在这项工作中，我们提出了带有 rmα-Ta 电极和 rm TaOₓ 势垒的 S-I-S 约瑟夫森结。我们使用种子层工程生长了底部和顶部 α-Ta 电极，表明 Nb 和 rm TaNₓ 都是可行的种子层选择，并特别强调在室温下需要重新种子层来使顶部电极的 rmα-Ta 成核。然而，我们注意到种子层的选择会对结的电隧道行为产生微妙的影响。我们使用可变结面积的室温探测，结合 Ambegaokar-Baratoff 物理学，来表征晶圆级临界电流密度。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在这项工作中，我们提出了带有 rmα-Ta 电极和 rm TaOₓ 势垒的 S-I-S 约瑟夫森结。我们使用种子层工程生长了底部和顶部 α-Ta 电极，表明 Nb 和 rm TaNₓ 都是可行的种子层选择，并特别强调在室温下需要重新种子层来使顶部电极的 rmα-Ta 成核。然而，我们注意到种子层的选择会对结的电隧道行为产生微妙的影响。我们使用可变结面积的室温探测，结合 Ambegaokar-Baratoff 物理学，来表征晶圆级临界电流密度。对于 0.4 μm² 结，我们发现 20 x 20 mm 芯片上的结扩散低至 2.0%，与器件性能相关。整个过程是使用标准工业铸造工艺使用 150 毫米晶圆工具进行的，这是证明钽基结可以大规模实施的重要一步。我们成功地制造并测试了 rmα-Ta 电极和 rm TaOₓ 绝缘隧道势垒的结，证明这是一个值得进一步调查和研究的材料平台，以在经典和量子超导技术中潜在应用。

articles.title: SrMn₂Ge₂: A metallic system with anomalous magnetotransport properties
articles.title_zh: SrMn2Ge2：具有异常磁输运特性的金属系统
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.04984v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The structural, electronic, and physical properties of previously unexplored layered tetragonal compound SrMn₂Ge₂ are reported. The compound crystallizes in the ThCr₂Si₂-type structure with a crystallographic parameters c/a ratio of 2.535(3), significantly smaller than those of the related BaMn₂Pn₂ compounds (Pn = P, As, Sb, Bi), indicating enhanced interlayer interaction between the moment-bearing Mn-ions. Magnetic susceptibility measurements suggest an antiferromagnetic ground state with a high Neél temperature Tᵣₘ N > 350~K@. A large and positive magnetoresistance (MR) of approximately 50% is observed at low temperatures, which follows a power-law field dependence with exponent n = 1.50(8). Low-temperature electrical resistivity data reveal Kondo-like features. Heat capacity measurements show no signs of a phase transition below 300~K and further confirm a metallic ground state. Electronic structure calculations reveal a three-dimensional Fermi surface and suggest the presence of substantial electronic correlation effects.
articles.abstract_zh: 报告了先前未探索的层状四方化合物 SrMn2Ge2 的结构、电子和物理性质。该化合物以 ThCr2Si2 型结构结晶，晶体学参数 c/a 比率为 2.535(3)，明显小于相关的 BaMn2Pn2 化合物 (Pn = P、As、Sb、Bi)，表明承载矩的 Mn 离子之间的层间相互作用增强。磁化率测量表明反铁磁基态具有高尼尔温度 Tᵣₘ N > 350~K@。在低温下观察到约 50% 的大正磁阻 (MR)，其遵循指数 n = 1.50(8) 的幂律场依赖性。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 报告了先前未探索的层状四方化合物 SrMn2Ge2 的结构、电子和物理性质。该化合物以 ThCr2Si2 型结构结晶，晶体学参数 c/a 比率为 2.535(3)，明显小于相关的 BaMn2Pn2 化合物 (Pn = P、As、Sb、Bi)，表明承载矩的 Mn 离子之间的层间相互作用增强。磁化率测量表明反铁磁基态具有高尼尔温度 Tᵣₘ N > 350~K@。在低温下观察到约 50% 的大正磁阻 (MR)，其遵循指数 n = 1.50(8) 的幂律场依赖性。低温电阻率数据揭示了类似近藤的特征。热容测量显示低于 300~K 时没有相变迹象，进一步证实了金属基态。电子结构计算揭示了三维费米面，并表明存在大量的电子关联效应。

articles.title: Synchronization in one-dimensional arrays of photon condensates
articles.title_zh: 光子凝聚体一维阵列的同步
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.04989v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We investigate the synchronization of coupled photonic Bose-Einstein condensates in dye-filled microcavity arrays, subject to a potential gradient. We show that in the absence of noise the desynchronisation threshold is the result of a dynamical instability. For a two-site system, we analytically derive the maximal potential difference that allows for a synchronized solution as a function of the system parameters and find that it crucially depends on the thermalization rate. For systems with N sites, we find a N⁻³ power law scaling for the critical potential difference. When quantum fluctuations are included, stochastic phase slips broaden the sharp transitions, yet the phase velocity and first order spatial coherence still reliably identify the instability threshold.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们研究了染料填充微腔阵列中耦合光子玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚体在电势梯度下的同步性。我们表明，在没有噪声的情况下，去同步阈值是动态不稳定的结果。对于两点系统，我们分析得出允许同步解作为系统参数函数的最大电势差，并发现它很大程度上取决于热化速率。对于具有 N 个位点的系统，我们发现临界电位差的 N⁻³ 幂律缩放。当包含量子涨落时，随机相滑使急剧转变变宽，但相速度和一阶空间相干性仍然可靠地识别不稳定阈值。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们研究了染料填充微腔阵列中耦合光子玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚体在电势梯度下的同步性。我们表明，在没有噪声的情况下，去同步阈值是动态不稳定的结果。对于两点系统，我们分析得出允许同步解作为系统参数函数的最大电势差，并发现它很大程度上取决于热化速率。对于具有 N 个位点的系统，我们发现临界电位差的 N⁻³ 幂律缩放。当包含量子涨落时，随机相滑使急剧转变变宽，但相速度和一阶空间相干性仍然可靠地识别不稳定阈值。

articles.title: Symmetry-protected isolation of the quantum metric in chiral type-II semi-Dirac semimetals
articles.title_zh: 手性 II 型半狄拉克半金属中量子度量的对称保护隔离
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.04996v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Quantum geometry, comprising the Berry curvature (BC) and the quantum metric (QM), underpins a wide array of topological and transport phenomena. However, in most solid-state platforms, BC and QM signals are inherently entangled, making their experimental separation highly challenging. Here, we demonstrate that the chiral limit of type-II semi-Dirac semimetals provides a symmetry-protected mechanism to cleanly isolate the QM. At the chiral limit where the spin-orbit gap m_z=0, chiral and PT symmetries strictly suppress the BC, its dipole (BCD), and the shift current, leaving the QM and its dipole (QMD) as the sole sources of the optical and nonlinear Hall responses. This pure-QM regime exhibits distinct experimental fingerprints, including a divergent longitudinal optical conductivity and a QMD-induced nonlinear Hall conductivity that exhibits a pronounced singularity as the chemical potential approaches the nodal point. Turning on a finite m_z reactivates the BC channels, transitioning the system from a pure-QM phase into a mixed geometric phase. By deriving a scaling law for the nonlinear Hall conductivity, we establish a direct experimental strategy to separate the mixed Drude, BCD, and QMD contributions based on their distinct relaxation-time dependencies. Our findings identify chiral type-II semi-Dirac semimetals as highly tunable platforms for isolating and probing intrinsic quantum geometric effects.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子几何，包括贝里曲率（BC）和量子度量（QM），支撑着广泛的拓扑和输运现象。然而，在大多数固态平台中，BC 和 QM 信号本质上是纠缠在一起的，这使得它们的实验分离极具挑战性。在这里，我们证明了 II 型半狄拉克半金属的手性极限提供了一种对称保护机制来干净地分离 QM。在自旋轨道间隙 m_z=0 的手性极限处，手性和 PT 对称性严格抑制 BC、其偶极子 (BCD) 和位移电流，使 QM 及其偶极子 (QMD) 成为光学和非线性霍尔响应的唯一来源。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 量子几何，包括贝里曲率（BC）和量子度量（QM），支撑着广泛的拓扑和输运现象。然而，在大多数固态平台中，BC 和 QM 信号本质上是纠缠在一起的，这使得它们的实验分离极具挑战性。在这里，我们证明了 II 型半狄拉克半金属的手性极限提供了一种对称保护机制来干净地分离 QM。在自旋轨道间隙 m_z=0 的手性极限处，手性和 PT 对称性严格抑制 BC、其偶极子 (BCD) 和位移电流，使 QM 及其偶极子 (QMD) 成为光学和非线性霍尔响应的唯一来源。这种纯 QM 体系表现出独特的实验指纹，包括发散的纵向光导率和 QMD 引起的非线性霍尔电导率，当化学势接近节点时，该电导率表现出明显的奇点。打开有限 m_z 会重新激活 BC 通道，将系统从纯 QM 阶段转变为混合几何阶段。通过推导非线性霍尔电导率的标度律，我们建立了一种直接的实验策略，根据不同的弛豫时间依赖性来分离混合的 Drude、BCD 和 QMD 贡献。我们的研究结果表明，手性 II 型半狄拉克半金属是用于隔离和探测内在量子几何效应的高度可调平台。

articles.title: ConvexAD: differentiable phase retrieval with geometric regularization for high-strain, low-signal Bragg coherent diffraction imaging
articles.title_zh: ConvexAD：具有几何正则化的可微相位检索，用于高应变、低信号布拉格相干衍射成像
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.05020v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Bragg Coherent Diffraction Imaging (BCDI) relies on phase retrieval (PR), a non-convex, ill-posed inverse problem whose conditioning is degraded by factors like noise, partial coherence, and strain or crystallographic defects in the imaged nanocrystal. Conventional approaches, including alternating projections and deep learning methods, represent the object on a dense voxel grid, which is prone to amplitude-phase mixing and becomes increasingly ill-posed under these factors, often preventing reliable three-dimensional mapping of the particle's shape and strain. Here we present ConvexAD, a gradient descent PR model that parametrizes the object shape as a convex polyhedron, built by the intersection of half-spaces and enforces flat amplitude within it by construction. This geometric regularization eliminates amplitude-phase mixing and reduces the number of trainable parameters, hence facilitating the convergence of the PR. Implemented in JAX for native GPU acceleration and forward-model flexibility, ConvexAD is validated on simulated and experimental BCDI data, where it outperforms conventional and deep learning assisted PR at high strain, low signal, and reduced coherence, extending the conditions under which quantitative BCDI reconstruction is achievable.
articles.abstract_zh: 布拉格相干衍射成像 (BCDI) 依赖于相位恢复 (PR)，这是一种非凸、不适定反问题，其条件会因成像纳米晶体中的噪声、部分相干性以及应变或晶体缺陷等因素而降低。传统的方法，包括交替投影和深度学习方法，在密集的体素网格上表示物体，这种网格很容易发生幅相混合，并且在这些因素下变得越来越不适定，通常无法对粒子的形状和应变进行可靠的三维映射。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 布拉格相干衍射成像 (BCDI) 依赖于相位恢复 (PR)，这是一种非凸、不适定反问题，其条件会因成像纳米晶体中的噪声、部分相干性以及应变或晶体缺陷等因素而降低。传统的方法，包括交替投影和深度学习方法，在密集的体素网格上表示物体，这种网格很容易发生幅相混合，并且在这些因素下变得越来越不适定，通常无法对粒子的形状和应变进行可靠的三维映射。在这里，我们提出了 ConvexAD，一种梯度下降 PR 模型，它将物体形状参数化为凸多面体，由半空间的交集构建，并通过构造强制其内部平坦的幅度。这种几何正则化消除了幅度相位混合并减少了可训练参数的数量，从而促进了 PR 的收敛。 ConvexAD 在 JAX 中实现，可实现原生 GPU 加速和前向模型灵活性，并在模拟和实验 BCDI 数据上进行了验证，在高应变、低信号和降低相干性方面优于传统和深度学习辅助 PR，扩展了可实现定量 BCDI 重建的条件。

articles.title: Ferron polariton Hall effect: Deflecting optically rectified polarization with magnetic fields
articles.title_zh: 铁氧体极化子霍尔效应：用磁场偏转光整流偏振
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.05025v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Ferrons are elementary excitations of ferroelectric order that can propagate and transport polarization when excited with light. Here, we show theoretically that ferron polaritons exhibit a Hall effect: an applied magnetic field generates polarization transport perpendicular to the propagation direction of a ferron polariton excited by an incident terahertz pulse. We demonstrate this effect for the example of ferroelectric SnTe using first-principles calculations and a microscopic theory of the phonon-polariton current. The direction and magnitude of the transverse polarization transport can be controlled by the polarization of the terahertz pulse and the applied magnetic field. Our results establish a route toward light-controlled directional transport of electric polarization in ferroelectrics.
articles.abstract_zh: 铁电子是铁电秩序的基本激发，当被光激发时可以传播和传输偏振。在这里，我们从理论上证明铁子极化子表现出霍尔效应：施加的磁场产生垂直于由入射太赫兹脉冲激发的铁子极化子传播方向的极化传输。我们使用第一原理计算和声子极化电流的微观理论以铁电 SnTe 为例演示了这种效应。横向偏振传输的方向和幅度可以通过太赫兹脉冲的偏振和施加的磁场来控制。我们的结果建立了一条铁电体中光控电极化定向传输的途径。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 铁电子是铁电秩序的基本激发，当被光激发时可以传播和传输偏振。在这里，我们从理论上证明铁子极化子表现出霍尔效应：施加的磁场产生垂直于由入射太赫兹脉冲激发的铁子极化子传播方向的极化传输。我们使用第一原理计算和声子极化电流的微观理论以铁电 SnTe 为例演示了这种效应。横向偏振传输的方向和幅度可以通过太赫兹脉冲的偏振和施加的磁场来控制。我们的结果建立了一条铁电体中光控电极化定向传输的途径。

articles.title: Observation of Scaling of Higher-Order Flow in a Unitary Fermi Gas
articles.title_zh: 一元费米气体中高阶流的缩放观察
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.05028v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Collective flow emerging from spatially anisotropic many-body systems is a fundamental manifestation of strongly interacting quantum matter, from ultracold quantum gases to the quark-gluon plasma created in relativistic heavy-ion collisions. Yet how collective flow emerges across different spatial harmonics and how dissipation modifies its evolution remain largely unexplored. Here we investigate the nonequilibrium expansion of a unitary Fermi gas initially confined in nearly homogeneous potentials with engineered angular deformations. By suddenly releasing the confinement, we resolve anisotropic flow harmonics up to the seventh order. Remarkably, after normalization and rescaling by the characteristic expansion timescale, the different harmonics and system sizes exhibit a universal early-time evolution. At longer times, this universality breaks down and we observe an approximately quadratic dependence of the harmonic attenuation on harmonic order, consistent with viscous acoustic scaling. Furthermore, temperature-dependent measurements reveal the role of shear viscosity in the dissipative evolution of higher-order flow. Our results open a new route to exploring the interplay between universal hydrodynamic expansion and dissipative transport, connecting collective dynamics in ultracold quantum gases with anisotropic flow in strongly interacting nuclear matter.
articles.abstract_zh: 空间各向异性多体系统中出现的集体流是强相互作用量子物质的基本表现，从超冷量子气体到相对论重离子碰撞中产生的夸克-胶子等离子体。然而，集体流如何在不同的空间谐波中出现，以及耗散如何改变其演化，在很大程度上仍未得到探索。在这里，我们研究了单一费米气体的非平衡膨胀，该气体最初被限制在具有工程角变形的几乎均匀的势中。通过突然释放约束，我们可以解析高达七阶的各向异性流动谐波。值得注意的是，在通过特征扩展时间尺度进行归一化和重新缩放之后，不同的谐波和系统尺寸表现出普遍的早期演化。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 空间各向异性多体系统中出现的集体流是强相互作用量子物质的基本表现，从超冷量子气体到相对论重离子碰撞中产生的夸克-胶子等离子体。然而，集体流如何在不同的空间谐波中出现，以及耗散如何改变其演化，在很大程度上仍未得到探索。在这里，我们研究了单一费米气体的非平衡膨胀，该气体最初被限制在具有工程角变形的几乎均匀的势中。通过突然释放约束，我们可以解析高达七阶的各向异性流动谐波。值得注意的是，在通过特征扩展时间尺度进行归一化和重新缩放之后，不同的谐波和系统尺寸表现出普遍的早期演化。在较长的时间里，这种普遍性被打破，我们观察到谐波衰减对谐波阶次的近似二次依赖性，与粘性声学缩放一致。此外，与温度相关的测量揭示了剪切粘度在高阶流耗散演化中的作用。我们的结果开辟了一条探索通用流体动力学膨胀和耗散传输之间相互作用的新途径，将超冷量子气体中的集体动力学与强相互作用核物质中的各向异性流联系起来。

articles.title: Twisting the pseudo-magnetic field lattice in periodically strained Graphene
articles.title_zh: 扭曲周期性应变石墨烯中的赝磁场晶格
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.05122v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Periodic deformations flatten electronic bands of graphene which could host strongly correlated electrons similar to those observed in twisted graphene bilayers. The most spectacular effects of strong correlations like superconductivity or magnetism have however not yet been observed despite several experimental attempts. Here, we use tight-binding calculations to investigate the effect of twisting the periodic strain lattice with respect to the atomic lattice. We find that misaligning the two lattices kills the band flattening. We also report on the universal behavior of the band flattening by periodic strain which is controlled by a single parameter, a pseudo-magnetic field flux. Our study strongly suggests that controlling the twist of the strain lattice is essential to unlock the potential of periodic strains in graphene.
articles.abstract_zh: 周期性变形使石墨烯的电子带变平，从而可以容纳与扭曲石墨烯双层中观察到的强相关电子。然而，尽管进行了多次实验尝试，但超导或磁性等强相关性的最引人注目的效应尚未被观察到。在这里，我们使用紧束缚计算来研究周期性应变晶格相对于原子晶格的扭曲效应。我们发现，两个晶格错位会破坏能带平坦化。我们还报告了由单个参数（赝磁场通量）控制的周期性应变导致能带平坦化的普遍行为。我们的研究强烈表明，控制应变晶格的扭曲对于释放石墨烯中周期性应变的潜力至关重要。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 周期性变形使石墨烯的电子带变平，从而可以容纳与扭曲石墨烯双层中观察到的强相关电子。然而，尽管进行了多次实验尝试，但超导或磁性等强相关性的最引人注目的效应尚未被观察到。在这里，我们使用紧束缚计算来研究周期性应变晶格相对于原子晶格的扭曲效应。我们发现，两个晶格错位会破坏能带平坦化。我们还报告了由单个参数（赝磁场通量）控制的周期性应变导致能带平坦化的普遍行为。我们的研究强烈表明，控制应变晶格的扭曲对于释放石墨烯中周期性应变的潜力至关重要。

articles.title: Evidence for a Dirac Spin Liquid in the Kagome Heisenberg Antiferromagnet from High-Precision Neural-Network Quantum States
articles.title_zh: 来自高精度神经网络量子态的 Kagome 海森堡反铁磁体中狄拉克自旋液体的证据
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.05174v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The spin-1/2 kagome Heisenberg antiferromagnet is a central model in the study of quantum spin liquids, yet its ground-state properties remain unresolved. We perform large-scale variational Monte-Carlo calculations using neural-network quantum states (NQSs) with kagome-geometry-aware message-passing convolution on two-dimensional tori containing up to 300 spins, and achieve exceptionally low variational energies for the kagome model. The spin and dimer structure factors show no evidence of magnetic or valence-bond long-range order. Moreover, the dominant symmetry-resolved spin and dimer correlations exhibit a common scaling behavior consistent with the emergent SO(6) monopole multiplet of the Dirac spin liquid. Finally, the fidelity of the optimized NQSs with Gutzwiller-projected mean-field states increasingly favors the Dirac state over the competing Z₂ candidates as the system size grows. Together, these complementary results provide evidence for a U(1) Dirac spin-liquid ground state in the kagome Heisenberg antiferromagnet.
articles.abstract_zh: 自旋 1/2 kagome 海森堡反铁磁体是量子自旋液体研究的核心模型，但其基态特性仍未得到解决。我们使用神经网络量子态 (NQS) 和 kagome 几何感知消息传递卷积在包含多达 300 个自旋的二维 tori 上执行大规模变分蒙特卡洛计算，并为 kagome 模型实现极低的变分能量。自旋和二聚体结构因子没有显示出磁性或价键长程有序的证据。此外，主要的对称解析自旋和二聚体相关性表现出与狄拉克自旋液体的新兴 SO(6) 单极多重态一致的常见缩放行为。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 自旋 1/2 kagome 海森堡反铁磁体是量子自旋液体研究的核心模型，但其基态特性仍未得到解决。我们使用神经网络量子态 (NQS) 和 kagome 几何感知消息传递卷积在包含多达 300 个自旋的二维 tori 上执行大规模变分蒙特卡洛计算，并为 kagome 模型实现极低的变分能量。自旋和二聚体结构因子没有显示出磁性或价键长程有序的证据。此外，主要的对称解析自旋和二聚体相关性表现出与狄拉克自旋液体的新兴 SO(6) 单极多重态一致的常见缩放行为。最后，随着系统规模的增长，具有 Gutzwiller 投影平均场状态的优化 NQS 的保真度越来越有利于狄拉克状态，而不是竞争的 Z2 候选状态。总之，这些互补的结果为 kagome 海森堡反铁磁体中的 U(1) 狄拉克自旋液体基态提供了证据。

articles.title: A Resonant-Tunneling Quantum-Dot Demultiplexer for Scalable Cryogenic Single-Electron Routing
articles.title_zh: 用于可扩展低温单电子路由的谐振隧道量子点解复用器
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.05194v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Scaling quantum electronic systems such as quantum-dot spin qubits and single-electron devices is increasingly limited by the wiring overhead between cryogenic devices and room-temperature control electronics. Multi-channel quantum-dot architectures that selectively route electrons using a few shared control lines, analogous to demultiplexers in classical networks, offer a promising solution. Here, we propose and theoretically investigate a gate-defined architecture of three parallel quantum dots sharing a common source reservoir and coupled to independent drain channels. Using an analytical electrostatic model and tight-binding quantum transport simulations, we show that the device can act as an on-chip single-electron demultiplexer based on resonant tunneling in the cryogenic regime. Closed-system eigenstate analysis reveals localized orbital states in each dot, and open-system transport calculations show resonant conductance peaks when these levels align with the incident electron energy, consistent with the closed-system eigenenergy evolution. By engineering the barrier-gate spacing and the relative plunger-gate dimensions, we obtain well-separated resonances with minimal overlap between channels. Bond-current density calculations show that transport is confined to the resonant channel with negligible leakage into neighboring outputs, yielding channel selectivity approaching unity for all resonant modes. The architecture is compatible with Si/SiGe and GaAs/AlGaAs platforms and can be extended to more channels, offering a route toward programmable quantum routing and resonant-tunneling-based quantum circuitry.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子点自旋量子位和单电子器件等量子电子系统的扩展越来越受到低温器件和室温控制电子器件之间布线开销的限制。多通道量子点架构使用一些共享控制线选择性地路由电子，类似于经典网络中的解复用器，提供了一种有前途的解决方案。在这里，我们提出并从理论上研究了共享公共源库并耦合到独立漏通道的三个并行量子点的栅极定义架构。使用分析静电模型和紧束缚量子传输模拟，我们表明该器件可以充当基于低温状态下共振隧道的片上单电子解复用器。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 量子点自旋量子位和单电子器件等量子电子系统的扩展越来越受到低温器件和室温控制电子器件之间布线开销的限制。多通道量子点架构使用一些共享控制线选择性地路由电子，类似于经典网络中的解复用器，提供了一种有前途的解决方案。在这里，我们提出并从理论上研究了共享公共源库并耦合到独立漏通道的三个并行量子点的栅极定义架构。使用分析静电模型和紧束缚量子传输模拟，我们表明该器件可以充当基于低温状态下共振隧道的片上单电子解复用器。封闭系统本征态分析揭示了每个点中的局域轨道状态，开放系统输运计算显示当这些能级与入射电子能量对齐时出现共振电导峰值，这与封闭系统本征能量演化一致。通过设计屏障门间距和相对柱塞门尺寸，我们获得了分离良好的共振，通道之间的重叠最小。键合电流密度计算表明，传输仅限于谐振通道，相邻输出的泄漏可以忽略不计，从而使所有谐振模式的通道选择性接近统一。该架构与 Si/SiGe 和 GaAs/AlGaAs 平台兼容，可以扩展到更多通道，为可编程量子路由和基于谐振隧道的量子电路提供了途径。

articles.title: Exact Rokhsar-Kivelson points hosting first-order phase transitions in S=1 compass models
articles.title_zh: S=1 罗盘模型中承载一阶相变的精确 Rokhsar-Kivelson 点
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.05326v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study S=1 compass models on the square and kagome lattices with bond-dependent bilinear and biquadratic interactions parametrized by an angle θ. For compatible geometries, we determine the exact ground-state manifolds throughout the interval π/4≤θ≤3π/4. At each endpoint, a product of on-site unitaries maps the Hamiltonian to the Laplacian of a configuration graph G in the S=1 Cartesian basis. These endpoints are exact Rokhsar-Kivelson (RK) points, with one ground state per dynamically connected component of G. Each such state is an equal-amplitude superposition in the transformed basis and acquires configuration-dependent phases upon transforming back to the original basis. Both models possess m=O(L) independent and mutually commuting conserved Z₂ line charges, where L is the linear system size, forcing a ground-state degeneracy of at least 2^m at the RK endpoints. Throughout the interior region, π/4<θ<3π/4, the ground-state manifold on each lattice is instead spanned by two product states, both annihilated by the Hamiltonian. On both lattices, each RK endpoint also hosts a first-order transition into this intervening interior phase spanned by the two product states with long-range order.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们研究了方形和 kagome 晶格上的 S=1 罗盘模型，其具有由角度 θ 参数化的键相关双线性和双二次相互作用。对于兼容的几何形状，我们确定整个区间 π/4≤θ≤3π/4 的精确基态流形。在每个端点，现场幺正的乘积将哈密顿量映射到 S=1 笛卡尔基础上配置图 G 的拉普拉斯算子。这些端点是精确的 Rokhsar-Kivelson (RK) 点，G 的每个动态连接分量都有一个基态。每个这样的状态都是变换后基中的等幅叠加，并在变换回原始基时获取配置相关的相位。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们研究了方形和 kagome 晶格上的 S=1 罗盘模型，其具有由角度 θ 参数化的键相关双线性和双二次相互作用。对于兼容的几何形状，我们确定整个区间 π/4≤θ≤3π/4 的精确基态流形。在每个端点，现场幺正的乘积将哈密顿量映射到 S=1 笛卡尔基础上配置图 G 的拉普拉斯算子。这些端点是精确的 Rokhsar-Kivelson (RK) 点，G 的每个动态连接分量都有一个基态。每个这样的状态都是变换后基中的等幅叠加，并在变换回原始基时获取配置相关的相位。两个模型都具有 m=O(L) 独立且相互交换的守恒 Z2 线电荷，其中 L 是线性系统大小，迫使 RK 端点处的基态简并度至少为 2^m。在整个内部区域，π/4<θ<3π/4，每个晶格上的基态流形都由两个乘积态跨越，这两个乘积态都被哈密顿量消灭。在这两个晶格上，每个 RK 端点还承载一个一阶过渡到由两个具有长程顺序的乘积状态跨越的中间内部阶段。

articles.title: Quantum Error Correction in Nearly Critical Toric Codes
articles.title_zh: 近临界环面码中的量子纠错
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.05375v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We investigate quantum error correction protocols for topological codes deformed away from their stabilizer limits, particularly as they are pushed towards quantum phase transitions into trivial phases. Our focus is primarily on quantum information stored within the ground-state manifold of the transverse-field toric code (TFTC), subjected to independent bit-flip and phase-flip decoherence. Although the transverse field induces strong quantum fluctuations of m anyons in the ground states, we show that projective measurements of the "bare" toric code stabilizers can nevertheless be used to construct an efficient decoding algorithm which exhibits a finite threshold to both types of decoherence, even when the transverse field is tuned infinitesimally close to the quantum critical point. Our construction of the optimal postmeasurement decoders---that is, the optimal decoders assuming that the stabilizers are first measured---crucially relies on the stoquastic nature of the TFTC Hamiltonian, which affords a description of its ground states in terms of a classical lattice gauge theory. Using stoquasticity, we first prove that stabilizer measurements act unitarily on the undecohered TFTC ground states to excellent approximation, and that the optimal postmeasurement decoder can be efficiently implemented via Monte Carlo simulation of a constrained lattice gauge theory. We then construct the optimal postmeasurement decoder for the TFTC states under bit-flip and phase-flip decoherence, where we numerically demonstrate a finite threshold close to the quantum critical point. We provide theoretical evidence (without a rigorous proof) that stabilizer measurements constitute an optimal decoding strategy in this setting. For phase-flip decoherence, we further prove that the optimal postmeasurement decoding threshold is independent of the transverse field strength throughout the topological phase.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们研究了变形远离其稳定器极限的拓扑码的量子纠错协议，特别是当它们被推向量子相变到平凡相时。我们的重点主要是存储在横向场环面码 (TFTC) 基态流形内的量子信息，受到独立的位翻转和相位翻转退相干的影响。尽管横向场在基态中引起多个任意子的强烈量子涨落，但我们表明，“裸”环面码稳定器的投影测量仍然可以用于构造有效的解码算法，该算法对两种类型的退相干都表现出有限阈值，即使横向场被调谐到无限接近量子临界点时也是如此。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们研究了变形远离其稳定器极限的拓扑码的量子纠错协议，特别是当它们被推向量子相变到平凡相时。我们的重点主要是存储在横向场环面码 (TFTC) 基态流形内的量子信息，受到独立的位翻转和相位翻转退相干的影响。尽管横向场在基态中引起多个任意子的强烈量子涨落，但我们表明，“裸”环面码稳定器的投影测量仍然可以用于构造有效的解码算法，该算法对两种类型的退相干都表现出有限阈值，即使横向场被调谐到无限接近量子临界点时也是如此。我们构建的最优测量后解码器——即假设首先测量稳定器的最优解码器——关键依赖于 TFTC 哈密顿量的随机性质，它用经典晶格规范理论提供了对其基态的描述。利用斯托量子性，我们首先证明稳定器测量统一作用于未解相干的 TFTC 基态上，具有良好的近似性，并且可以通过约束晶格规范理论的蒙特卡罗模拟有效地实现最佳后测量解码器。然后，我们构建了位翻转和相位翻转退相干下 TTC 状态的最佳测量后解码器，其中我们以数值方式证明了接近量子临界点的有限阈值。我们提供了理论证据（没有严格的证明），证明稳定器测量构成了这种情况下的最佳解码策略。对于相位翻转退相干，我们进一步证明最佳测量后解码阈值与整个拓扑相位的横向场强无关。

articles.title: samQEq: universal charge equilibration for molecules and conductors
articles.title_zh: samQEq：分子和导体的通用电荷平衡
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.03687v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Charge equilibration assigns atomic charges by equalizing an atomic chemical potential built from electronegativity, hardness and the Coulomb interaction. Under one global constraint it lets charge flow without limit between molecules, which fluctuating-charge models prevent with one neutrality constraint per molecule. A metal needs the opposite: a global constraint and a hardness near zero, and there the charge operator becomes indefinite unless it includes each charge's own self-energy. Here, we present samQEq (solids-and-molecules QEq), a unified charge-equilibration package for LAMMPS that combines the two constructions in one energy functional and one matrix-free solve. An orthogonal projector imposes one neutrality constraint per molecule, and the finite-width self-energy of a Gaussian charge on designated conductor types, narrower than the conductor's own Gaussian, keeps the conductor's part of the operator positive definite at any hardness. On a gold slab carrying a water film, the operator stays definite down to the conductor limit of the model, the metal screens a point charge by a constant amount at every height beyond 4 Å, and the film's charges stay bounded under dynamics. Reciprocal-space electrostatics is evaluated inside the matrix-vector product, and three distinct shielding kernels are run-time settings. We verify the implementation by reproducing a published fluctuating-charge water model without refitting, and the native ReaxFF charge-equilibration step to approximately 10⁻⁹,e. On a single four-V100 node the largest tested systems run at approximately twice the throughput of a 128-core CPU node. samQEq thus provides one charge-equilibration layer for molecules, conductors and the interfaces between them.
articles.abstract_zh: 电荷平衡通过均衡由电负性、硬度和库仑相互作用构建的原子化学势来分配原子电荷。在一个全局约束下，它允许电荷在分子之间不受限制地流动，而波动电荷模型通过每个分子一个中性约束来阻止这种情况。金属则需要相反的情况：全局约束和接近于零的硬度，并且电荷算符变得不确定，除非它包含每个电荷自身的自能。在这里，我们提出了 samQEq（固体和分子 QEq），这是一种用于 LAMMPS 的统一电荷平衡包，它将两种结构结合在一个能量泛函和一个无矩阵求解中。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 电荷平衡通过均衡由电负性、硬度和库仑相互作用构建的原子化学势来分配原子电荷。在一个全局约束下，它允许电荷在分子之间不受限制地流动，而波动电荷模型通过每个分子一个中性约束来阻止这种情况。金属则需要相反的情况：全局约束和接近于零的硬度，并且电荷算符变得不确定，除非它包含每个电荷自身的自能。在这里，我们提出了 samQEq（固体和分子 QEq），这是一种用于 LAMMPS 的统一电荷平衡包，它将两种结构结合在一个能量泛函和一个无矩阵求解中。正交投影仪对每个分子施加一个中性约束，并且指定导体类型上高斯电荷的有限宽度自能（比导体自身的高斯更窄）使算子的导体部分在任何硬度下保持正定。在带有水膜的金板上，操作员保持明确的模型导体极限，金属在超过 4 Å 的每个高度上以恒定量屏蔽点电荷，并且薄膜的电荷在动力学下保持有界。倒易空间静电在矩阵矢量乘积内进行评估，并且三个不同的屏蔽内核是运行时设置。我们通过复制已发布的波动电荷水模型（无需改装）和本机 ReaxFF 电荷平衡步骤到大约 10⁻⁹,e 来验证实现。在单个四 V100 节点上，最大的测试系统的运行吞吐量大约是 128 核 CPU 节点的两倍。因此，samQEq 为分子、导体以及它们之间的界面提供了一层电荷平衡层。

articles.title: Long-range entangled criticality from coherent errors
articles.title_zh: 相干错误造成的远程纠缠临界性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.03811v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We find that coherent error can induce a phase transition from the clean surface code phase into an extended long-range entangled critical regime with diverging Markov length. To demonstrate this, we establish two general results of independent interest. The first relates topology and quantum information to mixed-state entanglement: we show that when a noise channel acting on a topological code preserves a higher-form symmetry and nonzero coherent information, the noisy state for generic logical input is long-range entangled. The second generalizes the local recovery construction based on finite Markov length to any locally parameterized family, thus encompassing local Lindbladian evolution, coherent errors followed by syndrome dephasing, and thermal states. We apply these results to the honeycomb surface code, in which we find an extended long-range entangled critical regime that is a quasi-long-ranged counterpart of 1-form strong-to-weak spontaneous symmetry breaking. As a byproduct of these studies, we relate the conditional mutual information to conductance in a Majorana network model.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们发现相干误差可以引起从干净表面码相到具有发散马尔可夫长度的扩展长程纠缠临界状态的相变。为了证明这一点，我们建立了两个独立利益的一般结果。第一个将拓扑和量子信息与混合态纠缠相关：我们证明，当作用于拓扑代码的噪声通道保留更高形式的对称性和非零相干信息时，通用逻辑输入的噪声状态是长程纠缠。第二个将基于有限马尔可夫长度的局部恢复构造推广到任何局部参数化族，从而涵盖局部 Lindbladian 演化、伴随相位差的相干误差和热状态。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们发现相干误差可以引起从干净表面码相到具有发散马尔可夫长度的扩展长程纠缠临界状态的相变。为了证明这一点，我们建立了两个独立利益的一般结果。第一个将拓扑和量子信息与混合态纠缠相关：我们证明，当作用于拓扑代码的噪声通道保留更高形式的对称性和非零相干信息时，通用逻辑输入的噪声状态是长程纠缠。第二个将基于有限马尔可夫长度的局部恢复构造推广到任何局部参数化族，从而涵盖局部 Lindbladian 演化、伴随相位差的相干误差和热状态。我们将这些结果应用于蜂窝表面代码，其中我们发现了一个扩展的长程纠缠临界状态，它是 1-形式强到弱自发对称性破缺的准长程对应体。作为这些研究的副产品，我们将条件互信息与马约拉纳网络模型中的电导联系起来。

articles.title: Non-Hermitian effective dynamics from post-selection protocols
articles.title_zh: 来自后选择协议的非厄米有效动力学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.03910v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Multiple seemingly distinct frameworks are commonly proposed to explain the emergence of effective non-Hermitian dynamics in quantum systems coupled to an environment.
