Furthermore, it remains contested how to properly calculate expectation values or whether thermal equilibrium states exist in non-Hermitian systems. In this work, we show that Feshbach projection, the Lindblad master equation, and the ancilla approach can all be understood through the Kraus map formalism, leading to non-Hermitian time evolution if an appropriate post-selection procedure is enforced. After first deriving an exact expression for the conditional system dynamics, we discuss the approximations employed in each approach and the classes of non-Hermitian Hamiltonians that can be obtained. Within this framework, we physically justify the consistency of the right-right formalism (as opposed to the biorthogonal one) for calculating expectation values. Finally, we demonstrate that the traditional notion of thermodynamic equilibrium is not applicable to general non-Hermitian systems. Consequently, stationary states are characterized as non-equilibrium steady states, which should not be conflated with system-projected thermal states of the system-environment composite.
articles.abstract_zh: 通常提出多个看似不同的框架来解释与环境耦合的量子系统中有效非厄米动力学的出现。此外，如何正确计算期望值或非厄米系统中是否存在热平衡状态仍然存在争议。在这项工作中，我们表明 Feshbach 投影、Lindblad 主方程和辅助方法都可以通过 Kraus 映射形式主义来理解，如果执行适当的后选择程序，则会导致非厄米时间演化。在首先推导出条件系统动力学的精确表达式之后，我们讨论了每种方法中采用的近似以及可以获得的非厄米哈密顿量的类别。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 通常提出多个看似不同的框架来解释与环境耦合的量子系统中有效非厄米动力学的出现。此外，如何正确计算期望值或非厄米系统中是否存在热平衡状态仍然存在争议。在这项工作中，我们表明 Feshbach 投影、Lindblad 主方程和辅助方法都可以通过 Kraus 映射形式主义来理解，如果执行适当的后选择程序，则会导致非厄米时间演化。在首先推导出条件系统动力学的精确表达式之后，我们讨论了每种方法中采用的近似以及可以获得的非厄米哈密顿量的类别。在此框架内，我们从物理上证明了用于计算期望值的右-右形式主义（与双正交形式主义相对）的一致性。最后，我们证明传统的热力学平衡概念不适用于一般的非厄米系统。因此，静止状态被表征为非平衡稳态，不应将其与系统-环境复合材料的系统预测热状态混为一谈。

articles.title: Fixed-grid schemes for fractional moving-boundary problems
articles.title_zh: 分数移动边界问题的固定网格方案
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.04026v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: The Landau transformation xi = x/s(t) is the usual way to hold a moving boundary in place. It fails for fractional time derivatives because they have no chain rule: the transformed operator gains a nonlocal integral with a closed form only for self-similar fronts. We develop a sharp-interface finite-difference scheme for the conservation-consistent memory-flux fractional Stefan problem on a fixed grid, storing the memory limit h(x) = s⁻¹(x) as the time each node melts. The front is advanced using an integrated energy balance, with the singular source timed to the sub-step crossing instant. Against a known self-similar solution, the front constant is accurate to 0.02 to 0.11%, whereas competing formulations differ by 17 to 27% at alpha = 0.6. A remaining positivity violation follows from dt/t0 ~ s0^(1 - 2/alpha) and disappears on a front-locked time grid. We also derive two exact solutions with non-power-law fronts: a source-dominated solution and a Mittag-Leffler traveling wave, and verify the scheme against both. Neural-network solvers for moving boundaries are often trained in normalized coordinates; for alpha < 1, this silently changes the problem, while the change vanishes at alpha = 1, where checks are commonly performed. In the classical limit, our scheme is more accurate in 12 ms than a reimplemented moving-boundary network in 177 s.
articles.abstract_zh: 朗道变换 xi = x/s(t) 是固定移动边界的常用方法。它对于分数时间导数失败，因为它们没有链式法则：变换后的算子仅针对自相似前沿获得具有封闭形式的非局部积分。我们为固定网格上的守恒一致记忆通量分数 Stefan 问题开发了一种锐接口有限差分方案，将内存限制 h(x) = s⁻1(x) 存储为每个节点融化的时间。前端使用集成能量平衡进行推进，单一源与子步交叉瞬间同步。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 朗道变换 xi = x/s(t) 是固定移动边界的常用方法。它对于分数时间导数失败，因为它们没有链式法则：变换后的算子仅针对自相似前沿获得具有封闭形式的非局部积分。我们为固定网格上的守恒一致记忆通量分数 Stefan 问题开发了一种锐接口有限差分方案，将内存限制 h(x) = s⁻1(x) 存储为每个节点融化的时间。前端使用集成能量平衡进行推进，单一源与子步交叉瞬间同步。与已知的自相似解决方案相比，前沿常数的精确度为 0.02 至 0.11%，而竞争配方在 alpha = 0.6 时相差 17% 至 27%。剩余的正性违规从 dt/t0 ~ s0^(1 - 2/alpha) 开始，并在前端锁定的时间网格上消失。我们还推导了两个具有非幂律前沿的精确解：源主导解和 Mittag-Leffler 行波，并针对这两种解验证了该方案。用于移动边界的神经网络求解器通常在标准化坐标中进行训练；对于 alpha < 1，这会默默地改变问题，而当 alpha = 1 时，变化消失，此时通常会执行检查。在经典极限下，我们的方案在 12 毫秒内比重新实现的移动边界网络在 177 秒内更准确。

articles.title: Bicarbonate/carbonic acid equilibria in aqueous solutions: Conformational Dynamics, Ion-Pair Speciation, and Free Energy Landscapes from Ab Initio Molecular Dynamics and Metadynamics
articles.title_zh: 水溶液中的碳酸氢盐/碳酸平衡：从头算分子动力学和元动力学的构象动力学、离子对形态和自由能景观
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.04121v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Carbonic acid (H2CO3) is connected with the dissolved CO2 and bicarbonate (HCO3-) equilibria in aqueous solutions. Its two elementary reactions in water, acid dissociation and dehydration to CO2, are difficult to resolve because both are coupled to proton transfer through hydrogen-bonded networks. In this work, we combine 0.5 ns of unbiased PBE-D3 molecular dynamics of 1 molar solution of H2CO3 with metadynamics on the O - H coordination (H2CO3 = HCO3- + H+) and the C - O distance of the leaving hydroxyl (H2CO3 <=> CO2 + H2O). These unbiased trajectories show frequent cis-cis <=> cis-trans interconversion through long-lived bicarbonate (well separated from solvated proton, H3O+, and also mediated by a short-lived three-water [H2O...H3O+...H2O] ring that acts as a solvent-shared ion pair (SSIP); only 16-23% of deprotonation events reach a solvent-separated ion pair (SShIP). Resolving ion-pairs as SSIP for proper reaction leads to an improved estimate of pKa1 from 1.1 to 2.4, toward the experimental 3.45-3.59 (measured at supposedly infinite dilution). Further, metadynamics simulations provide a dehydration barrier of 17.8 (1D) and 15.3 kcal/mol (2D), suggesting that the final product CO2 + H2O is 2.8 kcal/mol below H2CO3. Our two-dimensional free energy surface also shows that C--O cleavage proceeds through the CO2 + OH- which further goes down by 9.9 kcal/mol to product CO2 + H2O.
articles.abstract_zh: 碳酸(H2CO3)与水溶液中溶解的CO2和碳酸氢盐(HCO3-)平衡有关。它在水中的两个基本反应，即酸解离和脱水生成二氧化碳，很难解决，因为两者都通过氢键网络与质子转移耦合。在这项工作中，我们将 1 摩尔 H2CO3 溶液的 0.5 ns 无偏 PBE-D3 分子动力学与 O - H 配位 (H2CO3 = HCO3- + H+) 和离开羟基的 C - O 距离 (H2CO3 CO2 + H2O) 的元动力学相结合。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 碳酸(H2CO3)与水溶液中溶解的CO2和碳酸氢盐(HCO3-)平衡有关。它在水中的两个基本反应，即酸解离和脱水生成二氧化碳，很难解决，因为两者都通过氢键网络与质子转移耦合。在这项工作中，我们将 1 摩尔 H2CO3 溶液的 0.5 ns 无偏 PBE-D3 分子动力学与 O - H 配位 (H2CO3 = HCO3- + H+) 和离开羟基的 C - O 距离 (H2CO3 CO2 + H2O) 的元动力学相结合。这些无偏轨迹显示出通过长寿命碳酸氢盐（与溶剂化质子 H3O+ 良好分离，并且还由充当溶剂共享离子对 (SSIP) 的短寿命三水 [H2O...H3O+...H2O] 环介导的频繁顺-顺-顺-反互变；只有 16-23% 的去质子化事件到达溶剂分离离子对 (SShIP)。将离子对解析为 SSIP 以进行适当的反应，可将 pKa1 的估计值从 1.1 提高到 2.4，接近实验值 3.45-3.59（在假定的无限稀释下测量）。此外，元动力学模拟提供了 17.8 (1D) 和 15.3 kcal/mol (2D) 的脱水屏障，表明最终产物 CO2 + H2O 低于 2.8 kcal/mol。 H2CO3。我们的二维自由能表面还表明，C--O 裂解是通过 CO2 + OH- 进行的，进一步降低 9.9 kcal/mol 生成 CO2 + H2O。

articles.title: Asymptotic electromagnetic transition conditions for thin layers: the arithmetic-mean field and susceptibility hybridization
articles.title_zh: 薄层的渐近电磁跃迁条件：算术平均场和磁化率杂化
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.04324v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Effective transition conditions that replace a thin polarizable layer by a zero-thickness sheet are commonly applied in electromagnetic models of two-dimensional (2D) materials and metasurfaces. These conditions usually take the arithmetic mean of the fields on either side as the polarizing field at the boundary, and characterize the layer by the 0^th moment of its susceptibility, but both choices are typically imposed rather than derived. We derive transition conditions for a finite-thickness, in-plane homogeneous, in-plane isotropic layer with a general nonlocal susceptibility, using a single-scale asymptotic expansion in η = lmax(k₀,q), where l is the layer thickness, k₀ the free-space wavenumber and q the in-plane wavenumber. The sheet limit must be taken after resumming the out-of-plane depolarizing field, as this ensures that the resulting sheet susceptibility is independent of the material thickness. The arithmetic mean then emerges as the leading-order polarizing field for general susceptibility profiles. Asymmetries in the layer profile modify the effective susceptibility appearing in the transition conditions, rather than altering the arithmetic-mean field prescription. If the spatial profile is not even in both out-of-plane coordinates, in-plane and out-of-plane response hybridize, turning the diagonal volumetric susceptibility into a q-dependent effective tensor surface susceptibility with off-diagonal components. Mirror symmetry alone does not remove this hybridization. Comparison with exact solutions for local and separable layers shows that the derived conditions remain accurate to O(η) across propagating and evanescent excitations, whereas the standard sheet conditions fail once hybridization becomes appreciable.
articles.abstract_zh: 用零厚度片材代替薄极化层的有效转变条件通常应用于二维 (2D) 材料和超表面的电磁模型中。这些条件通常将两侧场的算术平均值作为边界处的极化场，并通过其磁化率的第 0 阶矩来表征层，但这两种选择通常都是强加的而不是导出的。我们使用 η = lmax(k₀,q) 中的单尺度渐近展开式推导了具有一般非局域磁化率的有限厚度、面内均匀、面内各向同性层的转变条件，其中 l 是层厚度，k₀ 是自由空间波数，q 是面内波数。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 用零厚度片材代替薄极化层的有效转变条件通常应用于二维 (2D) 材料和超表面的电磁模型中。这些条件通常将两侧场的算术平均值作为边界处的极化场，并通过其磁化率的第 0 阶矩来表征层，但这两种选择通常都是强加的而不是导出的。我们使用 η = lmax(k₀,q) 中的单尺度渐近展开式推导了具有一般非局域磁化率的有限厚度、面内均匀、面内各向同性层的转变条件，其中 l 是层厚度，k₀ 是自由空间波数，q 是面内波数。必须在恢复平面外去偏振场之后获取片层限制，因为这确保了最终的片层磁化率与材料厚度无关。然后算术平均值作为一般磁化率分布的主阶偏振场出现。层轮廓的不对称性改变了过渡条件中出现的有效磁化率，而不是改变算术平均场规定。如果空间剖面在面外坐标中不均匀，则面内和面外响应混合，将对角体积磁化率转变为具有非对角分量的与 q 相关的有效张量表面磁化率。镜像对称本身并不能消除这种杂化。与局部层和可分离层的精确解的比较表明，在传播和消散激励下，导出的条件对于 O(η) 保持准确，而一旦杂交变得明显，标准片条件就会失效。

articles.title: Wavefront engineering with atomic Huygens' surfaces made simple
articles.title_zh: 利用原子惠更斯表面进行波前工程变得简单
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.04538v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Atomic arrays provide a cooperative platform for light-mediated interactions in nonlocal metasurfaces which can operate in the quantum regime without nanofabricated optical elements or intrinsic material absorption. We present a minimal atomic implementation to harness wavefront engineering and create a near-ideal intrinsic atomic Huygens' surface. A simple bilayer square lattice with a two-atom unit cell, not limited to small lattice spacings, provides near-unity reflectionless transmission and a full 2π phase control of transmitted light without the localized site-dependent level shifts of previous proposals. This simplification is achieved through nonlocal radiative excitations that provide the familiar electric-dipole response with even radiation parity as well as an odd-parity radiation channel whose leading multipolar interpretation combines magnetic-dipole and electric-quadrupole contributions in atoms exhibiting only electric dipole transitions. This eliminates the need to simultaneously excite pure electric-dipole and magnetic-dipole responses with exactly matched radiation. We derive a two-mode model for this response and show that it accurately captures full coupled-dipole simulations near the optimal lattice spacings. Because of the wide applicability of coupled-dipole models, the relevance of our microscopic analysis extends beyond atomic physics to nanostructured metasurfaces. Moreover, the same platform also connects directly to established subradiance-protected single-photon storage protocols, suggesting a route toward combining wavefront engineering, storage, and retrieval in a simple atomic bilayer.
articles.abstract_zh: 原子阵列为非局域超表面中的光介导相互作用提供了一个合作平台，该平台可以在量子状态下运行，无需纳米制造的光学元件或固有材料吸收。我们提出了一个最小的原子实现来利用波前工程并创建近乎理想的本征原子惠更斯表面。具有双原子晶胞的简单双层方形晶格，不限于小晶格间距，提供接近一致的无反射透射和透射光的完整 2π 相位控制，而没有先前提议的局部依赖于位点的能级偏移。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 原子阵列为非局域超表面中的光介导相互作用提供了一个合作平台，该平台可以在量子状态下运行，无需纳米制造的光学元件或固有材料吸收。我们提出了一个最小的原子实现来利用波前工程并创建近乎理想的本征原子惠更斯表面。具有双原子晶胞的简单双层方形晶格，不限于小晶格间距，提供接近一致的无反射透射和透射光的完整 2π 相位控制，而没有先前提议的局部依赖于位点的能级偏移。这种简化是通过非局域辐射激发实现的，非局域辐射激发提供了熟悉的电偶极子响应，具有偶辐射宇称以及奇宇称辐射通道，其领先的多极解释结合了仅表现出电偶极子跃迁的原子中的磁偶极子和电四极子贡献。这样就不需要同时激发具有精确匹配辐射的纯电偶极子和磁偶极子响应。我们为此响应推导了一个双模模型，并表明它准确地捕获了最佳晶格间距附近的完整耦合偶极子模拟。由于耦合偶极子模型的广泛适用性，我们的微观分析的相关性超出了原子物理学到纳米结构超表面。此外，同一平台还直接连接到已建立的亚辐射保护单光子存储协议，这提出了一种将波前工程、存储和检索结合在一个简单的原子双层中的途径。

articles.title: Machine-Learning Molecular Dynamics Reveals Grotthuss Transport in Concentrated Electrolytes
articles.title_zh: 机器学习分子动力学揭示了浓电解质中的 Grotthuss 输运
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.04558v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Proton transfer is responsible for the anomalous high conductivity in acidic or basic aqueous solutions. Yet, the contribution of the proton transfer mechanism to the conductivity of concentrated aqueous solutions is unknown. In this work, we compute the transport properties of KOH(aq) systems with different concentrations, using Molecular Dynamics simulations with a Machine Learning Interatomic Potential (MLIP), which includes proton transfer. We quantify the contribution of the proton transfer mechanism to the diffusivities of hydroxide ions and water molecules, and the ionic conductivity and transport numbers of the electrolytes. The contribution is substantial at lower concentrations, but diminishes at very high concentrations.
articles.abstract_zh: 质子转移是酸性或碱性水溶液中异常高电导率的原因。然而，质子转移机制对浓水溶液电导率的贡献尚不清楚。在这项工作中，我们使用分子动力学模拟和机器学习原子间势 (MLIP)（包括质子转移）来计算不同浓度的 KOH(aq) 系统的输运特性。我们量化了质子转移机制对氢氧根离子和水分子扩散性以及电解质的离子电导率和传输数的贡献。在较低浓度下，贡献很大，但在浓度非常高时，贡献会减弱。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 质子转移是酸性或碱性水溶液中异常高电导率的原因。然而，质子转移机制对浓水溶液电导率的贡献尚不清楚。在这项工作中，我们使用分子动力学模拟和机器学习原子间势 (MLIP)（包括质子转移）来计算不同浓度的 KOH(aq) 系统的输运特性。我们量化了质子转移机制对氢氧根离子和水分子扩散性以及电解质的离子电导率和传输数的贡献。在较低浓度下，贡献很大，但在浓度非常高时，贡献会减弱。

articles.title: Surrogate Models for Stochastic Al-Cu Phase-Field Solidification
articles.title_zh: 随机 Al-Cu 相场凝固的替代模型
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.04695v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Phase-field models resolve microstructural evolution during rapid alloy solidification, but their computational cost limits long trajectories, stochastic ensembles, and studies across process conditions. We present a variance-preserving denoising diffusion bridge model (VP-DDBM) for state-conditioned prediction of two-dimensional Al-Cu solidification. Given the current phase, concentration, and prescribed temperature fields, the model predicts the subsequent state and is applied autoregressively. Across two held-out thermal gradients, VP-DDBM produces lower long-horizon errors than deterministic U-Net and SI-ConvNeXt baselines in domain-mean phase, domain-mean Cu concentration, and leading-tip position. It also retains fine dendritic structure over long rollouts, whereas the deterministic U-Net progressively smooths the morphology. VP-DDBM predicts the phase and concentration evolution approximately 73× faster than the phase-field solver, showing potential for faster process-condition screening and ensemble-based microstructure studies.
articles.abstract_zh: 相场模型解决了合金快速凝固过程中的微观结构演化问题，但其计算成本限制了长轨迹、随机系综和跨工艺条件的研究。我们提出了一种用于二维 Al-Cu 凝固状态条件预测的保方差降噪扩散桥模型 (VP-DDBM)。给定当前相位、浓度和规定的温度场，该模型可以预测后续状态并以自回归方式应用。在两个保持的热梯度中，VP-DDBM 在域平均相位、域平均 Cu 浓度和前导尖端位置方面产生的长视野误差比确定性 U-Net 和 SI-ConvNeXt 基线更低。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 相场模型解决了合金快速凝固过程中的微观结构演化问题，但其计算成本限制了长轨迹、随机系综和跨工艺条件的研究。我们提出了一种用于二维 Al-Cu 凝固状态条件预测的保方差降噪扩散桥模型 (VP-DDBM)。给定当前相位、浓度和规定的温度场，该模型可以预测后续状态并以自回归方式应用。在两个保持的热梯度中，VP-DDBM 在域平均相位、域平均 Cu 浓度和前导尖端位置方面产生的长视野误差比确定性 U-Net 和 SI-ConvNeXt 基线更低。它还在长时间的部署过程中保留了精细的树突结构，而确定性的 U-Net 则逐渐平滑了形态。 VP-DDBM 预测相和浓度演化的速度比相场求解器快约 73 倍，显示出更快的工艺条件筛选和基于集合的微观结构研究的潜力。

articles.title: Bulk and edge states in Fibonacci-Bose-Hubbard clusters
articles.title_zh: Fibonacci-Bose-Hubbard 簇中的体态和边缘态
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.04777v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We study the one- and two-boson energy subspaces of finite open Bose--Hubbard chains with Fibonacci-modulated hopping and zero on-site potential. Their spectra exhibit a hierarchy of bands and gaps, and a critical zero-energy mode for odd lengths, in agreement with prior research. For the singe-excitation subspace we find two families of length-invariant finite-energy states localized at the left cluster boundary. For the two-boson subspace, we report both doublon and separated-pair excitations in the form of Tamm/Shockley states localized near either end. In particular, the right-edge doublon states occur across all Fibonacci generations whereas the left-side states appear every second generation. We check numerically that the second-order perturbation theory accounts well for the structure of the spectrum and the edge states in the doublon subspace in the strong-coupling regime. The results are useful for future explorations of many-body physics beyond numerical tractability, specifically using near-term Josephson quantum simulators.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们研究了具有斐波那契调制跳跃和零现场势的有限开放 Bose-Hubbard 链的一和二玻色子能量子空间。它们的光谱表现出能带和能隙的层次结构，以及奇数长度的临界零能量模式，与之前的研究一致。对于单激发子空间，我们发现两个位于左簇边界的长度不变的有限能量态族。对于双玻色子子空间，我们报告了位于两端附近的塔姆/肖克利态形式的双子激发和分离对激发。特别是，右边缘双倍状态出现在所有斐波那契代中，而左侧状态每隔两代出现一次。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们研究了具有斐波那契调制跳跃和零现场势的有限开放 Bose-Hubbard 链的一和二玻色子能量子空间。它们的光谱表现出能带和能隙的层次结构，以及奇数长度的临界零能量模式，与之前的研究一致。对于单激发子空间，我们发现两个位于左簇边界的长度不变的有限能量态族。对于双玻色子子空间，我们报告了位于两端附近的塔姆/肖克利态形式的双子激发和分离对激发。特别是，右边缘双倍状态出现在所有斐波那契代中，而左侧状态每隔两代出现一次。我们通过数值检验发现二阶微扰理论很好地解释了强耦合状态下双布朗子空间的谱结构和边缘态。这些结果对于未来对超出数值可处理性的多体物理的探索非常有用，特别是使用近期的约瑟夫森量子模拟器。

articles.title: An Exact QFT/Lattice Map for Fermions
articles.title_zh: 费米子的精确QFT/晶格图
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.05329v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We construct an exact map between continuum fermion fields and lattice fields in 1+1 dimensions. This map rewrites a continuum Hamiltonian as a lattice Hamiltonian with nearest-neighbor couplings and an infinite-dimensional local Hilbert space. The resulting lattice model reproduces exactly the energy spectrum, global operator algebra, chiral symmetries, and anomalies of the continuum QFT on any finite lattice. Unlike domain wall fermions, truncating the local Hilbert space introduces no extra massless modes, and the entanglement entropy of an interval converges as the truncation is removed. The lattice local algebras are of type I and lie between the type III continuum algebras of nested spatial regions, in accordance with the split property. We demonstrate this construction explicitly for N Majorana fermions, realizing the O(N)_LtimesO(N)_R lattice chiral symmetry. We also construct an exact lattice model for the Schwinger model and numerically reproduce the mass gap e/sqrtπ.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们在 1+1 维度上构建了连续费米子场和晶格场之间的精确映射。该映射将连续哈密顿量重写为具有最近邻耦合和无限维局部希尔伯特空间的格子哈密顿量。由此产生的晶格模型准确地再现了任何有限晶格上连续统 QFT 的能谱、全局算子代数、手征对称性和异常。与域壁费米子不同，截断局部希尔伯特空间不会引入额外的无质量模式，并且当截断被移除时，区间的纠缠熵会收敛。根据分裂性质，格局部代数属于 I 型，位于嵌套空间区域的 III 型连续统代数之间。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们在 1+1 维度上构建了连续费米子场和晶格场之间的精确映射。该映射将连续哈密顿量重写为具有最近邻耦合和无限维局部希尔伯特空间的格子哈密顿量。由此产生的晶格模型准确地再现了任何有限晶格上连续统 QFT 的能谱、全局算子代数、手征对称性和异常。与域壁费米子不同，截断局部希尔伯特空间不会引入额外的无质量模式，并且当截断被移除时，区间的纠缠熵会收敛。根据分裂性质，格局部代数属于 I 型，位于嵌套空间区域的 III 型连续统代数之间。我们明确地证明了 N 个马约拉纳费米子的这种构造，实现了 O(N)_LtimesO(N)_R 晶格手性对称性。我们还为施温格模型构建了精确的晶格模型，并以数值方式重现了质量间隙 e/sqrtπ。

articles.title: Impact of electron--spin coupling on exchange coupling parameters: a nonperturbative approach
articles.title_zh: 电子自旋耦合对交换耦合参数的影响：一种非微扰方法
articles.abstract: arXiv:2410.11256v5 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Exchange coupling parameters Jᵢⱼ in the Heisenberg model are crucial for describing magnetic behavior at the atomic level. In magnetic materials, spin fluctuations can be accompanied by a self-consistent electronic response, i.e., electron--spin coupling in the sense of electronic feedback to finite spin rotations. However, the quantitative importance of this coupling in extracting reliable Jᵢⱼ has not been fully clarified. Here, using fully self-consistent, nonperturbative evaluations, we show that finite-angle spin rotations induce such electronic feedback and quantify how strongly it renormalizes the extracted Jᵢⱼ. We examine systems of both fundamental and practical interest, including perovskite SrMnO₃, Nd-based permanent-magnet compounds (Nd₂Fe₁₄B and Nd₂Co₁₄B), and elemental 3d transition metals. The nonperturbative approach yields exchange couplings that remain consistent over a wide range of rotation angles. Moreover, when the sampled configurations represent the magnetic disorder near the transition, spin models parameterized in this way give reasonable agreement with experimental magnetic phase-transition temperatures. Overall, our results demonstrate the quantitative impact of electron--spin coupling on the exchange coupling parameters Jᵢⱼ and provide a nonperturbative route to effective Jᵢⱼ for a specified regime of magnetic disorder.
articles.abstract_zh: 海森堡模型中的交换耦合参数 Jᵢⱼ 对于描述原子水平的磁行为至关重要。在磁性材料中，自旋涨落可能伴随着自洽的电子响应，即电子反馈到有限自旋旋转意义上的电子自旋耦合。然而，这种耦合在提取可靠 Jᵢⱼ 方面的定量重要性尚未完全阐明。在这里，使用完全自洽、非微扰的评估，我们证明有限角度自旋旋转会引起这种电子反馈，并量化它对提取的 Jᵢⱼ 进行重新归一化的强度。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 海森堡模型中的交换耦合参数 Jᵢⱼ 对于描述原子水平的磁行为至关重要。在磁性材料中，自旋涨落可能伴随着自洽的电子响应，即电子反馈到有限自旋旋转意义上的电子自旋耦合。然而，这种耦合在提取可靠 Jᵢⱼ 方面的定量重要性尚未完全阐明。在这里，使用完全自洽、非微扰的评估，我们证明有限角度自旋旋转会引起这种电子反馈，并量化它对提取的 Jᵢⱼ 进行重新归一化的强度。我们研究了具有基础和实际意义的系统，包括钙钛矿 SrMnO3、Nd 基永磁化合物（Nd2Fe14B 和 Nd2Co14B）和元素 3d 过渡金属。非微扰方法产生的交换耦合在很宽的旋转角度范围内保持一致。此外，当采样的配置代表相变附近的磁无序时，以这种方式参数化的自旋模型与实验磁相变温度给出了合理的一致性。总的来说，我们的结果证明了电子自旋耦合对交换耦合参数 Jᵢⱼ 的定量影响，并为特定磁无序状态提供了有效 Jᵢⱼ 的非微扰途径。

articles.title: An Atlas of Classical Pyrochlore Spin Liquids
articles.title_zh: 经典烧绿石旋转液体图集
articles.abstract: arXiv:2411.03547v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Frustrated magnetism in the pyrochlore lattice magnet has proven to be a most fruitful setting for the experimental and theoretical search for spin liquids. Besides the canonical case of spin ice, recent works have identified a variety of new classical and quantum spin liquids engendered by the generic nearest-neighbor anisotropic spin Hamiltonian for that lattice. However, a general framework for the thorough and systematic classification and characterization of these exotic states of matter has been lacking, as has an exhaustive list of all possible spin liquids that this model can support and, perhaps most interesting, what is the corresponding structure of their emergent field theory description. In this work, we develop such a theoretical framework to identify the interaction parameters stabilizing different classical spin liquids and derive their corresponding effective generalized Gauss's laws at low temperatures. Combining this with Monte Carlo simulations, we systematically identify all classical spin liquids for the general nearest-neighbor anisotropic spin Hamiltonian on the pyrochlore lattice. In doing so, we uncover new spin liquid models with exotic forms of generalized Gauss's law and multipole conservation laws. Our approach allows us to compile an atlas of all spin liquids realized in the phase diagram, providing a global picture of their mutual connections in parameter space and transitions between them. Our work will inform future theoretical and experimental studies of classical and quantum spin liquids on the pyrochlore lattice and help rationalize the exotic properties of pyrochlore magnets.
articles.abstract_zh: 烧绿石晶格磁体中的受挫磁性已被证明是自旋液体的实验和理论研究中最富有成果的环境。除了自旋冰的典型情况之外，最近的工作还发现了由该晶格的通用最近邻各向异性自旋哈密顿量产生的各种新的经典和量子自旋液体。然而，一直缺乏对这些奇异物质状态进行彻底、系统分类和表征的通用框架，以及该模型可以支持的所有可能的自旋液体的详尽列表，也许最有趣的是，它们的新兴场论描述的相应结构是什么。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 烧绿石晶格磁体中的受挫磁性已被证明是自旋液体的实验和理论研究中最富有成果的环境。除了自旋冰的典型情况之外，最近的工作还发现了由该晶格的通用最近邻各向异性自旋哈密顿量产生的各种新的经典和量子自旋液体。然而，一直缺乏对这些奇异物质状态进行彻底、系统分类和表征的通用框架，以及该模型可以支持的所有可能的自旋液体的详尽列表，也许最有趣的是，它们的新兴场论描述的相应结构是什么。在这项工作中，我们开发了这样一个理论框架来识别稳定不同经典自旋液体的相互作用参数，并推导出它们在低温下相应的有效广义高斯定律。将此与蒙特卡罗模拟相结合，我们系统地识别了烧绿石晶格上一般最近邻各向异性自旋哈密顿量的所有经典自旋液体。在此过程中，我们发现了具有奇异形式的广义高斯定律和多极守恒定律的新自旋液体模型。我们的方法使我们能够编译相图中实现的所有自旋液体的图集，提供它们在参数空间中的相互连接以及它们之间的转换的全局图片。我们的工作将为未来对烧绿石晶格上的经典和量子自旋液体的理论和实验研究提供信息，并有助于合理化烧绿石磁体的奇异特性。

articles.title: Benchmarking and advancing machine-learning interatomic potentials for 3C-SiC across equilibrium and extreme conditions
articles.title_zh: 在平衡和极端条件下对3C-SiC的机器学习原子间电位进行基准测试和推进
articles.abstract: arXiv:2510.06966v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Several machine-learning interatomic potentials (MLIPs) have been developed for cubic silicon carbide (3C-SiC). Here, we benchmark seven existing MLIPs against a common set of structural, thermal, defect, radiation-damage, disordered-phase, and computational-performance tests. We also introduce two complementary MLIPs trained on DFT-labeled crystalline, liquid, amorphous, and defective configurations. TGAP, a Gaussian approximation potential based on the verb|soap_turbo| descriptor, provides consistently high accuracy across the sampled configurational space. MTP, a custom moment tensor potential, retains good accuracy across these regimes while offering substantially lower computational cost, GPU acceleration, and access to multi-million-atom simulations. As an application-level test, both potentials remain stable in displacement cascades spanning short-range repulsion, transient disorder, and recrystallization. Overall, MTP emerges as a particularly strong accuracy--cost compromise for large-scale and strongly non-equilibrium simulations of 3C-SiC.
articles.abstract_zh: 已经针对立方碳化硅 (3C-SiC) 开发了几种机器学习原子间势 (MLIP)。在这里，我们针对一组常见的结构、热、缺陷、辐射损伤、无序相和计算性能测试对七个现有的 MLIP 进行了基准测试。我们还引入了两种互补的 MLIP，它们经过 DFT 标记的晶体、液体、无定形和缺陷配置的训练。 TGAP，基于动词 |soap_turbo| 的高斯近似势描述符，在采样的配置空间中提供一致的高精度。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 已经针对立方碳化硅 (3C-SiC) 开发了几种机器学习原子间势 (MLIP)。在这里，我们针对一组常见的结构、热、缺陷、辐射损伤、无序相和计算性能测试对七个现有的 MLIP 进行了基准测试。我们还引入了两种互补的 MLIP，它们经过 DFT 标记的晶体、液体、无定形和缺陷配置的训练。 TGAP，基于动词 |soap_turbo| 的高斯近似势描述符，在采样的配置空间中提供一致的高精度。 MTP 是一种自定义矩张量势，在这些机制中保持良好的准确性，同时提供显着降低的计算成本、GPU 加速以及对数百万原子模拟的访问。作为应用级测试，两种电势在跨越短程排斥、瞬态无序和再结晶的位移级联中保持稳定。总体而言，MTP 对于 3C-SiC 的大规模和强非平衡模拟来说是一种特别强的精度和成本折衷方案。

articles.title: Photoinduced topological phase transition in monolayer 1T^prime-MoS₂
articles.title_zh: 单层 1T^prime-MoS2 中的光致拓扑相变
articles.abstract: arXiv:2511.15268v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We investigate the systematic competition between perpendicular electric field and circularly polarized light in nonequilibrium topological phases of monolayer 1T^prime--MoS₂ using a low-energy k!·!p Hamiltonian and Floquet theory. The off-resonant field generates spin- and valley-dependent mass corrections that reshape the Berry curvature (BC) and shift the conditions for band inversion. By evaluating the quasienergy bands, BC, and spin- valley-resolved Chern numbers, we identify a sequence of light and electric field controlled topological transitions by gap closing. Depending on the Floquet coupling strength and the electric-field parameter, the system evolves between the equilibrium quantum spin Hall (QSH) state and a set of driven phases including spin-polarized quantum Hall insulator (S-QHI), band insulator (BI) and photo-induced quantum Hall insulator (P-QHI) regimes. The results establish 1T^prime--MoS₂ as a tunable platform where circular driving selectively manipulates spin and valley degrees of freedom, enabling controlled access to non-equilibrium topological phases in transition metal dichalcogenides (TMDs).
articles.abstract_zh: 我们使用低能 k!·!p 哈密顿量和 Floquet 理论研究了单层 1T^prime--MoS2 非平衡拓扑相中垂直电场和圆偏振光之间的系统竞争。非共振场产生与自旋和谷相关的质量校正，从而重塑贝里曲率（BC）并改变能带反转的条件。通过评估准能带、BC和自旋谷解析的陈数，我们确定了一系列光和电场通过间隙闭合控制的拓扑转变。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们使用低能 k!·!p 哈密顿量和 Floquet 理论研究了单层 1T^prime--MoS2 非平衡拓扑相中垂直电场和圆偏振光之间的系统竞争。非共振场产生与自旋和谷相关的质量校正，从而重塑贝里曲率（BC）并改变能带反转的条件。通过评估准能带、BC和自旋谷解析的陈数，我们确定了一系列光和电场通过间隙闭合控制的拓扑转变。根据 Floquet 耦合强度和电场参数，系统在平衡量子自旋霍尔 (QSH) 状态和一组驱动相之间演化，包括自旋极化量子霍尔绝缘体 (S-QHI)、能带绝缘体 (BI) 和光致量子霍尔绝缘体 (P-QHI) 状态。结果将 1T^prime--MoS2 确立为可调谐平台，其中循环驱动选择性地操纵自旋和谷自由度，从而能够受控地进入过渡金属二硫化物 (TMD) 中的非平衡拓扑相。

articles.title: Field-induced first order quantum phase transition of the superconducting order parameter in Ising superconductors with Rashba spin-orbit coupling
articles.title_zh: 具有 Rashba 自旋轨道耦合的伊辛超导体中超导有序参数的场致一阶量子相变
articles.abstract: arXiv:2512.01910v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Ising superconductors have attracted significant attention recently due to their resilience against magnetic fields far beyond the Pauli-paramagnetic limit as well as their broader role as a platform for exploring the interplay of spin-orbit coupling, valley degrees of freedom and superconducting pairing in two-dimensional materials. Their protection against external magnetic field relies on strong Ising spin-orbit coupling, which originates from in-plane inversion symmetry breaking. Due to the heavy atom nature of Ising SCs, a smaller but sizable Rashba SOC can arise from gating or interfacial effects. Here, we study Rashba spin-orbit coupling within a two-valley model of Ising superconductors with an attractive s-wave interaction. We show that Rashba SOC induces a first order quantum phase transition in Ising superconductors. At low temperatures, this means the superconducting order parameter vanishes abruptly in the vicinity of the quantum critical point. This effect, however, disappears at high temperatures. Our findings demonstrate that the low- and high temperature physics of Ising SCs are quantitatively and qualitatively different in the two-valley model.
articles.abstract_zh: 伊辛超导体最近引起了极大的关注，因为它们对远远超出泡利顺磁极限的磁场的抵抗能力，以及它们作为探索二维材料中自旋轨道耦合、谷自由度和超导配对相互作用的平台的更广泛作用。它们对外部磁场的保护依赖于强伊辛自旋轨道耦合，这种耦合源于面内反演对称性破缺。由于 Ising SC 的重原子性质，门控或界面效应可能会产生较小但相当大的 Rashba SOC。在这里，我们研究具有吸引力的 s 波相互作用的伊辛超导体双谷模型内的 Rashba 自旋轨道耦合。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 伊辛超导体最近引起了极大的关注，因为它们对远远超出泡利顺磁极限的磁场的抵抗能力，以及它们作为探索二维材料中自旋轨道耦合、谷自由度和超导配对相互作用的平台的更广泛作用。它们对外部磁场的保护依赖于强伊辛自旋轨道耦合，这种耦合源于面内反演对称性破缺。由于 Ising SC 的重原子性质，门控或界面效应可能会产生较小但相当大的 Rashba SOC。在这里，我们研究具有吸引力的 s 波相互作用的伊辛超导体双谷模型内的 Rashba 自旋轨道耦合。我们证明 Rashba SOC 在伊辛超导体中引发一级量子相变。在低温下，这意味着超导有序参数在量子临界点附近突然消失。然而，这种效应在高温下消失。我们的研究结果表明，伊辛 SC 的低温和高温物理在双谷模型中在数量和质量上都有所不同。
